misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/a.title: Adventure Team 1
misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/a.description:
Andreas Rooks a well respected military leader from Owariyaru, in charge of Venture Team 1. Died, someone wished him back
Katherine Rooks: a minor political figure, in charge of strategy, wife of Andreas Rooks works with main operations rather than any particular Venture team though she has an obvious favorite.
Laura Rooks: Prodigal swordswoman of Owariyaru, proved her mettle in a small border skirmish with Vozgoa but hasn't done any campaigns far outside country borders, part of venture team 1
Alec Rooks: Was in charge defenses during the border skirmish, proved competent at his job but not enough to earn true respect, seeking to change this with a daring expedition. part of venture team 1
Aaron Rooks: Finally completed training too late to prove himself, will be his first real mission, part of venture team 1

misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/a.title: Adventure Team 2
misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/a.description:
Adventure Team 2 is the knowledge team. they help gather intel and cast spells
- Hatae Casilltenirra: A famous witch looking to separate herself from her patron through the largest stretch imaginable, brilliantly minded but very locked up about her past, in charge of Venture Team 2
- Dalgal Balderk: Dwarven paladin of Angradd from Thaumdeep, he is seeking a chance to seek dwarven holds across The Pale and spread his beliefs to them, charming but abrasive, part of venture team 2
- Katherine Stratford: An exile from Arctur following the fall of her empire, she was in charge of many raids on the vassal states before being overrun and forced to retreat. Denied the leader position due to hostility between the funder of the expedition and due to her not wishing to lead anymore. Part of Venture Team 2
- Ralf Trowbridge: A hermit of a man, dedicated to Erastil and wishes to see as much of nature as he can before his passing, Good drinking buddy if offputting, part of venture team 2 - died

misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/a.title: Adventure Team 3
misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/a.description:
Adventure Team 3 is the diplomacy team.
- Jo Stonebridge: Halfling Bard admirer of Merris, volunteered for leadership of Venture team 3 in order to prove herself to him, unknown if he even is aware of her existence
- Rohesia Stanley: Fighter from Ensile, believes innocence can be found across the pale and thus seeks to find it, more religious than the paladin, part of venture team 3
- Gimgen Trollbleeder: Named due to his insistence that his patients can lose a little more blood so they need not panic, medical doctor by trade, bad habit of not washing between operations, part of venture team 3
- Eldon Sympony: sorcerer from the gnome quarter of Brazenthrone, was undergoing the bleaching before he decided to go across the pale, seems to be healthier by the day, part of venture team 3
- Elysande Windsor: Cleric of Sarenrae, she seeks to learn how the religion has evolved in the time the two lands have been separated, kind but bound to fits of delusions, part of venture team 3

misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/t.title: Teamless
misc/groups/frethiar/wandering-embassy/t.description:
Captain Moreg Na'thril: A former captain from Caldera who has been searching for his own ship following the Caldera Calamity, a former pirate by trade. Well respected among the crew.
- Navigator Solune Verin: A cartographer by trade, hoping to be able to use the new Zilsparian map technology and reproduce it. An avid historian but mostly for Geological samples.
- Bosun Brackdraw: the bosun of the ship in charge of equipment. A merchant by trade who is praying the lands are empty so he can make his fortune
- Translator Moivicius Vrirevi: A man specializing in cultures from the Nexus in Advesperascit, was in charge of evacuation during the Wanting Throne incident.
- Belanor Sarberos: Venture team 0 defeated him and his drake companion. He could not return to his employer so he joined the Wandering Embassy. Can help with rituals - notes to be added
- Namaiye Basi : halfling ritualist who is friends with Belanor Sarberos

misc/groups/novu-mundi/dawnweaver-gnolls.title: Dawnweaver Gnolls
misc/groups/novu-mundi/dawnweaver-gnolls.description:
from the Vespertine Empire
nomadic group native historically to the Ensile Peninsula, famous for being one the few people to be able to accurately find manifest zones of the divine gate, they use a mixture of arts and divination in order to follow the dusk and dawn skies and divine where the manifest zones will appear. Typically troupes are no larger than 30, with a relatively close community that gathers in collectives once every seven and half years. Life on the road is rough, and unfortunately the divine gates don't wait for those that can't keep up. If someone is unable to make the trip they are abandoned in the nearest town given enough supplies to be able to haggle for food and shelter for the rest of your days. Often these abandoned folk become artists and other creatives reflecting their travels back onto their new home and eventual grave.

A fragmented portion of the Deep Soul that wished to save those from the backlash of the ascension
She reached out to Kyrie Edofol and brought her to the Freilands, giving her Adina, and directed her to joining Merris Hasalk's mission in Frethïar.
There, Kyrie placed a dream copy of Adina into the sleeping mind of the World Dragon, allowing it to rest and allowing her to become basically a god of the dragon's memory of Eberron.
Spreading the dream to Novu Mundi via dream spiders, but Kyrie will likely die before it encompasses a whole continent.

npcs/former-pcs/kyrie-edofol/kyrie-edofo.description:
Info


Adina. Deep Soul (Kyrie's Patron)
From ZupoolAge: 113 (Born Zima 2nd, 1149)
Given Death mark by Vol
Character Backstory Taken in by Iustus Edofol in what is now Greenpaths when she was a child, she was brought to what is now Hols not long after. She grew up being a bookworm, not as interested in what they were doing. After nearly 3 decades of it, they forced her to travel the old empire and become helpful to the people who needed it most. She made friends from this, exposing her to different parts of the continent she never anticipated where she started getting strange dreams that left her confused and curious in the morning. They kept happening, until she began having dreams of people she'd grown close to dying to killers, disease, curses, and at the end: an offer of being able to help them in exchange for making a pact. Settling into the pact wasn't too bad; she began sleepwalking, waking up to find herself in the center of town, which soon extended to the city next door as her power grew. After a few years, she'd wake up and find herself lost somewhere she'd never been before. Over the years, her patron became more and more pushy, pushing her toward and away certain things, only for her to end up being recruited for the follow-up expedition across The Pale. She got nightmares for days until she agreed to going. Iustus never liked this pact that she made, and liked even less that she was leaving across the Pale so soon after Auctur fell since it was such an uncertain time. Iustus Edoful (Ee-oo-stus) - A gnome w/ dragonblood (~191y/o) who's been fighting off boredom as long as Kyrie has known them. They look closer to a kobold than a standard gnome, with a large scar going down the right side of their face. They're nominally a fortune teller by trade, but they flitted between jobs just as fast as they got them.

Pipo

Witch of GalorfinBackstory Outline
from Emerald Coast, on good terms family Shy as a kid, people were not very nice to her, but liked to read a lot, always getting lost in books and loosing track of time. very interested in stars and magic Isn't quite dedicated to studying to go get advanced degrees and study forever Got a job working at a magic item shop, too shy to talk to magic item, use her powerful mind to make them activated Met her husband, a wizard-ly studious professor type, decided to settle down together Had a few kids, one of which is deaf, one of whom loves animals (specifically dinosaur) Kids are grown now Husband busy with work Currently investigating the mess we caused last summer Time to get a part time job to have something to do now that the kids are gone Librarian / bookstore person / archivist - oh wow spooky eldritch tomes? magic at a low cost? warp time and space? surely thats kind of bs dont mind if i do. “Basically there's an entity who marched with time though through the hubris of man he was left at the edge of reality with only time by his side, every step he takes no matter the direction is a step further from home and thus he does not move merely holds time and watches. He cannot return home but he can still observe it through the eyes of others. An artifact of his recently went missing and while impossible to discern for all but the most powerful of mages it could have found its way in your shop” Wow now I have my son's pet dinosaur as my familiar and I can cast spells Time to go on some adventures! npcs/former-pcs/edgar-alexander.html.title: Edgar Alexander
npcs/former-pcs/edgar-alexander.html.description:
Human Wizard from Earth. Joined the Drunken Lords.
At the end of his adventures, traveled to Nebraska(?).
Eventually grew bored and traveled to Novu Mundi.
Built an observatory to study the Pale(?) I was originally from an entirely different world, one where magic was only fantasy. I was flung into this world, without any warning, and consequently separated from everything I knew and loved. I have vague flashes of memory where I'm within a primordial space before I arrived in this world, but the only reason I know they're memories is that I can inexplicably understand the primordial language.After arriving in a random area and surviving in the wild for a bit, I stumbled on a city and found some respite at a local church. Here I learned Common and some of the local culture. I left before they could indoctinate me into their religion, but not before I learned a bit of magic from a disgraced and dying wizard.Afterward I did what I needed to keep myself afloat and learn as much about the world and magic as I could, be it doing odd jobs, living in the forest, or stealing books. Maybe I could figure out how/why I came to be here in the first place.Apart from how I was wrenched from my home and that there is something in my mind I can't quite remember, I am always at least a little on edge about believing in my own sanity, because "I'm living in a game of d&d. There's a large chance I'm just crazy in one way or another."Having no real way to verify my sanity, I default to the option of trusting in my senses and what has tangible, evidential effects on the world I percieve... That doesn't stop me from obsessing and spiraling, every now and again though.
From Nebraska
Eberron

Fucking over Aberdeen Skimberton's experiments in Rozen Character Questions Why is your character willing to go to the thawing mechanical lands?
She's tasked with making sure Caoilinn O'Connor doesn't flake out on her debts. Where Caoilinn goes, she goes. Any gold is good gold, and since much of the gold she had has gone to her family. What do they wish to find there? Ideally? A way to drag her family up from the hell they've been tossed in. Realistically? Something that she can prove her worth to those who love her. Where are they from? Thernos. Her family still lives there, though their home is not as nice as it once was. Who were they to the community they were from? Second child of the former noble Calloway family, as well as the family disappointment; she was sent off to fight and couldn't even do that right. Who is their closest person? Where is that person right now? (Bonus points for 2-3 more people)
Cyril Calloway - Her elder brother and the "golden child" of the family. He's back at home trying to make connections with the newly risen nobility in the hopes he can pull enough strings and get their family back on their feet. He is who she sends her earned gold off to, since she doesn't particularly trust their other family members.
Ansgar Nightstone - An older dwarven man from Hols who pitied Joan enough after the dissolution of the old nobility to hand her a couple "freebie" jobs. He typically sends her jobs with the promise of getting a cut of her reward in turn. What’s the most impactful moment in your characters life so far? (Bonus points for 2-3 more key moments) The first time she realized she was different from her family. "Joan," her brother lamented, bandaging her upper arm. He was twelve, and she was ten. "You can't keep doing this. Mother will throw a fit if she sees you've gotten hurt again." "But-" she starts, and is quickly interrupted. "No buts. You're a Calloway, not a street rat. And you haven't attended studies in nearly three days." She hated her studies. They all knew it. It seemed, too, that she was the only one who hated their studies. Why wouldn't she, when all they learnt about half the time were nobles who leered at her for her strange eyes, for her blunt attitude. She hated them, and she suspected they hated her. "...Yes, Cyril," murmured Joan for not the first time in her life, but it was likely the most bitter one spoken so far. The first time she got into a fight. She's fifteen. Her blood had felt like it was on fire, and she couldn't help but grin. She's sure she looked demented, as blood leaked from her broken nose and she took another swing. "The hell's wrong with her?!" one of the men shouted. He'd dropped the gold he stole long ago, and his buddies seemed to be trying to pick it up while they fought. She laughed, which only seemed to weird him out more. "Shit's not right!" He managed to kick her, sending her halfway acrosd the alley and leaving her sprawled on the hard ground. He and his buddies took that as their chance to book it. She got up still grinning that bloody grin. The first time she was actually thanked for helping. She's twenty-three. "Thank you," the child had murmured through tears as Joan set her down. Both their clothes were a bit dirtied, but they were otherwise unharmed. Her own new dress, however, was ruined, with a large slice through the front. Joan blinked, almost alarmed as her heart jackrabbited in her chest. She'd just stopped some asshole creep from hurting the child, but this... was new. She couldn't ever remember the last time she was thanked for something. "It's... not problem, dear," Joan managed out, but her smile was intense. It didn't even go away after she got home and got her scolding. What’s your characters goal? Gathering up enough gold and influence to make sure her family back home is safe, happy, and taken care of, no matter what it takes. What do you, as a player, want to get out of playing this character narratively? I'd like her to realize that she's worth more than her ability to make money or fight. She's currently pretty single minded on that, but I think being in a party will help fix her of that habit. What do you, as a player, want to get out of this character from a mechanical/gameplay perspective? i love playing a character that can hit hard! i havent played a fighter yet, so i'll likely be getting a feel of the play style as the game progresses From a story perspective, why is your character the class they are? Why aren’t they any other class? She's never been smart or charismatic enough like her brother to be in high society, and the fact of the matter is, she's been picking fights since she was a teenager. How do your highest skills reflect your characters personality? Due to not holding up to expectations had of her, she never truly held onto the majority of things she was taught and instead did her own thing growing up. (Athletics +7) She was always more interested building herself up than learning about the noble families she was supposed to know (Society +3). This led to her sneaking out as a child often (Stealth +5). As of late, she's been given a good couple "hunt this person down" jobs, so she's been learning how to deal with the wilderness and follow tracks (Survival +4). Describe your characters moral or ethical beliefs. What would have to happen for them to go against their morals? Be altruistic. You have to do whatever it takes to survive. Don't lie. Everyone lies, but you don't have to. Pay a fair price... and if others don't, make sure they do. Her trust has to be lost. Betrayal is not something she takes lightly, especially when it affects those she cares about. How is the relationship with her parents? Are they alive or did they die during the rebellion? It was strained while growing up, and still remains strained. Her father was injured during the rebellion and has been bed ridden since. Her mother stays by his side. She still sometimes writes her own letter and sends it along with Cyril's, but it's grown less frequent than it used to be. What assets does her brother control, are they even enough to still consider the family a noble house? The majority of their land was seized during the rebellion, alongside their old family home. They managed to keep some of their land and built a relatively nice home, but they would certainly no longer be considered a noble house. They have no authority in the area anymore, but Cyril is still trying to pull some strings to see if that could change. How would you describe her fighting style? Is it more fencing based or street fighting based? A mixture of both, but she leans more heavily into the street fighting as of late with there being no one to train with her like she had as a child. She's more of a heavy hitter as of late, but still tries to stay light on her feet in case things go south. What type of fighting did she do during the rebellion? Why was she considered a failure there? She wasn't able to protect her father like she intended to. She got too wrapped up in making sure that insurgents didn't get past her that she wasn't able stop her father from getting hurt. And, when he did, she abandoned her spot to keep his attacker from dealing the finishing blow. She wasn't the first to abandon their spot, or get cut down, but the way her father blamed her felt like she was.

npcs/former-pcs/onarach-agus-fìor.html.title: Onarach Agus Fìor
npcs/former-pcs/onarach-agus-fìor.html.description:
Onarach was born to a single working mother in a run down home in a small town. The two weren’t necessarily unhappy with their lot in life, but the cooking job Onarach’s mother worked at left much to be desired in terms of a comfortable livelihood. On the occasions when a rich nobleman or merchant would stop on their way through town, Onarach would take note and ponder the difference between himself and those with means. This sort of pondering eventually showed itself as his main personality trait and his mother did what she could to encourage his mind to grow. She scavenged discarded books where she could find them, used what money they could spare to buy ink and paper, and taught what she could herself. Onarach never considered it until later in life, but his mother was surprisingly knowledgeable for someone of their class. Maybe his father had taught her or she had a more interesting past than she let on, but she never told him, and he never thought to ask until it was too late. Whatever the case, he was just happy that he could learn about things that interested him. And nothing interested him more than alchemy. In general, he liked just to make things, but the things one could make with alchemy were the most amazing to Onarach. Potions, elixirs, poisons, explosions… it all enthralled him and he took to alchemy with passion. Eventually, he came of age and his mother managed to secure an apprenticeship for him in a large city about a couple weeks travel from home. He promised to make her proud and support her as much as he could. Maybe one day he would open up his own shop and purchase them a nice comfortable place to live. In the city, Onarach kept true to his word and set his nose to the grindstone. He rented and lived in a room below his means to save as much money as possible and bought only what was absolutely necessary, sending what he could afford not to save back to his mother at home with his letters. His mother told him that it was unnecessary, but he sent the money all the same. And since he used very little money on himself, he spent most of his free time in libraries, experimenting, and occasionally exploring the wild city. By the time he was 19, Onarach had gained a few chemical scars, a decent nest egg, and a sharp mind. However, it was around this time when the trickle of letters from his mother had stopped completely. After three months of no reply, he took some time off and went to see her. His childhood home was completely barren and his neighbors informed him that his mother had died of a rare disease. It turns out that she had been hiding her sickness from him for a long time, and although it was curable, the treatment was ridiculously expensive. It seems that she might have sold off everything just to keep it at bay for as long as she could, or at least, that’s what he was told. In shock and grief, Onarach didn’t really know what to do next. So he just headed back to work. For a while, he did nothing but work, eat, sleep, and think about how all his past problems could have been solved, were he only born rich… Living life, he came to speculate, was in itself a goal and aspiration to aim for. But being wealthy can greatly increase one’s longevity and ability to enjoy all aspects of life. After all, money could afford him books, experimentation supplies, quality apprenticeship, quick passage home, life-saving medicine, and even magical/alchemical ways of extending his life. With the way he was now and the amount of life he had probably had left, he couldn’t even hope to have enough time to become as wealthy as he needed to be in order to really “live” life… Not unless he could find a ludicrously profitable way of getting rich quick or a secret way to significantly extend his lifespan. All this he pondered in the cold logical space of his grief as he went through the daily motions, like an automaton, for several months after the news of his mother’s death. But then, like a sign from the gods, Onarach stumbled upon a rumor about a secret alchemical concoction that could potentially provide the user with indefinite youthful health. It was hidden in the footnote of an old, disused library book, and the rumor was dubious at best, but it gave him all the reason he needed. Onarach quit his job, took his alchemical gear, and abandoned society for the woods. Telling himself that the reason he was running to the woods was to get rid of distraction, he found a good spot with not too many dangers around and a nice little stream nearby and set to work. It was tough going. Onarach had very little experience with the wild before and nearly died several times for minor mistakes. But eventually, he became a seasoned woodsman over the course of nearly twenty years as he worked on discovering a formula for an elixir of youth, out in the woods. Much of his experimenting quite literally blew up in his face. He never seemed to make any progress with the youth potion, but at the very least, he had several new explosive ways of keeping wild animals at bay. And while he had become very cynical about society as a whole, he could never really disengage himself fully from it. After all, society had books, and good alchemical supplies, and entertainment. Trips back to town were a regular occurrence. On one of his trips, he even ended up buying a canine companion which would both help him hunt and keep him company. Eventually, however, Onarach’s stagnation got to him. He had made next to no progress on an elixir of eternal youth in twenty years and the lack of new experience was positively mind-numbing. So he decided to finally pull himself together and reintegrate into society with the express purpose of pursuing his dual, co-dependent goals of obtaining wealth and the secret to youthful immortality. And with that, it has been a year since Onarach had left the forest. He now wanders the continent, going from town to city selling his alchemical wares, saving money, finding new formulas, looking for new experiences, and searching for any information on the elixir of youth. Description ~ 40 years old (Looks both older and younger than he is at the same time) Skin tanned and weatherworn with small chemical scars across arms and face Patchy eyebrows (perpetually growing back) Toned but not muscular 5’11” Shoulder length unkempt hair; dark brown Face stubble Sold Gold Master Sun Orchid Elixir
Crossed The Pale to Frethïar
Lives in Castle Alchemy, Ciburn Human Alchemist Member of the 20MM.
Son of Einsed Rider and Adriana S. Fìor.

DE 1225 — Marriage to Léonie Keson in Vitry-Seilave, Tunseel

Elf - Writer with a focus in romance novels (Night Under the Seven Suns, a short series about a priestess of Sarenrae and a priestess of Pharasma overcoming hardships and falling in love, was notably popular for a time) - Moved to Frontillé from the capital not long after Viktor was born, ended up getting wooed by his mother and they got married soon after. pcs-(active)/fitzie-fairntickle.html.title: Fitzie Fairntickle
pcs-(active)/fitzie-fairntickle.html.description:
Family❄️Father: Fitzie's Dad
Mother: Elidira Fairntickle (b. DE 1225)
Lila Fairntickle (b. DE 1262)Timeline❄️📋DE 1260age 0 — Born in Melissa, Emerald Coast
DE 1289age 29 — Marriage to Lila Fairntickle in Caldrith, Numartu
DE 1290age 30 — Start of Feywild Incursion Campaign in Caldrith, Numartu
DE 1290age 30 — Azreal Blight Joins Feywild Incursion Campaign in Caldrith, Numartu
Info

Gnomish wizard from Collegium Arcanum in Caldrith looking for her missing wife Lila Fairntickle
MelissaSPOILERS The city itself appears stressed. The most powerful mages seem to spend most of their days casting walls of stone in order to expand the walls and ports rather than doing research leaving the students to run amok. The lesser fey of grimples and miflits, or of brownies and toothfairies stay far away from the Arcadum preferring the softer targets that won’t banish them. You make most of your living off of helping people with these pests though you’ve yet to have to encounter a major fey and gods willing it’ll stay that way.
Your wife went missing around the time the old Duke Miryel Siroth went missing. She worked as an aid to him occasionally, and he’d seek her out over Ephiane Savile for some reason you were not privy to.
Thoqiohne has a fondness for guns. A fellow student, Sifri Emberbead (Kobold Witch), has started talking to him about it. Though he has never been spotted firing one.
You’re fairly certain your acquaintance Thromulus was not responsible, he lacks the magic necessary and has his own missing person from around that same time. During the time when the stars were gone, only 51 stars have come back to the night sky. They are not the same ones as before. Who are you now? Fitzie Fairntickle (she/her) Wellspring Gnome (arcane) Born Tem 6th, 1260 Why are you the class you are? What drew you to this path over all others? Wizard Why are you the calling you are? What drew you to this path over all others? Sage’s Calling What do you specialize in? Combat, magic, faith, cunning, artistry, diplomacy, etc.? Magic and general lores What are your personal edicts and anathemas? Describe a situation that might challenge or complicate those beliefs. Edicts: Delve into diverse fields of study, never limiting yourself to a single area of expertise. Embrace mistakes as valuable learning opportunities. Let personal connections guide you to where you need to be. Anathemas: Turning away from a mystery or puzzle that begs to be solved. Making and breaking promises without thought to the consequences. Exploit the fears or vulnerabilities of those seeking guidance. Should her mistakes lead to promises being broken, she may have to take pause and really consider if the promise was worth it at all. Should her divinations show her that hurting those seeking guidance would bring her closer to her goals, she may have to go through with it. What are your current goals? What do you want to change or preserve in the world? Current goals are to find Lila and further delve into what is happening with the missing and newly arriving stars. Why are you in the free land of Numartu in the city of Caldrith, where the river splits? She is a student at the Collegum Arcanum, but she has between towns nearby trying to track down where Lila might’ve gone. How did you become the class you are? Training, natural talent, circumstance, etc? Studying, though not as dedicated as she could’ve been since she flits about from interest to interest How did you gain your mythic spark? Was it granted by a god, stolen from a relic, born of tragedy, etc?
It came after a long, sleepless night, She was busy working on research for professor Ildor Ilnudor; something felt wrong, briefly, and she looked to the sky. Something within her clicked, and she woke up the next morning utterly confused with a large spread of books around her and the beginnings of the spark within her. It was the same day that Lila went missing. Were you born after the Return of the First World? Were you old enough to remember it? She was born before, but was a bit too young to remember the world being any different than it is right now. Who were you before the campaign? On the path of fully solidifying her thesis and graduating from her school. Potentially was going to become a fully blown adventurer like her mother, maybe even join her. Are you tied to any orders, kingdoms, faiths, or circles? She’s a student at the Collegeum Arcanum, but otherwise no. What was your life before you became part of that group or cause? Bored out of her mind and directionless. It took the beginnings of gray hair at a young age that scared her mom and Aldri into enrolling her at the school, whereupon she brighted up almost immediately after. What is your strongest memory from earlier in life? Are there memories you’ve lost or ones that haunt you? She remembers when her mom and her sibling got into a big argument regarding their parents. Fitzie remembers standing outside the door, wanting to show them the book that she had picked up with Aldri that afternoon. Fennel had stormed off, all but accidentally ramming into Fitzie in the process. She remembers how they had quietly apologized and brought her to her feet. They had seemed so sad, but even after being there for the whole conversation, Fitzie can’t remember what started the argument. If your life had gone differently, what would you be doing now?
Likely still studying underneath professor Ildor Ilnudor, maybe further helping him with his research into the stars post-Rozen Crisis. If she could, she’d probably be joining her mom on adventures. Where were you born or raised? A small town in western Emerald Coast (name tbd once you get maps up and going lol). Who were you closest to in your past?
In her childhood, Fitzie made friends with a few kids in her town (Retta Pith (she/her, half-orc) and Calder Ceslistan (they/them, human)). They’d hung out constantly, but fell distant once her mom started leaving more and more to bring back gold, which only caused Fitzie to almost exclusively talk about her for a time (she thought her mom was The Coolest Person Ever). Fitzie didn’t understand why they didn’t feel the same way. Who do you consider family: by blood, bond, or oath? She considers her bonds incredibly important, but does recognize when her word and oaths overshadow them. Describe a moment or event that deeply shaped who you are now.
When she first went to the Collegeum Arcanum, she didn’t really have any sort of idea what she wanted to do. For at least the first few days, she had holed herself up in the library. While she didn’t exactly get kicked out, Thoqiohne did seem to eventually tire of her continued and overbearing presence and asked her to leave. She wandered the courtyard until she just sat in the grass and stared up at the evening sky. Professor Ilnudor found her there and just spent the next long while talking to her. It made her happy, and she sought out his classes to continue their discussion. He hasn’t gotten rid of her since. Name three NPCs from your past that you still think about. Are they alive? Where are they now?
]
Lila Fairntickle (née Isleys) Human Sorcerer Born Preispo 20th, 1262 Has 2 younger brothers, Lyall Isleys and Asher Isleys Wife and classmate Met her at school, ‘loosely’ dated (in Fitzie’s eyes) for about 6 years before Lila was like. Hey. I’m human. Can we like. Commit. Fitzie was initially Bamboozled but agreed to get married. It’s been a year and a half since. Was doing research on the return of the First World where she very briefly hit a roadblock, went missing for a week, and came back with about 10 more pages of notes and a new lead in her research. Just when she was on the verge of completing her thesis, she vanished again, and Fitzie has been looking for her for the past 6 months.
]
Elidira Fairntickle Gnome Swashbuckler/Bard Early 60’s Mother An adventurer part of the Ambassadors' Guild who wasn’t often home, leaving Fitzie in the care of her former party member, Aldri She never married, preferring to take a “it takes a village” approach to raising Fitzie. This lead her to being a less than ideal parent since she failed to be there when she was needed, but Fitzie still loves her immensely. Is using her adventuring funds to put Fitzie through school. Does not know who Fitzie’s father is, and seems to prefer it that way. If she remembers, she will cast Sending and fill Fitzie in on what she’s up to, but she is incredibly inconsistent about it. Last heard of her in southern Greenpaths
]
Aldri Ranbin (“Uncle Aldri”) Human Investigator Early 50’s Godfather Former adventurer (NOT part of the guild), retired after his reflexes began to fail him and he almost got grievously injured Lives in western Emerald Coast, in a little town close to the mountains (the same as the one Fitzie grew up in) Do you have any prior connection to any of the other PCs or NPCs from this campaign or previous campaigns?
Throm Macer - Came to learn of him from eyewitnesses saying that he (or someone who looked like him) was the last person to have been seen with Lila before she disappeared. He’s mostly been ruled out of being a suspect, but she still doesn’t fully trust him. What themes or story arcs are you hoping to explore with this character? Being forced to see the details of the world as they are and not just facts you can list off. Does having all sorts of knowledge make you any better than someone who doesn’t? What happens if you use it for your own gain? What kind of gameplay experience do you want mechanically? (e.g. cunning trickster, relentless warrior, miracle-worker, strange mystic, support, wild card, etc.) Wild card, cunning trickster A few laws of the world may be different such as the nature and distinction between death and undeath, the concept of cultural magics, rituals and the like, how do you want these introduced?
Unsure how to answer this that isn’t just “please give me handouts” Link Sorry Fitzie’s Izi Fairntickle (née Emmlen) + Faidron Fairntickle Grandparents Izi passed first, Faidron passed soon after Moved to Numartu when Elidira was young Children: Elidira Fairntickle Mom! Adventurer Children: Fitzie Fairntickle Married to Lila Elaide Fairntickle - Middle child (she/they) - Became a school teacher in Greenpaths Fennel Emmlen Elidira’s youngest sibling (they/them) Druid Kept grandmother’s maiden name after an intense spat that caused them to be ostracized by their dad’s side of the family Adopted a daughter that Fitzie has seen Maybe once total Children: Sedris Emmlen Lila’s Melana Isleys (née Mohd) + Balyn Isleys Parents Melana is half-elven, Balyn human Children: Lila Fairntickle Married to Fitzie Asher Isleys Married to Isona Alberon (they/them) Children: Banor Isleys (he/they) Sivan Isleys (she/her) Lyall Isleys Youngest (he/him) Training to be a soldier

places/icon-nations/silvershore/silversh.description:
Named after the sparkling white sand, silver is not actually found in any exceptional quantity. Controls most trade along the inner sea islands due to favorable trade routes taking one through the islands. Each island is vastly different in customs yet shares a specific unity caused by migration beliefs of its people. One should be sure to be born and die on a different land, so that the soul may know travel and be able to lead itself to the afterlife. Though there are some cities located on the mainland, the capital of Auhule is located on the small island chain of Opoili.
Opoili

places/icon-nations/thormark/thormark.ht.title: Thormark
places/icon-nations/thormark/thormark.ht.description:
A buffer state developed in order to defend against the now pale swallowed nations to the East, it never lost it's military tradition. Expanding slowly outward, it has become one of the larger nations despite the poor resources of its homeland, encompassing the entirety of the Rosealia Mountains which run like a spine down the center of the nation. Young people are taught about the importance of duty, discipline, and honor, all families are required to volunteer one of their first three born for 5 years of service. It was a blessing to many of its neighbor states when the ruins started appearing years ago, since it turned the armies inward instead of outward.
Rosealia Mountains

places/icon-nations/viridian-expanse/vir.title: Viridian Expanse
places/icon-nations/viridian-expanse/vir.description:
An agricultural land that is imbued with magic seeping into its soil from below, it primarily is a leading exporter of magical herbs and crops.Formerly ruled by the two nations of Thormark and Luang, when those two nations went to war the lands fell to banditry from disbanded/fleeing units looking for a soft targets. They naturally chose to target the unguarded farmlands resulting in the druids protecting the people forming the new nation, the farmers then sold the crops to the engaged armies.
Culturally rural, there is a hostility the closer you get to Luang/Thormark border as the people there used to be on opposite sides of a war, towards the grand Falfer Forest, a new culture is forming from the union of the traditionally isolationist druids and the rich farmers. Oakhaven, the capital, serves as a border town between the druidic wilds and 'civilization.'
Falfer Forest
Oakhaven

places/icon-nations/kanishch.html.title: Kanishch
places/icon-nations/kanishch.html.description: A nation built in a valley surrounded by active volcanoes, the rich soil and obsidian marked landscape leads to deep greens and black that surround the towns. Started as a penal colony for rebels and criminals of an old empire, the people were forced to mine in the dangerous but profitable conditions for rare ores that flowed out of the volcanos.Following its collapse and the rebellion of the people, a democracy was established in the valley and surrounding lands such that all who have been accepted into society are able to have their voices heard. Voting rights are not restricted and there is no formal justice system, however crimes against the community will result in exile, though you may still vote if you find a way for your voice to be heard even if exiled.

places/icon-nations/luang.html.title: Luang
places/icon-nations/luang.html.description: A nation of academics for the arcane, it is technically a collection of city states that sprung from the universities many of which have their own philosophy and ethics surrounding the use/nature of Arkentech, recently the Comhairle na nGiúistísí has been sending automatons and students to the fronts in order to fight the war with Thormark. The cause was the discovery of a piece of Arkentech that remains unknown to the public but was evidently leaked by a spy to the Thormark royal family instigating the skirmish.

places/mundi-memoriae/novu-mundi/altos/n.title: Collegium Arcanum
places/mundi-memoriae/novu-mundi/altos/n.description:
The school was first established 30 years ago under an initiative by Auctur Empire as a border school meant to infiltrate/steal magical secrets from the nearby free cities and Dirmandian Lands. However, after the fall of Arctur, the small town could no longer sustain projects going on in the city leaving it to ruin as the archmage of the school was recruited and killed in the civil war.
It remained abandoned for several years until the cracks in the world began to show. The lower half of the magic school sank beneath the waves according to people from the old town, though the basements have no doors that haven't been explored. Eventually, a mage named Ephiane Savile moved in and took over the place with the stipulation that she used her magic to build the walls around the island of the growing town. It is a small school having around 20 students and 3 teachers allowing them to independently study with tutelage being mostly self guided by open lectures provided by the faculty. The first floor is open to the public, and sometimes towns folks sneak into the lectures though they don't tend to stop them even if they're caught unless they get caught too many times. The lower and higher floors are sealed to the public and require an enchanted ring that will reveal the doorway in the stones to access.
Ephiane Savile teaches planar magics mostly focused on the incursion of the fey but she is knowledgeable about the Elemental Planes and Shadowplane.
Ildor Ilnudor is a dwarven man from up north focused on the recent disappearance of the stars as a diviner following the Rozen Crisis. He is attempting to make sense of the stars of the new age and is quite pleasant to talk to if it weren't for his habit of going missing for weeks at a time. Great lecturer.
Thoqiohne is an Anadi researcher of the history of magics though not magical himself, he can still use magic items as if he was a mage. He runs the library on both the first and second floors. He has tackled a bookthief who tried to steal his books from the second floor before. He hails from the east in Ruhhat originally.

sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.description:
Aeguntil Silvermoon
Merris Hasalk
Onarach Agus Fìor
Tiberius Acre Fishing tackle is in the mage tower, in my room.
Aeguntil is from Lygate*
Grundiir~ ancient dwarf area, in middle of continent. (lost to time civilization, due to a major event in the past (Lower Warp))
Ciburn~
Litha – elf guard at ciburn on wall, “dating drossa”
Drosa Korunda - dwarven fighter guard at gate, Night Captain of the guard, oddly friendly dwarf. Jane Korunda’s brother.Occult magic of the gigatrx (or however its spelled) is what harmed drossa. Gorateth – killed drossa but was revived by janes magic eventually, and remains cursed.human quiet doesn’t talk much. (maybe the lieutenant of the guard)
Crowned Wolf – inn/bar – Orwed female elf bartender can be found near the gate. Leyapa daytime bartender, Orwed’s brother a bit rougher as an innkeeper.
Head guard, at mayoral residence for the city. Learned where blacksmith is. Linquinnes Nooby – the bs savior of us. Balding man with the resessive chin. Douche head guard.Blacksmith – paid him to make me a chest with thin cold iron plates inside. Should take about a weekCrazy wizard in the tower by the lake.
Jane Korunda: wizard from wizard tower, golden leathery skin dwarf wizard. (somewhat aged), drosa’s sister. Sent us to tower to build her trust~ the korunda’s were once dwarven nobility
Map leads to tower in the mountains near ciburn. Tower prior to Earthfall event in the past, may hold ancient secrets/information, built ontop of dwarven ruins, built on a massive crater that filled during earthfall. Approx. 1+ days journey from ciburn.Killed mantis thing. we had to run back and try to hide for the night, hoping we covered our tracks well, we can try to go back and continue our search/attack on the tower in the morning if we live the night. The Zulgoth – might be spelled wrong are nocturnal and we are trying to hide from them tonight.Doru ~ a type of djin/div grants “wish” for something. Summoned by the “owner” of the tower, bound to it by him. Long long ago. doru’s answer to hirockas? The rubbing frees them not breaking the rune. The doru has information about 2 hair soaps of the past, shampoo and conditioner. Were gunna kill it. We killed it.
Tower created by Bali Korunda, he died when the tower fell. (pseudo cleric, Oracle, wizard) tower was alive* (sentient) it lost sentience after we calmed it down.Leylines of teleportation, across the world. Gundgir 2 electric boogaloo.We entered the lower portion of the tower (the part still standing) initiative* in the main roomWe have angered the tower!Once the gates are finished they need to finish building the access point, basically another tower, points towards (Averasche). The coin pointed towards another tower, if we can find more information let her know, possible have us be the excavation force.Read books on local wildlife, foraging.
Warren Shadowcloak – “alchemist”, previously murdered someone and admitted it in atonement. This is why he is the “shady alchemist”. He gave us something to interact with the plant, potion of acid resistance and 2 moderate healing potion, given to the alchemist.Level 3! Level 3!
20MM 2

sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.title: 20MM 2
sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.description:
20MM 1
Ancient dwarf ruins under the water in Ciburn. Difficult to access, magic gets tricky pipes pumping the water, too small to swim through.
“Lygate” guards came to Ciburn to ask questions. Drosa Korunda marked it down but was somewhat unsettled by the group of them. We should be picking up going after them soonish.
“Lygate guards” Last seen by a farmer, along the southern tip MTN Range, precarious but relatively unexplored. Southern Ridge, avoid the local water pools – “bad memory for Warren Shadowcloak” “queens lilies in the water, can swallow a horse, very difficult to acquire but very big for alchemists. (used for curing multiple illnesses) anti-aging properties. (Sun Orchid Elixir)Following the trail we came across small ponds littering the ways. No lilies, continued further find a path where nature is damaged like a cart went through, found a clean trail fit for a cart.We took the camp! I almost died.. I died 3 times I’m really hurt. But I live!
“The Reigning Face” bandit organization. Bleen, Bruna and Brockus. They are contracted out of Ciburn, they were excavating here. Owariyaru merc org. nation to northOdd diagram of a pendant form the sorcerer tiefling.The alchemist in Ciburn is enemy threat #1 we are assuming he is the Ciburn contract for the mercenaries.Destroyed base is over an old dwarven stronghold, ruins. Mainhall area connecting the 4 tower passageways down, with a tunnel going 3-5 miles towards more water. Marks of a torch hitting the top of the area, the ashes reach it, form no more than 2 days ago. Tunnel connects to a ruin of a old nobles mansion/house in ciburn. (problem problem)
Einsed Rider –Sketch the old dragon slayer. He killed the dragon that once inhabited the top of this town. He killed the dragon with the korunda twins. “young/adult dragon, imperial sovereign, gold like dragon”
Ringbriar Guild owns the land where the ruined mansion in Ciburn is that.
Harramora – goddess of love. Killed by one of the Venerated Vanguard. He shot her because she wasn’t human.
Diodore – multi-billion gold business, in control of the Outer Pines Shipping Company (in this area). They have a royal monopoly. He operates in the absalonian area, the company operates across basically the entire globe. 6’2” light seemingly bends around him as he moves. Weiss-Wiesemann coefficient. Or Wild Pines Logistic Corporation. (magic jeff bezos)
Garte Ringbriar - alchemist in tower we thought was bad, wants us to work for him. “Super lucrative” he wants to basically sponsor us. He probably knows a lot about what happened in my and our pasts. He knows about my father! “may have been the anonymous funder for the town” when they first made it. Still very sketchy but his information pool is massive, and well hidden.He is problem number 1 again fuck this douche, like 95% certain he is the cause of everything now.Drug den – some people got kicked out not so long ago, (few months back) fits our timeline. c
Religious symbol tied to there weapons. A long lost religion, not known anymore. Often referred to Pharasma and/or Nethys.
Book about Grundiir, im taking it. – talks about making this area a part of the “new capitol” a centralized area to connect gungdir to all the other areas. Talks about the old wayfinder tower we already went too. prospects – list of names of people.
A gift for the sempiternal lord.“messiah”: covered in mist, don’t know his name or voice, understand his words as true, seen his presence.
They wanted an artifact that was suppose to be past down to me, that’s why they went to Lygate, they burnt down Catalina (20MM)’s restaurant and are the cause of me getting kidnapped.
20MM 3

sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.title: 20MM 3
sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.description:
20MM 2
Bella – halfling guard that Drosa Korunda led us too, so we can report our information.The map has a few small x’s on it along the mtn range. More info to go with either the “bad guys” or related to gungdir/ ancient dwarf stuff.
Heal print from the person who took the bodies away. – Linquinnes Nooby bought the boots from the cobbler, way back in the day. (the guard we “praised for saving us”)
Get boots back in a week from the cobbler. When we are back in Ciburn me and merris can get our boots**
Omeruan Blood Walnut – planted inside a corpse that will grow a walnut once every who knows how long that when eaten can give you an answer to a question. (seemingly known by the corpse it is planted in)Wellspring of wildlife underneath Ciburn in an unnatural sanctuary- “life waters, lots of animals, etc” near Barazod (its really ciburn) across the “ciburn mountains” he describes a place around the SE marker of the area, a tower leading up that will eventually be brought down onto the network system of gungdir.We all have fascinating parents???? – from the muse of merris (nobody else heard this)The tree grew another walnut because of the muse ^On the night we were captured every moon was in a new moon phase this only happens once every 5 years. Might be important.
The great crypt – runes say this as we get closer: We made it to the crypt** lots of skeletons. The Great Defiler – name on plaque in the crypt.
Eerie green light fading away, figure, bound by chains to the wall, sarcophagus in center of room. We saw this guy before, in the fallen dwarven tower, in the line of dwarven leaders in the mural, in the gundgir expansion project. “GUNGDIR IS THE Capitol of the world” – the capitol of the new dark world. Lord ThreanarI made fancy beets, balsamic beet mixture, fancy af, low cal filling snack.Cobblemites – sentient pieces of earth that follow smell of food and try to eat it. (attracted by my fancy beets) Small little rocks with amethyst teeth with pinprick eyes, all they really do is eat when they need to that’s it, onerach is keeping one as a “familiar” in a bottle – little rock pirahna’s when in large groups, by themselves not a big deal.MY COOKING SUPPLIES ARE NEXT TO ONARACHS HORSE OUTSIDE THE CRYPT.
House Korunda is from Tunseel historically, south of the Absalom in the far east.Conjuration magic onto rocks on path near where we are sleeping.Earthwisp – mostly harmless, but it might give our position away, when the owner is in a dangerous situation it will “detonate” itself to protect the owner, - removes its essence from the world to give ist owner +7 temp hp basically. The rock hums along to music. There are other varieties for each other elemental plane, if you get all of them it becomes an elemental chorus (earth wind fire water)Might be magically protected.Nocul – demon like – appears as pestilent ridden boars, don’t like things that are clean. Doesn’t like me because I’m celestial. Notably used by powerful mages as guards because they are incredibly easy by demon standards to bind.Tower buried in the mountain, covered by an illusion of a waterfall over it.
1st floor, we found a star map in a hidden lead compartment – they are following not stars but something that oddly lines up with starmetal deposits – meteorite landings etc. various deposits around the world. **One deposit is related to Subatai’s home, a few remain undiscovered to this day.
2nd floor, Man in front of poker table. It’s a Bone Croupier – undead gambler, can twist luck while gambling to always win for whoever it is serving. “merris made a deal with him that he will summon him out of the tower when able, merris needs level 9 spells do that so we have a lot of time” we won a bet, after some stuff.. merris got a bag of holding I got a cloak.3rd floor, suit of dwarven plate armor (animated) protecting the locked doors in theory. We found a walking cauldron for onarach – works as a mobile alchemy lab.Etc.
We killed Garte Ringbriar!!!!!!!!!!!Faraway business deals across the world, no magical resources accounted for, various future deals. His interest in the gate was related to mass transportation of goods across the world.The memorial to Ringbriar was paid for by his brother.FARMER TO BUY SUGARY BEET SUGAR – not beetlike.Dion lemelion or something – famous, supposedly just poof gone turn to dust or just disappeared, famous musician died long ago.Iron gods – bestow gifts like this, (giant fax machine like thing) reports information over distance.Old absalomian – after death life, after life death againVarious figures amongst the rafters (carved)
Tiago – crablike superhuman strength guy, in the rafters of the abandoned church.
The old lady: Talda - “The swallow” thought to be a hole in the world, an enigma, if found it will help some people very dear to her (the old lady who’s device it is that printer sued old absalomian as a password. (after death life) is the password. Old company called “fortress accident”
Fortress Accident is a game studio – trying to establish a way to play dnd magically over the aetherwaves. -.- they also tried lygate- horse market, dross head market, catalinas and here in halfling land.Speaking stone -Clare was sent to catalina’s – signal happened same time as when catalina’s was burnt down.
Aroden the human god who has been completely missing for thousands of years.We need the contact mic and the speaker?
Conversation long ago with Catalina (20MM) – theory of the pale, suggested with a weird amount of confidence, something slowly blooming form inside the world, it will come and bloom and engulf us all. Catalina possibly pulled into the hole in the world (unlikely as there was a burnt corpse in the burnt down restaurant)1000 women sacrificed repeatedly to the pale, snapped at their necks, thrown into the hole in the world of the pale. Clothing similar to sempiternal lord, but slightly different, a religion born of admiration of what the dwarves of the hill had created.
Vision for merris and Subatai - Einsed Rider, young Drosa Korunda, young Jane Korunda, a woman, small child looks like onarach but a child taken up a hill. Unknown sketches of arcane symbols on paper fully filled in, woman holds ainsed riders hand as they ascend up the mountain. “I need you, you can keep me on this earth, be vigilant, I love you.” Might be onarachs mom and ainsed rider might be onarachs dad? Maybe.
Ms. Fior onarach’s mom. ^ Adriana S. Fìor 🡨
“Humans don’t learn from past mistakes they repeated what the dwarves did.” – merris Omeruan Blood Walnut answer to why the women had to die in his vision.
Were headed back to ciburn – questions for Drosa Korunda, Jane Korunda, Einsed Rider etc, maybe try to get back into the underground spring.I think tis coming for me and I cannot wait till your all alone. Heard in my headWe found the oasis area underground by completing a symbol~~I also just realized I can use the crafters book for the formula for a “lesser healing potion” (1d8)Ainsed rider is a douchebag – hes working for/with/is the sempiternal lord
“my father did something great” ainsed said regardless what your father did I have to do this to you before stabbing the shit out of me. “my dad” tried to stop arrodens burial way tf back in the day. Arroden likes this gesture – a memory from my father sitting across from a prisoner drinking wine, apologizing for not being able to save him. The prisoner – (arroden) cannot be saved. My father will head west to the Arctur Family and help them next.
Ainsed also has a medallion from Catalina around his neck. The arcturian kingdoms symbol on the necklace. I took this from ainsed’s corpse. Necklace fits perfectly into one of the portals to access it. “righteousness, restoration, healing, connection between world.” Connection between isolas of the lower gate, this is an activation token created through the sacrifices, that my father stole away, part of a relic trying to open a gate, one of the 4 gates we saw in the celestial portal, where the mans aid find something in order to convince us not to destroy the world, not to encase it in amber and glass.
Arroden (God) - More based on thought – the more that know of me, the less control over the actions I have, keep me hidden and I will let you live longer, as well you have reason too. He caused the first apocalypse – caused the fall of this part of Grundiir but not earthfall itself. The waters of life are found here though.The golden rose – will only work once – when a phrase is uttered into it while in clean air, it will blossom if words are true and wilt if the words are false. Everyone who sees it will instinctually know these words are true.Only minor celestials remain - after I spoke celestial to Arroden he said thisWine taken from the sovereign dragon that he took long ago. 2nd of 4 casks he took form the dragon fight. 1st was drank on the night of the fight. “barrel of fine red wine” – delicacy from the orcish nation to the south known as Chocolate?? Thousandish year old magically preserved wine, protected by a dragon, taken by Drossa. Essence of a sovereign dragon, a protector dragon. – einsed convinced everyone else it was an evil dragon, but it was a good dragon.
There is life beyond the pale in a newEinseds will was to go to his lover and therefore his lovers son would therefore inherit his mansion.“blue forget me nots” growing on the dead bodies in the portal room. Should be white but are blue because of the magic of the portal room. They are an odd strange color that glow with an eerie blue light back at us.Were keeping the mansion (einseds)

sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.title: 20MM 4
sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.description:
20MM 3The waters of life are purified by a semblance of the fires of creation of the world.Purple gate opened in the portal room. Opaque swirling magical energy portal. Attunement focused on portal 🡪 “hes returning home” 🡪 Tiberius went through – statue of a humanoid, hand holding the portal, crystal glass. We all went through. We can go back through it, can only close it on the other side, magic doesn’t work where we are.
The arch druid (Omeruan Blood Walnut druid) also went through the main portal (pale) and is now gone, arroden said so.
Tiberius: Simaron – talking elves, strange language, his father came through the pale? From another land, maybe different planet. His father travelled to a world beyond the pale.
Sun orchid elixir? Back in arroden’s day? (elixir of immortality basically)??? Someone who knew part of making this went through the portal and is now gone, but the elixir truly exists.
New continent (Altos) – Arcturian Empire – near Dirmandian Lands - We are now in Alkenstar**** we are on Abernathy Estate’s farm they have owned for a very long time.
Outer Pines Shipping Company – (magical jeff bazos corporation)Magic don’t work right.. I feel not good in a very very limited almost non existent magic place.Closer to durmindian lands human towns – mix of monster cultures and human cultures in food.We cant get back right now the portal closed and the “key” my necklace isn’t strong enough to open it due to the low magical power in the area.Shipping district – poorer area, one of the places that was bombed in the past, only the shipping union is really prominent here but otherwise its very poor. The ACM who Tiberius worked with don’t really have jurisdiction here and he doesn’t have good contact with them currently.Manyanas horse shop – I bought a horse – for 10 gp, idk how imma keep it or bring it back to cyburn but ill figure it outRioters at dock – standing up against the endo-tribe – a tribe that was given their power and is basically a company that started with a royal monopoly - the empire is just part of it that helps own it. Dock is owned by magical jeff bezos.
Tiberius's Ranch – sizeable chunk of land, not massive but its not small. Like 70 acres of farmland, Tiberius’ family land.
Sadon Degray – a friend of Tiberius's Father, helping Tiberius’ mom (Mary Acre) get back home, both elderly. He was one of the founders of the ACM (the citizens militia) – one of the original groups that originally fought against the empire.Rumors of why theres no magic – 1: hated by the gods, (unlikely imo). When this place was created one of the founders created it this way on purpose so this place cant be scryed upon.Mineral rich land to get metals for guns, even have mithril and adamantium veins. Tons of mithril and adamantine they can even make waffle irons out of it.Tiberius’ father had a jezail? A long rifle – due to the distance it can cover. (basically a sniper)
“maybe I’m from Vozgoa” idk but maybe
Some altars - Symbol of Auctur an old artifact form the old empire imperial family the original arcturian rulers carried this out of the eternal vault (or it’s a very good replica), hidden in a farmhouse. (tiberius’ family basement hidden area) Some sort of dagger some sort of magical properties but unknown because its in Alkenstar and wont function, some ammunition bullets made form the same geode in the room, a fossil like thing resembling a geode (slight arcane auras despite being in alkenstar) near the gate we entered, and a lamp that looks rubbed, theoretically a genies lamp. They sacrificed the wishes of the lamp to survive Earthfall.The geode is supposedly part of a dead god?? – maybe somehow still magical geode even in Alkenstar. I can theoretically have onarach create small sources of indrium like substances, I can use 1 action to activate it and I could use a spell here in alkenstar, but it is highly addictive. Don’t tell anyone else this yet. Attune: Ancestral recall on the geode: Wars of gods past, various people waging, gods being killed, this small purplish geode remains, the area around forever scorned, as gods die. Need a few crafting checks via- onarach and/or me. Were taking it. Don’t know who’s taking it but I would like to hold onto it if everyone else agrees. Figure it out next time.The ACM is working with the union in order to start a revolution. If what the union leader said is true we are looking at all out war form the mercenary company.
The Downwell Corporation – mercenaries, known for foreign wars. They have gone through 3 separate name changes to cover up their war crimes they have committed.
Contact in Auctur City – heart of the empire – working with him to cut off their ability to ship troops and squash us the instant the revolt begins. Guilodor the elf wizard.

(a divine being in the Arcturian Empire – possibly behind the door)ice melts and water drops refreezing rapidly in this area.Snow a little different from other areas an odd tangy texture too it, snow is fairly clean pollutant free.Gold alloy, Pure steel, black too it as well unidentified alloy. Gold does conduct electricity and magic really well.
The nations 5 (language on frozen chained book in the ice area thing) faraway land named Sharn, various people who went through, the coalition that shattered the areas, left one in charge who would not die behind the gate who would be awakened, statue of elven women going amongst many adventures, very small bits of her remain including a sword with an eye in it among other things.
Matriarch to my people giant statue elven woman, surprisingly achieved high magic eventually resulting in me through the bloodline. My old ancestor. The giant statue elven woman angel wings. Aenor. A memory deep down in me, sense of man in ice, a man of smell, both together in this world, she thought it fake but turned to be true.I can cast a 5th level spell of my ancestor once per day as an innate spell (illusory scene)
Kardova lives in library banished from old religion he can help Tiberius with the souls in the belt from the hag. Might have spelled it wrong, it’s the librarian in Ciburn that Tiberius talks too. Jane told them to talk to him. He recognizes the souls in the belt he knows what they are, opens the door to the old library,A giant spider controlling this elven man? Kardovas true form as a spider thing???? Snaps open the fireplace for the first time since ciburn was founded 40 years ago. Begin the peaceful transference of the souls sealed away in the belt to help them pass on.
We have a new friend T3a the automaton. Apparently he is slowly gaining his sentience and autonomy – and some vegetables he can somehow taste sort of?? (thanks to the druids in The Vale)Can use dzejet to make my staff – magic conductive, when critically hitting with a spell or the staff it will drain a spell slot from the target. Expensive-ish if used to make armor instead it can hold extra runes and its very easy to etch runes on it. Ask jane maybe she has some otherwise – the best bet is in arcturian empire (which is not exactly safe for us to enter) I have a backup plan to make it out of silver >.>

sessions/20mm-campaign/nick's-20mm-campa.description:
20MM 8
Cull'Thaine Estate: - underneath Brazenthrone (in Blackloch), travelling by river, the vampire Vlaundet Thaine is here… oh no. vampires don’t make plans that go into effect immediately – they have the advantage of time their plan ont need to go into effect until millennia pass. – he said to Tiberius: Mary Acre is going to die a nobody alone unloved and unknown, but you will be different he is looking for the portal underneath the city… to report to those higher than him.. terrifying..Mom has a magical amulet. Made of gold with odd filigree inscriptions on it. The inscriptions seem to match the door in the wasteland of ice, it could be useful to get through the door.
We get to escort Jane Korunda back to Ciburn for extra safety.Fundamental shifters – these runes can bend on there own to move reality around somewhat. Merris caused some weird time shit.
Searching Sadon Degray's house – painting of degray in his youth – happier alongside tiberius’ father and a few others, small signature in bottom right a deroyo signature (couple thousand of golds signature).Adjacent artifacts similar to the ones in acre household, filled with little keepsakes from across the mountain range, infront of the sun currently far far to west. (took few of them)
History book covering Arcturian Empire and its vassal states.
Book on small druidic circles in the north close to the Freilands – some hidden lost to time, isolated and hidden from the empire – possible desparate gamble to get help against the empire.
Striking Warhammer with the symbol of Gorum emblazoned onto it, striking longbow, +1 half plate, “magical” shield (sturdy shield cuz were in antimagic area), and a wayfinder.Servant demon – Oni – shapechangers – incredibly strong posses magic and can blot out the sun.
We freed Sadon Degray from capture.700 goldPlain silver ring, ring of lies - +2 to deception, 1/ day as 2 actions can cast glibness on yourself without having to speak a word.odd fabric with runes over it: makeshift house, incudes firepit,utensils basic food and water etc. (mini hut effect basically)spectacles: conundrum spectacles – while wearing spectacles you get a +2 bonus to decipher writing, 3x a day can flick a toggle to understand the meaning of the language your reading.
She is an inherited fetchling – a fetchling is what happens to humans growna dn raised in the Shadowplane. “its ok he still has your blood, you will come back to this” don’t know where he is – but we see vaults, with vials of blood, her name is “Marcene Blackros”, lines and lines of other women’s names on other vials, 1180-1232 on a dif vial. This man is lying to get me to break faith, - merris poured his thousands of womens consciousness’ into her head – which I was reading her thoughts and it made us both pass out, pain etc then sleepy time. Advesperascit – underwent revolution then the rev fervor fed to the vassal states and they came together to crush the revolutionary state that was forming.What will become of the city underneath the archer? – the archer: a name of a specific aerostatic vehice that is owned by the arcturian empire, it has the ability to range multiple kilometers away from it, not precise but area target attacks.
The investigators name is Corvius Von. And his wifes name is Lilith.A man of scent?
“from the old worlds destruction comes the new” – all major religions of this world state, signs of my family connection, zombie apocalypse land, large armored man, man of changing skin come through a portal or unknown way, they begin attacking back at the zombie land. (dox and Riven Maze – some of the previous campaign characters were the ones) celestial writing golden chain thingCloak of the bat - +2 stealth, can hang from any surface with no check that can support weight, can grant 30 ft fly for 10 minutes, or turn into a bat once.Ring – smells of smoke, fades in and out of its bronze surface. Ring that lets you jump between fires within 100ft of eachother, once per day.

Elizabeth Acre (Tiberius sister) is a magic user >.> don’t know yet what kind but my assumption is it’s a sorcerer based on info we have, shes boutta be my secret disciple if jane doesn’t take over her teachings in what way she can. Since Tiberius doesn’t want his family learning from us much. Arcane in nature (imperial) she is starting to learn ancestral memories.Vamp weaknesses: stake through the heart when its unconscious to fully kill it, sunlight, fire, “silver maybe”, religious symbols slow them down but doesn’t actually harm them, or very specific to the vampire weaknesses.
Have you received any information from out contacts at the Emerald Coast? Cardus is compromised.
The reagents come from Vlyn'Darastyl, in the Blackloch for drossas dagger info. The drow city in opposition of Deepspire – the faction of drow that still believe in slaves. Some form of shadow essence from deep grungdir, they can transfer themselves to the shadow plane.
Banarv – expected dude who faked Drosa Korunda as the murderer. Alchemist, will likely become head alch of brazenthrone if Bali Korunda takes the throne (bali = drossa dick wanna-be-king brother) scarred left eye slghtly lazy, typical alchemist eyebrow, shady lookin beard, hair still in militaristic style form his guard days, lighter skin almost translucent.We can get a “clockwork glove” from kelda to record 3 minutes of speech.Atropal – unborn fetus of a god, in rumors it is able to bring about the “death curse” a curse that anyone that gets it, that has been revived slowly loses its revived life. (similar material like thing that Tiberius’ gun is made out of)Acid big dmg, healed by fire, electricity slows it, rust hurts it.Vague memories descaliese – high point, its rough hewn colors, fading into black and white.
“I apologize for the delay, the murderer was an assassin, still trying to find the true culprit and definitive proof that orders are from Bali Korunda” need to send to the angel who’s looking for the murderer, who we are like an entire 3 weeks late in providing the answer too.They have a teleportation circle. – kind of matches what we thought. They know we broke in, were under attack.We beat them level 11!!!!

Found more evidence, turned it in. – notes about making a fake clan dagger, and alchemically changed Drosa Korunda blood from dwarven bloodbank used to implicate drossa.Storage closet of potions: 2x greater healing potions, 1 silvertongue mutagen (given to onarach), +2 resilient armor (almost brand new) (Im using this now wooo!! bonus armor)
We own a dwarven home now.
Grull'sna – ice giant in frozen north2 thousand-ish years ago – an old empire called rune giants, to control other giants, they basically parasitically infected other giants to take control of them.
Dragboni Empire seeking godhood through arcane magic, diviners, really old empire. (only 1 of us kinda knows this I forget which one) city into tunnel –

Pitfiend, demivagga potential devils strong enough to grant wishes (Corvius Von’s potential master)
3rd story of the grand temple of Brazenthrone, scrolls of information, potential to do it ourselves if we don’t trust anyone, the problem is Kelda Proudhammer is able to help us there, the head priest is in favor of his brother. (if Drosa Korunda becomes king he could let us into the hold)

Greater striking and armor pot +2 for Tiberius? Asmodeus symbol – merris?

The gogiteth nest is near the nail, we killed it. Luckily, Drosa Korunda shouldbe free from his curse.
Sternbore – magical collapse on itself long ago. Warrior state Continent where Ruhhat is. Also known as kadvatski 🡨 100% spelled wrongI need to research the ritual to make teleportation circles so I can begin a network for our travels that only we have full access to.
The Freilands in the north (portal) use to be a tropical paradise???? Way back in time.An item of the dephths (paragon status item) to help drossa int terms of dwarven acknowledgement.
