Gavin Rooks
Urgan
Myka Chamomile
Olwen Scribe
Next Session: Session X

we have come to this world as part of an expedition funded by Merris Hasalk and Onarach Agus Fìor to see what is beyond The Pale. there are 4 adventure teams:nt
Teamless: more powerful leaders selected by onarach/merris who have been given alchemical treatments to cross the pale and additional folk we have found and hired
Captain Moreg Na'thril: A former captain from Caldera who has been searching for his own ship following the Caldera Calamity, a former pirate by trade. Well respected among the crew.
Navigator Solune Verin: A cartographer by trade, hoping to be able to use the new Zilsparian map technology and reproduce it. An avid historian but mostly for Geological samples.
Bosun Brackdraw: the bosun of the ship in charge of equipment. A merchant by trade who is praying the lands are empty so he can make his fortune
Translator Michael Vent: A man specializing in cultures from the Nexus in Advesperascit, was in charge of evacuation during the Wanting Throne Incident.
Belanor Sarberos: Venture team 0 defeated him and his drake companion. He could not return to his employer so he joined the Wandering Embassy. Can help with rituals notes to be added
Namaiye Basi: halfling ritualist who is friends with Belanor Sarberos
Adventure Team 1 team 1 is the rooks family. their role is to protect the expedition via combat and give a small amount of prestige to the crew with their noble status. their primary goal is to return to Owariyaru and have merris help their family.
Andreas Rooks a well respected military leader from Owariyaru, in charge of Venture Team 1. Died, someone wished him back
Katherine Rooks: a minor political figure, in charge of strategy, wife of Andreas Rooks works with main operations rather than any particular Venture team though she has an obvious favorite.
Laura Rooks: Prodigal swordswoman of Owariyaru, proved her mettle in a small border skirmish with Vozgoa but hasn't done any campaigns far outside country borders, part of venture team 1
Alec Rooks: Was in charge defenses during the border skirmish, proved competent at his job but not enough to earn true respect, seeking to change this with a daring expedition. part of venture team 1
Aaron Rooks: Finally completed training too late to prove himself, will be his first real mission, part of venture team 1
Adventure Team 2 is the knowledge team. they help gather intel and cast spells
Hatae Casilltenirra: A famous witch looking to separate herself from her patron through the largest stretch imaginable, brilliantly minded but very locked up about her past, in charge of Venture Team 2
Dalgal Balderk: Dwarven paladin of Angradd from Thaumdeep, he is seeking a chance to seek dwarven holds across the pale and spread his beliefs to them, charming but abrasive, part of venture team 2
Katherine Stratford: An exile from Arctur following the fall of her empire, she was in charge of many raids on the vassal states before being overrun and forced to retreat. Denied the leader position due to hostility between the funder of the expedition and due to her not wishing to lead anymore. Part of Venture Team 2
Ralf Trowbridge: A hermit of a man, dedicated to Erastil and wishes to see as much of nature as he can before his passing, Good drinking buddy if offputting, part of venture team 2 died
Adventure Team 3 is the diplomacy team.
Jo Stonebridge: Halfling Bard admirer of Merris, volunteered for leadership of Venture team 3 in order to prove herself to him, unknown if he even is aware of her existence
Rohesia Stanley: Fighter from Ensile, believes innocence can be found across the pale and thus seeks to find it, more religious than the paladin, part of venture team 3
Gimgen Trollbleeder: Named due to his insistence that his patients can lose a little more blood so they need not panic, medical doctor by trade, bad habit of not washing between operations, part of venture team 3
Eldon Sympony: sorcerer from the gnome quarter of Brazenthrone, was undergoing the bleaching before he decided to go across the pale, seems to be healthier by the day, part of venture team 3
Elysande Windsor: Cleric of Sarenrae, she seeks to learn how the religion has evolved in the time the two lands have been separated, kind but bound to fits of delusions, part of venture team 3
the final team is Adventure Team 0. Us. thrown together at the last moment from different members of the crew, venture team 0 leaves the crew to go on adventures at the behest of our captain or powerful locals who we want to cozy up to. this particular world has 2 main groups: dragon and giants. they do not like each other we have found 3 things consistently in our travels: holes in the ground that will deem people worthy or unworthy
a strange necrocleric named Meitremar who worships wyrms and exists in many places at once. everytime one is killed the others are empowered. 3(?) we've found were bad while 2 have been good. people being turned into dragons or giants we have found 1 instance of each in modern times and one of an ancient dwarf turning into a giant in a very horrific way. they seem to 'ascend' powerful or worthy followers into their form as a reward actually, we also found that shrine of something becoming a dragon as well... we are currently in the tomb of annihilation some ancient dungeon guarded by snake people where we are being forced to do a scavenger hunt and solve puzzles. notes from last session (courtesy of Oz): Met a night hag, didn't drink tea Blew up a metal t-rex Went back to check on captain, Rooks snug in a nook Cap'n is cursed to be old Abolith show illusions of dead family
Met the DM lich Cadium Aaron = D- (good candidate) Gavin = D+ nope F Capn = A Dwarf = B+ Myka = B+ nope C Urgan = B+ Fought a devil with a pole-hatchet and an umbilical cord for a giant god baby Meitremar was killed somehow, maybe Captain? not clear Dad died and we don't know who made the deal to revive him with the shady god dude
We found the Dragon Temple, has sings of proto-religions from before the pantheonic religions began to form. More than likely in between the god is a force of nature and god is a personification stage. The symbols belong to an old symbol of the axis before modern understanding, more aligned to the side of chaos. Temple seemed to be dedicated to dragons – if theres a dragon like being here it would probably be in the inner sanctum. Coatls are not extinct in our home world but they are here. Undead monastic armored dude. The temple of the divine conversion of the coatl – likely where they transform the coatl into dragons. Arcianthus: The god dragon – dragon of justice and law? When the false gods took over they stopped the dragons from being in control. 4 paths: frog door portal well (hidden) Library books describing the formation of the area and the history of speaking races No stand out info on orcs 3x archmages' skeletons hanging Gavin took a tea set fire trap Gavin spoke to his father about contingency plans against everyone Gave Boson a +2 greater striking greviouis weapon Urgan requested his mambele be made +2 greater striking RIP Trowbridge, Urgan had to give his last rights. Far from home and without a body. Cave on land: skeleton of a young prodigal dragon – mix of drake and a dragon.60 gp, metal hand attached to a necklace, goz mask, odd looking silver piece that hasn’t been rusted away not actually ridges on the coin but cogs that can twist into a figure of an elf like figure and further to that of a dragon, and an odd pendant made of pure bronze.Spellskenes – magic imbued paper – relatively harmless but take paper to heal themselves.Jotun “I need to know where you hid the treasure of the r---?” hear a wounded human speaking in common “ill die before I tell you, why don’t we just get this done”
Vinther: Merchant: his homeland is tribalistic but kind, tribe near the frost.
Kohil? – town in the north, closer to frozen lands, he sailed across the sea and now he’s here. War between dragons and giants.60 gp, metal hand attached to a necklace, gauze mask, odd looking silver piece that hasn’t been rusted away, and an odd pendant made of pure bronze. 3x +1 runes, hat of the mage, 2x darkmantle corpses, 1 metal wisp corpse left 1 taken byHand of magi: mummified hand cast in iron and silver. – mage handBronze bull pendant: +2 to shove, failure instead of crit failure, 1 time use. ForGoz mask: allows you to ignore concealment from smoke or mist, appears to be that of a wolf. For MykaDragon-giant war – both sides say an artefact was stolen, is being seen as an excuse from both sides to wage war.Adventure team 2: expedition team lead by the witch Hatae seemed to be talking to a wolf.
Bears sigils of Sighar a nation of undead – bears symbols of an area near the dwarven capitol, hes trying to created a mixture of medicinal and necrotic arts for healing.Dragon turtle in the port, giant snapping turtle that has the jaw strength to snap a wooden boat. Very strong but somewhat dumb, likely have a condition that it is trained for if we learn it would likely leave our ship alone.New world gold coin – silver and gold dragon on either side, our coins form home are unique.Saying yes that we are from the council, would give a somewhat representative of why we are lost about the goings on. The council is related to the dragons apparently – don’t use that again. Or a meet – giant side.Don’t say part of a council, don’t say part of a meet, don’tAsking about coin: he could be trying to con us out of money, or a way of asking about specific kinds of coin.
Warren's Trading Goods: general store:Stone cathedral – depicting some odd looking god of geometric shapes, smells of strange earth, interior walls are made of smooth stone, with a glass dome that creates odd patterns depending where the sun is. Some form of local phenomenon unknown to our home world, they have extrapolated to be a god. “the quilted sky” the pattern that appears when ushering the dead to the afterlife. A deity in that it is inevitable and omnipotent and takes all. Most people call it death, we consider it the transitional state. A lesser religion – more akin to a druidic order than a church. A week tops until the next quilted sky – a weekly event.
A withered woman looking at us, surprisingly tall: Lya Lamb? Made her money in military and now she enjoys a good rest as part of the guard. 30 years in military, as a human.Inner sanctum near the coliseum, a tree. Illusions around the tree. This tree is not native to our home world, the tree creates illusions around it, the tree follows Dave Cooks swordplay performance.
Gobbelfern: Brachial Fallenthrow: Gnome with a heart tattoo. Temporary mayor of the land, inheritor. Until the next meet, Chosen of Megisus. Lives at the illusion tree. Blessed with luck by Megisus.Megisus: menadaius: god of wine feast and festival.The gobbelfern incident – they left him behind as he was the waste son, they went to dragonlands and were sank and burnt. Leaving just Braxel behind as the Defacto mayor.Burnt house: among noble coats in closet – some religious gown/cloak with a symbol related towards the quilted sky.Sawtooth sabre – used by red mantis assassins – used by assassins as part of their religious swords, used to cause maximum pain. Appears to be that of a war trophy taken by the head of the house. Sabre is enchanted – fanged rune.1 healing potion minor, 2 oils of potency.The dragons and giants reason for betrayal of one another despite their guardianship – academic journal.Some creature – labored breathing, odd heat radiating beyond skeletal guard.Hunter’s bow - +1 bow, if you strike a creature that cannot see you it deals an extra 1d6 of damage.Explosive bird – reproduces by exploding and its offspring attach to preys body.Orb of sustenance – false – lead to secret treasure roomBracelet in each drawer under dissected pixie, that of a dragonkin oddly preserved, unicorn horn devoid of magic, under the pixie an odd bracelet with varying small charms resembling weapons underneath it.A form of camouflage – that of a shadow rune, while wearing this armor gain +1 to stealth.Painting – that of a view of a flying creature, has to be of a high/wide range, or a predatory creature – seems to be a dragons perspective of a mountain range.Painting – self portrait of a flumphs.Art supplys fund – colorful token showing a bush with red dots of dyed copper built into the token, alongside 106 goldThe previous owner was a dragon. The wife – belongs to linaea the goddess of the oceanAncient globe – northward to the lost land (an Isola attached to their world long ago cut off)Notebook to the north at a familial hunting lodge, dreams of flying, still a half elven man no matter what his dreams say. The mention of a severe headache before he leaves to go to sleep. 2 days travel north in mountain range.
The burnt down church – signs of movement – not life, but semblances of care for the podium and altar atleast, alongside a few pews that are oddly unaffected by the mold that would normally affect a coastal ruin like this. While most of the gods remain unfamiliar but at the top it seems to show an old depiction of nethys including his split in two incarnate form, likely goes by a different name we don’t recognize. Humanoid track leading towards the shore, shoe seemed similar to clerical boot. At midnight there seemed to be a light at the church – noticed from the mtn when we were already day away.Nethys goes by nephtyr in this world, the god of magic and the god of balance. Humans can use all magic, giants have occult and primal, dragons only have divine magic and arcane.Phalanx of 100 fingers and toes, not actually undead, area damage from alchemical great, holy not special, weak to area and splash, resistant to cold, electric, fire, pierce and slash.The hunting lodge – owner used magic to pretend to be an elf, pretends he is an attendant and not the owner, we know its him from portrait.
Gone to Corrtada – Zerkyr and Brexwall Principalities

Northern clan – the northern power, binoth ulur. This footprint is big, by a heavy man, this giant left a week ago, maybe even longer, the rains are constant so its hard to tell exactly. Footprints leave from a large clearing made by one who could lift boulders – aka giants.
Underground lava and a bridge – 2 giant guards we said we are requested by Arkull Binoth Ulur(heir to binoth-ulur that we killed)Arkull is not the heir but the father, we killed the heir above. Arkull is a mage, along with the “overwatch” who kicked my ass last time, and 4 dwarven guards. Petrification gas oh no.We defeated 2 gorgons – the bull monster not the Greek ones.Inside is ruined areas, with a lodestone, and a cube/key thing?Armbands of athleticism, frost rune,

And if not… unfortunately, we’ll have to take measures to cooperate.”
Her name is Deserai
Part of the attack force on Advesperascit who was stopped by an unknown entity ramming into it Let her wind up here “Your sister’s not here. But I feel like we can go to the palace to discuss your rank.” She seems to be telling the truth, the decoy was specifically for Gavin =) “Would you be so kind to meet the young lord?” Yeah… I suppose. “King Moivicius Vrirevi would love to meet you.” “I’ll have you know, should anything happen to me or you are to not show up, your sister’s life is in danger.” Asks to uninvis the person, reveals a woman who has Laura’s general build who takes off a disguise Atom, go with them or be put down. Atom jumps into the water Forces Gavin to go with her “I’m sorry we had to meet under the terms, but you weren’t there when we found the ship. This was the soonest we could possibly do.”
“For what it’s worth, I’m sorry what happened to your father. He was a good man.” Yes. He is. Was. Fighting the guards with the captain Sleep the big guard Steal a stupored, invis captain

Alongside 2 familiar faces of brothers (Alec Rooks and Aaron Rooks) and numerous guards
Micheal Vent/Moivicius Vrirevi Michael expects the proper courtesies one would give a lord or a king “It’s beautiful for you to make it to the start of our new empire.” You said that my sister would be safe? Can I have proof? “Once we come to an agreement, I’ll have her transferred to the palace to visit her and me whenever you want.” What do you want from me? “You would accept lordship!” “From that which has bestowed me, you’re very worthy.” I’m beginning to wonder what that word means. “It means you’re worthy to become a lord.” Theres been so much that has happened to me these past couple weeks, I need time. I’m not saying no! But I need to figure myself out. “What else is there for you to deny?” I’ve never had this responsibility. I wasn’t a good study in lordly manners! Maybe I could follow you around, to see your duties so I could be prepared? “There he is! Dave! There is a certain tone when you speak bullshit.” What are you implying? “You’re being honest, but it’s all in service of bullshit.” You wound me! I don’t intend to speak bullshit! I talk a lot when I’m nervous. “That’s not how you were. You are a master in magic, a master of intelligence gathering, a master of tactics, a master of diplomacy. Are you not?” “You were all those things despite not being them.” Gavin has to stall for 3 hours Laura wasn’t moved from the cell, just the captain (left a small contingency there) The rest of us are let in Direct us where Gavin is “We’ll do away with laws against people like you. Unless you think we should keep the purity laws in place?” Claiming status based on ancestry Guy next to Michael, it appears to be a symbol of ancient draconic priests when inured to death. Standing next to the right hand of the king.
The Owariyarans are on the side of humanity (humanoids) Technically the truth, but there is a catch (we don’t know)
“Where do you stand on Meitremar’s point of view?”
“The entity of this world will avenge our home, our land, and the Vespertine Empire’s sins will be punished.” “Metriemar is a god, an aberration, and one who’s made sure the flaws were made out for the perfect vessel.” Pride in his voice. One of the things mentioned amongst the dwarven ruins. The best vessel would be one who would need to be a king, one to rule the entirety of man. Gavin talks to his brother “A lord doesn’t need to address peasants.” You realize our father is dead because of him? Doesn’t care. Alec “Our father only lives again because of me. But a pact was sealed, and I have to live with it. Its part of responsibility.” Who was the one who took his life in the end? Alec “Me. It was part of my burden.” He believes it was him. Arbul swears that there’s something odd about the courtyard, but doesn’t know what it is. There’s something important about where this palace is. “This is the center of the world! And at the center is where all magic will happen. The important details of our time. Its why Advesperacit was picked there, but the gods didn’t realize it would no longer be the center, but the edge when they were done with it. This one, despite the consumption of land, is truly the center. It understands the chaotic bend of the world.” Sooo whats the goal of this entity? What’s he gonna do with our land? “Our land is not important. Just this land.” “He’s going to awaken it and show a true god to the world and allow perfect order or chaos to reign. Whatever the wish of the king who helped him.” Uhhh. This doesn’t seem like it’s going to go well? He’s withholding details.
“You swear loyalty to the king, we discuss what you rule over, we discuss what your purview will be. You could be the lord of alchemy, Arbul, in charge of all commissions. You would have a laboratory that extends beyond what Castle Alchemy has.” The quilted sky holds souls
It’s the wings of the gods that this world rests on, World Dragon Unfortunately he is sleeping, and we rest atop him now They’re going to wake him up. “It’s the founder of this realm. We’re merely a parasite that rests atop it. It will wake up one day, whether we like it or not, but I intend for us to rest atop its head when it wakes so we can let it know we mean it no harm. We won’t take from it anymore. Whether it wakes up now or in a 1000 years, it doesn’t matter.” “When you die, you soul gets absorbed into it, and eventually it wakes up with no knowledge for those who had helped it. It won’t be happy to be asleep for thousands and thousands of years. It doesn’t even seem to process us.” “I will kill no one under my kingdom (but will kill murderers and rapists).” “Those who die will be those outside the kingdom and from not under my hand.” How do you know all this???
“Are you familiar with the school known as the The Nexus? Its a school in Advesperascit where I was sent, foolishly, by my family. And during which I had the pleasure of knowing the founder of the school who, in her infinite wisdom as a seer, was able to tell me this in exchange for my support. Whether she knew any of this would come to fruition is unknown.” We cut and run Gavin runs towards the building where the guards were Empty cells Echoes… A person is waiting for us: Metriemar “It’s good to see you again.” “Preferably I’d like to die of natural causes, but I feel like we have a time bomb we need to resolve.” “Once I die, the next one will gain all of my memories. This issue is, this Metriemar lead the resistance against the changing of kings before he was hung.” “I know [ways out of the city]. I also know ways through the city. You could kill me, if you wanted…” And THROUGH the city But it’d be better for us to kill Michael Vent. “You’ll die. He has the backing of a god, and you don’t!” Is his god different from your god? “Technically it is my god, we just have a different opinion.” Seems truthful. Metriemar is 50/50 corpse memories/previous memeories. “I was a noble man.” “Why was [Laura] transferred from here?” Bargaining chip. Safety important to Gavin. She wasn’t part of the inner group. “She’ll be given a chance to become worthy. Likely fight in the coliseum. If she refuses, she’ll die in her cell.”
“Unfortunatelty, the closest to the St. Sirnach Coliseum is the sewer of blood that runs underneath it.” He wants a 1000 gp as price (thank god).
Sewer of Blood is a simple way to get rid of the nasty blood (dumps into the river near the poor people). A small girl has the courage to ask us to give her our gold before we die “Its free food for the various rotting creatures.” “The rot does attract some creatures. And some demons will be attracted from the violence above.”

Wandering Embassy 20 day travel, Downtime On day 16
Flagged down by ship with Owariyaru colors, forced to stop We don’t have any colors on rn Asking the captain a few questions before heading on down to us “Just routine, we’re asking very basic questions. Who do you sail with?”
Telepathy w the Captain
Cassalerino Port We claim we’re privateers, that its sanctioned “Carry on then, remember to report what you find.”
Acererak mostly known in the Dirmandian Lands, worshipped and inspired by the queen there
We have to go pretty deep in the undead territory, a weeks worth of travel on the Acererak Mountains Sage’s path free of undead Wellspring seems attached to the feywild/First World Manage to find a bridge that crosses the various ruins Not holy, but full of vitality A figure rises out of the water “Are you lost?” A merfolk “It’ll take a bit to rouse them.” Need combat to rouse them
Runescarred giant is a giant of war, Varkash While they are seeking peace, there is a bestial curse that makes it seek out/awaken to combat Finding a sleeping shark and dropping some blood in the water to make sure it wakes Living rune underneath “Step and carry all onto the stone platforms, I will end combat.” A giant lightning bolt goes into the sky Giant comes out We say hello in common It says hi back in common Asks where we think we are
Frethïar “That’s not where you think you are, that’s where you were told you are.” Casting a spell, checking if any of us are shapechangers Happier “Why have you sought me out?” We’ve heard you’re an expert on things in the realm and that you’re a scholar of the Quilted Sky, they seem very integral to this world “Of course. And the Quilted Sky - what do you know of it?” We explain what we know “The Giants have no god. And the dragons only have the son and child of the dragons. Just the one. At least in this region, they don’t fall to the usual trappings.” “From where you’re from, this is an isolated place after it was cut off.” What do you know of that? “As far as I know, it was natural. I couldn’t tell you an exact date outside of a millennia. I was a young man back then, so it was about 4 millennia ago.”
Have you ever heard of Meitremar? “No. If its from the last millennia, I’m not entirely sure. I passed out.” What happened last time you were awake? “Last time, I was giving advice about where to put humans in this world, apparently seeking refuge.” Passed out = sleep? “Not exactly, but its natural.” (Some people like to harvest giant sleep, bc they create sleep that can be used. Older giants sleep more. While a giant sleeps, it doesn’t need to eat or breathe, just rest. Given this giant’s age and other factors, its a natural “hey the bear is hibernating.”) Who were you giving this advice to?
“Threnirax. The son of the giant dragon. Allegedly saving people from your disaster. The dark skies, I believe.” Century where there was no sun
(according to the Merris Hasalk documents, someone was holding the worlds apart for absolute order at any cost) (A creature of decent power could steal civilizations at that time and bring them over.) “Some [humanoids] set foot here before the war in your home. Orcs, goblins, bugbears and the like, looking for a better world.”
Do you know Cadium? “I don’t know many people.” He lived in the tomb for a while. “One of the originals here in the world?” Maybe??
“The Quilted Sky dragon rests atop the primordial civilization.” What does that exist of? Does it still even exist? “Presumably. It shelters us from it, so it deserves praise.” “Whatever lies down there is best kept away from us. Away from itself, too.” Do you know what it is? “I’ve seen signs of it. The corruption of man and the like, and how the various worlds would have to deal with it when they came here. The dragons seeing it rests its body atop a giant hole. It rests aslumber, bearing the brunt of it.” If the dragon awoke? “There would be no filter between us and it. There have been people who went down there, but they found themselves turned into monsters. The type unrecognizable to the greater extent, abominations and aberrations.”
It might be best to appraise you of current events. A king from our world has come over and is attempting to… move all the people onto the head of the dragon in St. Sirnach, and he seems very insistent that it will be awakening very soon. “That’s not great.” Humanoids are transforming spontaneously into dragons and giants after dreaming of it. There’s someone claiming to be the god of giants, Ámgrunðigr (am-grun-thi-gar “The explanation is simple. Both gods are Threnirax.” Why would Threnirax claim to be both? “There are a few easy conditions to awaken a god. A great war would need to be conducted, and the people the dragon had sacrificed to save would have to be present and in danger. Only then would it be stirred from its slumber. Those are the conditions, hence why he stole you and brought you here.” What would he gain? “By awakening the parent, the parent is more valuable than all of you together. The grand dragon is vast. I sustain myself on it, you do it, seas rise and fall on it. A being that does that much is worth more than a hundred or a thousand people brought over. To them, all of you would be worthy sacrifices.” They use worthy and unworthy a lot, but never answer what they mean by that. “Potentially maybe the worthy are to be sacrificed? Then your death would be the catalyst to awakening the great dragon.” A lot of the worthy become giants and dragons. “If the giants and dragons are at war, they are destined to die. Or by becoming giants/dragons they may already be dead from the humanoid form. I could contact him if you want, but only once. He won’t lie in front of me.” Where is he? “Don’t know, but we as the children, who inherited the world, were given the same means to contact each other.” Are you related? “No, I was one of the first giants who built the mountain to hide its form. Evidently I haven’t done a good job.” Are there other primordial power sources? “We had to have some tricks. There should be 7 of them in total. They supposed to be used for a hundred years. Have they been activated again? I believe so.” At least 2. “They are meant to ground the material plane and section off all others from the world in order to keep this reality stable while the dragon rested.” It is meant for our safety, not his. “While they are there, they channel the elements with no need for this (feywild). No need for the divine realms, no need for the realms of shadow, ice, and the like. If they’ve been activated, its possible for those realms to be activated. Its how he would remain a god.” Coatls are the only ones left. “There was a knight of the old realm who resided in a city of towers down south.” What was his name? “I can’t remember it right now.”
(He’s referring to Rozen. The lush jungles would have still been there. It would mean that history of Old Dragboni Empire forming Rosen was a lie.) “A knight of the coatls.” “Three questions that Threnirax will answer truthfully.” “Devils sustain themselves off of mortal souls. Wherever you are are demons and devils.” We’ve only seen demons, no devils “Then the hell portal must be cut off, and only the remnants remain.” “He likely gave the dragons/giants gifts and then stole them back. As long as neither finds the other, then war continues. Neither can deny a gift from god.”
We came across a wizard who sent things through a portal to Threnirax. He was attempting to turn elves into hosts. Harven Dasvonther “Its simple. He has a limited humanoid form, and this would allow him a permanent form. You killed the transformation wizard, so you did a good thing.” “If you want, I can do a quick duel and see how you fair against him the last time we fought.” “He’s not a giant, he’s not even a dragon. He’s a shapechanger made of silver. I told him not to see me physically again after the last convo we had.” “He attempted to stab me, I struck him with lightning, we went our separate ways. You may call me selfish, but I like the First World, and wanted to keep part of it alive.” “I’ve said my refusal to go along with a plan, or awaken the slumbering dragon beneath us all.” 1000ish years ago, before he stole humans “How he stole the truth from giants and dragons is anyone’s guess, but I still remember.” Is it because you were asleep? “Maybe my dreams protected me.” (still dreams, unlike giants) “The dragon would not want to hurt its children. Its true children.” Does it have more children? “Yes, but I am an immigrant. Not a true child.” “Threnirax is the only one. We were told [not to question how he was a shapechanger]. I would not go against my lord’s word.” What would be inherited? “The wings that which the giants will stand on.” “The dragons inherit the beating heart. The long part where the soul is kept.” “He would not harm me, and I would not harm him, as part of our pact. You are outside of that pact.” You have a pact? “Its a pact between two powerful people with the world as its witness. Thought he will not maintain honor, he will maintain the pact.” What would happen if he broke the pact? “I assume he would die. Just like how I believe I would die if I did. But he hasn’t.” “Once the dragon has awoken, it would harm us, and he would die, having done his goal.” You made this pact, but what did you do? Was it just word? “We stood on the dragon’s bare scales, where we told him to beat his heart 3 times in a minute if it understood us.” “The seven of us precided over the planes. I was over the eternal storm. I was meant to activate it and let it run for 100 years, after which I would check it every millennia and let it run for another 100 years.” (we turned that off. Its why he is currently so weak.) How long would it take you to recover your strength? “1000 years.” What did Threnirax precide over?
“Divinity. He maintained talk with your gods. The city known as Advesperascit.”
Sooo. 5.5ish years ago the Divine Gate opened and our god were dead. Skeletal. “He’s not strong enough [to kill them]. They likely tried to run from what they created and locked themselves in.” (The stuff the dragon is protecting here from. It might have escaped to our world since the divine gate opened) Would it be possible to get the names and domains of your siblings? “I’m afraid not. I can’t fully answer.” (Dubiously in the pact, and he’s not ready to kill himself to potentially answer a question. That could be considered putting them in danger) Some siblings might be friendly to us
A hole opened up and dragons flew up in Erolyth “The lord down below bled for a second.” How would the lord bleed? “I don’t know, but I would assume our mutual enemy is behind it. You’re lucky. It failed.” We were interested in going there, is it safe? “Probably not, but you managed to speak with me despite the rune of the old world protecting me.” (So if anyone could do it, it would be us)

Giant sage (Varkash) Parts of reality that is needed for this Storm, change, chaos Fey?
Grundil near one of the old abandoned citadels of dragons. He resides between 2 bookcases now
Undril (she/her) Resides in the Great Sea Chasm, the mortals have started calling it the “Eternal Abyss”
Ulthanim (they/them) resides in the Einventh Grove
Lahabel resides in the far wings of our father, on the very edge of an unnamed set of ruins, deep within your people’s lands
One or the other
Malak The other in the part we never finished, (the shadow) “This is isolated from the external realms of the material.” “If you got rid of the material, you would be left with nothing.” If we were to meet another one of your siblings, would they also be able to ask questions to Threnirax? “If they’re as kind as me.” Are they all as kind as you? “Some.” Any signs to look out for to know we’re contacting friends? “Unfortunately, the only sign is if they attempt to disintegrate you, assume they’re not friendly.” Varkash starts his chant, stomping On red crystal, the image of silver appears Pleasantries with a tinge of bitterness Varkash to Thernirax “How are things in your domain? The gods of the baselands.” Thren: “They stopped responding 800 years ago. It was a simple cry for help from all who could hear. Unfortunately, I was busy. As for the other issues that are going around in the continents and realms around, they have their own issues, and they’ve gone silent recently. We might be the last things close to gods left.” Varkash to Thernirax, talks about memory issues “I wish to talk about anything else right now, if that’s alright.” (skip) “I need to visit our other siblings, where would they be now?” “Grundil is near one of the old abandoned citadels of dragons. He resides between 2 bookcases now. Undril (she/her) is in the depths of the great sea chasm at this moment. Ulthanim resides in the Einventh Grove. The other in the part we never finished, they still reside- the mortals have started calling it the “Eternal Abyss”. Lahabel resides in the far wings of our father, on the very edge of an unnamed set of ruins, deep within your people’s lands.”
“I’ve heard of a fellow named Meitremar, who appears to be your first and last disciple. Can you extrapolate on that?” “I see, they are with you. Then, for them, a simple: He is the first one who has truly seen me, and you, too, are on the path to Meitremar.” Crystal goes dark “Unfortunately, he can speak in riddles.” “He” is Threnirax Varkash to us, regarding us avoiding becoming Meitremar “Dying is what you people excel at.” Do you think if you struck down Meitremar, do you think it would stop the resurrection process? He doesn’t know “I doubt he would take direct action against me, since I cannot against him.” “I would recommend you stay the night. If you do, good things may happen.” Could you give more details on how orcs came to be here? “They were a surprise. I don’t know much. We weren’t told we were going to have visitors, but when we helped set the world up, there they were. This land used to belong entirely to the orcs. I gave them their own home, but they may have been a hindrance to my brother’s plan, so they took out the civilization himself.” Looking around Orcs close to Urgan’s clan grew horns The statues have snarls, or orchish grins Worship site, they were worshipping the fey onto this part of the world, creating a little pocket of fey where it should be impossible to exist

Not all of us are as pleasant to look at as me.” “When he was a true mortal, he was but a simple changeling.” We rest for the night He passes a small rune to us “For your ship” Simple rune to attach to our ship to make sure that the wind is always to our back “I would recommend, if you have the skill, you can make your ship fly with it.”

A: Stulffri Proper noun, location Judging by various debris, there was a central explosion. Majority was a pointed explosion, pointed downward toward the earth. Roughly 60ft in the air by the time of explosion Crystal seem magical, but need to do testing Ancient dragon in the distance Gold 2 others smaller, can’t tell Come closer to the dragons up a cliff “And what of the tribute?” (Give the 9k we just got) “And why have you come all this way?” We would like to know what’s going on in the dragon world that we may be of any aid. “I doubt one of you would be of any help.” Whatever we may do could be a benefit toward you, no matter how small! “I could always use more gold. I know, and can smell, that there is more on you.” I feel there is a few things we could do that may entice you better than gold? “The most helpful is ask what you came here to actually ask instead of wasting my time.” We wish to find out what happened here in the city and what caused such ire to be rought down upon it. “The mortals decided to build upon our land, and when we came back to the world, they suffered for it.” Where have you been that has not been the world? “The heavens above, of course.” How long were you gone for? “I, as the oldest, the first of the divine gifted, was taken 1200 years ago.” Why have you returned from the heavens? “Because it is the time to return. We come as a messiah to help with the war efforts of our earthly kin.” The dragons who have stayed here? “Of course. 1 in 100 are chosen, and by the time they hatch, the egg comes out empty, and they go to the divine realm. Now, here we are. We lived in peace in luxury and commune directly with god for Eons.”
Arcianthus or a different deity? “Arcianthus of course. The only one that matters.”
Our gods were behind a Divine Gate. Did you have a similar… “Of course, that is why we couldn’t return to the world. But one day it opened, and here we are. How fortunous indeed. The path to follow our divinity is nigh.” You deserve to rule. Is there anything we can do as mortal creatures to have the least loss of life, or is it an inevitability of the changing of the world? “It’s not inevitable. You’re returning back to the land you’re intended to. Not the peripheral, but the central, as God intends. I’m sure you’ve noticed that some of your own have turned to dragons. 1 in 100 will turn.” And what of those who have turned into giants? “It will just happen.” And what of what happened here? “This is where we returned from.”
Do you plan to awaken the dragon that sleeps beneath us? (World Dragon) “Now why would you ask such a question like that?”
One in the capital has been speaking of the city resting atop their head, and this being how we’ll be kept safe from harm during their inevitable awakening, but I did not know how accurate, since he is human and not from this world, so I thought you may be able to confirm. “The awakening will be metaphysical, but it should not concern you. Don’t worry and sleep tightly knowing you’ll be safe as long as you follow our orders. You can do your alchemy and witchcraft in your own.” Is it polite to practice divine and arcane in this land, or not at all? “It is fine. But if you wish to be changed, you would stick to divine and arcane.” Is worthy the same? “If you lived well, you would be a dragon, but if you lived poorly, you would be a giant.” Where do you stand on the magic of performing arts? “We prefer the higher arts rather than the small arts of humans. We sing and dance for eons and not minutes.” (Dragon performances can go on for so long, they can last years.) “You first need to live well as mortal. I assume by these pointed questions you have been chosen as worthy?” Yes. “Then live well, and I won’t be forced to kill you later.” (As long as we don’t turn giant, there’s no reason to kill us.) Do you know of anything regarding a mortal king who foretold the metaphysical change? “I do, but I have no reason to tell you.” The one who did was from our world, so I was surprised. “Odd, but perhaps there were no mortals that were worthy here.”
When you were beyond the Divine Gate, did you hear anything from other deities beyond The Pale? “The false gods?”
Yes. I think? Like, was there a Nethys? “That’s more than the gold that you brought would be worth. That’s more than any of the gold upon you. Here, I’ll make a deal: if you poured all the gold in the world and did it 2 more times, I’ll tell you.” I appreciate you allowing us to back out. “May I ask a question of my own?” Of course. “What direction did you come from? (When we entered the world or how to get here?” South both ways
“I had a scout down there, Halderis, who did not report in on schedule.” Would they have happened to be a magma dragon? “But of course.” We met them in combat and defeated them. We can give you their bodypart if you wish to return them from death? “They were a divine dragon, you understand. Chosen from god at birth.” We tried to appease them. It was regrettable. (Hard diplomacy check) “You might just be a true dragon yet.” (The 2 side dragons, adults, lay down their necks.) (Long bow to it) “I can fly you to your ship if you want. Save you some days. But remember, if any of you turn into giants, make sure to stab them through the neck midtransformation.”
We fly back to our ship on the dragon Wandering Embassy
Captain is bewildered “I thought- how did you end up meeting a dragon.” They’re still nearby. “So they conquered it as war spoils?” They say this island is for dragons, so they’re taking their land back. Explain how we killed an adult dragon “It is actually quite noble to fight and going down to fight for your comrades. You just have to believe it is noble. You wouldn’t spare any extravagant details if you weren’t trying to convince the audience. Your story was excellent”
Travel to Omu Lich “Youre back. Minus 4 to you Gavin.” - Have you been expecting us long? “Longer than anticipated. Gavin took a while to take you back here.” Gavin -10, Arbul -4 (for redemption yaoi) What is your name?
“Cadium.” How long have you been alive? “Not long. 50 years.” (He turned into a lich when he was 50) How long have you been undead? “I would rather not say.” You’ve mentioned you were waiting for our return. Is there anything you were hoping to ask before we do our laundry list of questions? “I have time, you don’t.” Why does this area need overseeing. “It needs an overseer for its purpose.” What’s its purpose? “The transmigration of souls.” Transmogrification? “No.” Are you trying to stop that? “No.” You have no idea who’s doing it? “I do.” Is it the dragons? “I can’t say.” Souls coming from here to somewhere else. I know the divine plane has had dragons leaving it, but where are the souls you’re shepherding going? “Back to the earth. Why would we be on the earth if not there.”
Back to the World Dragon? The quilted sky? “One and the same, really.” Are you a child of the world dragon? “No.” Do you know of them? “Yes.” Do you work alongside any of them? “Of course.” Which ones? “I’d rather not say.” Are you bound by a pact of nonaggression? “No, I just don’t like you. All those I like are long dead.” “I am immortal, and you are not.” DO you need to feed on souls in this realm? “Yes. But do you know how many souls pass on?” No “Approximately 1007 a second.” I presume your soul cage is somewhere impossible for us to get to “You could get there, but it would kill you and then I would just teleport away” I apologize for my companion’s way of negative speech to you, is there any way we could make that up? “If you could ask your questions and I ask mine.” Do you know about the aboleth nearby? “You could talk to him. He’s quite lonely.” Is that relevant…? “He is the last of his kind.” There’s a laboratory in here? With a baby? “There was, but the baby was killed.” What was the test? “The birth of a god, but Gavin killed it in womb. Do not worry, if it's not born, it is not a living being, it cannot die.”
This dungeon- is that related to the experiments to give a certain Threnirax a mortal form? “Initially, but we succeeded at those 800 years ago. These are my own personal experiments.” Then why were more tests being done? “We gave him a physical form, but it may not be what he wants. I only oversee his dungeon now.” Are you sad? “No.” Could you be sad about it? “No.” Do you know what the purpose of the war between the giants and dragons is? “Of course.” Do you want to tell us? “No. I don’t quite like you enough.” We appreciate you letting us ask you so many questions. The dungeon is 3k, but people claim that the world is only about 1050 Is that discrepancy related to the loss of memory in general in that whole situation with convincing the people of the world’s youngness, or is it so old because it’s from someplace else? “What do you know, Master Arbul?” WDYM “You asked a very pointed question. The question is precedent to some sort of information.” You wish to know what we know about the world’s age so far? “Of course. I would not reveal information you don’t deserve.” What is your relationship currently with Threnirax? “Friendly coworkers. About even.” When we tell you this info, might we know who gets to know about it? “No.”
We know that this world is older than what the giants/dragons think it is, because they have memories that aren’t accurate. At some point during [X], humans/orcs crossed from our world, and around the time the dragons believe the world started, humans were brought over. The world dragon was sleeping longer than most people think except the people who were there. About 6 years ago, Meitremar appeared. “Yes. So what is the question?” The age of the tomb. Is it something to do with something that crossed over from across the pale, or was it [smth else i missed]” “Neither. It is both older than this world and older than the understanding that you & the people have of this world.” Even further beyond the dragon god? “The another god came before him, Is it possible this world didn’t come from our world but another world? “Why not both?” Have you travelled to many worlds? “Three” This world, our world…? “Not your world. Three worlds total.” All on the mortal plane?
“Of course. You’ll be a proper hero yet. I went through one, its name was Faerûn, another Agathrond, and this one.” When and if they awaken the sleeping dragon, how would you remain-” “I’d be fine. Don’t worry your beautiful bald head.” (Has a way, won’t tell us.) Do you have a particular care for the plans occurring, or is it a relationship of convenience. “Convenience. I’d be willing to work with you, but Gavin is in the -300s at this point.” What’s the lowest? “-300s” Have you used this point system before?” “Of course.”
Do you know what happened to the gods behind the Divine Gate? “Bits and pieces, but it doesn’t concern me.” What about the trial these fellows underwent? “Of course. It was to see if they were worthy. It was also to see if one he didn’t have dominion over could be king. They were worthy, but not worthy to be king.” “No matter what happens, do you swear I’ll be alright?” What if we alter the deal? Could we agree that you won’t harm us, and we won’t harm you? “No. The specific deal I mention, or you don’t leave and I harm you.” “I promise to help you.” So the deal is, we promise not to harm you and you will help us What do you get out of it? “The finishing of my project. And the various souls that I’ve collected, I get 0.8% of it.” 1 against, 1 abstain, 2+ for “My arrival and Threnirax’s awakening happened at the same time.” Why did they coincide? “Most mortals can’t handle the process.” Your arrival didn’t bring about his awakening? “No, they merely coincided.” Was there no shared cause for both occurring like arrival in this world or weakening of the Pale of the gods? “I can tell you exactly what happened when I woke up. The great cataclysm of our worlds. My world was Faerun and Agathrond and here.” When the sun went dark? “Don’t be so naive Arbul.” (He is doing this because, no matter what happens now, he has won.) “I came here a long time ago from a land far away. Agathrond.” What happened?
“It got taken up by this world. The great conjoining. The council came together to try to force it apart, tried to separate it. Create a discrepancy to separate it as each peace landed. A great discrepancy about the void of notion than the notion. This was mine, and I had landed over a great dragon and a changeling chasing after his father from the realm what they once called Eberron.” Now that you’re here, what is your end goal? “Bring back my old lord and bring myself to godhood. Those beyond the divine gate were all mortals and they lied to you all 10000 years ago.”

sessions/across-the-pale-campaign/sessio.description:

Next Session: Session X+16
Omu Who is your old lord? - “A good lich. It’ll be nice to rise above him.” Any specific one?
“I doubt you know. Acererak.” (We don’t know who it is despite really high rolls.) Oh, huh, yeah IDK. Any great accomplishments? “This and that. They helped build the original design for this area that i helped perfect in a small junction point.” Are they gone? “For now. But he’ll be back when he sees what I’ve achieved.” Where is he? “Great beyond.” What happened to him? “Some get jealous, and they kill because of the jealousy.” Our gods being mortals. Could you elaborate on that? Is that the reason they were able to be killed? “I doubt it. You can kill a god easily if you plan it. There’s no such thing as a true immortal in this world.” Are you a true immortal? “No. You could kill me, but the way you do so probably falls outside your morality.”
We’ve heard a creature that was contained behind the Divine Gate that was the death of our deities. Any idea what it is? “Maybe they finally just started rotting. They’ve been alive long enough.” They were apparently screaming for assistance? “I’d imagine you would too if an infection started eating your skin.” An infection? “A metaphor.” (None of this is his concern, he’s taken precautions to make sure that he won’t be affected. He does know about their ascension, but doesn’t know about their death. He was truly down here in a hole in the ground at a “juncture”.) This areas a small junction point, WDYM “The space between worlds where there is the suspension of reality. Then, there’s some parts that overlap instead. A juncture. As long groups enter together, they come to the same reality, but if they split, there’s a copy elsewhere.” “If you were to destroy the entirety of this dungeon now, it would still exist in every other copy.” Can you travel between those? “Of course. You could stay and learn if you have 500 years.” What other worlds are there that you travelled to? “I don’t think you understand. The differences between the worlds are… when you enter a junction point, you create a small spatial rift that only you can see, but when you leave, it goes back to how it was. Your observation changes reality, but when you stop observing, it goes back to original blueprints.” “If you destroy me or this area, I’ll just reappear unless you enter the default reality.” Is this not…? “No. You entered, and this was a new reality.” You had some questions for us? “Yes if you’re ready.” Could we go back to asking questions after? No probably not
Do you know where that giant door in the Choosing Dungeon leads? “I want to say an old castle. I’ve never been there myself.” Do you have any recommendations for what we should do next for stopping apocalypses?
“You could always try to kill the son, the one who determines who’s worthy. The great World Dragon does not wish to wake. It obscures your movements in the city, of course. It provides some screening.” “You could also try to kill the dragon soul within him if you could reach it.” How do we do that? “Great question. IDK.” Do you know how to get to it? “It’s probably behind the worthy door.”
We’ve been working on a meter to track Meitremar, if you have any recommendations for upgrading, that’d be great “I can teach you how to eat the soul. It wouldn’t stop him, but it would stop that incarnation from adding to the collective.” Would we know where it was going to go, though? “Yes.” “You always then deliver the souls to me.” “Meitremar was hung 2 days ago.” How did you hear about this? Why was he hung? “Assisting the resistance group.” How are they doing? “Fine. They’re still shielded. It’s just Meitremar isn’t because of his nature. Thankfully for him, I don’t think he can die.” What about the regular people’s souls if the Meitremar souls are eaten? “I’m sure they’ll be fine.” Do you know about my (Rargwar) clan’s artifact? “They were natural people from this region. He may have lacked the ability to make his own divine artifacts, so he took it and modified it. So he now has a wonderful artifact to call his own. For all his skills in subterfuge, he never was wonderful at creation.” How does the souls being used this way affect you? If this whole apocalypse occurs, what happens to the souls you were trying to get? “The apocalypse happens, thousands of people die, and it’ll be like a flood. If you lose, I win. If you win, I win.” (Smth abt Meitremar) “You can catch one Meitremar soul, you should then empty it, lest it burst on you.” (There’s a chance of betrayal here, not from him but from us. If we release it, it would flee to Meitremar, telling us where the next one is.) (He works on one of the meters) Questions from him
“Gavin, you get to finally talk. Hopefully, make it count. What do you say a little deal? A deal for both of your brothers (Alec Rooks and Aaron Rooks) and the return of your father Andreas Rooks. 2 traitors for one who stayed true to you to the end.” Why would you ask this? “I’m on your side. We’re friends, aren’t we?” I feel like- how long will you give me to think about it? “Til you leave. When you leave, the deal’s off. Stay as long as you like, but I wouldn’t recommend staying longer than a year.” Why a year? “Well, I doubt anything will be outside there after a year.” “A small question. Have you ever thought of infecting dreams, Kyrie?” It’s not out of the question, I could certainly try. “You could always try, the dragon might lighten the defenses for you. Just have to prepare for them.” (Asks some general questions about the state of our home society) All of these are questions pointed very inland, far away from any water. “I was offered a position (as a dragon child), but I decided against it.” “All of the dragon kids will help in some way, though others are less straightforward than others.” Perhaps a more postmortem assistance? “They’re all alive. Why would he kill his siblings?” Oh, no, I mean us killing “Oh, no, you don’t need to. None of them are the type to kill their siblings (grins at Gavin)” Any recommendation for those to visit first? “Can you breathe underwater or take great pressure?” Uhhh. Not really. “If you kill the aboleth, I will be very upset about you. Not enough to kill you, but he’ll be very upset when he returns to the base reality.” Aboleth “Welcome back.”
I never got a chance to ask Cadium your name. “This one doesn’t have one anymore.” Would you like one? “No.” How did you get here? “I was captured by Cadium, and then he killed the rest of my people on the Isola. Isola? “This land.”
(This land is called Frethïar) What do you do down here? “Meditate and hear my people.” You’re not part of the hivemind? “I’m not, but I hear errant thoughts. My kind are under a place called Caldera, waiting.” How are you surviving? “An aboleth cannot starve fully.” Would you like some food? “If you’re willing to step into the water, of course.” Gavin wants to know if you can help him to breathe underwater again. “Of course! He just needs to shake my hand.” How old are you? “This body or mind?” Both “The body is only 1600 years old. The mind is unfathomly old.” Did you mind come from a different place originally? “Of course.” Any recollection of that? “I am one of the few with individuality now.” You can remember what happened? “Yes. The others now believe that they were from the worlds they’re now on. Others gaslit themselves.” Can you tell us about this place of existence?
“I could. I’m originally from the Sulnor Ocean.” What was it like? “Plenty of people. That’s not important. None of them are alive, would remember you, or know you.” What was this world like before the lich? “This world? You have to be more specific. Fathiar.” It’s currently known as Frathiar. “It was magnificent of scale. The small intricacies of the dragon and the land slowly settling down as little bits fell on top.” SO you were around the shaping? “I was around the birth of 2 worlds.” What worlds? “You weren’t around for the first, and I don’t have the energy for the 2nd.” You’re not lonely? “Of course. He promised to free me. At the end of my service, in a year, I’m out.” A particular deed? “It won’t take a year.” What’s the deed? “The awakening of the great dragon.” You would survive that? “Of course, you would too.” And then he’d set you out to the new world? “Of course.” Do you think they’ll set the dragon back to sleep? “The answer is quite simple: The great chasm below will open once again and I’ll see what lies beneath it. Surely the dragon wasn’t the first thing to fall here, and it certainly wasn’t the last.” Why do you want to see it? “Because then I won’t be here. I’ll be out there.” What if the dragon doesn’t awaken? “Then I’ll be trapped here, but that won’t happen.” So you’d rather face certain obliteration than be trapped? “Why would it be certain obliteration?” I was led to believe it was a void of nothingness. “It would be certain to believe what you reside on is the first that’s ever come.” Any theories what’s down below? “As far as what I’m aware, I believe the origin of the Echo is down below.” Echo? “The thing that brought all the other worlds here. The worlds didn’t naturally collect in one plane, something called them here.” “You can sail here because there’s no lightkeeper organizing the chaos.” Is it still echoing? “It still is, but it’s not concentrated. We’re in the inner layers, shielded from it. But the further out you go from the base reality, the more likely you are to see land fall.” Land fall? “Somewhere, more land forming, falling from other worlds. Though whether they come from other worlds or are simply landing now. Sometimes, new aboleths are found, and they let out their psychic screams.” So you literally mean that land was coming from another plane. “I wouldn’t call it a fall, but metastasizing upon the world.” And this land is called from the echo, or the echo causes metastasizing? “IDK. I need to see it first.”
Do you know anything about Meitremar? “What is it?” A collection of souls “IDK” We fight the t-rex for some reason - because myka is needy We won We tossed the Adult Red Dragon head (i feel this is important to note) Go to chosen trial dungeon

COME BACK HERE TO TALK TO PATH MAIDEN Go down the door below, odd passage Cave bear Eyes of an animal that has died before, small scars that it dies and reheals from repeatedly There seems to be like 100 bears based on the footprints around
Bear is crazed bc it keeps coming back like at Omu Portal room Portal dead It used to lead to the wizard lords sean thinks: this place has collapsed. thats why all the prints overlap and kyrie feels no magic and the portal is dead Sort of, like an abandoned factory, it has made/done enough that it is unneeded Enough chosen have been made Spiral staircase TRIPPY AREA
Desiccated corpse in a reforming map at the bottom of the world
“Vault of the Old God” The old reforming god looks at us The cosmos around has bits of vapor Sorry for barging in on a lovely home….? Creature seems connected to undeath, more than lichdom, unable to die but also unable to reform Odd marks on the body that resemble old tales of power, unsure of origin If they are dragon marks, i'm shitting myself -sean Extends a hand Telepathy Hello…? “Common enemy. Help.” What common enemy?
“Treacherous changeling.” Threnirax That is a common enemy. Who are you? “Closest to god in world I come.” Do you have a name?
“Vol.” “I help. Ask nothing in return. Carry part of me out so I can live.” This creature has spent unknown amount of times isolated due to a weird flaw in the way she’s reforming, she’ll never complete the reconfiguration. By taking this, she can leave and see what’s going on in world. In return, she’ll get revenge against a changeling who killed her in the past. She is a spellcaster with the capability of armor, she’ll do whatever she can to escape. If you want revenge, I do too. What do you know of our common enemy? “Left place to finish using my power to make chosen, excellent thief.”
(Text on her is found in Rozen, the S’leah language which is before Dragboni) How do you know he’s a common enemy? “You would not be here if not. Doesn’t let ally, and thus only foe, in.” What was your enemy’s name? “Darstellar. Among others.” “Accept deal.” Deal accepted. She starts disintegrating after the deal is made.

Vault of the Old God Constellations are unfamiliar We leave the astral prison Go to the crystal to talk to the path maiden Hello there, we don’t mean to bring any harm. Who.. are you? Do you have a name?
“Astareth.” Male name, when you die you become a path maiden no matter what Odd, might be something there or might be a dead end “Why have you come?” My friends came here when they were labelled worthy. “I know I fought with them once, and was sent back.” Would you say we were worthy? “Of course, you defeated the challenges.” What do you mean sent back? “Recalled. We play the part of all monsters here. All but the bear.” Who sent you back? “The leader of the place.” Is he here? “No.” We were looking for more info on this leader, looking for clues. “There is nothing but the dead and the bear here.” And the void. “That is the end of the world.” “What is death if not the end of you?” Are there other temples like this one? “There were.” What happened to them? “They were shut down, there was no more reason for mortals to pass through the door.” Which one of you played the large snake? “That was also the dead.” The snake was a chosen? “It wasn’t always a snake. It was a man.” Any particular man?
“None that you’d know. A man, the merchant, Sine.” A famous stone merchant who tried to control the rollout of stone statues, disappeared without a trace. Family had a bounty, unfortunately the city recently had an eruption of dragons. What god do you follow? “A god of revelry. If you are familiar, though he is minor to the south. The god is good, in the same way that any sort of merriment is good.”
(Threnirax pretending to be all the gods here) Why were you brought here? “I was determined worthy while fighting off bandits while drunk, and my god appeared before me.” Why did your god look like? “Handsome person, with grapes draping down below their body.” Do you know where any of the other temples were? “I know there’s one on each continent, 2-3 depending on the size.” Do you know how we might find the other temples? “The gods call you. Same as how you found this one.”
Cassalerino Port The party had so much they forgot they needed to do here Kyrie gets a rewrite memory We should be fine here if we don’t stay for more than 2 weeks
giant hole that is probably where one of the siblings is Great Sea Chasm, very purple, very in the harbor big ziggurat emitting great storm levels of heat, concerning, probably one of the devices being forced open for too long

Decorated in symbols of Irez, lady of inscribed wonder Cards, glyphs, scribes, and spells are all the purview of the Lady of Inscribed Wonder. She holds knowledge and understanding of the great power and symbolism behind runes. In particular, Irez understands how runes can supplement and empower arcane magic. It’s through this understanding that Irez is able to make enigmatic predictions on events in the distant future, which more often than not come to pass. Many of her followers are calligraphers, gamblers, harrow readers and others who regularly handle cards and symbols, be they for an arcane purpose, prophetic practices, or their more mundane applications.
Notably had angels, one solar and one daeva beyond The Pale These are the symbols of her of our world Crowded tavern Old man relieves a skeleton in front “What can I get you? You need to talk to the owner?” We had some questions about the name of your establishment. “Of course.” What is an angel? “I thought that the letters sounded good together.” (Easy lie with the initial presentation of the question) Oh yeah… of course. Divine inspiration “Divine inspiration indeed, thank the couatls for that one.” From one creative to another I understand very deeply where the inspiration comes from, I’d love to chat more about the deeper meaning. If you don’t mind, of course. “No offense, but you aren’t one of the scholarly sort.” “Fine. What do you want to know about them?” “I wake up at morn to paint the chalk on the side.” You know I’m very interested in harrow reading, do you happen to do any cards? “Uhh, no. Can you show me how to do it?” He gives us the exact number of coasters needed without telling, he got peeved at Urgan for scribbling terribly
Kyrie does his fortune, pulls The Winged Serpent “Well I guess the cards are a good way to determine fate.” Have you seen anything like that before? “Never.” (His life is divided into segments, so technically in this life he’s never done so. He is hiding it behind half-truths. He’s an angel disguised.) (By all standards, all angels have tongues up. Tripkees can’t speak here. Use myka to talk to him.)
We’ve come across the pale, we’re adversaries to Threnirax, we need to speak to you in private. (His break comes from a drunken man interrupting myka, he escorts us to the back stables and wine cellars.) “You come from the pale?” Yes! “What is the word from my lady?” We haven’t heard them speak in a long time, dead or fled, we don’t know. “Surely not dead, they have a plan. The gods have a magnificent plan.” What are you doing here across the pale? There’s no divine beings here. “I was sent to investigate the odd runes that popped up on the secret’s back. But you’re here talking about a dragon out of sight of the gods.” We’ve learned that much, unfortunately.
“We aren’t sure why, my god being fairly newer and a keeper of secrets. I was at no rank to fight the secret holder of this world (Threnirax). I know where he’s not. He’s not here, nor his throne he was supposed to sit on (atop the Eternal Mountain behind a pseudo Divine Gate). He was supposed to sit there along the others, but he refused. They left to save mortality. During the time of gods, a person could get a gift from an evil god and destroy an entire village. Now there is no chaos.”
“None where his influence can spread. And none in our sister city up north, St. Sirnach.” “I’ve been here for 1500 years.” How come the curses aren’t here? Is it something to do with the dragon turtles? “No. They prevent dragons and giants approaching, they hate gods. They are entirely tied to element, not divinity nor occult. The curse is as simple as this (shows some chalk laced with silver and gold).” I’m sorry do you have a name?
“The easiest one for you would probably be Phelios.” “It’s good that we managed to smite the bastards.” Who? “The unholy gods.” (A great war of gods, more complicated than what he made it out to be. The angels typically believe that the gods created war etc, so if those gods are killed, war and such won’t exist.) They’ve been silent as of late. “I see. The ceasefire.” Did you come alone, or with others? “I came with others, but the sneaky bastard got them.” What are you working on right now? “Save what people I can in this city.” Any plan to thwart Threnirax? “What could I do? I died once, at full power, and now i’m but a daeva.” We’re trying to get the power of his siblings. “There’s one here, but I would advise against it. She has the powers of the fires of hell.” “I tried to contain it when convincing them to build the ziguraut.” We understand that this world is built on a dragon god, do you know what’s beneath him? “Some sort of abyss, but I shant look into it.” Like a void? “I shan’t look into it. It would be against my nature and against my service.” What about the giant hole? “That’d be where her true body is. Regardless, if you can’t survive the fires of hell, I wouldn’t recommend going down there.” (step 1, don’t be a divine being. It’s regular fire for us.) Do you believe if she’s aligned with her brother? “No, but she has the fires of hell so that she’s not good.” What about my clan’s artifacts that are being fought over? Why are they being used to manipulate? “Its sad what happened to your people, while you might have once walked the land freely, it’s unfortunate the way the empires ended. He split it out, like rewetting pottery. For the cheap price of an empire and its people.” What would happen if the fires of hell within the ziguraut were extinguished? “It’s hard to extinguish as long as souls such as yourself exist. The ziguraut might be extinguished, but it would bring an end to this empire that relies on its heat. Were it that simple, I would’ve extinguished it myself early.” Where is the artifact? “At the foot of where his throne is supposed to be” (The capital) What is going on with the undead? “I believe it’s an attempt to go past the holy wards.” And your bartender…? “My faithful cleric who came across the pale. I wouldn’t look a gift horse in the mouth.” Is he sentient? “Yes!” How do you talk? “Writing.” Do you know where the pirate is?
“The one who’s a servant of Threnirax?” (Tasha Quasfyr) Yes. “Out at sea.” How often does he return? “Once every 2 months.” How long ago did he leave? “3 weeks ago.” (When we stole the ship) Do you know how the undead are being created? “Its a natural act of nature. If I could stop it, I would. He simply teases the body with an anema of their soul and create undead. The undead are sentient, and if they have a particularly strong soul, they can be reasoned with.” TO DO WITH THIS INFO: Gavin should find out if the undead bartender is a spy Can't tell Next Session: - For Zack: I need a 6th rank info on the coin - Object read symbol of helm - Rewrite memory on pirate with suspicious info on Meitremar and worthiness - Snoop around Zigurat - Enter hellfire
