sessions/across-the-pale-campaign/sessio.description:
Prev Session: Session X+18
Next Session: Session X+20
Urgan has given Laura Rooks a token to teleport urgan to her Kyrie & Gavin have one to go to the ship
Captain has one to teleport to us
We have to trek it to the ship Wandering Embassy
Kressle is quiet, Gavin talks at her Mind reading: Not thinking too hard, thinking of kind of odd “one group of killers to another group of killers, have maybe less cult stuff going on” nothing malicious under the surface Nazva 28, 1263
Back to Cassalerino Port 4 soldiers outside Ask if we’re hunters, where’s our game Gavin tries to bribe them w 5gp to let us through
“C’mon you can do a bit more. You of all people should know how Napaka can be with unsuccessful hunts” Fact that we just came from a known necromancy infested woods, they’re doing a search for bite marks that would carry diseases Would think we’re doing necromancy if they saw the pirate’s corpse Bribe with another 20gp Look at our tattoos “Which gang do you belong to?” U: No gangs, it’s from my clan, bring power to those who they’re on. “You’re not part of a gang but you’re smuggling drugs?” G: he’s something of an exaggerationist. Its more or less to say that we have ambition, something that binds us together U: we’re a private club. Let’s leave it at that. “I won’t ask, lest one of the merchant lords knows.” Captain “Alright, what did we manage to learn from the operation” Not a whole lot, they were prepared for us, we’ll have to do some repairs but i can talk to the corpse The last time the party was here, the ziggurat was picked clean and given to a merchant lord
Jessie O'Tamu Man lived for 700 years, had the artifacts under their purview for 600 Fix the jaw
Talking Corpse on Tasha Quasfyr's corpse
Who is Meitremar to you? “A good drinking friend.” Why did you approach our captain with the job you gave us? “Because you exceptionally skilled at killing people, I’m sure you’ll agree.” 1 thing that seems to be of note. Familiar with talking corpse, using manevours to avoid to lie to waste questions She succeeded her spell save What do you know about the chasm? “There’s a chasm.” Kressle Sit her down “Well. We were a fairly new rising pirate crew-” U: Before or after the fires? “Before you came and lit the fires and threw me down a hole, Urgan.” U: Well. Now that you’re part of our crew, things like that- (shuts up) K: why did you join us? “The only option is a cult of people slowly losing their minds. They claimed they could dream.” haven’t had any dreams since we came here, but we also don’t stay for very long If dreams are necessary, the only thing protecting this area is stopping them from turning dragon/giant. People planted here are the way to revert it, enough people planted = the protection is useless. “They’re very strong, but not so hardy. Those are the ones that could dream.” “The captain was very smart and very strong.” K: Any more within the city like that? “I don’t think so.” (too low level to know.) G: how long have you been here? “I’m turning 25 next month, I think.” G: your entire life you’ve been here? “Outside a month or two” R: how many could say they could dream? “Just the 4 you killed.”
(never classified how Cadium’s souls are taken, he probably takes souls and keeps the chosen souls) K: there were 2 other people fighting alongside the captain, one was meitremar
“Oh! Davius. Got ill one day, and then found god. God healed him.” A: how long ago? “Roughly 2 weeks ago?” U: So. He died. Fully. And his soul combined with a powerful being known as Meitremar. (she thinks she’s joined another cult) G: please just work with us, you’ll be paid for your time “What group activities do we do in the morning and evening?” U: We drink? (fumble with words) Captain: LET’S TALK ABOUT YOUR PAY- leads her away. Warfare lore on the map Notable outposts, outposts that would be good for cutting off supply lines Likely inactive, better to hit it all at once Local government will pay a lot of money for this
GO TO JESSIE O’TAMU O'Tamu Estate Guards let us enter, don’t try to disarm us “He is in the study” A: Has our legacy spread far? “Of course master arbul :)” “You’re quite famous around this estate.” G: famous in a good way? “Of course.” Undertone of they don’t know, but trust the judgement of the master Absolute faith, cult-like faith Enter, attended to Asked to take our shoes off “I’ve been expecting you.” G: thanks for having us “I expect my concierge took care of your needs.” (he’s wearing indoor shoes) “You can sleep here instead of your ship. There’s nothing wrong with it, but hard to get a hard night’s sleep.” G: You do have probably many people in your network who knew we were coming to you “I have a wide array of receiving information. It’s the way of a Wizard Lord, you know.” K: what do you specialize in? “A bit of this and that. Now, gavin, the stealing of artifacts is not good.” G: it was a joke “It wasn’t, but I appreciate the lie.” G: You have a keen eye. “And keen mind.” R: uou know about our proposable then? “I’d still like to hear it.” G: we were hoping to bargain information for a gander of your wares. “The artifacts?” G: yes. “What would you like to know about them?” “What do you think they’ll find in 3 mins that I hadn’t found in 600 years.” K: What have you found about them? “Of course. Interesting bits and tidbits.” “I propose a deal. One of the locations of the bases found in your mind in exchange for questions.” (Arbul thinks really hard about explicit yaoi.) (he’s a merchant lord here, he’s been here for 600 years.) Lady in the back has pustules on her body. U: Who’s your companion? “Someone I hope to make an apprentice. I hope you can forgive her current state.” Looks at Kyrie “don’t worry, kyrie, it’s not poison.” G: pardon us for being cautious “Of course. Do you have name of the bases. You have 5 of them.” Urgan takes out the map, he immediately reads it mentally He can read the mind of those closest to him “While you’ve given away the map, I’d be willing to trade inscriptions of your tattoos in exchange for those questions you sought.” G: Why are you interested? In our tattoos.
“I’m a scholar. It’s extreme arcane interest. I was wondering what was in that basement, and you’ll save me a trip.”
(Choosing Dungeon) A: would you say you’re pro or anti world ending? “Anti.”
K: what are your thoughts on the World Dragon awakening? “I would say it would bring about the end of the world as I like to see it.” U: The same as most people. “And yet you’re still trying to drive a hard bargain.” K: I don’t feel comfortable with your apprentice here for it. “She’s safe, she’s protected, she’s in the city. There’s no reason for her to leave.” U: We will for now accept your terms- G: We are on a quest as grand as it may seem. Once we save the world, I think the people would want to know that would help us and those that helped us. They’d be showered in praise and glory. “I have yet in my years been a vain asshole, and I would die in obscurity, and I would be rich, and I would be free. I will exactly as good of life as I can.” G: I would not be one to boast- “You are.” G: i am knowledgable in storytelling, I can keep people in the news “And that’s why you’re only banned from 3 cities instead of 5.” U: i understand that your apprentice being here is important. Youwish her to thrive and survive, but her condition is a liability. U: I believe at this point, your teacher has made his decision, what is your decision. A: i’m sorry, we haven’t asked your name?
V: “Vivasayin. He has encountered a similar fate. I should be here as well.” “A simple engraving of your tattoos for the answers you want.” K: what exactly are you hoping to learn from these? “I wish to just learn.” U: there are artifacts in your possession that are tied to the zigurat and the being connected to Urgan’s tattoo
What are these things essentially “They belong to a primordial fire spirit, one of the first flames of the world. Have the ability to burn away things, past, memories, and this one likes to burn away dreams. If you’re smart enough, you can eventually learn to read the ashes and see what is happening in the city.”
“Undril is kind, but fire does not discriminate, so be careful when approaching.” K: so you’ve spoken to her then? “A few times.” K: has she spoken any thing of her siblings? “That sounds like another question.” (Atom’s tattoo)
“We spoke of the machinations of her brother, Threnirax, but she keeps a lot of that to herself. Both of us are set in our roles, and our roles play a part in the city.” K: is she allied or against her brother? Gavin tramp stamp “I see. I’m surprised you didn’t use it against me.” “Hostile. Though she cannot take any direct action and she is, unfortunately, in poor taste. The burning is indiscriminate.” Rargwar wants to trade tattoo for info on his clan’s artifact Clan brought to the city, be protected “It can be done.” “Secure housing in the city, as long as the city stands, they have a place to live.” “I merely am going to research how enhance them.” K: enhance how?
“They used to be part of a city of towers to the south (Rozen). I’m not entirely familiar with it, but we did have books at the old school (Wizard Monastery), and I could theoretically improve it, give it time.” A: Are you interested in a possibility of exchanging info and action? “I don’t trust you right now, and while I can put you under a Geas, I prefer not to strip free will of people. While trying to save the world, some of you found that it’s hard to give the info that would do so.” Arbul tattoo, on his tail Sorry we’re not very trusting A: any course of actions to take?
“Contacting the siblings. Killing the wizard lords that are allied to threnirax. Preparing for a revolution in St. Sirnach. Unfortunately, there’s not a whole lot else to do here.” “All of them active are allied with Threnirax.” How was your apprentice exposed to him?
“The last person who had this mark, threnirax killed and trapped in the chamber. Unless you wish to enrage him. It was a half dragon lich. They called her Lady…. Illmarrow. There’s also the fact that there are forces out there that have remained hidden for a long time. The last clan that had it, they committed a genocide against.”
V: “I happened to be… the first time, I don’t remember, but I was in the capital, tending to the king’s nobles as a courtmage. The one that was dethroned. It was only until the current king- Moivicius Vrirevi that upon his crowning, I saw a wicked creature putting the crown atop him. Everyone’s eyes stopped, and I was the only one able to look around. He swore fealty, and it disappeared.” V: “I don’t think Virevi saw.” “As far as he cares, someone who quit and left the next day, it is the common courtesy. If you’re abject to the currently nobility, you may leave with no repercussion.” “Matter of business is done.” “There is a great forgetfulness in the depths. I advise you, unless you’re a masochist, to lose those old baggages as well down there. She sometimes will take the threads- back at the academy, I had a good friend, but I cannot remember their name or face, but I cannot remember their death within the pit.” G: do you recall the type of person you were before you lost them? “Very angry. But now I’m quite forgiving.” G: I only ask if I were to change. “Only one needs to go down, but whoever goes down there won’t come back the same. I’d also recommend that they be of a hardy mind. Able to control what they think about in that moment, lest she burn the lot of it and you sink down with the soulless corpses.”
G: a perilous journey into Great Sea Chasm “For one of you, at least.” K: how have you not allied with threnirax? “Luck, clarity, and the burning of memory that would have brainwashed me. The years from 1-40 are ash in my head. I managed to steal a great number of books, but specifics are lacking.” “When you descend, there are creatures who hate those that can dwell in light. You will be going below the abyssopelagic zone. Where light doesn’t pass.” Aberrations “The lady down below is technically a fiend. Quiet friendly. A good conversationist when she takes a bit of your memory. As long as you focus something, she’ll only burn that part and some tangential threads.” “As a small sign of faith, I would have Hamish join you.” “Hamish, no matter what, don’t take orders from Gavin, but you can the others.” “Who was the leader during the slaughter of the majority of the crew.” G: we did the best we could, it was a travesty what happened.
“I wish for Hamish to remain alive, so don’t follow Urgan or Gavin.”

Prev Session: Session X+20
Next Session: Session X+22 Nazva 28, 1263
Dragontop Myka recognizes we’re in the mountains, spire-like Mentioned to be in the dragon nations, where their high council would be
Sending to the Captain
Went down, talked to Undril, she sent us through a portal, now above the clouds? Go back to city, talk to urgan’s bird Setting sail now, how will you reach us? How long should we wait til we set sail again? Good luck. Captain trying to think of what to say beyond that We’ll wait here for 2 weeks, afterwards we cant be caught sitting much longer less they blockade us in Closest drop is a mere 400ft, then another area is 500ft down, then can’t see below Inner part are smaller stairs for medium creatures, bigger stairs are for creatures that need it Rargwar knocks on the door Dragons!
Sent to talk to Grundil
“This is Freeagon’s mountaintop” One of the adult gold dragon leaders of the war, technically the youngest of them but very ambitious Asks our names Gavin sucks up to the dragon who opened the door Sending spell via wind sent with our names? Young dragon comes back “Make your way through the chambers, the lord would like to meet with you. That goes with you as well (to other dragons).” Walkable clouds Dragon smiles at us “Its so gracious of you to appear. How did you get past the teleportation wards?” Is there perhaps special permission..? “Only if given specific permission from god.” We were sent by your god’s kin It was a being who knew your favored god We don’t like the giants and you don’t like the giants, so we should be friends “You are the ones who killed one of our kin and paraded his head like a backpack.” Gavin awk G: how would i best apologize? “I would like an honorable duel.” G: not to the death, perhaps? “Ours will have no guarantee. I can kill you, or if you best me, i’ll vouch for you to the council. Why would i do a 1-on-1?” G: what happens when a dragon goes against another such that one’s life is at stake. “You attempted to trespass in his territory, and you took his hoard, which you should have fled. Maybe you would have run away if you didn’t have his hoard.” Mind reading, voting Are they more useful dead or alive? Vote appears to be alive “I’m willing to make a deal, under a few conditions. Let you explore the mountaintop to your extent. You may not pick anything of value up without my permission or visage. This does not include books or things that need to be picked up to be observed properly. Two you shall harm no dragon while here. Intentionally, unintentionally, or through inaction.” U: what if attacked first? “Your word against others. Note, if they wanted you dead, I would have killed you on the spot. Finally, I will call on you, and you will come within the week.” (biggest, most obvious: he will be used as a testimony against a dragon general on the front line. If we don’t have enough evidence to support him, he’ll say he’s caught us.) We humbly accept your terms G: thank you for your graciousness and mercy. “You may do anything you wish here, and I’d be happy to assist.” U: do you perhaps have a library to look through? “Not much. No need for one. There are bookshelves in the main room and my private room.” Main room Looking around Kyrie found magic between the bookshelves, she sticks her fingers in and disappears
The Space Between Books Sea below, sky above, incredibly cloudy 2 people gnomish man, smiles and waves
One of the wizard lords, one of necromancy (Eorray Icmal) Gnome: “Sorry, we were having a discussion, but i see you have something to settle.” Grundil heals us Gavin introduces us “She was a good conversationalist, she’s been ehre for the past 3 days”
(we were in Cassalerino Port for 3 days) He doesnt get hurt by talking to Undril “She has a one track mind, it’s about burning things.” K: why are you here in the demi-plane? “Familial disagreements, its why i can’t fight her or help you fight anything. How have my siblings been?”
Ok! We’ve had some run ins with Threnirax “And you were able to recognize him as such?” More proxy run ins “Part of the problem of being a trickster being.”
We had some pleasant convos with Varkash “Boring fellow, but pleasant.” You’d think he’d be more surprising. “We often embody the opposite of what we represent. Fire and ocean, etc.” “Stories are pleasant and full of adventure. They aren’t set in stone.” “Do you know of a story that sets in stone? Opposites of metal. You see.” (he’s made of metal, that’s why he’s interested in stories) G: when was the last time you talked to undril? “A millennia ago.” G: a while, but i imagine you still have a sense of who your siblings are, what they stand for. Do you know why she would have sent us here to tlak to you? We have our own goals in trying to get out world back from threnirax, so there must be a reason she sent us to you. “I assume it is because i’m the wise one.” G: so you might know ways to defend our homeland?
“I don’t know much about defense. Defense is stone, steel is for killing. I have ideas how to kill him, but I have no way of doing so without breaking the accord from our dear father.” What’s the accord? “We can’t bring harm to each other, but we could do actions that could bring harm. Telling a prophecy, telling a story, should be fine. Handing one of you a blade, say ‘stab that man’, would breach it.” G: share a story with us? “There’s a quite sad story, about numerous small realizations that we had. Though some of us are less prone to it than others. A few siblings, of which any semblance is contrived by the audience, came from different world and have no resemblance to each other, but all have the same father. But it begs the question, if the thing down below is really their father, or possesses the memories of their fathers. It takes a little bit of thinking and spiral into denial, one says enough of it, and then wakes the father.” (threnirax is trying to wake his father to find out the truth?) “I imagine its more complicated than a simple want, but nevertheless.” G: beset at the thought it might be his true father? “Might be, or might not. The realization is that we all came to this world and despite it all, we all have a draconic father. Its a very kind thing, whatever it is, I think it is simply pulled in against its will as well. The simple reality is they all have a draconic father, they all have a tale of looking and fighting and triumph. And we all wind up here.” A: did the siblings ever exist together at a time when their father was present? “No, unfortunately.” A: so he was already asleep when they arrived. “The curious thing is that the siblings felt they knew each other, or thought they did. They couldn’t tell a story about each other, not one based in any truth, at least.” G: stories upon stories. K: you mentioned a prophecy. Is it different?
“It simply stated that the children would exist and it would all be well. According to powers that be, and it would never change. But a group crossed The Pale and killed the lighthouse keeper and people could cross however they like.” K: any conclusion to the prophecy? “1 or 2. It depends on which side wins. There are 2 sides, one is of awakening, of finding your truth and releasing it from the depths of the world. The other is of learning to let go, in learning to do so, they can forget their pasts and come together and uniting the two worlds. I prefer letting go, but i don’t fault those who think the other way. Neither side is as bad as thought. Life would end here as we know it, but i’m from somewhere where that’d already happened. Flood planes flood, and though they change, new life can grow. The old and stagnant may be removed but new life thrives. I promise i would be one of the ones to go, almost certainly.” A: importance beyond the truth? “It depends on who you ask to tell it, what you get from it and what you lose all depend on the storyteller. If you were to ask me what i would make the gift and curse of the story to be.” U: what kind of things were your previous convo partner talking about? “She was hoping bygones be bygones, if i was to forgive my sibling.” “There are those that i bicker with, but not many where forgiveness needs to be from either side. I might argue but- do you have siblings?” G: yes “You love them, and they might not have done nothing truly wrong. Its a lot like that!” G: they are shitty, and did shitty things, but there’s hope!! U: we understand what you mean good sir “Of course.” “If you wish, i understand- this is a big ask, and i’m in the position to do so. I could send you to another land, and you wouldn’t have to deal with the problems.” G: would you do that??? “I see it through the eyes of those who have done it for a few thousand years. You are more like a child.” “I am gnome-ish…. Sure.” G: i think my family deserves a chance. We can fix things. We’ve done a lot, and they’ve done some wrong things, but we can deal with it despite our differences “The empire won’t arrive if the dragon awakens, if you do nothing it might fix things.” “Understand that there are hundreds of worlds that are just as vast and wondrous. You needn’t dig your graves here, you can go elsewhere. Are the people here still worthy of your care?” G: yes. Even alec. “Then i would… offer two more stories for you and a few gifts of parting. Won’t be anything to help you kill, of course, but be something. The first small story, is the puppet master. When he dies, the puppets fell and are never picked up again. If you intend to kill the puppet master, you must first cut the strings and allow them to stand.”
K: Meitremar? (free those controlled by threnirax and THEN kill him) “Meitremar is one, but is part of the second story. The second one is… the another doll related story. About a doll that would wander out in the world, doing the master’s bidding, it would bring memories to master. Some hunters followed the doll, and were able to kill the master.” (meitremeter = find where threnirax is) (gives us 70000 GP) “What is your plan from here?” U: seek out your other siblings, ask for boons, we shall on the way meet other meitremars who will guide us to their master
“There is a small unfortunate reality of hunting down the dolls. The actor playing the doll is smart enough to not appear now. But i do know where one is always kept. By the king’s side of course, for the king is merely a doll of the doll. What is a pawn if not a doll?” “The dolls are of the same sort. The one that stays put is the one that doesn’t shatter. It mostly exists if needed. A ship that stays in port… it’s not what ships are made for.” “You are familiar with the doll. Though you might not have met, you certainly know of it.” A: a doll there for a while or…? “Recently deposed of.”
(Atharian Veldrake) A: before we leave, there’s a number of dragons outside this story. When it ends, they may appear. They seemed interested in getting- it shouldnt be a metaphor actually. There are a bunch of dragons outside of your bookshelf. Is this known to you? “The necromancer talked of it?” A: they seemed very interested in having us go in here. The only reason they didn’t kill us was because they wanted us to explore around? “I assume they know of the vast quantities of gold here. If you leave here with that pouch, they should attack you.” (below there are odd giant spires, deep beneath the sky, unfamiliar. Obelisks with hex-like shapes, that cause them to whistle with the wind.) “Since the apocalypse has come, i’ve taken to observe this place. This is another plane of existence, i will allow you- send you to a place temporarily, you’ll go where you want to go, and in a week you’ll pop over to the place you entered from.” “I hope you enjoy your week’s break from the apocalypse.” K: thank you for your stories “Of course. I hope you come to visit again.” “I’m not super familiar with where you’re going, but i’m taking from your memories.”
TELEPORTED TO NOVU MUNDI? Dirmandian Lands
In the report gavin didn’t read, arbul was fired from Castle Alchemy but then rehired bc he’s very good at alchemy and sent very far away
We’re gonna visit the Darkwater Tribe and then spend 2 days teleporting to castle alchemy to make sure Merris Hasalk & co know whats going on across the pale Level 14

sessions/across-the-pale-campaign/sessio.title: Session X+22
sessions/across-the-pale-campaign/sessio.description:
Prev Session: Session X+21
Next Session: Session X+23 Nazva 28, 1263
Dirmandian Lands
Darkwater Family Town Belongs to larger conglomerate of tribes Results in a pseudo sailing culture
Everyone assumes we died across The Pale
Darkwater Tribe sends people across the pale every decade or so Urgan is the first one to come back alive They begin aiming ballistas at us Shoot at the pocket stage gavin tries to bring out Still confused
Orcish “are you changelings from Retcog?” U: no! It is me! “You bear proof?” No… “Unfortunately, you cannot carry weapons if you cannot bear proof.” Forces us to put our weapons into baskets Throws down a ladder/basket to pull us up Brings us to urgan’s house (2 stories) No one is waiting at the door Urgan knocks What appears to be a small child coming towards
Urgheil looks up with big black eyes U: is your mother or grandmother home? Child screams and closes the door
Urgan’s Mom opens the door U: hi mother, may we come in? “Are you real?” Yes mother “All reports stated that you died.” We had traitors amongst our midst, they falsified a report. Regardless, im very much alive, but i’m only back for a short while. Can we speak over tea?
Hugs him “unfortunately, Grelda Hillhammer won’t be here til the afternoon. She works til midnight, does patrol rounds, and comes in.” U: she’s gonna kick my ass bc i lost my weapon. It was a choice between the blade and my crew “She’ll understand, but she will beat you to death.” Makes idle small talk, asking about adventures and the like U: gavin has even slain a dragon U: we have had losses, members of the crew have died, killed by traitors, gavins own kin turned blades on one another, he needs the chance to brag, i’m sorry A few people come and check on her given she’s older, not an elder, but in 4 years definitely
U: not to cut gavin off but- i know urghale is too young, but is brogun- has he done any of the- is he ok? I know young folk like to sign up as mercenaries but… “He’s… no longer with us.” U: WHAT. what happened? “We aren’t sure, we didn’t get a full report. His battalion just went missing. You are unfortunately the heir, but- i know we don’t want to pressure you at this time. Young urghale has already been announced as the future heir when he becomes of age.” U: as… he should. I’m sorry mother. M: when he’d go missing?
“During the war. When Auctur fell.” U: how has his mother taken it?
U: WAIT BRONGUN THE 3RD, not Brongan II Brongun III is fine G: all your dwellings are aggressive “In what sense?” G: they’re fortified “Last week we had a drake attack.”
“Three were injured. They’ll be fine, the Lichen Grove are tending to them” Local group of druids U: then they’re in good hands. “They’ll make a full recovery, they’re a bit… wary of some outsiders.” Looks at gavin and kyrie U: perhaps i should speak to urghale, he was frightened by me “I know you have to leave, but i could get you a boat and get you to the boat within a day, or two days.” U: we plan to leapfrog “You’re the commanding officer???” U: yes mother, though based off our last mission, i believe they plan to have another vote. Last vote had me over gavin, but it’s a miracle he was put in charge in the first place.
She lets us go talk to the Darkwater Chieftain’s hut “You return!” U: yes chieftain, but my return is temporary, the magics that let me return will wear off soon “Magics?” U: a primordial person has given us a short reprieve for what’s going on across the pale (gives spiel of traitors, saving that world, owariyaruns are still bastards) “Doesn’t concern me, i’ve never met one.” U: he’s owariyarun, don’t hold it against him “So you all met a god?”
U: similar to a god Grundil “What edicts did he preach?” U: similar to one, but isn’t one. He granted us assistance, but most of it is against us “He did magics that were stronger than the pale lady.” (more god than actual thing, but occasionally leaders will get visions of advice on how to deal with conflicts) U: perhaps his strength eclipses hers, but if its unused its worthless “Strength unused is still strength. There is still gods on this earth yet.” U: i was hoping to head to the docks to visit the nephew i haven’t scared yet “He is… we did renounce your claim to the right of your various holdings. But you are clear as day, in front of us all.” U: i wont be here for long. My property will still remain in his name “Go down there. I expect a report of signs of orcs who made it across the pale, we will name you as champion.” Docks Going down, the “child” (17ish in human) hasn’t noticed us, shadowing the various warriors training U: i always struggled. Dodging is easy, but gotta make sure it doesn’t fall in the water Guy squints U: if i could have a moment to speak with my nephew Nephew screams U: working on your battle cry i see U: make sure it’s lower in the gut U: i was hoping to ask for a favor the last time im here. Your mother may attempt to beat me to death. The weapon she forged me- it has been destroyed. “I… i’m not going to die in your place (fake deep voice)” U: no, make sure she’s in a good mood when she finds out im not dead “I don’t know how to do that for you? I do need to remind you, there is another she could replace me with?” U: i wont get away in your training, we’ll be staying the night “What happened to your eye?” U: it… is with my weapon U: i will happily tell you and your brother the tales of our exploits tonight by the fire. For now, i should give my companions a tour before your mother returns me to my grave To one of the orcs U: he is leading too much with his back foot, correct that “We’ll correct it when he learns to throw a punch. First punch, then stance.”
Forge to see Grelda Hillhammer Urgan tosses myka in Dwarf is in there, turns around with fury “Oh- i’m sorry, i thought you were someone else.” M: urgan lost your mambele “Oh so you do know him.” M: he’s outside, he’s scared to come in “He can come in.” Urgan comes in She throws her hammer at him “You’ve gotten quicker!” U: yes! I have! “What happened to it?”
U: a madman had the lives of our crew and gave me to trade something of value for one of their lives and- well… i’d already given something else. I was wondering if you would have… another blade i could use? The one i’ve been wielding since is subpar to yours. “How many people did the last one save?” U: there was the giant i killed, the hag i killed, lots of undead, servant of the fell god, the same servant again he keeps coming back… i would say it has, myself not withstanding, maybe… three score? “Three score?” U: And myself numerous times “You managed to come back somehow. Repeatedly.” U: not counting gavin, i had to fight many beasts off of him. It is surprising how many times a fierce warrior will go down in a fight. “Don’t… ask how we got this, but… we asked for one favor for what you’d done in your loss and death. We put it on your brother’s blade. He would kill me if he somehow came back and i didn’t give it to you. But if you lose it, i’ll go across the pale and beat you to death in your sleep.” Gives a REALLY GOOD MAMBELE LIKE. REALLY GOOD. She talks about the things we experienced, technology we’ve seen. She’s one of 4 different smiths who work in the Darkwater town
Caldera gavin arbul atom myka kyrie Teleports not that far from a small city
Summerwater Port town, one of the nicer ones
Diamond Ivy, fairly nice looking tavern Named for the pirate crew that settled down here to settle it Give current lawlessness of caldera, there’s no one who can say no to the pirate crew lest they give away the cannons that protect them Elven woman, lightish purple at various points “can i help you?” 2 or 3 rooms for the night “Of course, under whose name will it be?” Dave cook Little recollection “Aren’t you on my husband’s ship?”
(Captain’s wife! Farren Na'thril) (he’s going on a quest to get an immortality that would let him live as long as he needs) G: yes we might- we might know him “How is he? I heard the boat sank!” G: um. Well. this is perhaps not the immediate place to discuss certain matters, could we have a room to talk to you in private? “For friends of him, it’s on the house. You were on the crew, is there is any word of his sister?” K: sister? “She was on another ship, sailing toward a tree?”
(play by post captain Jongrun Na'thril G: we have no knowledge of him having a sister? He rarely talked about himself- but you he talked about you all the time. (she chooses to believe it) G: we’d tell you if we knew anything “Is he doing well? It must have been a success, if you’re back.” We’re here briefly G: there’s a lot of headway that needs to be done, travelling and such. He’s doing quite well! “You’re quite knowledgeable for being a janitor!” G: i’ve risen up “Swordsmanship seems to be doing you quite well. You seem quite younger than what my husband described.” Oh yknow. G: but yes your husband fares well. A few snags here and there, we’re maintaining order, good democracy amongst people “So long as he’s staying out of trouble. It seems to be very easy mission, according to the halfling.”
“Merris Hasalk.” G: hes doing very well. New lands, exciting stuff. “Do you know when he’ll be back? The mission was supposed to take 2 years.”
G: there were a few communication issues, we’re just here to clear that up with merris and Onarach, then we’ll be back on the ship, be back within roughly 2 years
(very pleasant lady, drafting something to her husband’s sister’s Jongrun Na'thril's Wife about no news, but one expedition came back safe so don’t worry about her.) Rest for the real time Nazva 29 Kyrie has violent dreams Area is thawing, trees cracking through the ice, a bright light Tomorrow will be worse. She gives a package, with a letter to give to her husband The captain was a pirate, as well as his siter and his wife Sending to Merris
Venture team 0, on the plane, headed to Ciburn, where should we expect you? Much to talk about. Kyrie edofol “Will be in Ciburn tomorrow. Must hire wizard.” Ciburn Beautiful town on the mountains Built kind of like a giant cauldron Tasteful nude of merris that looks like his grandpa still remains on the window
Castle Alchemy Kindly gnomish man looks at the party, stares at arbul “You’re back!” A: yes! Here to report on my great adventure! “I didn’t think you’d come back!” A: i am hard to kill!
This is Warren Shadowcloak, alchemist who was the rival to Garte Ringbriar Legally the one who kicked out arbul “I didnt think you’d come back so soon!” A: i am only back for a bit but then im returning! I learned a lot of poisons! “What about cures!!!” “This sounds mighty derivative of Onarach’s lifeshot formula!”
“He’s met Tiberius Acre!” G: who? “Famous gunslinger who uses lifeshot!” A: i’ve met 2 beautiful boys who are like the reincarnations of merris and onarach!!! “We’ve created many a potion til we erase this part of his brain, but every part of arbul persists like a plague!” A: they try to lobotomize me, but it doesn’t work! “I understand (that he’s helpful), but it’s company policy that arbul cannot carry a journal within sight of castle alchemy.” A: seriously though i have a lot of my poison formulas in here, please dont burn them “We will just make sure all company secrets are contained.”
“It counts from arbul’s writing within the city, as ordered by Jane Korunda, unless you want to anger Brazenthrone! Jane Korunda is sister of Drosa Korunda, and she ordered that arbul’s writing cannot be in eye sight of castle alchemy.” “Secrets, as defined by jane korunda, again sister of Drosa Korunda, are anything that are slander or libel against the owners of castle alchemy.” A: my sketches… “That’s fine. You have……. A brilliant mind.” Arbul tries breaking into castle alchemy
Gets in past the ward that Aeguntil Silvermoon put down Steals food from the pantry Restrains from breaking into rooms or alchemy supplies Does eventually finds, oddly, a coffin that seems hollow from the air gushing out of it It leads to a ladder that descends a quarter mile into the earth Lights appear down below, 4 mystical portals, all brightly lit, a fountain in the center, stars reflect in it from the cavern above A ghostly figure along the fountain, waving to sit down on it A: hello there! It doesn’t respond, motions to the water (WHY ARE SEAN AND DANIEL REACTING SO NEGATIVELY TO THIS.) It cups water from the well, drinks from it It appears that the water is very cool and pure, sinful sweetness to it He drinks of the water, spilled of tiberius, merris, and onarach’s blood in a yaoiful experience
Arbul passes out (Sempiternal Lord) Merris and Onarach emerge from the same portal, see the unconscious halfling M: Onarach- M: is he dead? O: wait, i’ve heard reports of a very weird, tailed, short, halfling creature outside castle alchemy? M: THE WRITER! The storylines are blase but i think he has a passion for the arts, not my cup of tea O: why is he down here? SOMEHOW THE YAOI HALFLING GOT PAST VERY POWERFUL WARDS O: i’ve tried everything to get rid of him M: i think it’s very weird how i take my tea and you take your eggs Throws him over his shoulder M: i’m gonna talk to jane, jane will know what to do like always. O: i’ve been dealing with it for too long M: we’re expecting guests tomorrow so O: if he’s here, i’m sure there’s others M: they’re expecting us right? O: probably harmless M: lets go say hi! Kyrie teleporting away Go up M “which one of you is kyrie?” Atom: she’s not here right now Myke: arbul let us in O “so you thought that was good enough reason to come in?” M “i’m gonna go make drinks” O “why are we entertaining them? Don’t take any occupied rooms, i’m going upstairs” Merris comes back with several expensive glasses, cheapest alcohol O “if any of you come near my room, you’ll be incinerated immediately!” M “what all- what brings you here? Your friend was very um… light on the details.” G: there’s been a lot of happenings, our sendings have not reached you, things have taken a turn. A lot has been going on M “which ship were you a part of?” G: i was hired after, i came in, worked my way up, dave cook? M “what was your ships name?”
G: Wandering Embassy? G: he deemed it important to get a message to you, so we did a lot to get here, only here for a short time, information heretofore that is given to you Merris and gavin are so yaoiful and artsy Atom: do you have an estimate how long he’ll be out? Merris wakes him up M “i was wondering why you stopped writing!” A: what??? M “your stories?” A: you sent me across the pale! M “no onarach did that” A: do you want me to send you more? M “did you get better?” A: ummmm (shows the works) M “seems this gavin and urgan fellow, do they know they’re in love?” A: they dont! M “they dont even know!” M “onarach actually has a potion to wipe this from your memory” G: oh great M “i have some right here actually” (bottle of whiskey) “you’ve definitely improved as a writer just improve some more!” A: well. Ok idk how to do that without drawing a little merris and drawing a weakpoints M “onarach didnt like that so dont do that” Party describes situation to Merris, there will probably be something to come from this but zack has to check in with players about a sunday-monday special Nazva 30 Gavin wants to see home, doesn’t know what happened Agenthill shows up to help us up O “a lot of shit has happened across the pale, i didnt think much would come from this, but these guys want to go to ruhat” Gavin is sad to hear owariyaru is gone G: this puts a presence on my mind, i am no longer just curious
Teleporting up to Ruhhat (Owariyaru)
Destroyed Rooks Estate (Remoto Estate) Town is ok, notably worn down but only targeted nobles Top parts of estate are blown up, bottom is notable fine Fairly ok condition all things considered Gavin’s room is fucked up, but only his and Aaron’s rooms survived the destruction Neither fully survived, but all the same, they’re still technically here Gavin asking about servants and people who lived there disguised as dave cook
Elven servants, Jenghar, appears to be there Generational servants that, as an elf, served gavin’s grand-grandparents They always seemed just “there” for gavin G: sorry. Don’t mean to intrude, seems i havent been ehre for a while, wondering how things have been for the city since the new paradigm has come in “Its different” G: different good? Different bad? “Different too soon to tell. So far good, but hard to pretend to be good for the long term.” G: wont know until the longterm comes along “Wont know at all probably. Eventually, even nostalgia will take over and be superceded by the nostalgia of the past. I have memories of the former noble heads before they were killed by the new noble heads before they are killed by the upcoming noble heads. These new nobles have come by and killed people.” G: nothing new under the sun “Not when it comes to nobles.” G: though i suppose some might be considered affable, nice, even if they’re nice “Old ones were great, but doesn’t excuse grandparents or great-grandparents.” “You have to take it from someone to gain it. There’s only so much nobility under the sun. if you don’t have land, your noble crown is but a fancy hat.” G: not much of a hat if you don’t have something to support you “Only means anything if everyone believes its a crown. You an actor?” G: yeah “What troupe?” G: sabor troupe
“Do they stay in Caldera? A noble kid learned trickery” This is such a hard convo to keep track of “I say they become great at violence” G: if they use it well- even violence has its own beauty “Against things like an aberration or demon, but i’ve only seen those who claim to be demon hunters kill people.” G: i wouild rather like your thoughts on manner of transition, i was looking at the houses, i saw a rather dilapidated one on the hill “Rooks estate?” G: i heard smth abt the rooks, do you know what happened? “It was to make an example, they knew no one was there. A show of force, if stone walls were blasted off, what would happen to plaster and wood houses below?” G: doesnt mean they disliked that particular family “War is war” G: what’s your opinion of them? “Id say that they were good, but now that they’re free from the castle, they may be better, little lord. They were fine, i suppose. Lords as they always are… are fine. Of those, they were the most fine, they had cruelty, propensity to war, but i’d prefer those that don’t. If most men cut off a finger of yours, you’d still prefer one who doesn’t cut off the finger.” G: someone’d have the job of cutting off the finger. “Under what circumstances might they?” G: personal gain “Personal gain doesn’t justify it. If i were offered 15 gold, would you think it reasonable to cut off your finger?” (missed stuff) G: if you had any wish, what would you do? Where would you go? Who would you be?
“Id quite like to see my ancestral homeland, it goes by Tunseel now, its a beautiful land from what i heard. It’d take 100gp to take me there.” G: i’m certain you’d come up with it one way or another, let me buy you a drink Arbul puts 100gp into their pocket G: thanks for the talk, its been enlightening, i hope you get to where you’re going Figure out what we’re doing next week bc we have 3ish days left to travel around

We decide to go to The Nexus to ask about to Moivicius Vrirevi We go to the registrar and ask if there was a Michael Vent We pay 30 gold for his transcript He is certified in linguistics, cultures, visits to various wizarding schools, and leadership He seems to actually have gone here We try to see if theres any professors we recognize

sessions/across-the-pale-campaign/sessio.title: Session X+24
sessions/across-the-pale-campaign/sessio.description:
Prev Session: Session X+23
Next Session: Session X+25 Nazva 30 1263
Discover that Moivicius Vrirevi burned his old research at The Nexus
Asking Professor Thaxar about if he could recreate the research if “Are you... interested in necromancy?” @ olwen “Can i ask why you are interested in mr vent?”
U: He was part of the group going across The Pale, funded by notable adventurers like Merris Hasalk, Onarach “Im familiar, im sorry theyre doing a body-heavy endeavor.” U: It went across, some of us were members of the original expedition, we were hit with a banishment spell
“Should banishment be able to send you across pale? You’d have to be a near deity, and they’re all across the divine gate.” U: Close to that level, they waved their hands, said some magic words. We’ll be returning. These coins are some of he funding we picked up “Might i have the coin of yours, i’ll give you a hundred of our currency for it.” U: If you were to share your findings with onarach, that would be enough for us, as him having access would directly help us “Judging by the fact that you took vent across, old owariyaru is funding this expedition?”
He has a few books on Owariyaru, but has an interest in building empires. If we took vent across, we needed a funder, then its likely funded by owariyaru U: no, but there is a separate owariyarn fleet that we’ve clashed with, vent is not as loyal as we expected. “Of course, he’s a bastard son.” K: elaborate? “He’s half elven, his family are elves, they didnt want anything to do with him.”
“Advesperascit is a wonderful city for peoples unwanted children of nobility.”
Ask about Auctur Empire “I’m not a citizen, nor do i live close, but it is sad to see a magnificent structure fold.” O: werent they taking people to fight in wars? “It was an empire, yes.” Some parts about this guy less than favorable Not keen on owariyaru
Elven man that worked for Vespertine Empire as a military advisor, so he bears the weight of their atrocities
Not there for genocide in Tunseel, but was there for invasions into ruhhat
Fondness for owariyaru is about them keeping Ruhhat in check Not a great guy but we all make mistakes in our youth of 300 years old
“I do believe the Dirmandian people will be the new empire, unless one springs from the ashes of Auctur.”
K: what about the Freilands melting?
“Bunch of corpses? Like Sighar, but sighar only happened because of the manifest zones. Unless that, and i dont believe the bodies are that good, underneath the ice there would be remmorazes under the ice and eat the people. The thaw is theoretical, we’ve yet to see if it’ll actually thaw thaw or if its just heating.” “Michael vent- vrirevi [smth smth] U: he’s aligned himself with some higher powers of the other plane/world. Possibly deity of that plane. And we believe that, if he continues, many innocents will die, more so than a regular expansion of an empire. It’ll be for naught, no empire formed, itll just be death and destruction without the empire. “That sounds like theology and i dont deal with that or the afterlife, but i’ll say he’s not even the first in line for the owariyaru throne.” A: who is?
“Some of the noble-born sons. Anemone Veremund wasn’t a regicider like Tiberius Acre.” U: he already gathered a large political power by having a king abdicate to him “Oh! Unprecedented.” U: now nobody speaks of the old king, nor has interest that he gave up his throne “What were his policies? Were they in a time of peace?” U: nation was very neutral, but wealthy. No one hated OR loved the king, simply abdicated to vrirevi, and everyone accepted it. Not a question asked. No nobilities trying to angle for more power, no citizens wonder what it means for them, nothing. Its incredibly strange “You coming across the pale is more believable. Speaking of which, that coin?” 8 copper coins & 5 silver “Theoretically, i will be in touch.” U: i will advise you, vrirevi is a bit of a bastard. It wouldnt surprise me if he sent someone back here to silence you. I would recommend you be discreet. “Naturally. If the great merris and onarach, they killed a god and i dont believe there is an assassin yet who could kill a god.” A day in advesperascit Venrach 1, 1263
Time for a fun Kyrie adventure in Hols (city of Zupool) [Zack: Hopefully I don’t make it too easy to identify why I picked this city, teehee]
Giant Ice Crystal
Giant crystals are anchor points taken from across the world, ice is from freilands, one from Jafatan for desert that only spans a kilometer, one has a tropical forest, deep ocean that allows an ocean to form Powered by not campaign relevant druidic magic Gnomish but elvish part of the city Key under the mat has been moved :( Knock on the door, shuffling from behind the door Some complex device to open the door
Iustus Edofol! gnomish “I thought you died!” Merris came to tell them that we had died after a month Their hair goes from grey to bright again upon seeing Kyrie, un-bleaching Discussing gin, drinks, and exports Lots of primal research gets done here, but most of it is using the artificial bay to export goods down the river to the other nations “Why didn’t you ask about this Kyrie?” , It literally didn’t come up Pseudo-port city, it could be destroyed at any moment We go in “How’s life across the pale been going? Are you finally back? Was communication a non-starter?” K: Long story short, we have a week long vacation and we’ll be leaving again in two-ish days “So I wasn’t the first stop?” 😠 K: We had to deal with our benefactors and things have been stressful R: How long have you guys been married? “MARRIED?? THATS MY DAUGHTER!” Adoption exists “Do you know how we die Ragwar? We fade to dust. If we loose interest in the world we turn to dust, one day we lose color in our body and fade away.” K: This is a bit morbid “Surely you’ve seen people die in your travels, youve done a lot, you’ve made pacts !” “The pact was a mistake Kyrie!!” K: Everything is going fine!!! R: He’s your dad you should tell him the truth! “Oh?? What is the truth??” R: I am from the other world which might be destroyed They are interested in the conversation, it causes some color to return to their hair “If she honed her natural abilities instead of taking the cheap way out she would’ve been even more valuable” K: I. Do. Not. Want. To Go to the nexus!!!!!!!
“You could’ve done it normally, like Aace Arubedo” K: This was so much faster!!! “You’ve deprived yourself, do you even know the terms of this pact??” The party gangs up on Kyrie “We don’t know what they will ask of you” K: I’ve barely even heard from them across the pale, I don’t think they cant even talk to me We to loudly discuss our various pacts, many of which are reckless K: Listen things are going well, I’m barely even sleepwalking anymore Sleepwalk?? K: It’s more intentional now, its fine! I know what I’m doing and its completely fine K: I fear I’m a little too far along to break anything, can’t you trust me with this? “I have to trust you! I don’t have to like it or sit idly by!” K: This is why I didn’t come here so early on, I knew you were just going to berate me R: That’s what parents do Kyrie! U: Aaaaaalll right, lets go R: I’ll have a conversation with your father later Kyrie. The rest of the party goes to look for a gift shop to kill time K: Now I’m regretting not asking for that drink. Are you doing alright? “Better now that you’re alive” K: I’m fine I promise “I know, but it could be better. You weren't yourself when you signed, you were ragged, you looked like you’d been drinking for nine days straight. It’s not good!” K: No, it's not… but at least I’m getting some good sleep across the pale. I’m not waking up in the middle of nowhere like before and I can do things I’d never imagined “I am happy for you but what have you given up? What can you no longer do? What part of the world do you no longer retain?” K: I’m still me “You are, for now, but it’s easy enough to lose yourself in these sorts of pacts” K: I will do my best to make sure its really me and fight to make sure nothing truly bad happens “All I’m saying is that the group you're with has killed something that controls fate, I’m sure we could get them to kill whatever it is holding your pact” K: They need me! “They do, but you can do this without your pact!” K: No, I can’t, I appreciate it but I don’t have the ability that you think I do “We can agree to disagree for now. But before the ways where you go back, at least consider talking about breaking it. That way when you go save the world over there it will be you saving the world.” K: I’ll see what I can do, now that we’re back over there well be able to contact them a lot easier, I’m sure they won't be happy but at the very least I’ll see what I can do Hug time “Love you” K: I love you too, I know this is very stressful “My child came back from the dead.” 😬 K: And I will be back again, I promise you “If you come back alive I’m sure they could break that pact.:” K: Okay, it's a deal “You should honor this pact.” Myka and Urgan return with alcohol to drink with Kyries dad [OOC: Maybe we should contact Kyries patron? Zack: Don’t worry they’ll be in touch.] The party gets drunk and browses shitty books, no new masterworks Olwen wants smth odd but informative
Library of Sha, 12 children raised by a father who each gain a part of his power when he passes
A Diagnosis of Desire - shitty romance doctor x patient Author not listed Kyrie goes ask about where she made her pact
“I believe they called it Ventsroad. It was during one of your first major passouts.” K: how did you find me? “Thats … not important.” K: i think it is! “Whats important is that i found you like that, asleep over cracked it. Its where it began. Anything that needs you to be unconscious doesn’t have consent. K: I’m sure I consented, the pact wouldn’t have worked otherwise!” “Not how consent works.” “A creature needs to be able to sleep and walk”(?) K: oh. That’s a bit concerning now that i think of it” “A little…?” K: “I’m trying not to be pessimistic, is that okay with you??” “That’s fair. It is a little concerning.” K: “Well, we don’t have a whole lot of time to investigate it. I’m… sure… that i’ll be able to contact them. We’ll be back soon, I’m sure of it.” “You could go back to where it was.” K: “Certainly! How far into the ice was I?” “Not far, only 50 ish miles. All things considered, not that far.” K:“Still, not an ideal location to be found asleep. Why didn’t you ever bring this up before?” “I told you I hated the pact and hoped that would be enough. I wanted you to come to your own conclusions and then I thought you died, I figured you’re going to be gone in 2 days, thought I’d try.” K: “Well I appreciate it! I don’t like that whatever is under the ice is just… hm. Its fiiine i’m sure its fiiine. We’ll check it out. We have a couple days.” “I think you go there and ask and maybe you get an answer.” K: “Well i suppose yes and answer would be better than running around in mystery... i suppose. Do you have any idea, you have had more interactions with me when i was asleep” “Asleep, but walking. I imagine whatever it is wants to migrate.” K: “Well, I don’t see why it would choose me of all people.” K dad: “Because you had great magical potential and it could entice you with letting you skip to it” K: “That’s a pretty good theory.” “You still have great potential, you just need to trust in yourself and not the other self as it were.” K: “I will consider going to magic school after all of this. Would that make you happy?” “It would make me happy to know you hadn’t wagered your soul and thrown yourself at death’s door.” K: “I’ll try to wager my soul back.” Kyrie may or may not have made a deal with the Deep Soul and started at level 10
Using Aeguntil Silvermoon to teleport for our next plans Same day, Venrach 1, 1263
Olwen’s monastery in Caldera, Temple of Nethys (Saltstone) in Saltstone Currently have temple of nethys
A person comes out, appears to be Sister Naluma O: sister ive returned with gifts beyond the world! “Brother you’re alive! You’re alive and have knowledge of either death or wherever you’ve been?” O: from beyond the pale. Lets us in
“Well tells us all, how does magic work, do they know of nethys there, etc”
“Only one of us are allowed to drink, High Brother Colmeth.” Olwen gives smut, also brings out stuff from across the Pale Bible of the quilted mother Pirate memorial flag Bible of the local religion Coatl scales Book of inner sea religion “Quite a lot! No offense, this one (new religion) reads like poorly written fanfiction of our gods.” O: it seems like a poor copy “We might make a saint of you yet!” Gives an area map “Kind of looks like a slumbering turtle.” M: not a shark? “No, are you stupid?” Venrach 2, 1263 Ventsroad
Ratfolk and a catfolk are having an argument Ratfolk approaches “You’re a master wizard?” U: yes. Who are you? “Aberdeen! Aberdeen Skimberton!” U: not exactly a wizard, but i do dabble in magic, kyrie and agentill do occult and arcane. How can i help? “I was wondering if you’d been on any adventures as an arcane caster?” U: not as a caster, but kyrie is a powerful occult caster myka dabbles in primal, i dabble in all 4 schools “All 4 schools?” U: while im no expert, i do make scrolls Shes a bit nervous about causing harm to other, she seems like a good soul :)
Point us toward a local expert of nearby terrain, a homeless looking man talking to a pumpkin (Niven, Mr. Pumpkin and Sowwin) “Maybe dont go that way, we’ve had some trouble?”
Olwen gives sowwin some gold, he gives it to Mentha Head out to the cracking ice Kyrie falls asleep on the ice Awakens in a deep, hard dream Endless courtyard, all by herself
Dream Courtyard “You know I don’t really remember having been here before, but its quite pretty at least” There are statues that disintegrate and reform into new statues K: Hello?
Deep Soul (Kyrie's Patron): “Hello” K: Well, you might know me, you are my patron? K: I was hoping to discuss the terms of my contract DS: “Terms of contract, you wish to discuss?” K: I’m a bit concerned, I dont remember making the pact and I dont know that you want DS: “Memory together we are making, together we form pact, in terms of contract go” It can only speak in words that Kyrie has already said K: Well the concern is that we haven’t truly discussed our terms, my understanding is that you want me to galivant around, I'm not entirely sure? It was a very long distance to even get here, I feel this is a bit hard of a discussion” DS: “Galivant, go the distance, for a pact, we work together to spread distance, to far distance.” K: “Well, I am going back across the pale… Do you.. I… oh god. Well, what if I don’t fulfill the terms that we apparently decided on?” DS: “We go to god.” K: “We go to god……. We both die?” DS: “We both die” K: Not a big fan of that, are we linked. I'm concerned and would not like to experience death DS: We are linked, you will die, i will experience death, other me will become god. K “Another you? Is it… I don’t really know how to understand that. Are you just here, in the ice? Is there another you running around?” DS: Both me in ice, I run around with you, other me stay in ice, become god. K: “Oh! Huh.” (Kyrie, asleep, is running around the fire, its only about 20 degrees outside at the hottest) (this creature is trying to explain deep philosophical context, she hasn’t provided a lot of complex sentences) K: “Good heavens, uhm. Are you wanting the other you to become god, or is it a sort of distasteful situation? Are you happy about it? Sad? Trying to give some words here to help you.” “Don’t want, but will happen. Other me and me together. Part of me with you, happy. Go beyond Pale.” K: “What will happen by the end of our contract? Because I… my father is a bit concerned about the whole making a deal with the soul situation, I presume that if I imply that I’m about to break our pact, you will not be very happy, WHICH IM NOT IMPLYING, I’m not trying to do that, I’m just putting it out there!” “Not happy, but will run course. Soul together. Go back together, die.”
K: “So is it… are we like… stuck together now? Is this irreversible? Will… if, for say, this whole thing with Threnirax doesn’t come to terms nad hte world across the pale is destroyed, does that negatively impact you, will I die..? You know.” “Threnerax impacts me, does not impact me. Is pact, him and me. But together we go back. God kills both of us.” K: “Okay… If i’m understanding this correctly, if I fail to help you, I die.” “Yes” K: “Because god will kill us both. God is also you.” “Yes” K: “And… what is the end goal? I feel i”m struggling to figure that out. Are you just wanting to stayi n the other plane permanently, the other world?” “Threnerax father stay permanently.” K: “You dont want the father to wake up? Which I don’t want the father to wake up either!” “No” K: “No?” “Threnerax father stay permanently, I stay.” K: “You… (She wants that very powerful creature to stay permanently sleeping, she’s like a parasite to it.) K: “So are you wishing to jump from me to the world dragon?” “Yes”
K: “Okay. And if you jump from me to the World Dragon, would that mean there’s two of you, one here and one there?” “Two of me now.” K: “That is true… Lots to think about. Okay! Interesting. And, so what if we get theworld dragon to stay asleep without you there?” “Both me and god stay asleep.” (It will still attach itself and yourself to the world dragon. It needs you to do this to make sure that the dragon stays asleep. The dragon is so strong that if it wakes up, the patron can’t stop it.) K: “Okay, well… it seems that… we have the plan then. I”m glad that we had this discussion to remind me of what the terms were. Is there anything else I need ot be doing before I head back int he nextday or so? Because we’re not stayingo n this plane for very long.” “Do as you will. Keep god in check. Keep me from dying.”
K: “You or Adina… Just clarifying.” “Both.” K: “Oh okay. I mean I can’t really help you here on this plane, but if you’re coming with me to the other one, I’m hoping not to die myself. Speaking of death… what… this mark that I’ve gotten. Do you know anything about it?” “Yes.” K: “Will you tell me anything about it?” “I could tell, if only.” K: “You know, I’m trying my best to give you the most amount of vocabulary that I can, unfortunately I do not have a dictionary or thesaurus to expand it. Perhaps you can point me in the right dirction so I can give you some words to expand it.” (Repeats this phrase) “Where from, you?” “I’m from Hols” “What is Hols” K: “Well, it was previously part of the auctur empire.” “Where from you, what is Hols to you?” K: Home. “Come home soon. Back across pale.” (Kyrie can now cast Planar Palace to come here!) K: “So once I’m across the pale you want me to contact you again?” “Talk more there, will tell.” K: “Okay… Is this you kicking me out for the night, or are we discussing a little bit longer?” “Can’t discuss much longer. Time small.” K: “Well I’ll leave you be then, let you recover your strength to speak more in the coming days.” “Not days.” K: “Nights”? “Not nights” K: “Tomorrow” “Not tomorrows.” K: “Week? Month?” “Week.” K: “Next week, okay. I’ll contact you next week.” Kyrie wakes up on the ground, tongue stuck on the ice.
We teleport down to Sentolin Venrach 3 Approach with clear skies around, people looking at us with awe “Apologies! We didn’t realize we were having luminaries coming” “The fey, the small one.” Arbul??? “Yes, the one with the scales and tail, the fey feature one. By what court do you belong?” Arbul: “Myeeeh, you have me mistaken, I am but a noble man!” “Is this a trick, I’ll answer your riddles!” Arbul: No, I just enjoy my alchemical brews! “Oh.” (Leaves)
Shunted back to Frethïar, Cassalerino Port Level 15!
Captain gets his letter from his wife Farren Na'thril The owariyaru fleet sent out to find us, we have to set out in the next day or two
We are planning on going to Heawich and then to find Lahabel

Tell the crew its abandoned on the Wandering Embassy

“I understand the confusion, its in the capital city of Erolyth. The building of Stulffri in it. Privateers?” U: we dont kill and steal, we fly a ship not sworn to any nation but we dont mean to be threats to those who arent aligned with us. We’re adventurers
“Oh like the Ovacy?” (shlock book, people who go to colonize areas of the world.) U: we dont want to take land “Ovacy doesn’t kill uncivilized people, just [smth smth]” Like orcs? “Huh????? Orcs arent in tribes.” Its rare but i didnt know other orcs lived so differently “No tribes???” - urgan in his journal
K: thoughts on new king Moivicius Vrirevi? 2 says hes fine, 1 says hes bad, the other 2 are neutral K: What suspicious things were going on? “They wanted us to move from our town despite no attacks. They said attacks from inland, but they told us to go inland. It didn’t make sense. There was a physician, he was sick but idk how, didnt seem sick” Other 2 say odd feeling Subtle spell mind reading on woman with daggers No thoughts, seems almost animalistic in her actions “We could work for you in return, not be stoways.” Captain comes down, investigates them
One was a palace guard A teacher An accountant A doctor A dockhand Subtle spell on palace guard There is a kind of odd disgust for little man in front (arbul) “I wish to be assigned to the captain” said mentally Try to point direction to the Atom: Exactly what happened that day? “No he got to them before me. I took a few from him, old religious symbols and the like. I found one of a dragon in front of the divine gate. Im not a thief, dont get me wrong, it was gonna be left there anyways.” Arbul shows him his yaoi
An alchemist cleric Alchemist Cleric “A healer if you would. A real healer.” U: arbul will not heal you…. “I worship the quilted sky itself. And it told me to stay. What good is a healer in an empty town?” K: What exactly did it tell you? “It simply said there were people here that would need help and that its chosen were coming and then once a ship left, that would be the last one. 3 days after the people walk, if you see a ship appear, that is who you should travel with.” “You might not be the chosen ones, prophecies are hard to decipher, but you might be the ones i’m chosen to travel with. I read the transmogrification of souls.” A form of tea reading where you focus on how the sky changes day to day Astrology girlie - sean

An hour ago

Initial Meeting in the Auctur Empire, the Freilands The party meets and sets up camp for the night.
Fuyuko draws “The Brass Dwarf” while inspecting Niven and Sowwin. Niven and Sowwin were investigating a missing persons case near the ice flows, the rest of the party decides to tag along. During the night, Fuyuko and Aberdeen feel suspiciously well rested after their night shift as well as felt their shift lasted shorter than it was supposed to.
The party journeys down into the ice. Ice Caverns Further down the ice turns into stone.
Before entering, Fuyuko draws “The Demon’s Lantern”. In the first room The party finds a fake wall, in which long dead skeletons are hidden, having been dragged into the corner. They appeared to have died from being tricked into ingesting a form of seed, from which roots shot out of their hearts and chests. In the second room
There are magical chants in the Dragboni Empire’s arcane language originating from a glowing blue door. This empire was the precursor to the arcturian empire. The door shoots lightning so it is left alone. In the hallway The party comes across a group of kobolds. They claim to be thaumaturges and tell us that kobold spellcasters can become true dragons. The one in charge claims to be able to do this. The second-in-command kobold tells us that humanoids provide tribute in the form of gold and leave, asking us if we came here because we “heard the calling to come deeper”. It seems that many people have come through here and “ascended to their next life”.
Fuyuko draws “The Betrayal” Further in the tunnels The floors are filled with less rot. We talk to the kobold leader.
Fuyuko draws “The Betrayal”. We are met with two doors. The first has an “elemental” inside, and the leader claims that we need to eat a seed to enter, but we find out that basking in the pink light of the room past the hag would also suffice. Our hands slip through the handle of the door but the door itself is solid. The kobold also mentions the “Tree of Desire”. The second has a “night hag” inside called “Old Lady Dream Weaver”, who turns out to be a sea hag being transformed into the “shape of a night hag” by another entity in exchange for service. “People come here of their own free will to live their real selves. Merely aid them by letting them sleep and enjoy the process that happens within.” Past the hag’s room An incandescent pink room. The dreamers awaken.
Among them is Therin of Di Florio, a knight the DiFlorio team is looking for, and Jean Hisblad from the nature village. We battle them and win, with a casualty of one of the “enemies”.

Our Person of Contact between us and Theren Asks if we allowed her in (VAMPIRE) Long auburn hair, long for halfling standards, roundish face, 2 shortswords, unassuming looking Need us to be resilient, but a bit more socially aware Another group working out of recently dragonized district down south Some would call it a Red Light District They believe theres a new substance called Dream Lily that influences people’s dreams Mostly a pain control substance, but it also psionic properties Related to The Flask of Fellowship 2 major buildings, find a 3rd
Chance's, more sophisticated casino site Ambassador known for arranging all manner of bets Owner allegedly wears many faces, identified 1 piece of apparel by those who know him Possibly a distribution center for dream lily

Both seem to have access to Shifting Hall that changes location daily, can only find it when given directions or if you’re exceptionally skilled If we can do this, our pay will be increased We ask for 200gp each on completion Despite the size of the city, it is more a small town like diflorio than a large town like Arctur, people haven’t moved in much since the rails arent set up yet Heading towards The Casino Fairly well structured despite how poor the area is, Desnan priests outside blessing people’s gambles
Priest talks to us about why we’re gambling so early in the morning Priest from Horse Level They offer to “aid us” in the church if our gambling temptation grows too strong Most of this district is still under ice, the cogs havent quite freed it from the frost yet Most people around here carry torches that shine in the light If we send our familiars out it will be considered cheating, we must keep them on us We enter the casino In the center theres a group of bets to be had in lengths in time how much ice will melt today
whether a drunken man (Raythar the Drunk) will enter today Bet on anything, and they will back it up All the waiters look eerily the same, as if they are all twins that all aspire to be waiters at the same establishment They’re all Chance We get a room (5sp for the lot of us) It’s dead in the morning, but at the night its “wonderful” Offer alcohol and other remedies to help us sleep We lose 5gp and then leave to come back later Grocery Shopping Stores plastered in replicas of food left inside with promises that when the rail opens, the store opens An odd amount of fresh veggies are here Only fruits that are at a reasonable price to assume they’re grown here are Apples and Apricots Some merchants have greenhouses; not an unheard of product A few druids in the city that would prefer to stay hidden, helps them all survive a bit better Druids here are not Leaf or Animal based on merchant hearing Niven’s wildsong The post office won’t be built & functional for another 2 months The Stone Trees Abandoned district is tiny compared to normal districts Full of metal and stone trees (statues) Tiny plant seems to be trying to emerge Caoilinn spends the time gossiping The automatons have begun talking of visions that haven’t happened The automatons are dreaming
Niven trying to fix up the greenhouse. Sowwin's Garden There appear to be some malnourished plants Unfamiliar plants Time to grow strange plants! The Tangled Briar, a historical thing or creature that will have some influence on the question. The object or person in question is one lost or murdered in some foul way. The Guy:
The Juggler, represents fate, the gods, or those who play with the lives and destinies of others. Asking the patrons the better card
Joan won the 2nd bet by pulling The Liar destructive, treacherous love. The lamia signals obsession, star-crossed lovers, or unrequited desire
The other guy pulled The Unicorn one who generously offers up that which is sought Asking for substances, cheaper prices by cutting out the middle man Wait til the sun rises, move along the light reflecting ice (but we might not be prepared yet)
Luck is dumb,,,,, “bless the Orchestra and dox” “Dream of Fuyuko’s to tell the future, theres been some gossip that this place has been related to a Shifting Hall that would get this dream.” How do you tell the true Chance from the others? A black pendant with silver underneath on one’s neck. Wizard holding a spellbook. Silvery substance, black overtop. He has the pendant!! How do we get to the Shifting Hall? Where would you like to go? Not physically, but mentally. The key to entering such a place would be a mentality, not physical directions. He can’t tell us unless we give him an answer. Answer: A feeling of security and trust with those close to us, Recommend fighting a bit more in the pits before you go there. He believes in our will, but not our strength as people. If we go there right now, we’d have a rough time. Go around town, deal with stuff. Understand the plight of the people, and it might help you. Say these words before you sleep: Of the twin towers, and the Twin Noxra, and [Just list of the names of the countries in any order??]
Twin Towers: Twin Noxra and Dusenhir that border Arcturn Led by the mighty bell, one is led by the mighty queen Between then, the people dream of what could have happened had Arcturn not fallen If you dream tonight of what a city and a nation and what lie between (more after) We definitely got all that, for sure :) (lying, crying)
The fate of the twin towers: The Survivor a creature that has managed to survive a terrible ordeal, when everyone thought him lost His answers are vague, because the way forward is vague.
- Simply dream of what you could imagine of the fall of Arcturn. - Imagine what could become of those lands, should it ever rise again, whatever you want of it. - A stable home, a nation so wide, whatever you dream of, dream of it. You’ll become intoxicated by it, and it’ll lead you to that tower, unless you’re woken up. - Figure out what dreams you have. What idea you want to become reality, dream of it, one of you. Dream of it so hard you give up your life. That will lead you to the twin tower. We get a bottle of fermented wine for 1sp. Wine in the room is The Last Winterberry, the last vintage of the year The winterberry is expected to go extinct because of the warming since it needs cold climates Once it goes extinct this wine will become infinitely more valuable Oddly sweet 3 difference Chances enter the room They think we’re law enforcement, with a “poor liar of a noble woman who is not a noble woman” Think Caoilinn is not a real noble and is there to investigate them
They think we’re from Hols People from there are very interested in extreme law(?)
Believed to be influenced by Hellknights One of them might be the real Chance! If one of us is him, you’re FUCKED. Sowwin can tell that the front one is not Chance One in the front is an orcish man, so it’s not him
“The only people who are named CHARLES are in Advesperascit! 🙄” They dont like that Caoilinn tried to lie about being a noble when she was traveling with a noble The Chances thought about poisoning the wine!!!! Gave us a chance to explain ourselves “Oh we’d be really bad spies….” The group of druids down below the ice have a hidden sun The orc trusts Niven about being a druid

Aberdeen and joan visit the Gold and White Guild - Basically they’re called that cause they dive under the ice to recover treasure The area seems to be run by a tall by dwarf standards named Cari 00000000 Inspired by cheesy pulp fiction novels, aspires to be that type of writer Benefits: - Any treasures found under the ice are exempt from taxes as long as they’re registered with the guild - Offer gear - Providing healing, act as a middleman if necessary - Community Dues for first year is 10sp, after first year for the next decade it is raised to 100sp for the next 10 years We’ve signed up and our organization numbers are 00000004-00000009 00000004 Aberdeen 00000005 Joan 00000006 Niven 00000007 Fuyuko 00000008 for Sowwin 00000009 Caoilinn

Easiest way is through the Rozen Necropolis, a cemetery with a large ornate door that seemingly leads into the city The actual graveyard is beautiful in it’s resplendence A few mins walk from our home Day 2 See a group of people going to the city carrying large vats worth of alcohol on their back Leader talks to us (Messy auburn hair and black eyes) Warns us about a troll on the path We get wine from her The troll says our wine is shit, can’t help him become king Is supported by hargolca (spelling?), kingmaker troll, first to dream Wasn’t actually dreaming, was posessed Giants can’t dream Only accepts wine that can make him dream which comes from the brewery Day 3 Collection box that says “Deposit 20gp to receive wine” Caoilinn is sneaking in and investigating (and probs robbing the place) Aberdeen disguises her as someone who Should Belong There The inside is a very neat looking winery setup Large barrels on an overhang Various vats are unlabeled Man currently moves around, opening sprigets of the vats and taking large sniffs of them Cheese-grate metal thing that leads to a basement, fine goldish iron 2 men in here, both not working too hard One is the sommelier around the area “Did they finally send us up someone from down below?” “They finally make one that can speak?” (referring to Caoilinn) They didn’t even make the other one with a tongue “Ask them if they want wine, then we go down below.” “Elevator is working then, good. You may not see them, but when you power down you’ll see them.” The top one, the golden switch, lets out the Dream Lily substance. Now a proud owner of a bottle of Dream Lily. Fills up a crate “Machine outside only takes 20 dragbonies.” (only detects the gold, not actually the type) “We give them what they want. Their fate.” Wait for us to put in money
