Here for the The Reforged Under what pretense? - Discussion of a common threat The Reforged has no threats, they’ve been killed before and will be killed again Joan says that the danger will make it so that they’re not rebuilt Reforged =/= druidforged The Reforged will be able to speak only a few sentences before having to rest Led through caves partially blindfolded Odd clearing with impossible sun, slightly artificial in nature Holy fuck this map is cool He does not speak, he only answers (he won’t speak without being talked to)

The Cogs, Rozen
Questions for the The Reforged (12 per day when he’s awake, wakes up every 2 weeks) 1 question eaten to ask if we meet w them
How to defeat Theren? “Destroy his soul cage. His masters will not bring him back.” Know of any knowledge or tools to defeat him “Unfortunately none that you would be able to wield.” Why do you/hate oppose Theren “Theren is of little consequence. It is those above that matter to one here. The masters are more dangerous than the puppet, but still a chance to beat the puppet is too valuable to let up.” Who/what are the masters?
Dragbothine, they were rivals to the Chaxgohei
Dragbothine (group of mages who were neutral on the war on gods and divinity. Didn’t go beyond the Divine Gate, and disappeared. Nothing happened for 1k years, assumed dead) Chaxgohei (Dragboni word for Vespertine gods) AKA Mage Gods(?) who are rivals of Vespertine Gods With the gods dead, what’s stopping the Dragbothine from taking over? “There’s still transformation, we may have to cut off the realm of dream from the rest of us. No one will be able to dream, no one will be able to imagine vividly, but it will mean we are safe. Otherwise, we would need someone able to interact with dreams themselves as reality.” We can do that! What do we need to do to deal with them? “Find a way to find the throne, open it, and then go and confront them.” The partially translucent one? Where is the central spire? Do you know? “No.” Druids that cast like wizards (stealing from nature), do you know anything about the origins of that tradition? “It’s unusual, it provides no benefit from true natural casting. Unless, of course, you needed control over matter, like a creature made from dreams.”
Who are the masters’ strongest servants? The other half from which I was discarded, the founder of her school/your true master, and the Watcher. There is a cadence to their speech where some meaning was lost due to psychic projections. the founder of her school/your true master = DiFlorio? More, I may not be aware of. Those are the only ones I met while attached. Who/what is the Watcher?
“The Watcher is a creature that lives on the floating piece of sky, beaming down on those that enter the dreams. You have met it before.” It lives on the sky view, based on the beams we got. MUCH STRONGER. Don't fight yet. But it is static, so we have leeway! “It watches for odd dreams and reports them to the Masters.” Who/what is your other half?
“The Betrayed Man known only by you (potentially) as Galorfin, slayer of the Auctur Empire.” Lead the revolution against Auctur “He needs strife in order to bring them back. And strife again he will cause to complete their transformation. No doubt he has put someone in the position of power to reignite war.” God fucking dammit -Jay Reforged goes to nap Go past dream research, back to Dream creatures can no longer hide from us Enraged dream Heartbroken dream Special abilities Dimension door at will Telepathy Endless Nightmare 3 stages Fatigued Fatigued + stupefied Unconscious until cured Fort save “You’ve returned” “And you’ve taken a book the last time you were here.” “We’ve counted endlessly, and we’ve come up 1 short a thousand times.” Oops Caoilinn stole a Dragboni book Caoilinn lies “You are still of flesh, and thus too weak to go down.” “Those of flesh could never defeat a creature like that. It is not like the scrap metal up there.” Still thinks its invis lol Go down Right go up, left go down Mechanical automaton “Why have you come down here?” “You are normally accompanied by one of higher status.” Fight it That sucked Giant glowing orb It is of some concern
Clearly a portal into the Astral Plane (DON’T GO INTO IT) A small globe that has slowly fractured open into land mass-esque pieces of reality separated by the Pale. 4 planets, one of which being our planet before it exploded (in its current state) That’s one theory of reality! There’s an ephemeral entity around our world, and places around the ephemeral entity Kind of dormant and oddly safe. Not being used in active experiment, but if you wanted to rule the planet it’s a great thing to keep your eyes on. Small arcane charts of notable renown/good price on the table Each of the 3 are 1k gold (3k total if we find a buyer. Theren would buy it!) Vats of green acid Same that we saw proto-sowwin in Tubes that go into the wall Manage to get a small dosage of it Have to dilute it with water Immediately or else it starts melting through the vial Not just a physical solvent, but a metaphysical solvent For dissolving things down to the soul Cube in chains?????? We all feel the urge to touch it SOUL STEALING CUBE Festering here If souls were good on their own go to the cube, but if they needed to be coalesced into the vats Cube and vats have been used recently Painful tests to determine if you go to the Cube or the Vats 3 days old blood, or a week with good condition Treasure chest With odd square and circle sigil Obsidian goggles greater Lucky breastplate 2000 gold pieces (modern, odd for the area) Planet room? Planets all seem to have smaller planets within them Doesn’t move around, but moves inward to the central planet The scarab flies, knowing secrets of the universe. The odd spheres seem to be different realms of reality, and the center seems to form our realm of reality, however millennia ago. One appears to have a city where Rozen appears to be on the central globe. The Dream? Some event caused these to crash and meld with each other. Papers strewn about in Old Dragboni, seem to be in code Reinforced area below It’s incredibly quiet GIANT CREATURE MADE OUT OF LIQUID METAL We run away

“Aunties” implies illusion magic Estelle Auclair and the real one Ayame Auclair
Dream Fuyuko has been swindling this woman’s family? The temple is finely furnished with multiple pews and a very good look of the horizon Small shrine built into the corner of her father, with candles still lit Object Reading on the Survivor Card Able to see what appears to be a month and a half ago

Loving recalled 12 minute story Sad that Fuyuko can’t recall her distraught and a little drunk and taking her back to the temple and growing closer to each other over the course of a week Eventually after a few people helped her claim her inheritance, Fuyuko (thru noble connections) helped set up a shrine with her That’s when the aunts were met Appeared to be cold and distant, but were at least friendly? Light spell reveals the sheer darkness around us. Area is notably extremely well maintained. A noble house in Sighar

I hope you don’t forget about the deal you did with my assistant Kepgeda Ymires.” Have you [Eryndor Lothalith] noticed any strange happenings in your country of dream-like things or heard reports? “Occasionally some people are becoming prophetic. But its surely much more minor than what’s happening in the old wasteland.”
Cassien has been talking to King Celeste while we’ve been talking
“So this is the end of the Ildorian Family?” “The house will need to be dissolved unfortunately. Which does mean a subsidiary will need to have the account. I could give it to one of you [Joan or Cyril].”
Gives it all to Cyril Calloway Cassien dimensions doors away
Eryndor Lothalith gives Joan a letter to be able to contact a spy in Rozen
Offers Twin Noxra citizenship to Joan, tells her to take a temporary name
Aberdeen tries to take a small chunk of Mocthunsi Murders Cooks A few critical guards Most of the nobles are relatively unharmed if paranoid!
Sending to Fuyuko’s librarian mom, Ayame Auclair “Hi Miss Ayame. It’s Aberdeen, Aberdeen Skimberton! Fuyuko says your wife has not divorced you, she’s just being controlled. We are working on it. Goodbye!” “My wife is alive? How is she controlled? How do you know this Aberdeen? Do you need help? What is going on?” “Yes! An archmage is controlling her through dreams. Fuyuko told me. We have a spell to help. We own Rozen. Headed there eventually. Long story.” “I’ll take PTO and head there soon. What spell is needed to help her? Heading out now, or by sunrise.”
Sending to Chance
“Galorfin killed two kings, Greenpaths and Ziliarn. War inevitable. Twin Noxra and Numartu attempting peace. Archmage to Rozen. Fake Joan dead. Cyril head of house.” “Understood, will act accordingly.”
Meeting with Bel down south Jump off the train New outfit, but same old smile from the meeting “Its nice to talk somewhere a bit more secure, isn’t it?” Sowwy…. “Would you like to go where the first king was thought to be assassinated? Where the plan to assassinate the king was formed?” You know this?? “Of couse! We hired a group of individuals to clear out a dream monster. And managed to take what was told to be, during the initial founding of the kingdom, the first Di Florio fort. We managed to clear it and use it as a staging face. Me, Galorfin, and some of the founders of Numartu. I apologize for the famines when you were younger. Dusenhir withheld their crop to the nation just in time for when the siege began. We salted our own fields in order to hurt them.” You chose not to feed people? “Of course. Those they were gonna feed were to be our enemy in a few weeks. This is also the place where Galorfin died.”
Di Florio Fort is 120ft disconnected from the actual base. “I believe its an anti-gravity zone?” Oh is it supposed to last so long? “No. My bet is… actually I have no idea.” (Few ways. The easiest and most likely was it wasn’t gravity but conjuring dream material that lasts until dispelled.) Galorfin did this?? “Of course! He’s a mage and a sorcerer.” “He’s a wonderful assassin. He’s killed 3 kings now!” “He did talk about wanting to bring back Old Dragboni. I thought it was more to be metaphorical, but apparently I was wrong. From what I’ve gathered, he may have actually lived there at some point. Old Dragboni itself.” “Before he looked like he did, he was half machine. Maybe the machine stopped his aging?” “I know that he was- the reason for his first assassination, and again, I thought it was metaphor, is that he hated the Auctur empire for being a betrayal of Old Dragboni.” Did he mention anything specific? “He just said he wanted to bring it back and that he wanted to kill the king we all did. You can’t exactly pick your allies too harshly.”
“The current rule is better than Auctur!” Do you know why some people weren’t poisoned? “I believe that killing all the kings would have been too bold of a move and wouldn’t give you a person to blame it on.” They did try to dispel his magic. Maybe they just wanted to have a different cause of death. “No reason for that. Poison’s good enough. You could shoot him on the ground to make it look like he was shot for killing a king. So then you have 2 leaderless nations who hate each other and off they go.” “The Admiral’s not a true king, also.” Do you know anything about a Mr Di Florio? “Only that he’s dead.”
“The only thing odd was that the Headmaster of Di Florio Academy (Headmaster Eldrichs) seemed to refer to him.” Have you run into dream creatures? “There’s talk of them becoming more active. There’s a man at Di Florio who seemed really interested in dreams and the stars.” Looking around: Galorfin reformed 2 years ago, the robot part reformed first and ran off Small tracks in the mud in the same shoe size as the Archmage (3 months ago) Faint signs of monsters, small signs of electricity singes. Whatever the lightning hit are long gone. Some small tracks that lead through the entryway of Di Florio Fort, toward one of the walls and disappear. Appears to be various arcane implements have been laid down. Small sign of swirling, odd vats of gaseous form of Sowwin material. Contain some odd sentient pieces of mist that form eyes before dissolving again. One of the runes activates, the Archmage appears out of it. “I don’t remember giving you permission to be down here.” We haven’t touched anything yet… “Yes, but you’re still in someone’s area. If you asked, I would have let you in. Why would I have let a fort go abandoned? It was one of my first projects.” “So what do I do with you?” Maybe we turn around? Walk away? “Fine idea by me.” Can we come in? “No.” We can’t check it out? “Of course. The part that’s available to public.” Sooo. What’s so special about this project? “We’re simply taking the dreams that would harm people and containing them. So the people around here have wonder, pleasant dreams.” (This place could draw dreams in. When enacted it could bring a dream to reality. The equipment wants to be holding it.) (This is a fake Archmage. The real one won’t even know what’s happening until this one is dispelled. It transfers all knowledge to the real one.) Caoilinn time jumps into the room of arcane implements. Many odd devices Find a few jars with eyes (anger, sadness, heartbreak). All negative emotions gathered here. Underneath what appears to be an odd alter, appears to be people dripping out of a ceiling. A small journal and a few personal keepsakes of the old empire. Journal in heavy code, a day of downtime per page to read it Odd looking dagger that looks like a tooth (if obsidian was made out of a substance that’s not quiet gold, this would be it. Yellow glass-like) A small odd coin made out of pure platinum. Appears to have a beautiful woman on one side and a fearsome devil on the other Fuyuko does a harrow reading, The Betrayalselfishness and envy To-do list: look at stolen items sending & meet up with ayame on the way to Rozen check in with secretary check in with chance check in with twin noxra spy ask all these people about next steps try to save estelle first unless we get more information on joans parents

“It was on a badge. But I wasn’t able to take hold of it or take too much notice since she returned from the kitchen at this time.” We did see a similar symbol on the Archmage’s robes. Weirdest guest was one who asked for the train to be sped up to do a divination ritual 2 years ago
Train down towards the Emerald Coast Anyone talking abt weird dreams? “People have been having odd dreams of things going up north. Things like conquest have been coming up the past 3 weeks.” A good amount of time to get people paranoid. “I relayed their concerns to court mages of nobles.”
“A few people have been forming cults to dreams. I thought at first it was Desnan worship, but it seems more serious than that.” Part of the reason why he may be unaffected was probably personal will (unlikely) OR for the dreamscape to firmament you have to be stationary. (Dragons, hags, etc) Most can conjure skin, but its faster just having skin around.
Talk to Rubrews later abt giving this guy money
We’re gonna take Ayame to a “safehouse” in Rozen and then kill her bc she’s Not Real Ayame “Did you know the reason why they built the lightning rail in the upper part? Rozen
Chance's
A Chance is there “You’re back” Lets us into a private room, another Chance enters “How is the war down south going?”
“Unfortunately, the Flemotha Ports might also be at war. One of the kings you allegedly saved hasn’t made it back yet.”
Assume all royal advisors are also court mages trained by Di Florio Academy (thus compromised) “He is still alive though, Don’t ask me how I know.”
We have told Chance that DiFlorio is alive Show the sigil Object read (1 year) The conspirator dragon drinking with 2 siblings. Each with a badge, stumbling, changing hands. Confuse who’s is who’s.
“Your best bet is to check in with Bhidan Emberreach in the Sky View, he’s a bit of a dragon expert. Aurora’s Reach.” “As for what’s happening here, there’s a small rebellion of the automatons. A few were uncovered from the ice, they were imminently violent.”
We remember that Galorfin may have been digging in the ice to find his other half “I fear that war out there will drive refugees here. It does mean we’ll have too many people to house. Also, whatever they’re planning, if it has people, this will be the location.” We tell him that Di Florio caused the war to create strong emotions/dreams Also about the outpost that was collecting this energy THE TOWER WITH DEMONS IN IT!!!!! LETS GO THERE!!! ITS LIKE THE OUTPOST
Is Julian Ozlebin ok? “As well as she can be. I’m afraid she doesn’t have a good grasp on reality right now. She’s adapting to 2k years of history in a week.”
Outside of Chance’s is Dream Fuyuko
“Hi. It sounds like you fucked up again. I’m here to clean up your mess. I know where she will be unguarded.” Why would you tell us? “I tell you, and she gets freed.”
“He will be at a meeting down near the Irathyl District, at an Inn they just opened up. They do own it as a small base of operations.” Any advice on getting in there? “Can you teleport through windows?” “It should be relatively unguarded to seem less suspicious to outsiders. They don’t want to seem like they’re holding someone hostage.” “They have a connection on Irathyl street, they make her mime inspecting items as if shes an archaeologist? Paleotologist?” “I would expect 5 men, maybe, but if you avoid detection, you should be able to get in and out. She’s usually only escorted by one.” She’s in the globe room Circular building Tower with guards, center hollowed out, allowing people to pass up Sneaking around Aren’t alone in this room, there’s something here Judging by small bits of dust, it’s a sphere around an inch in diameter
We can now enter dreams once per day. Dream Fuyuko is dead. It was a trap for them. Run to the bar (50 mins away) Irathyl Bar Surprisingly nicely furnished Old style of the market Lights flickering, no noises remain Almost completely silent, odd crackling fire that is different than a normal fire Sounds like burning paper mache? Kick down the door Fine tavern with odd looking carpets, ostenstiously red In the center is a deep lapis lazuli blue Fake!Fuyuko with a green beam slowly disintegrating Time stasis bubble On the counter is a deed “Whoever finds this, the tavern is yours.” If you claim it, it tells them that we saw what happened, and if a rando claims it, we didn’t get to see it Alarm spell on it Object read it
Hieronymus Di Florio in an argument with a creature that stares at us, glowing, before conceding to give up his toy because he misread his students. Give up his own personal bar. It appears that Fuyuko is staring down at the paper before a force jerks them away towards the center of the room, and things disappear from there. A small knock on the broken door Old mage looking down at us The Archmage “Are you the new owners of the bar?” That remains to be seen. I imagine you’re responsible for Fuyuko? “No.” Oh. That’s a surprise. “Please. I’m not a monster.” “I’m a man who’s realized my mistakes and it’s time to clear it out. Fondness for my pupils and those I helped create.” So uh. What exactly are you doing here then? “Asking questions about the state of affairs for 2 uninvolved people who should stay uninvolved.”
“Few small things. How’s Ventsroad doing? How’s Di Florio Academy? Before these events. I’m asking nicely, and this might be our last chance to talk. If you keep going down the current path, I may be forced to kill you.”
If you didn’t get Estelle Auclair involved, this didn’t need to happen. “She asked too many exposing questions at the wrong time.” If you weren’t responsible for that Fuyuko, who was? “A well respected colleague.” (Used “she” for her) I’d like to know who she is! “If you’d like, I could tell her your name and she could come visit you. Don’t ask questions about my colleagues who are not here.” (4/6 he considers his children in a way. Niven/Fuyuko/Aberdeen/Sowwin)
“How’s Ventsroad?” They were doing alright. The town’s changing but other than that, things seem to be going well. We buried sowwin’s predecessors. “They never woke up?” I don’t believe they ever had a chance to. “I had hope [they would]. Hope’s what keeps us alive.” How are you alive? You’ve been alive for a while. “I’m not that much older than an elf.” But you’re not one???
Ok. Whatever. Do you know about Niven’s teacher, Ionhar? “Wise. Very wise.” Do you know if he’s alive…? “I didn’t stick around very long. Is he supposed to be alive?” Yes! He went on a journey and didn’t return. “It doesn’t sound very alive.” Oh. Well.
Sowwin: Did you know old man Dorcalaide? “I’ll answer your question if you’ll answer one of mine. What kind of powers can you manifest?” Fire and wood. I get stronger by the day. “Then it was all worth it.” And the answer to mine? “Of course I knew him!” Anything more, or…?
“I taught him. He was just a wandering vagabond when I first saw him. It was nice to start up a small academy and start a new project. I just needed someone who knew the area better than I. We just needed to make sure there were people up here. The powers that be, Climber the Cold Bringer, tried to stop people from being here. We needed to defy that decree.” Every crop I planted. Every crop I tilled. Was for this? “Of course. You were doing wonderful things for the world.” War is bad? “The war will be over soon enough. I don’t see it taking more than a year.” “There’s no reason for you to be fighting me.”
Are you not trying to bring back the Dragboni Empire via dreams??? “In a sense.” (it’s been gone for 1200 years) Why??? Why would you bring it back?
Diflorio: “It’s not just the empire itself. The mundane and magical will rise with it too. I just want… We’re going to bring back the Deep Soul.” (There is a rumor that someone who went down to the foundational earth of the Dragboni Empire and emerged as the Deep Soul. They were a rumor, but she was an amalgamation of various souls found at the very substance of earth that managed to arrive with their sanity intact. Someone who has command of the very stuff our reality is made out of. If what he’s saying is true, the Ice Bringer tried to trap this thing in ice.) Diflorio: “The Deep Soul will come.” You want this why? Diflorio: “The ability to shape any matter? The ability to stop any conflict or war?” How can you be certain the Deep Soul will go along with this? Diflorio: “Because she’ll have a trusty advisor.” Have you met with the Deep Soul already…? Diflorio: “I’ve met her a few times. She talks to me, and I get to talk back.” Niven: How did you meet? In dreams? Diflorio: “A young military advisor walking the lands up north” I thought they were encased? Diflorio: “There’s a lot you don’t know, which is why you should stand back and let the adults handle this, Niven.” Hey! Niven’s grown a lot since we started. Why’d you invent the new Druidic order? Was it an accident? “I needed to help sure up some of the weaknesses of the Deep Soul. So I managed to make myself a master of matter.” (Niven is following his path. He’s a mix of Arcane and nature. His spellcasting is both a druidic focus and non-druidic focus.)
Spirits of nature huddle behind Niven away from him. “If you stop us now, the war will go on for years. You do know that. We’ve made ourselves the only power who can stop the war.” Why does there need to be a war??? Why start a war if you were just gonna stop it? “It was a small spark. It’s all we needed. We can’t control the dreamscape entirely on our own.” (They need people panicking and feeling strong emotions to fuel the dreams. There’s a war, and your family might die.) “I just want to offer you four a chance to back out. This is the last opportunity I think I’ll be meeting with you on friendly terms.” What would backing out entail? “Going home. Letting what happens, happen. You would all be left along. You could even live in the city. But if you continue, I can’t promise what happens to you. You’ll be like them.” “If you aren’t going to take [the deed], I’ll take it.” No. (The bar appears about 6 years old judging by the decor. This place just thawed, and Rozen was only founded about 4 years ago.) (Fuyuko takes it) “Shame. How much for a drink?” “Here, i’ll show you a better power.” (A breeze blows out the bar.) (Wisdom of the Winds scroll. Did it primal to show Niven how to do it.)
“I would have been willing to trade Estelle Auclair for it.” (A bluff to make us feel bad) He leaves Start smashing Guards show up, show him the deed Very confused, we got a noise complaint Talking Corpse Fake!Fuyuko before they fully disintegrate Is Estelle still in the city? Blink one for yes, twice for no A single blink in thirty minutes After 2 hours, the bubble dispells Amongst the items seems to be his personal stache, up top in the personal bedroom. Too minor to care about End of Act 2. Level 11

People don’t fare well when faced with outsiders living within, and with war on horizon, I don’t believe things would go well.” Behind the room is a dream-like, Gauwilh can’t see it Good news: We’re even specialier Bad News: The dreams are solidifying themselves into reality Scrolls made of odd bamboo substance, written in Old Dragboni Architecture seems old, like an old time capsule Seems almost displaced in time Buy 2 scrolls of sending and 1 of Translate Translate on scroll Various contracts the devils had with Old Dragboni Needed something to orchestrate moving souls and something to attach to the soul Some people would need to pay off the debt to the empire in multiple lifetimes Recycling, in karmic rebirth People in charge of marking souls were devils In odd cases they could take them If the person decided to flee in their new body, they could take it out on the person’s loved ones You run = everyone you love goes to hell TRANSLATION: ARCHMAGE HAS BEEN DOING KARMIC REBIRTH, BUT HE’S WILLING TO DIE INSTEAD OF BEING AFRAID TO DIE Copy down the symbol on the floor Gauwilh doesn’t recognize it Shifting circle for different realms Gems used to see how much they can put through until it breaks

His name is Verlos “You’re now the masters. I wouldn’t be so upfront to assume you’re the employer.” “This used to be a historical house. Whoever designed it designed me.” Have you just been here? “Yes. I’m under contractual obligation.” Who contracted you? “It’s been a while.” What do you mean designed? :) Are you undead? “No, I’m technically living.” Are you a construct? “No, I’m a person.” Do you eat? No Do you need anything, like anything you need? “If you make any renovations, I would please ask if you go through me.” Do you have any hobbies? “I occasionally like to lay flat on the ground in the closet imagining I’m one with the world.” Are you made of dream?? “No, I’m a spirit.” (possible he was an unseen servant that was bound to a lot of dreams to to make a personality) (a small experiment from someone ;)) (This guy is so freaky, he tastes the things he does. The house being dirty hurts him similar to a stomach bug) (We own the house, thus he’s our servant) “I mainly do prestitidigtation. I did it when the city was crawling with abominations under ice, I did it until I got a master, and now I do it for you.” Circle back around to this pls “Most of the house been retrofitted into the design. Changeling Filditov Family Small arcane family, probably don’t have enough might for it. Too much confidence.

Extremely caring and passionate, able to repair war wounds, asks people to take care of themselves and improve life Allegedly doesn’t sleep, hasn’t for a while. Appears to be alchemical, and some people say she has a sulfate-esque smell to her occasionally (devil) Niven talking to tree “You understand me? You can talk?” I sure can! Soon, we’ll all be big, or bigger, together.” Even the ones in the big city?
“Those ones are are cold in the god’s radiance. We dare not interrupt her.” God is up but also in the city? “She’s high in the lands above. We’ll reach her one day.” Describes god as a blossoming old god “You can see from her eyes the rain that comes down upon us. Send word through the roots to contact me. “Are you that which reaches for my roots?” Huh????? “In the pockets of air in the world below.” Are there things that look like me reaching for your roots? “I can’t see.” Creatures like me below in the air pockets? “They have the same hands.” (Root reading, numerous dead down below. A few in a bubble like stasis, are stirring awake, reaching for the tree for the first time in a millennia.) “They merely tug and pull, and my roots grow to them. I’ve only been here for a few days, but they’ve made significant progress.” How deep did they start? “No further than to my small basalt roots.” (10ish meters down) (zack talked to a guy about scandinavian burial practices for this????) The guy whos armor we stole Therin of Di Florio Aberdeen and Fuyuko have been expelled Can we confirm what address the expulsion letter was sent to We were initially only been let in because we were buddies with aberdeen and fuyuko He goes to talk to the admissions office Other guy just started “Given the state of the academy during the last war, they’re paying quite well. (giant attacks here, kidnapped a bunch of people including Ayame Auclair) “Lucky you (aberdeen) didnt get kidnapped” A: i was still young, so that might be part of it “Maybe, but the mechanical man took no mercy.”
(Galorfin. Merris Hasalk put out a message to not trust the elven man of half machine) “All the same, if you were here, could you tell me how it happened? “Allegedly it has something to do with the great betrayal of… Ashua that you were working with, how his research came to a screeching halt due to your lack of correspondence.” A: I was a bit preoccupied! “You should have told him, so he could take on a new research assistant. I feel bad about it “Do you wish to make holy amends?” A: I do want to make amends! (he will try to make a binding pact, trying to make amends that happen bound by soul) A: can we start with an apology and go from that? The other one goes to talk to ashua, therin stays behind “Is something wrong aberdeen?” A: noo “Last we met, you wouldn’t hesitate to bind a soul!” A: well i just want to come to an arrangement before the soulbinding! “At the very least, i could teach you some of the rituals, asmodeus would shine upon you!” A: maybe another time! Ashua shows up Ashua “Aberdeen.” A: hello professor ashua terribly sorry about the lack of correspondence “I heard you were dealing with the research of another.” A: umm more urgent life matters that led to research opportunities where i wasnt able to receive correspondence for a time! A: it does somewhat tie back into what we were doing “Unfortunately, higher management prevented me from signing you as an assistant” We should forge some documents to give him tenure after we kill the headmaster
(aberdeen to Scarab what would you like me to say? S: ask if he’ll take me back? (he cant do magic bc poor resurrection, his soul came back but not his magic ability) (he’s here for research but also ties to the academy)) A: as an apology, we want to offer some funding we recently came into a bit of money, we’d love to provide some as an apology “While you were off galavanting pretending to be a hero in the north?” Yes! “And leaving the research to die?”
“You claimed the correspondence was going to the wrong address but you did respond to one of my letters. At the adventurer’s guild? The people there write back to me, but you don’t, and i ask if you’re in the city, and they say yes.” Shameless request him to go to dinner with us “We can discuss it over dinner.” A: thank you! I’ll look forward to it “I dont date students, aberdeen, if that’s what this is?” Not a student anymore! “I don’t date FORMER students.” Dinner A: Seen any stars lately? “Less and less.” A: We’ve discovered some info, once the stars turn to illusion. There is- so in the dream realm- “The illusory realm, as it’s known.”
A: this is going to sound like we’ve lost our minds, you’re not going to believe anything we say, so just hear us out? In the illusory realm there is- what do you know of the old Dragboni Empire
“Precursor to Auctur Empire, and through the ice that came their nation the soldiers were blessed with the still sun.” A: magics? “Mageocracy.” A: very powerful. One of the people was utilizing the illusory realm (known). The part that sounds like we’ve lost our minds, consider the concept: within another dimension, a subset of the dragboni have survived. “Similar to the divine ice.” A: there are steps being taken to bring that former empire out of the realm of illusions into our reality. “By what means?”
A: there is an entity within the realm of dreams known as the Deep Soul- “We already discussed this. We came to the conclusion that such a thing cannot be true.” Scarab wishes to speak A: what do you need to say? Ashua: “i’ve told you what i need to say.” A: oh sorry i was communicating with my familiar, she was crafted from… another.. Its a long story, she has separate- “I was unaware you had a familiar. Can i see it? Does it take the form of a cat or an owl?” A: she takes my form, actually. Puts scarab down S: im aberdeen! A: she was created from me, we share a lot similarities “I am here to talk to you aberdeen and not just some familiar” A: well she does have some insights that i sometimes miss, please hear what she has to say, we’re one and the same on these matters S: (various arcane phrases, the entity wouldnt be random, but if it was being pushed back by a force itd appear random from the day night cycle) “Why does your familiar know this?” A: oh yknow. She has memories. “I see, but this is the entirety of the disproof of it being an otherworld entity and not another force. We spent 2 weeks working on it together, aberdeen.”
A: i have to be upfront with you. The aberdeen that you… did your research with was not me. That aberdeen was a clone that was created not by me, i dont have that magic, but it was created by a mishap. (Scarab) “An alchemical/magical mishap?” A: no it was tied to the dream realm. The clones were part of both the dream and this realm “To do so, it would have had to be from both a dream soul and a real soul, so you only have half a soul right now, aberdeen.” A: well. The other half is… some of it is probably there. In front of us. S: i am the real aberdeen, aberdeen skimberton. I have all the memories i just happened to wake up first! “So this familiar is… you?” A: this familiar is the me that you knew. Sorry. “So you did great violence against half your soul and turned it into a homonculus.” A: yes “You’re a monster” A: thats what they sayto me… N: the devils tried to recruit her A: that really made me think! That i’m not embodying the spirit of a true adventurer “When you die with half a soul, what will happen to you? The two halves of your soul will go to different places and be torn asunder.” A: this is partially why we know that the dragboni empire plans to return through the deep soul. Because well. What we’ve learned. And my atrocities. “We should tell the nations of the world, they may turn their war efforts to the north.” A: the war is the issue
“We can talk to Headmaster Eldrichs, he can send out word.”
A: issue! The headmaster is still operating under the orders of the STILL LIVING di florio. (Hieronymus Di Florio) “He died. His body was found 100 years later.” A: well. We’ve encountered a lot of evidence that make us believe that’s not the case. Even if you dont believe it, the court mages that have been sent from di florio academy have been inciting more violence, we can see it from all the nations that got florio mages. “If they enter war now, they herald a claim to auctur. Many florio academy students have signed temporary peace deals. Little nets of neutrality. This will be nothing like the (aeger?) war.” (there is war, safety does bring dreams and people bring dreams. Temporary truces can be broken easily and easily written over in history, large civilian population you can use as a fireball) “The issue is the only way to potentially avoid it is mass migration is to go through the mountains of emerald and sail through caldera that doesn’t have the infrastructure.” “You mentioned the people in dreams, but they still age in dreams.” “They wouldn’t be able to raise that many subjects without staying hidden.” A: its difficult to believe, especially hearing it over dinner with just our testimony. “They could be extraplanar entities taking the shape of people? There is no way of keeping dreams in a place.”
N: theres automatons under the ice in Rozen and Freilands “There should only be about 10k buried under the ice based on reports.” N: thats the number of ones up and about, there’s still more buried “Buried in bedrock? The towers themselves go to bedrock, and unless theres some extraplanar thing there, if they dug down, sea water would flood it.” N: there is a marketplace that people go down in illusory “It does exist in reality, but its just not thriving there.”
“I know another researcher in rozen, Ririana, she talks of extraplanar places there. She filmed an elevator, but it could just be a (teleport?).” A: we have heard of her, we havent made contact yet “She is a lovely lady from the time ive met her.” A: that’s good to know! “I can put in a good word for you. I believe she belongs to the same guild you do now?” A: ok, we’ll attempt to get in touch! “Of course. And you did make sure to pay the dues while you were still there, right?” WHOOPS WE FORGOT

Joan sees Galegal Ulgincamp 1 arm We approach, looks at us, “keep walking and I’ll let you live.” We drop the diguise, he follows us 20ft behind us Accidentally bring him to the cafe fuyuko is on their date “You’re alive.” So are you “Yes. you killed one of me.”

We realize you had the right idea about a lot of things “I had a good idea about a lot of thing.” J: what about now?
“I understand where my foolishness was, she is not desna, she is that thing in the basement.” A: so now that you’ve come to it, what are you intending to do if not contain? “She may not be the original desna, but the original is dead, and this is an entity that can promise dreams. S: as someone who followed Desna, would you say a god such as Asmodeus would have rule? “If there’s no one else.”
S: or Nhimbaloth? Would that be one you want to live under? “I wouldn’t, but divine begets divine.” S: at the end of the day, you’re still a father? “Of course.” S: why’s your daughter still in the city? “She’s protected here” By you? “By me and the deal I’ve stuck. Both of us understand it and are willing to pay the price, such as the will of faith.” “If you dont mind me asking, why are you.. Working with the archmage and all them? “Because he is going to bring back god.”
At the expense of bringing back an empire? “Yes. We both get what we want, gods walk the earth, he gets his empire.”
A: Quick question, about the elevation of the deep soul to divinity. Is the idea that iut will be before the divine gate?” “The gods will be here, yes. I have seen her before, i have talked. She is beautiful, even without mind right now.” N: What does she look like to you?” “A creature long and tall. With little braids that rise up to the dreams of people nearby. She showed me a reality of me and my wife, but when i woke up, my mind was still in tact. A reprieve.” N: “Oh,,, i see…” A: but you dont believe that this business with the divine gate wouldn’t happen again? The gods vanish, go behind the gate? “They did it to save us and themselves, and it failed. We are killing each other and they are dead. Why would they redo it? If you see a man walk across a street and die in a war, do you then walk across the same street?” J: “and what if she never reaches divinity/ “She already has, she just needs to awaken. All that is left is bringing her into this world.” A: “And doing that will be the awakening? Or is there an awakening that needs to happen before she comes to this world.” “When she does it, it’ll bring her awaken soul into this world. As soon as she reaches here, i’m sure itll be over.” A: “And you know this for certain that this process will occur?” “Its a process ive been told, im a man of faith. I believe the people who have told me this would not lie to me.” A: so, yknow, i do think that, while i mean, you’re within your rights, you’re still an influential figure that they could lie to to get your influence. “Am i?” A: you’re powerful “I am notably weak. I believe joan herself could kill me if she wanted to.” J: And you’re okay with having two of you? “Of course, its part of the deal” J: “What does this other you get out of it?” “Safety of our daughter. Safety of knowing our god- we talked about it, if one should be punished, itd be the one who committed the original sin. The one that tried to take control.” J: “This ‘original sin’. Can you elaborate on that?” “Stopping a god.” (stopping the deep soul) “We’re really traded places here haven’t we?” “Yes, I’m sorry that you’ve fallen. Your original master came around.”
“Theren?”
“Yes, he came around willingly.” (because of his daughter Julian Ozlebin) And now he’s not around to see her. But he knows that shes out there. It’s not really her though… “Why” Different soul

N: “Speaking if the experience where you lived with your wife, how do you feel about the Creator’s body walking around while they dream?” “I know nothing about the body, ive only met the dream. Could i see the body, if you know where it is?” N: “Ehh, I mean we believe it’s Estelle?” “Is the body of the creator?” N: “That's what we understood..” “That would make sense.” N: “Well, when she appeared in dreams what did she look like to you?” “She was… well you’ve seen her blessing on me. Outside of it, what does she look like?” (abby mind reading on him, sees an outline of a woman as it glows in her mind before it turns glowing, looks at her, “hello aberdeen.” he doesn’t seem to notice) (A: “Well… pleasure to meet you!”) She doesnt seem to notice 2 conditions react to Detection spell She can see through galegal A waitress turns and faces aberdeen, just thinks shes talking to herself “Isnt that that ratfolk that caught fire the other day?” C: she looks like fuyukos mom to us The figure: “i will tell him the truth when he returns.” “Maybe she’s taken that recently, i assume that the spellcaster will be- the host body what they’re preparing her for.” “That seems like it would make sense, what advantage would that have over her current form? Bhidan Emberreach is here at Skimberton Estate “Conspirator dragons in the order?” Yes! “I talked to my expert about the symbol, it apparently belongs to… it was apparently an old, old symbol of nobility. From when the towers were first founded. Apparently it now belongs to an order that seeks to resurrect former glory. I should let you know the conspirator dragon you killed was the youngest, the other 2 are ancient. One is active. “Down near The Cogs. Allegedly on a heist mission for the order. Stealing an automaton (The Displaced)?” Great okay he’s in the city Your contact alright?

At a line that looks south
Sending to The Passionate: hey babygirl out of the bubble. What happened? Thanks for head.
In displaced people dream folk have emerged and integrated themselves pretending to be refugees, trying to keep casualties to a minimum. Head not from me, tiberius
Go to Chance's Get stopped by 2 chances out front Allow us to enter without a check this time
“Do you need to speak with Chance” Yes “He no longer wears identification. Order a room and he’ll meet you” We order a room “How can i help you all?” Explain the situation
“Well. as you signed a decent chunk of the city over to Twin Noxra they expanded their claim to northern territories, the other nations took umbrage with it and are settling disputes down south to engage. Don’t worry, twin noxra has sent ships in to settle things.”
(there is smth that will happen if we ask twin noxra to help: they’ll also be in debt w twin noxra but if we have flemotha ports and Ziliarn ally together they can shut down greenpaths) Chance doesnt know that the admiral is a fake “And where would he be?” Explain “Thats not too specific, thats a 10 mile shoreline.” “I can see about extracting him, but getting him on the throne would be an issue. I propose i get him here and you, in one night, sneak and assassinate the fake, drop him into the ocean, and we let the real one give the orders hes meant to.” (would immediately end the war. Better ways to do it but they take more time from us)
(Cyril Calloway was able to fight Dream Joan, so at least injure dream fakes) Sure let us know when you find the king and we’ll deal w the fake “Will do. Word is is that youre in contact w the passionate?” Yes “Can i ask why youre working with an indiscriminate murderer?” “He’s killed 2 of my men.”
Any chance theyre connected to Dragboni Empire “IDK but i did swear them under my protection.” Changing the topic, are you aware some of the displaced people are dream sleeper agents? “No, but how would i even test for that?”
There is that alchemist w know of (Ririana) “She isn’t a devil, she is a saint.”
Rubrews Typing away on new fangled device, typewriter “We are looking into getting your lost profit in the next year” What abt our new profit “No we get paid on the 15th every month” Any other incidents since last time
“Theres been a warforged you gave him a decent chunk of the city” The Unsung We did do that “He wasnt lying??” Unfortunately not “Do you know where i might contact to apologize?” Dont worry abt it rn, if they come back, we did promise half a tower We need to get better at telling abt propert decision
Filditov Family They sit in their manor disguised as orcs Bow to us “My lords.” You dont need to do that -joan Please do that -fuyuko “Why are you here? An update or?” Thatd be great we havent introduced ourselves They deshift, shake our hands A few things covered, few scrying orbs that scry down below Right by where the passionate stuff is
“We have started counter intelligence into Yuki's University on the upper of the city. Right now, we still need to embed spies. The demon problem is an issue, but it is unlikely the Yuki Seppänen there is either yuki or a devil.” “We do have a theory if what you said about the ascension is true?”
“If it were to register as a god, it could have spawn an unheralded angel that had yet to form? The god gets an angel like avare brit, if its unformed it mightve just awoken alongside its master.” “I would be warned that angels dont die easily, but i dont think you need to be warned of that. We’ll look into it, but if it is an angel, steer clear as best you can.”
“We plan on picking up a tenured official, we’d be from The Nexus to the east if youre familiar. They recently had an incident where someone destroyed many records.” Sending to unsung: we’ve cleared things up with assistant, sorry for the confusion. Is there anything youd like to let us know about? Xoxo Run your shit better.
Sleeping Library Immediate combat Liquid metal unaffected by magic Golems have anti-magic, harmed by cold or water, healed by fire, slowed by electricity Can stay in Other thing Ghost, all damage resistance except force spirit touch or vitality Here where souls are contain or can be shoved into itself AKA here where souls be recycled Caoilinn briefly goes into a nightmare dimension Vault room is full of dream metal Modified hurraculum Metal for interacting between planes Put it into our bag of holding in caoilinn Boxes have reagents, we take them put them in sowwins bag Wards on left door, heavier than last time Leads to a cave with a slow empty wail that echoes Hallway that seems like its never been used but is also a dead end
Screeching metal, beyond that someone is yelling out a prayer to Desna Freight-like elevator that descends into the earth down below Send hermes down like a bullet with everlight crystal
He gets down to around 500ft mark till the light starts to fade and then lost connection + Hermes dies Doors on right Beds Immaculate, proto-typical beds Enter dreams JOAN AND NIVEN FELL FOR THE TRAP?? Others are fine People on the couch w caoilinn “Are you the sacrifices?” “You are in then sacrifice bed, how long have you been here?” “You will be going into the abyssal depths” Is it a cool abyss or “Its the abyss that makes up our world, ofc its cool” (Theyd used to send people into the depths where theyd die from the pressure) “We may contact the master to let them know 2 new sacrifices have willingly come in” Whos that “You were sacrificed and you dont know?” No we’re stupid we’re new here
“Corretha.” Whens the last time you had a sacrifice “Here? Its hard to tell time” “But she will be coming. Allegedly we have more sacrifices in holding.” Century object reading on the bed is TOO SHORT??? When are they coming over to sacrifice us? Is that soon? “She will arrive shortly im sure” Ok we wait Meanwhile joan gets grabbed and gets DOMINATED by a FALLEN ANGEL (nat 20 is a SUCCESS)
“You arent supposed to be here.” J: Clearly not “So why are you trying to be a god?” J: We’re not trying to but we have to take down a god “Then i’ll have to turn you into a god.” Grabs joan and FLYS 300FT TO THE PIT and drops her Joan does wings “a pale imitation” Dispels her wings Joan leaves dreams, falls onto the elevator thats covered in viscera of fallen creators The elevator goes up to where an alchemist, ririna, lives :)

sessions/freilands-campaign/act-3/sessio.title: Session 70
sessions/freilands-campaign/act-3/sessio.description:
Prev Session: Session 69
Next Session: Session 71 Provodid 14
Go to sleep at Skimberton Estate, Rozen Provodid 15
Go to Ririana’s Serves as a local community center for refugees of the war Down south is also where she runs an orphanage for the children of the city, as shes done for many decades Look in the center first Few people paying attention to us, to get to the tower we have to cross an open field first Guards look at us “could i help you sers?” We were hopin to get in contact with miss Ririana? “You can wait in the kitchen if u need something to eat, we’ll get in contact wth her” Yeah sure thats nice Nobody hungry or ill here, that’s pretty swag… maybe… Guard returns “shes been expecting you” Oh yay…. Go over to her tower Full of glowing alchemical bottles Standard alchemical stuff “You took your time getting to me.” Things came up. And then they went up. And then we realized what was up. And now we’re here! “I see. And why are you here?” Because when we looked up, we realized where here was! “And it took you… um. No it would be… a month and some change after raiding my laboratory to realize i was here?” You werent really high up on our priority list tbf… She has a surprising amount of metal under her hood at the base of her neck “If youre not going to get to the point, id ask you to leave. I do have a lot to get to today.”
Whats your involvement with the Deep Soul?
“Mostly scientific, mostly trying to cure your mess. I was trying to attune my soul in dream, but it turns out 6 people beat me to it.” Nnot on purpose “Doesnt matter. When the deep soul awakens, there will be immense pressure on the people, and most will die. I am seeking a cure on that. When you inevitably fail, i will aim to save as many as i can.” Wait what do you mean “There were 2 of you, and i know what you have done, so i’m certain you’ll fail.” Why are you so certain tho? What is it you expect us to fail at? “I assume you’re trying to stop the awaking of the deep soul.” Any advice? “I could do it.” Well given that your goal was what we we did, we could try “All that’s left is that the deep soul will awaken. All thats left is to mitigate the damage.” Wheres your proof coming from
“I contacted the Old Masters of the world.” Werent they also trying to awaken her “I saw her in real life. You saw her in dreams.” I missed the last bit
“The angel seeks to awaken her, they seek to bind her.” So the fact she’s already been manifested in reality means its functionally guaranteed? “Essentially. One of the best things I could do now is kill you now.” What would that do?! “Stop her from having a host.” Its gonna be one of us? “One of you.” If you had to kill one of us it would be… who. “Joan fuyuko or niven. Caoilinn is a possibility as well. Strong body that she doesnt have, a natural attunement to the occult, or the natural (smth i missed abt niven). sowwin is too strange, aberdeen doesnt have anything she lacks, caoilinn is neutral.” Well. id rather them not get possessed. Or you to kill them. “Of course” We’re not the only ones, theres also the old priest. “There is, thats why they keep the original version chained up, just in case.” 😲 Appears to be the truth. She doesnt know where he is currently, but she has seen him. Aberdeen tries to cast mindreading, she moves close “Next time you try to cast at me, i will inject you with something most vile. When you do, you’ll try to jump yourself out of the building to cure yourself. Your death will be more pleasurable.” And if we wanted to get in contact with the old masters? “Theyd get in contact with you first. They’re already in contact with you anyway.”
“Master DiFlorio.” I feel like more people are shocked about old master diflorio being out and about
“Why would i? Hes an old wizard from an empire. They had many ways to defeat Pharasma. I dont the nature of his immortality, but i am aware that he has it. As such i try not to concern myself with it.” If you’re concerned about the deep soul waking, won’t she be waking up here and destroying all these people you’ve been working to protect? “They won’t be the first to receive it. Their brethren are the ones that died to create the cure.” Youve made a cure? “Making one. Itll take a few more sacrifices, but itll be worth it when it does.” Is that why you chose this location? “Of course.” “The depths will recreate the conditions of her awakening. Their sacrifices are immense and theyll be remembered as heroes.” (itd be better for us to be sacrificed than randos, we wouldnt be immune but we’d get further down.) Whats the cure for? “The awakening. The pressure on the souls of the people and the nearby lands.” Youre sacrificing orphans to get the data you need? “Not the orphans, just the refugees. I remember their names.” Do they consent? “As much as they can” wdym “They dont know what entirely will happen when they go down.” “A decent amount die, and a decent amount come up not what they were. Dont worry, i do my due diligence and take care of the abominations.” (She was operating the elevator) Sowwins asks to see her research “No” Sowwin explains the most complicated dream stuff “You may look at one copy.” (theoretically itll work, but there are a ton of assumptions that dont have full reasoning behind it. But based on it, it should work.) Question her assumptions. “Those are, my understanding, gained from the old masters. Theres no reason to substantiate it with my own findings as they have no reason to lie.” They dont? “No” Have you been in contact with anyone else?
“Just diflorio. Ive been in contact with various people of the lands, like Madame Velvet as you’ve established.” She isnt aware of what youre doing here? “No one needs to know except for you, since you did steal my notes.” Would youd finish your research faster if
“An old fey now resides over one of my labs, so i had to start anew.” And you havent been in contact with the old fey? “I have attempted, and he has attempted to drive me out. He is much stronger than me, so no.” We’re on speaking terms, if you want us to act as a go between. Or have you already recreated all the research “At this point its a lost cause. We’ve sacrificed many more to catch up.” What were you doing down in that lab “It was a potion to turn someone into you for a few hours.” You like joan or someone with a connection to dreams? “You, like you all. Help split their soul in two, send half into dream.” We didnt consent to this??? “It doesnt matter.” We could go retrieve it. “Will he let you?” We can find out? If itd cut down the number of people you need to make this happen, im willing to go check. We have similar goals, and though our group isnt the wisest, we’re open to advice and ways to help. “You may certainly try. Now is there anything else? I have things to do today. If we’re going to fight, can we do it somewhere not the laboratory?” What do you need to just stop the sacrifices altogether. “I want to get it working. I need someone 75% down without them dying or turning into an abomination.” How far now? “55%. Its taken 3 months.” If you were to send someone stronger down, could you pull them up at 75 and not send further? “Unfortunately, the elevator doesnt go up until it reaches the bottom to stop the slaves from preventing their fate.” How far does the elevator go? “Not measurable in distance.” How are you getting the percents? “Based on the pressure. The distance is variable. The pressure is the only consistently going up.” What if we planeshifted? “You could try.” Has anyone done it? “Yes, and they instantly died.” Was it a scroll or were they capable? “Capable, and now i work alone.” Ms riri, could we- we might end up in close proximity to the deep soul, could we get some of your samples of your works? If you have anything that gives a slight edge to being around it and you have no further need of it… “I can attempt to. At the very least, i can give you whats left of those that got furthest down.” If we tried to go down, how do you get usable results? “Usable results… id have to attach devices to you.” “Its a simple barometer that cuts off if you die or turn into something youre not. If it survives all the way, it means you made it all the way down before dying.” What are the creatures that come back up? I noticed there were fiends in your lab, is that related or unrelated “Aberrations.”
Wait. did you know about The Watcher? “Yes.” Is that related or “Presumably. They likely had a lot of aberrations and used them as shock troops and the like.” Quick question about the devil down there “Yes” Howd you get in touch? “He moved in and i didnt kick him out. He also enjoyed the pain of the people. I went all the way there to use the lab that was already set up and not one that was hastily built in a tower.” Would it be useful to get access to the lab again? “Again no, youve asked twice now. Look at the logs of refugees, we dont recognize any of their names Is there an easy way to get down She leads us 3 secret doors, the first of which is a secret lab, the 2nd is various drug substances, the 3rd is people names and memos put into cubbies What happens to the souls of the aberrations? “Theyre destroyed completely. The pressure affects the soul as well.” “So what is your plan when you leave here?” Wdym…. Step one, see if we can make it a little bit safer to send one of us down without turning into soul paste, i think we offer to talk to the fey Hey did you put wards put at the old lab “No, those were put by the old masters.”
Do you know whats up with Yuki Seppänen? “I believe she is the angel that tried to kill me before.” “It is unknown, and impossible to scry. But she does not bother me, and i do not bother her.” (aberdeen is looking at the work of ancient archmages that could battle gods.) “If it were that simple, i would have done it already” I mean sure but i wanted to check
“I believe Thirteenth Tower is where i was trying to go before you beat me there.” “I let your doppelgangers out of the prison they found themselves in.” Do you know why they were given half the city??? “That way half the city was owned by people with connection.” (ghost who owned house had connection, but reverse. Master owns us = we owned the city = master owns the city in the eye of the public. Helps the dreams manifest in those areas)
Thirteenth Dream Various footprints that align with the archmage alongside the angel and alongside multiple others Faint hint of a decent amt of people that disturbed dust but were walking on air Don’t indicate that they have wings, it merely disturbs in a line Gyroscopic thing Someone appears before us DIFLORIO AGAIN GOD DAMMIT Hi…. “Hello.” “You came down the elevator i presume. Then teleported into dream to get to the old masters.” The old masters are here? “This is their throne room. And they do deserve their rest.” Are you the real one or are you one of the fake diflorios with the box in their brain? “I am the real one, there is no fakes, unless someone has been impersonating me.”
Tiberius Acre keeps delivering us your head “Tiberius is a fool that has been taken care of. If you’ve been interacting with a tiberius, its likely a clone.” When???
“When he had to go potentially betray his best friend and destroy his betrothed. He hesitated, and then lost.” If hes a clone- you didnt do that? “The angel and i are in an agreement until her betrothed awakens.” Her betrothed…? “I am unknown if it is the right term. They were merely engaged.” The deep soul? “When they were both alive.” Was she always an angel? “No one was always an angel, at least the archangels. [horrifically describes an angel turning into an archangel after a god ascends]” We pull out his head from sowwins head, initiative starts (pulling out his head is what caused hostility, we’ll apparently get to it?) TLDR: We meet Riri She left an important potion in her old lab under the brewery She is trying to save as many people as possible via human experiments with the depth elevators, to help people resist the pressure of the Deep Soul She planned to make herself part dream (like us) to prevent the deep soul's awakening but we did it first we, and the priest, could become hosts Most ideal would be joan niven or fuyuko. Sowwin aberdeen not ideal, caoilinn is neutral She has gotten information from the Old Masters (Di Florio's masters) Also, she is probably not be a fiend Riri thinks that Yucky is the Toxi Yuri Angel who is the Creator who is the Glowing Woman The reason the dream clones (and now us) owned half the city was to establish a connection between the city and dreams We go to the 13th tower Angel, Diflorio, and many hovering people have been here (the old masters) This is the throne room of the old masters, Di Florio said so Di Florio claimed that Yucky beat Tibby and that they replaced him with a clone Deep soul and the Angel are Doomed Yuri for each other They were slaves who loved each other, when the Deep Soul became a god, her wife to be became her angel We reach into Sowwin's head to pull a Di Florio head and he became hostile immediately

Thirteenth Dream
Hieronymus Di Florio goes invisible Resistances applied rn Void Fire Cold Physical Electricity He wasnt prepared for combat, but does have heal prepared with druid slots Niven takes him down, mechanical click goes off in his head Sowwin gets a device that is like writing words down before the paper is destroyed out of his skull Joan, niven, and sowwin get sickened, no one else does Might be 2 effects that are combined Feels like when niven was near the runes Joan destroyed the first rune Might be targeting fey + nephillim? Going down
No Old Masters, no throne A cage that is meant to hold a holy creature with various sets of runes
So that no matter what form the Deep Soul takes, she’s bound by the cage Fuyuko Retrocognition at 8th rank Asked to make an occultism? Odd gap that is about year 3 onward for a traumatic event To about year 4ish, completely skipped over, not even mundane things Strong anti-scrying. NOT the angel, we would see the angel
A small scout that appears to be galorfin in both realms year 7 or 8 (little bit before lighthouse, year and a half before), checked in. ensuring that its there, sent his report. From then on, it was di florio for the rest of the time 6th rank object read Last decade Skipped time period again Thinking about di florio calling it the throne of the old masters, it was sarcasm The rune that was fey was recently tampered with to include more scope. We could just conventionally destroy it to introduce a weakness Joan destroys it Back to the IRL throne room Throne is faintly glowing People currently sitting around, looking at it Look at us “You arent the ones to be heralded.” Various garbs from around the city “Are you divine messengers?” S: Blind prophet please speak to them “Blind so they may see dreams better?” F: wdym?
“The one in dreams, the god? The second coming of Desna who called us here?” “To see the birth of a god is to be blessed.” S: thats why the prophet is blind, because they’re already blessed A lot of the people look like the coma people from when the city first flooded F: what deadline did they tell you? We’re behind schedule “We wait with patience and reverence. But it will come soon. Within the month.” “Its hard to hear, but we do hear it. We’ve been following your instructions” J: repeat so we can confirm them? “Whenever we hear someone singing in their sleep, we invite them down.” N: how often can you find those who sing? “It grows exponentially by the day.” (mmm i see. pemdas.) N: have you received any of the visions?
“The visions? We’ve received the instructions, the light, the angel descending upon us.” N: yes the vision “Not a vision, a communication. It was amongst the first thing she said to us. ‘This is real. Do not panic.’” A: when you hear the song, is it always the same or does it vary between people? “Its the holy song.” A: yes, its always that? “Yes” N: sing it for us? (old dragboni singing. Mostly symbolic lyrics, variant that the party is unfamiliar with. Seems to be talking about holding hands together and going into the light. A lot about loss and the lost)
Head back home to Skimberton Estate - Has anybody been by the house “Outside of the normal?” Whats the normal? “Postman. The various people of the city that walk by the house. The automaton you’ve invited in a few times.”
The Passionate? “Yes single eye in the forehead.” What was the passionate doing? “He did not enter. He knocked and then left.” Sending to the passionate - heard you stopped by, everything okay? We killed another di florio
“Tiberius Acre is still missing. Situation is growing more dire. Many automatons are beginning to sleep. Real sleep, not stasis.” Sending to tiberius - hey man i heard you were dead? No response Passionate - are you available to dream council? “No. on the hunt.” An hour passes, a knock at the door
Dream Galegal outside “Might i come in?” Appears to have his simple sword that he used to slice us down once. Let him in “Might I sit down?” Sure? “I come not as a man, but as a messenger from the gods. My patron wants to propose a temporary truce.” Conditions? “Now that her pact is coming to an end, she wants for her friend to not be a slave to the powers that be. I want to see the witnessing of a free god. And you dont want to see her power be used by the old masters of the world.” S: we dont like you but we haaaaate
“Thankfully we’ve securred her awakening. So what we propose is to work together to take out the Old Masters before turning on each other. I dont expect you to have a sudden change of heart, but i do expect you to work toward a common interest.” N: this is exciting we never get included in these “Itll be better than last time where you snuck on me and killed me.” S: you got better He doesnt want any wine or ticklemint tea Level up - 16 TLDR: After a battle, we defeated Di Florio Fuyuku is perma blinded The device in his brain destroyed itself and a chunk of his brain/jaw Old masters weren't here, it was cage for the deep soul Anti Fey/Angel wards We have damaged it We moved out of dreams and found a cult They believe that Deep Soul is the second coming of Desna When someone sings the holy song (in old dragboni) in there sleep, they pull them into the cult lots of symbolism and in a different dialect of old dragboni lyrics about holding hands and entering the light and surpassing loss varies person to person We went home and spoke to the passionate Tibby is missing (maybe Di Florio wasn't lying) Warforged are falling into true sleep, with dreams and stuff We messaged tibby, no response Galegal, the priest, came to our house as a "messenger of the gods" team up against the old masters then openly betray each other

Skimberton Estate, Rozen
Galegal Ulgincamp J: What exactly are you proposing here beside a temporary truce? “That’s it. Simple ceasing of hostilities. If we’re investigating into each other’s territories we simply send a message and we’ll leave. Once we’re rid of the masters of the city then we turn on each other.” “She’s not capable of killing the old masters. To question a god is heresy.”
J: are you relying on us killing the old masters? “We’ll help, of course. You’re going that way, though, aren’t you? You already killed one of their servants.” N: their servant?
“Master DiFlorio.” J: well he has been killed many times recently “It’s still murder, isn’t it?” J: who exactly is involved?
“Me, the newly converted, Corretha” J: did she agree with this?
“She is the voice of our god. She inserted the clause of us betraying each other after.” J: what exactly are you lookin into rn?
“Ways to bring her back to the height of her power when she awakens. And how gods moved when they were back alive. We’re thinking of taking her across the sea to Advesperascit to take a throne.”
The throne of want can only be activated by a god rn A: that would be effective all things considered “What are you looking into?” A: we believe di florio is making magic clones, including students and leaders around the continent. We’re looking into nobility that have potentially been replaced “I’ve been looking into him as well.” A: have you learned anything/seen anything?
“We learned of a journal kept by higher ups down below, thats why corettha was down below in Sleeping Library.” We have this J: well if we hear anything about that we’ll let you know A: is there anything we can provide assistance with? Morven
Philomene
Rosalind
Viktor Keson
Yurei Anmoku
The doctor is searching for the local necromancer in a small town called Fathrell
Enters a 2 story building with a wooden door, Anmoku Funeral Parlor Inside is the sound of bickering by 2 different sized creatures They are arguing about some trees Viktor knocks on the door and is asking for the necromancer Yurei lets him in and they are talking Viktor’s asking around looking for the person that turned him Upon seeing he’s a vampire, yurei is v nice to him and checks the parlor’s records Yurei does not know the person he’s looking for There’s a small argument about who counts as a kid between morven and yurei Yurei and Morven are bringing Viktor to go look for undead at a temple outside of town Someone is raising them there Someone has built a temple atop of old dwarven ruins Thoroughly destroyed, no obvious symbol outside
Inside might indicate Shelyn Re-animated corpses above Kholeran finds a body From a few hundred-ish years ago, magic keeping it partially from decomposing A ghost, Philomene, comes across her ripping into the body
Kholeran is from Grundiir It is from nowhere anymore
Old dwarven capital, fell to the Lower Warp Odd reality bending the lower into the earth you go Did it to their capital If you don’t write in stone, the Warp may take it as if it never was The empire fell to this Most dwarven states are vassal states for staying in contact with the surface Morven investigates the two of them Philomene and Kholeran This is the closest Kholeran’s been to town Rosalind waking up Most undead in the temple are mindless, there is one inside that is mindful The mindful walks closer Asks why we came here Claims no disturbances, they have not bothered anyone Asks what order we subscribe to
The mindful is a hellknight
The Order of the Nail Was hellknight turned undead
(One near where Viktor lived was Order of the Eclipse) Signs the waiver after a long conversation Wants to show us something Wait til midnight Described as “pleasant” Unpleasant first Yurei feels nothing Rosalind feels arms go spindly, feverish pain as green light touches Morven there is exhilarating and awful pain, 20 souls screaming at once Viktor feels the rain falling down, foul copperish taste as teeth retract Kholeran feels the hunger, feeling rain plop down Philomene is able to feel the warmth of someone nearby Man in front of us was an elven man before the green light goes away Uh oh! Combat We head towards the church now with yurei and philomene detecting magic The chapel is slowly repairing itself Scarf of disguise in the chapel room Descend down into the basement Stonework is dwarven, but most of the stones corrosion going in reverse. Stones are slowly rehealing themselves Well preserved coffins and catacombs Different calendar system Coffins arent empty, don’t seem undead They are not decomposing, but _re-composing One died of old age, but the others look to be bodies of soldiers Halflings, elves, humans, dwarves. Don’t seem to be the same group, but all wear the same uniform
There is a shrine to Torag down here, offerings upon it’s altar Offerings belong to a series of religious people, rune stones and hand wraps and an odd looking pendant Pendant of the occult 2 +1 potency rune stones Handwraps of mighty blows Kholeran grabs the items Door/air behind the door has a rhythmic beat Familiar to Yurei’s fox half, but unable to make out any details Badly humming a song Open door Someone calls Wolfman, oddly celestial
Hound archon of Torag Foot soldier By archon standards very dumb Not allowed to break into areas [jay missed a bunch] Hellknights just wanted to know what it felt like to be alive Doesn’t know what the light source is Wizard showed up, she could not find the source Light is an anomaly, but source isn’t Sometimes area between planes is thin, and when they crash together, they create a light but much bigger Wizard woman was a vampire, the archon assumes she was bad intention Black hair, short cut at the shoulders, 5’2” Appeared well-nourished (unlike Viktor) A giant fuckin runic circle situation on the ground??? Source of power, but beyond our reasonable knowledge Except Ume
Ume unhinges its jaw and swallows the rune. “You’ve done well” - Auntie Miko Ume is now confused why Yurei is upset bc “Yurei” gave the command Whenever the familiar eats something, the patron blesses the witch Crypt is now devoid of runes, erosion occurs as normal Heading back, party rests in the funeral parlor There’s a halfling man at the door asking about business, asking for Yurei
Garmond (so many jobs) Pain in the ass, audited them many times Needs names for who helped “Did you start building the house next to the funeral parlor before or after tax exemption” Brand new as of the last day Reestate plans need to be done after a month of tax exemption Have a day and eleven hours to get paperwork It’s 1264 House Serpent has an inscription (“You’re welcome”) Big fuckin house

Come close to the D'Esme Regalia Mines, it appears that they are hiring workers there again Philomene Searching the last third
Find the Fathrell Archive is under lockdown Something dangerous that has been throwing people out windows Waiting for the archmage to get there Monster looks like a ravenous fox They believe its a type of daemon She tries to go in, claiming as a priest They contacted one from the north, comes in 3 days time The cleric will find whoever did this, and will exorcize them. Guys. guys is that good. Guys.chuckles im in danger
Dayalu =) She touches one of the guards, nat 1 Kholeran ends up finding Yurei drunk as fuck In Kitsune, “Thanks for the night” 3 stolen spell scrolls from the archives Yurei has to sign a contract for their aunt to get full body possession Similar to devil contracts so creature has to sign of own will, but there are no rules against creating situations of duress where creature is incentivized to sign Priest (Tunseel Operative) knocking at the door Morven gets us unsanctioned undead outside the back
Godrun tells the Tunseel Squire that any undead here are under the protection of Sighar Tunseel agent is looking for a vampire woman who’s been in the area
They’re being sanctioned under House Fi’Stralis We have an address of this guy If we have a vampire, should report it so they can stop the outbreak across the border Auntie what were you doing for pleasure in the Archive? No response, fuck you Vampire goes through the streets, confident but light, and goes to the outskirts of town Appears that she walked through the front door Blinds down 1 back door, heavily locked 1 story, plain, kind of guard shack repurposed Viktor picks the lock in the back Captains quarters Foot tracks of the female vampire lead here The captain is looking for undead, there are casualty forms on her table (they are unfilled)

Have known each other a while but are only a couple as of an hour ago Kholeran found an invisible gnome in the basement casting spells to the people upstairs She tries to eat him, he casts a spell to open all the doors, and initiative starts

See beautiful Tunseel Rolling hills and orchards Don’t see her, but Kholeran knows the survival techniques someone would take You’d go along the water Follow the river Four moons, the fifth trying to peak out during the sky There used to be 1 moon, but during the apocalypse it shattered into 4 Split moon blotted out the sun for a few hundred years Underneath the moon is a fallen tower where a campfire is burning Hear from around the side, 2 men Tunseelian footsoldiers Yurei giving them coupons and shit They’re claiming to just be patrolmen on patrol The tunseelian standard is 3 men on patrol They say #3 is sick but they assign replacements for sick members

Go out to meet with Succubus Cult Tunseelian chariots Nobility and some guards
Actually framing Yniesse Zenderholm, saying she was Tunseelian soldier turned vampire Say she did it 2 days This man is the one in charge??
