“Will have to warn that Dione lady that she may have a vampire on her hands.” “A wizard lady that came through.” "jay you are awoken by a procession of naked men going through the cave" -zack Go over the mountains Takes 3 days, closer to 4
Back home to Fathrell, Anmoku Funeral Parlor No mail despite being gone for a week?
Someone has amateurishly picked the lock, managed to get in at some point (halfling/gnome/rosalind size) Searched through everything, but they made a considerate effort to put things back in its place Downstairs area tried to be picked, but couldn’t get into the secondary locked room Person who stole mail = person who picked lock
Texting Auntie Miko There’s a woman in town that’s plagued by an abundance of magic, can you help absorb her magic? “Only if she doesn’t mind dying.” Well we’re trying to keep her from dying from her magic…. You still get her magic tho?? “Absorbing magic is outside my purview. I can only give power, but to take… a nigh impossibility.” A knock at the door, a little after business hours Peephole shows someone’s black pants leg “Rosalind just let me in.”
It appears by the voice to be Shiryo Anmoku Hi dad you’re back early??? “I heard there was trouble. Something about Tunseelian hunters in the establishment? I thought we agreed if anything bad happened in the parlor.” We got busy and we had to go on a trip and made friends but the friends are weird but they needed help with things Yurei’s babysitter is the one who broke into the house and told their dads about the hunters
Other dad is still on honeymoon Asks Viktor what line he is from, might be distantly related to his husband Offers to give Phil a gravestone Lectures Yurei Takes Yurei to the pews
Ume whispers to Viktor A veiled hush Auntie is angry and the recipient hasn’t responded yet, she’s been waiting TWO WHOLE MINUTES, and she has things she needs to do Phil writes on the snake: “Dear Auntie, Yurei is getting yelled at by their dad, that is why they are not answering. He is very angry. Much love, Phil.” “Who is Phil and how are you able to contact me?” I am Yurei’s friend and I am a ghost. “Why is my gift not with the recipient?” The dads don’t know about the witch situation Yurei’s dads don’t know about the contract XOXO Phil “Is Yurei’s father more important to talk to than upholding our agreement?” You know how teenagers are 🤷 Father w Yurei
“Why and how did you manage to find a Sussurro, and why is it here?” Yurei has heard it before, but they forgot so hard “The cultural ghost? One that’s formed from culture.” Oh I just kind of found her on the road??? And then she started following us??? She seems nice??? “You were in the workshop when your father sculpted her. Surely you remember.” Vague memories Dad makes a lot of sculptures tho….. “Be careful, they can be unstable. They think they’re real people.” Are they not??? “No they’re born from an understanding of a person, a concept. Remember when your dad worked on the Dimenshecahi?” “You kept the downstairs office the same, he had an old book about it.” We had some restructuring, what’s the name of it?? “The Tonofo.” Yurei going to get the book. It has a picture of Philomene on the cover????? “She thinks she’s a person, but she’s an artstyle.” Did dad make her??
“No it was a popular art style that was popular in Ensile. Near Flamhaltn?” Artistic representation of Phil “When enough people believe in a concept, they give a bit of their soul to the thing each time. A little bit of a lot creates that.” Dad asks about the books (financial) “I also see you built a house. Can I ask which fund you drained for it? The only one you had access to that wasn’t our retirement fund only had 500 gold is. And that house is too nice to be worth 500 gold.” Yurei’s in pretty deep shit Okay…. So say we got a tip about things happening in a church, and it had a sigil, and now we have a house next door, and we had to commit tax fraud but ITS OKAY!! “The second any official comes through, the business will go under. You understand this?” “BAD BOOK KEEPING.” Can’t make it disappear now “Either way, are there bedrooms in it?” Plenty!! Yurei giving Phil the book Ok so what if you were like a concept. Ok so what if you were a kind of art that got really popular and then became a spirit. Have you thought about that? Have you considered that? Hey Auntie can it wait, ahaha? 10 mins later. “NO IT CANNOT WAIT.” Father interrogating Moven and Rosalind “ARE YOU SURE YOU WORK HERE.” “Yurei has offered you raises, correct? Competitive to standard?” “How did you come to both of you be? Is it from your spirit not passing on? Or was it something like witchcraft or alchemy that brought you back?” Rosalind: IDK but i don’t know much about my origin. But they’ve offered to help me pass on a lot!! “What steps has Yurei taken in pursuing the discovery of your origin?” R: Contacting sales people, but hard. But have more info as of late! Soooo true Yurei has been doing things by the book, even added steps that werent in the book. But yurei did some blunders ofc (technically would have sent wrong parchment to gnolls, small mistakes that are def mistakes but forgivable to their dad) Dragging Yurei out “Why not just tell him so we can get our business done faster without interruption?” Wasn’t you who said to keep it a secret?? What changed??? “A small change in form.” What change in form?? And also what do you need me to handle so imminently?? “Potential travel of course. We just got back but I didn’t get to appreciate your adventure. I yearn for the open road.” Uh huh. Is it related to the locations that were in the book in my pocket?? Snake steals some things “So despite your father’s words you CAN actually read.” You didn’t tell me NOT to look through the book “If I did tell you not to do it, you would have done it for sure. But remember we have a vested interest in each other! My power grows, your power grows.” “I even gifted you a house. :)” Hey auntie how many tails do you have right now? “9 ephemeral, 1 true.” What was that sigil about, really?
“It was a rune of remaking. It was the only reason the church was still there.” Why did you need it? “I think we’re getting a bit ahead of ourselves.” Phil book Mentions techniques to drawing in the style for invoking beauty
Afterward: Dedicated to Lord Régis Rosaire d'Esmé’s wife, Philomene, who died in the Miverian Revolution. 5 revolutions that now are called the Undetermined THE NAME OF THE MAN WHO SAW YOU DIE AND HAD NO EXPRESSION ON HIS FACE Dedicated a fund and art movement in her honor Book is as old as Yurei and is 20 years out of date Artstyle is dedicated to simple aesthetic beauty, meant to resemble people but the outlines. A solidified impressionism style.
Many people visit her grave daily. Many artists visit and is part of a temple of Shelyn.
Is in Flamhaltn, is visited daily by the husband. 2 weeks travel
Hey Auntie why does Tunseel want these fragments? “I wish i knew 💕” Are you lying??? “Why would I lie??”
“Flamhaltn is close, there is one I found in an old tome while I was piloting your body. There is a man named Esme who has opened a mining company where I need to be (Shenval).” Viktor snacks on Morven
Government Official Ono is known to the party. Typically in charge of surveying land, not exciting but it is important Level 4!!

Fathrell, Anmoku Funeral Parlor 6pm (too early -viktor) Yurei is going to come out (as a witch)
Yurei’s dad, Shiryo Anmoku is pacing the Fathrell Graveyard (expect a report card in 3 days) He’s attempting to de-weed part of the odd vines that have taken over part of the graveyard Says to be careful with it, it has a few anti-void properties “How mad would you be if I were semi-posessed by one of our ancestors? JUST SPITTING THAT OFF AS AN IDEA.”
He asks which one, says it’s Auntie Miko “You’re sure that this spirit is an ancestor and not a trickster spirit?” Uhhh. Well she knows a lot of things about us. And she claims to be [an ancestor]. Doesn’t know any ancestor that goes by Miko “If i don’t know her she’s over 600” “You have a grasp on it, right?” Uhh. Yeah! Kinda? “And this “Auntie” - could I talk to her?” Well she only communicates in writing. Writing to Auntie - “Auntie my dad wants to talk to you” After 3 hours: NO. “Now you have Rosalind and Morven as companions, would you say they’ve been keeping an eye out on your wellbeing? Not just physical.”
Tell him we were in Uisu He calls bullshit, he passed through there Ok so like we may have been getting framed for something we didnt do. And had to go clean it up. And had to go into the mountains in Uisu…. Ok the people were vampire hunters
“Were they Vollacy?” - proper noun vampire hunters from Tunseel No they didn’t seem as organized as that, but they were from across the border, so…. They were framing us for vampire attacks (WHICH WE DIDNT DO) “Are you sure your friend Viktor didn’t do it? When you’re new, its harder to control.” I don’t think so? “He could be lying.” Well what if he’s telling the truth? “Then it’s more complicated.”
We’re not selling out my friend. We think it was his sire? The knights made a fake copy of her head “Who specifically has her head?”
The lady who we killed didn’t have her head…. We didn’t manage to track it down. You’re not mad right???? “No….. I’m disappointed, BUT, right now we need to find an undead or something to pin this on. Its okay, its just vampire politics.”
Okay… well i think they’re gonna be pretty set on using the head as evidence bc Tunseel might be trying to invade Ensile We were hoping if we could clear up the evidence we could stop the war! “You sign back the funeral parlor for me for a few months, legally your actions wont affect it, and [we’ll be okay bc dad was out of town]” Yurei gets demoted “I recommend skipping town as soon as you can. The longer you’re away, the easier it is to justify you not being here. You haven’t answered any business correspondence since then, right?”
Did you take my mail??? Could Suraito have taken it? “No, i asked him for an update when he first got here. Why would he break into the funeral parlor? He can teleport through windows.” “Has someone been stealing our mail and breaking in?” WELL. While we were away, it seems so? They didn’t steal anything but the mail?
Yurei’s other dad, Florence Anmoku, is working for Aace Arubedo on Ziliarn Lightning Rail “I’ll take care of that…………….. Um. You know where the mail could’ve gone?” Ummm. No. but we were gonna get a scroll of object reading Yurei casts summon undead to prove that they can cast spells “Oh. So Auntie is real.” “Did I ever tell you about your uncle?” “He went mad from staying too far away from living people and just being around bodies.” “I feared that in the three months since we last saw you you went mad.” “I think its best you [sign the funeral parlor over] and leave town as soon as possible.” OK SO WE MAY HAVE LEFT THE CARRIAGE BY THE MOUNTAIN…. “okay……….. “ Rosalind Phil, Yurei, and Viktor go to the wizard
Go to Goodsong Tavern (thankfully without Morven) 3ish story building, historic, custom grown oak Look and find the lowly, curled black hair, drinking alone, wizard Doesnt offer Rosalind a hand up on the barstool We need a scroll of object reading and also something to be able to absorb the magic out of someone
“If i was able to absorb magic id be like the wizard in the Advesperascit incident. (Gold Master)” He could get us some books on it?
Just needs to get help from the The Nexus (he cant cast the spells) We are just trying to help a woman heal It would take 2 weeks for this guy to get object reading, speak with animals, and our book He MIGHT know people in town Needs money first, bc what hes doing is illegal Getting spells from nexus students when he isnt a nexus student Practicing the selling of magic w/o registration
Sending Kholeran and morven to Uisu for the carriage Getting there around late night The carriage is no longer where it was
Kholeran follows the tracks to the inn, a local halfling has taken it Goodsong Tavern In stone stables, locked from the inside They go to talk
Shalana and Goodsong “Why are you back? To steal a ring again?” No…. we’re looking for our cart…….. Awkwardly hanging out with Shalana “You do know that- be candid now that its over, were you acting as a scouting party?”
“A scouting party for the monk hunters.” (Shino Hakusa) NO???? Get the cart “You better get going. I wouldn’t stay here after dark. You arent welcome here, you broke hospitality the last time you were here.” She’s trying to make sure no one is trying to see Morven OR she’s going to murder the two of them There is someone coming from the monastery to the tavern Viktor earns income, Yurei begs their dad for money, and phil earns income There is a letter that gets sent out from Yurei’s dad: “My dear love, i have a request for your employer and those attached to them. It is related to our dear daughter.”
Viktor asks Yurei’s dad abt Dione, who sends a letter to his husband Reconvenes We bungled our downtime. Just a bit We buy a horse
We’re going to Shenval Long road across several days No one seems to inspect Viktor’s body
We get to the Levarian Cliffs and stop for the night before being greeted by a scholar-esque type person, Homveran “You don’t happen to have room for another person?” Asking about what kind of rituals yurei reads Is a spellcaster, mostly occult He has a spellbook Hunched over, thick eyebrows, writing things down, platonic ideal of a wizard I mostly keep the names and souls of objects and try to call them from wherever they are Heard about news from the west, investigating commotions “The stars said that there was something and I go where the stars tell me”
Kholeran somehow knows that Zukrat is a Tunseelian town of little renown, located north near Milaun Sort of questions Phil abt her god? Feels v skeptical
Doesn’t seem that Phil coming back is related to her goddess Naderi Willing to pay Phil about asking her god a spell and answering a question (Augury)
His god (Pharasma) has stopped answering, and is the only one This guy isn’t a witch, not a cleric, not a champion
Is an undead hunter known as an Nomlant, his name is Homveran Umbreon the Omlette Writes down names, if they turn red, they are hunted Typically would wait for a sign from pharasma, a psychopomp, and they would turn red based on who is judged He’s surely met psychopomps in the past few years, but none of the names have turned red The psychopomps don’t really want to do this judgement without Pharasma’s approval He casts Cozy Cabin, lets us hang out His donkey’s name is Tomine Phil casts augury Will Tomine stop to have to use the restroom in the next 30 mins? Yes Leaves, goes whistling down to the west Heading south
Great lakes of Ensile, turquoise water goes from turquoise to a greyish brown
See the city of Shenval Only a mile or two away, Morven, seeing the natural habitat gutted, passes out briefly from their head aching Approaches a giant gate with what appear to be Phil’s head on it Asks why we’ve arrived so late, they run on elven time not dwarven time
Say we came on order of Anmoku Funeral Parlor “Make prior appointment next time, but you can talk to the manager” Ask if we want to trade our coin for Scrip (company currency) Take a left upon entering the gate, salute the guards, avoid the right town if we dont have scrip They let us in
Morven wakes up, says they’re Raghni. The brain. Not something funeral parlor’s seen before Ragni died here <3

Shenval, d'Esme Mining Company Phil Morven + Viktor Inn Burleyish inn keeper/bartender asks why we’re bringing coffins in Asks to look for contraband, opens Viktor’s coffin (empty) Knows we’re undead, but won’t tell anyone but upper management Yurei + Rosalind Worker tavern Switching up of shift (16 hours on, 8 hours off) Going in, goblin/dwarven group Few immediately turn to face Go to a group that is about to start a shift Lying about being paranormal investigators, trying to check out stuff thats going on =) “[Check] on who’s behalf?” Ours! We’re not getting paid.
“My friend over there has seen some ghosts before, not in Shenval but if you’re willing to go to Milaun.” But we heard things about this town! “We don’t have much ghosts, just dead.”
“Ghosts are very visible. My friend said one showed up and threw a book at his head.” (in Milaun) We ask about a forest, they say itll cost us “Are you interested in werewolves?” “(speaking in another language brings attention) Speaking of a local innkeeper, you can’t say much before being sacrificed to his fellow creatures of the night.” Start talking via message “The administrator bartender is a werewolf and favors other creatures of the night. Offers underperforming miners to them.” Werewolf is working in a silver mining town
“I saw him transform into a wolf and eat my friend Erik.” The mine Erik was sent to collapsed a week after Uses Yurei to talk with message back and forth between the friends Dwarf attempts to convey, the townsquare used to bloom a while ago before the mines collapsed. No one is allowed to work in the mine. If we wait til the end of his shift, he can talk to his friend who worked there Asks for a small favor: if you could burn the binding contracts that they all have, they’re kept in the tavern where your sort stay There’s at least 5 armed guards, plus wizard
Klieg, Freeks, and Radvoigz Gives a small handsign
A handsign of the Undetermined, of group that killed the Ensile king Morven Viktor Rosalind 8 hours after rest, a knock at the door Elven woman with her hair, platinum blonde, slicked back with a fine robe Asks if we would be able to sign a contract if necessary She leaves, will come back in an hour Woman comes back Asking about absorbing “the coffin company” “What are your terms for signing with the Esme Mining company?” Asking about signing an exclusivity contract, mining or lumber company
“I trust that as good business owners the Anmoku Funeral Parlor keeps more than 1 contract.” Shes doing mind reading lol
“Our proud owner is about to be crowned king by the time we returned to Fathrell” They’re offering to sell us whatever we need below market rates, but in return we can only buy from them and also, with their new company opening in Fathrell, they’re only buy from us as well
Doing this would essentially plant them on the Ensile throne After they become king, they could renegotiate any contract they see fit This is a contract that is skewed to our favor in writing, in actuality if we plan to live more than 5 years, it will probably not be as good. We have to contact the family about it, send out a letter “I hope we won’t have to evict you during the day.” Go back to the worker tavern Goblin man has returned with 2 reserved seats for Yurei and Rosalind “I don’t know how you’re going to get through, its this X here. It’s where [names] met their demise at the collapse. But it should lead you to where the odd happenings were.” Mine is unused, closed gate CLOSED FOR WORKER SAFETY. DO NOT ENTER. IF YOU ENTER, GUARDS HAVE THE RIGHT TO DETAIN/CONTROL THE FLOW OF TRAVEL. No tracks on the ground, not even ours There is a major trap, overturned cart with gold If need to fill quotas, it could make sense for someone to come here to try and fill it Send morven in, she opens the gate for us Go to the left tunnel Disbelieving the collapse Poorly made gravestones further in, made of stacked rocks We find The Orb Get attacked by a gobin The workers on the grave have their ids
This guy is Chornurt, one of the guys originally left here The people died were killed by slashing, not bludgeoning Have some chunks taken out, as well as dead rats Small registration at the names we say “Why not kill. Torture?” Rescue! “Why no kill?” Looking for dog? “No dog. No dogman. Only sword.” He’s been trapped here because of the illusion We ask about the Orb “Ball goal.” Game? “Death.” Why??? Scared. “Ball big magic. Taken, us killed.” Ball was an artifact to store great magic so it didn’t affect nearby area. It’s, since then, contents have been stolen. Taken by the Esme Mining company.
Ball made out of copper and bronze, only second to Noquol. Made to contain. Whatever it was was a rune of some sort. How long magic gone? “Time hard in dark. After collapse.” One of the issues with copper is its inertia. It had the same magic in it long enough that its still producing the magic. We leave this tunnel There are guards here… “Have our lovely business partners found something that would sway the contract?” The elven woman, guards, and the bartender, for some reason (hes a werewolf) Hey uh… there was something in that orb. I would deeply consider that contract if you gave me info on where it went “Are you sure you can afford what you’re asking for right now?” “Its with our dear leader, who is talking to other kings about further gathering them.” What about the binding contracts? The workers.
“They’re binded for a better life for their family back home. They’re from Milaun. Its contract work.” “The dryad” is just the orb Phil speaks, and the assassin guards get confused bc she’s not an illusion like they were told “I prefer to show kindness to those like me, but I won’t hesitate to remove it if necessary.” Bartender Only 1 moon, Basura, is one that werewolves transform under. It’ll be full in a week. The bartender is a werewolf.

“What does a funeral parlor have business with the city?” We’re passing through on business, we’re looking to expand our branches “We have our own funeral parlors and sanctified funeral site.” “If you arent invited and on business, we have to charge you 2gp.” The tavern up north is nice and crowded, the southern one is cheaper All citizens from Ensile are permitted to stroll through the noble quarter “Temple” given to the artisans for local art movement
Recommend the temple to Régis Rosaire d'Esmé's wife, underneath his keep He visits it everyday at sunset =) Go to the fancy inn Elven man asks us where we’re from “Legally you cannot inherit the crimes of your father, you would inherit his debt.” We lie 100s of gp in debt “Apologies. It must be a coincidence, then.” “He was trying to woo some man he met down here who was also a head of a funeral parlor.”
Unfortunate sexual description of their dads, Shiryo Anmoku and Florence Anmoku Beautiful artistic inn, you can eat as much as you want as long as you can cover the entry charge Its very expensive, we leave We go to the other inn Not as expensive, but still nice Ok go to the temple/memorial crypt 3 guards outside Ask us to give weapons We bungled that so hard. whoopsie Phil gets to go in Rest of the party is held at halberd-point outside Lord Esme gets to decide if we get to leave the city No rage within Phil at seeing him Coffin that Phil is inlaid in has a glass top, has a stab wound within her heart “What should I feel guilty of?” The chest wound Nothing to do with her death? She remembers distinctly differently “I have no memory of it being different from how the stories told.” I know that you pushed me in front of the assassin. “You threw yourself to save me.” I dont think I did, though I would have at that time. There are very few things that I know but one is that my death was your responsibility “Is there anyway I can make up this perceived slight?” “I would like answers. I want to know why you did it, what was happening there? Why did I have to die? Did I ever really mean anything or was it just for show?” “Of course it’s meant something. Ever since I’ve known you it’s always meant something. Again I don’t remember doing it so I can’t tell you why your memories feel the way you do. Or that you’re not some sort of apparition of guilt around the whole thing.” He has no real guilt around it, maybe he didn’t do it? Seems truthful about not knowing, though he is hiding something “So you don’t know. But you aren’t being fully honest with me.” “I am being as honest as I can.” “As in you would like to say more, but you’re not capable of it?” “Can’t say that.” Elaborate “I’m afraid that question is a dangerous one.” “Now that my funeral parlor friends have brought me here on this journey, IDK what to do. I thought I’d have a divine revelation of the nature of my death, but if you don’t remember… or you can’t tell me.. Then I suppose I have traveled all this way to do nothing but scare you.” “That’s all you have managed to do. Scare me. That’s all you’ve ever done.” This isn’t the man Phil’s supposed to talk to, this isn’t him. Security is oddly lax for a would-be king. “I am Lord Esme.” How can I talk to the actual king? “Through me.” Its likely he’s under a Geas “I will come here tomorrow at sunset. I just think that’s something you will know.” “Unfortunately I will be here tomorrow. I have been here at every sunset with you for the last 35 years.” “Hm. Perhaps I will be somewhere else. Is the city a good place to be?”
“Have you heard of- they’re still trying to figure out a new name, but it used to be called Advesperascit.” “It does sound like a great city.” “I wouldn’t worry too much about it, whatever you look for there is bound to leave before you get there.” We can have guest rooms in the keep as long as we can learn to behave ourselves “It is a pleasure talking to you. He feels like meeting you again for the first time.” “Let me know if there’s anything you need to tell me. I’ll be around. Thank you for doing this all these years.” “I do it for the ones I love.” “That’s a great reason to do things. Let me know if I can be of assistance while I’m in here.” She does death rights on her own corpse then leave Explain the situation, we’re free to do as we wish under Lord Esme’s command (stay in the keep and not break laws)
Even if the rune’s not here, notes or hints where it’s been transferred to, are.

sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.title: Session 12
sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.description:
Prev Session: Session 11
Next Session: Session 13
Flamhaltn Make our way to the actual castle Have had vampires here in the past All of Phil’s things are in a public museum, or in a Homes Villa (a day’s travel by cart away) Be careful, wait a week A king regent is powerful, but must still follow the forces that be As a body double, he’s allowed to be seen visiting the grave He’s allowed to do anything that make him seem like Esme.
“The young doctor Domocle Feucreux would need to see you at some point?” Medical prodigy, 16, notably a procedure in inspecting anyone of questionable health. Checking blood Checking for reaction from nearby plant life Garden Nation Breadbasket nations of the world, all nobility except for exceptional ones, own large farmsteads Faux pas to kill plants Waking up the doctor Oops its 11pm, sorry young teenager Asks Phil if she believes she’s the real Phil Have gotten another Phil, before his time (20 years ago)
Sussurro (ghost of culture) Let’s not worry about what happened to her in the end Normal checkup stuff, very by the books, including stuff you could probably not do Some not standard with Phil, a lot have to do with cultural ghosts take on aspects of who they have Getting raw details (how tall, extreme medical detail) Unlikely that he has answers to such a test, however there is a kind of… intense chill behind his eyes Rosalind doing a will save? He begins drifting out, kind of disassociating Do check on the rest Rosalind limp, babbling incoherently Phil tries to cast Status, but the doctor blocks it The doctor is possessed Tries to buy Rosalind for 10kgp - Rosalind loosely aware of occurrences Dasa fails but plants like him “Enjoy the city, buy unfortunately I might have to check-ups on you should I see you again.” Walking away, Rosalind wakes up fully lucid
Texting Auntie Miko “Hey do you know what something someone is possessed by” Catty response, basically no, why don’t you use my gifts i give you, i’m busy Different kind of possessions Temporary (like ghosts, catch and release. Parasitic type, it drains life force) Symbiotic (2 souls in a host, a la Yurei) Extremely variable; consent/honor/limitations of the spirit/etc Permanent (sometimes someone sells the soul, sometimes something latches on like a ghost possessing but the soul dies) Whatever was in the person is basically dead 7 rooms Some are not prepared, like Morven’s where they don’t have a tall enough bed but that’s w/e Central area allowed in Hallway yes, but offshoots no Library yes Mosaic spread of Phil reading to children (recently installed) A woman pacing back and forth Looks at Phil, asks if she’s another ghost she made Accidentally makes a ghost every 5ish years They usually lament about love They’re usually sad Phil is oddly happy for someone who is dead To Yurei: You remind me of this one cunt who stole my apprentice and ran off A kitsune stole her apprentice If you’re real, your husband is about to show you as much love as he did in life. Yurei’s dad wanted to join the spreading art movement Tells us about the Paint Brush Incident (we regret it) She had a crush on Phil 45 years ago
She mostly makes art and is a priestess to Naderi She used to come around the villa as a smalltime acolyte at the time (trained to scry but also capture love in its artform) Was a painter at Phil’s wedding Phil died at 26 Says a Mirnovian Assassin got Phil
Now known as The Undetermined “All reports says it was an Undetermined assassin that your husband slayed.”
Her name is Félicité Vermeil She would know where the king is The agents of Phil’s assassins still reside in the city, if we meet and find anything about them, she’d be willing to pay for info about it
They are poor and worship a figure called Henry Wachter “I would avoid the man inspired by your death. He’s ungodly strong.”
Maîtreé Charbonne King’s personal guard, guards the castle Wrap it up this evening, leave by morning She tells us don’t waste time here, we have a night, and if you don’t get it done tonight, come back later We go to the tavern Rosalind feels a longing to the castle before being dragged away (His body is probably the teenage doctor being possessed lol) Bartender points out we’re coming back late
Barkeep has a masquerade scarf, orc Phil met before Abgast “I believe that they will turn you into diamonds. They exorcize your spirit, and turn you into a diamond where your memory can be touched and looked at.” They have dozens of them “The gods are dead and…. [considers smth, but doesn’t say smth] they’re dead!” “[Naderi] has a borrowed power based on our understanding of love.” Phil has appeared many times Gives Phil a 700 page communist manifesto about infromaterialism
They aren’t going by Undetermined anymore, but those in charge would love to hear recollections that Phil has Asks Phil and Yurei to leave bc phil in the past tried to kill everyone in the bar and Yurei is a capitalist “This Philomene is much more lovely than the last. I believe she died by an assassin at her husband’s hand so she could be a martyr for him and let him request forces from the old king. It would be foolish to not reinforce the king who was threatened with assassination. Marrying a commoner also showed he was ‘of the people’ during the revolution. Of the noble families he was one of 3 that survived” “That’s my theory, but I learned it from the best.” “I recommend that we all make our own conclusions of the world and meet from an understanding there.” All perspectives are valid, all are shaped by reality, and if we join our thoughts together, we can shape reality He walks with Phil away from people to explain Prays to whatever god is hidden in his hands with a prayer symbol
Shelyn Prayer to love, rather than art “Your husband killed you many years ago and framed the Undetermined assassin.” “Would you be so kind as to… could you imbibe a poison for me?” WHAT??? What kind?
“One that is… less than amicable for mortals, but for you undead, addictive. Dreamlike serum from my god’s wife.” Uhh. Sure, but why? “My god’s wife has been gaining in power recently, and I’ve been finding ways to use this to my advantage. I can look into a dream or memory you have and see if it’s true.” Inframaterialism: thoughts affect matter as much as matter affects thoughts. Zack explained it with a lot of words and then i kinda lost what he was saying Drink the poison 1 hour later “You might be the real one!” Oh yay! I was kinda worrying I was another one. “With your permission, I’d like to investigate the nature of your assassin and figure out who killed you. And clear the name of you as well.” If any of us are spotted helping him, it might be killed They’ll send for us, we give a coupon “May you know you always have a friend in the city of windmills.”
“He’s trying to gain with another monarch, the monarch of Tunseel. He survived at the life of that abomination Avare Brit.” “He’s using it as a bargaining chip to Tunseel.” The wind goes directly to the capital, just like in mondstadt, all of the flags around it point towards it What’s up w/ the body double? “The body double for the past 30 years. The previous one got antsy and threatened to expose something. But then he suddenly got LESS antsy!” This guy was one of the aqueduct guards under Wachter. “I am known to play a planar hand or so.” The lesbian artist has suspicions against the lord, and if they are true, her crush on Phil over the years has been for good The head guard Slew the “assassin” and believes him to be a hero, and is a hero in the eyes of the city
He’s almost as strong as that one they call Karn Karn slayed an angel
“I saw him deconstruct Advesperascit and I had to move away.” The teenage doctor He’s possessed and trying to steal our doll 🙁 “He was once a sickly child, and now hes a medical doctor looking to cure all.” Rosalind: i had a strange experience with him “They rose in power due to their son’s medical expertise.” A decorporealized spirit tries to return to its original body when its in proximity to it. “He was miraculously cured of his condition. He was bedridden for most of his life before this.” Rosalind: Ummm. I don’t think he was cured. Or at least, I don’t think I was cured. “Have you considered you’re a cultural ghost?”
“They’ve been riding on the coattails of the d'Esme Family for the past 3ish years.” Have provided excellent service through their “cured” child Rosalind has only been Rosalind for a year

sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.title: Session 13
sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.description:
Prev Session: Session 12
Next Session: Session 14
Flamhaltn
Viktor goes back to the castle to deliver a note + talk to Félicité Vermeil Ideally if they were to kill him, itd be a small group instead of everyone on the force He runs into a tiefling man wearing royal guard
Maîtreé Charbonne, wants to meet Phil to “learn how to protect his lord” Talking to the lesbian Lets us know the tavern owner here knows someone in the undetermined Its the tithe and tan tavern owner Gives us her signature to give to him, tells us to get the local tavern owners signature to show we’re not just a fan here
Mosaic is Phil with the Ensile crown
Crown is going to show Advesperascit to show that here is still the jewel of the Vespertine
Doctor Domocle Feucreux “I feel quite motivated about [morven]”
Access to classified info bc of Régis Rosaire d'Esmé Cagey about specifics of research? Medicine check against Viktor (Viktor is getting rapidly outpaced; he knows enough proper nouns to overwhelm him)
He suggests meeting at the Marchen Courvant in 2 hours! We’ve passed it; public market built on a bridge. Neutral ground, middle of the city Go to talk to him 2 guards waiting “What was it that you wished to talk about? Was it a renegotiation of the deal?” Of the deal to be bought??? "I would take no such thing as your independence, no more than what you have in this great land.” What would it be then??? “The ability to examine you.” Whats the examination??? “No more invasive than what you’ve done on numerous patients with or without their consent.” “I will make sure he’s under proper anesthetic.” I’m not really interested at the moment? I came to ask questions about your nature and mine. “They’re mostly unrelated, but you’re a medical anomaly close to it (Morven), but it doesn’t seem to be shoddy craftsmanship.” Poppets aren’t unique though?? “You’re not unique in that way, its more the magics that dwell within you. Most poppets are creatures of physical being. Most of their power goes towards animating the body, not projection of the spirit.” Wdym “The sorcerous, I believe it is known, projection onto this world.” This is the first im hearing of this?? “I need to investigate him further.” I would prefer that my questions were answered before any intrusive procedure was performed on me! “I could try but… I feel like we’re running out of time.” Wdym??? “If I were to speak in concise language to convey it in time, you wouldn’t understand.” (The two guards are having labored breaths, breathing in and choking on the fog. Like someone ran a mile type of breathing) “We have time for one or two more questions, depending on what they are. And then the deal.” You’re possessing the body that was once mine. I want to know how this body became yours. “Through my, formerly your, parents’ love.” I don’t believe that! “Believe the truth or not, that’s what happened.” How would my parents’ love put someone else into my body? How would it not put me back? “We’re running short on time. Are you sure you’re satisfied with that as your last question?” Why is it you and not me? “They should have worded the deal better.” Initiative. “I hope next time, you’ll accept the money.” Dimension Doors out. Higher level devils are hard to pin down, as according to their nature. Guards and people are cursed Stage 2. If they go into complete darkness, they will die. It depends on what the mind and soul believe for them. Satyr and guard woman jump and leave while the guards are dying No one seems to have noticed? Go back to the tavern Get his signature, tell the tavern owner about the situation Meet up with him there He checked out the bodies, said that Viktor bit into them (UNTRUE) He believes us that we’re being framed Basically everyone but the artist will sell us out lol Gives us some alcohol (100 proof lol) Heading vaguely north
Viktor reads on Ume from Auntie Miko: “Are you familiar with academic dishonestly?” Yeah? :( “It appears that the little boy you encountered bested you despite me giving you your powers.” GIVE ME THE ABILITY TO TELEPORT AND I’LL GO AFTER HIM! 45 mins later… “I WOULD if your body could take it, but your aptitude for my gifts is not good enough. And I wish not to kill my vessel, so I can’t give it to you.” What do you want?? “There’s 2 places I know where he could have gotten it from. 2 major capitals, one beneath the world and one above the world. Thats where they keep the pieces away from you.” (She speaks an unknown word that doesn’t translate to anything Yurei knows)
Advesperascit!
And then in Old Dwarven: Capital of the Dwarven Empire, the Fallen Kingdom beneath the world, Brazenthrone
Writes a long tirade against dwarven city and advesperacit, warns us of Pharasma who might wander the streets You know the gods are dead right?? “Of course.” But pharasma was walking the streets?
One certain Dayalu made a deal with the priest of Pharasma to take over a church Hold a religious stake in the city Pharasman followers have an extreme hold in Advesperacit
Fathrell
Anmoku Funeral Parlor The sound of someone moving around in the backroom
Red hair- its the other dad! Florence Anmoku “Darling I was afraid I wouldn’t get to see you!” Hi dad its been a minute did you enjoy your trip im sorry it got cut short!
“I brought back a friend to visit. They’re friends’ roommates of my employer, Aace Arubedo!” Catfolk man in heavygarb DAYALU “I understand there’s some maladies affecting you?” NO. WE’RE GOOD.
“My friend in the barn (Johnny Assassin) found some concerning things when he went through?” What did you find???? “Nothing. Apparently.” Okay well if there was something there what would it be “I’ve had friends go through similar things. (Posession)” NOO. The company’s been good! We’re working through it! Florence: “Its okay! I understand. I’ve always had a connection to Undeath. It came from my side of the bloodline.” Yeah but the spirit might be important before she goes away. Dayalu: “SO ITS A HER!” You could see her right? He’s asking more about what Yurei believes than what he sees. What does she look like to you? - Dayalu: “I would let my associate in the barn answer that one.” - (Dayalu sucks at lying so tries to force us to talk to Johnny) - Johnny: “Your patron’s a beautiful lady! Has got all the fixin’s! A couple o’ tails, a gorgeous broad, some ears.
- Florence has probably met everyone involved with the Advesperacit incident at least once (except Yuki Seppänen and Karn). Sooo dad you know about the other murder we got framed for right? “The one down south? Yeah, it happens once in a while, you have a decade to cool off.” Have you been murdering people?? “Nothing i’ve been convicted of!” Okay so lets say we got framed for a second murder. Is that good? Is that ok? “How framed?” We got ambushed by some guards and bandits and a goat man??? We had to escape so I casted darkness and ran through it, but the people, were conflicted with a dwarf fever who die in complete darkness and they followed us and died. They also put vampire marks on the ones who died to frame us further. “Babes. Is keeping Viktor alive nonnegotiable?” He’s my friend. :( I don’t make many friends. :( I don’t want him to die, but it wasn’t him! “Darling, he… you should leave, somewhere away from here.” Yeah.. We’re going to the dwarven city that collapsed. “I have a friend there who has a tenuous connection through my employer’s polycule members.” Is this a trustworthy individual? “Of course! He’s done far worse than kill a person! However I have 2 requests, and I hate to extort a family member. For 1, a small kiss in case this is our final goodbye, and the truth about what’s in your soul and how it works.”
She goes by Auntie Miko, and she claims to be one of my ancestors from dad’s side. She’s really interested in necromancy, and also wants me to go find some things for her? “That’s not enough. If you could be so kind, but when you find it, could you tell me of it? I promise not to expel her from you, but I want to know some things from whatever it is.” Yeah! SHe’s not very explanatory on who she is. “Your dad’s side of the family is a bit lost right now. I’m sure you understand.” Have we seen any relatives lately? How are they?
“They’re lost. They’re from Owariyaru, right?”
(Records were burned from the capital archives by Aace Assassin, Anemone Veremund, Merris Hasalk, and Onarach Agus Fìor.) Huh. Well IDK where to go with that. I’m pretty sure she’s telling the truth about being from our family, she doesn’t seem like the type to lie too much for fun. But if the records are gone… do we have anything from the clan? “Not a lot. But whatever you find, I’ll take it darling.” Hugs. “I’m sorry for cursing you with this.” (It might be Yurei’s half connection to death that allowed her to manisfest) She’s pretty fun company! If you read her book reviews they’re pretty good! She knows what I know at least! It’s been like 3 years. “3 years? Before we handed you the business?”
I went through the attic and I found some prayer beads, they seem to have activated her? She’s obsessed with runes also, and absorbed one. “I’ll ask my love what I can.” (Gives Yurei a signed receipt to everything in the Arubedo name) (Given access to Aace Assassin’s fortune for a cause, put in a purchase order, has to be low enough that it can be passed off) Dasa understands, it would go under Florence’s name, so he would be able to know an follow up on.
We’re going to Brazenthrone

sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.title: Session 14
sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.description:
Prev Session: Session 13
Next Session: Session 15
Long trek to Brazenthrone
Sailing, stopping only for a night at Advesperascit before continuing onto Ulnox and to Brazenthrone Brazenthrone 2 glowing statues with ballistas pointed at the road Large wrought iron gate We get a protective guard (important enough to have an escort) More guards lining the room, leading us to the royal palace More statues
Cremmel Korunda
Gommel Korunda (King of Brazenthrone) We’re led to the throne room We should bow when we enter You bow for 10 secs Don’t lunge at the king. This area’s probably full of detect magic Address a royal as your majesty to start. After that, you only need to do it unless you’re asking for something You can have a weapon, but don’t pull it out Whole palace seems recent, even by human standards
Symbol belongs to a half-giant hero of Grundiir, far before Kholeran’s time. Kind of a lost symbol since then until recently added. Meet the king
“You’re here to represent Aace Arubedo?” Not to represent, but on their patronage to investigate magical occurrences. “What nature?” Mostly undead, but general… mostly a situation of not knowing until we find it. “I’m afraid I can’t grant full investigative privileges to the city on a whim.” Would we be able to request further permissions should we need them? “Of course. If you wouldn’t mind, I have a message for your patron as well for when you leave the city.” Of course! We can’t get the message until we leave.
“Aace couldn’t wait until the Aeguntil report? As magical scholars you surely know it.” (we have no idea) Ummm yeah of course! It’s also a matter of study for us under our patron. “I could connect you with the Proudhammer estate if you need. It might help to work under a master such as that.” (Proudhammer is the master smiths of the city) “He’s surely awake at this time, he only needs 2 hours of sleep. A dwarf can sustain themselves for 8 hours of sleep a week.” (Technically true! But only if they don’t have magic. Trading out magic for better physical performance.) Offers to get Kholeran her rites since she’s. Very dead Maybe she’ll search for any remaining family members? “We could have a chronicler look at it, if you want?” She’d appreciate that! “Note that a lot of our old records were kept in the previous palace are now inaccessible at the moment.” Is what happened to it known? “Its just antithetical to life right now. Part of the fall of Grundir happened here.” Oh. Right. “You could certainly… if you prove yourself, we could see you getting access to the city to get access to those records.” If we can earn a chance to enter the sealed portion, there might be records that Kholeran might want.
“Now, I’m sure you’re all smart people and wise. I would also advise you, we have recently given the Haukengale Clan hall to the Tunseel forces who have also come to investigate. If you want, you can always try to compare research notes with them.” Um. I don’t believe the Tunseelian party would like to compare notes with us given what I’ve heard about Tunseel since Kholeran woke up. “If you’re under Lord Arubedo’s will, I’m sure they won’t harm you.” What do you mean the part of the city is antithetical to life? Is it metaphor, or is it perhaps where our unique talents might help us? “Possibly could. Unfortunately, a small fracture- we haven’t had chance to study it yet. We sealed it off for our people’s safety. We know they were drained of life and rose again, and it originated from the center of the palace. There were messages scrawled on the wall.” Oh yeah. That sounds a lot like the phenomenon we’re researching, so we’re going to work hard to earn your trust. “Proudhammer has a connection to you. It might be amicable to someone like you.” He asks if we’re citizens of Ulnox “Wonderful. I think you might be perfect for the job.”
Going to Kelda Proudhammer Private rooms, that also serves as a bath area alongside a workshop “So you’re the undead folk?” Yeah “And why have you come to the city?” We’re here investigating magical phenomenon, under Aace Arubedo’s patronage “Looking to get into necromancy?” No it’s more like funding our passion project like natural undeath All our points get countered “And your patron… how did you get Aace’s slip exactly?” One of Aace’s employees decided to invest in our research (Looks at Yurei and Viktor) Thinks Viktor and Yurei are vampirically related “It’d be a shame if the good Lord Aace were to hear about that.” Threatening to tell Aace We scratch his back, he scratches ours
“I’m going to send you to something a bit more dangerous of a situation. Are you aware of a Blackloch?” Underground freshwater lake the size of an underground ocean connected to Grundir. Also a spot of war for the underground empire, independent city but works closely with Brazenthrone.
“It appears the underground empire has encountered a phenomenon similar to what has affected our capital but has somehow managed to contain it. We fear that if their demands aren’t met, they’ll unleash it upon Deepspire and later, Brazenthrone. The problem is, is that if we send forces down there, they’ll be shot and they’ll be war. But if someone came down here with false pretenses, [Brazenthrone would take the blame for a murder there].”
“You should bring a light, be prepared for the Warp. The Emergent Empire controls a non-insignificant part of Grundir. They seek the restoration of old ways. Less of [everyone but Kholeran] kind down here.” Dwarven cities are for the dwarven people Slaves/indentured servants “I can arrange for a boat in 4 days.” Waterbreathing spell is important
“If you’re here for the actual academics, there is an old university that have sunken underneath the waves of the Blackloch. It was created as a home for some people of Owariyaru, but right now it belongs to the Aboleth.” Benthic University “I wouldn’t check it out if I were you. But I don’t know how many lives you have left.” We get items
“You’ll be meeting up with a fellow by the name of Koltho. She’s a colorful character, likely to shoot if you surprise her.” “The sooner you go down there, the less expected you’ll be.” 15 hours of staircase
Ends at Delver’s Rest Small case, only about 200 meters x 100 meters Heavy guard presence, small inn that we can rest at
Attached in the Pits of Justice Dwarven prison system where they dig a big hole for you to stay in until your sentence is up. People are curious about us bc other than vampires, uncommonly expected Trading post, that connects to the river that contains the Blackloch All you have to worry about here is the Veiled Master Creature that believes it should be worshipped “Be careful with the lights” “I would advise you to situate yourself along the deep spire”
Passage on The Grinning Widow is mostly boring except for small parts Navigation is what she would call rain (lakes and such from the surface dumping into the Blackloch) Boring enough that if you spend enough time, you’ll lose your mind a bit Eventually, we come across what appears to be jagged rocks. Shines a light to let her slowly navigate. Beautiful large column emerges where stalagmite and stalactite meet “You all have fun, let me know if you need anything, but don’t need anything for a day or two.” Orcish and drow, some others sprinkled in. From the outside doesn’t appear lit, but it is on the inside. Approach the tavern Trying to find information about magical phenomena regarding undeath “You might be looking for one of the sigils they put on the Great Crypt.” “The bad news is, it was held in Grundir and being brave enough to explore that area is atonement to the death sentence. They legally pronounce you dead, and if you come back, you’ve served your death sentence.” “The other bad part is Grundir is under the Warp still. The warping shadows. The hallways never stay the same, and by the time you try to come back, there might not be an exit. The way is a bit unclear.” “The good news is that, of the various places, the Crypt is the most documented.” How to get info that is most recorded? “The wizards up top would have record of it for sure.” (If we want more info, we have to pay him more) Gathering info Easiest way to get the thing, just go to the other city. They do hate anyone that is not drow or dwarf, but if you ignore it its fine If you try to avoid the city, you can follow travellers that have access to passages that only work once but work
There has been a vampire much like Viktor, Vlaundet Thaine, asking questions, the dockmaster also knows Allegedly very friendly though
Getting into the guild is hard. A gnomish man is researching lichdom, Eleanderel, and is most of the way there. Just trying to find someone to sacrifice. Trying to get close to someone who is close to death (on death row?) Allegedly, there is a lich he’s been talking to that looks very close to Dasa
Eldara Ferncla tends to just walk into the water and move around that way Might be the lich who set the traps in the previous cave Wannabe-lich knows how to contact them Tavern keeper could get us in contact with someone abt the Crypts in 2 weeks Can tell us info now, but might not be accurate
“There was a gogateth, but Lord Korunda started clearing it out, and while its a small force, they’ve been effective. While people down here may be cautious, there is a church to Torag and his ilk along the path that was recently cleared out. Assuming you don’t mind the lesser crawlies, it would lead you directly into the back gates if you knew the direction already. I happened to hear from one of the drunken guards, along the Chorunese(?) river there’s temple, that they pretend isn’t there.” (Also Illusory Rocks) We heard something of a newly formed empire that solved the original undead crisis, do you happen to know anything about it? “Newly organized, but not new. Part of us disagreed with slavery, but those families had the backing of surface government. When you have the backing of a surface government, you are bound to win. We don’t know who was sending resources, but they had bottles of sunlight that blinded us.”
“The rune that they have can only be outside of the Warp for a time. They don’t have full control over it. We tried to destroy things, but they started to reform.” OTHER CITY. ONE WILL SHOOT US IF WE GET THERE, THEY ARE SUGGESTING POTENTIAL BACK TUNNELS “I think they were using that preservation power so that the crypts weren’t making swaths of undead in the fall of Grundir.”
Other city’s name is Vlyn'Darastyl
Find the Deep Spire Dockmaster Vampire (asking similar questions to Viktor + powerful undead tend to know about each other) We have to wait for the captain to recover before going to vampire time Sniff around for the wannabe lich because he is here in this city right now

Deepspire, Blackloch Go to mage guild One of the dark elves asks if they can help up We fumble that Necromancer comes to get us
Eleanderel Gnome man
“Why has Lord Aace Arubedo commissioned [undead research]?” It’s our research topic
He’s really into Yuanshen Collision, asking if we’re researching for the Sighar expansion We lie and hint that yes we are We are going to actually take this info to Aace tho Gives us a letter with long dashes and short dashes, tells us to use a lantern along the southern reaches “Fair warning, the space she chooses to wander is quite large.” “Some creatures do tend to swarm ships that show light like that.” The Dangerous Globster Ooze-like lobster, attack in small swarms, near the shallows Elementals sometimes, like living waterfalls Gogateth Bring a gift to her, she likes things from the surface He sells scrolls (30% upcharge) “It’s best to keep it between the undead and soon to be undead.” We travel for a day to get to the vampire See a large ziggurat poking out of the water (only 4 stories remain)
Cull'Thaine Estate built into the wall A few odd zombies line the way to protect the vampire Some Creature (Totomask) gets the door, asks about us, asks Viktor and Yurei their sires Like body horror stuff Gellifies flesh and drinks it Can rearrange others’ flesh We tell him we’re here under an artist, he Immediately is like lol Let me check with Aace and we’re like EH He doesnt check bc rosalind is so sweety
His name is Vlaundet Thaine He’s definitely a vampire, but his face is recently changed Questions we ask him: ask abt viktor sire ask about crypt ask about why hes asking questions are there commonalities btwn viktor, this guy, sire, etc? the vampire network? 5 degrees of vampire kevin bacon general "hey whats up with the undead here" The lich!! We have vague info about where to go and what to do to contact her, but do you have more specific information? Or can provide more insight into what we should and shouldn’t do? general "is there anything regarding the degradation/reversal of degradation of buildings and people and shit" if yes: where? of what nature? do you know of any people/groups involved? whats the deal with this other city anywhere for us to check out? (cool tourist spots?) whats with the ziggurat? why r u down here, human vampire? (ask about his little fleshcrafter friend. is that rude?)
Viktor’s Sire, Dione Viktor goes with his poor little meow meow approach of idk my sire im so sad. In a wet cardboard box outside No experience, asking about protocols
“The dandy?” (about Florence Anmoku.) you just need to know how to turn it off </3 “As for your sire, how much affection do you have for her?” “Not much. She abandoned me.”
“Say you don’t know your sire when meeting another vampire. I’m feeling kind so I won’t kill you. Your dear sire is working with the government of Tunseel” “Why do you say that? This is the first time we’re hearing of it?” “She tried to kill me” “Huh that’s so weird, why would she make me” “She may not know you exist. Vampires can create childer on accident. Where are you from? Border of Tunseel?” “From south central Tunseel. Had to travel a long distance to escape death.” “No idea what she’s up to.” “Lots of dhampirs being created without vampiric parents. Any idea? Is she connected?” “If she had blood even older than myself, there’s a theory you can inject it to directly create a dhampir.” “Are there many vampires older than you?” “Not many that are still around. Has about a few thousand years of memories” General Undead Info Will form new memories that feel like dreams, won’t know which we imagined and which were real. They’ll become indistinguishable Recommend keeping a flower garden in the early years. Gives practice with seeing things bloom and wither Morven will have a mortal lifespan without upkeep from yurei Kholeran might have no goals and is just making excuses to keep eating people
He’s gonna look at Auntie Miko in Yurei’s soul Oh he’s biting Yurei on the neck Spits out a bunch of her blood into a goblet and says “you certainly taste like your father” He looks into the goblet and just said “what an interesting spirit. Shrine maiden for the undead” “Anmoku?” yeah ଽ]:3 “Fascinating.”
The Lich, Eldara Ferncla We need a gift for her We don’t have shit but he buys a ring off of us for 10x the value He wants us to keep him informed, so he gives us a slate of distant letters We hide viktor she hates Tunseelians If he doesn’t talk we’ll be ok hopefully What she likes is hard to come by We can offer a living Tunseelian soul to her tho if we have one Any other older undead? “Quite a few, but you have 2 of the best. Why would you need anyone else? The others tend to be sleeping.” We heard there was an aboleth here. Any other areas with similar scary monsters to avoid?
“The Smoldering Abyss. They tend to gather there and Glugdorf. The Garden of Eyes as well, it’s right above the Warp. It’s a small garden of eyes where aboleths like to be. It’s a manifestation of the dwarven warp. It’ll try to hypnotize you and eat you whole.” This area is mostly dwarven, dark elf, and orcish. Is there a reason you’re here besides the lack of sun? “Look up at the beautiful stars above.” Galaxy shimmers, very pretty. Also, notably a deflection.
Ask about the runes “Its what the spirit wants, right?” Yes and also Tunseelians who are here want it
“Recently (it feels recent, don’t ask how recent), Andrastil has come across such thing. But moving there would be suicide. Thankfully they keep it in the crypts by the Warp. The problem with the crypts is that they’re full of negative energies.”
Gives us a location of the Grundiir Crypt Into the wall, into the river, and then out “Before you go, I recommend meeting with the lich. And when you go in, send me a message with the slate.” By the time we hit the city, it would be about the time he could sail to the city and do whatever he needs while we’re there. “I mean no offense, the rune itself is not unguarded, but most are out front. Me and my companion get to go in, and I get what I’m looking for in the archives. (So Lying) They stole my diary while I was sleeping. The way I figure, while you’re distracting, they’ll go to you until they see the vampire and lich in their midst.” Ziggurat Ziggurat belonged the Coatooa Also has an Aboleth We go talk to the lich

sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.title: Session 16
sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.description:
Prev Session: Session 15
Next Session: Session 17
Blackloch Lighting the lantern Sounds of things clambering on the side of the ship Combat Aboleth shows up Tries to control us, we go aaaaah “It’ll be fine, just give me one. Of you.” “Do I need a purpose for fine things?” Collecting sentient undead because none of us should exist, “none of you reside within any order”.
We try to quickly get Eldara Ferncla to show up again Morven can now breathe underwater, but now must be within water Aboleth, curiously, leaves A skeleton in armor crawling up the side of the ship Accidentally speaks as Viktor, she asks how old Viktor is and who his sire is
Lie and say Florence Anmoku “You seem like his type”
“He’s calling himself Vlaundet Thaine now?” “That’s fine. He can call himself whatever.” We try to upsell our gifts to her, she’s not pleased “Hold on until we meet again. I’ll demand something more.” How’d you become a lich? “Through the sacrifice of a soul of someone I loved deeply.” Why down here? “People I hate are down here, and we’re far from prying eyes?”
The Vlyn'Darastyl or the Tunseelians? “Just the Tunseelians.”
Are you the one who set the necromantic runes in the water? (Mine between Tunseel and Ensile) “Yes and no. I didn’t make the charges, but I did set them.” Oh! Why there?
“I was hoping that the person who would go there would set them off. At the very least I could kill that lustful mayor and ilk with them. I hope that when he does whatever he does, it’ll rattle the bones of those settled there and they won’t get to rest.” Any reason why this mayor? “No, just because he’s Tunseelian.” Is there any reason you hate Tunseel despite the undead hunting?
“Solvandor was its name before it was conquered, laid upon, and its people killed, before the Vespertine Empire.” “It was always Tunseel, but it was a province before.” “Even those born within Tunseel take the sins of their priors. Even those that move there usually deserve it.” What sort of sins? How were they different? “Conquest, genocide, pillaging. At one point they had right of ownership in war. If you conquered a town, everything in it was considered yours.” You were living there that time? “I was. Before I became like this.” She asks Phil what she seeks vengeance on Ask if she knows anything about the Aboleth “I killed one and they hate me and now they want you. Sorry.” We clarify what the aboleth meant by us not being a part of any order Like the natural order, the outsider order, the order of leshy, etc Undead fall outside that order We can refer to her as Ildara How did you come about knowing Mr Thaine? “He wishes to kill Tunseelians. I wish to kill Tunseelians. He’s a bit more selective than me.” How so?
“He wishes to kill Dione and those who work for her?” Why is he down here? “He was betrayed by Dione. He needed a place to escape.” What was the betrayal? “He planned to betray his sire and asked his childer to help. She betrayed him.” (This isn’t a setup, but a lot of the questions Thaine asked us determined whether or not Viktor was gonna be killed) Not fully unselfish, but he gets to use his childer against her and get some satisfaction against her Why are you here? “People I want to kill are down here. Them attempting to back slavers doesn’t sit right by me.” If you kill the ones down here, will you go back to the mainland? “Of course. I plan to kill myself and go back to the mainland.”
Asking about the Grundiir Crypt (what’s in there, specific paths) Don’t know what’ll be found down there. Hasn’t done it herself. Knowing the ones here that went through, they started using the crypts for their own dead at some point. Go towards more elven skeletons and it should be the right direction Asking about the Tunseelians “Do you know who they are, or just that they’re Tunseelians?” (lot of names) 2 sentinels, 2 paladins, 1 artificer. All royal, detached unit acting independently Tunseel won’t have repercussions because they weren’t given orders
Lythrea and Commander Pheylor Tenthall Strong enough that they can take on a nation
Runesmith is Elethera Vainwin, most likely we run into
Interested in rune’s ability to destroy undead “My understanding is that she’s mostly a heretic hunter here to stop some shrine maiden from appearing. She’s quite good with a hammer, too, be warned.” Do you know anything more about the rune? We’ve heard rumors, but you may have heard or seen it for yourself. “My understanding is that it allows things to be remade, but I haven’t studied anything of it. They are both before my time and now.”
“They stopped existing for a while and then came back when the Divine Gate opened.”
“My suspicion is that the maiden messed with death and may have been bound to Pharasma for some reason. Now that she’s gone, the maiden returns.”
How’d you know they’re trying to stop a shrine maiden coming back? “I happened to find a boat of them and crawled up and tortured them until they started talking.” What shrine maiden? “The recruit didn’t seem to know. Bless his soul.” Would the runesmith know a lot? Probably, would probably tell her enough to properly look it over What are the Tunseelians doing to assist? “Supplying forces and intelligence. The fact that they know how to use the rune means they can rebuild infrastructure and access Dwarven tech thought long gone. Along the wall sits 15 ballistas that can pierce 2 miles away.” What’s up w the betrayal? “He was planning on betraying his sire and his childer betrayed him.”

Blackloch
Drop off Ildara, Grundiir Crypt Crypt stuff Pool Odd worms in the pool, chewing on things that grow out of it Hex Worm Any spells cast make them go aggressive Any magic item on the corporeal world A few are living in the puddly mass Some roots from trees transforming into worms when they touch the black void Unknown tree type Large tree that is missing above the roots and the roots have decided to keep living Extreme light akin to sunlight down here, more likely its a manifestation of the Warp down here 2 paths Catacombs (structured) At one point what was a mine but collapsed inward, creating a rocky crevasse (unstructured) We go catacombs Aren’t what we’d expect from entering a mausoleum structure Stays narrow until it opens up Opens into a courtyard looking area, complete with its own sources of unnatural light that flutter through See a camp of people that have made their stay near the crypt
Mostly dwarves, nothing Tunseel. Rather, Brazenthrone-make They wave at us, becken us over, ask if we speak, where we’re from
Mage comes out after saying we’re from Ensile They’re all serving sentences, one is doing research Trying to gather old history
We lie, talking about Yuanshen Collision They warn us about the Rose Courtyard Its forming and destroying undead They are merging together (hand of the father attached to the mother)
Its acting so weird because the rune was here, but it was removed. They’ve been here for 3 months, and it wasn’t like this 7 years ago A few people have been here, “No one you should be too concerned about, and no one who would bring harm upon me”. Undead hunters
“Check Grimvir’s tomb, its southeast from here.”
Do you happen to know anything abt the fall of old Grundiir/that section of Brazenthrone that had to be sealed off? “Mostly an earthquake.” Did they bury their dead? Would the earthquake been messing up their dead? Unrelated to the dead, we will have to come back when Kholeran is here Find a drop point Ladder down Old dwarven engravings, talking about the family history of this tomb Unusual Stonework Hearing water dropping occasionally, not much else Hasn’t been opened for >50 years Kholeran sees unusual stonework, revealing a 2nd entrance Green crystal - GREEN BAD Anti-undead crystal, warding off undead Disabled for 24 hours Soft singing from beyond 3 doors, past a body preparation room
Seeing Auntie Miko, currently sleeping in Yurei’s shadows 2 tails Full plate armor with lifting belt
Angels of Pharasma are here Fight them Undead hunters, reasonably good If you wanted to post guards somewhere who would die for a cause and could stay for decades at a time, they’re pretty good Desicrated skeleton that wraps around itself Other door has 2 angels, one singing Choral angel Dangerous Monastic Daeva EXTREMELY DANGEROUS “Why have you come?” Passing through to the nearby city, we want an item that is important to us “What is it?” A kind of rune taken to the city. They were made by one of our friend’s ancestors “You can go, as long as you don’t touch any graves.” NOT OUR INTENTION PROMMY. “We can help your two friends who are possessed?” Nnnooo thank you “Once I have finished looking for god, wherever she has gone, I can help you release your soul to a vessel that is not undead.” Who’s to say once you have found your god, maybe?
“Name is Ziphren. I work for lady Pharasma. There are many dead down here.” Why are you searching for her physically? “She was dead beyond the gate, but that was expected. By the time the gate closed, her body was stolen, alongside the other gods. If someone were to steal it, it would be.” “I search where the dead are. Where the dead are, Pharasma might be.” “We don’t know how the tower distributes souls anymore. One did know, a solar of Pharasma, but upon receiving the info, he went mad. He disappeared 6 years ago.”
Vridessa Most gods have 1 solar, greater gods have 2 “A god can fit on the head of a pin, if need be.” There’s a strange phenomena caused by the item we’re looking for Choral angel still singing Eulogy to Pharasma, working in the dwarves Seemingly wrapping us into the story Choral angel wants to kill us, the Daeva doesn’t want to see violence in front of it “If you do find her, please let us know. If we were able to commune to her body, we could arrange to have you brought back to life.” “[Philomene] was killed before your time. We were unable to stop it.” Uhhh. Wdym. I thought that dying was your time whatever it was “Sometimes you’re dead before your time, and you still have life flowing out of you. The norns are still spinning their threads for you, but you aren’t there, so it recreates you.” Can see how Phil died, probably everyone else. Dagger in her chest I have a ring on my finger I cannot see, wtf does that mean??? “You no longer see yourself married, but everyone else does.” How to kill a devil posessing a body: Knock out the body Remove the spirit possessing it Kill the spirit “So you found the revovian(sp) devil?” Specialist devil, specializes in a human trade. Offers its services in exchange for pacts. ‘We need a healer for my child who is sick’ = body getting possessed, kicking child out of body “I could come back with the terms of the pact.” “I can tell how you each died.” Yurei = hasn’t died (shocker) and they could tell about Auntie but it would require expelling her Phil = stabbed thru the chest Rosalind = strangled in a hospital bed Very likely they brought in a surgical bed. The doctor, during surgery, strangled Rosalind to death. Viktor = assaulted by a woman heavily injured. She attempted to stop, but couldn’t. Dasa = ALSO DIDN’T DIE??? Dead but didn’t die “The only way I can tell a lich is a lich is if they die when they drink the poison [part of the ritual].” ASEXUAL SKELETONS!?!?!?!? Not exactly, but smth there
Morven = latest of the 20 to die was the dwarf woman (Úna MacSuibhne) - “Do you know of a multi-eyed creature that saw over your death? It is there. It has about 5, it seems. Hoofed feet, clawed arms (3 of them), carried the body over. Was invisible during it.”
- Shino Hakusa???? - Was roughly 3 years ago
- “I have a colleague who created 5 eyed creatures and pitted them against kings. His name was Avare Brit of Advesperascit. They’re known as Wachter kin.” Kholeran = ghoul fevor slowly overtaking Way we want to go is in the direction of the stairs

Very large animal, roughly the size of a bear Cave bears around here, but this sounds more like a boar Trees, glowing blue, no boar to be see Various drow dead bodies positioned around Something living down there Throw a rock Woman who makes us stop, asks our name Odd shaped runes on her
Elethera Vainwin the runesmith Rear guard Embedded part of the rune into her, other part is a manifested eidolon symbol Message the vampire “Encountered runesmith with rune we’re looking for, down below city under crypts, starting attack” “Synchronize any attack, bring any reinforcements, I’ll take you all down”
Message Auntie Miko “URGENT IS THERE ANY WAY TO GET RUNE WITHOUT KILLING” “Is the rune near you?” “Embedded in woman nearby” Rune around her neck and face begin strangling her Elethera refers to Viktor by name????
Probably told by Dione Restraining the snake, “what do you need these runes for?” Snake manages to bite, rune disappears We take her head because of the eidolon mark on her Book on her Collection of various trees in the area growing on Original Earth The power of the rune seems to restore it back to a previous state Response from Auntie Content, “I owe you another favor.”
Lume j'Estrilla “Fighting is already under way. Don’t worry. Holding the bulk of it.” Auntie takes over
Message captain that we’re teleporting to Brazenthrone Teleport to Brazenthrone Talking to her, try to convince her to have a drink with us and talk to us She teleports away
We go to Kelda Proudhammer Seems a bit weirded out that we’re here so early
What appears to be from the embassy from Tunseel, paying attention to Viktor, a runner runs to the communicative offices (not where you’re supposed to run, you’re supposed to go to administrative first and then communicative) Show the head “How… unusual, but it will work.”
“Prepare for whatever the capital may bring, prepare to sneak in the city, then prepare to fight when you reach the Grundiir Palace.” Iron golems on a rampage An hour passes, Yurei/Auntie teleports back in strange garb with knicknacks
From old Owariyaru/Northern Ruhhat Level 5
