sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-1.description:
Prev Session: Session 18
Next Session: Session 20
Grundiir Golems are here Dasa turns into a rat bc they ignore pests One is taken apart on a blanket, piece by piece, with nails through it 2nd floor Something the size of a small bear has clawed its way through Tixitog Tries to talk to Dasa in dwarven. Fails Dasa goes back and gets us Tixitog asks why we are here again Have you felt any strange magic here? Motions toward decay around, going unusually fast How long have those golems been there? “By my estimate, they’ve been here for about 800 years, but sources vary.” “They only started rampaging about 2 years ago.” The Decay Did anything cause the decay or? - “From my POV it just started decaying. I was simply working my little shop, and then this happened. I get to be king along with the doppelgangers. In the church.” What about the dead golem? “IDK. I sleep for 10 days at a time. It was not there last time.” Have you seen another golem dismantled? “Destroyed by soldiers, yes. You tie them down and rip the flesh.” They’re spider like, but they also just eat spiders. Grow spiders and picks them off Dead golem Nearby, dead corpses of creatures (like mimics) Probably done by a human, strategically taken apart Missing from the mimics is blood, stabbed multiple times with precision Didn’t even have time to fully detransform Some makings of an a black substance Grabs a mimic, takes it back It was stabbed to death, but only one stab A sword cane was the cause of death Church down south 3 visible doppelgangers Tixitog knows of 7 Saw them half a year ago “You’re going to the haunted palace?” Yes. Why is it haunted? “There’s ghosts there.” What ghosts are there? “The old mage instructor, the archivist, and many of the servants that died that day when the palace fell. There’s also just a general miasma of souls. Elves and kitsune were mixed up in there, IDK how. Maybe they were having a feast with them.” Are they violent? “Extremely so. Almost all, but if they aren’t violent they’ll try throwing something near you. If they are violent, they’ll throw something at you.” Sometimes when you resurrect something, you embue something of yourself in it. Even if you unwillingly resurrect something, it still gets embedded.
Go up to the palace, Grundiir Palace A few oddities Small runes on the sides of the door, etched in recently Grow stonework they’re attached to about 3 inches, basically ensuring the doors they're attached to don’t move We fail to Nothing else really out of ordinary, intended to be restored as a heritage site Go inside Etched into the ground is the symbol of the old Dwarven nation that fell Door up north has pen on paper noise Fist clenched, holding something itched Group that translates to “Forlorn” Group that helped settle the upper regions to the dwarves (top facing surface mountains) Represents leaving the old world behind Area seems surprisingly empty Up north Figure that is notably bald Figure that first made contact with the dwarves There is a spirit that is watching us, noblish. Elven. Slender build, over 6ft tall - Book, with fresh ink, in elven
- Musings about the rune - Phil talks to the ghost and they respond in Elvish - Ask why we’re here? - Searching for the rune “Do you fancy yourself rune hunters?” No just trying to contain them
“A rune in the south lower reaches (Blackloch) disappeared lately, was that your doing?” (Sometimes when you do an investigation, you ask a question you know the answer to to see if the person is lying/what they look like when they lie) It was taken by someone else, we returned it to its original creator “And who would its creator be?”
Our friend’s patron. We don’t know much about her, but she’s working with us for good. “Is the creator the same as the rightful owner?” In this case I believe so. “Under what pretense?” In the pretense its caused harm. In this case, there is someone who wants to keep it safe and went into making it “There’s the one who killed her, there’s the ones who sent it off, there’s the ones who taught her.” Many people died w/o being killed, why do you know that specificially? “Its my job to keep track of such things.” How do you gather such info? Do you know who killed her? “We might. But what’s in it for me?” What do we have to offer for someone of your status? (She has a heavy Tunseelian accent that she is hiding.) ‘My name is Philomene. How about you?’ “A Philomene, or the Philomene?” The Philomene. “The name’s not important. My name is Essie.” (This is the Tunseelian equivalent of Jane Doe.) “It is better for you to not know my name. I would rather your last moments be at peace.” (If we know their name, we might start panicking.) What do you mean last moments? “I can’t let you leave this room. Through no fault of your own, you’re abominations.” Are you not a spirit? “I figured this would be a better form to take with you.” (Removes invisibility. Woman with a sword cane.) “If you tell me where the runes are, I’ll give your bodies to your families.” - Yurei tries to message Auntie “It is my duty to know things on all unnatural undead.” “So she’s manipulated you without telling you?” “There’s not a lot of point in telling you. You’ve allowed yourself to become an abomination. Are you not a necromancer who is hosting the spirit of another necromancer? And young Viktor here was accidentally turned into an undead.”
So what DO you know of my sire?? Dione “Do you know of the Clairvoyce?” An devil who turns to the light and goes to the side of the angels. The devil did so in the hopes he would be reborn as an angel (which he was). What did she do to deserve your pity to allow her to live? “Those I follow trust her. I would consider it a practical role.”
This is Commander Pheylor Tenthall Is there anyway we leave this room without fighting? “You don’t have to fight. You will just be dead. I will be as quick as I can.” Allows us to pre-buff She one shots so many aaaaa
Viktor sending a message to Lume j'Estrilla, halp please papa Yurei writing to Auntie PLEASEEEE WE’RE GETTING BEAT UP We don’t die. We wake up to the sound of waves in a ships hull. Have all our stuff, we’re not in a cage It’s impossible to tell if its day or night, galleon sized. 80ft long and very wide Various stab wounds across the body, including Philomene Feeling about 1hp in this house tonight The wounds are sustained Things feel odd
Judging by opening the door, we are familiar with this design. Sighar design. This is a vampire sailing ship. Sounds of people around, and the smell of salt. On the ocean. Appears that this is our private quarters alongside 1 other room They’re speaking common To them this is an average sailing venture, and don’t know we’re here
It appears they’re chill with us because you can’t really judge people. We’re going to Advesperascit. Message back from Vampire and Aunt Vampire: Arriving shortly Auntie: Asking for clarification before getting cut off, pen scritches Tactical doll It is newly dusk outside Encounters a halfling working the ship “Oh. You’re awake.” I am! IDK what’s going on? Please explain?
“Master Thaine ordered a ship for you to get you to Advesperacit. (briefly disappears for a second) Fathrell seems to be the next stop.” (He was already going to Advesperacit. And then plans on taking us back home.) How long have we been on the journey? “Five days.” Uh. Have we been out for all that time? “In an undead stupor, he said.” (NOT how undead work????) That’s a long time! “Fairly short. Winds have been kind.” Oh yay! I’m glad for our good fortune! “You seem very lucky.” (We are actively VERY wounded.) So you’re an employee to Master Thaine? “A chartered employee.” (This boat doesn’t belong to Thaine, but he has enough money to pay for it.) Oh would he be open to talking with us? “Uh IDK. You don’t happen to be blood cargo are you?” Nooo? (click clack porcelain skin) “Doesn’t mean that there isn’t blood.” WIll you let us know if there’s anything that needs our attention? “Of course. We’re only going to be in Advesperacit for a single night, and we will be leaving w/ or w/o you.” Will Thaine be going as well? “Unsure. We’ll go with or without him as well.” Message Auntie “Hey we just woke up on a boat do you know about that?” “Weren’t you just in a Dwarven city?” Yes. Were you also unconscious? “I was conscious the entire time. You were going into the capital, and that’s the last we heard.” (Doesn’t seem to recall the combat.) What do you remember of the city? “Meeting the king, going up north, going to the Black Loch, I took over your body to generously save you yet again, and I left you to your own devices at the capital.” Do you remember the woman? Pheylor Tenthall? “No. I don’t know who that is outside what most people know.” What do most people know? “A victim of circumstances. Her village was killed by a zombie plague. She rose over the course of 200 years as an undead hunter, and in 600 years, she now works directly under the king.” Yurei drinks the potion of memories A soft memory of a woman trying to bring food to her friend who’s going to death row for her crimes. She walks away, she comes back to the food, it seems odd, but she doesn’t think much. She brings her friend the food. Another kitsune it seems. Her face is longer than Yurei, ears outward vs Yurei’s up. Seems similar to Yurei’s lineage. Very clearly a different person.
Theoretically it would be in a town of Now southern Vozgoa (either belongs to Vosgoa or Ruhhat/Owariyaru) Forensic acumen, cause of death: Poison Some undead can just arise from someone being prepared for it. If you are unaware of your death, it can lower the chances Could come back as a ghost/revenant if you figure out who poisoned you Whoever the person who made this intentionally put it there Message Auntie abt this Oddly quiet

sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-2.title: Session 20
sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 19
Next Session: Session 21
Knock on Lume j'Estrilla’s door He’s somehow looking at his reflection (vamps have no reflection normally) Can be done “As long as you aren’t protected by scrying.”
It would be best that Viktor doesn’t learn magic bc “Florence Anmoku’s kind aren’t very… good at magic. It’s a fine art, not a normal one he is into.” Thaine found us unconscious
“You imagined you fighting Pheylor Tenthall. She doesn’t let undead survive without reason.” He creates a small illusory scene, where we move things around to recreate our death “There was one small issue. The snake itself had been moved about 3ft away from Yurei at the position of their besting.” 5ft away, mouth agape, not closed “The patron can’t do anything with the host unconscious.”
Yurei’s snake still has the runes, “That makes it a bit more complicated.” “There is the possibility she didn’t kill you because she wasn’t sure which one the snake was bound to.” “She’s not the kind to leave survivors.” “She’s much more competent than you. While it is convenient to have someone do the work for you, its also sloppy, and that’s one thing that she is not.” If the host was killed, the runes would be rescattered/sent to the patron If the host was killed, the patron would go into a slumber, so she might gather the runes, kill Yurei, and then collect them from the patron while she sleeps She may feed the snake something in the future to see where things go in the future He wants to go feed
“I’m seeking assistance from Lord Ozlebin."
After this we go to Fathrell Fathrell wasn’t around 400ish years ago
Ummm so we haven’t had much time to talk, but I am Philomene, a name which I know is wildly known now. I’m not the culture ghost, but my ex-husband hired an assassin to stab me to death and that’s not really smth the other culture ghosts normally believe “That’s certainly a new story. What do you believe you husband’s name is?”
Count Régis Rosaire d'Esmé
“He’s in Advesperascit. He’s meeting with the people’s council.” “He won’t take action against you in here unless you cause problems. It would be unwise of him to kill a ghost that is a symbol of his rising empire.”
What is the People’s Council?
“Formed after the killing of kings the revolt of the Undetermined after the opening of the Divine Gate. It’s a push for self determination no longer under its vassal status.” (Advesperacit it technically piecemealed by each nation) “Allegedly he is partially pushing forward his finances toward it if he were to become king. He is a man who took a commoner wife despite being a noble.” “All may enter as long as they brandish no weapons. Tunseel boy (Viktor) info
Avare Brit tried to bring back the age of gods
Morning Dew Sanctuary is now independent and gone to the people and is no longer backed by Tunseel (Tunseelians are peeved) Central church no longer belongs to Tunseel and the like
Sighar did a huge push after they consolidated their money to Theren Ozlebin We go the People’s Council Allowed into public forum People look at Phil We hand our weapons over, get ticket back to get our weapons back Various people are petitioning to local politicians Orcish woman, and other diplomats, including 1 soon to be king of Ensile
He’s with his personal guard Maîtreé Charbonne Scholars make note of Philomene and D’esme poetic phrases Phil politely waves and smiles He appears to cry while looking at her “It’s so good to see you after all these years.” It’s so good to see you as well Regis! “Philomene.” I don’t mean to distract you from the people. “Of course! I need to take care of the people, and the little people.” (It’s easy to see how this was the newfound love because they’re both Beautiful. It’s almost like he took the perfect person to complete His portrait.) The guard smiles at Viktor and Phil Guard (the one that Viktor ran into in the hallway back at the manor) grinning: “I have seen many people, but it’s so strange to crawl out the window.” D’esme gets a scroll, casts a scroll on us all (group telepathy session)
“So it connected. So you’re the real thing. What do you want? Make a scene, and I’ll burn you and the retched Anmoku Funeral Parlor down.” Mostly wanted to see what you were up to “Legal moves right now. Kings have been killed. After 40 years how have you managed to come back?” I was resurrected by god. “No you weren’t. That god never cared about your love.” Then IDK. I have holy powers and I’m devoutly religious “Then you’re still a love obsessed fool.” Well. That’s your opinion. I hear you’re moving up in the world. “I had an unsuccessful assassination against me. Your death has aided me greatly in those troubling times. The nobles loved me for surviving and the commoners loved me for giving my possessions to a commoner’s family before they tragically died in a fire.” Um well i’m hoping to remain housefire free “It would be wise to.” So let me know if there is anything I can do to protect myself from open flame “Give me a simple kiss, then cry.” (Phil does her magic thing, the guard takes the save instead.)
(Gold Master ass situation???) “Cute trick. Unfortunately, your charm has worn off.” I appreciate you crying outside my grave every night, very romantic “It should be written about for another 1000 years after my death. Its a good way for a commoner such as yourself to be remembered.” I suppose. Maybe a library would be cooler, idk. I didn’t know everyone would know who I was and what I look like “Its an easy enough aesthetic to appropriate. And we make a great couple.” Well. You are capable of contacting me if you want to. Let me know before you send any undead hunters. “I know no such thing about them (/ronins)” Really?
“I know the king personally, but I would consider myself no better than the common man. From my understanding, he already knows you all.” Well. Let me know if you’re going to burn down the Funeral Parlor. I’m gonna try to stay out of your way??? It would be really great if you gave us the opportunity to stay out of your way.
“Unfortunately the funeral parlor is part of my new nation. It would be a shame if I had to show some force there, or if something on the outskirts would cause a tragic fire yet again.” “Where did you come back?”
A river around Rivashi “I’ll be sure to visit it in your honor. Maybe I’ll discover the secrets of why you came back. But you’re a ghost still, and you’re here on unfinished business.” I don’t know tbf “If you kill me, your friends would be left without you. I would suggest you kill me last.” TBF ur almost king and IDK if that’s what i’m supposed to be doing. Maybe i’m supposed to make you king “I’m doing better without you than I would with you.” “I have a question, why are you doing this and not helping out those you knew in life? They’re old and it would be comforting to see you.” My memory isn’t very in tact. It’s not very reliable, at least not reliable enough to remember who is/was important to me. “Then I’ll get you a list so you can fuck off and do that instead of messing with me.” Well I hope my death gave you motivation for your story “Don’t try to speak. Go stand in the back. Let everyone know how poor D’esme is affected by his long lost wife.” Would you give us a bit of money to spend and get us off your back (He gives us 100 platinum pieces in a type 1 bag of holding) He throws 1000pp into the crowd (1mil gp) (He’s very rude to Viktor, telling him not to grab any off the floor) “Seeing you has reunited my love of you and the common people.” (lying) “Let me attend to them. My flock.” Let me know if you need your demure and considerate wife for anything, we’ll save you for last
We go to stop by The Neighbors Hear various sounds of sweet music Fairly busy Bards singing
Merris Hasalk and Anemone Veremund Merris haunted by the spirits of 1000 women
With an orcish man with bruised knuckles known as the sculptor comes up to ask what we wants to drink (The Sculptor) Offers if Phil can incorporate some bread its free and he’ll recommend a drink for her “I am somewhat of an expert alchemist and occultist.”
He has blood vines from Auctur that he can get Viktor (+ vodka) Bread tastes hearty, but it’s actually stale bread, she incorporates things how she believes them to be Merris and Anemone are here dubiously “Advesperacit are trying to move away from allowing kings and their consorts into the city (Philomene is exempt)”
(Late will of Henry Wachter)
We sit on the Throne of Want Able to view up the near infinite abyss above the bar
The Divine Gate in its entirety as a small speck, make out the gate, if you could reach it could open, but no answer Merris comes up as we sit asking what we want Begins an expert diatribe, mostly talking at us
Merris resides in a small town known as Foucalt (just like Karn) and everything he describes is very sweet from sugarbeet Anemone gives phil the ability to taste and then a fucked up Yuki drink First taste is a little gingery followed by deep oak and sugar Second is an odd citrus, overall not bad but very alcoholic Phil very drunk, she takes a little nap
Viktor heads to an actual undead bar in Little Sighar (Rattling Bones Tavern) Little things are odd here, vials instead of kegs A small skeleton calls out to Viktor
This is a Bone Croupier, notable enjoys games of chance and secrets (if Viktor was alive they’d steal his soul) Poker for secrets. A win = answers
What’s any notable history between Dione and her childer that’s not well known? What about her grandchilder? Sure
“Recently one of her childer has recently sired a woman named Sabine Keson and she is watching over the area.” Oh “That’s a surprise? I’m changing my bet to ask about that.” When did she discover this grandchilder? “Few weeks ago. Best as I know.” Why was she chosen to be in charge? “She’s from an area of intense interest. Would be good to raise a child/grandchild there.” Why is it intense interest? Can’t say/don’t have the info
Has the grandchilder only been in Tunseel or has she been near here?
“Only in Tunseel in her home town where she was killed by someone she trusted dearly.” And Dione? Has she been here as of late?
“She’s been everywhere. Even up to the Ulnox area.” Ulnox? Why was she in UInox? “My understanding was that she was working with some agents disgraced by Tunseel.” Why would she be working with agents disgraced by Tunseel? “She serves the true king of Tunseel, as I believe they are called. There is the King, and there is the Real King, as they are known.” “Why are you interested?” She is my sire. “That would be your sister, no? The one you were asking about.” ….Yes. He asks for Viktor to tip him on the way out (a small secret).
Go back to Fathrell

sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-2.title: Session 21
sessions/undead-campaign/act-1/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 20
Next Session: Session 22
Fathrell
Viktor asks around about the new king of Tunseel
New king is Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie Notably has recently taken over following the death of his father during the Wachter incident (prince was out at the time) They’re the spitting image of one another All the Tunseelian kings look like one another, all the queens look like one another It is considered a blessed line, if you look like the ruler you’re destined for it. If you don’t, you die before you reach the throne
Currently marrying a woman from Northern Ensile for political stability
Clélie ir'Leclair
Part of the old Sternbore Family (royal line)
Sternbore blew up one day after trying to expand their borders Been an ecological disaster seen Happened a decade ago Every heir to the throne are nearly identical aasimar
Last king was torn limb by limb by Henry Wachter monstrosities Not as war hungry, focused more inward. More recent events regarding undead around the border have, unfortunately, forced his hand Fairly skilled fighter, trained in warfare. Not legendary, but formidable Fathrell
We go to kill the mushroom hivemind in Mine between Tunseel and Ensile “You’ve come back. Would you like to join the family?” Not particularly We kill that thang It tried to put Viktor into a mushroom
Stop briefly by Uisu
Goodsong Tavern Halfling man recognizes us
Met ur friend up in Flamhaltn [show owner signature] “You don’t have to pay for anything if you are a friend.” No we insist “What would you like to know? We live right on the border.” Attacks on monasteries?
“Both had been hit from my understanding, and the third time is when they kill. But I believe the attacker has had a reprieve after making a horrible mistake. They might be dead for all we know. He attacked monks and decided to attack the Dulcin Monastery in Northern Tunseel. It’s a monk, run by one Dayalu.”
“It’s also one person, not people. [the monk hunters]” Shino Hakusa “Tall for me, short for you. 5’ flat.” “They never stay in town, just outside it for some reason.” And it’s just one person? They were doing so much damage that people thought they were monk hunters? “Because war is on the horizon, I think there’s a reason why they only attack Tunseelian and Ensilians.” (Not a war yet. But we live under a shadow of it rn. The biggest thing involving that would be the sheer facts that a lot of the northern monasteries were conquered less than a decade ago by Tunseel, thus aren’t loyal despite lying in the territory.)
“Although it would piss off the Temple of Erastil (Uisu), Morven could pay back for the life before her undeath by advertising as bait for the hunter. And for what it’s worth, the hunter won’t kill unless it’s the 3rd visit.” Is there anything else we can do? “Unfortunately, I think they’d rather not see you. You can be in the city, but you can’t enter the monastery grounds.” Anything we can do to help our mutual friends? “Not right now, but we can be in contact.” Okay, just let us know if we can be of service in any way.
Back to Fathrell, Anmoku Funeral Parlor
Viktor talks to Shiryo Anmoku abt Vlaundet Thaine
“There was a story about him, but he died 6 years ago, fully destroyed. If someone is going by that name, then they are going by the name of dead man to stay anonymous.”
A bard participated (Merris Hasalk)
An alchemist of some kind killed him (Onarach Agus Fìor) Yurei’s kitsune dad offers Viktor co-ownership of the parlor–he’s the most promising of their company, and they’re hoping to expand. Viktor would be good for filing paperwork Rosalind groceries, interacting with shopkeepers
New general store owner took over Tela ir'Vasimon’s shop =( Half elven instead of human, shorter side, 5’2” “You must be the famous rosalind i’ve heard about?” Yes! What’s your name?
“Guran.” I have not been working here as much I was previously, but I’m glad to be doing my rounds again. “Of course. The town is a bit odd to me, so- you’re a social butterfly, right?” I’d be happy to help, is there trouble you’re having? “Since I took over for her, a few nobles have been asking for fancy champagnes to be imported. They said it’s not common, but I fear its a test of my ability. Do they normally import so much champagnes and wines?” (Would only do this if you need an extreme order very fast) Not to my knowledge? I fear this may be hazing, but it is out of the ordinary. What nobles, if you don’t mind me asking?
“The mayor Edouard Boutin, a few of the council members, and House Angril.” I’m not sure I can think of any reason they would do that. Maybe its a childish way to introduce you to town. “If I might be so rude, I’ve heard word that your group travels a lot.” Uh well
“I was just wondering if you were going to Sternbore. You seem like…. Unconventional merchants.”
“I was hoping for a letter and gifts for my Tela ir'Vasimon. I would hope to avoid it, but she wishes to head there in emergency cases. If you leave, or go there, but I could pay you about 10 gold.
Kholeran and Dasa go to Tunseel cabin New knight has taken over, cabin has been cleaned, and he and his squire are resting The bricks have been worndown by someone standing in the window, a small child or halfling who has been observing this cabin for the last few months. Daily. Stood there until it got cold (dusk). Philemine delivering a message to Yurei’s dad I come bearing some bad news! “What did my child get into?”
Not your child, but the business. I had the misfortune of speaking to my ex-husband about the state of things, and he gave a warning to pass on that essentially: Fall in line, or the Parlor will be burnt to the ground. “I… see. So we need to keep all attraction to ourselves low. As for you, I may have to exile you from the funeral parlor proper. I’ll figure something out.” (He’s panicking that the king would threaten to burn down his business) “Let’s make srue that we do nothing that would bring attention to ourselves, okay?” It has been requested of me that I don’t rock the boat in terms of speaking out against him until it’s time to kill each other. I just want you to know that I don’t plan to go on anti-government tirades or whatever. I was going to investigate around the city, but I can stay inside. “I would rather the funeral parlor to not be involved in politics.” I’ll appear like a vapid and happy wife “I would ask you to be careful to not sweep us into something we cannot handle.” Please let me know what I can do to help the parlor, you all have been very gracious to me Next day, torrential rain continues. When dusk should come, all 7 suns are above as trumpets blare outside A loud knock A battalion of soldiers outside our door Rosalind opens the door, the soldier opens the door fully
A high priestess Elois Se'Barde and the TUNSEEL KING ARE HERE
Tunseelian King = Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie “I have no business with the funeral parlor.” - Knight forces Rosalind to bow A dome of 7 suns around the king blocking the king from getting wet.
“I wish to see the undead who interacted with my group in Brazenthrone.” Bows to Phil but no one else (she’s a noble, just post mortem) “Rise.” (We rise) “Lovely to meet you.” Lovely to meet you as well your majesty. How may we be of service? “I understand you interacted with a few… renegade undead hunters from the nation of Tunseel in the nation of Brazenthrone.” Yes, your grace. We did. “And why did you interact with them? What did you do to them?”
We went to a drow city near Brazenthrone to reclaim a lost artifact from one of our members ancestors. We encountered a woman by the name Elethera Vainwin. We fought, and ultimately she did not survive the encounter. “You killed her?” Yes. “Speak plainly.” Um. Yes we killed her your majesty
We were investigating the ruined part of Brazenthrone, where we met with Pheylor Tenthall and spoke with her. We fought her, but were left alive. “Why did she do so?” We do not know. “Then, simple questions out of the way. I’ll give you a small boon. The people of Tunseel will not harm you in our lands. You may travel our lands, and no people may legally take retribution against you.” You have our utmost thanks, your majesty. “Now. Do you know your husband and who he’s been making deals with?”
The people of Advesperascit, this king- “What deals did he make with me?” I thought you all had a non-aggression situation? “And?” Maybe trade? I know he has a mining company. “What does he mine? Beyond silver.” (Long bit of silence. Nun: We don’t need to ask this my lord. King: We do.) I think some of the miners mentioned keeping an eye out for valuables left behind in the earth?
“Of course. I see. So you found either the rune or a part of the rune.” (This is absolutely the king. But the bodyguards arent just here to kill us, they’re here to kill the king if he acts out of line.) Uhhh. Yes. But I found that out by being nosey. “Good work then, Philomene.”
(Basilae’s aggression for us is for the king. He can’t kill us. The king is aware this is both his executioner and guards. They’re the best Tunseel has to offer. Reasonably, we could gang up and kill the king, but the 2 on his side are legendarily strong.) “If you wish, we plan on expanding south into the resting lands below. We could offer this parlor exclusive rights to funeral rights there.” (Kitsune dad is pacing outside, Yurei is not here) Ummm we don’t have anyone here who can accept- (King starts shifting) “I understand that Viktor is a medical professional.” Uh. yes your grace. “Then he may go down and investigate the land. You will go down and we will discuss when he reaches a conclusion.” Uh. Yes your grace, thank you your grace
The king speaks Porlumiè, but his voice doesn’t match his mouth movements. “Vitry-Seilave” (the area of viktor’s hometown Frontillé) Oh. Thank you.
“You could use the gift I gave you (boon) instead of letting it rot away. It is by the grace of the gods above, Sarenrae and Pharasma, of course. Do you have anything to eat?” (Cheap shit) (Yurei’s dad is shooed away bc he wants to do business deals.) “I will talk to you later. As business partners, of course.”

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 22
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 21
Next Session: Session 23
Fathrell The town is active, making themselves available for the king to peruse
Phil uses Leverage Connections to let us near Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie (& Ono)
King is currently talking to the Edouard Boutin (not the governor) Ono is nowhere to be found
Elois Se'Barde looks back at us “i didn’t realize you were nobles in the local area” I’m technically not but I run in noble circles 🙂 If it is displeasing, we can leave “Every noble gathering needs a prop piece (something to look pretty). You should figure out how to exit as a prop piece.” “I can always assist you, after this whole thing is done.” I’m working on it, don’t worry. “Don’t worry, I can make it as seamless as possible.” I believe I have a holy duty to carry out, but should I come to the realization that I’m mistaken, I’ll seek you out. “When you do, just be sure to send word ahead of time. I’ll order a wonderful coffin for you.” Phil then finds an off-shift guard, she’s very drunk “Hello ma’am. Could I buy you something?” “Yes! I can drink, but please, I am sure you work very hard for your gold, it’s on me.” “Don’t worry, all of it’s on the house, don’t need to buy anything.” “We had to hike all the way for the king for him to teleport in. I’m sure you’d find Tunseel quite lovely.” “Oh, yes, we’ve been invited to tour around there. Do you know any places that are good to visit or should avoid?”
“Shelyn will protect you… beautiful. Places to travel… Beau’claire?”
(By the way she leads it, she’s from Beauclaire. Not super useful.) “What direction will you be headed so I can accompany you?” (Everyone leaves so she doesn’t implicate them in treason)
“Gordrivvmyr? The hunters cleared it out, and it won’t be part of Ensile, but Tunseel. We could experience it as part of Tunseel… together? We would be the first to see it as part of Tunseel rather than Ensile.” “It’s possible we might be able to.” (Small oddity. She did, when she was flirting, ask Phil to go back to her hometown. But she wouldn’t do that unless the war was over or your shift has ended. You don’t go home until the war is over/decided. She has a reason to believe that everything will be fine.) “When do you think you’ll be able to show me around?” “I can for a few weeks, and then go in the honor of the old king.” (A slight leave to remind you what you’re fighting for before being thrust back into war.) “That sounds lovely, I’ll put time into my schedule and meet you there.”
Her name is Mulli (Various people seem to be panicked. The ones who don’t have on site tailors and the like are very last minute put together. The king and the men are talking about trade deals and the shut down pass down south. The king’s men are clearing out the vampire infestation down south, they expect a removal of taxation for the areas down south.) Has the Tunseel/Ensile border situation been hard? A few ignore him, but a few do take a weird curiosity in him bc of his political questions
“Are you from the Freilands?” “Pardon?” “Automaton with a soul?” “That is what I am.” “I’ve only heard of them coming from that region, you must be an odd curiosity. Please, ask any question, I must see what curiosity you have.” “I’ve heard there’s been conflicts. I don’t get very much information about the trade, only everyday tasks.”
“It is tragic to have to rely on aid from elsewhere, but Tunseel has been stepping up the trade. They’ve been helping with small bits here and there about people of undead repute. Our local monasteries seem unable to do aid despite our assistance.” “The purpose of monasteries is that they’re quite secret. I don’t want to interrupt people of god, of course.” “Undead? I’ve heard violence, of course, but perhaps that was kept from me.” “Undead. Vampires, zombies, and the like. Idk if you’ve encountered an undead, as an automaton?” “I’ve heard stories from my employer and those I’ve talked to.”
“The problem with them is that they’re unnerving, the quietness of Pharasma brings unease and the like. You would’ve been alive 200, 400 years, right? From before the Dark Sky?” “My spark of life was a year ago, I’m very new!” “I see, you’re one with forgotten memories, of course.” “The unfortunate reality is that- well, 4, 5 years ago, you don’t know about Pharasma right?”
“She stopped talking to us after some idiots opened up the Divine Gate in Advesperascit. To be honest, I personally blame all of them for the various things happening. If you want, we’d pay handsomely for an odd thing such as yourself, we’d pay for your odd questions.” (This is an archmage, technically. The thing that separates souls via arcane origins is the ability to ask questions. This is the next step in evolution to this archmage.) “I fear I’m happy in my current employment, but I’d be happy to keep in contact if you have a form of address.”
“Simply address it to Bianchwood Richtmar of the Richtmar Estate.” “My name is Sire Richtmar” “An automaton such as yourself, able to ask questions, I could make the time any day.”
Ono and Garmond Man recognizes the name Anmoku Viktor introduces himself under the name “Keson”
“Does the Anmoku Funeral Parlor work with the nobles?” “We were independently invited.” “By the king?” - very major leap. Would assume the local business was invited by locals, not the king of a foreign nation “What makes you think the king invited us?”
“Well everyone’s heard the king went to visit you before all the nobles so we assumed you had some kind of deal. looks at the Abadar champion We hadn’t discussed this, can you promise you aren’t lying?” Viktor promises we aren’t lying and the halfling Abadarian casts a spell (ring of truth) while asking Ono “I simply knew that it was happening and figured it wouldn’t be too unreasonable for people to talk to guards. (True statement)” “Why do you ask Sir Keson? (about being invited by the king)” “It just seemed a little out of place is all. (true) Is that a problem?” “Not at all. Just want to make sure no bloodshed happens in my city” “We don’t intend to cause any bloodshed” “I haven’t had a chance to ask this but how did you get a house? They said it was built overnight but I don’t believe that’s true”
“It was a gift from an ancestor. One of Yurei’s” “A gift how?” Other guy perks up also “A very powerful spellcaster conjured it.” “A spellcaster of what variety?” “Not entirely sure” “And why are you so interested in this Viktor? Sorry, Keson” Ono “Merely wanted to ask various things about him. Like why a vampire is allowed to walk among society” (lie) “The truth I cannot say due to prior contract” (true) Viktor “is it perhaps a local contract?” Ono “You could say that, in the grand scheme of things” In the grand scheme of things Tunseel is very local What are the terms of the contract? - Ono “I cannot say” - Mr Abadar “We cannot get in the way of an existing contract can we Mr. Keson. Also did you know his name was Viktor before he introduced himself, Ono?” - “Yes” “How did you know my name?” “By channels you are familiar with” “Have you been in correspondence with Tunseel as of late?” “Of course, I am an advisor” (True) Advisor to whomst? Mostly to local businesses (true) What businesses? I shan’t say, as per contract Perhaps we may encounter one in the future. Are they in talks about coming to Ensile? I’m sure they’ll wind up here. Give it maybe half a year (True) Mr Abadar now has an understanding of the two of them and will keep their secrets. If they need anything he’ll be at his hold. AKA “I may not legally tell what happens, but if someone takes my book and reads through it, so be it.” “You already know, Mr. viktor. If you don’t leave now, I will call the guards.” A ideas come up, a few more people show up
Notably, there is a very familiar mayor to us, Régis Ballesdens “A pleasure to see you again!!!” “You’re looking to expand your business?” “Always! We might be getting deals with the king, soon.” “Might I offer you your first step into Tunseel within the month? The inner city has become infested with a plague that we shant name.”
(Unfortunately, he runs outer Gordrivvmyr. The inner city is infested with vampires. They’ll need coffins when all is said and done.) “I go where there needs to be coffins.” “Send an employee within the month, there is another party but I’m sure it’s fine. :)” “Who’s the competitor?”
“I doubt you’d know, but they call themselves the Dione Group. They handle the bodies themselves. The bodies are handled, but they don’t do rights. They take the body and bury within the same day. They do mass rights, and we’ve never had a zombie infestation.” “You have to do the rights. You haven’t had a zombie infestation in how long?” “Been a while. It’s named after their ancestor who died, or went missing, about 200 years ago. 200 years without a single zombie is a fantastic sign.” “How long has there been a vampire situation?” “About 4 months.” They are repulsed by her Most have not been in a mine, some are bragging about having a tan Small figure that fits the description of Kholeran’s hunted prey, staring at the king Royal guards notice them Small child, beaten and battered and homeless over the past few months
Tunseel Squire Sees Kholeran, starts running She stops him from running with a bola “I’m not going to eat you.” “A monster’s intent doesn’t matter, its what they do. You can’t help yourself.” “I try not to eat people I’m planning on talking to.” Kholeran picks him up by the scruff “Ok, I’m not going to eat you, but I do have questions. If I put you down, will you run, or do I need to keep holding you?” Will run
“May Pharasma know I gave it my all.” “I know you’ve been watching where the knights were housed. What have you been looking for?”
“I wanted to find a way to cure the curse your witch put upon Yniesse Zenderholm to cut off her own arm.” “She has fangs, she’s a vampire.” “How far as a squire did you get?” “I had been a squire for 7 months.” “Were you doing well?” “Yes, I can tell what you are, zombie.” “Did you have a parent that got you this squire position?” “They were killed by your like, zombie.” “Ok. Sure. What did you see while you were watching the house?” “She cut off her arm by the witch who layed that curse upon her. Why else would she do that and then run?” “Sometimes things happen that we don’t quite understand.” “A second hunter appeared and collected the arm, brought it back as evidence.” “Was it a hunter you recognized?”
“Seliah of course. You’d be an idiot to not know who she is.” “You’d might have to enlighten me.” “Don’t lie to me, zombies can’t survive 20 years without meat.” “Let’s assume I somehow did, and survived in a cave for 1000 years. Let’s assume I’ve only been around for a few months.” “A colonel in the corp of undead hunters.” “Why would she take the arm?” “So that she could identify what that witch did to cause her to cut off her own arm.” (There was a decapitated arm despite us stealing that arm. Who’s arm was that???) “Sure. Yeah. the witch made her cut her arm off. So did you see- did you stay there the whole time with the arm, where did you go?” “I was told my last order was to protect the city. I took the male of that flamboyant gay. I was looking for traces where you could’ve gone, and then I threw the mail in the sewer.” “I think that was illegal when I was alive. Is it still?” (Yeah it’s still illegal. He’s just 10 and homeless.) “I can find someone who’s still alive who can tell you that you broke the law.” New person, pricks kholeran, tells her to put the boy down
Homveran “A pleasure, of course, Kholeran.” “I did say I wasn’t gonna eat or hurt him.” “Of course, But I’d feel better if he wasn’t in your grasp.”
“You surely have more than a gold, Kholeran. You’re a chosen of Brazenthrone.”
“(To the boy) Play up your sympathy, go back to Tunseel as far as you can. Attempt to become something like a farmer if you can.” “Report to me with whatever you find when you get back. You did good, kid.” “Were you the one to get him to watch the house?” (“You’ll kill the monster?” “Of course, Kholeran won’t be leaving here alive.”) “Glad to see you alive, Kholeran. If I didn’t show up, you would’ve been executed.” “I’d rather not be executed.” “Don’t act so special, most people prefer to live. Or unlive, as it were.” “What brings you over here?”
“I said I was going to Fathrell. Am I not there?” “I guess you are. We’ve been a lot of places. My memory is not great. Why did you come here, anyway?” “I got an odd suspicion that things were going to go down here, and I was right.” “General feeling, or more specific?” “General feeling, but now that the king is here, I was right.” “What are you going to do?” “My goal was to hunt down undead who hurt innocent people. What have you been up to?” “I didn’t kill anyone innocent.” “You killed undead hunters, didn’t you?” “They attacked first.” “They always say that.” “You know how they are.” “Am I one of the good ones, then?” “You are actively stabbing me. So IDK.”
Get a letter of intent to got to Gordrivvmyr
