sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 23
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 22
Next Session: Session 24
Fathrell, Anmoku Funeral Parlor
Viktor is bullied into being adopted by Shiryo Anmoku
Warn him about the cannibals in the Fallrenkiir Mountains Tell him to warn the guards of them 4 days to the Mountain pass Occasionally, in the distance, the sound of a cart behind us just out of line of sight Behind ridges and bends, NOT invisible We wait for a long path, slow down and go to the side of the road, they also slow down and don’t pass Use Rosalind and Yurei to make a distraction so Viktor can sneak and look at them Cart is also pulled off to the side, nicer than ours, more compact, holds max of 3 people Horses seem to be lightly grazing on side of grass, tied to carriage, driver has passed out while seemingly covering his head to prevent the argument from reaching his ear Viktor goes to cut the ropes of the horses A man’s hands drag Viktor under the cart What is going on??? “Now, you wouldn’t happen to be a monster, would you, Viktor?” I don’t consider myself a monster (Gives him a notebook.) “Just the names of everyone you’ve killed.”
(Sabine Keson (remembered), Claire Berger, Chavolott)
(Ume sees Homveran.) Are you just going to keep following us? “Of course, but I don’t want to interrupt something as intimate as death as with an onlooker.” Why are you following us? “You’re undead. You were invited by the king. The undead kill people, the king kills people, you two together may kill a lot of people.” Should we be concerned that you’re our babysitter? That depends, do you consider yourself a monster? Not particularly? All of you should be fine, except Kholeran We’ve been trying to keep her from eating people as much. It’s been a month and a half since she last ate someone. That’s less time than it should be I hope we don’t get any more surprise visits I could travel with you and interrogate each of you individually, preferably not at knifepoint Will you continue to jump us if we don’t travel with you? Only if you travel alone, I don’t want to spill one’s secrets out to the whole world What changed between our first meeting and you choosing to do this? The king likes you I’m not sure that’s the case That’s exactly why. There’s no reason for the king to show favor to some walking corpses Do you have any theories?
The king’s gone mad. The king wants to become undead. The king understands why we’ve been fighting at the border for the last few years. Undeath doesn’t follow nationalist lines, but populist lines. Where people die there will be undeath, it’s not where the nations draw their borders. If we find out an answer will we be spared in your eyes? I’ll only kill you if I deem you monsters What does it take to not be deemed a monster? Having a human understanding of death, it’s consequences, and the people around you. Have a human understanding of death, know the people you killed, feel guilt. Can’t drink feelings away but can carry them with you. Once an undead stops feeling that’s when they become a monster. The “driver” was sacks of food under his coat and sprinkled with blood so undead would go near it We continue with Homveran following us He has an alchemist kit that smells horrible to all the undead and makes us sickened 2 Yurei: Sick eyepatch bro How’s the family? Doing good, i think? Both sides? I hope so, are you familiar with them? Only one half. Which one? You know which one. Good thing he’s not in town rn You take after which side more, do you think? Everyone says I look more like my dad. Which one?
There’s dad or papa. Papa is the red one. In my textbooks he is not “Papa”. He is no “papa”, but i’m glad he stuck around for as long as he did. I hear he’s flighty. He mostly just stays in the back and makes statues of people. He tried to get me into the arts but nah You mostly prefer resurrecting corpses right? And you ask their consent first? Yeah sure, i try to How old are you? 19 You have 3 years to get a good practice. What about Rosalind? The possessed doll? Yes Complicated. What is the soul of the doll like, what age was it when it died Very early teen, IDK i found it in a shop Automaton undead are complicated, case by case basis. (Squints at Rosalind) Leaning towards “spare” unless any heinous acts surface (His carriage has 3 secret exits (top, bottom, back)) What do you do for fun? Any hobbies? I enjoy reading. I’ve taken up some recreational alchemies What kind of books do you read? Mostly heroic fiction, as cheesy as it is Do you like true crime? Not really, i try not to mix business and pleasure. Have you read any pulp fiction? Not really. My guardians try to make me read academic literature when possible Florence? Yeah sure Florence wouldn’t make you read academic literature, who is it? (He won’t read the art textbook that yurei gives him)
Castellwoth Known for logging, people go up and down the rivers (notably down toward the ocean) Most of the houses within are multi-family, most people don’t live in the city but rather shore homes so they don’t get taxed by the Ensilian and Tunseelian governments Ghostly still town Guards look at us, suspicious At most there are about 9 guards maybe on a shift, at night probably goes down to 6 per shift “What business does a funeral parlor have here?” Just passing through “I’m afraid you’re passing through with unusual companions.” We’re all employees, part of the company “That one in the back appears to be a ghoul.” “The man behind-” Homveran: “I merely wish to observe.” We’re just passing through for business. I have all our legal paperwork.
“These are for Tunseel and Ensile, this is neither Tunseel or Ensile.” Can we pass through or not? We won’t cause any trouble. “I’ll ask the Lord.” (The wealthiest family, who handles the legalization of the enterprise)
“Lady Landarios will see you.” We approach, she asks us basic questions “You appear to be undead. By who’s allegiance are you allowed?” We’re going to Tunseel by order of the king “By the king! Of course we won’t stand in your way.” (The undead are not exactly unknown. The fact that she immediately acknowledged that we were sent by Tunseelian king was weird) (Phil) Oh! Has news travelled so fast? Yurei shows our paperwork “Of course! This paperwork dispels any doubts I had about you.” Why wasn’t our companion allowed in? “I only have questions about the undead like yourself.” Party goes on through, leaving the lady of the estate alone
Homveran stops a mile outside of the city “Do you know exactly what that was about?” “I assume because of your undeath” We were let through quite quickly “You have paperwork do you not?” We had not shown it yet. She approved us before we did it. “What other signs did she show?” She was pale, and also seemingly had some confusion in her sentences. She had a kind of rapid breathing. “Viktor, you should know this. This is a lot of blood loss.” There are fucking vampires in this city. We are not sure if we have time to handle this
I know you mentioned disdain for the crown and I assumed you had allegiance to Tunseel, is that the case. “Legally, I work with Tunseel.” So if we were late to our promised engagement, would you be someone who would vouch for the reason our travel was not so immediate that it was not to spite the king. “It would be my word against the king’s. (Whatever the king says and the kings’ men assume)” (Homveran sent a letter ahead to undead hunters so that if he isn’t with us the undead hunters will kill us no matter what. if he goes and we stay, we get killed. Lots of tactical errors if we don’t stay with him.) (Phil) If we stay here for like an hour or so will we be able to kill the vampire? It will take so much longer than an hour. Do we know the coffin location, type of vampire, method of control? If we attack a vampire too soon then everyone dies and the vampire keeps killing. To me, this is 6 suspicious individuals vs 1 suspicious individual We will have to make a note to come back and deal with this later I assume we will. You have to come home don’t you? (This would have been a recent development within the last year, probably within the last month. There is, however, the fact that it seems that we were going with the king was very important. This seems similar to what Dione has been doing, but likely a brother or sister of Viktor.) Odd shift when we pass through the mountain range Built at the point where the celestial bodies above multiply by 7
Chantetsu Various guardsmen begin panicking upon spotting us Multiple begin to run outside, blowing trumpets to announce our arrival, waking up many people at 4am It’s about as bright in normal places in the day as it is at night in Tunseel A woman approaches
“I am Joan M’let, I am supposed to be your guide. Where would you like to go my lords and ladies?” (Visiting 3 major cities or 6 smaller ones would be good for us in Tunseel. More about seeing and appreciating the country than staying.) “We can accommodate you at anytime. For when the sunsets- well, the sun never truly sets in Tunseel, but I would say maybe 11pm would give you a solid 6 hours before the first sun begins to rise.” We wouldn’t be waking them up right…? “Nooo, I’m sure they’ll be happy to welcome you, no matter the time.” “For Viktor, they have offered a blood boy.” I prefer not to feed off of human populace, any animals…? “I will make sure that the scholar apologizes 7 times to Viktor” We would love to meet him and learn about his research. Yurei also has knowledge of undeath, so they might get along
“We have our own funeral parlour but we can sign some paperwork to approve expansion in the south. We will be expanding to the demon-infested lands of Porlumiè” We’d love any other educational/cultural experiences you may have to offer. That would be great. We’ll retire and meet you tomorrow at 11pm “Might we offer you the Maisommune or the Honbrulant.”
Maisommune is for writing, mostly poetry
Honbrulant would translate to “The Guild of Honor”
L’Oiubli des Etoiles - Undead hunters guild
Castle Chant
Haulonks - Wizards and Druids
Venin de l’Ocean - Bard guild
Church of Sarenrae (Chantetsu)
Deau'argent - Alchemists guild We are just wanting to learn about Tunseelian culture “Oh isn’t Viktor Tunseelian?”
(Viktor) I am from Frontillé near Vitry-Seilave “Ah. I have not heard of there” (Kholeran) Tunseel wasn’t around when I was born “Tunseel was always around, you just didn’t recognize it yet.” (Says the name in Dwarven) “Oh. Interesting. :)”
I died before Grundiir fell “They didn’t rescue you?” Yeah… “If you died here, we would have made sure to drag you to the light.” (Dasa) Druid place here? No, but I’d check out Haulonks Time to be like Tuber and rest A woman enters Dasa’s private room “Master dasa, i hope everything is to your liking.” Pretty good! Any place with more nature here? “Quite a few natural places. Where’s your next destination in the grand scheme of things.” The magic school, I want to figure out why i’m not quite dead yet I can assure you that you’re quite dead That’s what the doctor told me. “Who?” Doctor Viktor! “How’s his relationship with his new sister?” Oh, good! We’ve kinda almost died “How have you almost died?” Bandits, ghouls, angels, a woman with a sword, I think the last person who tried to kill us was… eh, i can’t remember. “I apologize for the crazy woman with a sword. Not sure who she was but I imagine you mentioned she was Tunseelian, right? It wasn’t in your words, it was in your tone.” Oh she was definitely wearing armor! “Where did you encounter her? Not Tunseel?” Some giant ass temple? She gave us a warning- she tried to kill all of us! “Yes we established this, but where!” A temple i think! They were talking about the runes had doors and the doors had runes and they were going to put clothes on us. Woman who wasn’t a ghost” “Because she was alive, right?” Nooo because she appeared out of nowhere! And she said she was going to touch me and then she attacked and next thing I knew I was on a ship. Do you have any other questions, oh actually I have some questions! Do you know why I’m not dead? “Master Viktor established you’re undead, and Yurei is a necromancer, so they’d be able to determine your state of death.” Oh I need to ask a few questions to Yurei! (goes to Yurei’s room and wakes her up) “YUREI A SERVANT CAME UP TO ME I HAVE A FEW QUESTIONS” Y: HWUAGH. What….. “Master/Madamoiselle Yurei? Your good friend Dasa has questions.” P: DASA WHAT ARE YOU DOING UP AT THIS HOUR :D D: You know I’m undead, right?? Y: Yeah???? D: Could you figure out why the angel said I wasn’t undead. Y: IDK P: Who’s your new friend? “I received a call from master Dasa!” P: What did you call for Dasa? D: Oh no, the servant came up to me and asked a few questions, I gave answers, I’m so good at this “I was told to go up and entertain Master Dasa. (Brings out a gem that is alight) This corresponds to his room, so i came!” (ever light crystal with an unknown trigger) P: What triggers it? “Asking for help in your rooms. If it glows very brightly it means you need guards, and if you need me, it glows softly.” P: Any recollection of doing this Dasa? D: I was mostly standing in the corner of the room. Doing the sleepy thing you all do. “You need to sleep but you’re a skeleton?” D: Yeah I go into the corner of the room and stand there (Sharper teeth under her visage. Smiling at Dasa, nodding at his bullshit) P: why are you wearing a disguise? “I am afraid that I wish to appear human for you all, so that you get the true Tunseel experience. The majority of servants are deathly afraid of you all.” P: Are you dead? “I have no fear of the undead, and the people of Tunseel have been kind to me.” P: Why were you asking Dasa very specific questions? D: I didn’t call you “I have a signal, so someone must have called me. Philomene, if you mind, ask for some minor assistance.” P: Can I have assistance? (Crystal lights up) D: how’d you know it was me? “I know which crystal is which” (8 crystals for 8 rooms) P: Thank you for being willing to - What is your name by the way?
“You may call me 'Mavier'” P: This seems to have been in error. Perhaps he was sleep talking “I have never known a skeleton to sleep, let alone sleep talk!” P: he’s weird. Strange. P: You are welcome to not entertain us :) (She leaves, goes to the servant quarters) We go to make sure that there is not a distress call from someone else, listen and smell at the other rooms (for blood and such) Dasa’s door was locked?? Servants only unlock rooms in case of emergency If you were to get answers from someone who just woke up so they don’t have time to prepare lies. But she picked Dasa so its fine Go to guards, not closest one, pick random one P: Pardon me? “Yes” P: Do you know if it is typical of the staff to go into rooms unprompted and ask pointed questions? “Of course not, my lady.” P: There might be someone posing as a servant. Idk if they’ll still be here, but someone woke our companion up and where he was going next, what the relation to our companions is “Did you get a name?” P: Mavier
“I doubt Mavier would do such a thing” “I will check” P: Do we need to alert anyone else? “I’m sure it’s fine.” (there is a servant sleeping on duty.) “I apologize, did you need something lady Philomene.” P: Just out of curiosity, what is the last thing you remember? “Reading my book, of course.” Small story of a seafaring adventure of the western continent P: What time? “I’m sorry, I passed out during my reading.” P: How long do you feel you’ve been asleep for. No… retribution about the answer. “The throbbing headache makes it feel like I’ve been asleep for 5 minutes.” P: Do you have a house doctor? Otherwise I’d bring Dr Viktor “The house doctor is not for the common folk.” P: Ok I will grab Viktor Viktor is grabbed and taken to examine this servant Appears they were bitten from behind, looks to be a 33 millimeter distance between the canines which would match the fangs of “Mavier” (“Mavier’s” bite mark is 41cm) P: could we talk to who would handle things such as this?
“The Priest of Sarenrae will handle this” P: Would you be willing to take us there? “I’d be willing to take her there.” “I wish not to offend my lord priest.” P: Anyone else we could give testimony to?
“The captain of course.”

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 24
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 23
Next Session: Session 25
Chantetsu Preispo 30, 1264
Report what happened to the guards, Captain Vorc “I promise these things don’t happen here often.”
“We’ll check the records to try to find the person 'Mavier', see if there’s any way they could have breached the walls.” Not a lie, but its a point of pride that there’s no way there could have been a vampire in the city, so it must have come from outside
“If there’s ever an issue, do not hesitate to call the priests of Sarenrae and Pharasma.” There was a system where a crystal in the servants quarter would light up if a guest needed assistance-
“That would be tantamount to spycraft, and I can assure you that Tunseel would not do that to you.” Maybe they got through the sewers “The priests have a habit of flushing holy water down.” (There is a certaince of disbelief, these people are here to sow doubt. Also, we said that the castle had an infiltrator, but all the guards are still here, so they don’t believe us.)
To the wizards, Haulonks Walk up a flight of stairs into a building Water isn’t actually holy btw
Encounter one of the druids, Leticia “You must be the esteemed guests!” Yes! You’re a druid! “I am, and you seem…. To be practice the craft as well!” (Wildsong) Are there any more druids here beside you? “Yes, but most live out in the woods working in the fields.” When do you think is a good time to summon them? “Why would we do that” (Theres so much) An angel told me I’m dead but not undead! “An angel??? What’st eh name?”
Ziphren!
“Emlay may be able to help you.” (Leads us deeper, knocks on an office.) L: Visitors! E: Come on in! (Nice office for a Pharasman scholar. Undead prophecies made of wax. Various ways to lure and kill ghouls using their base instincts. A serum that smells to ghoul like a fresh corpse.) E: I apologize. I’m not so familiar with your conditions, but if you are looking for a cure, but there’s only 1 I know of. “I’m not looking for a cure-” E: You’re a skeleton that retained its intelligence. Kholeran: I don’t think any of us are looking for cures, but answers for Dasa’s questions. E: It appears to be a skeleton, it may have been a wizard. E: If the head was strong enough it would repair itself with bones nearby. Viktor: An angel told Dasa that he’s dead but not undead. E: Cute, who put you up to this? V: no one. The angel’s name is Ziphren? E: (Looks through book, asks Dasa to sing (badly), asks him to teleport) D: I think I can teleport! E: no you can’t E: The only type of creature who is dead but did not die is a psychopomp. You lack the wings of a vanth, and you lack the calming nature of a catrina, both of which would fit your general description. E; The only things that are dead but haven’t died were created by lady pharasma herself, and, well, I doubt she made that E: She is the god of dead. Antithesis of unlife. R: Any extenuating circumstances that could have created him?
E: Maybe a residual wish when the Divine Gate opened that came down and blessed him? A wish is given will in its form, but that would have required someone to… want this on the world.
(Dasa is 5.5, Advesperascit happened 5.5 years ago) E: If the angel is trying to find Pharasma, that does mean they believe that she was stolen. Conspirators, as you will. (Believing that the body is amongst us) V: If we were to investigate this further, do you have a direction for us to head in? E: I could send a signal to psychopomps to investigate and they’ll do as they will. If you truly believe this one to be a psychopomp then he’ll be spared. You only need to have to meet him with the psychopomp alone. Even the weak ones can sense undeath within 60ft
K: it might also be important to mention. We encountered these angels in a set of crypts that were formerly part of the nation of Grundir. Near the Blackloch.
E: IDK, but I’m familiar with the concept. Lady Pharasma, if she were to be hidden, she’d be in the largest crypt in the world. Grundiir Crypt. All of the dead of Grundiir were transported and buried there at the fall of Grundir.
(Dasa was born in the woods near purplish trees. Didn’t meet people for the first year or so. Theoretically, the forest west of Thornello and south of Onevecchi)
Writing guild, Maisommune Fine arts guild, specializes in writing and chronicling of the Frontier Lands (outside the valley of the seven suns) Mostly stories about tunseelians going out of the country, making names for themselves, then coming back They have printing presses and we’re on the 3rd page We count as a horde of undead apparently “They are to be treated with the utmost respect and hopefully we will see the wisdom in the coming days” Front page news Annexation of the dwarven lands
Expansion southward to the Porlumiè region
Tenuous agreement with dwarves in Brazenthrone to finish the tunnel that connects the Tunseel valley to Karlsirchterin They let us inside
Halfling named Sengo looks at us “A pleasure to have you all here.” “Now, to what do I owe the pleasure? We handle all the dissemination of the news from up north and down south (SO MUCH)” (They wrote the newspaper, they assumed we didn’t read the newspaper) R: hello! We’re passing through, seeing the sights of your beautiful town. I feel this news may have already reached you, but we are doing a tour “Of course, as a publishing house, we can give you any Tunseel info you may require, I’m sure though with your allegiance with the king its not required.” (Rambles about crops in the region, propaganda about Tunseel, nothing negative) “You could quit that mangey job you have now, we always need in-the-field reporters!” R: i’m not suited for field work. P: I’m sure we could send your opinions in the mail if its a serious offer “If you send opinions, we would rightfully pay for it.” R: I consider myself a good communicator, but we have those who are adept in other writing avenues . “Of course, and you have the famous Dr. Viktor with you!” V: … famous??? “Yes, famous! We wrote a bit on you, I hope you don’t hold that against us.” R: We are hoping to see what Tunseel has to offer, could be a non-Tunseel perspective on things that have happened in the past. “I don’t know if we could pay for an outsider opinion, its not uncommon these days. That being said, if you do happen to find a good story, we’d still pay for it, especially if it happens in faraway lands. If it happens inside, it’d have to be exceptionally juicy to sell.”
R: it would be well within our abilities, we’ll be returning to Ensile soon after our tour. Surely there are many stories to tell of faraway places.
“Of course! And you were in Brazenthrone so-” R: We have been there, but I don’t know we have plans to return. “I’d take a personal interview if you’d be willing to be paid for it.” R: Oh who? “Each of you!” (Some he really wants, others are neat, some it’d be fine if he didn’t have it.) R: As far as interviews go, I’d be inclined to do one if you desire. “Of course, it’d be 30gp per interview? It’d have to be an exclusive interview, if I see any, I’d have to send the debt collectors after you.” (The more insular the town, the more likely they’re accused of heresy. Smaller ones that would be better to be interviewed, but they wouldn’t offer us money and wouldn’t go as far.) P: While I would be happy to give an interview, we, um… we did very much enjoy your article on the new tunnel opening. I just want to make sure that giving exclusive interviews that this is the start of a relationship together instead of any hostility or misunderstandings. R: I feel we could be sensationalized more than necessary, especially given the circumstances. “Now I would never mischaracterize anyone I’m interviewing, and I’m sure your shining personalities will go through the newspaper trickery. Now, it is important to me that the people in nearby towns know the shift in policy. The last time that happened was 700 years ago.” (Death knight that changed his ways and tried to redeem himself. The death knight died bc once you release hatred) “Questionable people exist in all forms, not just undeath.” R: It would be bad to see ourselves represented as a kind of monster that we are not. We can be misrepresented in ways that are kinder. P: perhaps those of us who are a little bit more verbose speak with you now and we see how it is, and if it looks like we’re going in a good direction we bring our not as verbose friends to share their stories, though you may need to do some editing to make Dasa coherent. “That makes it sensational, I’d love to have it. I’d love to have the whole group, do a chronicle. Start with the most eyecatching, have the people learn to love you.” (True intentions are hard to parse out, he’s good at hiding them. Some truth, its letting hikm control rollout. Flaunt across the other papers, in case you missed the first one, you can catch onto the next few. One thing that he has that they don’t.) R: Eyecatching first, what would be eyecatching for your standards? “I can’t imagine you all giving an answer that’s not eyecatching. The sheer novelty of a doll walking is more than most interviews.” V: what order would you release them in? “That depends on the answers. Viktor and Philomene would be prime candidates for first issue.” V: If there’s a question we don’t want to answer, can we skip? “Yes, of course, but I’d dock pay.”
Bard district, Venin de l’Ocean Not a whole lot here Preparing and willing to show an Ode to Phil, reenacting her death. Showing the 4 northern lands the galleant strides her husband went through to avenge her. “I hope you enjoy it, it was commissioned by him a half year ago.” “We have a few other undead ones if you wish.” P: What would you recommend? R: A tunseelian undead stageplay?
“It would be about Sir Loth.” (Death knight) (Typical tunseel play, following him as he become a knight, fall from grace, undead knight, redemption in act 3. More passion of the local populace rather than a commission behind it.) Rosalind goes up and starts asking about techniques and acting. A few are taken aback “How long have you appreciated the arts? Years… hours?” R: I haven’t been alive for years, but it’s been a lesser interest for sometime. Acting is something I’ve always been inclined to, I’d like to engage with the arts more. “We could always take you as part of our troupe, away from what you’re doing right now?” R: I’d rather not leave, but thank you! Given a slip of paper, “We’ve heard you were a slave to your undead master, blink three times if you need to get away.” R: No i’m fine! “Are you sure they’re not holding you as a thrawl, a slave?” R: I’m also undead, I’m not a thrawl or slave? “That’s what a necromancer does, and then you’re under their…” R: I’m under a contract? I’m not under duress? This is how I choose to spend my days. After all, the king invited us to tour Tunseel, it would be remiss for me to stop here. “We might make our way northward at some time. We understand you’re from Fathrell?” R: Oh! Yes! I hail from Fathrell, it’d be lovely to see you there? “Is there even a theater in Fathrell? If there isn’t we could do a street performance. We could do it around your abode!” R: I fear it would conflict with our business practices. There’s not a theater per se, a street performance is more doable. “You’re always welcome. With proper correspondence, we could have someone bring you down if you ever desire. As long as you’re only in Ensile, its doable.” R: That’d be nice! (Implication is that they don’t believe a war is gonna happen, you don’t start planning an opera tour into a war zone.)
Alchemists guild, Deau'argent Bustling As we arrive, we see a gnomish man look up at us. “You wouldn’t happen to be the undead party?” “I can tell, I am very astute with these things. One of the agents has requested to speak with you specifically. If you need to breathe, I’d wear a mask there is lead, so safe, but there chemicals that are unsafe.” Give us rebreather masks Old friend and small child sitting together
Homveran and the child “Could you introduce yourself to Ms. Zenderholm.”
“I’m Elain Zenderholm.”
(She’s 14, likely Yniesse Zenderholm’s sister.) H: Don’t worry, these ones are the ones who wouldn’t hurt people, I’m sure. (Using her as a way to test us) H: Why don’t you tell the nice people what you saw your sister doing before she disappeared?
E: I saw her talking to the king. V: talking to the king? E: In the middle of the night. I woke up and saw him out there. R: Suns and all? E: It was at night. R: That must have been quite scary! E: It was. The king and a few others, but I couldn’t make out their form. (Homveran has done a good job lying about her sister, so she doesn’t know anything about us.) R: I’m sorry that happened to your sister, I’m sure it left you hurt and scared, alongside otherthings you don’ quite understand. E: Yes… (Sense of a child experiencing loss for the first time.) I can live with uncle Homveran for a while though. R: I’m glad you have people taking care of you. (She’s scared talking about death, but it’s not the first time someone near her died. It’s her first time grieving.) H: Unfortunately, the lady that was with them, would you describe her as holy? E: I saw her turn into a wolf and run away. The woman.
(Classic vampire ability. Maybe Dione?) E: The other person was covered despite it being night and warm out. K: Family is important, its good you have uncle Homveran in your life. H: You’ve done good. You’re already for your first step (giving an elixir). You only take it if you’re ready. (The plant he grinds is a type of vitality plant used for anti-undead elixirs. Used in small doses to turn someone into an undead hunter. First one, where you let them do it, incredibly lethal unless you’re a good alchemist.) H: Don’t worry, it’s natural the first few times. Kholeran, if you wish you can take a bite :) K: If i HAVE to kill someone in self defense and the body is right there- H: You WILL give funeral rites H: Ok everyone stand 5 ft away H: Kholeran there is a dying person on the side of the road. No one is around. K: I have more questions. How injured? H: Extremely, without medical intervention they’ll die. K: Is Viktor around? H: No you’re alone. H: It’s a very simple question K: Any number of things will occur.
K: I once heard its not paranoia if its right. A Grundiir classic. Next week, go down the river

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 25
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 24
Next Session: Session 26
Tunseel Drink: Dry gin, “Roots of ruin, a spirit from the ashes” Spinatta Fuga plant
Vineish, said to grow toward the manifestation of Pharasma, incredibly toxic to undead. Protects against undead
Plant growing in the Fathrell Graveyard
Originates in Advesperascit, the Callenwall area (600 miles to the north) Boat A river boat, notably a tug boat that uses elemental reactions to turn wheels
Expensive to charter our, we’re on the king’s bill tho
Reading Elethera Vainwin’s book Book has areas of expertise that the reader is assumed to know, makes it hard to read
Talking about the rune that was found there seemingly unmakes things, allowing it to rewind time, hence it allowed the area to be filled with trees. Area they were in used to be above ground OR had an artificial sun
Other idea was to bring it around to other parts of Grundiir (lower warp might’ve changed how it was)
Rune itself, 2 of them were found in very close proximity to Brazenthrone, mentions a mission to go into the old library and find ledgers of someone who would’ve brought in runes and go from there. Likely a merchant brought them in and disseminated them. Don’t plan on stopping for long
Captain Malu lets Viktor know: “We’re only stopping for a quick load in, load out. My understanding is that we’re supposed to make it to the capital in time.” “The suns of the city are intense even for human standards.” (Directly in the center of the valley, full atmospheric effect of 7 suns. Good for various plants, growing wheat in winter, stays warm enough due to the heat. A breadbasket during the colder months.) Viktor bubvestigating 2 days to realize it, someone is sleeping on one of the beds (not one of the crew) Once found, they never seem to return to the bedroom Ship continues moving before lurching to a stop, 4th day, during the midday suns After we were supposed to stop, still in the middle of the river 2 people arguing upstairs, followed by footsteps downstairs 2 unknown people enter the room, 2 more outside Look around “We’ll be taking the dwarf with us. Please don’t resist.” V: Eh? “The dwarf.” V: Why?
“A deal we made. Someone vouched for the rest of you, but the dwarf is fair gain. Do you understand the statute of murder?” “If you all move, we will start opening fire.” We don’t give Kholeran over
Initie Elodie (initie is their title in combat, i think its french)
Cleric of Sarenrae Keeps spamming 3 action heal Viktor knocks him out
Initie Camille Bit by Lacedon, stage 1 ghoul fever spellcaster
Initie Margaux
Initie Thibault Knock them out, take their weapons, tie them up These are all initiates, all very low in their organization We passed under a canopy at one point, they ambushed the captain, then went down to us Captain and crew are dazed, but healed up alchemically As if someone waited a bit to intervene Captain is shocked that the men are still alive “I mean no offense, the crew- none of us are combat trained. I wouldn’t want you to be a guard on your leisure cruise, but can you detain them?” We’re trying to decide what to do with them We think hard to see what would happen to them if we drop them off Tunseel Lore & Society: A way that can happen in the king’s favor. These people are under my protection, don’t attack them. This would be a public execution by the king. Men are genuinely surprised to wake up alive V: Bonjour “Doctor.” V: How are you feeling? “Are you going to drain us of our blood?” K: Why? “Some vampires like the taste of those afraid.” P: In all seriousness, we will let you go, but it will be tomorrow, but I don’t want you contract ghoul fever and we can’t check right now if you have it. I’ll cleanse it tomorrow, you’re free to go on your way, we’ll drop you off without making a big deal of it. Any objections? Questions? Concerns? “What do you get out of it? V: Your blood not on our hands? P: You can find love? You can leave? D: No public executions? P: We don’t even have to have you tied up if you don’t stab us or leave before we can check you for ghoul fevor. We just really want to make sure you don’t die from ghoul fevor. K: Speaking from experience, it’s not fun. “You have our weapons.” P: You could still flee if you wanted to. If we do so, will you stay so we can treat you and not stab us? “I don’t appreciate being talked down to by a corpse.” P: I’m going to close the door, and you get to talk about whether or not you are held captive and treated by the evil doctor or if we’re just hanging out. (It seems they’re talking less about that, but the punishment for failure. If they admit to what happened to their weapons, they could be executed, but if they say they were robbed by bandits on the road. Devil bargain was used wrt being untied, they don’t believe it’s going to happen. A few have weird suspicions about vampires and undead, like maybe this one prefers elation before it bites.) “Keep us tied up.” P: Are you able to prepare Cleanse Affliction tomorrow? “My goddess allows me to do so.” V: Who sent you on this mission? “We sent ourselves. We took initiative.” (They overheard leaders, and if they did this it’s an instant rise in the ranks.) “Bandits would not give us snacks.” P: Would you drink water if we give it to you? “It’s fine, we’ll get our own water.” V: Where are you from? What city?
“Ammurun.” (Bullshit, smaller ones have 1 or 2 guilds, would help narrow it down.) K: Which guild did you come from? “We took the initiative ourselves.” K: I’d imagine every guild is having the same thoughts. “We haven’t even been initiated in a guild.” (A lie)
(Their accents are from eastern side of Tunseel.) Let them go, pretending like they escape Ammurun - Khesvoyna 5 1264 Essentially 1 church per block

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 26
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 25
Next Session: Session 27 Khesvoyna 2, 1264
Ammurun Arrive at actual docks Concierge meets us
“Hello. The name is Marcel, I’m here to escort you around. Since the sun is about to rise, I have arranged an inn for you to stay at.” Area is notably beautiful, takes a birth to the west, leads us to the side gate before entering the inner city Points to forts on hills, a giant tree, golden topped roofs
Le Repair d'Voyage Overlooks bottom of the river, where they intersect again “I was unsure how you wish for accommodations, so I got individual rooms. If you wish to sleep together, we can drag beds over if you wish.” Yurei waits for viktor sleeps, Yurei sees room service going around the various rooms People seem to be workaholics One housekeeper opens up morvens room before letting off a soft apology (morven sleeps thru it) Half elven woman appears in early 40s by humans (120ish range) Yurei calls out and asks if she needs anything “Just checking the rooms. Are the others sleeping during the day as well?” Y: great questions. “Could I help you?” Y: i was just going back to my room (goes to viktor) “Um. Alright.” Yurei sleeps in viktor’s bed, kicks him awake Sibling argument They hear a whistle from Morven’s room Door is locked, but the lady didn’t do that Room is silent from 4th rank Silence Spell Morven has been supernaturally groggy looking Usually the movements are faster, this takes 3-4ish mins Nothing medially wrong, but odd marks. Pinpricks that were done to them, wrist, heart, thigh, butt, neck Teeth are smallest bit of residue that would be dissolves by saliva, some sort of clay Blood collection points for various types of blood from human body Molds of teeth The window sill makes a whistling noise when closed Silence breaks Nothing was taken beyond medical information Servants quarters asking about half elf lady Kitsune man and the woman Y: I just wanted to know if you recognize the servant- “That’s me. Are you feeling alright?” Y: someone came into my friend’s room and blood was taken. Was anyone suspicious around this morning? “We had some hunters come through which i fear might be the one who messed with you if that was an issue?” Y: TY i’ll relay it to the others Man: “If you have an issue, please- I’ll tend to it. We’ll make sure she never has to interact with you if that’s the issue” Y: no it’s fine, i’m leaving now Rest for real Gather information
Phil asking about Dione Group “The headquarters technically are in the capital. They do reside near the old destroyed quarter to the south.”
Viktor is learning about the Monk Hunter Have to go to the clergy
Father Tybalt “The day the divine gate opened, we thought we would see god. The subsequent days, parts of the city were ravaged by aberrations, not unsimilar to those that emerged from the ground and destroyed temples. One had a hatred for monks. Presumably she was hunted down. The entirety of the city of Ammurun were red that day.”
Points to Destroyed Quarter
Dasa (disguised as a Desnan priest) learning about giant tree
Priest of Erastil (Ammurun Priest of Erastil) “Memoirebebur.” (Dasa hears “name a beer”) “No the Memoirebebur the tree that landed along the banks when the elves were slaughtered in the valley” Why’s it dead around? “It was a curse placed by the tree, none may grow” Any importance? “The founding of it was when the seed of the tree was planted, it carries memories, that’s why we call it the Memoirebebur.” (Anything about the tree that seems wrong?) Dirt and gems are forming on top. Given time, it could form a landmass. A few acres have formed rn Top is oddly flat that wouldn’t be conducive for water collection “The Memoirebebur is a beautiful thing is it not?” Are we allowed to go up? “Yes, but you cannot take the gems.” I’ll be respectful. Do i climb or…? “Be warned, at the top, if it deems you unworthy, it’ll kill you.” I’m travelling around, from north
“Advesperascit?” No south
“Ensile? What are you from?” [bullshitting] “This covering is the another denomination, how did one like you become solitary?” More likely than not, I was sent off “Sent off? They opened up their temples?” No, I was a little bit too much for them “What heresy did you commit” I think I annoyed them too much :( “Such is the way of the church.” OK IM GONNA BE IN THE TREE NOW. where does your temple reside?
“Otherside of the city, but we have a temple on the outskirts.” Temple of Erastil (Ammurun) “Good luck, i’ll be watching you climb the entire way.” (dasa has a very hard time climbing but catches himself, climbs up) When this tree is fully grown, it will rise up in miles, not feet. There’s likely that a large tree would have the ability to talk, more than likely the priest would asks “who took things from you” and it would respond no one or give names. They would then go to the king and they go. Okay. hospitality is revoked. From the burnt quarter down below, a few glowing figures facing the tree, and then they disappear in the light Morven learning about imports and exports? Lift and move things around Eventually make friends with a grizzled dwarven man “Lot of ships from Ensile, notably. Trade seems good this time of year.” What comes in from Ensile? “Flowers, ritual components, the various woods, breads, the like. It’s the breadbasket of the vespertine.” With as much religion here, you’d think they wouldn’t have to import it.
“Most of the Gozreh followers wander. Better imported than grow here. Not much adventure if you travel a mile from home.” True. Odd. Anything unusual? I don’t work around the docks much
“Most of it is normal, but from the soon to be king, Régis Rosaire d'Esmé, they had a shipment that was full of wood, but not that I was a thief, it was full of flakes and a drawing of a rune. I don’t think he’s paying more money but paying more taxes, making it seem like its better for the economy.” Don’t pay him any mind? “He still needs to prove his worth up there, so as long as exports a lot, if they pay for exports, itll feel like exports have been good, it’ll be good.” When was this shipment? “Month and a half ago. I think it went to the palace.” Don’t see too many people out at night “I was dropped on the head on a few rocks, now I cant sleep at night.”
Yurei (disguised as a commoner) asks if anyone has seen the king do any suspicious things at night, hanging out with certain people, etc. The more seedy types are willing to talk about king taking on the old king’s form in the last 5 years
“Slowly but surely, and i wouldn’t want to say anything about the lady of faith. But I feel that lady Sarenrae is being blatant this time. I think it’s a bit unnatural, when there was a time of crisis of who would be the natural king. He was already a grown man! 23! I’m no expert, but he was already grown, and doesn’t go from dark hair to blond.” How does that make you feel?
“Felt like taxes were gonna go up, and I was right! New king was crowned, and the Old King of Tunseel was there torn asunder.” WDYM What’s that about?
“They go to the chamber, among which all the old kings go to the new one, giving their blessing. The last one was torn asunder from the abominations, the Henry Wachter abominations. They go into the chamber, i’ve never seen them declare them not king. Ghost wander all the way back to the city, and disappear. No one else is allowed into the chamber but the king and the ghosts.” “They all look solemn as they realize their time has come and they have to go back to pharasma. But it’s better for most of us, we don’t get to come back for a minute, not even an hour.” “I heard that one lad across the mountain range [story of an alchemist defying nature across a mountain range]” A name?
“Castle Alchemy?”
Companion: “Onarach I believe is his name. Right bastard.” Where’s he now?
“Somewhere in Ruhhat I believe?” Khesvoyna 3, 1264 Augury abt going to dione group: bad Decide instead going to burnt quarter
Church of Light No easy way to say this, but someone has been going through here day in and day out, continuing various priestly duties here to remember something that’s lost Used to be some sort of temple to Sarenrae, an older one first established Beds have been made consistently in the past 2 years, no one has been using them though Bread placed about a week-2 weeks ago Message in Morven’s head when we go to the crypt “get out” Dasa hears the same thing Faint light still flickers down there Every minute, a message goes to Morven if available “i will kill every last one of your kind, leave, or else we both live.” Small bottle with embalming fluid with a tiny bit of flesh, given eyes and a mouth, stares at morven
Dasa goes down into the Church of Light (Crypt) A small voice rings in his head “Then both of our fates are sealed. I’m sorry.” “Just imagine your favorite place.” “Bring him (dasa) back so we don’t need to do this.”
(Creature is unknown, but there was one like Botend Mozes (the gay). There were others like him that were sent to other cities. This one is notably weaker than him, he was a trained killer.) Yurei summons a ghoul and eats it
“It was once the priest of this area before it was kidnapped and shunted to advesperascit. Now it resides over its home that it burnt down. Priest turned monster burnt it down. I only know that it was known as Father Lucrèce de Montluc.”
Priest under Avare Brit, picked to commit twisted justice 2 apprentices underneath him Go back down into the crypt?? P: Hello? “Hello.” P: I am a cleric and I am a ghost. We understand that- “I am a cleric and a freak of nature, just like you.” P: we are in a similar situation, i was hoping we could talk as peers instead of enemies “How long have you walked the earth? How many have you killed before gaining your sentience?” P: A year? “A year that you remember. But undead need to absorb death.” P: to my knowledge, i haven’t absorbed energy, but i feel unwell if i don’t eat “I would simply say that what you are experiencing is what you should be. A man gets to pick what they do and how they eat. We have no such will.”
V: how long have you been residing within the church? Since the divine gate? “Before. Much before. It feels like an eternity. I woke up and it feels like significantly before. I was dormant and kidnapped for months, and the gate opened and all i could see were enemies.” “It was during that time that i knew i was a freak of nature, and could not stop myself.” “I have tried to stop myself since, and an occasional rage occurs.” P: Are you able to keep yourself down here when within your rage? “In my land, I have protection over rage. And I feel anger at those who have a similar condition.” P: similar how? “Similar condition. Such as… being turned into an abomination by another. While in such a state, only death may grant a freedom. I remain a slave of my ways to guide others to freedom. So long as there’s nothing to do on this world, only then shall I remove my chain.” Y: How are you guiding people in the dark? “Someone appears in the dark, the sewers. I find and stalk them, and when they are alone, I free them.”
P: morven may be in a similar condition, but she still has many purposes. There is an attack she must prevent on the monastery that is close to her heart. Until that business is finished- “If the monastery will fall, it will fall.” “As a monster, what can you do about it?” M: you stayed the same person, i’m a new person Combat knock him out Everburning candles in the crypt “The last abominations took them. Ones not unlike you (viktor and yurei). They beat me and took the bodies of some saints.” V: what saints..?
“St. Matin of Toles. Patron of the soldiers and beggers. St. Genevive, the shepard, i’m sure you are familiar. St. Lusu.”
“However, I have a St. Helene body that I am taking care of.” “I attacked you because of the abomination and because you tresspassed.” P: were the people who took the saints, were they sewer dwellers. “That is what I am, they go through infinite tunnels. I’m sure you’re aware. The city is built on the ancient ruins of the once elven nation. The old capital is now covered in shit and piss.” “The temple above was abandoned and will be forever. Should I be able to expire by time, I will not be here by the time it is fixed.” P: can we bring anything to the city? “What confections do I deserve?” A book? “I will die in a righteous way.” “The abominations like the Monk Hunter deserve to be killed. If you don’t try to kill me, I will not kill you.” “The soul of those taken are no longer held within the heart as the body is no longer in the same fate. There will be no point to return the saints. I have resigned myself to it. It is part of my failure.” V: have you encountered the monk hunter before? “She paid me a visit and we shared wine. We used to be comrades during that time. She’s a nice lady despite her proclivity to murder. She was turned like me but still has the old ingrained hatred of religion. I don’t know why she does it. She is shorter, more spindly, multiple arms where her ribs should be.” M: 2 eyes? More? “I believe 4, but it is hard to tell with some of us.” V: glowing figures? “Glowing of the departed. The elves of the old capital stand there and stare.” V: anything besides that? “Sometimes wail and attack those that have the blood of the king. And the king will sometimes come down and slaughter them. If he’s truly righteous, sarenrae would grant him that strength.”
Current king, Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie, has not done this “The spirits go to him when its time. They move 10 meters a night, until 10 nights have passed and they can move freely.” “The gods know what to look for, lest they interfere with divinity.” P: the name of the monk? “She’s a lovely lady. If you meet her, tell her to come kill me.” P: what is her name?
“Just promise me that you will. Tell her that I was a worthy monk, worthy of death. The name was Shino Hakusa.”

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 27
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 26
Next Session: Session 28
WHOOPSIE
Ammurun Best way to avoid political issues is go directly to the king and then leaving Main streets in an unhurried manner
Château Sangblanc - Tunseel’s castle 2 palace guards Look back and forth at each other, seemingly “of course, he will be waiting for you on the 2nd floor piano room” (something they wanted to say, but didn’t. Confused at our arrival)
King Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie (really True King of Tunseel) Odd look, bows to us, dismisses the guards so we can talk “There was something you wished to discuss with me?” P: your majesty, we wanted to thank you for the invitation to tour your lands, we’re headed onwards to see the country, we didn’t want to leave without thanking you. Just wanting to let you know “You understand why i wanted you to tour the country?”
Porlumiè? “And i needed undead for that why?” P: we wouldn’t want to presume “Consider me part of your family now and not a king. Speak freely.” No one is moving outside, odd but the men would stay close in case one were to attack There’s something uncanny that happens for a split second, but can’t put our finger on it P: there’s something different about you since we last met. Have you maybe.. A new style of clothes? “I’m in casual wear.” Odd look, ‘family’ feels especially right to viktor No obvious clues, and the feeling fades “I expected more from a doctor trained in my lands.” P: here’s the thing your majesty. We have in recent times been beset by shapechangers pretending to be people we knew “The shapeshifters would be bold to be a king? They would lose their head if caught. Do you know what I would do if one of you pretended to be me? I would hang viktor to nightfall and wait for him to burn by morning. [explains how he’d kill the others] That’s what I would do if one of you tried to pretend to be me. And neither am I to be something I am not.” Notices us staring at him. “What am I to do to prove I’m human? Bleed for you Viktor?” (threatens phil’s students) P: my liege you let us speak freely? “I said you may speak freely, not that you may speak without consequence.” More power behind the words here than when we met. The other one was 27, unsure. Either this is a different person, acting different, or a whole ‘nother thing. V: my liege we’re simply undead we don’t know what you want from us “I asked for no mission, no location, nothing?”
P: the Anmoku Funeral Parlor…? “Are you actually this dumb? Would you be better as ash?” P: i would prefer not to be ash? “Then you should be smarter. As it stands, i am forced against my will to not drain the blood from all of you and then turn you to ash.” “I have invited a vampire into the land of seven suns, there is a message i need to send. Imagine putting the land on the line, only to discover the undead cannot hold a memory for more than a week?” We start groveling “Lets calm down, you will simply tell me what I ask, and I will let you go. I’ll make sure you’re protected leaving the city.” K: we’re going to viktor’s home province
“Vitry-Seilave, beautiful land.”
“Viktor deserves to see his home. Since you’ve been so kind to me, I will drain your blood at your home. That goes for all of you, except Grundiir. I could argue Brazenthrone, but those spies and those working against our law deserve to get caught.” K: unfortunate about the brazenthrone situation. If it pleases you, we’ll take our leave now. We go back to ammurun main city Guards verify we’re the undead allowed in the city D: hey do you know where the king is right now?
“The king? I believe in Advesperascit right now, why?” D: what’s the king doing there?
“Neutral ground for meeting. Meeting with the nobility of Ulnox and Sabhailn about the Brazenthrone situation that a certain group caused.” WE LEAVE
We respond back to the message from Lume j'Estrilla, an hour outside of the city: “Too late. Did not receive messages. Why should we avoid? Leaving soon.” “Powerful forces beyond both of our control. Avoid sewers and castle if you can. Can’t explain without compromise.” “Understood, we succeeded in one of those things. Anything safe to tell us?” “Powerful creatures. No names are written or spoken in their lands. Cannot send details without being caught. At castle, who did you talk to?” “Ruler, was playing piano. I don’t Know if important. Felt like family to V. Pressed about true destination. Hyperfocused on bloodletting.” “He likes those things. You should know. Will break tablet in one day. Good luck.”
(Various undead who might be part of it, it was a show of appreciation for the first king, Audovère fi'Alémanie the First. Draining them of their blood and then burning their skin.) “Understood. Thank you for the help. Contact us when you can? Happy to hear from you again.” “We’ll be in touch. Thank you. You’re lovely young undead.” Slate breaks Khesvoyna 4, 1264 As day breaks, approached by group of people “Sorry we missed you when you when you were in the capital, we have the rewards for your help to our organization.”
“We understand you stamped out the corruption of those in the higher part of our party. Lady Shanza has decided to reward you.” K: i don’t think we need a reward? “We prepared a thousand gold. Our leader- in the capital of Brazenthrone, you encountered her and thus Lady Shanza was able to rise up the ranks.”
Pheylor Tenthall Take the money, they expected it
Approach Vitry-Seilave 5 days later Khesvoyna 9, 1264 Guards look at us “I suppose you will be seeking refuge in the city.” P: yes if that’s ok? “You have the king’s welcome. We would never do anything against the king, as it were. Especially to you Viktor.” He’s treated this man before, when he was a teenage boy “I see you’ve found a new family Viktor. A sister and all.” “I was hoping that the rumors weren’t true, but it seems my prayers and the prayers of everyone in this town went unanswered.” Woman passes the guardsman She checks our things
Overhear “the rumors true, she was not lying.”
“You remember Sigosti? She still runs the inn.” (dwarven person, weirdly informed of wizard affairs in the area. Studying demons as a holy mage, inherited an inn. Didn’t want to be an innkeeper but is one now) V: I do. Is she doing well? “Yes. It’s just, we never found the body. Same as with the other murders. So we assumed that one such as Kholeran was in town.” V: Who has gone missing? “There will be time for that later. You should sleep first, we have maybe 40 minutes before sunrise.” V: It is late. Early rather “It is early” Person seems a little peeved, ready to kill viktor right now.
Heading to The Sapphire Pipe to rest 3 rooms for us Around noon, a thump against the window with blood Someone has thrown a bat with it’s head cut off at viktor’s window Level up 7

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.title: Session 28
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 27
Next Session: Session 29 Khesvoyna 12, 1264
Vitry-Seilave, The Sapphire Pipe
Sigosti, kind of awkward look of shame “Did you enjoy your rest?” 😬 “No offense, but you’re dead viktor, but after all those years ago, rumors have been circulating. There have people been going missing, and one… vampire.” He hasnt been here for 10 years
Viktor asks about his sister, Sabine Keson The missing people started with viktor, stopped 4 years ago One turned, but he was held in the sun “I do beg you not to be caught in the crossfire.” “Its unlikely they’ll let you strut about town without some brave souls, that were saved by her, some were children and grew up. People that wander the streets, the vegetable sellers, the hunters in the woods. If it meant avenging the person that saved them, i’m sure they’d risk their lives.” “There is a small call to arms and the training of troops, but i don’t know where they’re going. They leave at 8, come back at 5.” “Hope theyre going to fight demons” Viktor backstory time??
He was turned by Dione, that's true He died that night, his sister was there, her name is Sabine, the last thing he remembers is waking up with blood in his mouth His actions have consequences here. uh oh. It wasn't dione being a vampire here after Viktors turning. It was sabine She might be in cahoots w dione now, possibly in control of her feelings bc of this She has been serving as a doctor here after she died (she helped him with studying) Monument to the final founding battle This used to be the sight where the old empire in the valley’s castle stood, it was torn down, this is the only bit that remains Last hold out in the mountains where the first king rushed in and killed everyone No remaining fortifications Unusual stonework Some small unusual bits Seems like some sort of dagger was dug in the side repeatedly Theoretically on its side as much as a stone can be on the side Side facing south would have been at the bottom and the side facing north wouldve been the top Dagger marks seemingly go up and down on the stone, on one side
Local ruler is Berge ir’Azad Shes been the ruler for the past 20 ruler since her father died She falls firmly in the unnotable category Has done the proper rituals of going over the mountains to fight demons Fought a Hezrou Unlike her father, she hasn’t had an extreme fight to deal with Rule of peace isnt a rule held firmly Waiting for one of her siblings to do better or her to do something better under her belt Militaristic rule vs divine Some sway in the church bc killing demons, but still militaristic We are let into the grounds to walk around, look at the blood soaked rock monument Whys the rock like that
“Because once the king of tunseel (Audovère fi'Alémanie the First) demands the blood of the enemies be spilt, it’ll never stop. Not til there’s no blood to spill. He let most of the civilians live, thus their blood continues spilling, and if they rise up, lest we… combat them.” Speeds past the soldiers training Most of the soldiers appear to be notably new, younger, impossible to tell why, but most of them seem unfamiliar with actual spearplay An easier sign of this, 1 sergeant for an unusual amount of privates. Don’t have the leadership. Preparing for mass casualties on the battlefield. If you survive the 1st war, you were very able bodied/hardy/good w sword or spear. This training formal to give confidence, when they survive the 1st battle, they become soldiers. The real training is on the battlefield. Get them ready at the battlefield and then its too late Biggest clue comes from phil who notices they’re not training with holy water or things against demons. You’d expect them to be training to work with holy water if they were fighting the unholy The fact that none have any coating on their blades does imply they’re not preparing to fight anything unholy
Leads us up to the church to Sarenrae and Pharasma, she leads us to just sarenrae parts though The priests don’t exactly like us, but the sarenrae edict isnt to kill undead
“That is the local archwizard’s tower (Drulmoth), he won’t be seeing you at this moment.” “Last time any undead tried to break into the mausoleum, they were promptly killed.” (smiles at viktor and yurei) P: oh perfect! Leads us to royal ground where the ruler is (2.5ft stature. “It’s so kind to have you here.” R: wonderful to be here! “You even brought back the doctor!” V: i haven’t been here for the past 10 years so its nice “Mhm, of course” (she doesn’t believe it, viktor has been killing people here is the common belief) V: how’s the region?
“Going good. We even have been planning to expand your city soon (Frontillé), they found a mine worth its gold they’re going to open. A small mithril deposit down there.”
“Everyone in Tunseel is important. The land, and the people, cannot be so easily replaced.” YIKES “Of course, good doctors are hard to come by. You could always leave this motley crew and become one down in the mines.” “Of course, i’d have to acquit you, people will be angry but i’m sure justice won’t find you.” V: new doctors in the region? “A few here and there, but none as beloved as the Keson family. People missed you. As much as they believed your first murder was healing them, but that is in the past.” V: Have those hallucinations still been happening? That’s a bit of a concerning statement “I haven’t looked into it, im not one of the clergy so i don’t look into the state of SPIRITS.” 4 day downtime Morven Getting the sitch that there are people concerned for our safety Morven isn’t super useful in the mine
A few mention that, “i wouldn’t be here in a few days if you could avoid it. We all know about viktor and… you know what he did. Murdered his sister. IDK if its because- his ma (Léonie Keson) left his pa (Rosaire Fauveau) for her pa (Anatole Keson), but they say the vampire’s first bite is personal.” Why would we leave? “Day or so to send word, day or so to find out if he lives or dies.” I heard people have seen his sister around? “Seeing the sister and seeing the sister alive are 2 different things.” She been helping people? Being a doctor in his stead. I cant really say “Its more of an urban legend.” With the war going on, a lot of you have been training, or is that just some of you? “Mostly volunteer, though they started talking about second child going and someone wants to save their 2nd child, they volunteer before their kid is called.” Phil Leverage connections courtly graces, gather info, learn more about viktor’s sister There is an open secret amongst nobles 2 things, fairly established Archmage has had a vampire occasionally visit They’re all aware viktor’s sister is alive, but because she’s useful and innocent, they don’t report her in any official capacity Rosalind Grocery thing, interacting with workers im going to go around talking to like, working class type people, specifically stores and places that would be open very early or very late (talking to the bakers and like the line cooks at the tavern) under the guise of getting little treats for enjoying the city or getting groceries/other good for the party at large mostly like being a charismatic little guy to see if there's gossip, "are there any urban legends/weird things happening (oblivious child voice)" or "are there any really underground places that are newer than viktor or not mentioned to tourists" places being like establishments. are there cool restaurants or something silly like that that would potentially have information i want but could still be a cute little guy wanting to go to a fun place A few ghost stories in town Notably the hallowed warriors who died with the first king who walk along the bridge to the first king’s gravestone where he was eventually killed Symbollic tombstone, no actual bodies A couple things warned about A guard taking rosalind along the ridge Warning of the people viktor’s killed “He’s killed a guard captain, a fellow of mine, and worked his way down to the common folk.” Scary! I didnt know “If he asks you to travel anywhere, don’t, get us, and we’ll take you out of the area. We serve the people, be they automaton or flesh.” I appreciate ur help, its beautiful “Have a good day, holy construct.” Viktor Trying to find out if dione or anyone associated has been here Not dione by name, but someone of note has been warped in by the archmage at some point, unfortunately during his tracking of her he’d lose her for 10 days at a time Most recent one was 2ish years ago, more recent than not Checking if there’s anyone particularly looking out for Dione’s mentions, but he doesn’t notice anyone Dasa Wildlife shit and nature stuff Commune with animals about vampire Double nat 1 Chatty squirrels =) One saw a lesser demon passing by, they called it a gug but probably a grug Kholeran Blood rock Stones arent supposed to bleed 2 things, but 1 escapes her mind Other is simple, viktor was attacked by a vampire who “needed blood”, she’s allowed in royal grounds, why didn’t she drink blood from the blood rock? Little taste of the blood rock She’s familiar with taste of blood and people, different ancestries have different tastes This appears to be what a mass of petrified people were put together and were constantly bleeding out Tastes good =) very fine, well preserved, aged with sunlight over a millennia Rewrite memory (enhance) on viktor Remember what happened that night She attempted to patch viktor up, crying, but that’s when he woke up, tore his claws into her, and turned her No trickery here, he did just kill his sister
Grundiir fell 1224 years ago, making kholeran is 1354
Party sets out toward Frontillé Stopped by people with torches “I apologize, but we have a way of handling justice here. I do promise, if you leave viktor behind, no harm will come to you.” “We can’t let viktor go, the one he killed has said she does not forgive him. We don’t wish to kill you my lady, or your fellows, but we will do what we must to make sure justice is carried out.” P: if it helps, i am making viktor atone for what he’s done each day “No atonement better than death.” About 50 of them Only 2 are trained soldiers
Goharts Dubos was a bandit who was raided by soldiers, he fought off and reestablished a name for himself
Altier Terinos is a bard of some renown, run across on the road, but he had a soft spot for his sister, given current situation, this is the way to win his spot in sabine’s heart 2 ways to go about this, they’re vulnerable to wildlife but wildlife doesn’t like groups of things We could light a signal fire, signal to the guards to come to this area NEXT SESSION: non-lethal combat against a mob of people
