sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-2.description:
Prev Session: Session 28
Next Session: Session 30 Khesvona 16, 1264
Vitry-Seilave Combat
Convince Altier Terinos to stop fighting “I suppose it is part of the journey that the hero loses to the monster at least once in their travels.”
V: Have you been in contact with Sabine Keson? A: Yes V: Is she well? A: Can you hand this to her and tell her i fought heroically? It’s a love letter V: Are you certain you want me to give this to her? Is there anything unsavory in it? A: Please don’t open it but give it to her V: My younger sister? A: Well she’s like 30 now and also a vampire. I figured it stopped being weird at that point V: She’s still my family A: And hopefully mine too one day V: You’re a very nice man, maybe one day We get some vibes that Sabine is nearby A: We’ve been following the bandit man, he knows V: Can you show us on a map? A: my map skills are (incomprehensible french accent) V: can you show us? A: a tree looks like a tree to me V: we go to the forest? A: just a bit. It’s a cabin in the woods V: did she say anything about not wanting to see me? A: we asked and she said “do as you will”. It appears she was partially indifferent V: i see. I appreciate the information regardless you are very forthcoming A: i am at your mercy. Hopefully i’ll be a vampire also? V: i hope not. My sister is hopefully the first and last A: the last? There have been like 4 or 5 though? These were after viktor was gone Mass hysteria and lying A: So why did you not call in the reinforcements? V: The what??? A: the flare you launched? Certain things that undead cannot see that living people can see Used by undead hunters K: when and where? A: midway, when we were fighting, came from the city, was headed towards you
Follow the wayfinder Goharts Dubos had, toward north 1 thing we notice is a slightly odd rock formation, rocks stacked on top, boulder on boulder on boulder Another is a cabin near a small stream, daybreak is happening Viktor wants to see his sister Knock on the front door A familiar voice that sounds tired says “you’re back early” She doesn’t know who it is
Windows are blacked out during the day, seems like a decent little cabin. Sign of the Dione Group along the mantle
Sabine Keson comes out, sees Viktor, and draws her blade V: I’m sorry S: It’s been a decade V: it has S: i’m sorry the rest of you have to be caught up in this. Please come in and make yourself comfortable V: I don’t want a fight like last time S: last time wasn’t a fight, it was a murder V: I didn’t know what happened. I’m so sorry S: It wasn’t just that you murdered me. It was that you left me V: I’m sorry. There’s nothing I can say. I’m here now S: I don’t need you now. I needed you then V: I heard what you’ve been doing in the area. You’re doing quite well. I’m very proud of you S: thank you but your pride means nothing at this point V: I understand. S: I know you were confused when you killed me. But the others… it doesn’t seem fair V: the others? S: the old guard captain, the day after. A few small children V: I have never hurt a child in my life, or unlife. I swear to you by this S: You are free to wait outside if you all want. She realizes the rest of us can go outside unlike them Viktor could survive out there but Sabine can’t S: I don’t need you and I don’t accept your apology. I’m not a murderer like you so I won’t kill you, but you can’t stay here beyond today. V: You really believe I could kill all those people? S: i know you could kill your own family, so I can believe that you would kill people who don’t matter to you V: But I hardly even… it took a long time to come to terms with what I did to you. It is not… I… S: you didn’t need to come to terms. You needed to be there V: I know… I fucked up. I wasn’t there for you… I don’t want this to be the last time that we talk- S: that’s unfortunate because I do. I have others, they are my family now. V: The dione group? S: They have been very kind to me
V: she is what happened to me S: and you are what happened to me V: i do not believe the situation is what you believe it to be. I would not lie to you S: but you would kill me V: i did not want to. (something) Things change in a decade huh? S: yes. I used to have a human family but now i have an undead one and humans that rely on me V: i’m sorry. My apologies mean nothing but i truly am sorry. S: you can be sorry all you want. Just be sorry far away from me V: and if the dione group is not what you believe it is? What then? S: then i will find a new family. I have been betrayed by one family before. I can find another. It may take a decade but thanks to you I have time. V: have you talked to our parents? Do they know? S: i went to my funeral. At least the part I could attend. It was a morning service. I didn’t dare set foot in the church. Have you talked to them yet? Or is it only me you feel guilty about betraying? V: i have not been back home yet. I don’t think there is much of a home left there for me. S: i see you found a new family. Watch your backs around him V: i hope that we are not at this awkward impasse in the future. S: there’s no awkwardness from me at least. I’ve accepted the monster that you are long ago. You’re the only one that has any feeling residing in him V: perhaps it is for the best that I hold onto this. So that you are able to move on. S: do not make yourself a martyr. You are a vampire that rejects what he has done. You are a monster. They do not exist outside of stories but that is what you have done V: perhaps this monster will be slayed once everything is over. But I still have people to help once I am no longer running away S: be a better person viktor. But alas, we are no longer family. You have those around you. You have, as far as what i have considered my actual life, not been my brother for longer than you have been. V: this is very true. I do hope you stay safe OIL ON THE ROOF IGNITES WITH VAMPIRES INSIDE Theoretically, there are 2 possibilities of bringing the coffin to the building, but any damage to the coffin risk it Vampires in torpor burn slower than vampires not torpored
(man named Gorvain Lecrân)

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-3.title: Session 30
sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-3.description:
Prev Session: Session 29
Next Session: Session 31 Khesvona 16, 1264 Drink of the day: stake Combat: Viktor steps forward with a stake in his hand, his sister looks at him with fear in her eyes
Viktor’s sister is not hesitating to kill him Sabine Keson He has set the woods full of traps, specifically in areas of deep shade in the direction of the retreating night Dasa hears a door closing near the cart One of the cart side doors Into the coffin you go Chain suspensions are relaxed, indicates that there is not someone inside
Exiting from the otherside are fairly large feet, medium creature of decent build Is standing (invisible), or went flying Dasa realizes someone bigger got to the cart 2nd (morven) Morven opens the door, still has the same scents left in there “Sorry for turning morven into a puppygirl” -zack Phil tries to detect magic, whatever is in the coffin is in the coffin Some oddities left A wayfinder, the north compass is vaguely pointing east Head to an abandoned inn to hunker down for the day Feel like tracks are covered Nothing seems to have rigged it, some undead recently used a winecask in the basement as a makeshift shelter Long rest, wake her up at dusk Time to unsteak, victor in the r0pom with the party in the next She does not wake Medicine check from Viktor, she probably just needs to rest for an hour to feel better Healing the sister but she still doesn’t wake up The issue isnt with her, her clothes are torn but that is expected given circumstances Under the pillows, in the lining, a small bottle that was crushed when her body was put in We don’t know what it is, Viktor isnt very good at crafting Time for a tactical yurei Even yurei does not know what it is, it was a pretty good roll too It is highly specialized and not a generic substance Puncture? Oil? We can’t really tell what happened, but it probably went dead center into her spine
Back to Vitry-Seilave Look at us, “cold feet about home, viktor?” V: something like that…
Augury on going to the Archwizard in Wizard Keep (Vitry-Seilave) Answer: mixed. Good and bad Approach the gates “Who are you trying to see?” V: archwizard “Under what pretense?” Give a letter
S. is incapacitated, we believe the Dione Group are the only ones who can help. We have her with us. Guard looks at us, sighs, realizes he has to deliver it, goes up the stairs, into the tower Significantly 45 mins pass Return back with “Drulmoth will see you now.” “He does request you take the coffin with you.” Allowed to go up He doesn’t have any guards, bows to us
“I understand you are with the king’s entourage, or at least his courtesy.” Yes “Now. You have something I am interested in let’s not waste each other's time:” “You actually have her, how did you come about her?” J: I’ve been trying to track her down after many years spent not by her side “You decided to come back after all this time just to torpor her?” J: That was not the intended thing to happen, unfortunately when we arrived at her cabin we were reunited momentarily and then the cabin was set on fire, it is a miracle to even be standing here. But that is unfortunately where things went wrong, we got her somewhere safe and then when we removed the stake form her heart, it appears someone lined the coffin with something and she has not woken up. I do not know what it is. “Of course. Place the coffin down and take a few steps back.” We do it He steps up from behind the desk and takes a look, then casts a spell on her. Viktor somehow succeeds an arcana check, 3rd nat 20 of the session. Spell is checking if its actually her or if its a trick to gain an audience He really doesn’t seem to care about her wellbeing, “her kind are heartier than you may be” He’ll look up towards the ceiling and sighs, “make yourselves comfortable and if you draw any blade I will kill you myself” “I do not know what is going on with her and I have no interest, but my associate does .” He could disintegrate us all uwu aberdeen level She walks down slowly, she is smiling with fangs “Little Viktor, I wish we met under more favorable circumstance”
ITS Dione J: certainly, you are a hard one to track down “I think the chase gives it a bit more thrill teehee” “It seems that somehow, you’ve killed your better half again.” J: She’s not dead “But yet she does not wake” J: it wasnt me “Just like it wasn’t you last time, you were in deep denial that it was me that did it” “Are all your problems solved now? If you want I’ll let you torpor me, you can bite through my neck if you want, would it make you feel better?” J: Not now but maybe one day “Now little Viktor, we don’t have to be enemies” J: Why do you call me that? This is our second time meeting “You are quite small and quite my junior are you not?” Big Wife, 6ft tall “You wound me so, you decided in the chase to take on a new family and a new sister when I collected one just for you back here. You would not believe my shock when I saw you already replaced her, I'm quite old and it still takes me over three decades to get over someone J: I never got over it “Well the same, when she wakes she will come back to our family and I want you to know there is a place for you here. I don’t want it so that every other generations of our family hates the others.” J: And how many generations has this been? “It's not about how many generations it's about how long it’s been. J: And how long has it been? “Thousands of years J: that is quite impressive “So after it's all said and done you can join our family, it's what your sister would want” J: I'm afraid she wants nothing to do with me, her words have made it very clear “That's not important, don't you want a family again, to be a part of her life? You're going to live forever you might as well be happy J: And are you happy? “Yes of course I have a beautiful family and endless woman and men that chase after me it seems” J: I need to know, why me that night? “You were close, you were a kind soul that helped a woman and I needed some blood J: Is that it? Just because I dared to help you? “I’ll let you know, I’ll even let you know where it was, it will be of great import to all the rest. But only if you’ll let me see what was taken of me. J: What was taken? “My grand childer, to embrace someone is to take them as a husband or wife but I assume you don't want to think of it that way viktor. You can be my husband and she can be my wife” [OOC Discussion of how freaky vampires are, turnso ut the blood soaked noble that takes from the people and gives nothing back might eb a metaphor for royalty] “Please, it is much better than the alternative J: The alternative? “Like i said, you as a husband to your sister./ Poor sabine uwu” J” It is better, I am not a fan of that interpretation “I have to ask since we are talking now, do I have any great grand childer or any grand childer to know about? J” not that I am aware of? Were you the cause of the people who were killed in the past sixish years “No, no more than I am the cause of you murdering you own sister uwu” J: Then perhaps there is one unknown of “Don’t worry , if you want to know why your sister is handy with a sword I taught her how to take care of herself and get rid of dangerous vampires like the who killed her” J: What do you get out of this? “A family , I get to take care of someone who I indirectly brought into the world since the one who did it did not. Plus you and your sister are quite cute 😘” J: So what, has this been a cat and mouse game?
“No I’ve been on important business and you are slow. You almost caught me, you beheaded someone I was about to turn (Yniesse Zenderholm) and then had kholeran eat her judging buy the status of the remains:” J: You fucking would, it feels so good knowing I was right “Congratulations you're a very smart boy “ J: So what? “So were going to get revenge on the fucker who decided to take out your sister. I just need you to give me any clues about where they are and I’ll take care of it to the best of my ability” Viktor pulls the wayfinder out of the bag of holding She looks at it, shell look towards the wizard, “Go ahead, they can't do anything no matter what they have in that bag” Viktor brings over the wayfinder “You put this in some sort of extra dimensional space I presume? They have done the same in the time you’ve been traveling. J: That is all we had left over. I presume you know where her cabin is “Yes I built it” We describe how the crime was committed “My best guess is that it is a magus. They actually work as a group, the alchemist does not need to be on the battlefield to supply” “We have a common enemy Viktor, unless you don't want revenge for your sister “ J: I do, if this is the only way to meet you and find out what you are really like, I’m glad that she is “She is a worthy sacrifice for that goal, is that what you're saying?” J: No “Viktor you don’t need to be so hateful, why do you hate me J: you ruined my life “Your life wasn't much anyway you used to be a small town doctor and now you're doing something so much more important J: Is that really what I’m doing
“Yes of course, people who commune with gods know of you. Pharasma HERSELF KNOWS YOUR NAME” J: and you? Does pharasma know your name? “Of course, but that would require me to trust you first. And it’s just my years of experience telling me that you seem a little hostile towards me” J: i will work with you on eliminating the person who hurt my sister, or at least getting revenge. “And what about after that? J: that is the question “I see no reason why we couldn't be friends J: We’’ll see what happens in the time between “So there's a chance. Might I ask, I know you've done it, how is my sire doing? [OOC: UGH, OOF< augh] J: I would say that he is doing fine all things considered “Just fine?” J: Just fine “I would like to talk to him myself, do you know where I might find him?” J: Not right now “Now viktor, I wish to just end the cycle of violence right now going back to my grandsire. He betrayed him and so I had to betray him and now it seems you are seeking the same, your sister tried to stab you through the heart” J: She had every reason “He decided that some people were more important than family, your grandsire is certainly a traitor, he chose his own personal beliefs over honor. Thats not a very Tunseelian way for a general to contain himself J: A general? “What name does he go under now Viktor”
J: Vlaundet Thane (Lume j'Estrilla)
“The vampire that died in Ciburn?” (Vlaundet Thaine) J: I know he has taken a name to be anonymous “Vlaundet thane died unannounced to the public, six years ago/ So if I find this Thane it will be my sire pretending to be him, would it not?” [OOC: You might’ve just burned one of his covers]
“His name was General j'Estrilla,” (Lume j'Estrilla)
Lore time: Notably a general that claimed a decent amount of land for Tunseel 900 years ago, secured the southern border, and built the only successful city on that dangerous peninsula, and then one day his boat arrived empty to the capital, a ghost ship on the dock His first name, ironically if he is a vampire, is Lume
“Don’t worry I will find him eventually and stop his incessant worrying and anxieties whichever way I can, And then I hope I won't have to do the same to you, we can be family y ou me your sister and your grandsire ("True King of Tunseel?) J: And who is my great grandsire? “You’ll meet him in due time. He has some questions about you.” Rosalind notices its the royal you, not just Viktor but everyone here and he knows quite a deal about you There is an implication that her grand sire does not know about you meeting like this, this is theoretically behind his back [All will be well counter +1] “Viktor would you like to know a little secret that might give the game away?” J: Yes wizard, telepathic message going on, he stands up and walks out Shell stand up and walk towards viktor ”Do you want to know why I gave you the embrace that day? J: yes
“I was looking for a set of runes which had appeared with the awakening of someone quite dear to me. (looks at yurei) Unfortunately they were protected even during the middle of the night by the light of the sun. and i simply needed a little bit of blood to help me complete my tasks, but my duty called me elsewhere, i would've stayed with you truly” Auntie Miko? Pharasma? Sense motive: she would’ve, she had a group of vampires she raises with incredible care and love. You were just incredibly unlucky Viktor “I know you've been looking for them and you've come into contact with a few of my associates in such a thing, but I wish not to hold you back from what you need to do. I am going to help you find out the fuckers that did this to her, if I find the fucker that burned it down I will capture him alive and bring him to you and we can burn him as family” “I will do everything in my power to ensure this goes according to the best way I see forward J: What is the best outcome? “You leaving this group and the promises of old coming to fruition J” The promises of old? “You'll get to know that when I trust you a bit more, you still have that lust of killing me in your eyes [OOC: Zaaaaack WAAAAATKINSSSSSS] (SHE TELLS US THE LOCATION) “It's a good deal and if you don't take the rune by the time if get back with the information, I’ll take it myself, afterall it would be a shame for him to die for nothing after all” “One of us has to take it that way your death means something”

Vitry-Seilave
Dione leaves with Sabine Keson’s body
Drulmoth, “if you don’t need anything specifically from me, i ask that you leave the tower.” We buy a scroll of sending for 300 from him
Leave the city, sending to Lume j'Estrilla: "dione is aware of your current disguise and likely our contact, apologies. act carefully. investigating Frontillé. why would the king send us to Porlumiè too?" Seemingly upset, “to find the man who betrayed his captor. Unfortunately, I'm compromised, don’t keep in touch.” (king had figured out the missing general - captor refers to true king, the person he’s looking for was j'Estrilla [fake Thaine])
(1 name was said outloud. If Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie was sending undead there, "True King of Tunseel would send spies down there) We’re pretty good at covering our tracks, we’re good the entire way as far as we know. Stopping by the rock
Kholeran knows: Belongs to a religion from the south, druidic circle, belonged to a group of lizardfolk that inhabited the valley (from before the Earthfall, could be a lost civilization, Vechiem Civilization) Supposedly pretty nice
Recorded history states this was an elven valley before taken over by Vespertine Empire We copy it down for later Burnt down house Able to determine place was ransacked right after the cart left
There was something there once, a notes box made of stone, a symbol of the Dione Group. Notes taken out, box discarded 100ft away from the cabin Person went 100meters into the forest, and then disappeared. If had short range teleport, many mountains and hills (worlds without numbers thing? More likely zack military thing)
Speak with plants about the figure who disappeared “He left. Just up and disappeared.” Was it through the air or the ground? “He was standing on my root, and then wasn’t. Didn’t pass by my leaves either.” Speak with animals, birds Did you see the figure disappear? “Went (points toward the east)” Do you have any general description of the figure? Hes the one who set the fire “One of your kind, 2 arms, 2 legs, tusk-ish.” Colors? Tall? “You plus your foot?” (tall-ish) “Tusky, tall, green, black and red.” Did it send anything outside its hand? “It threw its sword when waiting. Flew back flew forward flew back. Want 3 little white things from Dasa for information, switches to wanting all, hard bargaining with bird Its bread “To the south there is delicious berries that don't have a scary man watching it. The ones that stare in the field (scarecrow). It is clothed in fine jewelry, stands still, when i fly toward it the wind blew and i saw it move. It doesn't sleep.” Gives the bird 10 loaves of bread Writing on snake to auntie
Hi ms miko this is yurei’s friend, where do the runes go when Ume eats them? Half a day later, “to me, of course, the rightful owner. What the snake eats gets sent to me.” We met a vampire who claims to have a connection to you, do you know Dione? “I have no idea who that is.” The person poisoning auntie in the memory we saw couldn’t be Dione because she’s way too young (we all desperately try recall knowledge about things that happened in session 18 Khesvoyna 19, 1264 Go to the rune Vitry-Seilave Buried History No traps outside, we start at the hallway of the building that got eroded by time Relatively fresh bloodstains on the floor past the locked door, possibly from rats getting caught in the traps Unusual stonework Throw a rock, spectral blades eviscerate it, too hard to be destroyed, appears that this trap affects physical creatures by weight on the floor Philomene floats thru the hallway, thrashing noise to the west Fire gives no warmth Viktor disables the pressure plates, there was probably a puzzle, but he disabled it by force Thrashing sound is big but distant, sounds closer than it is, thrashing against stone, sounds very large To the west: a dark room with iron bars, offering plates Past iron bars, fountain with more offering plates, 2 dusty levers to open the bars Send in Dasa to tie rope onto one lever Dasa casts light, only for a split second he sees a small creature hanging on the ceiling drooling before disappearing Dasa believes he ties one lever and Morven pulls on the rope and bodyslams into an offering table as it slips, Dasa did not tie the rope correctly Kholeran walks him through how to do it, the gate is halfway up She goes through before the rope snaps so she can do the lever The party goes thru the open gate, tactical Yurei to make the gate stay over using a wedge It seems like someone intentionally broke the lock so that the gate would stay closed The creature that Dasa saw: had green dripping from its jaws, found claw marks in the room What he saw was a hound of tentalos (ooc theyre creatures that hunt time things) Gate has odd colored metal that might have blocked our vision of it Door to the left, crackling noise Desiccated corpse, preserved with runes with lightning arching between Cold fire remains Familiar sight to funeral parlorsties Similar to how morven was formed Proto-morvens? Ancient body that was a failure and just left here, still has blood Book with indecipherable runes, we take the book Door to the left: a stairwell leading downward Grates to deal with excess blood and body parts Doors, one on right has the wheezing breathing sound again, the north door sounds like real fire and the very faint sound of a fountain Door to the north: Coffin held down with chains Knock from within the coffin Another odd-runed book Cabinet with various rotted implements Augury about opening and engaging with the thing in the coffin Mixed Detect magic, 10th rank magic coming from it We talk to it thru the coffin: Rosalind says: Hello can you hear us? Rasping, sound of something slightly moving. Someone adjusting their shoulders in their sleep R: are you awake? Can you respond? No response, but there is tapping. 3 intentional taps with 1 finger on the coffin R: if youre tapping intentionally, tap once to say yes Five taps R: are we safe in the room and temple? 3ish taps Possibility the thing doesnt understand our language R in modern necril: can you understand? 10 taps, 6 from rosalind’s side, 4 from otherside Kholeran in old necril: tap once if you understand me 4 taps Rosalind throws his voice into the coffin, can you understand this differently (necril) 5 taps R: 4 taps if better? 11 taps, 6 on far side, 5 on close side R: if you can do anything to help us, do it in the coffin, do that, and if not, do nothing and do not tap 3 taps
Viktor’s Tunseel lore gives nothing. This is like a foreign land within the country Fountain next door, radiating - We open a door that reveals the wheezing creature Door to the right: eerily silent, multiple ft thick door Door to the north: don't quite sense anything, but sound of someone holding their breath but having trouble doing so

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-3.description:
Prev Session: Session 31
Next Session: Session 33 Khesvoyna 19, 1264
Vitry-Seilave Coffin is incredibly old design, chained to the ground, cant open on its own Combat against irnacurse Torture some repeatedly until their flesh goops, give them curse of immortality Notably created from elves The area begins to fill with green gas WATER IN THE DUNGEON ACTS LIKE SUNLIGHT Thing in the coffin is a necromancer Holding room with small unlit fireplace and various cages for people and bones littering the floor Kholeran tastes the things Discerning who they were is probably out of the question, down here long enough they forgot how to speak despite being able to do so We open a closet and go into initiative Hound of tindalos staring at morven maze Scary glowing corner with orb-like button Activating button makes A feasting room??? Priests in the paintings Start preaching at us Need strength for the apocalypse, strength-based cannibalism eating their enemies Armory
Vechiem Civilization Locals of the valley Lucky we know the name
Inspo for Audovère fi'Alémanie the First to take back was was taken through Bottomless pit Clanks against metal, then whirling as copper piece is grinded into dust Blood coin room Skeleton with bleeding bones but money Dasa touches the skeleton, chains slowly unwrap Another book we cant read Script/symbols make this appear to be a language that went out of style 1500-1600 years ago Yurei takes the book Another necromancer “I see! I’m sorry, but this workstation is occupied.” Y: can i look around? BIG fan of necromancy work “Thank you, i figured this would be the best place to take my revenge.” Y: oh yeah! Tell me more “The city above harmed me, so i am going to raise dead to attack them.” Y: whats your name?
“Hevech.” Y: where are you from? Why are you here?
“I tried to make a home above, but the people kicked me out. So vengeance it is! The people of Frontillé will know hurt.” (brings out an undead giant, zombie hulk) Y: did you summon this, or was it already here? “Already here, i just found a way to reanimate the body. The way i see it, with this thing, i wont have to raise a finger.” “I dont do a lot of summoning, i do a lot of creating.” Y: a ritualist? “Of a sort. I have my own spells, but theyre not good for summoning.” (she wants to just like. Destroy the storekeeper) Y: when are you gonna send this guy up there? “A week. Its a work in progress, and I wanted to make another. I wanted to make another, but the parts are in between.” “There is another one, but it guarded by an annoying psychopomp. He tried to give a sermon to me, and i ran away while he wasnt looking.” V: where was that? So we can avoid it “Down in the lower reaches.” Y: where did you learn?
“The southern parts, the Ulmancy Forest area. Its just east of Jafatan.” Y: more necromancers down there? “I’m one of a kind, i’m technically a bogard by half-parentage. But i would avoid the psychopomp, it seems quite powerful and antithetical to our work.” P: what type of psychopomp? “Not a very religious gal, i can’t tel you. It had a shell on it and hunched over shoulder.”
(shokie. There to lead wayward souls to the boneyard, pretty powerful. Reasonable for us to take on, but we should rest.) “[area above] It was a water control station, but that’s all i know.” Y: there was a coffin up there, know anything? “I tried to open it, but i’m not that strong. I’m gonna drag it out and have this guy open it.” Y: whats in it? “Given this is a tomb to a great necromancer, probably him.” P: know anything about the history of him? “I dont know, just know the decorations apply to him. He is quite cunning, depending on the traps he left. The blob monsters he made are quite powerful. And if the far reaches are interested in keeping him confined in time, who am i to say? Who am i to judge some of our methods? He’s done stuff that the two of us could aspire to be.” “Did you turn all of these? Is that your father?” Y: no! It’s my brother! I did make that blue one “Small for my tastes. Its good, its just…. I didnt expect it to be so small!” Y: i can summon giants, and owlbears “You seem like a hardy bunch, i could pay you all to go down there to deal with the psychopomp. The switch to open the gate is here!” Y: we’d like to rest if you dont mind “Of course, i just stick myself to the wall and fall asleep that way.” Lets kholeran and yurei’s ghoul Meat appears to be finely aged, pickled in the acid to preserve it from rot Appears the acid leaves certain bits of flesh alive Hill giant, reanimated, inside of which, some preserved smaller bodies in the guts so it can take others out of its rib cage and throw it V: what exactly happened in frontille? “I did what my father said, i claimed it as a domain to make a horde, and the shopkeep kicked me out.” “My dad would not lie to me about frontille.”
“My dad is the dragon Serenia.” “My dad is downsouth, preparing for the newcoming age.” Y: is he also a necromancer? “A very wise one!” V: the newcoming age? “The times are changing, we had an age 1000 years ago. I thought this was common knowledge.”
K: i thought Grundiir would be eternal “Oh very old. My father has a great sum of gold, she would be well taken care of, we’d put her in a cage where she can chase fresh meat.” Rest Khesvoyna 20, 1264 Lower Seilave Viktor and yurei feel sick because of sickly green light “Will you submit peacefully?” D: what if i didnt come from a corpse? “You would be a psychopomp, but you wouldn’t have killed these undead so i would have to kill you.”

Vitry-Seilave Fighting the shoki psychopomp He had a giant statue in the water???? Shoki is considered both undead and alive
GOD DAMN IT Ume EATS THE rune We go to the coffin
Mummy crawls out, speaking unfamiliar tongue Y: hi he or she or they!
“Uthatcho. You?” Y: those are pronouns?? “...Yes.” Y: oh ok. Im yurei. These are my besties. Thats my brother viktor, kholeran, morven, phil, etc. we may have freed you i think “The… new blood. Correct?” Huh? “New guardian, new god servant.” K: i did learn that the gods are all dead
(talking about Pharasma who wouldve just become a deity when he went under.) Y: ummm idk if pharasmas still around “The servant still alive or dead?” Dead “Which death?” Wdym “True death, first death, second death.” P: IDK we defeated in battle but didnt do anything special (pharasma is god of death but various states of death she normalized death and became god. Set up actual death (true death) other deaths separated. He came before death or undeath) K: it turned into water, thats all we know “Can’t hold me. No worries.” K: now that youre out of the coffin, what are you wanting to do? “Reestablish kingdom, take back lands. How many years has it been?” Y: who locked you up? Was it that guy? “Myself. Needed time to prepare and wait out the longlived ones.” Y: so you locked yourself in here? “Only for a time, but was kept in here.” Y: we’re not sure how long youve been here, but about 4000 years “Where are the people? My people.”
K: we would know them as the Vechiem Civilization and they seem to be gone “Other like me to rule.”
(lizardfolk in Caldera and Yenitaht) We say that “What is caldera and yenitaht” Yurei shows maps “Will go there then. Thank you.” Yurei gives a coupon “Symbol to find you?” Y: in a way yes! “Will be in touch.” Teleports away We take the books
We go to the other necromancer Hevech “Oh youre back! Howd it go?” Y: we killed him, but this place might collapse. We mightve removed smth that would keep it structurally sound. We’re gonna leave soon, so you might leave too.”
“Oh so the assault on Frontillé starts today? I did promise a reward.” (gives us a bag of jingling bag.) She goes to leave, we try to convince her to stay for the night R: i do think we suffered injuries, i do believe we want to rest, we can cook and provide lodgings and food that have no chances of collapsing? “I see no reason to hurry up, they’re all going to die anyway. Those that die will die anyway.” R: we all know intimately how we all die, so there’s no reason to hurry
“I plan on becoming a lich like my father.” Dasa goes down in the crypt area The area the psychopomp was guarding, theyre skulls crying the stream The crying is channeled into the water that provides holy light in the area Some small interesting parts, under moss there are reliefs carved into walls. Maidens on a voyage to a large city on an island, put one on the throne, the others leave the throne, travel to the mountains, the relief ends at a crypt currently held shut Dasa opens the crypt Morven and phil arrive, hear a tomb lid open Skeleton in the tomb is preserved, wearing a maiden dress Has some small rings Magical Beautiful green gemstone that matches his own Dasa puts the ring on, it fits Dasa puts the body in the water, sees the bones float normally Proto-psychopomp skulls, anyone touching would be hurt But dasa is touching them with his bare bones Dasa’s wearing what appears to be an artifact, mostly inert, that belonged to the processions of maidens who travelled with the maiden who would become pharasma Morven touches the ring, she takes 2d8 vitality damage Dasa tries to take the skeleton of the SAINT OF PHARASMA He wanted to take it bc its so mysterious and related to him Morven touches the corpse, the skulls stop crying and begin chanting Proto-psychopomps calling for another psychopomp If there’s one available, they’ll teleport to this place as long as the body is disturbed Dasa can touch it and the chanting stops, theyre crying again Theyre not sentient but aware Dasa tries talking to the skulls D: hello! Skullsties! They dont respond Dasa rubs one of their heads, picks up a skull and leaves the room (it stops crying, doesnt chant) Morven touches it, harmed for 12 damage, it begins chanting again Only chants while being touched by morven Group topside exits, there is someone waiting for us
Eldara Ferncla
“You’ve been marked for death. Master Vlaundet Thaine is upset with you all. Master, now lady, marked it as betrayal.” “I was here to kill you. But i’m willing to strike a deal.” R: im sure we can come to an arrangement “Mr thaine is keeping a secret from me, and now she wants you dead, but at her heart, she’s still a coward. Afraid of that secret that i want, so if you were to learn it…” “I’ll you even kill me. If you’re able to kill me, he’d consider you too powerful to attack. It wouldn’t be worth the risk for him.” Whats the secret
“About who his sire is, how he came to be, and who it is. I understand that it is the "True King of Tunseel, but i don’t know who, and i don’t know what. Unfortunately, i, despite my disposition, dont have access to spells and knowledge you have access to.” Y: would you be against this deal being on paper? “Id prefer it. I understand it binds you magicians.” (she has no ability to cast spells) She wants to kill the sire, but doesn’t know why thaine wouldn’t tell her “I have a way to track people if i know their name and identity. I have met them on battlefield before. I met it but i could not make out their face, and i only noticed their spear when it pierced me.” She was in the area, there are still people to kill.
Auntie Miko writes up a REALLY good contract
Gives us a loophole where we can say an alias and be spared (we can say the true king of Tunseel and be good) She doesnt seem to notice the loophole “You kill me to get her trust and fear. She will likely, at one point, to reach out and make a deal and that is how you find out her sire. She is a coward at heart, she will avoid fighting someone that could kill her.” Steal the tiny giant Can do holy water on it If you put something that is shrunk in smth that it cant fit and it expands, itll get crushes Viktor goes and throws it into the crushing hole, it squelches dead “Just make sure [the one who kills me] is not viktor, or i will fight back.” Kholeran chews through her, fucks it up Necromancer is confused about where her giant went, checks the acid pit R: i dont believe ive cast shrink before but he shouldve stayed with you no?? “I dont know where he went…” Y: we can help you look R: if hes meant to be larger, it shouldnt be a difficult task “I suppose it would be good to look together” We take two long hours of “helping her look” phil/dasa/morven return, with three skulls from the tomb! Yay! Not even crying! Finely preserved, made of bone-white stone, not actual bone The bones seem a bit too heavy to be actual bone, some sort of carved stone Party rests Khesvoyna 21, 1264 Level 8

sessions/undead-campaign/act-2/session-3.description:
Prev Session: Session 33
Next Session: Session 35 Khesvoyna 21, 1264
Leave Vitry-Seilave across a few days, first to Cieltsuk, then the outskirts of the town Ammurun Khesvoyna 24, 1264 Walk through town is simple, most undisturbed
Kholeran feels an odd feeling (probably our bestie Homveran)
Dasa goes to talk to the big tree Memoirebebur
Same monk is there from last time Ammurun Priest of Erastil “Welcome back!” D: yeah, ive been meaning to climb the tree again, i had a noble time, it was great “Let me accompany you.”” D: has the tree changed at all? “No its growing as steady as ever” D: what makes it so important “Its size, and the fact that it seems to be growing nations as it grows.” D: so do you just climb everyday? “Not everyday, i climb 3 times a day.” D: how many have died falling off? “Not that frequent, happens once every 2 months.” D: i see. So how often do you commune? “3 times a day.” D: are the convos good? Are they spicy? “Spicy?” D: do you have gossip? “I ask for wisdom-” D: 3 times a day?? “3 times. One should pray 3 times a day to live a good life. How often do you pray?” D: once a month? “You should do it more.” D: once a month was fine for me back at the temple “What temple was it again?” D: DW abt it D: i wanna know what wisdom you hear “It talks of distant lands.” D: may i? “That is why we are up here.” “If youre afraid of the knowledge being too potent, i understand, but you should always ask. If it harms you, thats how it was meant to be.” Speak with plants - D: hey tree, whats the history with this place?
“This place, i have learned its to be called Tunseel under the new people. It once belonged to an elven nation, and i am told those who belong here are no longer elves. It used to belong to the lizards (Vechiem Civilization) before that.” D: what started your growth? “When i was a seed.” D: why are you so big? “Because i am supposed to be a world tree like that to the south.” D: what tree? “Father. Or mother.” D: how many others? “On yours there are but 2, on mine, there are 5.” D: do you know where brothers or cousins are?
“When is surrounded by spires, another in a dense toxic fog, another is the world itself, one is me, one is building itself on the ocean.” D: how do u feel abt tunseel? “No different than those who have come before than me.” “The moon has started shining brighter, and soon itll split like the sun before it.” D: abt the moon, how does that work?? “I do not know, but i do know the moon fell upon this nation 6 years ago.” D: the tree was so wise! “For your soul, a week is a good start. I look forward to seeing you again.” Eventually the kholeran electricity stops before we leave Khesvoyna 28, 1264 Back to the first cave
Through the days travel of the mountain cave Mine between Tunseel and Ensile, arrive at the outskirts of Uisu Khesvoyna 29, 1264 Town quietly going about business as if we never showed up
Goodsong Tavern Manage to see the halfling currently working behind the bar/stables Turns and faces us “Oh youre back! I have bad news, nothing too bad, but i dont have room for you. If you need to hide viktor, he can hide in the cellar.”
“Monk hunter was back a month ago, but Kasumi wasn’t here so i dont think its a mark against her.” M: has there been any notice when shed come back? Kasumi or the hunter
“I believe she’ll be back a week and a half, Shalana- she’s smart but not subtle. Sent kasumi on a 3 week mission, so it’ll be that time, i reckon.” M: its been a hot minute since i saw her, but i dont want to see any harm come to her. If theres anything to help out, id love to do that’ “Itd be the right thing to do, but i wouldnt expect a warm admission. Afraid to say, but if the monk hunter could beat her, you dont stand much chance.” M: hard for shelana to know the past of things, but she meant a lot to raghni and id like to pay it forward “You know how its settled, if you go in, expect a fight.” M: ist here a way to send a message in through you? M: just let her know, if you see her, if she wants help with the attacks i am here to help, but i dont want ot go in and cause disarray “I know your heads a bit scrambled, but shes not going to askf or help, youre just gonna have to do it. Best i can offer is a stable, rooms are taken. Youre free to camp out.” “Some travelling salesmen are staying.” V: what are they selling? “IDK but theyre staying.”
Go to the temple (everyone minus yurei and morven) Temple of Erastil (Uisu) Shelana greets us “Youre back. Did you bring the… the necromancer with you?” R: we left them, we understand your wishes. They’re somewhere else. “You were in tunseel?
P: you didnt hear? The king (Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie) extended us an invitation “I thought he didnt like the undead” So did we P: he possible doesnt, its a political thing with many layers. “Well poltics arent my strong suit, P: we got info about the monk hunter “What do you know?”
P: we know theyre an abomination creature that goes by the name Shino Hakusa.” “An abomination?”
P: we had it described to us, they were a victim of Henry Wachter. A priest who was unable to die told us about it in the hopes we do something. They are spindly and had many arms. 4 glowing eyes” “Shes covered fully, her short statured. She had 2 eyes but was covered.” P: its possible she can cause perception alteration “Maybe, but how does this help us fight?” P: it gives you more info, knowledge that you are not working with someone who is bound by limitations of normal human movement. “Maybe. If you wish, you can observe the fight and come to the conclusion yourself. I wouldn’t wish for you to join.” P: what if we prove to you that we’ve improved ourselves, and morven has been studying monastic tradition, and let that determine us being permitted to assist you. “You may fight, but i do not wish for the help of morven.” V: why dont you wish for morven to fight?
“I dont respect what has happened to Raghni.” P: we did speak briefly to raghni, it was their wish for us to take care of the whole of morven instead of revenge. They seemed sad but- at peace, but sad that we were visiting where she was attacked “That was her wishes, and these are mine.” (simple fact, its not about what morven is. She already sent out one of her pupils to avoid danger, and she doesnt want to put her other one in danger. Shes fine with the rest of us fighting, just not morven.) Vampire = D'Ambrue
Marquis d'Vauren = lord that died

Theyve taken care of me all my life, theyre also a dhampir, theyre lovely and kind, and also us “Will i grow ears too??” R: no theyre unrelated General: as the doll said, you wont become a monster, and thus i have no reason to kill you Dasa talking to rats? - Heyy little buddies, i have some questions would you mind if i asked “WHOA THE BIG FELLA TALKS” “Never known one of yous being able to talk” This is great im willing to entertain ur talkery Do you know what happened in the battle around here? “Might. Whats in it for us” “Are you one of those kings” Noo im just a humble traveller “We can arrange an accident betwen us, see that top shelf. Be a shame if someone knocked over one of the pots in it” Kholeran grabs one it starts squealing “THERE WASNT A BATTLE” “A battle is like THIS, it was more like ‘play along’ (bites at a rat, the other falls instant)” “One with the rod, 2 rod in hand, walk through taller than the big one that sits now” Any biting as well? “One tried to bite big one, but it stabbed quickly, and before i saw all of them dead, and they didnt even leave bodies behind.” Daytime or nighttime? “Nighttime.” Any details what the figure looked like “Tall, big ear, bigger than the monster, devourer. Sharp like palm.” Would you happen to know any good spots to ask other friends, id give more cheese “More friends have more eyes, more eyes mean see more things.” “I grab from wall” DELUGE OF RAT FROM WALL Hair = black and short Lanky in size or wide? “Wide? White.” Hunters arrived at the courthouse, announced themselves, fought, then the general showed up about an hour later. Im sorry, but i thought youd understand of sacrificing evetrything for your beliefs “I am about to sacrifice everything for my beliefs, that the dead should stay dead.”
P: how are they going to do that with the boneyard left unattended? “That is not my role to find.” P: but it COULD be. You CAN help. That is much more of a rejection than choosing to stay in this state. If you want to kill yourself you can do it after you find pharasma! She tries to cast a spell but it fails “I will take the decision into my hand. Allow me to do my jobs as a priestess and tend to the bodies one last time.” V: of course. Your brother still lives. Within the grove She goes to the grove He, on the first snow of the winter, sees his sister And the aeon seems lighten up, stands at attention Aeon allows them to communicate He will begin to churn his jaw, as what he does activates A DEATHSTALK MUSHROOM He dies V: what did you say to him???? “I didnt say anything, he started to apologize, he said he was made to do it.” V: by who??
“Élodie Varnet”
A tavern owner (Watchman’s Respite) up north Stoneborgont V: lady christanti does that mean anything
“Yes. you are a monster though. All of you. You are a monster, but you are at least innocent. If the time happens where the king drops protections and you are in the borders kholeran, i will hunt you for sport.” K: yeah get in line
Priestess: i do know shes the adoptive mother of Tunseel undead hunters (tavern owner) V: what does she have with killing of local leaders
“IDK but if she raised Pheylor Tenthall shes probably strong.” P: do you know why phaylor tenthall would let us live “IDK. maybe she was uncharacteristically stupid that day. If she wanted you dead, you would be dead.”
Show the bitemarks about the neck to her, the bite marks and slash across the neck are more recent. They match both dione and Lume j'Estrilla P: do you know why any of the things (vampire bites, murder) Thorne “Unfortunately, the day i was going down south, i was going to arrange a logging deal. My priestess was supposed to have a heartbeat, as well as my grandmother and the guard. I will call off you as guilty and bring him back to trial to be judged postmortem. But do not visit the castle again.” Brevill: let me stay with the body until sunrise. Then you can come back and i will be gone.
We travel to Stoneborgont 8 days of travel On day 6 we cast talking corpse a second time why were you participating in the ritual to bind pharasma (“oh he doesnt have the knowledge to avoid things” “dont worry about it kitten”)
“I was kidnapped from the capital during the Divine Gate opening in order to serve as his witness to marriage.” Who was participating in the ritual
“"True King of Tunseel, the keeper of kings [tries to say the name, skull is getting dissolved. A 35 is a still crit fail]” Aeon looks at us with fear and hatred. Give the corpse and other pharasma stuff to the aeon, sorry Its not happy but takes it In the ash, we can see symbol of pharasma. (hes using his BITCH WIFE to NUKE PEOPLE) New camps of people readying, people carrying bows but not hunting animals exclusively (preparing for war)
Undead hunters are in fact religious in nature, pharasma and Sarenrae. The special types are for ghouls and fleshwarps. The swamps of Stoneborgont get mummy-type creatures that need to be hunted. There are parts here that are harsher to live in. typical hunters go by 2s, unlikely we’ll go by 1 alone Specialize in also killing abominations This is a filter town, youhave to get through this town to get into tunseel from further north Dasa scouts ahead as a bat, no moons above The trees that have leaves rustle against the bark Dasa, kholeran, morven phil, viktor Kholeran wakes up in the middle of the day, the trees not casting shadows (sun directly above) Here the sound of bells from the top of trees like churches Bells are loud enough to wake up everyone even viktor
IN THE SKY THERE IS A SMALL MOON THAT SHOULDNT BE THERE (moon from the Boneyard (common belief in Tunseel that the moon is Groetus))? A MINIATURE ECLIPSE Unnautrally quiet, no birds, no leaves, only bells. Trees produce no noise Religious motif of pharasma After about 5 mins, as soon as the sun moves away from the moon, the bells stop, leaving us alone and paranoid Eclipse that lasts exactly 5 mins We’re now fatigued as we go to the next town Tem 7, 1264 TLDR: Wake up thorne christanti She’s willing to take us to court for an “unpartial” jury, but its likely we’d be imprisoned or sent to the Ensile king who would imprison or kill us The assassin has no tongue The aeon shows up because we tell him the directions, but the assassin wont talk to him Bury the priestess, she awakens and hates us for turning her into a vampire She talks to her brother, he apologizes, tells her that he was told to do this by Élodie Varnet, who is a tavern owner in Stoneborgont She ALSO raises many undead hunters like PHAYLOR TENTHALL The assassin kills himself with poison Thorne christanti willing to admit we’re innocent, but we cannot go back to the keep anymore in Verdehas The priestess stays behind with her brother’s corpse to kill herself as well We leave with the aeon, talking corpse on the corpse He was kidnapped to perform marriage ceremony The marriage was to the TRUE KING OF TUNSEEL to PHARASMA He tries to say the king’s name, his head disintegrates Aeon takes the body and leaves We travel more, and when we stop briefly, in the middle of the day there is an eclipse over our camp for 5 mins exactly Bells toll from every tree, everything else is silent, and the moon is the moon from the boneyard The next day we wake up fatigued

Stoneborgont
Fatigued is caused by boneyard = if youre alive, it drains some of ur life, if ur undead, it begins to break some of ur bindings Arriving at the city Approach, look at us, close the gate as soon as they see the undead walking toward the area “Are you intelligent?” Y: VERY im pretty sure. You got a test or smth? “Communication will do.” “What authority are you here under?’
Y: king of Tunseel Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie They dont believe us
Y: Anmoku Funeral Parlor? I have business cards. And coupons “If youre here for business, then we could sell a merchants pass” How much “10gp” “Are you a necromancer by trade?” Y: whos asking “I am. They have to be chained the entire time youre in the city.” We give 20 more gold to let us in “Are any of you abominations within?”
“Creatures of Sternbore, fleshwarps, and the like.” Y: nooo Let into the main city
Closest inn is Root and Thorn Odd building, top floor is a guard post Human man on other side “Um. sorry, this is an inn where people sleep.” Y: yeah, wed like a room. Or two “Do you sleep??” Yeah “I have a shared room on the 2nd floor or individual” 3gp a night Overnight Morven Innkeeper is gossiping abt strange people above A regular rolls in for alcohol, getting drunk before work He does start with “youll never believe whats right above you” convo “theres a ghoul and the like and theyre unchained” Yurei Oddly empty Quiet given that its midday Dasa
First to notice a creature standing on the roof across from us (Shino Hakusa) On all 4s staring at us Humanoid, at about 5ft tall Dasa gets a bird to talk to, many actually. Oops. 4 of them “This time i can drive a hard bargain w the birds” -thomas D: mr and mrs birdies. Theres someone looking at me over there, im wondering if for a bit of bread you tell me what they look like “Little bread or lot of bread?” D: more than what ive given you “Ladies by park feed lot of bread already” D: how much? “Half loaf” Lying bird D: i think that she wouldnt. How about an 1/8th of a loaf “Half bread?” D: idk if i can do half. An 1/8th of a loaf and another 1/8th “8+8=half?” D: you basically get 2x the deal, think about it “Half bread + half bread = 2 bread?” Birds circle around, landing close enough to look, cooing, before flying back around D: so whatd you see? “It has 4 eyes.” D: skin color? “Kinda gray. Covered up. Underneath it had small little legs. Multiple legs. 1/8th 1/8th 1/8th legs 1/8th? (4? 6?)” D: sticks? Like humans use to swing at stuff? “No stick” D: creepy vibe? “4 eyes, mouth agape, pincer like” D: shiny? “No shiny. No hands on leg.” D: have you seen him before? “Seen in city before. Crawl up wall to get in.” D: how many days? “Last i saw. Year ago crawl up wall? D: more like them? “No. human walk on ground, not up wall. Cant even fly” Dasa gives 2 bread D: if you find any more info i have more bread “Found more information yes have” D: ill give bread based on the info, so if its good, ill give more bread “Still across street. Bread.” Viktor Viktor cant see it anymore It seems to have noticed that dasa was waking someojne and left Hear 1 name asking pointed questions about the group
“Gaspard Duval” Mostly asking abt us, confirming things. Asking pointed questions as if he already knows who we are, confirming rather than information seeking Tem 8, 1264 Wake up, all groggy, but some not mechanically so Dasa pest forms up to the roof to investigate No signs of anything left before Discreet inquiry about gaspard du val
One of Pheylor Tenthall’s men Beloved, legally an outlaw, the guards dont care and let him pass
Technically the fiance to Elethera Vainwin Deeply in love, a classical romantic type. Noble heir who chose to be an undead hunter, while she was one of lower standing Overall received very favorably by the city Easily known abt the the people racking their brains together, the creature was probably a fleshwarp that crawls on the walls that has a personal hatred/investment of us
Élodie Varnet
Elodie’s tavern’s name is Watchman’s Respite Doesnt normally serve travellers, typically serves solders coming back. If you come back from sternbore region, first drink is free. If you show a head, you get the night free It serves to stave of bleaching She’s still raising undead hunters, and also owns an orphanage. They typically become people of note. 10 years ago a ton of teenagers came down and it became a great soldier force of 20 y/os Still get some occasionally from events outside the city. Well respected
Turman Brothers (bandit force from previous Sternbore military) still respect them, give them children they cant raise for a better life
Tunseelian government funds her orphanage, she used to a soldier and freed this area from the Azerin government
She knew Ludolf Aumerce during life, shes approximately 900 years old, she is notably weaker in her old age though (tunseel is about 1000 years old) Watchman;s Respite Festivities stop as soon as we enter Weird whisper from tavern owner “Hello kholeran” K: oh you know my name, thats fun “Can you drink? Do you want to drink?” “You just came back from war did you not? At least realively.” K: not really? “In the grand scheme of things you did K: sure if you consider my entire lifetime. Do you have anything dwarven” “Its appropriate. To your kill: vainwen.” K: who? “My daughter you killed and maybe ate.” “I dont hold too much hostility. Do you know what the 2nd line of an undead hunter’s oath is?” K: no D: can i drink “I can give you a mop and something to drink. As long as you pay. For you, 1 gold.” “The 2nd paragraph of the undead hunter’s oath is the same as tunseelian soldiers take when they go to war. There will be no hostilities after the fight has ceased. Whatever happens happens. All of my children who are still under said oath shant seek revenge.” For yurei, 1.5gp Coupon? “2 gold, yurei.” Y: i have a feeling you dont like me “Worse is someone who cant help it, worst is someone who chose sin and made it part of their life.”
K: do you remember ludolf aumerce “Of course. He was a human, young 90 years old.”
K: and you raised Lennix Hellewell the assassin “The hellewells” “Siblings. Came down from sternbore. Took 2 different oaths.” “You killed them down south?” K: no actually “Your actions were unrelated?”
K: Brevil Hellewell was helping us speak to the corpse of ludolf aumerce. Lennix killed her “I met a talking zombie. Before i killed it, i taught it some things about personal responsibility and how to be a person again. So ill ask: if asking about this killed 2 people, what would you think would happen now?” V: we’re confused about the situation
“This whole situation happened because he doesnt wish to be found, and you keep poking around. There is some weak links. Id recommend some easy cure: go back home, go back to your funeral parlor, and this will all – less people will die. The more youre involved, the more people will die.” K: how long would that take? “You stay out of the way until you stop drawing breath. You wont get an answer out of me if you want a timeline of the machinations.” (there is a certain source shes weak on. She wont fall for machinations, but she will take pride in talking about her children) M: so we’re quite familiar w your children, like pheylor tenthall. Shes a formidable fighter, she downed us all, but we all woke us up. Do you know why she let us livin “If she kept you alive, then she has a plan. Shes higher up in all of this than i am. Which means he has a plan. Which means youre fine and he wont kill you. You could go visit him rn or her, and i doubt shed do much more than knock you out.” Y: you know where they are? “I know where she is. And she knows where he is.” V: there is a man who has been asking after us, du val? “He is part of the noble family who owns the city. He will certainly kill you if he gets the chance. He’ll hunt you down after you leave the city. He’ll introduce himself, tell you your crimes, and then kill you slowly. He’ll knock you out, enact the Travisine. It allows retribution against you, all of your victims pain will be felt over 3 days, and on the 4th, he’ll strike a nail through your heart.” M: do you know of any fleshwarps coming in and out? We had a run in with one alst night
“The bastard woman who shows up occasionally from up north. She wanted to fight you, but i told her that my son has first privilege. The lady said she faught you before in a temple down south.” M: whereabouts up north? “The bastard nation of your kind.” M: im not from there “Youre a fleshwarp, and thats where they all flee” M: Im from yureis basement “You should flee it and go up north” M: Its a nice basement!
“Wachter fleshwarps have made a home in the old capital. Thats where she goes.” K: what abominations? “The sternbore abominations?” K: i was in a cave
Sternbore blew up 10 years ago (5 years before Advesperascit) Causes still unknown, only recently has the mist lifted enough that people can start going in and rebuilding Most people dont do it
Fleshwarps who regain their mind + Henry Wachter abominations go there Dead magic zones
Hence why Tela ir'Vasimon has magic overdose in her blood “If you do kill another one, my oath is now over officially. This next one, if you do kill him, we will be at war.” “I do have to ask, why are you doing this?” V: more specific?
“Hunting down the runes, killing people.” Y: mysterious forces tell me i must go find them “That might be schizophrenia. Ive seen people write on the walls with their own shit”
“Id recommend a priest of erastil, so that he can cleanse your aura and affliction” Y: is that how you fix mental illness “It helps” “Why do you do it if not for your companions own illness? You could go home, it would be fine for every party involved.”
“I can tell you the one that tore your family apart and stupored your sister if you leave and go south.” She is 1) telling the truth, she knows, 2) she has a way to make viktor suffer if he doesn't follow through Viktor takes the deal, passes the dc 34
“The one who stupored her is one Gorvain Lecrân. He is one of the higher ups of the Cecian Nocturn” Vampire hunters “I was understand he was compelled by righteous justice despite what the leader said.” “If righteousness skips over one, you are cursed and a bastard, and she is a true hero of your family.”
“You take after Lume j'Estrilla do you not? Your grandsire.” V: i was unaware that information was common knowledge “Well of course. It is important to know the major vampires even you cannot hunt.”: “Ones we cannot hunt yet. The second they betray, we are allowed to kill. I am not of oath anymore. Bless your souls, i would kill you right now if i was.” K: thats lucky for us “And for me. It is a new change of pace.” V: this is a very illuminating conversation “[viktor] is a soul committed to sin and cant be convinced even by magic to do something right in his life.”

sleep at Root and Thorn Viktor Not a lot Yurei Not a lot Morven Someone heated, drunk in the middle of the day, talking about the monsters being harbored in the middle of the city Guards have to carry the person out Phil Not a lot There’s now guards posted around the tavern Dasa Not a lot Rosalind Not a lot Tem 9, 1264 Onto the road we shall go Through the rain In the middle of the night Stopped by a single man on the road wearing plate armor
Monsieur Gaspard Duval “Doctor keson. Titles mean nothing in death.” Perhaps that will change “Not while i draw breath”
I hope that you do. I am sorry for your loss (Elethera Vainwin) “Are you sorry about it because shes my fiancee or because of her death” both “I will trade her one unwilling soul for 2 undead souls.” Combat Viktor Knocks gaspard out Yurei kills an archer Rosalind kills the other Archers are guards from the city We decide to cover the bodies respectfully and let Gaspard take them back to do their rights Tem 10, 1264
To the mistwall that separates Sternbore to the rest of the world Drains the vitality of living creatures that enter and leave
Was supposed to become the next of the Vespertine Empires before it imploded
Heading to Stlehai Kholeran manages to avoid odd bodies with their skin flapping in the wind Telltale sign to be cautious due to the presence of a shenrigal Also signs that some of the bodies have had various bodyparts taken occasionally Hearts, organs, and parts of the head have been taken Some people manage to live here, but they took on a new form of Umasi. They have to steal bodyparts bc theirs are rotting They’re hated by the outside world bc of the stealing bodyparts situation Viktor Nothing Yurei
Ume does notice some large things that dont go to the fire “Large meat snake on cliff, afraid of fire” Meat snake different how “More worm than snake, head open like blossom, tendrils inside the blossom” Probably a neathalid Morven Dont notice until its a bit too late Feel a hand on their shoulder, a hand across their mouth as it tries to get their attention “We’re going to get you out of here and away from your captor?” What??? “The one that has your chain.” Theres not chains! No chains at all! “Metaphorical one. The spellbinder.” Yurei???? “Yes” Thats like my cousin i dont wanna go away “Thats what you believe because youve been charmed.” People have tried and failed, its not that easy “Its not that easy because you might already be charmed.” No???? I think im built different. I appreciate this tho but im staying?? Im good “Unfortunately you should come. At least see if you like the taste of freedom before you deny it.” Im pretty free. The only thing that ties me is an employee contract but its fine “You dont believe yourself magically bound?” I know im not “Wahts the most amount of days you spent away from the master?” [ramble] “Is that how it feels when they do it to you” Noo “Yes. i can show you.” Whats the password. Where are you from “Here. this is the new home for us” Where you stayin at “Theres only 1 city, but we’re slowly trying to recapture the port” From who “The ghosts” Well ive got a ghost, shes great “I dont want to sound predjudiced but i dont like ghosts, they wail and moan about their deaths” Shes fine tho “The second she gets what she wants she’ll disappear” Her prerogative “Not really a way of living.” Again, my friends built different “They arent a bound ghost” Exactly “I dont think it means much” Ill disagree. I think im good, ill stay put, but maybe ill come visit “Listen im being honest. I am the nice one” Elaborate?? “We have a few amalgamites that were spared due to kindness. Some werent killed during the uprising.” Cool dude “Well the issue is the amalgamites is that theyre still in their prenatural self” Interesting?? Anyways. Ok so u seem pretty adamant abt this, but id rather not be taken away from my compatriots during the middle of the day. Do you mind if i take up one of them and taking me with me? “As long as its not the chainholder.” So im gonna get my lil doll friend rq if thats fine “Of course. And then we will decide if the fire were to go out. As it were.” Go away a bit, go to a base camp for reclaiming the port Meeting with the leader of the camp, wizard with flesh that folds in on itself. Head has a doppler effect as it rolls around the body “Youve brought a comrade and a possessed doll” R: hi my name is rosalind! M: hello! “Why have you come” R: uhhh i dont feel comfortably letting morven go alone, better to have security, buddy system R: im not her keeper or anything like that rest assured M: i dont think i have a birth certificate
“No you dont but we know of you. You are notable figures in the region to the south (Tunseel).” R: true! We were in the newspaper recently “Im aware. Awful read.” R: i assume not many good things said about undead “Not that. Just pointless drivel to attract mind. Not very academically inclined.” M: different strokes for different folks “But thats not why youre here. Why are you here in sternbore?”
R: um so. We’re from a village far over where our shopkeeper has a cousin here, we’re making a delivery “You can hand the package over and we’ll deliver it” R: i told them we’d do it by hand “Then we’re at an impasse. Morven would be allowed to go, but the rest were not.” R: why? “Youre outsiders. Those who arent like us wish to kill us” M: we wouldnt do that “Theres no proof.” M: theyve been with me for a minute “So as long as they have a friend they wont?” R: im not very harmful… “You are very harmful” R: morven has more in common with me and our companions than you “The nature means theyll be well received upon entering.” M: i could vouch for them “Unfortunately a vouch wont do much for walking magical weapons” M: we’re not doing anything to harm you or your people “Youre here for a different reason than what you said” R: would you take a message to tell someone their message here? “Shes not allowed position to be allowed entry, shes allowed because she’s not a danger to people.” R: our group isnt interested in wiping your town out, idk how to prove that “You can help us” R: how? “Clearing the port.” R: ghosts? “Not just the ghosts. Its also the less friendly abominations.” M: like who or what? “There are 2 gigatath that have chosen to live on the surface of the city. Where they are, more will form.” R: i would say we are able to help. Or at least try? As a collective we have dealt with this sort of thing before, but this would mean entry for all of us. “All who participate. As a sign of faith.” “We are not mindless, we wont kill you without reason. Dont give us a reason” “After you deal with those things, we’ll kindly escort you to the capital.” R: guiding us or supervising “Supervising, i’ll be leading the way.” R: we musn’t worry just yet, we have bigger fish to fry as they say Tem 11, 1264
Night falls for sternbore, but not for Tunseel. Down below is a nice wall of light along the border
Wall of light is clearly magical in nature. Encroaching on Ensile. Declaration of war by Tunseel!
Sending to Shiryo Anmoku Hi dad, saw theres war on the border. are u ok. is there anything i should know
“War is good for business. We have survived 3 wars as a family, we will survive this one. Stay safe, travel to florence to be safe.”
Henry Wachter war
Sternbore war
Azerin reclamation war
Sending to Phil’s husband Régis Rosaire d'Esmé hey honey, just saw the war is on, need any help with that..? xoxo, phil Get a response from someone else “you have been redirected to the emergent king’s secretary. Do not contact again under personal matters.”

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.description:

Next Session: Session 42 Tem 11, 1264
Sternbore
Takes 2ish days to Stlehai Tem 13, 1264 Gigiteth gather toward the port to feast on sailors Since the sailors die by gigiteth, if we kill them they’ll get ships Will & fortitude are their worst, DONT TARGET REFLEX Ambush creatures, theyll remain hidden until they strike They can move full speed after grabbing someone. Move 50ft after and then beat them to death We fight the gigiteth Return “Shall we go to the capital?” Yup sounds good Tem 20, 1264
Approach the capital Rovean “Why are you travelling here?” We are delivering a package to a friend “I still dont believe thats the only thing”
“We only moved here 3 years ago, things have been fairly the same. If you have anything specific, I’d recommend going to Selius Wachtervan, the leader.” Where might we find them? “Typically at the bottom of the chasm, they prefer to be surrounded at all times. When you enter, open and close the doors as quickly as you reasonably can.” Why? “They were a general, Tymorican.” “Do not feel the need to alert him; he will know you are coming.” Oh. yay
Tela ir'Vasimon set up in old abandoned merchant hubs “You’re far from home???” Well. we were in the neighborhood. Your cousin asked us to deliver a package if we came anywhere near you “And you happened to be coming to the middle of nowhere?” We happen to go a lot of places “I didnt think they had need of caskets here?” Theres that need everywhere “The people here take the bodyparts and attach them to themselves?” I did also want to see how you were faring? She looks healthier Im glad you were able to find some solace “Its the middle of nowhere, but it feels the closest to home ive ever been. Are you planning on setting up shop here? We have plenty of buildings if you need. They arent a very monetarily inclined people. The people here dont use money outside of trade with the outside.” We’re just visiting for the time being “If you arent here to sell caskets, why are you here?” A personal venture at the moment “Is it related to their experiments?” As much as anything we do is, really
“If its to see Estra, i could put in a good word. She gets various reagents from me occasionally.” Estra? “One of the fleshwarpers.” We could see her before we finish passing through? “Her shop is down by the river. It should be fairly notable, but the experiments do taint the water a deep purple.”
Some visitors from Ruhhat, the ones from Tunseel havent made the way up. Some occasional adventuring parties, some small groups are able to get their way up. There are strong enough people in the city that the average adventurer wouldnt stand up. The ones that are the strongest were experimented on the most by Henry Wachter, so kinda antisocial Go down the ladder to meet Wachtervan “I knew you’d come.” Its a pleasure to meet you then “Pleasure is mine” How’d you know? “Tymorican. Time flows differently for me. I can see briefly into the future. Not enough to predict tomorrow, but enough for a fight or conversation.” We were told by tela you'd have some history of this place/knowledge of events? “Decent amount, I spend most of my time down here reading. Scouts send their reports down, so im informed of the outside.” We’re here in search of an artifact that is important to Tunseel? Are you aware of any odd things with a self healing nature outside of the typical apocalypse things? We’re looking for an artifact that changes how things regenerate. “Tunseelians are not welcome here. I go deal with them personally. There are exceptions.” Yes, have there been any incidents other than people? Like buildings or the land regenerating or destroying itself that seems atypical? “No, only hardworkers rebuild the city.”
Yurei brain blasts: we’re looking for a powerful rune in the area, dissimilar and out of place “Yes, there was one. It was taken up by the monastery. It speaks to the dead.” Who hangs out there?
“The Sternbore Monastery is still finding its way, but the original way was Shelyn. Many are not currently religious, its various priests who were taken in by Master Wachter.” Any monks specifically? “Yes, there is Katan, Shenmaru, Nolen, Hakusa, Shion…” Hakusa? “Are you familiar?” Unfortunately so “She doesnt reside here permanently, but…”
Shino Hakusa, or someone related?
“The Hakusa family, from my understanding.” Are you aware that Shino Hakusa’s infamy in the countries down below? “As a murderer?” Yes “Yes. If we exiled everyone that killed someone, this town would be empty.” The bodycount is stacking up a little bit “Do you know how many i killed that night?” We’ve all done so, but its the assassination “I killed a king” Which one?
“The one of old Otepera up north, now Callenwall.” And also besides that its a personal grudge “If its personal, say it.” She killed morvens mom, and is going to their lover next. “I see.” M: not technically my mum but- [complicated] “It has caused issues with the local monastery. Most are up there to resign their ways as pacifists, not war machines.” If we met her in combat, would it cause strife with you if we killed her? “Itd be a tragedy, but i see tragedies a 1000 times a day when i step out the room.” Is there anything that we can accomplish our newfound friendship? Anymore creatures causing problems? “Creatures causing problems. If you could use your connections to help us get our sovereign rights to not be invaded.”
Its my lifes purpose to kill the king of Ensile (Régis Rosaire d'Esmé). After that- they’ll have problems when we finish up there. I'm sure tunseel will be busy as well considering we’re not on good terms…? Its a strange political situation. Theyre sort of trying to get us killed, but IDK anyway we’ll keep that in mind as we continue on our inevitable path to those kings “That is all i can ask. Other creatures that threaten us are stupid enough to come into the city.” Any vampires? “Only you viktor. At least in the last 2 years.” What then? “They met the sun. I am unsure who.” (lying)
We ran into issues regarding the Dione Group if that rings any bells “No. A funeral group in southern tunseel?” We were investigating how far their reach was, i am not sure if youre also aware we’re a funeral home, but thats not why we’re here.

Path of Perfection P: hello thank you we are here to visit wonderful temple you have “Why are you here?”

M: she killed my mom kinda “So you’re planning on killing her in front of her siblings?” Noooo R: we’re here to ask questions, we dont have combat centric business “Im not here to stop you, i hope you find your way, but i hope you find it on your own.” Y: who are you??
“Zarqaa A-Kabir” (one free backrub. Thomas: MORVEN DOES BACKRUBS? WILD!) “I am no position to stop you, so feel free to go in. but i am in no position to stop anyone who tries to attack you.” He lets us in Statue of Irori Judging by the monks, half are irori, the others belong to other gods Yurei texts auntie “hey u up” No real natural greenery, all cultivated
Monk of Shelyn, one of erastil, Pharasma, Sarenrae, 3 of irori, 1 more sarenrae Wait lets go talk to that one guy again R: we heard word of smth that could connect/speak with dead? Can we see that?
“Unfortunately thats under the Hakusa Family.
