The unfortunate reality is, murder has alreay happened?”
P: yes, she killed our friends mother (Shalana) “If it means anything, she does not want combat, but she is prepared.” P: if we dont instigate, we can be peaceful? “Yes, i believe she’ll be peaceful within the temple.”
Dornec the priest wears his mutations proudly Form of a giant spider-like person, 4 arms go down his body + 2 legs, they are tipped with human-like fingers “Are you looking to make a deal?” R: unfortunately no, i have questions? Seeking info more than anything. “(to yurei) What od you want? Extended life?” R: not looking to make a deal. Questions about devils generally speaking. I am rosalind, a poppet, i am possessed- well the possessor of this body and my body is possessed by a devil and that is not something i am very knowledgeable about/happy about, so i’d like info or guidance? “To get back your body?” R: kiiiinda. Id like to know how to handle it? “You can always get it back, you can sign another contract with the same devil.” R: that was signed by my parents “Were you a child?” R: yes “Legally binding. For what its worth, you cant lie on a contract, so if you get a copy…” “You must simply make a copy of the original contract. Do you have an alias for the devil?”
R: Domocle Feucreux, hes being presented as a medical prodigy working with the king of Tunseel “If hes still in tunseel then he survived the purge?”
P: no Ensile sorry
“Oh that makes sense, there was a purge by avare brit.” R: are you a devil?
“No, Hellknight.” R: and for those who werent born 2 years ago? “Follow laws in face of lawlessness.” R: and legally binding with my legal guardians, theres no way to change postmortem? “If both the signee and the one holding the contract agree to change, then change will happen.” “Offer him smth more valuable than yourself. Theres plenty of criminals that deserve to go to hell. You have a strong group amongst you from what i understand.” R: i can kill someone and give it to him R: my current understanding that my aliveness in this form is not intentional on the devils part, would there be a reason hed want me or want to destroy me? “Unfortunately without the info on who you were, the contract, or the devil.” R: they wanted a healthy child “They got it, look how you move in your body.” “You can move and dance, perfectly healthy from the law.” “Your parents may not have specified when you’d be healthy.” R: could a devil put a soul into a doll? “Easily.” R: is there a reason why the devil would want possession of the child / doctor status? “Body is simple. The devil can only stay for about a week unaided, but with a host (its for a while).” “Profitable, and it allows you to be near the dying and desperate. And imagine it, they too can probably move around instead of being sent to hell!” R: theres also- this might not be ur purview. When im near the body, i become absent from mine bc of my spirit trying to leave “You can find a lich and turn the body into a soul cage, but the soul would be lost upon destruction of the body.” R: why would he want to buy me? “They could just lock you up, and once 2 years are over… fish in a barrel.” (makes a bow & arrow motion with 3 arms) P: are there vulnerabilities presented from the soul being on this plane? “The devil could be exposed as cheating. I doubt the parent would be happy of such an affair.” R: is there a way to prove this sort of thing? “That is the purview of magic it can be easily faked.” R: si there a way to handle a deal- “To get the best deal?” R: to avoid contract or coercion? “I dont see why you need to mess with it, youre moving quite well and hes around those who need to make deals” (yurei asking abt deals)
(Auntie Miko: see the deal first yurei) “Power. Love, if you dont mind her being a slave. Someone thats signed away their soul for smth else.” P: i dont think capitalism is that far away from making a deal with the devil K: is there one that cannot make me hungry “Yes, but a steep price. Maybe a hundred fresh souls? 10 mins from first to last kill.” R: the devil took my body is this not- “Cause of alarm? No.” (auntie: get a sample contract.)
(hey auntie are the runes legally yours? 30 mins later: yes) “At what point was it her property?” P: a maximum number ur looking for? If its like 5 years or smth like that-
“For devils, it wouldve been the ordaining of asmodeus.” P: as long as it was after? (auntie responds with a rune in response to asking abt how long it was, he runs it up the chain of command. Takes an hour.) “This was before the ordaining, however, they are willing to make a deal with such a being if it exists.” P: for reference, how long ago? “7k.” P: is it smth we need both mortal conduits or can it be done metaphysically over long distance “Yes, metaphysically, if such a devil exists.” Y: who is she????? “Idk.” “What form of entity is she…?” Y: IDK “Where is she from?”
Y: Owariyaru “She mightve been before it was owariyaru.” Y: sure IDK im 19 “It does mean she predates some of the gods?” Brain blasting on the rune
The symbol is not uncommon like the Speakers of Pharasma would wear on their cloak Old enough its not actually really a word anymore Headmaster again M: so as you can see the origin of my body is not all in one place, its hard understanding intentions of the past bodies. I just want to ask, how does one go amongst finding harmony when youre part of many pieces “The various different pieces, most here are made of 3 people like wachter did. There is a ritual, i could teach it to you all. It makes it easier, but its more akin to death and rebirth than true harmony.” “IDK if it has a name, we invented it here to find piece amongst ourselves.” R: where did you get- is there anything this is comparable to? We dont want to go into blind “Have you ever performed a resurrection? A true one. The memories will still be there but theyll be dull and gray, but theyd be there.” Y: how long to learn? “A day, but it takes a week to perform.” M: any way to talk to the remnants? “No, we focus on what's here. Keep the pieces you like, discard what you dont.” “I invented it after several years of meditation.” (specifically 5) P: any other monasteries that are in similar circumstance to you two and arriving at peace?
“I fear that we are the first major case, unless you talk about the fleshcrafter. If you go there, Vidrizil (this might be Vlyn'Darastyl) is popular with fleshcrafting during their war with Brazenthrone.” P: we have a few- what type of people are best to learn it in terms of skill set, or does it have to be performed by yourself? “Yourself is the primary, the others are the secondary.” “So far we’ve managed to add up to 5 to the ritual.” P: have you done it with anyone tied to the original souls participating? “No, but those in the monastery have done it. Those with family members are still tied to the past.” P: have monks from other places travelled here or are you isolated? “A few come and go. Some are willing to learn, especially when they found out we restored the temple to Irori. This is believed to be the temple Irori meditated in when he ascended.” P: anyone from erastil? “We have a priest from there?” “Its been primarily irori, the others have found it dangerous. However, irori priests go to where it is necessary.” “Will you be eating with us then? If youre staying the day.” P: oh we’d be happy to accept your hospitality. “Please dont make trouble during the night, we do need sleep.” Eating Priest of pharasma takes 2 meals and brings them to their room 2 hakusa family members, one is a priest of sarenrae Take beds near us “Please do not cause any issue. She is willing to give up the rune.” Seems to be sincere, they dont want harm to come to shino hakusa Shes the fighter, but there are 7 of us, and we killed 2 gigiteth here v: oh we don't really. want to fight? we have not come for a fight inherently “Itd be best if i get the rune, bring it down here, and she not make contact.” P: while we’re here in this place of neutrality and peace, id like to sit down an try to understand, but i understand if you want us to stay away from each other “Only one of us have combat experience.” “I will try to get it to you by the morning.” She leaves for an hour, viktor + dasa (bag) + rosalind follow Her area is near the waterfall, a small dingey cave that is unfurnished, she rests near an old statuette from Tunseel of pharasma She does seem to wake by her sister, they exchange words but we cant see SH: yes, but you will give it directly to the snake We disguise dasa as a snake + illusory animal Rosalind viktor waiting “Could i see all of you? That is one of the conditions she had, to hand it to all” we bullshit our way into her believing us as yurei phil and dasa are busy, thanks rosalind and ur magic She puts the stone in dasa’s mouth, dasa fort save He bites on the stone, odd green-blue glow DASA CHANTING OUT NAMES FROM AN ANCIENT LANGUAGE NOT HEARD OF DASA DOES NOT WANT TO MOVE ITS LIKE DASA IS TALKING IN YOUR EAR IF YOURE IN A HALF MILE RANGE OF DASA
Most are ancient name in a random order, 3 in a row that are familiar (Yniesse Zenderholm, Claire Berger, Everard Gage) VARIOUS PEOPLE AUNTIE HAS KILLED IN HER QUEST A FEW ANMOKUS AS WELL? Sister hakusa is PANICKED Morven rips the rune out, dasas fine
r: What the fuck, Ume the snake The wind howls, and then everyone goes back to bed except for a creature standing above us shino hakusa: “I had but a simple request.” R: we had a simple request “You gave it to dasa. I can see through the disguise, i can see the truth. Ive been given 8 eyes specifically to see.” “I dont want bloodshed in front of my sibling” “You still have a month before you can strengthen up” R: why is the snake preferable compared to yurei? “The snake is a direct conduit so if we’re in the thrawls of a being, i want to speak to ume.” “I would take the rune by force, but id rather not.” “I have spoken to the dead.” “You can talk to anyone as long as it was a specific spot of their life or death.” (we decide that exchanging body time for usage of the power is better than fighting shino hakusa for no reason) Brain blasting Why were they created? Auntie was a powerful spirit, she couldnt be dispelled, so they split her Whats the religious significance of the runes? Used in pharasman religions about the 9 steps she took to the divine throne before she died to become a god Because she died in such a manner, some of the dead became pharasma’s angels. Rumor has it that her sister became her angel + first psychopomp Snake eats the rune, the shadow of yurei gains another tail Rosalind spirit sense She grows powerful, green flash, before the flash goes northwest beyond the mountains before it settles down vaguely near yurei (went owariyaru?) Auntie do u know where the rest of the runes are No SH “can i ask why youre looking for these things?” “Why are you beholden to an ancestor?” Y: i think shes neat “Shed kill you for any amount of power” Y: im still here “Yeah because youre giving her power” P: you speak as if you know a lot of the entity “I dont but i know the gods.” She meditated about this for 5 years “I was alive for an average of 21 years.: Y: so why do you have this room “Bc its here” Y: so its yours now? “Yeah.” P: were you here when the monastery was founded “No.” The hakusa family is a family of 9 combined into 3 “If they were strong enough to protect the people, theyd be strong enough to stop me. I give them 3 chance to prove themselves.” “They have 2 months between each bout.”
V: have you been defeated by anyone but dayalu? “No, dayalu has proven himself, but i have to be defeated 3 times.” Y: you seem eager to give up the rune “It served me no purpose so far.” “I only want to kill the creature, i dont want to kill the rest of you. Only 1 of you is a priest and a monk in their heart, so only 1 must die.” She wont kill phil bc she doesnt swear to protect ppl P: why is it that you feel so strongly abt this particular subject? “Many priests promised to protect me, and… but i found new light, and i will promise to pursue that light. Pursue it or kill myself.” P: you plan to fight dayalu again? “Yes.” P: until he kills you? “Yes or until he dies.” “But hes currently not on this plane.” “I dont deserve a coffin, i think its better if i am given to the animals.”
“Put a rock down at the Avare Brit monastery (Church of Light).”
insert the priest who asked us to pass along the message to her, she refuses to kill him and refuses to give any answers Lucrèce de Montluc “I would like [her rock at her gravesite] jet black with a bit of blue” Y: do you have any other runes?
“No but i had contact with a woman you killed (Elethera Vainwin). Also i know of the one who gave you the rune (Pheylor Tenthall).” V: do you know why tenthall did not kill us? “She might just think youre interesting undead.” Shino hakusa is lying, she has a well written idea but she might not want to say or cant k: why are you lying “Not lying. You are interesting.” R: ok. I feel like that implies nothing else is happening, but there is a more important reason “There is” P: if we defeated you 3 times without killing you, would you stop? “No. youd have to kill me.” “The souls (inside her) were compressed already.” R: bc ur siblings? “No.”
(not a Henry Wachter thing) V: did wachter do that to you? Or a 3rd party “It was not wachter” P: how do you feel abt vampires? “Ive met many people, some might be vampires.” D: i dont come from a living being. Am i dead?
P: we ran into an angel of pharasma (Ziphren) who told us how we died, and they said he didnt die “You may not be dead. You might just be created through magic as dead. So youre technically not undead. Imagine if a necromancer creates a temp undead, they (smth long i missed). youre someone’s summon or familiar.” “Potentially you could be controlled” P: (pharasma things that dont affect dasa but affect us) “Dasa might be made by an angel of pharasma for some reason.” D: shows skull. Do u know this??? R: what purpose does this serve? “Entertainment or torture for her. You know how those gods are. They leave things behind like humans.” D: do you know anything abt the rings “No” D: ok D: do you know anything abt the saint of pharasma? “Which one?” [describes it] “That might be the 6th stop on her way to the throne. V: what was her final stop?
“The Divine Gate.” V: her first? “Her homeland, somewhere northwest.” The stops of pharasma are slightly offset to the fragments, but this could be from people taking them/moving them

The third is Tone Hakusa (Tone-eh)

“Thats what Henry Wachter did, we do as many as we need. Helg is not picky.” M: average? “5. It works! V: I fear… my sire is not someone you may like… many people do not like her… “I don’t like many vampires. Except u viktor <3” Yurei is not a vampire but “close enough” V: Most of the time, when you die, you are dead. The majority of the time. K: Speaking as someone dead, I still don’t care what coffin I would be put in. We go to his personal studio for privacy
“My sire is Dione” “Of which name?”
V: sired by Lume j'Estrilla “Oh, those bitches. (Do as I say, not as I do. Don’t swear.)” (@ y)
V: It’s been a time and we believe dione is working with the vampiric tunseelian king. (Not sure what name to refer to him by?)
Florence has 0 recognition of the word. He thinks the founder was a human. Confusion. V: My understanding is she is direct lineage to whoever that is? “Many vampires get a big head with their immortality, begin believing they are a god”
V: oh we think he married himself to Pharasma. “You are experiencing sun psychosis! The presence of an eternal ball in the sky that can vaporize you is stressful!” V: no it’s not just me! (everyone agrees) V: we were hoping to get any sort of information on the two that you know… rn most undead are not very. Forthright. About the situation we’ve run into
“Both religious nutjobs in their own way. One wouldn’t shut up about Gorum the last time we met, Lume. Let them do their own thing, they choose to live in tunseel, hellish. Beautiful if you are human.” V: I had a very bad time trying to escape, i agree “I know a man who was perfectly well preserved and hidden, but one of seven suns reflected in an unexpected way and he burned to death!”
“The other, religious, tried to take over the business in Ensile, offering a discount for any followers of the religion as long as they convert after death. To Pharasma.” (Huh?)
It was the Dione Group. “I’ve only met her once, she was young.” V: I had a good life! “And you have a better undeath, you’re like a child, you’ll get used to it” (Florence is not super good at supporting his adopted son) Y: you heard of that dhampir plague?? That’s her. “She’s giving birth at a rapid rate? Do i need to explain how dhampirs are made?” V: Unfortunately I have already heard about your sex life :( “Ok yurei go find drinks for us. Four floors away. Just go adventure.”
V: you remember when you met your loving husband and did not pay your tab in Flamhaltn? “ I paid ^u^” V: That’s not what we’ve heard! “I wasn’t an anmoku then :(“ V: there is an unpaid tab there… “He should be honored he got to see it, he walked in without knocking! Two i did pay. Three, customer service??” Hes glad to have another financially savvy child! “I could claim you as my child if you want to get rid of dione’s mark?” (I may have misheard this) V: Nooo…. Maybe later…….. Florence forgets drinking age and how to judge ages V: youve been around for a couple of tunseelian monarchies. Have you noticed anything strange abt the king? The.. .facial features? “Theyre boring. It’s interesting to see how they change, doing portraits! Not me they never invited me :((“ Y: How’s work going btw? “The master sleeps at a different time. I could go wake them?” No We Are Good. We Are Fine. V: perhaps if we stay a bit we talk. I dont want to wake them up
We might get a free ride off Aace? Advesperascit? City of dreams? Y: Has dad told any weird stories abt anmoku deaths? “It was before my time” Ok thats all We talk to aace? What would we ask? We should table it </3 we don’t have a reason, and we are invited back to see yurei’s papa We prepare for auntie to have yurei’s body =/
Sending to dione - how’s viktor’s sister doing?
“We have maybe a week left until we find out. Come back, and i am sure we can corner them in Ammurun”
Homveran - seems dangerous over there, hope youre doing well “No but we’re making do” Soln 2, 1264 Phil casts status on yurei Hi auntie, Could u teleport us 50 miles north of Ammurun “Can you be more specific, or just 50 miles?” Teleports us to the side of the mountain, we spend 3 hours looking for for the entrance in the dark
Immediate teleport is toward Owariyaru, closer to the ocean side before its dispelled
After an hour, we find the top of a tower sunken down thats only visible bc a waterfall follows it into the earth - Buried Tower We wait for yurei to come back Comes back with Pharasman clothes from a 6’5” built person, fits yurei not very well Wailing as we go down Elven, 2 floors down, a pair giving orders Elvish soldiers Small symbols and runes of a flooded room Dasa steps in “what would you like to know my liege?” Wait he doesnt know elven Holding spell for a devil of some kind “Are you not one of the original lords who is meant to be here?” V: i am checking your knowledge “This is one of the final strongholds that remained when your kind were killed.” V: how long has the sewer been here? “Then you arent one of the ghosts. They would know it was a street before it became a sewer. I ask kindly if you wish to learn anymore, free me.” Runes make the symbol of a stypholosis V: how do we know the information you have is even relevant? You’ve been here for a very long time “You don’t, but you’re going into an ancient tower, so you’re interested in the ancient. If you wanted gold, you wouldn’t be so interested in info.” V: why are you sealed here? “For my power?” Y: who sealed you? “The elves. I stay as a watchman of the tower eternal, and then after the war was over, theyd free me.” “I will give you 3 answers.” Can you tell us the leaders
Audovère fi'Alémanie the First Notable undead?

Guiles ir'Bordon, fi'Laurunet, Violette Gilraunt. Ok bye Go down deeper Fight some ghosts We hear a door opening down below A flooded living area Another room has been used, perhaps once every 3 months
Oh hi Shino Hakusa “You took several weeks.” “I see youve made it. Did the ghosts up above give trouble?” Not really “You understand that i have to kill you now, right?” “There is a beautiful place down in the sewers if you want to fight there. Theres also a beautiful field. Unfortunately bc oif the nature of this transgression, i’ll be skipping the 3 step rule.” (weird that she offers the field outside when she has the advantage) Fight shino hakusa Morven gets the final blow! Takes her head off We go down the tower, at the bottom was a hole that shino hakusa would climb down Scouting eye down the hole Deep into the earth Able to see runes down there, they seem to be the same sigils like our first cave exploration Feather fall rune set down there! We can go down easily, coming back up would be harder Jump down Find an odd looking sewer, seems metropolis street that used to be above but is now buried down below, only one way to go Go south until we come across a set of double doors, feels about a mile away Made out of glass but cant see through No inscription Kind of forms an ace of spades symbol Occasional mark of fresh sword fighting The person who does the most favors a spear (oh fuck the king?) Within the month old, have yet to grow mildew but have the stench of dirt Open the door
The King's Ballroom, set for a wedding feast OH FUCK THE KING IS PLAYING THE VIOLIN?
GLOWING CHERRY BLOSSOM FROM PHARASMA’S HOME LAND (Owariyaru)
He bows to us “Thank you for making your way down here.”

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.description:

Next Session: Session 45 Soln 2, 1264
The King's Ballroom, Tunseel
Audovère fi'Alémanie the First Bows to us “Thank you for making your way down here” Y: dont worry it wasnt intentional Kholeran does a hip modern greeting No one but him gets it lol V: were you anticipating us coming down “No but fate brought you down.” Y: why are you down here “In my castle in my land?” Y: do you have friends?? “I do. I have many. Those that i choose to keep. It is far more unusual to always been in company than be without.” K: my name is kholeran. What is yours “Audovère fi Alemanie the first” There might be conditions abt the effect “And your names? It is proper now that you know our relative ranks to introduce ourselves.” “Feel free to walk along my halls, just dont leave from the doors” V: why??? “I want to talk civilly. Its harder to do so when you walk through the doors.” Outside the windows
Painting recreation of the night sky of the Boneyard if the clouds ever lifted V: beautiful painting. Who is your painter?
“None, i created it myself. I have time. Anything for my beautiful wife im sure you would understand, i’m sure.”
Y: so if you were to describe your wife “I… don’t know how to make it in a way that makes sense to you. Her bones are beautiful, the way she stands is beautiful, the way she sits crumpled in a pile is beautiful. Shes the most capable out of anyone i ever met. If you want a display, i could kindly request one just for you.” Y: wdym??? “Her power for our kind is intoxicating and possibly destructive if youre weak.” D: is she alive? “No, she is the dead god. And god of the dead. She is able to do as we are alive as in dead.” “She’s beyond those doors to the south. Past a few hallways.” “You are free to meet her if you wish, though im sure none of you would be missed.” K: sooo our kind “Undead.”
Auntie Miko doesn’t know this guy He’s abt 4k years too young. “I was gifted with (undeath). A blessing so i could see my wife in person. I am simply built stronger than you. I can stand in the sun and not die.” K: how does- it feels like i might be wrong here but there are some ideological differences between your wife’s religion and um. Our existence. “There are. You will eventually die. It will be fine, itll be best for the world.” V: shes fine with you being undead?
“Of course. I was made for her. I was a born god. But i never had a chance to ascend. The throne was shut off from me.” He fully believes this
V: the current line of kings look like you? “Intentional. I shape them in the womb to remove the imperfections the blood of other people bring.”
“The old king was torn to shreds in front tunseel, so i could not bring him back as he was. But he has been punished for his failure.” V: so he is back, but not as king? “Yes.” P: just out of curiosity. I didnt think we were on great terms? “Are we on bad terms my lady?” P: i thought you didnt like us, and that were about to be smote, so- why are we still alive? “Why would i kill you? Youre no challenge, no honorable army. And i have no reason to.”
P: eh. We um faced. Pheylor Tenthall in combat. And obviously were defeated. But um. We still live. Do you know why?
The tree is growing bc its a blessed tree from Owariyaran royal family. He tended to it like a personal bonsai until the divine gate opened
Blessed by a line of tree that were allegedly blessed by erastil himself “I asked her to let you live.” V: why??? P: it seemed like easier to kill us then
“It wouldve been. But you are planning to bring the runes to the old ghost, right?” V: old ghost? “The haunted shrine maiden.” P: do you know her?
“I know of her. I know that she created my wife. She possessed my wife’s sister. So my wife had to kill the sister. Turning her on the righteous path of destroying our kind.” Y: are you against the ghost from obtaining the runes? “No. i wish her to obtain full power, and then to kill her myself.” Y: do you know where the rest are?
“I know one. He’s one you know. (Régis Rosaire d'Esmé)” P: oh! Wow! Uh. “You could surely ask him. I’m sure he’d give it if you explained why.” P: what is your relationship? “Business. He’s a lovely man, he brought his wife back.” oops so about that. P: your majesty. There is one. Small issue. I havent really- no witnesses and all. He is the architect of my death. It was to gain sympathy. “I see. That is why he wanted those precautions. I cant let you kill him now, but after the war is started, you may kill him as you wish.” P: what precautions? “He kept a doctor in his employ and refuses to let the contract slip.” P: about that doctor. If you wish to elaborate–
R: uh. Domocle Feucreux. “The devil, the very one, yes.” R: another complicated situation. I am.. That was me? The soul of that person is in this doll? And that is currently a devil possessing my body and being a doctor? “I see. Hes done you a great service” “Ive seen the weakness of your body. Its better to be a doll.” “No reason to seek revenge.” P: is there smth wrong with the body? “It is unsustainable, chronic illness that would lead to paralysis at age 40, 60 at the latest.” R: but it is mine rightfully. “Take it. Kill him. If you cannot take it, it is not yours. He gave you the strength. Use it to kill him. Go back to being weak and dying in 10 years.” P: it wouldnt intervene?? “It would, i would have to kill you” P: what do u need him for?
“Do you have knowledge of ancient medical procedures kept in the 8th rank of Hell?” No P: if it were something, a temporary need, we might help you get to him “How did you come down here. By which method” The hole “Which one”
Buried Tower More holes? “If you exit to the north, you can exit anywhere you wish.”
“One to my capital, one to Advesperascit, one to old Sternbore, Owariyaru…” P: can we use them? “It takes 10 mins in here before use” “Its all underground for your use, viktor.” Oh. yay. D: So I'm a construct of an angel of pharasma, does that make me undead? “No that makes you a psychopomp. We can talk to an angel if you wish.” “I have an angel. Just a few rooms down.” “Its one of the angels of my wife.” He goes to get an angel Dasa viktor follow Leads through an opulent hallway for a mile “Do not avert your eyes for what you’re about to see.” Unfortunately, as he opens it there is an angel spiked to a wall, its insides are like a crab trying to escape He will hit it until it dies and bring it back until it answers a simple question D: Oh hi there “The solar is not feeling talkative right now.” D: You’re an angel right? Seemingly throwing up in its own mouth to ask “Help me please.” D: “I’m not sure this is an angel” “Do you doubt that my wife’s 2nd closest person would be an angel?” V: “This is your wifes 2nd closest person???” “They’re a solar…” V: Why would you do this to them? “Philosophical disagreement, I’m sure they'll understand when its all done” V: Who is this? Do they have a name? “It’s been lost to history, they forfeited their name during the resurrection.” OOC: Do they match the appearance of the memory (i think?) No, your appearance changes significantly when you become an angel V: If this is pharasma’s 2nd closest person, are you her first? “Who else would it be?” V: It never hurts to ask “Its hurts my feelings, your doubt with me” V: To be fair we have met for approx 30 minutes at this point, I fear that i'm allowed a little uncertainty. I have not heard too much about you “You have not read / learned from history?” V: I have learned from history, but not personal experience talking to you
“Dione has not taught you???” V: We are a bit estranged, does that surprised you “No, prices have to be paid. there would be many people who would make good grandchildren” V: You have a list of the entire line? “Of Course” V: Shit. That is news for me. I did not know there was a certified list “Do you think that my childs would go out and betray me?”
V: based on what I have heard of Lume j'Estrilla…. “One did, now she hides in ruins and shit. Do you know where she is by the way?” V: I do not WILL SAVE Who knows what happened here “O.K. Would you like something to drink?” - V: Perhaps not right now - Dasa: beer please! “I insist” V: Oh you insist! “If you are to know of my presence, I insist you drink of my own blood” He walks out and holds the door open, where the angel lies cracked and bleeding, fighting against its bonds
V: Is pharasma okay with your treatment of her sister? “Do you doubt my methods viktor?” V: I feel If i was a god and my closest person did that to my sister– “Are you one to question cruelty against your sister?” D: It wasn’t cruelty, it was out of compassion He is taking Viktor to another room, closer to where the party is. Dasa follows, not allowing him to stay back and talk to pharasma sister OOC: How close are we allowed to get before we leave? We can touch her if we want. Dasa attempts to distract him while Viktor tries to leave his thieves tools D: If you are here, where is your god?
“My god is me, I was meant to kill one, I was bred to kill Gorum himself then marry death” D: So you’re not an angel, “No I’m what the layman would call an Exemplar™” The King Talks to Dasa who seems confused by his responses but when aren't they sometimes THE ANGEL HAS THIEVESTOOLS PLANTED ON THEM!!!!!!!! He leads Viktor to a side room, he has various veins and arteries and hearts laid out like an anatomical diagram Looking at it, Viktor sees that the facial features match the king’s own and there are enough people here to match his royal family. Judging by the eyes staring at you they are alive still “This is the price of betrayal Viktor.”
“You do wound me, since you refused my offer of the house that time, so I’ll offer you a deal. Your arm or Sabine.” V: My arm. It will be unfortunately VERY PAINFUL DOES AT 62 HIT YOU???????? Yes <3 The arm is clean cut with 160 damage. Viktor is down and brought back at 1 hp. Viktor, from now on, you are only considered having one arm. OOC: Don’t worry we’ll find you another! Zack: Oh you’ll try :-) He feeds you his own descendants blood As the blood falls out on you: “Drink up, this is the best it get.” Back to the main room “My great grandchilder has decided to sacrifice himself in place of his sister. Clap.” “You;’re lucky i didnt do what I did to the last group, I made them clap for 24 hours and the first 4 who stopped were sacrificed “
Fun Fact: He was in the first major fight you ever did,. Yniesse Zenderholm bled on his picture while turning herself into a vampire. Foreshadowing is a literary device. “So you came through the tower. How were the ghosts? Lively?” No issue “They werent worthy of life. I tried to be fair, i killed their loved ones in front of them to try and inspire vengeance.” “Did you kill anyone else on the way down?”
P: yes. Shino Hakusa?
“I see.” he reaches his left hand out, gloved hand reaches into nothingness, boneyard radiance Pulls out shino hakusa, naked, covered in dust “Go get dressed, you need to get back to work.” P: what work does she do? “Killing the false priests. Any priest who is no good for war is not good for humanity.”
Y: so like. You wanna help me get these runes back right? So you can have the cool battle? If you had to pick a city in old owariyaru where she and her sister lived, where would it be? “Are you simply asking?” Yeah
“I appreciate the bravery in the face of madness. Shitaro, though it doesn’t exist anymore. It’s about 10 miles south of the current town of Shilyn. Sounds like the god, but spelt with an I. i wouldn't recommend going there, they likely have the rune and, unfortunately, the… abbot also happens to be one of the two head priests of Pharasma. Though i guess he’s the only one that’s left.” P: what happened to the other?
“The other one dared to cry on my wedding.” Ludolf Aumerce K: was he the only one there? “Yes. he cried heresy, so i slit his throat.” D: what do you see in pharasma “Simple. I am the god of war. My goal is to meet her.” “Shino hakusa said, as she died, ‘kill me, but anything for my siblings.’” M: howd you meet?
“Some upstart of the new age sent abominations into my capital and destroy my descendant, as i found my queen, and then tried to leave through my sewer. They all ran, except for her, who stood and fought.” OOC
Avare brit mentioned meeting a great evil in tunseel that caused him to want to bring the gods back
If avare succeeded and opened the Divine Gate, perfect for him K: are we still allowed to be publicly in tunseel? “Give me 2 days to let me talk to my current one. He should allow it. If he doesnt, ill remind him what it means to fail.” “You can wait 2 days, explore, but avoid the door.” “Avoid saying my name. Those who know my true nature get destroyed.” HE DID THE BLOOD ROCK LIKE 4 TIMES TO MAJOR CITIES “It was petrify. I can place a few conditions, since i’m my own god.” P: do you think dasa would have divine protection (with seeing? “I do not know. The solar refused to speak for some reason. Because of that, i do not know if it is worth the risk of injuring dasa.” P: and i assume just being a cleric is not enough divine protection
“To see a god? No. especially not one who hates you. She and naderi had an odd… call it a conniption. And odd relationship.” P: how so? “I believe that due to some circumstances, she (pharasma) wished to be reunited with lovers in death.” She had jealousy of those who could die and be reunited D: Do you know any way I can find my maker or who my maker is? “I’ll find it. Those thieves tools will be ineffective against the angel. And she’ll begin talking. Do i have permission to send the answer i get out of it?” “Then i will do so.” P: much appreciated. “Please enjoy my streets and my city.” Thanks……. We try to leave, but the door is strong
“Before you go, i want to test something. To see how shino hakusa might have faired with a small blessing of mine. A minutest kind. You may leave, but if you wish to gamble, and you yearn for blood, as is your nature. You can kill her right here and now. She did kill your mother.” Morven says no “Very well. She will find you on the road.” “If you die, i will rip you out to inform you of your inadequacies and give you a blessing. Send you on your way.” P: would you know innately, or would you know? “Should you die outside of my conditions, no benefit.” Argue to do it spontaneous, he agrees, lets us leave. Ends the killing of priests for shino hakusa to hunt us down. If she fails, she’ll be indestructible and be tortured 5ever
There is a path to capital of ensile, one to old Azerin, Caldera, and one that one goes to Firkotin Going to Firkotin Oddly humid for an area so tundra-esque Exit into a cave of greenery into one that is hard druid territory Known as giant and druid land Nature fights back against civilization Blessed by erastil, grows a tree that normally takes 30 years in a year Despite it being winter, this cave is humid Walk through
Exit the cave in the middle of the night, goes to the unnamed capital of Firkotin, also known as Firkotin (City) Some hole, outside of lucious farmland Farmers get lumber and crop profits Very clearly a few plants have turned to look at us, leshies being born A place where a great druid let its leshy familiar die Dasa, in wildsong: hello “Hello” D: This place is beautful “Youre beautiful as well. We’ve not seen one of you move before.” D: I'm quite surprised myself “Is there anyone you wish to talk to it about? The various druids know things of it.” D: I'd love to understand my condition for who created me “Are you created and not born?” D: would you know anyone? D: I don't know I have many people telling me different things. Unless you would know?
“Oalian may know. Very old, knows many things. Before even gods.” D: Gods you say? “Nature existed before gods. Nature continues existing after god’s death.” D: Would they be able to tell me my history? “No way to be certain.” D: I'd like to take a chance D, in common: so guys i think they know a guy, he seems really smart “To great root.” Go into town, a giant kin rushes at us “Do you understand what i am saying!!!” Yes??? “Youre intelligent?” Yes! “Then youre intelligent enough to know not to come in town.” D: I GOT PERMISSION FROM SOMEONE TO COME, THESE ARE MY COMPANIONS “Are you a druid?” D: yes! “By whose circle?” D, wildsong: IDK Giantkin looks back, repeats it One says, in wildsong: potential heretic Giantkin, man of 8ft tall “id offer food, but IDK if you take tea, meat, or my own flesh.” Y: yurei i take tea! “Does anyone have anything else more reasonable other than my blood?” Morven and rosalind take tea, morven takes meat
“Could i get your names? I am Droktug.” Y: do you guys bury the dead here? “Of course. Its natural to bury in the field.” P: speciality coffins? “Why a coffin if theyre meant to be eaten by nature?” Y: we can make the coffin edible! “I suppose there might be some use of hiding the dead before theyre buried. If theyre able to be fully absorbed by nature in a week, who’s to fuss?” “I am the smallest in my family. Does the coffin cost more for larger sizes.” Y: we can give a discount M: whens the last time you got a massage by chance? “I learned of the way of the bear??” Hes willing to sign a deal Arguably, due to the lax laws of firkotin, its legally binding “Why are you here? To sell coffin?” P: yes and to pursue our friends spiritual quest of being a druid and a skeleton “Oalian may have an idea. But it does mean he has to say yes to you all. Once you make your case, all will be done.” K: who is that “The great the tree. The first tree.” K: how can we meet with oilean “You have to present something interesting enough to move the tree. You can speak any language you wish. Be it an item, be it a story, the world will not judge.” “You will have to spend a day in the village. He responds slowly.” V: will it be an issue? Us being undead? “You may have to go back to the hole you crawled out of.” P: has anyone else shown up in the middle of your fields? “Ive seen scarecrows and banshees? They were wraiths, but screamed like a banshee.” Soln 3, 1264 Droktug meets us with an umbrella, holds it towards dasa “Oalian has agreed to meet with you. But if you case a spell, he will kill you. I hope these are okay, otherwise i ask you go back into the hole you came.” Approach One of the edges of his roots, swells and manifests margit wood into a sentient being “You are here to seek your nature” D: yes. I have a question on where i came from. And. well. Thats the question. Idk my maker, was i born, was i created, i just came ouit of somewhere “Everyone came out of somewhere. You had not died.” D: so im technically not undead, but i am undead “Are you undead, or merely dead?” D: i dont think im dead? Im still moving “IDK if undead fits you, you may use druidic magics as you wish.” P: an angel of pharasma once said dasa has never died “What does that tell you?” D: that im not dead? “That youre not undead. What is the nature of death?” D: to not be alive? “Are you alive?” D: yes? “You are not alive.” D: but im living arent i? “No. I wish for this to hurt as little as it can.” prays “please survive.” Hit with a 9th level heal “You are not living then. It is a simple dichotomy of this world.” D: so im not dead. Im not alive “You are undead, but youve never lived.” “And you are able to… (wildsong) able to know this.” D: i see. “You are one with nature, but you defy all laws of it. So i ask, what are you?” D: a druid “I need more. I see many a druid. But none of you.” D: a…. Skeleton…. Druid “Again, i imagine all that i know, and none are similar to you.” P: you know when you summon a creature, not a ritual, but on the spot, and they come from nowhere, maybe-
“They come from the magic essence of the Forgotten Realms.” “Its possible (that dasas a summon), but he wouldnt be able to learn. Not meaningfully.” D: i learned that i… might just be a summoned druid? P: he learned a lot of spells “It wouldnt count. Such creatures of manifestations of what was will never become what will become.” V: similar to a leshy, perhaps? “What creature would make a leshy like him?” V: IDK? Morven has a decent thought, would not a leshy to pharasma be a skeleton that happens to have magic? M: what if pharasma made a leshy? “I… shant speak of this, and you shant know this. Thus. (wildsong) to create a leshy is to give part of myself. You would need to have something that belongs to pharasma embedded in thy being. It is the only way to know for sure.” The ring!!!! Dasa begins fainting “I apologize, it might be too much for you all. Might i offer you some wood?” K: margit wood? I heard you should have some if youre over a certain age “I am made entirely of it. The progenitor of said wait.” Y: profit?
“Why would i want profit? I already had one being try. She betrayed the whole world. A small, ugly lady named Aurela.” D: would you perhaps know (takes out ring) this? Its been with me since i was presumably dead
“It belonged to a group of priestesses before the great dark. The sign of their mother and the sign of life. Thus they would bury the dead. The gem made out of whatever creature made you’s mother.” (dasa is not pharasma. Dasa is the milf. -zack)

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.description:
Prev Session: Session 44
Next Session: Session 46 Soln 3, 1264
Firkotin (City)
Oalian
P: speaking of Pharasmas family, we heard there was a shrine maiden like woman that possessed Pharasma's Sister?
“The revenant?” “That was what it was known by.” P: we believe that she is an descendent of this possessor and we’re a little worried, we call her auntie “It might not be the real thing, might be an echo. A creature that powerful would still leave fragments of the soul” V: sealed her up. Split her up
“Are you familiar with what the world was like before she bound death? There were 12 Rules of Death, each time someone died, it would fall under the 12 rules randomly. Some of the rules allowed some of the dead to exist in various states. About 5. Creating plagues of undead that would be killed constantly but would kill more than they were killed.” K: thatd be unfortunate “Trees falling in the forest without fungus.” “They were unified under pharasma. She made reason of them all.” P: if something were to happen to her, what would happen- is that a prominent ruleset where itll always happen, or- “She’s dead, but the rules she make stay.” K: how does her being dead works since she was already dead? “IDK if death is the right word. The gods didnt die, theyre no longer among us. Whether they ascended higher or cease to be, it makes no difference. Thus it makes no sense to worry.”
P: were you around when the divine gate was always open? What was it like? “The gate doesn’t stay open, only when one would ascend or went in. it was a separate plane where one could travel. But i was barred from it.” “I cannot leave a plane of natural life, but not a plane of non-natural life.” P: if pharasma, could she undo the 12 deaths? Make them separate again? “She could.” P: vampires. Were they around then? “Of course.” P: how did they interact with death “Those who were dead (smth) some could reincarnate. You could still be wished away, but it was significantly harder.” P: where did that apply? “South i believe of here. Though i do not know the name in modern terms.” V: what is the non-modern name?
“Khentimentiu.”
Before the elven nation. The one that the mummy ruled over (Tunseel & Jafatan area) “That’s a lovely place down there if you ever get to visit.”
V: i am from there, but more modern. Tunseel.
K: question. Do you know what happened when Grundiir fell? I heard about it “I do not. I think the roots don’t go that deep. There were brethren in there you could ask, but i don’t know where they are.” P: is there a way to find them? “If i could fine them, i would have.” P: i figured we could walk, that could help. Yknow. (insert description) “Oh yeah that is” “If you did end up killing them, know you would not be welcome in this forest again. Destroying entire ecosystems for your own selfish gain.”
V: Dasa here has talked to a tree that resides in tunseel, it claims it was connected to two other (west / south) , its called Memoirebebur “Yes they exist.” VC: Have you been able to speak to it , to the roots or you just know they exist “I know they exist independently of us and they all choose to root for some reason where immortality and great death shall be achieved.”
(Might be connected to the immortality world tree situation in Travespoir) V: That is concerning that one has rooted in the capital burt that does make sense why it rooted itself there
“Of course fate has found its way there, I do believe that it is related to the Sicane Tree [SP] of which we shant spek” V: The Sicane [SP] tree, is there any more you can tell of about that? “I do need you to disarm before I tell you about that, I mean no offense looking at you” We disarm WILDSONG: Cover you ears children, be ready to shoot if they start moving unnaturally Various birds and squirrels in the forest will begin moving objects towards their ears to block sound “IF you wish no to take part in it, I do recommend you leavE” But to those that have disarmed small roots will grow over the disarmed objects, rooting them to the ground and covering themin slight dirt
“I am only telling you since you dont possess life you might be partially immune, primordial evil on the Plane of Wood, it is a seer tree that tells prophesied but hates all life.” “It hates life and it has perfect clarity, so it will tell you whatever truth and lie that will cause the most destruction and hate and losso flife” V: why would us learning about this affect us? “If your ancestors had touched it and you learn of it you will start growing violent.” V: Thats concerning “There are many concerning things in the world that the young mortals should not worry themselves about anymore” V: Okay… P: Does that mean it has been contained somehow?
“It has been isolated in the Plane of Wood where there are keepers that burn any life that would attempt to revere it just outside of the range here its able to whisper.” V: How many reside there? “Many druids choose to bind their souls to the task”
“Though we lost contact with them when the pale collapsed. The world used to be larger but that is a tale for another time” P: So the fact that these trees can see that there will be death, makes you think thisll be connected to this other tree? “Yes and that they refuse to talk to the other nature.” P: so they talk to druids? “Occasionally, but rare.” P: they were willing to talk to dasa “Probably bc they’re not life.” P: any communication thru dasa for them? “None that I can seek the answer to or make meaning of.” P: should we assume advice from those trees might be of a similar, destructive vein “I wouldnt trust them, even trees can life.” P: ty, good to know M: real quick, you know erastil- “I’ve met him a few times”
M: my brain is not of my own, but- thats most of my body parts. So the person who was the brain’s owner originally was a monk of erastil, i just wanted to ask how he would feel about undeath and finding yourself and finding sense of everything when ur made of many parts
“He didnt approve of undeath, but gods and mortals vew things differently. I knew a vampire who was a priest of sarenrae. You do not need be natural or worship erastil to serve nature.”
M: there’s a fox back home im trying to make friends with who seems to be on his lonesome
The King's Ballroom Approach
Audovère fi'Alémanie the First awaiting us “did you have a nice trip up in Firkotin.” Yes ur majesty, ty for asking “Of course. It is beautiful.” Yes, how did you get a portal so close? “I set it up for a personal mission. For all of its beauty, it would be better marked with a red sky.”
“Red sky refers to, ah, forest fire. Closest i could get to a war against the natural war. It is a mundanely small forest. I wouldn’t burn down Yenitaht of course.” P: why this forest? “A granddruid, a tree who is quite powerful. He doesn’t have the ability to come to me, so that i will go to him. He is the most powerful druid i have met, there are some coming from the west, but i have no way of getting there without spending actual power.”
(Caldera, out of curiosity, is where he spent the next little bit of his stuff towards.)
(Might be talking about Niven?) V: is there somewhere we can rest when we’re tired? “Of course, i can assign you a private chamber? Would you like one each or one total.” V: one should be fine “Of course. There are 5 of you, so i will make sure its 5 stories tall, with a central staircase.” P: are you able to reshape this domain? “Partially. I can use my power. Helps to be a god.” “It’ll only take 10 mins. When you enter, itll be the first room on your left.” P: ty. Are there any other rooms-? “Any. i have no secrets to hide. It’s only a matter of you surviving.” “I have elven ghosts who reside here. I use them as sparring partners. Despite their undeath, i allow them to still use fear and pain when their comrades die.” “Would you like a sample?” P: i think i already feel fear He makes us do a will save Pleasant for phil, back alive for 10 mins For viktor its pleasant for a second until the pain in his arm starts up again. Blood spirting out. “Make sure not to dirty my ballroom.” Has to tourniquet his arm with a table cloth Dasa blinks out of existence for a bit P: im sorry viktor “Don’t be sorry. It was his own fault. If he does good, i will attach it again.” P: it would be good to have a medic with 2 arms again “He will learn resourcefulness.” He lets us leave Top floor beds Next is viewing area 3rd is kitchen 2nd closet/bathroom 1st reception Soln 4th, 1264
Ammurun We pick up newspapers Crawl out of the sewers Convoluted way to the church Kholeran and Morven are able to see, during the torrential rain in the night Guards whisper at us being here Someone on the rooftops follow us but stops
Not Shino Hakusa Taller and bulkier Anyone following us will have to go thru the open
Church of Light Hear prayers echoing throughout
Lucrèce de Montluc “You’ve returned. The words of your removal of the favor of the state were exaggerated, no?” P: well. No. V: it is not desirable fixing but at least we are able to enter the country again “Do you have word of my disciple?” V: we brought your request to her attention and she refuses to fight you. “I see. Then I shall have to maybe forsake honor at the end.” V: For what its worth we could help you out, but you are a kind man when you arent trying to kill us “To be fair, both of us do deserve to die.” V: You know, yeah, all things considered I understand the sentiment V: Have you heard anything about the stealing of the saints? “The saints have been stolen but we still have one. Know that he is secure” V: I wont push. Good work. I hope he remains safe. I hope they are not using the saints for anything blashphemous “I dont know if it counts as blasphemous, I dont know if the rule of gods has any sway and more or if this is part of the plan” (Remember, vampires stole these saint corpses, they are like 2 streets away.) “I hope my plans don’t inconvenience you.” M: what plans? “To find a priest that does deserve death and be killed by his congregation.” P: whats the criteria?
“Corruption of the church and state. For failing our head priest Avare Brit in our time of need.”
Dione Group HQ
Dione Group See someone thru the windows, he meets us outside, holds an umbrella over viktor “Right this way sir”
Leads us inside “shall i contact Dione for you master viktor?” V: yes…. “She will be here in the hour.” Hands a menu for those Offers him a glass of blood “Dione knows you lost about 15 pounds” “I shall be back with a present from her.” 3 employees, 1 head, 1 child, and 1 equal to the head (for doing an offshoot family) After about 30 mins, hear the door open as the girl opens it for Dione who walks through “Viktor you survived your first meeting!” V: I sure did, what a wonderful meeting it was -.- “And the rest of you somehow made it as well” V: Is that a surprise? “He normally kills one as a message, if it means anything I suggested the least among you for sacrifice.” V: Who? “Kholeran of course” K: Do you have any food…? V: Perhaps he was simply just in a good mood “Perhaps he was in a wonderful mood, things have been going smoothly for him and war is on the horizon.” V: It seems he is thrilled “Who wouldnt be? We get to bring righteousness to heathens. And in the coming week we get to avenge our family Viktor.” V: Who else are you fighting? “I will tell you but I need something Im aware that you know. I just need the name of shino hakusas siblings.” V: Why? “Shino hakusa is a powerful tool but one that needs motivations, we ll ensure she has the proper motivation. :) V: by endangering her siblings? “They wont be in danger, she will do it” “do you care for shino hakusas siblings or your own more?” V: Actual siblings?
“Sabine, dont be obtuse. The hypothetical injury of someone you care not for or the very real injury brought upon our family. V: My family “Don’t worry. I will do all the dirty work for you” V: What do you have planned? “I just need to talk to Shino Hakusa, something you seem incapable of without violence. we want the monastery we need someone to lower the gate”
V: Are you planning to invade Sternbore “No the one in tunseel” They need someone who’s adept at climbing and killing monks V: are you certain that shes even going to-- well to be quite honest shes been ordered by the king to hunt us down and she cant really say no to that “No she cant, but she may make a detour and Im sure I can propose this in a way that will make him very happy” V: I just -- you would hurt sabine because I say no? “Sabine is already hurt. whatever happens she cannot move, she may not survive what is yet to come. do you think the king would be so loose as to let one of his own lie there helpless and not take the opportunity to snuff out weakness in his own line?” V: he would. It is a miracle he hasn’t already “Because I have asked. She could have already died twice. once when you abandoned her and now.” M: Where is the monastary? “I can’t tell you that V: what’s the harm in that? “As the honored guests of tunseal you would be distracting the current kings power if you got caught slaughtering monks “And that wouldn’t reflect kindly on the king, now would it? M: could you at least give the gods that they worship? “Do not worry it is not Erastil. They do not have the capability to carry out an assassination, especially one so deep in tunseel territory.”
V: their names are Aki Hakusa and Tone Hakusa
“Thank you, now we can start exchanging true info. Monastery of the Northern Sun. it’s being operated by those who dared to assault you on the boat. Their underlings got word that the higher ups were planning a mission and jeopardized it. The name is Gorvain Lecrân. He's a Cecian Nocturn. There are children up there, but i am sure that will be no issue.” V: are you killing the children? “No. i am letting half of them live. They will learn the folly of their ways and spread it to the living. We don’t have to do it, but its either kill them all or kill some.” (this appears she worked with the king and got his approval. At the very least, this would cause full escalation of a war of a monastery being attacked close to the capital with witnesses.) “We will prepare for the assault in 4 days. Take your preparations. For now, viktor, a gift. I have been told there are some modifications. Every hour itll dig into the arm to induce pain as a remainder. And youll need to drink blood of not morven for it to work.” “We both agree that its time for you to be above the living.” V: it seems like you are both acting as my parents…. “I am your sire. I am closer a bond than any family can be. It is familial and it is intimate.” V: is that what you believe “That is what is true” V: I believe we will have to agree to disagree “You may believe what you will, but I will believe the truth.

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.title: Session 46
sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.description:
Prev Session: Session 45
Next Session: Session 47 Soln 4th, 1264
Ammurun Downtime
Phil looking at Elethera Vainwin’s Book of Lost trees Elethera has made a new word, a Tendency The trees indicate the world was incredible chaos, that led to age of monsters, age of heroes, age of desolation & poverty, then current day Using the Tendency of the tree, you get a fairly accurate approximation of when the age of gods ended and the age of chaos (war of the gods) began Get the true account of gods, not lied about gods but filtered through nature via the trees The underground once had a sun underground that then left to the south Get amber from the underdark trees, might be easiest to get from a dwarven lord’s stash
Viktor gather information abt Gorvain Lecrân Lecran is a beloved man, ppl love talking about him Hes had various disputes with other local monasteries Very aggressive, known for bouts of anger (tho he does control himself) (barbarian?) He does tend to hunt undead across boarders, creates tensions from local lords, he doesnt really get prosecuted
He and Pheylor Tenthall were close as rival schools, but with her falling out he’s become the defacto leader and become somewhat more recluse Viktor follows him on day 3
See him go to the Guiere Base
Temple of Gorum that’s also a fortified base He stops by a local tailor, stays within for a suspiciously long time (15 mins) Viktor gets shot at with a letter, “climb down” -> go to bakery (they go on a date) “I wouldnt rely on such tricks, when youre a hunter youre used to seeing the unseen.” “It’s a lovely night.” Yes i wish it wasnt raining “It cleans the streets for us” “Up on the mountain, it brings up mud and other hazards. But here in the plains, its a pleasantry at best.” This guy really likes the rain maybe he likes being wet “Of course i built them i saved them from monsters such as yourself” when viktor asks about how the people like him a lots The date seems awkward
How long were u hunting that vampire in Vitry-Seilave “4 days i heard you were coming so i waited” Its a little gay to hunt a vampire so closely i think.
“I learned it from the old master Saya Cleatiure” There were murders that went unexplained by just being on a mountain which is how he figured out she was a vampire Would a you blame a shepherd for killing a wolf near his sheep [Insert viktor ramble about his mistakes and how it is not his sisters fault] “But, her turning into a vampire, it brings me no joy to say this, but as a doctor, you have to separate the leper from the people” He’s tried to deal with the ones in the city but hasn’t been able to take care of them yet “I could start here if you so desire” V: No, there are many in the city that i do not agree with-- “Dont be coy, say their names and I will begin the hunt. dont worry I’ll leave room for you”, He keeps talking about hunting and catching people guys i dont know V: they’ll kill me (basically) Hes proposing “You walk back to them and i will follow i will be more silent than you” What a weird proposal V: Let us pray that your silence is enough
Viktor WALKS BACK TO THE Dione Group HQ
Arriving at the Dione group; assistant Viktor how may I help you? V: any more of that vintage from the other day? Of course, anything for you, to give courage We are unsure if the murder monk magus is following After 30 min Viktor excuses himself He does not meet up with Viktor and we don’t see him, even if viktor looks around really hard Yurei crafting mines Morven ritual Slowly losing memories of each part until nothing Great power for each 3 of memory burned Lose 3 people = 1 free reroll (that DOES stack with hero points)
Dasa going to the Monastery of the Northern Sun Wisdom of the winds Best way to silently escape the monastery Easiest way is to fall off the monastery and ask the wind to catch you Down along the cliff, but especially along the north
Along the mountain is rows and rows of vineyards convering the entire Tunseel landscape Hard to hide Where’s viktor’s sister? Wind blows far to the north east
Any danger in near vicinity Blows down from the monastery Influence Nature “influence nature to notify a pathway so that escapee can hide into the hidden area” “And then make the hidden area more hidden” Kholeran Vanishing into the woods Northwest, surprisingly safe place to eat wildlife Lots of rocky terrain Soln 9th, 1264 Fairly barren but surprisingly lively leaves of the local flora Rain will fall upon the monastery Dione leads us up “Now. you do know what we need to do, right?” You want all inside the monastery to die “No, all the adults, but half the children. I am no monster.” Of course…
“Now, the way that i plan to do this is simple. We have Shino Hakusa up there wrecking it. If you could take care of key influential figures. I will take care of the one who injured my first grandchilder. Though i will make sure that you, if i have the luxury, let you get the final blow. Hopefully he has his formula book on him. We will bring back poor sabine. And i hope that we work together again in the future.” Idk we’re competing businesses “We’ll sign a merger.” Will you be the one to be merged “Sure”
“Would you like to kill a priest of Sarenrae?” (family had papacy of sarenrae, but a new family took over. Religious seat in tunseel gives an insane amt of political power. They did lose it, but theyre the equivalent of a normal noble family with high religious connections now.) “He is decently powerful, but you will be more powerful, im sure. If you wish to fight him you may.” Who else should we anticipate in there?
“Alceste Lagarde. Anastacie Chefaur. The old Guild Master. Luc Giltaut. Medad Radine. Rosaline D’Taine.” “Might i propose, we have a mage ready to teleport us up there. Might i recommend that, or do you have your own way to climb?” Teleport up, dione uses an odd scroll with bits of silver lining the text (able to teleport all of us)
Penned with the hand of Pharasma, given it power beyond normal Enhances power in multiple ways: double the distance, halving the mishaps, or doubling the targets Dione casts sending, flash of people swarming throughout Infantry takes over
Recall knowledge, they’re various soldiers covered ion the colors of Fathrell. Dirty and underhanded attack. Call upon the armies upon Fathrell
Morven disguises as Amoanch
Viktor disguises the ensile king’s guard Maîtreé Charbonne Combat They were prepared for us Temple lets sunlight in no matter the angle of the sun Alceste was able to instantly disbelieve this bc pope “I see the truth. You are not the incestuous fucker.” @ viktor who is disguised Tried to chant a 7th rank heal (somehow), and then is shot by Kholeran

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.title: Session 47
sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.description:
Prev Session: Session 46
Next Session: Session 48 Soln 9th, 1264
Monastery of the Northern Sun non-fathrell infantries are currently pincered between infantry units
Rosaline D’Taine and Darian Evan, distant relative of Gorvain Lecrân and a noblewoman stationed here
(are we full on betraying Dione here? Discussion time. Basically angering dione + True King of Tunseel, has sister ramifications and arm ramifications for V; dione could be stupored which would be just her not reporting back, rather than her dying and being resurrected quickly, just a couple hours is Anything for us) A lead lined coffin would be annoying for him to manage and find. Temporary removal of The Dione Situation so we can gtfo
She’s starting the war in Fathrell + wiping out our hometown; if we stupor her it will delay and weaken his effort for wiping out our hometown
Also if viktor’s Grandsire (Lume j'Estrilla) finds out it puts us better in his eyes (they dont like us rn =/ ) We Can Get Out Of Here Alive
Sister might be in Flamhaltn (directly w/in cone and has a tower TP point) We go upstairs to the second floor and have found no survivors (buncha dead people indoors and on the roof in various places) Morven jumps across the roof
Shino Hakusa is the guard at the Dione fight “You betrayed my family viktor” V: i’m sorry, my sister was on the line “And now my brother and sister are on the line” V: we can make sure that nothing happens to them if you let us pass “No you can’t” V: I fear that you do not have much faith in our ability ​ “I do not, no.” V: then maybe you should have some faith “Why should I? You fucked it up again viktor” V: and i am trying to fix it. As i am always trying to do “Well maybe we should make sure you stop trying” It’s another shino hakusa fight baby She tries to kill viktor, but fails a will save before it and starts vomiting black ash and becomes stunned Dasa gets the last hit on her Now we heal up while we’re figuring out where to go We go down and are like right at the room where dione was fighting Gorvain has already been defeated by dione and tied to a chair She has removed his bow fingers and part of his face Dione has his weapons, but many of his items are still on him She is drinking his blood in a cup while it drains from his hand Phil tries sneaking closer to send him a message P: Do you have the vampire poison on you? Should we come help you? If so where is it? Philomene “I keep a vial under the back of my armor. It’s still there.” Viktor climbs down to carry out the plan “I see shino hakusa did not kill you” V: whatever you said made her upset. … (i missed a second) “I know we said we would kill him but I have a better idea. how about you embrace him and give himthe option to kill himself or become your childer” V: no “Why not” V: every one of my childer has passed. It’s like a big curse i’m passing along “It’s not a curse, just a hard way of life” “Even so, I won’t have another childer pass like that” Viktor sidles around to his back and kinda gropes the guy “You know who you remind me of viktor? Me when i first turned. You might be the most successful childer yet” V: that is a bit unnerving to be quite honest Viktor starts to pickpocket Rosalind begins the distraction Creating an illusory creature in a guard uniform that starts talking like “yes sir, as we discussed” followed with the king saying some kingly shit Dione turns towards the noise and viktor manages to grab the vial Same as in the coffin of sabine “Sorry I wasn’t expecting company. Lets get on with it.” V: I understand. Viktor steps forward with his dagger as if to slice his throat, then crushes the vial with his hand and tries to grab dione’s face HE MANAGES TO DO IT?? She looks at him dead on and says “This is why you’re my favorite. Lecran, jump” He jumps off the edge under dominate “Viktor, were you looking for this?” and she throws the vial off the thousand foot ledge “I told you, you’re too much like me viktor.” V: “What now?”
“We go see your sister and she’ll be delighted. Then if you care about Fathrell, that place you call home, you’ll take care of it and it will be a great success for your great grandsire. You’re the only one that can mitigate the casualties viktor.” “I do want to ask, to the person up there impersonating the king. What makes you think this is worthy of his time?” …. “Do you want to have a family reunion? Next sunset we will have a meeting and get teleported”
v: by your friend in Vitry-Seilave "But of course." We collect the body of the dead guy, the surviving kids are released by a monk that seemingly worked for dione
We want to head towards Ammurun but uh, it’s kinda hard to travel around so we stay in a cave instead Viktor is at the Dione hideout where sabine is in stupor surrounded by guards “Viktor, I know that you had some trouble but since you’ve helped me so much in the past few days i’d like to offer a slight rewrite of her memory so she thinks of you more fondly” V: If she hates me then that is just how it is. I cannot run from what I have done. “Yes but she isn’t happy in hatred. This way she can be happy, and isn’t that what’s important? V: I don’t think so. Regardless of how she was turned and who turned her she cannot be happy with her condition. Regardless of if it was me or you, she is still a vampire. She is still undead. She cannot watch the beautiful sunrise without risking death “Yes, but this way she could have her brother back. V: her brother died a long time ago. That is what she believes and that is what is correct “It’s not about what she believes it’s about what you believe V: I am her brother in my heart and I am fine with accepting that. I am not going to change her memory just because I am unhappy with the outcome Soln 10th, 1264
Tunseel Cave moment. It’s Auntie Miko time Y: Hey auntie there’s been a bit of an accident and we need you to bring this guy back for us. Can you do that? It takes a few hours but definitely He is revived in 6 seconds w/ manifestation and then auntie just fuckign leaves in a hurry via Gate Sitting there shocked and grabbing his hand as it reforms over the next hour Yurei teleports to somewhere that appears to have many floating islands in the distance as she steps through a portal and leaves
Owariyaru aka land of wind where the land can be disconnected by it Going back, this time in enough of a hurry that she uses gate instead of teleport Morven and Kholeran follow P: Do not worry about that. I am philomene how are you? R: I’m rosalind
“Both the undead of Anmoku Funeral Parlor? Associates?” Both: Yeah basically “Am I in hell? P: no, through some personal sacrifice we have brought you back. “So what kind of undead am I now?” P: Technically you will show up as undead to your own tests, but it will pass after a day. Just a normal resurrection “Why have you brought me back?” R: You didn’t deserve to die “You have killed many people” P: You are against war and there is a war coming up “The war with fathrell? Who is doing it” P: The woman who made you jump off the cliff “My last memory is fighting fathrell soldiers” P: oh shit ok we sound crazy lmao. Lets see if we can fix that tomorrow. You told us about the vampire poison that you keep in the back of your armor. She had already taken it when we tried to use it. Vampires man, they suck We don’t think his memory is gonna return. Resurrection makes things fuzzy and rewrite memory would’ve just wiped it “You should dedicate yourself to killing them and yourself.” P: yeah ok we get that a lot. But about the war. Did nothing seem odd about those fathrell soldiers?
“It would be odd for them to invade so deep. But it would mean they want control of the [name] valley. Then it would follow that Ensile would be getting control over Milaun and theyd lose their independence P: we could go back and check bodies. We also saw a monk lowering children who appeared to work for dione. “He was one of mine” P: Oh he got dominated damn this sucks. This is so out of my league I was a schoolteacher. I would love to help you but I don’t know what I can do. “Are you not the queen consort?
P: Do you want to know who that letter telling me to shoot myself in the head is from? My loving husband
“Is he a follower of Pharasma? P: No it’s a whole thing. “You should not be here. We will solve your unfinished business or banish you P: well he’s probably my unfinished business “Well when tunseel wins the war you will be free P: Hey can we borrow your anti-vampire techniques?
“I am not an alchemist. I get all of my supplies from my master. Master Saya Cleatiure P: Could you make an introduction? “Yes but if you abuse his kindness then I will kill you. But first I will investigate this group you mentioned and if they are guilty I will kill them. Viktor time, everyone is moving about Dione conducts a ritual using an alchemical substance.
Sabine Keson awakens, hugging dione and then viktor Viktor gives dione a look and then hugs her back “I did not do anything. The stupor will take a while to set off. I don’t know if you have been in one for more than a day. It takes a while to regain all facilities, so she may not remember how much she hates you until it wears off. Take the day and enjoy it.” V: Thank you. I will enjoy the day with my sister “I will enjoy eternity with her.” and walks off into the night Owariyaru party “You were not invited M: saw a portal, had to check it out K: sorry i got confused “About what” K: i don’t know, that’s the point M: we can go if you want. “Where? We are on a mountain overlooking a town celebrating with fireworks M: wanted to say thank you for making me and see if you need us to do anything “Grab whatever merchandise you can from the stands. It’s a crowning and decrowning day.” A king has been recognized and a king has been derecognized in the same day M: anything in particular? “Anything in yurei’s size” Kholeran and Morven gather information around the festival Kholeran wanders up to a merchant and opens her mouth. The stink makes him run away, leaving all of his stuff for us to take Morven tries talking to a random guard M: Where are we?
“This is Haesi. The king has taken a crown and abdicated the crown to someone in Ruhhat.” M: Who?
“Gavin Rooks Revival crew
He takes the group through Ammurun, to a fortified area on the river. “No weapons and if he chooses to kill you I will do the same, despite my death.
Door opens on its own, Homveran's Shop “That is a sign that we are allowed to enter. Be sure to bow as deeply as you can” Phil just kinda floats Rosalind folds in half Dasa collapses into a pile then gets up The man working as the counter is like “who goes there?” R: “hi i’m rosalind. These are my friends dasa and philomene. We’ve come with lacraine
“You’ve finally thought to visit Rosalind” - SAYS Homveran CLEATIURE R: Yes, it’s been a chaotic time as i’m sure you understand. “Yes I had to kill a group of ghouls the other day. No offense to your group. Is the little one still around? P: yes “Ah that’s unfortunate. Maybe she’ll be redeemed yet” Some kind of philosophical disagreement between master and student P: what’s with the disagreement? H: On whether all of you should die. Some of you are predatory, some are peaceful. Like a dog removing a fox from a henhouse D: Who do you mean? H: Kholeran from your group. Yurei and viktor are also suspicious Party: “i mean viktor’s chill” H: yes but vampires have to drink blood from people Party: yes but his drinking blood is a whole point of contention H: Can you say that he hasn’t embraced anyone against his will? P: well he’s going through a lot. He’s missing an arm now and it’s been replaced with one that only works if he drinks human blood, since he’s so against it. H: Well then he will get a softer death. lacraine starts to talk Ah nevermind. We are here to talk about the toxin? P: yes dione had already predicted viktor’s betrayal and got rid of the vial. H: I can have one within the month. It doesn’t work all the time but if it’s doesn’t work it should stun the vampire. P: awesome H: you understand how it works right? On the skin it should enact sunlight upon the skin and grow a stake in the heart which spreads through the veins. This lasts for two weeks at which point the vampire is fine P: Well we saw it lasting for 6 weeks H: Shouldn’t be possible unless they have exceptionally weak blood. The most i’ve seen is 3 weeks. Party: any exceptions? H: Continued minor exposure could prolong it. I don’t want to torture anyone. Just make it painless and quick.
