sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-4.description:
Prev Session: Session 47
Next Session: Session 49 Soln 10th, 1264
Homveran’s shop, Ammurun
“so … you mentioned there was an attack on the monastery carried out by the Dione Group. Who ordered it?” P: dione’s group? “Yes but by the way you were talking, it was someone higher who called the shots” P: yes. But. hes about 1k years old and we’ll spontaneously combust if we say his name. Know he exists but its not a problem we can deal with. “I fought 1 vampire in my youth who was 1k before”
“The Corvenice Vampire Group. And their leader.”
Contingent of a warlord going south during the warring states in the east. Tried to take over Sabhailn, from Sighar, was killed by an uncredited assassin P: that is really cool tbh. But. well. “Not all vampires are created equal, such as man. 2 20 year olds can be vastly different power and their own potential.” P: true. He’s like a king of vampires. Kind of. “Most are.” P: he didnt claim but i noticed with my eyes. Which is worse. “Does he reside in sighar?” P: no. “Then why not?” P: he has many things in mortal affairs. Its a whole thing. He gained power of a large section of his country and then became a vampire. And didnt leave
“So he was a Vespertine man?” P: maybe? “If he conquered a thousand years ago and he resides in the east, that would be who he was under. Lest the kingdom no longer exists, but the way you’re saying it still does.” P: please watch out, please dont say his name. But i watched him rip off viktors arm. Its a whole situation, my- can i call you my friend? “If it brings you comfort in the afterlife.”
Gorvain Lecrân visibly disgusted P: i forgive you gorvain P: the vampire poison would be great… we will come back for that. Anything else i can help you with? “There is something else i could help with. If viktor is still along your side and has not betrayed you.” P: i mean i think so “There is a way to concoct a poison that would cause the sire to feel the pain of the childer. The poison does need to be administered to the sire, not the childer. It wouldnt be able to inflict pain only if it went to the victim.” P: any possibility- possibility to get formulas? Yurei can craft alchemically. “I would need them to sign a pact with me so they wouldnt sell such a thing and only use it for good.” R: it may involve more negotiation P: its so reasonable, i will tell yurei its the only option “I will have to talk to yurei. Where are they currently?” P: we had to offer… so you know the deal with yurei? From observing them? “I understand theyre a dhampir, and a wizard or witch based on the spells.” P: in order to bring your protege back, we had to loan her body out “Whats the patron?”
P: id love any context you have. A shrine maiden, a historical figure involved in the madness of Pharasma’s sister. Anything you know? Im scared “Of course, 1 second.” Brings out a perfume bottle, spraying it across the room “Laced with silver to ward off undead scrying.” P: i hope you find love in this life and the next. “Such a spirit is too strong for mortals to make a deal with.” P: it might be a part of it? It seems to have been split… R: it started at only 1/9th. 2/9ths. P: meddling forces. Parts keep getting fed to yurei “Its going to reconstitute itself.” P: yes, the other wants it to reconstitute itself so he can fight it. R: theyre externally in her homeland.
“Where will the battle take place? One is obv from Owariyaru.” “Oh so it was the one you were talking about.”
“He disappeared one day, presumably dead, his body mangled. Speaks to a dark truth. Potentially, he has no sire and is instead his own sire. IDK how it would have come to be, but i do know it would have happened in a small town of Vitry-Seilave. Perhaps there are clues there” P: perhaps we should go back to visit. Goddamn. Morven kholeran 5 mile walk thru the forest outside of the town, opposite direction of the temple Actual place where the teleportation circle appears to be a floating castle of owariyaru that crashed into the ground, the teleporter is embedded in the ground Crawl space, opens up into teleport room meant for the king Viktor Sabine seems horrified as she regains her memories Flinches, dione unsubtly casts message “Why did you do it, viktor?” V: you have to be a bit more specific “Kill me.” V: ….I don’t know. I’ve been working on the assumption that i woke up a bit too hungry…? Something went wrong (?) and i wish that were not the case Dione: You’re a monster viktor. The sooner you embrace it the sooner you can overcome it V: how did you overcome it? Dione: i embraced it and i found people i care about? (i kinda missed this part) V: is there anyone you care about? Dione: Yes. i have family that will never die V: well. It seems my family is right here, but i don’t know. Sabine: This is the second time you’ve killed me and the second time you’ve left V: and yet you’ve survived both. And i’m very proud of you. I’ll even give you the power i have V: what power?
Dione: Audovère fi'Alémanie the First is a vampire V: how did you do that? Dione: i’ve been blessed. Your sister has been too. She can say it V: has she met him?
Dione: no. you weren’t supposed to either but you did. My sire tried to keep me away but i met him all the same V: how did you meet him? Dione: through the sewers. I fought the ghost. And then i learned of the holy plan. I’m offering you, unlike my sire, the chance to learn from someone who walks among the people. I can give you the knowledge from someone who is on top V: what’s on top?
Dione: the people at war. The people vying for divinity. The people constantly being haunted. Also the pale lifting up towards the north allowing him to conquer new lands. Is that not a sign of divine intervention, of his right to rule? As he said he would conquer new lands the pale lifted.
V: this is quite alarming. Is he hoping to bring tunseel past the pale? Dione: tunseel? No. it will be all of mankind V: but under his banner Dione: of course. And you may take it. A man may challenge him at any time, you could do it right now. Win and he will give you his title. Stake it on the duel, a duel to the death. V: how would one even do that? Dione: with great power.
V: great power. The power to best one destined to fight gorum? Dione: of course V: that is a lot of power. It seems impossible for anyone in this world, on this continent Dione: probably. He wishes to spread his power. To remove death from those that fight. Allowing those without the will to do so to die as they deserve V: i simply don’t like it. I don’t like the situation. To fight and keep fighting. That is unnatural, even for those of our kind. Dione: is it? V: to keep fighting even when we should stop? Dione: is that not the blessing of vampirism? V: in a way. But i feel you are thinking too broadly with it. If a vampire dies once a vampire should stay dead Dione: do you feel the same way about your sister if she were to die right now? V: you know i don’t Dione: then it is not a true belief V: i know i am hypocritical Dione: then go on and abandon her for the greater good again. We are getting nowhere V: we are getting nowhere. As informative as this has been i don’t think i can convince you, and you cannot convince me Viktor finds yurei, who is wasted on a roof with pockets overflowing with gold, and tries to cure her hangover They start to head back to the teleport room V: there might be something in the teleport room. Hey wait why does Auntie Miko bring back armor from St. Sirnach?????

Get contacted by Lume j'Estrilla
Bring us to a tableroom she has constructed in the dream, in the Vlaundet Thaine form (the only one we’ve seen) Bonjour “First order of business. Hand over shiryo for safekeeping, safety, and my own insurance.” No??
“Why not, he is in no danger unless you betray me. Fathrell will go under a siege. The Anmoku Funeral Parlor lies outside the walls of the city” Y: hear you out first before i decide to give you my dad
“Current best course of action is to work with the king. I suggest you to seize fathrell and gift it to him” “Show him youre working with him. (stuff) also host him so you can capture him, burn him.” (business deal going on. If we fail, we die, she’s fine.) Y: better suggestion? One that doesnt get us killed? “Work with him for the time being unless youre strong enough to fight.” Y: when do i get my dads back? “When he’s dead, of course.” “Look at it this way, ive hidden from him for 200 years, and if anyone keeps them safe, itd be me” “Unfortunately i have no way of not making sure youre not working with him for real, and i do have one father.” She wont do a contract
“He can scry and ask a simple question to the gods and get a simple answer. Asking the god of words, ‘are they working with my enemies’, and he will reply yes.” “The only one he could ask in the name of treason would be a treacherous god, and the answer would be unreliable.”
P: will the fact that i am a direct servant of a deity be a problem? Do i have to step out? “Will your deity answer for treason? Is that their domain?” P: no “Then you will be fine.” “It predates the gods, but it is still one way to communicate to the gods.” Y: one they have to be kept in a place where i can sending “If they can sent to, they can be scried, if they can be scried, they can be found. You can send to me and ill let them talk to you.” Y: what benefit can you give us that you keep 2 parents of ours where we cant contact them “Info on how the king acts, ive been under his work for 900 years before 200 years of disobedience. I do know what this ultimate plan is. I also know how to avoid and thwart his plans if you wish to fight him.” Y: our expense? Are you going to keep sending us on suicidal hits? “Ive yet to do that.” (while it wasnt fathrell at the time, it is the same beaches where he first made landfall and began conquest to the south.) (one place the king wouldnt soil in conquest: new new world, far away. It would be unbecoming of him bc its his promised land to go right before it)
V: what is stopping him from punishing my sister?
“Nothing. The only one safe is Florence Anmoku.” P: can we count on your aid or just info? “If you have need for aid, of course” P: if we succeed in trapping, youll be there? “In spirit.” “You are not the only one i have been manipulating for this moment.” “He has a fondness for you. Makes it more likely hed fall for a trap.” P: youd never in your machinations come across a group that he is fond of? “He has people he likes, but he kills the people he likes.” P: if we give you their dad, would you tell us right away or? “Yes of course.” Y: but what about the business :( “You need money?” Y: through the business? “We can send money to the business, youll be sending coffins to the nearby battlefield from a charitable doner. They wish to stop ghouls that follow the soldiers.”
Any other blessings w Dione we should be worried about “He probably cured her of her deficiencies. She couldnt cast spells despite being a vampire. it skipped a line despite the bloodline. Can you cast spells?” V: nooo “In 2 days time, i will arrange a man stationed toward the docks, he will get shiryo as long as he takes a stroll.” “When shiryo is in my possession, we’ll talk. But only after he is off the boat will you get your info.”
“In the meantime, i would recommend you perform an assassination on the mayor.” P: can we just kidnap him? “No, that wont work.” P: why do we have to kill him, why cant we just have him surrender “I would recommend going to the estate, kill his champions alongside himself in the manor. Leaving their bodies to be found. Maybe leave a letter. Id also recommend going to the battlements, killing a few captains of the guard. Trust me, this is more humane than how i’d do it.” “I would personally burn the food rations and kill the priests so that they may not produce food.” “Make sure they have no hope, make sure the guards have no leadership. Some may resist, but without leadership, they’ll be promptly shut down” King probably knows all our plans if viktor said anything and knows where he is at all time (take off the arm if hes involved in important convos. It will be painful.) Viktor and phil go on a walk Shiryo heres the plan “Do we trust her?” No but shes bringing money for the business “How much money?” Pretty good deal all things considered, double what the business makes normally, also get whatever workers we hire and their profits “Ok so i just need to go walk by the docks. How will the kidnapping occurr. Preferably, id like the sleep spell.” Idk if they can spellcast “Assuming its not lethal, and they have a cleric on board (seems like they do) all concussions will be healed.” Morven goes and finds that fox
Rosalind talking to Tela ir'Vasimon’s cousin, Guran “How’s she doing? Is she alive?” Very much so! Doing as well as she can be! Made a comfy life more or less
“And um. Comfortable living more or less. Can one live comfortably up there?” Well as much as one can live comfortably in any place with war and violence. “I might be leaving the, war and violence is coming soon.” We have heard that yes “You’ve been gone for a while, when did you come back in town?” Last night ish “There were a few dead untended to, another group took care of it.” What group?
“Some funeral parlor from Tunseel.” Well. i believe we’ll be back, we will keep running in our absence this time. I apologize for letting this go untended “Its not your fault. I mean in the nicest way- the devil you work under?” Im sorry??? “The contract maker.” Yurei??? “Yes i believe thats her name” Nooo. well. Uh. i respect yurei a lot, theyve done a lot for me “They kept asking for contracts for a simple funeral deal” They like to have things in writing, theyve been burned before with not having things in stone “It doesnt bring comfort to the dyings family. Nor the dead.” This is…. Youve got the other two of us for that “No offense, but no one wants to be bombarded with 1k pages of text upon someones death” We’re working on it. I apologize “Despite it, i still prefer your funerals compared the others. Nice to know someone locally taking care” The others ive heard are less respectful than what we try to be “Their deals seem shady. Shadier than the contract’ How so? “Free funeral if they can do their own rites on it.” Oh spooky. Yurei and anmokus dont involve clients in the funeral things “No but they still charge.” Are they still in town?
“At the Tithe and Tan Tavern.” Any good news from home? Seems a bit dire. “It is winter, it brings out the worst of us. Food should be good, we should be able to hold out til spring.” Thats good news Phil viktor Phil looking at the arm, doesnt seem like the runes are on the outside Kholeran investigating the estate Trying to get an idea of guards A lot of the guards are unimportant lower guards (-1 to 1) outside of the captain of the guard, 2 of them Not a threat but not a 1 hit kill Best time to go would be 4am or 2pm The issue with 4am is that the mayor is awake 2 champions are there Elven woman and orcish noble man Woman is clearly a bard Other one is closer to being a ranger Best weapon is a bow, not his sword Phil reading the book that yurei brought back Mostly focuses on fiends and demons, going beyond our world and going to others
Devils moving recently with the Divine Gate opening Most are curious about the new world
One, however, named Bloody Hands has come back

And with the expansion of the lower city, unfortunately dangerous work, there will be plenty of dead” V: it seems we have our work cut out for us “You do. Try not to leave for another several months” Best time to attack the guards will be when theyre off duty We could break into the base and kill them on shift and then leave
3 days waiting for Lume j'Estrilla contact During which: phil making contact with nobles Get a few that no one is going to openly support treason, phil makes a convincing argument
Shiryo Anmoku does get kidnapped, gets hit over the head Sails out onto the water before meeting up with a larger vessel before going away Viktor watching dione group Minor branch, they have letters that talk about anmokus family parlor Keeping an eye on a rival business None seem to be in the know J’estrilla contacts us again Simple dream that she’s designed Round table with a map of the surrounding area “Ok so the plan.” “He will meet up with you by sheer conviction that you cannot kill him. He does believe that even in the sun, if the entire city grouped up he would survive”
Whats stopping him from stepping out of the boneyard? “I dont believe he could do it to himself.” “He wants to transform them both into one soul and mind, if not body.”
“He has procured a devilish doctor that will stitch the bodyparts of hers into him.” “I will get more slates to talk, dont touch those that have been sanctified by less than 20 years, it will burn.”
“I typically follow Sarenrae.” “As for how to get him up there, i suggest a building without a basement or pipe that he can go into gas. Tricking him into staying up. Burn it down in the day time.” P: would he agree to a challenge from viktor for those who could stay out in the sun the longest? “He may. But viktor would lose.” V: i have not burned in the sun for a month now “An oddity. He may try to drain your blood.” P: by the way, if you would be interested, they have invented a poison that causes the sire to feel the pain of the childe, you may be interested in that
“If he learned of it hed probably kill Sabine Keson in order to hurt viktor, but if you want to risk.” P: would you be willing to protect sabine?
V: she has been with dione “Youd have to stake her again.” “You could have the king bring her during his visit.” P: did he make you do things like that in your time? Was he always like this? “A conqueror? If those children were going to grow up to be soldiers, they should be put down immediately.” P: is that your belief, or his logic? “Im explaining how war works. If you wish to win the war. Do not let them have soldiers, slaughter them in the crib.”
(She was a general. She managed to conquer a very violent area of Porlumiè, she was able to settle it and kill the hostile wildlife. During one of the final expansions, she just disappeared one day.)
What happened to that lich?
“Well. apparently you killed her. If you can kill her, then surely you can the king.” (we make yurei wake up)
V: he was holding Pharasma's Sister hostage
“He already fought a solar. Brit?” V: did avare lose?? “Yes.” “She probably rushed in and got captured.”
“Pharasma had to kill her sister who was possessed with a demon. I am a firm worshipper of pharasma. Our disagreement about pharasma is why we split.”
Whats stopping him talking to asmodeus “The body of asmodeus was never found, its impossible to ask if you don’t know where it is.” R: so about the devil doctor. Feucreux. I do have a personal connection? It’s the- the devil in that body made a deal with my parents in order to displace my soul, he is insistent on capturing me, if you have any insight on the doctor thatd be great “Does he want you?” R: im sorry? “Does he want you back? Does he see you as his property?” R: he wants my physical body back, he does wish to purchase me
(rosalind is effectively the only one who can send him back to Hell) R: the miraculous recovery was at the cost of… “If i might be so bold. Id recommend offering him the one thing he wants, but make it subtly known that youre in an unprotected location. Whatever he brings may not be human, so you may not worry.” R: would this not complicate our relationship/aspect of the king’s plan? “If the devil died of its own foolishness, when the devil dies it has no memory of the last 3 days before they die. Its a way to get out of contract, its why they wait weeks between contracts.” Soln 16th, 1264 We disguise Guards ask why we’re here, we just start attacking Dasa kills 2 guards Morven kills a palace guard Kholeran kills a guard The others hear our fight beyond the door
William Gigot
Gwenaël Esoffier
Edgar Morel
Simonne Colbert
Edouard Boutin (mayor) Rosalind kills 2 guards Dasa kills 2 guards and Gwenael The king arm makes viktor healing hard :( Kholeran kills another guard Rosalind kills another guard The mayor closed the door on viktor, locked

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-5.title: Session 51
sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-5.description:
Prev Session: Session 50
Next Session: Session 52 Soln 16th, 1264
Fathrell More combat
William Gigot
Edgar Morel
Simonne Colbert
Edouard Boutin (mayor) Mayor sees phil go through the wall, seems shocked “i spared you all.” Morven kills the bard (Simonne) Mayor is killed by Viktor Edgar Morel is killed by Morven Rosalind kills William Gigot We drag the mayor’s body inside Best way of putting the message across is erecting the flag of tunseel Strongbox leads to sets of treaties he had made in private office Ones he had with tunseel, non-aggression pacts
Nearby towns, projects for expansion (including retaking lower part of the city), expansion plan for the pass in Gordrivvmyr Over 2 days, we kill the captains Soln 18th, 1264 Now the city is unofficially taken
Would take about a week for the Tunseelian army to show up, but we could speed it up if we contacted the king
Sending to Audovère fi'Alémanie the First, Your majesty, we wish to let you know your army will find no resistance in Fathrell. Hope you’re having a lovely day. XOXO Viktor and Phil “You took the fight from me? Well. Is there anyone left to kill of any note. If so, please contact me again, if not, don’t bother, I’ll send an envoy to implant a doorway. Please plant it somewhere fitting of me.” South of the river is where he built the first base, they fled in, killed a monstrosity, planted a tree to pharasma so the dead may find their way to the boneyard, built their buildings, built a fort on top of the hill. Settled the area, city was then given to the Vespertine Empire, thus he began his full conquest of modern day Tunseel over the mountains. Vassal state, but one he fully owned Waiting a week Hiring 4 people to work at the parlor w/ 500gp Viktor’s arm Emblem that has the blood to drink, integrated directly with the prothesis (hard to remove) The spying one (listening and seeing location) is surprisingly easily to remove We can take the rune, fill a jar of viktor blood every week, shake it up occasionally Soln 25th, 1264 Army shows up
The chaplin of the invading army, Sister Elois Se'Barde “I see you’ve met the king.” “Would you like to be anointed?” “I understand, you’re a worshipper of the old gods. It would be hard to follow the new one.” Has he taken up a new name already? “No, he is under the old name, but he is powerful enough to make clerics such as i.” New development “No. old. One may not preface true faith under tunseel, but soon all will fall under.” I understand you have a doorway for us so he may come through? “Yes. embed it into any wall, itll become a doorway. He’ll make his own way.” “This is where you were contacted by your patron, is it not? Or is it somewhere else?” What patron “The one he told me of. Unless you’re calling me a liar.” Im not… Wdym “Where you first made contact with her. I want to see it.” I dont think i want to say? “You dont, but there is an army outside. With torches and flames.” Can you at least tell me whyyy> “I want to see where the first rival he made as a god came to be?” What will you do? “Write it down as his first holy texts. Its not mine to destroy. Its his.” Yurei leads them up to the attic “Why do you have an elevator that leads from the crypt all the way up?” We only need one elevator “I shall start writing. Now, you find a good place for him to visit.” “The king has requested you build a door, why aren’t you doing it.” Im helping you? “You’re not helping. And it’s the king’s orders.” “You would defy god?” “When he requests the group, he gets the whole group.” “He’s sent an army to conquer.” Sounds kinda gay tbh “Why would you defy god? To save a box?” Not really, its weird. “He wishes to make treaty with you, and you defy him. To refuse god is to defile said god. To deny a god is to disobey said god.” Yurei goes down, guards don’t actively stop Phil tries to seduce a guard so that we can spy on her He investigates, watches her write down various things Rosalind, yurei, viktor, phil watching She writes in clear empyrean It takes in length in prose. A shame that we have to rely on such a loathsome being to fight its magic in the creation of the lord. Seemingly writing down number of tails acquired, alongside number of tails to be had We go to the mayor’s house, put the doorway into a war room that overlooks the tree Place the door, it expands past what it should, door opens and the king steps through “My priestess has told me you caused trouble.” It was all a jest “Do not jest, she has no sense of humor.” None at all? “Lacking.” We’ll make sure it doesnt happen again Explaining who we killed “Any who would defy me?”
House Charvromy “Where is there house?” “It will be painless.” He reaches back, throws his spear through the roof “The challenge will be to kill them all with a single strike from this far away.” “I will find out if it worked come sunset.” “Are the others going to be an issue?” They shouldnt be an issue. “Do you wish to be the lord of this land Viktor? Yurei?” Would that require them to stop travelling? “It depends, does your lifestyle say you continue killing?” Probably “Then i’ll have the best administrators to run in your stead.”
V: i have bigger prizes, flamhaltn
“A capital? You’re just like Dione. :) Never satisfied.” He leaves The spear fell in the noble district, multiple spears came out the ground and stabbed through multiple people in the roof. Many people are running away, guards urging us to stay away “They owned most of the mills of the city, alongside the recently constructed lightning rail’s entry way.”

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-5.title: Session 52
sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-5.description:
Prev Session: Session 51
Next Session: Session 53
Hey wait a minute
“Sarenrae Blessed. By decree of the Tunseel Kingdom, may the sun shine eternal. This city is under decree of the fi'Alemanies, as such, it shall now and forever m(covered) be the beginning of the sun’s rise upon the northern lands, bringing upon them the peace of Sarenrae and the finality of Pharasma. By her rightful claim, the goddess has allowed the family Anmoku to maintain administration interim.” Soln 27th, 1264
Fathrell, Anmoku Funeral Parlor
Armor from st. sirnach
From up north, where the king wants to go. Hell take the Vespertine and what is his and then conquer what isnt his At the house, hear a knock at the door Hello? Cant see anything through the peephole. Knocking again Kholeran bloodsense, 1 creature with blood. Fresh and almost nauseating
Viktor goes and looks, homveran talking to someone we cant see unfortunately Talking to someone slightly taller than us Open the door
FUCK PHEYLOR TENTHALL “Are you to blame for the trouble outside? The summary executions, the dead lining the walls? The military takeover?” Ummm. yeah…. Swiftest end to violence? She whispers something to him, walks into the parlor It has been a while “It has, have you gotten stronger?” I believe so, yes “I hope then this will take more than 18 seconds to kill you all.” Maybe a solid 24 “Why have you called me here?” Okay. well. We wished to essentially ask and speak to hear with your mouth and words why we are- the nuance why we are enemies. “You are undead, and i am an undead hunter.” I dont think its that simple. Why did you leave us alive? “Should i rectify the mistake?” No i just want to understand, if there is some commonality that we share We think you follow the orders of someone we
Homveran: “im come to refer to him as the Prophet.” Why? “He’s not a god but he speaks for a god. He speaks as a god. But has lived as a simulacrum as a person.” H: “if my companion is wise, she will not follow prophets. If you did this to appease him, cease your path and not follow any prophets either.” We’re following ourselves and our own interests primarily H: and yet you still did what he wanted “Even if you think you are winning, still fear prophets. Generally, as a rule, they make others die in their place. And often before them at times instead of them.” “At this path, you will die having achieved his goals while thinking youre playing him.” Phaylor Tenthall seems pretty stonehearted at this Rosalind aurasight Emotional state: boredom Attitude: just above hostile Phil: If faced with the same situation, what would you have done? “This situation where i am you?” P: you cant kill yourself. “That is the only thing that comes to mind if i was in your shoes.” P: the siege “I would ask why it needs to be done. It is not my duty to take the place of a soldier and play war.” P: and if they gave a compelling reason for the betterment of tunseel? Would you have done the same? “I wouldnt have dont it.” V: why is that? “I am not a nationalist.”
P: if you dont believe in the ideology of nations, what do you believe in? Pharasma? “But of course.” P: how do you feel about the relationship of your prophet and pharasma? “It is a holy union, if but a forced one?” P: what do you know of it? “Is this why you asked me here? To ask basic knowledge?” V: You’ve been very evasive and we have not seen you in a while. We have no way of contacting you. If you don’t want to ask these then maybe we can let homveran ask “He already asked everything he could” Phaylor Tenthall has been continuing pharasma’s mission outside the vespertine but won’t say where P: have you gone to the new world? “I’ve considered” V: what has stopped you? “My mission. I will make sure your kind has no place in this world. I must purify it before I do a second.”
V: and the fragments that you and your company were searching for in brazenthrone. Have you found more of them? “I have not. I have just the one we stole from under your nose. Had it I should say. I gave it to you and have yet to come across others” P: why did you give it to us? “Was it not yours? That is why” V: you are very gracious for answering our questions “Too gracious” P: if there was a way to separate the king and pharasma, would you assist? “Why would I assist?” P: you mentioned it is holy but forced. “It is forced but it is holy and it is just. It will lead to a better world P: will it? “It will rewrite the laws of death taht allow you to skirt and be here P: and you believe these will be in your favor? “And your god grants you peace and lets you run around here. Your husband sits there after killing you. Should i go kill him and let you pass on in peace? P: we are working on it “Yeah for 45 years now. Slowly but surely. Are you hoping the gout spreads from his feet to kill him P: there are other things. The forced marriage of your deity is an affront to my beliefs. “Why?” P: do you have eyes not which to see? “It is a dead god marrying a dead man. It is a tale of love. Pharasma herself wrote about the one that will be chosen later? P: what did she write? “She wrote that someone would come and conquer war and bring upon death. that would be the promised consort P: what if i did that? “You won’t. I can contact him. He will be here in a few minutes. P: no that’s ok actually She pulls out her holy symbol. “It is the nature of your kind to be cowardly and hold on to what reminds you of life.” Viktor removes his arm. V: are you not upset about his nature? Is he not cowardly himself? “I would not use the word cowardly to describe him. He has overcome his nature V: he has weaknesses “To the sun. he has shed most of them V: what “I once dueled him under the sun and lost. I believe he can pick one thing to be immune to V: hwo did you come to work directly under him then? “I saw his strength and his philosophy. He brought me back to health after our fight. I did not die. V: have you seen what he does with his family? With your eyes?
“I have seen the tubes of blood. I have walked to see pharasma and the angel. It is called having faith. V: your faith was not shaken by what you saw? “Strengthened by the trial” Some shakiness but if we press she will attack us We look at her arms and can’t tell if one is prosthetic. She does always wear gloves though V: after one of our first interactions, you can see I lost my arm. Have you had a similar fate? “Regeneration is quite easy to cast. And i have not disobeyed.” P: did you know you were coming to see us when you set out? “Yes P: and you still agreed? “Homveran asked V: in that first interaction where i lost my arm, it wasn’t just disobeying. I was trying to assist the angel, the closest to the angel outside of Him. “Angels are always right? V: do you believe that they are not in the right in this situation?
“If you believe they are in the right, as a champion of tunseel, go to Advesperascit, kill everyone in that tavern, then drag that chair out” Brain blasting
She gave us back the rune, ask about it or present the plan as we know it and gauge her reaction. Theres a chance we succeed to get her motive
Mention Auntie Miko stuff “And whom am i to stop him if that is his goal?” “If that creature helped create pharasma, maybe she is willing to help bring her back into this world.” (kholeran notices, bored, she knows the actual reason and it seems the king lied to us. Presented with all the formal niceties of dwarven customs of someone getting something wrong and refusing to clarify.) K: oh he lied to us. Ohhh. V: do you think he would do something to bring back pharasma? “Yes. if you do not know then he did not deem it fit to know. You should go tell him that you have sussed out his secrets he didn’t want to tell you. I’ll even talk to him for you” (she’s a divine blood sorcerer and thaumaturge. Her partner was trained in alchemy and fighting, though he got old.)
(she is from the destroyed town Traelée, destroyed by undead) P: we have found some objects and have had issue trying to find someone to give them to. We found the, um, the phylactery of faithfulness and the cloistered robe of the person who oversaw the marriage. It was in a creature, it seems important, you might know what to do w/ it or it might be symbolic to you? “I’ll take it off your hands, thank you.” (give it over) “Now can i go?” She leaves H: “do forgive her. I’ll talk her off the path she’s found herself on. Should it come to it, i will not blame you for her death. Just, if you keep serving him, i won’t blame her for your death.” P: btw viktor had a listening device in his arm “I could tell.” P: we have been seeking advice from people smarter than us without relying on them- advice from you, advice from other people- “The one that offered this advice?”
P: the only one who has hidden from his eye for an period of time (Lume j'Estrilla) “They’ve hidden from my eye too.” P: we’ve blown their cover before. You are so smart, im worried im going to blow it again if i say anything more “I do not know.” P: ty “Just pray that if they are bloodthirsty enough to ask for blood in the streets, don’t be surprised at them not giving back whatever they ask for
P: its yureis parents (Shiryo Anmoku Florence Anmoku) “Oh. then let me offer you this. (gives yurei an orphanage sheet.)” They leave, it still smells of blood Small cut on the top of his non-dominant hand K: you’re bleeding, did you know that? I can smell it. “Yes. i can feel it.” K: are you ok? “Yes” K: what happened “Can i talk to someone else?” P: AHH of course! (the implication is straight forward, stfu dont talk abt it outloud) Morven is able to find 3 fingerprints of his own blood, underneath the table. 3 evenly spaced. One from the farthest where his foot would be down to where his stomach would be Test it with alchemy, hidden message ink left with blood so the undead will find it
“I do not know why. She is stationed in the east, in owariyaru. She resides there and teleports as needed.”
The King's Ballroom Alone, wait the 10 mins for the teleport Dont know of any new exits Take a peak at the torture wall Does not seem to have anyone new, still the same people Here viktor is called by the divine blood, veins at mouth height for the king to drink from He has to get restrained and escorted out Soln 28th, 1264
Flamhaltn, around 4am There is now a curtain over the wall in which we emerge Blood on the other side of the curtain, creature with blood Hear the sounds of shuffling armor, 2 people alongside evil husband on the other side Yurei peaks out, 2 people blow the trumpets in their ears Y: ow
Régis Rosaire d'Esmé “I need to thank you.” Y: wh. What specifically? “Killing off my opposition. The one who held off my right of king of ensile.” Y: uh. Youre welcome “Who else is with you?” R: hello! I was also invited! Also. comrades.
Trumpeteers are blindfolded and coverings on their ears. Also does appear to be Maîtreé Charbonne next to the king. Both the king and other are warded by various spells that make it hard to assassinate him Charbonne is very heavily armed with magical equipment Y: you talked about thanking us, anything else you want to thank us with?
“Why? Youre enemies of the state? You assassinated one of my mayors.” Y: whats an assassination amongst friends “So you’ll forgive my assassination?” Y: wait is it me? Y: phils not here “No but she can hear.” R: i would not say that “I did after all fail to protect her. Thus i am culpable in her assassination, am i not?” R: i cannot speak for all of our party members, but for all my intents and purposes the past is in the past? “Good. if you wish to keep serving that king, then i would recommend keeping me alive lest you think you can survive without philomene.” Y: did you think we were here to kill you? “Yes” Y: we’re not “You were granted immunity in the lands, but i could consider this trespassing into royal grounds.” R: we’ll make our leave if you so desire, but we’d like to do it through royal grounds rather the way we went “Then if viktor is there, charbonne would like to escort you where you go based on what he did last time.”
R: i did wish to ask- is the doctor Domocle Feucreux in? Not in at the moment, but is he- “Visiting his brother’s estate.” R: where would that be?
“At the Feucreux Township.” R: where?
“It is north in Hollowyinth.” R: i appreciate your info, i was curious since he was quite interested in my presence “Of course, its by that that i allow a doll to talk to me.” Y: that was pretty rude “And yet youre a conqueror of one of my cities. You walk amongst my hall.” R: our presence was requested? “It was, but you failed to do my tasks. I would kill you, but powers beyond our control says that i cannot.” “You did dutifully as a wife, Philomene.” (13/15 major noble houses supported him, was 8 but things Changed.) R: when might he be returning? “2 days time. I can send word that you’re here?” Rest of the party comes out “Have you considered killing yourself yet?” P: it wasnt very nice to say to me, thanks for cash tho “Of course. (ignoring yurei) that cash can be used to provide to those you were close to in life” P: you left them alive? “I grant them life.” P: i thought the house fire got them “Of course not. Its by the king’s grace that lets you be on the lands, its the land that grants life” P: ah of course. Its the justification. “Its the way of the vespertine, and we’re the last true heirs of the vespertine.” P: we? As in we or you-
“Ensile that stands before me and behind me in all actions.” P: of course. How is it going t with your friend to the south. Nice entrance. “It is. It is going great. I made a deal, he promised me a kingdom. By the grace of god i have one.” P: youre welcome i guess. Whens the coronation? Do i get an invite?
“It already happened. The dead are not invited. We are not sighar.” P: you really think they cant do it without me. What a compliment “They should keep you alive till the very end. You survived when i thought you dead. Maybe soon i’ll be a god. It’s something i look forward to all the same.” (when one person ascends to godhood, multiple people do so. Very rarely an isolated event. One ascends, the other to fulfil the accompanying roster.) (phil is very effective at keeping people alive. Also the fact that he is heavily warded by unknown spells.) P: oh and one last thing. Is uh. How do you say. To continue spreading discussions of love, do you have anything for me to frivolously spend
“The vespertine empire doesnt give money to enemies.” P: there is no proof i was there “There is. And again, i can give 60k for the city.”
“Are you familiar with the Zoltaport?” P: the ones who handled my funeral? “They are a funeral parlor.” P: ok im done abusing my diplomatic immunity, unless you object us being here
“You may walk the streets, but know that many viziers know. The advisor mages of the Advespertine know. (Di Florio Academy)” P: thanks for the warning. Charbonne walks us through the halls P: we heard people calling you uh- V: an incestuous bastard “Im not, im not blood related. Im sure youre aware im a promiscuous one of the house.” P: a whore??? “Yes. a whore of the house. He is a beautiful man” P: you’re fucking him???? “No. he holds you in his heart.” (he was adopted by the king, they are not together but he is claiming that the king holds heart for phil) P: he sent me letters asking me to kill myself so? “Probably because you’re a blasphemous form of her.” V: did you know philomene when she was alive? “No, i am, 29.” P: good luck with that, but one of my oaths is to keep lovers together in life or death “Its a good thing youre no longer his lover, he shall live eternal.” P: i’ll see you around my metamour. “Of course, and should we meet in battle, know that i kill you so i can restore your image to what it truly is.” P: good luck with that, you have my blessing to fuck my husband “I have train with the best to fight.” Buy 2 carts, hide dasa in the cart in animal form We get an invitation to the dream council from Feucreaux in his personal plane Contract devil as the caster Dasa leaves the dream “You are hunting me?” R: im sorry? ‘Youre hunting me and comign to my location” R: im coming to the township? “My location” R: i wouldnt describe it as hunting you “You are across boarders, after vanquishing a righteous man of leadership. He is past the reaches of leadership.” R: have you considered phil “I have, but phil’s home is from the east, and you left from the north.” “This way does not exist in reality, but i use it to turn a man into a bear. Have you tried to turn a man into a small dog?” P: you dont need us to come back for you? R: i wanted to see if i could recover my memories- sorry are the bloodstains also in my home? “Should this disguise be destroyed, i have no reason to keep the family alive.” (phil is going to infantilize rosalind) R: i wish to see my home, is that much to ask? “Of course not, you may not see your family altogether. You may meet them individually” R: we still have an issue? “Of course, if you choose to leave, i will have the manegola deal with the ones you don’t see.” (flying war devil) P: thats a war devil, you dont want to see such scary things my friend R: im not afraid, i can handle myself (back and forth babying him) “If you are there for answers, i can simply provide them. And then we can all meet in the capital.” P: you should not meet on your own with scary men. R: i would be interested in that “In meeting?” R: yes “Know that if i am dispelled, the devils will dispel the remainder of your family.” “I can talk about them here. What would you like to know?” R: id like to see them “Then we can meet outside the gates of the city.” R: i can assure you that i am capable and respectful of whatever you want in your presence R: i wont take no for an answer P: then youre coming right back to the capital together? “I wont go, that is where you all are. If it must be in the city, then the old home where your family resided. Your old home still exists. Im sure the family that now lives there wont mind the intrusion.” “Be as loud as you need, its is among the countryside. Within the walls, of course, but it located where the walls of the inner farms stop.” R: i will go there. (gives address) “Now for a contract of my own safety, sign with her.” Y: hi i love contracts! (this is a very thorough contract written by him. There is a weakness! If we argue for long enough we can wait out the time before reaching an agreement.) Eventually the dream council ends

sessions/undead-campaign/act-3/session-5.description:
Prev Session: Session 52
Next Session: Session 54 Soln 28th, 1264 Manegolas are executioner devils, aerial superiority, can look like any creature medium or small while murdering someone Revert when theyre killed (black ichor and splatter on the ground) Special offenses: can teleport at will to some small degree If anyone tries to move they can fly after them Show the way the 4 days, so its 3 days instead Qlisalt 1, 1265 Feucreux Crew Rosalind Dasa Yurei Kholeran
Old Feucreux Manor 2 men seemingly talking It burned down a few years ago R: hello???
Tea set in hand Domocle Feucreux “come on in” R: its nice to be able to speak with you in person “Of course. Father, the curiosity i told you about is here!” R: hello! My name is rosalind
Father (Sansone Feucreux): “hello rosalind. I understand taht you believe yourself of some… affinity to domacle?” R: im sorry? “Im sorry. You are domacle. (smiles at the son)” R: idk what we’re discussing, my knowledge of the world is limited due to my physical form “My son told me you believe you are my child.” R: oh! Yes this is true i am the spirit of your child in a constructed form. “It is a curiosity, you look exactly like his fave toy when he was ill.” R: yes thats true, that is why i have possessed this form. the doll im housed in was sold to a travelling market of gnolls. F: “Doctor Quinzio Veronesi.”
(traveling doctor, elven man, resides Vozgoa Sighar border. Travels, as mentioned, out of town, likes to perform miracles in the far frigid north. Lets him preserve his body, he sleeps for a long period of time. Doesnt take on anyone who doesnt need the help, as according to the family.) R: i remember being bedridden, what was… the doctor that saved me was… was it a spectacle? I cant imagine smth that dramatic would be done subtly. Father: “it was. At least as far as i could tell.” R: i enever seemed toi be in pain? Father: “no you were, it was surgery, it was a knife fight against an unconscious person, so. The process will be a failed one, but it will create something, since Quolol does not posess a soul. (no soul = failure)” K: so. Um. we heard that the heroes of advesperascit have gone missing. “The heroes i wouldnt call them. Id call them the openers of the gate. Their morality has yet to be judged.” K: oh ok. Um. any idea where they are? “I have some, but the king will not hear it.” K: can i hear it? “Why do you need to hear it?” K: curious. I met them once and they seemed ok. “I believe in their panicked moments, they wished for safety. I believe they’re someplace safe that the king cannot find.” (seems plausible, the king would not believe there being a place that someone could hide from him. If they used powers, it would be ‘save us’ and save everyone from the opening of the divine gate.) K: and wished using power from the divine gate? “Precisely.” K: i heard about that. I wasnt around. I was busy. “It removed them all, put them someplace he cannot go, but he simply doesn’t believe such a place exists.” King “Would you like to see sabine? I know you havent seen her in reality since the cabin.” Dione: “as victor of the duel, i request that he be spared that.” Agrees, “so be it.” V: what has happened to my sister? Dione: “nothing, she just hates u. It is better for u to move on. King: and there is still a chance she could learn to love u again (viktor reminds her of herself when she was a young vampire. He believes that every childer of his can get whatever they want. If you have the strength to take what you want, you have the right to.) Ballroom
Yurei networking with the necromancer (Werner Fres) Y: hi i see youre hanging out in this dark corner “Of course, im talking to the paladin. Youre a necromancer, im told, and that thing up north is your creation?” (That is like cadillac of necromancy -zack) Y: yeah thats one of my first creations “Theyve only gotten better since then?” Y: whos to say. My party members dont really like me reviving anyone. Gotta pick and choose “Youre a sommelier for the dead.” Y: thats why i went to 20 different graves. Not all of them are graves tho. Def all dead bodies. “If you killed them, that makes it all the finer. Theyre fresh. Preserve better.” Y: hows your work? Have i seen any of your creations around? “Im sure. Im currently stuck in the mass production side of necromancy for sighar. They want legions that can go without food or sleep, they want them by sunrise. They cant hold a conversation.” Snaps at morven “can it speak?” “Its reaction time has something to be desired. You might want to replace the brain.” Y: i worked so hard! Morven grabs them (crit) and suplexes Y: i think i gave this one too much free will! My bad. Neck snaps visibly. “Oh, its ferocious!” he grabs, readjusts neck Appears to be an orc. At least half so. “How much would it be to buy her off you?” Y: uhhhh sorry uhhhh “Ive seen the way you deal. There must be a price. Sighar would pay handsomely for her.” Y: i dont think youd be able to get her out of here “It has free will?” Y: yeah “(necril) By what murderous intent have you been controlled?” “It appears to be lacking in its brain. Are you sure it doesnt need to be repaired?” Y: its working pretty good. “It doesnt understand the language of its kind.” Morven grabs “You keep calling her a her, but it is an it, is it not? You created it.” Y: you might wanna watch your works, i think its beating your ass “Its fine, ill be back.” Y: are you like. A masochist? Bones broken “where can i learn such technique to make something like this?” Y: i think you have to be a little evil “Thats fine. Ive been called evil before.” Y: idk it worked for me. “On your request master, ill read this and burn down the next family home i see.” Paladin walks away King The king is gathering armies into advesperascit, putting all nobles into a place where they will swear fealty to him and him alone or theyll be killed
Those that will will swear, military of ensile (House Feucreux), medical noble houses, people dedicated to farming, if you do not produce soldiers, you will be killed Anyone hard headed will not swear fealty, most of the kings will not. The only one that will is the guaranteed d’esme

True King of Tunseel comes back with dione and viktor Everyone stops dancing or stands and bows Dione stands ready, half bow, higher than those bowing but not the one being bowed to Through simple ritual covers up what shes thinking of, shes merely doing what she needs to do, no more no less There is pride in it, a little bit, the kind where youre doing something you consider morally wrong but god are you good at it Biographical eye
Hes King, obv, hes not actually the first king, that would be his son. He went missing in Vitry-Seilave before he could be king The elves that lived in the valley is the rock
He is technically from Ulnox, where brazenthrone is located. Moved to be a Vespertine soldier during the height of the empire before the dark came. Became a prodigy, somehow was able to expand his lifespan for 200 years, lived in Advesperascit, conquered the area for the Suzerain (king of kings) Familiar with his work, to say the least Various ppl move about like he is in a barn and looking at his horses, debating where to send them Y: hello kingstie. So like we know you werent telling us the full truth about the spirit. So like. What do you want with her? What are you doing?
“The spirit of Akari Miko?” Y: you know her name? Idk her name. (kholeran knows: means ‘red shrine maiden’. Notably a vengeful spirit in owariyaru, located close to the old capital. She is incredibly forgotten about in this time. A spirit that was active 1k years ago, disappeared, then followed a family all the way here. No one does rituals to her anymore, why would they? No official record remains of what happened to her. Vengeful spirit of someone that was killed, rightfully or wrongfully, came back to haunt a woman, who then had her own sister kill her.)
Y: what are you wanting to do with her, why do you keep giving us runes? “So i can fight her.” Y: why? “All the peasants and all the kings won’t be a good fight. All the peasants and all the kings again and again will be a good fight.” Y: resurrecting powerful people to kill them? “No. Most of the peasants on their own are weak. But, a few weak parts can create something greater than the sum of their whole. Y: why are you killing all these peasants? “Its war. Peasants die in war. Kings die less so frequently.” Y: shit i guess. Where are the rest of the runes?
“One is with phil’s husband. The other is the prime church of Pharasma )Holy Church of Pharasma). I dare not sully my boots of the divine temple.” Y: you dont know the location of the last one? “No.” Y: do you have any idea where the last might be? “I fear the devils might have it. Or it might be lost to the world.” Y: turn off ur firewall pls “Why?” Y: do you want to talk to her? “The killer of my wife’s family?” Y: um. I mean. Yeah? “I would love to. But i am afraid she will not talk to me. It is a bit rude to get in contact with someone you plan on killing,” Y: people do that all the time. “Serial killers. Not kings.” Y: i guess i can ask her if she wants to talk, if she does do you want to? “I would love it.” He turns off communications, to auntie Hey, the king wants to talk to you, is that ok? :( King: “might i try something?” Y: depends on what the something is “I will make sure she responds timely. It wont hurt so long as she starts responding.” Y: just give it a few minutes, my friends have some more questions V: where did the devil go? “The devil is going back to contact the one who has taught him medicine. While there is a lull, that is good for him.”
P: Quinzio Veronesi? Where is he?
“Then you know his curse. He is in the Ply Magnai.”
(section of woods east of flamhaltn) V: curse? “Immortality of the truest kind.” V: how so?? “He comes back whenever hes killed. Not even the gods could get rid of him.” (i didnt know quiznos was strong like that No its approaching bankruptcy)
“He cannot die, not until he pays out his debt to asmodeus.” V: hes creating more devil doctors? “It helps pay off the debt.” Phil & morven getting tied together “Shall i do the announcement? It’s a calling of war. Only should morven fall do you fall.” “May it be known, to permanently kill philomine, you must kill morven. The death of morven is the death of philomine.”
Tunseel priestess Elois Se'Barde is the first to clap, she can now do such rituals “I will have it done by sunrise tomorrow.” P: do we need to be here for it? “You announcing it in front of me is enough.” P: did you not need our blood? “I have already gotten your blood. It was hard to get. Morven’s i got a while back.” P: where was i buried? The mausoleum? “Yes.” D: do i have blood?? “No. you dont even have marrow at this point.” V: what did you need of our blood? “I have your blood. It ensures loyalty.” Y: whose blood dont you have? “Dasa’s. I could not find a mortal body.” (he can use it as a component for scrying, long range dominate if you have body part.) Auntie replies Who? He’s married to pharasma Kill him then Auntie i dont think i can I could kill him for a few hours. How would that help us? Do you know how powerful he is? Is he undead? Yeah. Then i can control him. And he has no contingencies? Also he wants you dead back btw Motions to yureis sleeve. “May i?” Gives him a pen, he writes to her. May we talk to you with the others present? I need to step away from the gala and war planning. Yes. How? “Would you like to come into a backroom with me?” Y: if my friends can come-
“Your dad was kidnapped with a club to the back of the head in fathrell.” He leads to a generals wartable, we are the size the miniatures to indicate soldiers. In the room is a second yurei??? OH MY GOID THE SPLASH SCREEN IS THE KING’S MAP. It is a room for dream council This yurei is barely holding into their skin, spiritsense almost like someone about to burst out, odd tumors rapidly growing and suddenly deflating Physically is yurei minus the shadow with 6 tails Y: thats pretty sick “Her form isnt meant for viewing as of yet, but dont worry we’ll change that yet.” He bows to her, she doesnt bow back A: “what do you want from us?” K: “i want to bring you back to your power and then take everything from you.” K: “if you were to succeed, i’d give you back your lover. She is in my custody.”
K: “Murasaki Miko is here.” A: “and why don’t i just take it from you now?” (Y: please dont get us killed rn…..) K: “I’ll make it simple for you all. If i die here before i achieve what i want. I’ll ensure her swift execution before you find her. Now that shes a psychopomp, she cant be raised as an undead. And shes too old for her soul to be tampered with and brought back beyond the veil. Your protege will do what they want, if my men do find any runes, ive arranged to give it to them.” A: “i accept, then. On the condition that i am able to intervene using my-” K: “you can say the word. Vessel.” A: “Vessel’s body. In the appropriate times.” He claps and smiles k: “you may do as you wish. It is the goal of celestials to grant mortals free will.” Auntie is so pissed. We need to try to get it done as soon as possible situation. The bind is pissing her off beyond thinking logically. V: how long have you known about yurei being a vessel for ms miko?
“Not until you met one of my agents in brazenthrone. She could see spirits, but couldnt ascertain which was the host. She made you fall unconscious too fast.” V: we shjouldve died there but we did not “You shouldve. The goal was the render you near destroyed and then administer a poison to you that allowed undead to enter a paralyzed state. It was devised by one of my younger proteges at the time. It works exceptionally well against all undead.” V: which protege?
“You wouldnt know him. Hes a sad old man who abandoned the war. (Homveran).”
(the king doesn’t know exactly what happened there, Lume j'Estrilla doesnt know, only pheylor tenthall does.) King bows to auntie. “I will see you when they succeed.” Back to ballroom. People bow towards us all
M: just one quick thing. I was chatting to uh. Its hard to put it. Shino Hakusa was mentioning some of their siblings were missing, what about the hakusa siblings (Aki Hakusa Tone Hakusa)
“They are free out in the world, but not outside my grasp. I understand she killed your mother, you must ache, i could set up a duel. They are currently up near the town of Stoneborgont.” Morven whispers to shino hakusa about it M: you dont know where ur siblings are, the king says theyre around stoneborgont. He says theyre free to their own devices but theyre there. Thought youd want to know “Better than some. And the assassin looking after them?” M: might be, idk
“There is one, up near Uisu. do be warned. I believe there should be one around anywhere, now that i am the assassin of kings and of priests.” M: the assassin, are they under the kings, yknow? On his payroll? Or a free agent? “More of a king’s man. You’re good enough to consider worthy of adequate insurance in order you cooperate.” M: alrighty. Well. thought id let you know. I hope your siblings make their way out of it. “The only way is to free all held family members at once. No way hed keep track. Only a god has 2 eyes.” (anmokus are also in danger once he finds them, itll be a to whom it may concern bloodbath. If you want to keep family safe, bring them to st sirnach.)
M: if you have a way of contacting ur siblings, St. Sirnach is a great place for them to go. To be out of harms way.
“Idk where it is. Is it near Rozen? Rozen is far.”
M: further north. Further than Kaldildsted Dione is talking to 2 fey + d’esme She is engaging in a jovial conversation with d’esme, he flicks his foot nervously.
Antlered Man says various prophesied omens, some repeat and contradict
She talks to Horned Man V: Can we talk? D: Is there something you don’t want to say in front of my friend? V: I’m not sure u want to say it. We haen’t had a chance to talk since I started working with the king D: pick ur blood. The king has every type. Ever had orphan blood? V: I have not. D: you should eat now. We never starve during war, but we don’t get our pick. V: (i missed this)
D: i am sorry about Sabine Keson. It was one of the few things i could do to make u fight for a righteous cause V: is that what u believe? That it was righteous? D: yes. Do u believe i am (something) V: i believe u are merciless – V: i will continue fighting for my ideals D: or u will be broken upon the wheel of ur ideals V: is that what happened to u? D: my ideals (i think that’s what she said) V: i have come to discuss because as long as i have been chasing u i did not know u. U showed a mercy earlier wrt sabine. U didn’t want her to join us D: yes. I have caused an unraveling in ur lives. Before u would’ve remained in vitry-seilave and only heard of the war. Now ur full blown participants V: she’s on the front line? D: she is a field medic. She drinks the blood of those who won’t make it V: very noble of her D: other sabine remains in torpor. Haven’t figured out what to do with her V: what happened with ur sire for u to join the king? D: hatred of my sire. Do u know how i was embraced? V: no D: i am a coffin salesman like yurei. I heard breathing from a coffin and went to administer aid. I was bit V: many such cases D: she betrayed the king cause she didn’t get enough godhood. Wanted to be a demigod, he said no, she betrayed him V: demigod? D: blood from the god’s heart V: oh?
D: happened once in Advesperascit. Take the blood and become like a lesser god sort of idk
Henry wachter D: she wanted to become a demigod and the king said no, the undead are not fit to ascend to godhood and sit next to his lovely wife V: that’s what i am confused about. Is he not undead? D: he is not a sired undead. He became immortal via his own free will. He merely, in his final act of bloodshed, wished for his bloodshed to go on forever and hsi wish was granted. He will engage in bloodshed and bathe in blood forever. He will do so until the gate opens and he can meet his wife. He is, at the end of the day, a promised consort of the gods. But enough about him, it’s about us rn V: it is. I still do not like u and i know that is fairly clear. D: u have tried to kill me what, 4 times now? V: give or take, and yet i continue to fail to do so D: drinks and tosses some blood over to viktor V: drinks some blood. D: (referring to the room full of undead) this is a place where we belong V: ur certain? D: even without anyone pulling the strings u know what humans do? V: they kill each other
D: after he is done there will be peace. There will be so few of them that they will need to make peace. He told me a secret rumor that there ios a failed god out west attempting to ascend. She has failed because she lost her way. Changing the wheel on the cart something or other V: u say this like u are lost
D: ur also Tunseelian. U know the power of faith V: but ur not ascending, not becoming a leader. What do u get out of this? Coffin business? D: a necessary, safe business. And i have a promise of safety in the world. Despite his flaws. He will keep those i ask to keep safe protected. Like sabine. If u mess with his goals he will void the contract and ensure she dies V: neither of us wish for her to die D: no, u were both mistakes. Actual childer, not the murderers u scope out which will be executed within 3 suns. U are one of the more persistent
V: i am nothing if not persistent. I have heard there are vampires attacking flamhaltn. Are u in charge
D: i am not the one in charge of that. He has contracted a vampire out of sighar, so when the time comes it will seem like sighar has been attacking ensile all along
V: the one over there? (Lyria ir'Cozurn) D: i think that one or one of her childer V: she is to become queen of sighar once all is said and done. D: yes, although he has laid an impossible task though she doesn’t know it’s impossible. The clause says she will perform war duties to the king’s satisfaction. V: he’s never satisfied. D: he won’t be until he ascends past the dissatisfaction mortals know V: and the dhampirs, what’s up with that? I haven’t heard about those in a while D: a special creation. I hand out poultices that do it. A mix of the king’s blood. If they administer it in battle they’ll gain a flurry of strength and healing as if undead. And dead dhampirs make it seem like vampires have been there the whole time and sired children through conventional means. Dhampirs take longer to make. V: once the war starts what are u up to then? Are u on the front line? D: there will be no front line but him. Once the real war starts. V: what is the “real war” D: it will be once u get those runes. He will find a way to make himself unstoppable V: unstoppable how? D: do u believe me to have more knowledge than u do? The only ones that find him are the ones who seek him out and discover him. He doesn’t give anything outnfor free V: u’ve been here longer. I figured u might know more. I guess we’re both mistaken. That was – i can’t say eye opening D: it was nice. Next time we see each other we may kill each other. It is war V: wouldn’t that be fun? D: for u maybe, for me it would be sad V: sad? D: of my childer u have lasted longest V: is that what u do when ur done with us? Toss us out? D: even so u would persist. That’s what u do, u survive the longest V: i sure do persist
D: even that old friend of urs “Mustonen” has died in the recent war V: died? D: technically destroyed but same thing. V: yeah whatever dead. He was sent out and fought?
D: not sent out. Did u think vampires without tutelage of the false king would be safe within the border? Those protections granted a great deal. The false king allowed u to come here as well as tunseel up above. When he dies do give him a good funeral V: when he dies? D: the false king. He will die bc he has brought u here. That was against his orders V: the king’s grandson? D: great great etc. grandchild will die. Bc they will have no need of mortal flesh V: he will kill all of his own blood? D: have they not failed him for 26 generations? V: have they failed? D: 26 generations have failed repeatedly V: how so?
D: getting his promised wife. And the moment he antagonized an angel he got his promised wife. So all family is below a single angel V: they are only mortal D: and yet a mortal helped lead to his promised wife V: wdym D: one of the merchant lords. A seer, someone who helped open the divine gate/ V: who? D: he doesn’t know who. But it wasn’t the neighbors
The gold master V: is that why he’s searching for the neighbors? To find who opened it? D: no but they’re the sole survivors V: ah ok i see
D: but in trying to find the runes for yurei’s patron. Once he has those runes i believe he will use them, like morven, to resurrect gorum to fight. And they will tear the world apart. V: likely
D: if they are powerful as the wish granting neighbors, they might be able to open up the divine gate again and bring back gorum V: wouldn’t that fight destroy the continent?
D: gods fighting doesn’t destroy the continent, just reshapes it. The dwarven mountains were made by torag hammering. Metal fell from the sky and he took it, leaving rock and dirt. Hollow where the metal was taken, firm where dirt and rock were left. V: do u regret it? Joining up with him? D: what other choice was there? To live is to cling to existing is it not? V: well. U are not wrong. D: i am much more lenient than my sire. V: wdym D: the second she found i existed she killed my family to ensure my obedience to her then resurrected them as thralls V: were u not intentional? D: nope. She was hungry when she awoke V: what coffin? Where?
D: she was mangled in the war. A border skirmish with old Azerin, when it existed V: so it seems that we keep falling into the same faults of our sires.
D: it seems so, but i haven’t threatened ur family. I’ve only created the illusion of it which i feel is more merciful. I have seen my own brother die of impalement by my own failure. U only saw ur real sister torpored and then cured. The only part he took umbrage with was in claiming his powers aren’t as vast as they are since they couldn’t cure her V: u still keep an eye on my sister, don’t let her run away, and keep her safe? D: if i don’t keep an eye he will kill her. If anything i will approach her as one who loves her and give her clemency to do as she wishes. she wishes. Ask how she is doing and how the front line is. She is the only one in this chain that i would count the most free. And she still lives with a knife at her throat V: let us pray the knife doesn’t go any deeper D: let us pray it doesn’t kills us before it does V: i’ll drink to that. (does a half-hearted bow) i should be on my way. I can’t say it was a pleasure but ty for ur time. It was more information than i was expecting D: ofc. (does a full bow, puts on her mask again) And it was v pleasurable for me viktor. May we meet on the battlefield as friends or as enemies Kholeran talking to the Jorogumo “They taste better when they have a tinge of fear and start dissolving from the inside. Muscular, not organ, so they feel the pain before death.” “Many people say we have diseases, but this is a way of life.” K: i think its ghoul fever but thanks “Yell at me to see if i feel fear.” “Ohhh im so afraid. (she doesnt feel anything at this)” K: its because of my height isnt it “No ive fought very dangerous things shorter than you. Would you like a sip of my drink?” K: ok. Taste like ash One approaches, casts prestidigitation on kholerans mouth, puts a gun against her head He twirls “youre welcome maam.” K: thank you Phil goes up to husband Shows up, kiss on the cheek, ohhh howve you been “Great. I shouldve had you killed by guillotine than how i did.”
P: great. Have you fucked your son yet? “I havent, no. he’s not the right age, and also isn’t a woman.” P: lets have a dance “By all means. You may not kill me in this courtroom. Have you improved your steps or are they still peasant-esque?” He out performs phil, but not critically so
Its a little scary phil can touch him, the blossoms blessed by erastil fall “I shouldve killed you more violently.” “That necromancer you parade around with likely wouldve binded you under their spell.” P: i think i am just spiritual energy
“You are, but as the spirit of most things, you will dissipate in time. Theres a reason there are no ghosts in old grundiir, only horrors.” P: have you visited?
“I have. Isnt it proper to visit? Drosa korunda is a good man, despite the people he associates with.” P: why are you still holding onto the rune? “Because it is the only think that ensures i survive when the king takes over. He wouldnt dare risk the rune to get my pretty little head. But before you ask it,” he opens his coat pocket, “they are not on me.” Very unarmed, no magic ability, just very good at politics Phil goes around introducing herself to people D’esme approaches fey “and this is what you get when you marry a whore.” Fey dont seem impressed or unimpressed, they dont have a concept of marriage from where theyre from Most people are surprisingly talkative here The other priestess wants to talk to her
Grim reaper to dasa “you have no soul to which to steal. Youre not alive, youre dead.” D: well im talking i must be alive “The dead speak often, they scream and talk.” D: you seem to know a lot of war. Why are you here? “I love war, war is one of the greatest things that mankind has invented.” D: do you know abt future wars, or just the past? “I only know the ones that sent people to me.” D: thoughts on life?’ “Most cling to life, yearn for it, a gentle illusion.” D: could you reverse death? “I cannot not. No more than you wish for the sweet oblivion. In that way we’re in our own philosophical war, o’ soulless one.” D: are you for hire? “I am for the king. He promised me the people lost in the war. Those that are best to be removed from the cycle of reincarnation.” D: we have a list of people who we want dead “A list, no. a category, yes.” D: what about a category of people we want dead? “Thats still a list by a different name. Now, soulless one, why not sit and think of those that you hate and see if theres a commonality between them. A commonality creates the category. This will be known as the third great continental war.” D: is there any way to call you up? “I am here. If you speak my name, grim reaper, in these walls, i will be there.” D: you can stop people from being reincarnated? “Would you promise me his soul should he perish at your hands?” D: i would talk to the party “Dont squander your potential. You could have souls within souls within you or have life as true oblivion as an apocalypse rider.” (horrible idea for all mortal kind but it does promise great power to you.) D: this only affects people? “It affects people, it also talks of the one who taught you about the map room.” D: can we exclude druids? “But of course.”
D: can we exclude yurei’s family? “By what category does yurei’s family fall under?” “A friend doesnt count for the world or society.” D: does a race count? “It could if you wish.” D: my friends are races “Yes, they cover almost the majority of races. All that would be left would be halfling and elves.” D: i think the elves can go “The elves may go!” D: dwarves seem fine “Your friend.” Hes disappointed at kitsunes are spared D: humans can go “Phil and viktor?” D: theyre undead “Theyre still human, undead is still a continuation of life.” D: humans may go “Humans may go, he says.” D: hmmm. Orcs. “You have no orcs.” D: they can go “Then they may go.” D: fleshwarps are fine, they seem to be suffering “Of course, by what stage do you consider a fleshwarp?” D: the stage where they exist “Thats dubious, its merely the warping of flesh of another. Society may consider them a fleshwarp should they undergo too much transformation.” D: the moment they become fleshwarps “I need a distinction.” He comes up with a REALLY stupid distinction “I need smth! I need you to think of our contract, what it means for the future” Second passes, time resumes “The true stars return, i pray you have an answer for me. One that includes what is a fleshwarp.” D: ill call you when i figure that out! (why does dasa have the power to offer the king’s soul? Why does he have jurisdiction here?)
Phil priestess Elois Se'Barde “Youre the first one bound by his contract are you not?” “I wonder why it was you bound and not me. Was i not faithful enough?” P: uh. I think my situation is time sensitive. And falls in line with his ideals. Im sure its a difficult choice for him to make and consider. “Maybe. Maybe i shouldve been the one. But you were the one, so i must celebrate you.”
(she is very attracted to women, basilae is normally attracted. By having sex u can pass on ur legacy.
