It cannot be the same.” “Im afraid she had a curse placed upon her by god, those cannot be so easily broken. The real one.” “A curse that she may not speak, that her tongue may not be heard. It was placed by pharasma herself. Its why i believe she became a ghost of scripture, the real one at least. The one that haunts you cannot be her.” P: what are required to break curses like that? “The god has to release it herself." Y: if they're dead?
“Then cannot be released. There are many curses. Jafatan has no rain, its only by the grace of another god do creatures bring water.” Y: blessing of another god to counteract? “Of course, it was a wretched spirit that died alone in a temple.” “Dying alone is how most spirits were made. Literally alone or metaphorically alone.” P: what of something that can borrow pharasma’s power briefly “It could borrow a god's power, I suppose that's possible, but the question is why?” P: would being unable to speak be able to stop her from conducting abilities should someone need to use them? “I believe so, when she possessed the other hosts it drove them mad, as the curse passed onto their soul.” P: who was the last to have this before yurei? “Of course. I can uh, surely find it.” P: Did your family keep any records? (as he spouts off names, none of them seem familiar. Stricken from the record for the family sanity.) Y: none of those ring a bell. (Sometimes the best way to contain a ghost, you don't speak of it. It helps stop the baleful influence.) “It haunted you and spoke?” “Then you're entirely fucked. Or you must be blessed.” Y: im gonna go with blessed, i like the sound of blessed “You might be doomed, or you might be blessed. It's too early to tell. How long have you been manifesting symptoms of possession?" Y: um. About 4ish years P: yeah wait actually how did that happen Y: well you see i was doing spring cleaning, i went into the attic, old stuff, prayer beads, i put them on- actually it gets fuzzy around then, auntie has been ever since. I saw a giant fox. Then um. Yeah. I think I blacked out a little bit. P: where are the beads now?
(arm just beads. Shiryo Anmoku didn't know it existed.) P: any record of where she died?
“I have the exact location. I dont think youll be welcome. The Holy Church of Pharasma, its directly underneath it. They raised the ground over her grave, built that as the first foundation of where pharasma built the first temple.” P: thats good to know. K: i know that my home is gone. Do you know what happened? I haven't heard much. “What do you need to know?”
K: grundiir. The nation. How did it fall? “Well that's a matter of scholarly debate. What philosophical tree do you consider yourself a part of?” K: i lived there “An empiricist then.” K: i ate one of those once i think Talks about various theories, including that the dwarves dug into smth so deep to rival the throne of want, presented to the earth from the gods to let the mortals ascend. Another is that they tried a form of magic to make them timeless, they overextended themselves, made it so that time doesn’t exist underground or spatial reality. No one has gone down, survived, and came back with a good answer. Found things that shouldn't be underground that thrive, also odd monsters that tell epithets that come true, time and spatial anomalies, happened in the timeless period, closure is that exact point where the warp stopped. Various lords became kings of respective kingdoms, all claiming to be true heir of grundiir. Do have various ways of going about it, some are more cruel than others, general consensus is that anyone who can take the capital and stabilize it becomes the true kingdom. Various expeditions of varying success. Some erect new religions abt such, pardoning death sentence people to do quests and go in K: Do you know if there are records from before the warp? “Of course. The dwarves kept records, double so of most things.” K: thats good. Would they be in brazenthrone or somewhere else
“Brazenthrone would have access, for sure. If you have access to that hold, that’d be a good place to start. Most holds are protected from teleports, unfortunately for us magicians.” Go to the broken down church Onto The Bridge A few creatures begin moving
Shadowplane
Plane to an old god known as Nerule, later overthrown by Pharasma She built her church over his His vestige still remains, creatures approach “Youre not the boss. You look suspiciously like the people he told us to kill should we see.” These are venyvers, beedy red eyes, least strong of darvokkas. Submit to masters that are powerful enough or are abt to release destruction in the areas they roam Void healing Have a weird need for ceasing existence. Made to do. Will drag people off into the pale, that way you will unbecome. P: your master the king of ensile?
“King of what is called Ensile.” P: he has passed away. “Tragic. Why havent you followed in his footsteps?” P: i have things to get done “You dont have to. Easily could let it go.” P: i have- a divine calling i must attend to. “As do we. it is going to unmake you, unfortunately.”
P: does there happen to be a strange rune in here? Since youre abt to unmake us does it matter “These answers make humans cling to hope, and theyll fight harder when clinging to hope.” K: we dont have life, could you tell us “You have unlife. In our eyes, youre still living, youre making actions in the world, and its tragic.” K: im hungrier than i used to be Combat Soft music coming from the building? Surprisingly good
Shadow Fortress Its a eulogy, dedicated to ensile king’s wife at the time when he was a lord Thing with blade arms, woman with stringed instrument smiling at philomine Horned woman with 2 eyes and 1 on the forehead Woman is clearly an Oni, shadow yai. Drawn to the subject and worship of beautiful deaths 100 people slaughtered here If you were to hide a rune of death, this is an excellent place to do it. Doesnt appear different, the average passerby wouldnt be able to tell such a thing would be here “Philomine!” P: you know my name, i dont know yours, who are you?
“Akazaki Rin. this companion of mine is nameless as they all are.” P: what brings you here to this fortress? “Protecting the rune for your husband.” P: hes dead “He is! And now we have 2 beautiful deaths on our hands. That's a conundrum." P: no need to protect it “There is. You might die here, and that means you successfully killed your husband and died shortly after. You're close to completing the epitaph.” “The epitaph.” “Phil needs to die for the story to be complete.” P: i will just come back, my business is unfinished “It is tied to morven, she is mortal. We could even write about how you were tied to a new lover and perished.” P: ah. Im assuming youd still try to kill my companions out of anger “Of course. And i have promised, and he has promised. Anger? Do you think im angry?” P: you might be if i ran away “If you did, more beautiful. Runaway bride. One who abandons her maybe soulmate at the precipice of death.” P: you could come join us?? “And?” P: watch me get evicerated by a soon-to-be god. “Who is that?” P: how could you not know of that person? “I can see the marital bond put upon you in the witness of divinity.” (non zero chance he transformed the matrimony ceremony of the divines and did that. Same ritual he did on pharasma.) P: whens our honeymoon morven?? M: i didnt know this shit i need a second “I will hear his name and i will give you the rune.” P: we cant say his name lest we be immolated you could give us the rune and we bring u to him Dasa gives his ring to viktor D: audovere Immediately immolated leaving behind the token Dasa is Dead “So its the truth. He died for it. Embraced oblivion.” Companion grunts at us “Where can we meet him?” She brings us to the rune Unseals the doors that once held the grand dragon, now holds a single rune
Ume snacks, swallows it whole Qlisalt 11, 1265 Level 15??? Dasa is resurrected Experienced absolutely nothing after death? Actually, able to see the world careening down into the grove where he woke up. Boney hand twitches fingers, undoes magic it once held.
Dasa going to Dasa's Grove Dead rings of grass and shrubbery, equicenter rings total of 9 No new grass has grown Grass still flourishes despite the snow Hand wouldve been roughly 200ft in the air Flies up, looks down Able to see in the new morning sun, soft gleam of metal on the earth. Somehow snow nor grass nor shrub has covered it this point of view Able to find a necklace with a gem dislodged. 4 green gems surround, another 4 red gems surrounded. Center gem dislodged He places the gem that serves as his heart into it Forms a beautiful necklace that seems fit for a human/someone of that build Some odd sentimental value to him He gets the skeletons from his bag, puts them in the circles, makes them look to the center Waits 4 hours 30 mins, 1 skeleton moves on its own After next 30, another will, so on so forth Form some sort of enchantment ritual He draws it out, recreating the figures as they appear The three skulls begin weeping then after 30 mins, continue to weep but point towards the south east Pointing towards the active gate of the king, whichever gate is active they point towards
The King's Ballroom
King + dione He looks “you must be more careful. There are those i would consider thieves of the body. But it is fortuitous. I thought it wise to track your body, philomine.” P: oh? Has something happened to my body? “It was stolen by a thief it seems.” “It is terrible. Ive taken it upon myself to find her. Philomine of course, and the thief.” V: any progress? ‘I have. And ive offered 2 options. It is through phil that i found her. Im offering the coup de grace to you philomine or dione.” Dione “i resign the right. I will give it to them.” P: have you already captured this thief or shall we? “I have captured her. Men, bring him out.”
Basilae brings out bound, bloody, Lume j'Estrilla (theres no tell on jestrilla, but on dione she would not pass off this chance. Shed kill jestrilla if it was actually her. Dont know why the king is doing it. But he Does have phil’s body.) K: uhh. Phil. you can borrow this. (gives clan dagger) King steps forward “i suspect this will be easier for you.” hands phil his war spear w/ ghost touch P: does this person have a lover? “She does not. If she had a lover, she did not call out for her name during the torture. Then she is not clearly a lover. If you do not, i will torture her to death.” Phil takes the spear, goes over there There seems to be nothing, it feels like stabbing her She turns to dust and ash with no coffin to return to Bows to the king He smiles “good. Know that should you work with enemies such as her, the same fate will befall you. But the kill will not come quick.” He looks at shadow yai, bows at them, they bow back “What will be your reward for recruiting someone to my court?” P: go to dasa. “Why?” P: he was the one who was most convincing V: of your power “Dasa the diplomat.” P: well. Dasa immolated his life, we thank the grace of pharasma “Immolated? By what magics?” P: so. This fine lady asked us to prove we were working for a deity, dasa spoke your name and was immediately struck down by divine power “He spoke my name?” P: mhm. “I see. I shall talk to dasa. Where is he?” P: he was feeling very strange after being brought back, he mentioned visions from pharasma and said he would catch up with us later, would you like us to bring him later? “I would, in the meantime i have something to attend to.” he quickly leaves Leave, jestrilla sending, spell is wasted Dione follows us outside K: whats your favorite kind of blood “Half elven.” K: compared to full elven “Its too light. Orc, human, i had a dwelf before.” K: i think ive had the same thing. “All undead are cannibalistic in a way. Phil consumes the parts of souls, morven is made of bodyparts.” K: any food “The king does, back there. You can eat the ashes of my old master.” K: that is a waste i guess V: you didn’t seem quite affected by her death “No, he said that is her death and that is her death. The end V: you don’t feel anything about the situation? “I do not. I was denied a proper battle. Would you feel good if you were denied a battle with me? Would you rather smother me in my sleep? V: no. how did u find her? “Dead. she had committed suicide with a potion of holy water and some mixture. He resurrected her. She seemed different but he assured that she lives neither in death nor undeath Viktor has heard of tales like this. Jestrilla had a clone, the king prevented her from transferring her soul to the clone. She is currently in stasis. If we find the item with her soul we can free her. We don’t know if he has it or if it’s just somewhere. Many magics don’t allow seizure of the soul but can redirect it. Some manner of magic jar. Clone is likely in another vestige. It was her body that we killed, didn’t cry or anything during torture or death “If you do bring her back in any capacity i will be forced to kill u viktor. That’s the decree and i agree with it V: unfortunately i didn’t know the woman. Not well at least “Ofc u barely interacted. Only with culthain V: only with culthain “I don’t wish to kill u. But if she stays dead it will be worth it V: is that what u truly believe? “U don’t know what kind of person she is V: i know what kind of people u are “She is the worst V: how so? “Has she been cruel to u? If u knew her, would she be cruel? V: she was kind as culthain
“Vlaundet Thaine was a kind vampire. He let adventurers walk into his home. He let them know world secrets that he sought and when he dug too far they killed him V: u seem bitter that they killed him “Im bitter he was usurped by a woman who pretends to be nice V: do u pretend to be nice? “Idk. i know i support a king who believes in warfare. Everywhere has war and in the 2000 years do u know how many years have had no war? V: 200? “25 years. Doesn’t it make sense that the god that rises should be the god of war?
V: you do not like war though, you have people to protect in your business “I want to protect people during war, protect the refugees. Is not a refugee how u found yurei? “I accept the war the same way i accept the sunrise means i must flee into the dark. And i accept these wars since he has promised 100 years of peace after his ascension. And we will have 4x the peace we’ve had in the last 1100 years. V: maybe u should make ur own path rather than having faith in the war “Do u make ur own path? V: i am trying “U critique society and yet u participate in it “pats morven i had to hold back to not kill them. Now it is a pat amongst comrades V; i don’t think i can change ur mind after all this. But perhaps just have u think about it “Maybe. But there will be a point where we must fight. Almost certainly at the point ur growing. He understands the betrayal but he’s entertained. As he grows he must choose between mortal and god. He will choose god. V: maybe that will change. Maybe he has fooled you or– i will not say that “He has and he hasn’t. He is not subtle in his ambitions V: things may change. That is the way of gods “pulls out a cigarette have u tried these V: what is that
“A cigarette. They come from the far west and let u feel warmth in ur chest. It’s odd having to breathe again. Sabine Keson is well. She does not wish to see you V: i figured not, but my thoughts go to her. Perhaps this war will not touch her in the end. “It will but she will survive. She survived you after all V: she is strong like that Next week: Look into dasa with his necklace + skeletons Dream council auntie Hey why does everyone go insane when possessed by you Back to Brazenthrone (eventually) Owariaryu pharasman temple

sessions/undead-campaign/act-4/session-6.description:
Prev: Session 63
Next: Session 65 Qlisalt 12, 1265
Go to Dasa's Grove Dasa hadnt left the skeletons, there is green grass growing in the winter Dasa puts a skeleton down again, it moves to have fingers an inch from the ground and feet above the head (person falling to the ground) Some of them, the back hand, is doing a blessing, though it seems to be dangling in freefall. All of the effort is going to divine blessing of safety and growth, other hand is ripping something off from neck and into the ground Fall wouldve taken 3 seconds, maybe shorter if a high velocity
Necklace is iconography of Pharasma, smth she wears along her neck. The Old Friend, as it is known Refers not to necklace, but the corpse of her familiar that resides inside when she was a cleric Very magical, artifact of pharasma Dasa puts the necklace on, invests it Gains ability to be affected by void healing or vitality healing at will by each effect +3 religion At will talking corpse, 5th rank peaceful rest 5x a day Dasa asks morven what fleshwarps are, they dont really know D: oh i see. Do you know where i can meet other fleshwarps?
Dasa teleports to Sternbore, Sowwin's Grove Sees a pumpkin staring at him
Sowwin smiling “hello!” D: hi! Are you a fleshwarp? “No im a leshy” D: oh! Thats a coincidence, im also one “You dont look like one, what plant are you?” D: my creator didnt know, so idk! “Bottled sunlight then?” “Are you just formed?” D: formed recently? Maybe a few years ago? “A few years?” D: wheres the nearest fleshwarp? “I met a few why?” D: i have to ask about what a fleshwarp is. My friend morven doesnt know what they are, so i came looking for the nearest fleshwarp “Fleshwarp is… not a unique thing, general category. Gotta get more specific. Its like looking at a plant!” D: thats what the other skeleton said too. What would you say is a good category of fleshwarps that would be great to live? “Most of them??? Except the mindless ones?” D: i have to verify with 1 more if the mindless ones should live or not “Only a few shouldnt live??” Pumpkin is so tired at another ranking of lives situation Trees grow around sowwin at a rapid pace Dasa returns Wtf where did you go?? D: a grove? I met a cool pumpkin. He was yee short, had a pumpkin head, inside the head was red. Did i mention he was short? Wtf you talked to the grim reaper?? Dasa doesnt like elves, humans, likes dwarves, D: oh i see. Humans Are good. :)
Sending to Kelda Proudhammer
This is anmoku funeral parlor, can we have permission to renter brazenthrone “Why?” We’re prepared now to get access to the historical records like we discussed last time “I’ll send word.” Qlisalt 13, 1265 Brazenthrone Outside gates for 3 hours Guards walk forward “Youre infected with ghoul fever. We will have to put a muzzle on you, but you may enter.” Muzzle is tight, gives her a bird like profile, top part of beak can be undone should someone need to feed her Kelda meets us “Why the sudden interest at the precipice of war?” K: well. When war happens its a lot more difficult to access historical records, we might as well do it now before its too late “That it is. We still need permission from the king, i’m not sure his company would appreciate people like you.” P: oh? “Undead hunters.” P: what kind? “The Namers (dwarven). I dont know the name in common”
V: man named Homveran? “I do not know the name. An old man with a young girl?” V: oh we have met him before, i’m sure there will be no issues
We go to see the king Drosa Korunda Dwarven halls are abuzz with gossip and movement. Some people havent slept in a while, and seeing us, the various iron golems will block our way until they’re allowed to strip us of any weapons Kholeran is manacled, phil is ghost touch manacled Gloves have runes so that they may touch ghosts P: do you deal with ghosts a lot? “No. war on the horizon. Undead apparently, according to the soothsayer.” We are let inside to meet with King Drosa, has a chained up homveran Greet the king He ushers us inside the stadium
A spy (Grabble Forden) is ready to be executed, looks at us with a smile, messages “free me” to us He is found guilty of treason and beheaded “And what can i do for you?” We were hoping to get that grundiir info To his men “clear the room.” has the guards leave with corpses “Then you must be the undead that gave him the information.” H: “I did try to keep you anonymous.” What info?
“The treaties of Advesperascit were renewed so that the kings and queens.”
“It appears the king of Tunseel was in 2 places at once, bc he was also seen talking to someone of Ensile.”
“He was talking to the nation of fathrell at the border. Last seen with someone of your party.” P: who?
“The mayor of fathrell, Yurei Anmoku.”
(yurei wasnt actually there, grandson in fathrell) P: the king uses body doubles sometimes
“Why would he do that? Any contract would be magically unbound. It would work if he was a lesser lord, but hes the king of tunseel and ensile. And technically azerin.” “There would be no reason, but thats not the important part. The important part is that this man says that there is a man claiming to be the powerful avatar of war.” Yeah “Then what he proposes is along your goals.”
H: “the warp poses a problem after the taking of Vlyn'Darastyl, if we were to have a siege here it would cause an issue. I propose we claim a part of the warp, buy time for the siege, that way they need not fight on 2 fronts, theres just a big murder hall. 6 soldiers side to side.”
Hes asking brazenthrone to be a brunt against the king’s army, the general gist is that brazenthrone will issue a challenge that the king wont be able to take the city, the city would be under siege until the situation was dealt with P: i have a question. Will you live past the next 100 years? “I will i have friends in high places.” P: then it will be a good 100 years if we lose. Itll be 100 years of peace, then unending war for the rest of eternity. “Then we best not lose the war. But we need security on the breaches.” P: oh yeah we can do that “Then we will make deals after its done.”
P: can we investigate old grundiir abt kholeran stuff? “I will allow it, but the square is populated by demon kind.” P: we’re a little stronger Morven lifts us up to prove strength H: “i can vouch, i can trust you. In my frail state, i trust them” “Then itll be his life as a wager. He promises to go with you and accompany you the entire way.” “The lower reaches, i wil give you a map for where i think an archive is, entry hall into grundiir proper. I wouldnt suggest going into grundiir proper bc of time dilation, its possible you enter and then return 100 years later.” “Ill let you know, there is a demon known as a katpaskier. Its a demon of doomsayers and nihilism.” Demon that thrives in field of distorted areas, able to manipulate at will. Each round may increase time by a day “It prefers area of rumination. It thrives where time is already distorted.” P: anymore advice abt things to prepare for down there? “I can give as much cold iron for the demons.” He is hardy, can take 1 hit from demon, but the 2nd would be fatal
Homveran bows, “might i bring my apprentice as well? I plan to drop her at the spire.” “Should we all perish, could you hold her in the halls till she comes of age?” King “of course.” V: training going well? “Shes ready for her 2nd name, eventually. Im not good at names, i hope she finds a suitable name for herself.” “Any loved ones that are dead?”
M: shalana i guess? “Shalanna might be good for her.” K: if i die she should consider kholeran mudriver “I dont think kholeran would work for her. Its also just the first name.” “Meet me down at the port in 2 days?” “I understand, if youre strong as you say, you may have the ability to teleport, id advise against it if youre going near the warp.” Qlisalt 14, 1265 Soldiers are talking abt which villages they could pull into the stronghold before the army gets here, where they can house people, where they can use the unskilled labor of surface folk for Theyd like to be able to house everyone without issue, but it will be a siege, any mouth eating and not contributing is rough Dasa influences some nature, causes mushrooms to start growing alongside wheat and fruits held alive by artificial lights Phil feeds people Qlisalt 15, 1265 Spent going down staircase to the black river This area disrupts magics in the name of safety and security, sometime you will spend an entire day walking down a staircase Qlisalt 16, 1265
Reunited with premier ship, The Grinning Widow Sail through the black loch, hear the odd whispers down below, veiled masters taking interest in us We hear the odd voices in our heads, asking us to jump in Dasa wants to jump in the water we say No Light in the water calls to dasa specifically No he wont become one of their pantheon of gods Creatures that have hatred of gods, they collect things that are related to gods stories They dont compromise their long term plan for vanity, let the rest of the ship pass
Deepspire City of drow, living alongside orcs Elaine asks questions to us “is it fine being undead?” M: ive got no complaints, but im built different
“My uncle Gorvain Lecrân says im to slaughter you all should i come of age” V: us specifically? “You are undead.” D: im a summon :) “Youre a skeleton!” D: im a plant! “No!” M: sometimes that one says things and you go okay, yeah “Gorvain has told me of the insane ramblings of undead.” P: id recommend maybe what homveran does, he speaks to the undead to decide if they are willing to live within rules of society or if theyll hurt people. Uses his kills against those who intend to cause harm to others “Do you cause harm to others?” P: technically yes but in the same way a knight or soldier causes harm to others.
“My sister was a knight.” V: fond memories of her? “She joined the organization after vampires killed our family.” P: oh i see. “Gorvain tells me she died fighting the undead.” V: perhaps u will make her proud “Did you kill her? Gorvain says you did.” P: yeah. We did. Its a lot to get into bc we want you to have a kind memory of your sister, if you wish to not know the reason and keep hatred so u have a kind memory of ur sister, i do not mind. If u want us to explain why, we can “Why?”
P: we… were trying to hunt down the vampire that killed viktor. When we realized there was a knight working with her, they had cut the head off an innocent woman to save the life of the vampire. Shes a merciless killer, that vampire. Our investigation led us to your sister. She or the vampire had killed the other knights of the holy order, bc we’re undead its an easy connection. Her next move was- “Gorvain said that you killed the knights and viktor killed 2 and didn’t remember the name.” P: the five of them were- we were responsible for , the other 2 were her. They broke into our house to kill us. “Because youre undead?” P: yes “Why do you refuse to pass on?”
P: i am the mortal herald of my deity, there are some injustices that are occurring in her purview, i wont leave “Is it not for the living to sort out the living world?” P: i… did not die a cleric, i died a school teacher. When i awoke i was filled with divine power, i believe its my duty to help my deity “How will you know when you are done?” P: well. Theres a couple things i know i must do. One, theres a greater threat to this world that we are in a position to help fix, i will help one of my friends finish up their business, and then i will go. “I loved my sister, and we are separated, will you kill me?” P: it is romantic love, and i can revive the dead. I prefer to bring one back into the living, but yes that is my divine oath She thinks abt it, she is dropped off in deepspire Giant column in the cave, hollowed out by the orcs, populated by the drow that are now doing a mass exodus
Go talk to the wouldbe lich Eleanderel He has paler skin, some curling off with calcified muscle, still not completed the process “Lesser undead, welcome.” V: you dont remember us then? “I do. But you are still lesser to lichdom.” K: how is it going? “Slow. but i am getting there. I need to kill myself 3 more times and itll be complete.” K: it took me a while to die too “Did it? I thought it would only take a week.” K: it felt like it took a while “If you had any potential, id revive you so that you may become a lich.” K: im kholeran mudriver, whats your name? “Elanderel.” “Is she mindless? I could make her my-” V: no V: has much been happening since we were gone? “The reclamation of that god forsaken city that belongs to the drow. The swearing of vassaldom and the creation of outposts. We do not know why they sought to siege brazenthrone after a prosperous time, but they did, and it led to some changes. And now we have a government with unfair rules. And what of the surface?” V: tunseel is at war, it has taken over ensile “Good, that means more bodies will be dumped down into the breach and to me. I am sad that it is tunseel. Do you want meat? We could arrange executions.” D: of who? “It does not matter. I am practicing some magics. I am practicing mind control magics. And i can make someone commit a crime most foul to create 2 corpses.” K: why are you sad its tunseel? “Theyre holy bastards, they dont understand the nature of perfected undeath. They see some undead as abominations but they dont see undeath is the natural evolution of life. Itd be like being upset at the butterfly for being better than the caterpillar.” K: “what’s a butterfly” He makes an illusion Viktor attempts to steal his soul cage out of his pocket And succeeds
Catch up to homveran, he is at a temple of Ashava trying to get a sword made Goddess of moonlight “I am thinking of getting elaine a moonblade.” V: will she be happy with such a gift? “I believe she wants to hunt undead, i want to suppress her violent urges.” “I hope the blade does not turn to you.” K: she was also being told by gorvain a lot “Unfortunately i cant punish him, hes a master in his own right, he did not speak untruth. It is undeniable that you are the primary factor in the sisters death.” P: We told her the truth to the best of our abilities and if she wants to pursue revenge later in life that is her choice. “She might. Unfortunately it’s only by my talking that the order hasn’t been hunting you. When she will be of age I will not be around “Its all i ask, you will likely be here. Its almost a certainty that you will outlast us at this rate kholeran. Should the universe end, you might be the only creature left.” K: i would not like that. By the time she is of age, i dont intend to be around. V: is that true??? P: you dont? K: no “I can understand. I plan on- once i pass by whatever means, i dont plan on coming back.” K: most of the time im very confused. But i know that theres nothing here for me. Nothing left. Why would i remain? “If you have nothing- are you okay with dying, or do you want to die?” K: we have talked about this before. “It has been months.”
“I dont agree with certain things, with the elves of tunseel what they were before, but we do talk about their death rites. An elf knows when they are to die of old age. Theyd cross the mountains, across Vitry-Seilave, theyd fight demons. If youre okay with dying, you could go to the Warp, fighting those off. Youd die, but youd be able to create a safe space temporarily.” K: i always intended back home “Then maybe youll go further than any dwarf before.” One of the priestesses cuts us off, sword in hand “I dont think her hands will be quite as big as a dwarf’s, maybe thinner on the hilt.”

Prev: Session 64
Next: Session 66 Qlisalt 16, 1265
Blackloch
Gotta go to the other side of vlyn'darastyl then deeper into the caves
Sailing upon The Grinning Widow, takes 3-4 days Qlisalt 17-20, 1265 The lake above is the source of the black loch Vlyn’darastyl Greeted very curtesly, people do glare at us Issue: most of the ones that were the ‘heroes’ of the city were taken into custody, the ones left are without combat capabilities. None could harm us, but 4 are willing to try Dasa talking to the rats D: what happened after the big battle? Anything change for the worse or better? D: OR ABOUT THE NATURE. When the trees died, waht happened? “There was the feast immediately after.” D: the feast? “Too many things to do with, too many bodies to take away. Our kind your kind, all need to eat.” D: i am just bones D: so what happened to the tree after the war? “The lost forest.” D: is it like the forest just ran away? “A different forest. One painted like your bone. All the trees white as that.” D: leaves? “Have no leaves, and the bark is inedible. No smell, nothing.” D: you couldnt eat it… were they made of this material (bone) “No, could not suck marrow from it.”
(TREES LIKE THE TREES WHEN WE GOT BLASTED BY GROETUS) (wait, groetus should be behind the divine gate. How was he there?)
See Homveran huddled in his coats, blowing air into his hands. Its so cold down here “Dont give a demon a step. A devil you can reason with, a demon you cannot. I would like to keep hidden, lest it think i am trying to negotiate with it V: do u want my cloak of invisibility? “No viktor, I will be fine dw. I’ve survived more than this in my time. Though I fear my time has gone V: i do not think so. Ur still spry in ur age “I’m spry FOR my age. Although my age is higher than it should be. I am well traveled, although I might be one of the younger Im the one that’s lived the most V: that may be true
“And what we’re up against I’ve lived more than even him V: potentially, but he has fingers in many pies and traveled a lot
“Probably, but he’s never lived a day as a man even though he’s fought more than I ever could. When he was born he was chosen to be a god and groomed by the empire to fill that role V: that’s true. Maybe he hasn’t lived a life like us. Maybe that’ll be his downfall “ do u know what kills most monsters in the tales? V: a simple man? A fighter who cares for those around him? “A monster is created bc he doesn’t believe himself to be like the other man. And the man who has others to protect can vanquish him thus” He talks abt the hunts hes been on K: i think i was older than you when i died “You mightve been. How much of that remains?”
K: i think i met a god once “You mightve met one twice.” K: true. Sure. maybe. “I’m just asking, and forgive the general term, maybe hold onto whatever aspects of humanity you find down here and hold to it like a flame. Its one with limited kindling.” K: i can try. But i think it went out a long time ago “Then hopefully we’ll be able to find it.” K: maybe D: kholeran can find anything V: good tracker K: i appreciate the confidence
“Its deep in the earth, and these stone walls are good at one thing. Preservation. Of all the pre-god empires, grundiir was the last to fall.” K: that makes sense. The stone helps protect.
“Well, it does. But they also have a storytelling tradition, they reminded each other what it meant to be around each over. The vespertine had it, and the dragboni certainly didn’t have it.” Talks abt empires of old “Do you know why your expedition was sent over there kholeran?” K: no. do you. “I have an idea.” K: why do you think?
“Well. the area to the north of Tunseel- the dwarven empires there don’t have the soil underground to grow food. They wanted to grow food there, it was described as a great plague up there. Ive heard stories of what happened when the food ran scarce. It let to some of the undead i fought against, im certain. People do horrible things when theres nothing to eat but their fellow man.” K: true. Hunger will bring out terrible things in a person. “But there are a few dwarves that didnt let their hunger define them, they were heroes. They found other solutions, ate monsters. It did cause some issues, but the attempt was heroic enough to justify it. Its unfortunately, and i believe your condition causes no exception, impossible to eat monsters without taking on aspects of them.” K: how so? “To eat a demon will slowly imbue your blood with demonic essence. To eat a corpse will have necrotic energies. One slowly becomes like the monsters they seek to face. Though i do hope you all forgive me, this form of cannibalism leads to the cursed condition of undeath.” K: true. Especially mine. “You especially. Though you have a more extreme case, vampires also suffer from it. A curse that causes them to eat fellow man. Though a bit less invasive, their targets, theoretically, may not even know theyve been feasted on. Believe they were cursed with some common malady.” K: i believe its a different kind of hunger altogether “What do you believe about it then?” K: the thirsting for blood. I have had every part of a living being. All of them feel different to my appetite. “Feels different, when you eat someone? Depending on what part you eat?” K: if i can taste it, they taste different. They feel different to me. “And they being the body parts, or the people?” K: both. But the closest i can feel to happiness is when im eating. If i was to drink blood, it isnt bad. But its not the same. “Both are cursed unfortunately. Either way, the victim likely die. The advantage of viktors is that they dont know it, but its much harder to diagnose. In all cases of ghouldom is the death of the ghoul. The vampires ive come to an amicable agreement. The vampire offers protection to the town. The ghoul- i’ve yet to find a way that works.” V: what vampires have u met where that was the case?
“I can speak to one, but they want to remain anonymous. I was abroad then so u won’t find them anyways probably. The other was one Korga Ashmark, orcish man. Notably the town under his protection became a state of sighar which brought a lot of heat to my endeavors. It was by him being there that he prevents worst undead being there. Unfortunately I believe the town is over a manifest zone” Manifest zone = place where another plane bleeds through Sighar is artificial manifest zone Manifest zones typically room to town size
V: are u aware of the theory of how undeath got passed on after Pharasma became goddess of death? Before where everyone could just cycle through potential deaths? “I’m aware but, sorry, i’m not too sure it was bad. It stopped nindorus from arising. I understood them as fierce demons that arise from undeath. Arguably worse than undeath but it stopped them from reaching a state of (something). I believe the “patron” of the party may have been a nindoru and not a true undead. She may have been the last of her party, the last to slight pharasma.” See city of white spires that used to be trees Can look upward, see the structure we weaved thru and fought a woman and her eidolon on Tree is rotting, various brickwork is falling. Glass has shattered, lies nicely amongst the rocks on the ground. There is no life, not even bugs Homveran struggles to breathe down here Area is So magical, trees are necromatic in origin Air continues to grow still, then subtle movements, creature turning through the trees. Womanly form Woman with a mask and bat like spiderweb wings “is there any regrets before you pass on?” Marigna Homveran “i beseech you as a loyal servant of pharasma to let these ones pass. They need not be hunted by the other of you that are lurking in the trees, theyre here to correct an injustice of undeath, and i am certain they will see themselves out” “Then speak for yourselves. By what grace do you live?” P: we’re here to clean out the warp “The warp is not our concern.” “Souls are not lost in the warp, theyre just transformed. We’re unsure if its the ladys will to take them.” P: we’re gonna kill a great undead. “Greater than yourself?” P: yeah P: besides that, dasa explain ur situation? They can help you? D: oh! Mmm. how could they help me…
P: youuuu. Are. we know youve never died. We’ve been told this by an angel of pharasma (Ziphren). He discovered he was born from- sprouted from the ground after a necklace was placed within it, he was able to come back and reconstruct the necklace that was protected by some magic by the stone that lived in his chest. The necklace seems to be important to pharasma. We are not sure of the significance of the necklace having been buried + dasas situation, but perhaps u would understand? Could we show you this necklace? “Then show the necklace and we determine if you die now or later. But do you promise to pass on once the business is finished?” Viktor lies, no bell rings “Then you are either truthful, or when its all done, we will take the swearer’s soul.” Homveran, smiles “then i’ll gladly go in their place.” He brings a notebook to the creature, they whisper back amongst themselves She looks at us “they may move through here, but they may not stay more than a day amongst the trees.” merges back into one Air returns to this passage Dasa goes to talk to a dead tree “Am i alive?” D: no? Youre way beyond dead right now “Then where will i be going?” D: to the plant afterlife? “Theres a separate one?” D: is that not where you go? “IDK.” D: youll pass on eventually. How old are you? “Older than the world. We belong to the sees and the acorns of the world below, the one mistaken for the first, but it is before that.” D: what is the world below? “A desolate hellscape. Its why they planted us up here when the worlds of others started crashing onto it.” D: different planes of existence? “I believe so. There are many different worlds. I did not get to see them all, i was but an acorn, and the worlds kept piling on, then the men, and then the men created the mountains.” D: how many worlds have u seen? “Many and the one. There were many, and it has become the one.” D: what? Did a merge happen? “At one point, yes.” D: when did it happen? “Before my birth.” D: you were created after the merge. “The acorn existed, and from the acorn became the tree.” D: any trees older than you? “Below. We were great trees.a nd they managed to merge many of them and take them above. Idk where they are. I was not worthy of the grafting, thus abandoned down here.”
D: what do u know of the Warp? “It… came all at once, subsumed down below. I believe the dwarves dug beneath where my roots could fathom.” D: how deep? “Miles and millennium become one, and then deeper than that.” D: what caused you to die? “The sun left me.” D: theres no sun here, this is underground “I wasnt, when i was planted.” (this was once the surface, and then a cavern formed above it)
(the trees werent alive from the rune, but were like undead turned alive) D: how long did you sustain life from the rune? “I dont know. But it got warm 4 times and cold 3.” (4 summers, 3 winters = 3.5 years) (if the runes were available as soon as auntie made the contract, why would she wait? Like an egg, they need time. There was a slight delay. The other priests went mad in a year, so the runes couldnt show.) D: anybody besides us recently? Or last 100 years? “I can only remember 3.5 out of the hundred. Elves and the like saw. Among them walked a majestic presences that tried to soothe me. Of gold hair and step.” D: was he an elf? “No. human. But older than most elves. He did reassure that we died of good cause. But to live- theres no need for us to live anymore. Then, like one of the grafted, we can be added to his consort’s throne.”
(he’s gonna put them on pharasma’s bone spire, let them loom over the boneyard) D: were the dwarves around when u were? “They were. They lived in my roots.” Party goes forth Day 1 Dasa - Fine Kholeran - approached by a dwarf “Sister are you seeking to find us?” k: i want to go home. “you can. Just… there are those among you who would prevent u from going home.” K: how so? “They believe youre on a righteous path, theyre not, they dont want you to go to your rightful home.” K: i will have an opportunity to fully go home later. For now, i will go with them “One who hates you travels amongst them. Your name was red, he offered your soul in exchange for the others.” (odd. Dont sense anything, all the words ring true, but the blood smells foul and rotting underneath. The words are true. Kill homveran, and you get your soul back.) K: that may be true “And it is.” K: but. I forfeited my soul when i died. When i started eating. “Theres a cure for undeath, ancient grundiir had it, hidden from pharasma under the mountains. He would prevent you from getting it.” K: i dont believe he could “It is written on stone, this is how stone goes.” Stone cracks, wakes everyone up Rest goes well Homveran looks at kholeran, asks if she would mind if he took her blood V: what do u need it for? “I wish to make sure she is dangerous. She is the only name that has yet to fully turn uncolored. All of your names except hers were in black ink.” P: any other turned? “A few. But names that you shouldnt concern yourself with. I believe if yurei was a true undead, her name would be red. But i have no ways to sense it. I do wish that kholeran would use it when the time is right, but its a painless way out. I need a sample of the blood. I would make a poison to undo kholeran without her consent, which is why i think asking might be necessary.” P: i think she would like it- to know that if she goes back down, she doesnt have to lie bleeding out in the dark in the warp. “It reacts with the curse in their blood, causes it to halt altogether. Akin to being deprived of oxygen. No resurrection bc the curse is also resurrected.” Making undeath a curse is how pharasma prevented nindorus P: i think u should ask kholeran. We will help u convince her but i think u can do this with her permission. “Unfortunately I’m not so sure P: i believe in her V: why do u think she would say no? “As I mentioned I’ve fought ghosts, vampires, skeletons, undead dolls, etc. with all of them i’ve managed to achieve reason. All except the ghouls. With every ghoul I’ve faced (he shows his shoulder full of bite scars) has reacted the same when faced with diplomacy P: we’ll talk to her and if not we’ll get it tomorrow “I want to do this as soon as possible. The warp will take a toll on her mind as we get further P: we’ll ask her right as she wakes up She wakes up Hey homveran can u give blood to kholeran K: why? P: he can make a thing where u can die without pain K: okay “Huh. oddly agreeable.” He gets blood from her, 20hp worth Takes an hour, he feels cold “I will have it done by the time that we arrive.” P: extra one for her to carry? “I can only make 2 batches of it. Would anyone else like to carry it? I can do the deed, as i’ve done it many times. Youve been more amicable than any before.” “I believe that pharasma will grant me the accuracy to land the bold. The best scenario is useless, and i have wasted 2 days of my life.” Oh we have to explain the dasa situation to homveran, he couldnt hear before Day 2 Do encounter demons that we take on, 5 of each while homveran can only take on 1. We’ve grown in power, but he’s only lost it as time marches on Nebasu Kholeran & Dasa - kholeran sees a dwarf. A different one. “The research is deep underground. How do you hope to get it without the demons help, who is unaffected by the warp?” K: huh. Dasa sees kholeran stare in the middle distance at a wall D: u okay?? Kholeran doesnt hear him, sees dasa on patrol K: i… will do my best. And if i fail. So be it. “Youll not only fail yourself, youll fail those around you. Viktor, philomine, dasa, who have offered you kindness. There’s no honor in dying. He is so close to death already. The demons will surely accept him as a sacrifice.” K: i… am already lacking in honor. I might as well do what i can on my own power. “Honor doesnt matter. Look where it got grundiir? That is what caused this kerfuffle. The warp and our condemned souls, kholeran.” Dasa slowly approaching Kholeran tries to move closer to sniff Again, foul blood before exists Dasa doesnt see her walking K: why do you smell like that? “The warp and the traitorous ways, they abandoned dwarf kind. We seek one that could be our champion. One who could free all of our souls, trapped underground.” K: i could not be ur champion. I stand for nothing but my own hunger. “Than eat him and be our champion and your own. Hed taste so good. Human flesh aged by years.” “The demons will have a better argument, and you will not like it.” Another stone shatters K: it was the souls again :( P: homveran heeeelp “It sounds like a demon? I do not know many, of course. Its not my specialty, you all are.” P: have you ever killed a demon? “Of course.” P: whaaaat kind “The weak kind, those of gluttony and greed.” P: none strong? “I do apologize but my expertise is in hunting you all, not demonkind.” “A demon obsessed i killed a demon? No.” “They are not long schemers like devils. Devils are vindictive, demons are inconvenienced at best. Likely considers death an amusement, a devil thinks it’s an interruption. Thus holds a vendetta.” P: have you been here before? “No, not since i tried to talk to king drosa. This might be the furthest from tunseel i’ve ever been.” K: told me about a cure to undeath. Did i say that NO? K: they said its in grundiir, away from the gaze of pharasma “I doubt thats true. I have my deep doubts.” K: told me to eat homveran Dont do that K: yeah i dont “You shouldnt want to eat you, i am a fellow to you. Do you feel no sympathy for someone who is weaker than you?” “Most prey does not try to cooperate with a predator.” K: i dont intend to eat you P: if we find evidence, would u help us find it? “Of course. But i dont think that without lady pharasmas guiding, such a thing could exist. Her say must be absolute.” P: she seems strongly opinionated We are roughly 50miles into the earth, but only 1/8th of the way old grundiir stood at its peak Thanks to some unknown warning, brazenthrone closed the gates, and when they opened it up, there was the calamity Day 3 Traveling, fight a couple demons. Have to save Homveran a couple times cause he’s elderly now Eshmoks and Kalavakus befall him Eshmoks are like wasps that treat people like caterpillars “We are a day away from the city center. I would suggest I stand back but that would be an awful decision tactically” D: u aren’t doing fine aren’t u? “No, but I will be fine when I see the sun” P: we don’t necessarily need u to be in the fights “If I stand far enough back to not be in the fight then the demons will swarm at an isolated target and kill me” Viktor gives him a scroll of sanctuary This is the night kholeran can rest Viktor - met by a human, tunseelian “When you get to the surface, might i ask, who will you kill?” Pardon?
“Lume j'Estrilla? Or dione?” V: i dont really like either? “Then you kill both?” V: That is not my intention, but- “You will attempt to save both?” I will try “Thjen they will kill each other and it will not be swift, it will be torture V: then I will try “Pragmatic in the ways of war viktor, where did you get it? V: wym? “Where did you become so good at war, you werent when you were alive: V: I fear that the king has changes me The king? Which one? V wym? Which king has changed you? V the true one The true one… ofc… sips ominously [anything you would like to do? > Perception check / see through disguise] [it stands still, but it is odd this line of questioning, if it was fully internal they would know the answer ofc] how close will it let me get? [50ft away seems to be the distance it wants to keep for now, try a will if you want to approach] [you do manage to take a few steps closer, 2nd perception check] [you can approach this thing that has been haunting you and kholeron, and its visage turns to flies bubbling out of the rotten flesh that it inhabits and it disappears for you] [you may attempt a religion check or tell phil Vision of a kopaskier, a demon of betrayal, doomsayers and nihility [ > oh you’re so lucky koi isnt here, nihility lol] [it attempts to sew betrayal among people, it has most interest in kholeran as she is prime for betrayal, it takes mild interest in viktor as he is stuck performing a minor betrayal on one or the other] [the time will come when you will have to chose viktor smirks menacingly] [you could kill the kind og torturer or the torturer directly above you lol] [> i dont like uuuuuu >:( ] [those 2 cannot peacefully coexist w each other] [would u like 2 approach the city square then?] [ > yeah Qlisalt 20, 1265 Day 4 There are only the occasional bug around, like flies. The flies hate dasa when he tries to talk to them Enter the dwarven city Food almost preserved like the day it was made Large stomping creature w big pincers, smiles at us “Its exactly as you remember, is it not kholeran? Minus the light from below of the lower city.” Impossibly deep void
Marketplace between brazenthrone and Grundiir's Capital K: its almost like when i was alive “It could be. We have those unaffected by the warp from their unusual composition.” Lesser betrayal demon, the major one is smart enough to not be seen Kholeran smells the food on the table, smells like food K: oh…. Smells the same to the rest of us, viktor and phil see a dwarf ready for kholeran to eat Homveran “this is the city of the dead, this does take a toll. I trust you all to carry me home. I can see all the dead. I am a cleric of pharasma at the end of the day.” His veins begin to bulge, it does take its toll. “Demon of flies above, when you bite of it, youll be under its control.” Combat: Reflex is the lowest despite being a fly High fort Homveran blesses kholeran’s bow Drains from his vitality!!!! It can start distorting space around it Glabrezu has truth vulnerability (itll take damage if you say something true deep to your heart) Banished “The space beyond is warped. I can undo it in a second, so you can see your family , all you need to do is strike at the man next to you.” K: huh. (nat 20) HOMVERAN STOP TRYING TO KILL URSELF VIA THE DEMON Oh he has a death ward, but also WE DONT WANT YOU TO DIE Its killed, kholeran tries to run up and eat it, he drags her back “Its not worth it. You have a chance of redemption. This is what it wants. Let it dies, disintegrate, move on. You can move on in your terms. Not its.” K: fine. V: dangerous of u “It was a demon that could fell armies. You all overcame it all the same.” P: thanks for the help? “It was help. A nudge. Without your force, it was useless.” He’s so rough looking
V: dont let elain lose another person
“I won’t. When i was young, i talked to pharasma. Vampires took my city. My companion, she and i, took back our city. You know what i saw at age of 13 when i killed my first vampire lord? Vampire thralls begging me not to kill them for what their sire did. Me and her each killed one each and then went our separate ways. Me and tenthall separated from our paths at that point. I dont know where she went, but i became a prodigy like a modern day karn. I became a teenager of incredible might.”
“I need a drink if im to claim such a boast. I wouldve been, and karn, wouldve been a modern Cayden Cailean.” “I couldve been that. And its fine. I was born beyond which. I will enjoy my alcohol and ridding the world of those trapped beyond death and life as pharasma permits. I hope you all find justice that i have not been able to find.” “I have 10 more good years in me. Elaine will be fine, she’ll find her own way. Should you all permit and guide her, she will find her own way.” Demon wasn’t fully lying here, the warp bending space and time. Send kholeran down with 400ft of rope 1 day passes. A 2nd day passes. 3 days pass. 4 days pass. 5 days. 1 year for kholeran passes 5 questions of grundiir….

sessions/undead-campaign/act-4/session-6.title: Session 66
sessions/undead-campaign/act-4/session-6.description:
Prev: Session 65
Next: Session 67 Kholeran What events happened right after the doors closed? No record of what happened. The scholars were put elsewhere, no survivors, so alas. Maybe written down, but not here Proof of the cure for undeath?
Technically. Partially a lie the demon spouted. Technically a way to cure certain forms, but shunted away long ago by Pharasma. By making a hard separation, she was able to make sure that nindorus could never happen again, thus what happened to her cannot be repeated Records of living Kholeran or her family Kholeran not quite. There is the sheer fact that- there’s maybe a name or 2 of her, but she wasnt famous to have records. Someone sent on an expedition occasionally mentioned in ledgers.
Do have living family! In Hofenuhlgeover. Not a dwarven state before, was an outroads between brazenthrone and gordrivvmyr, more like a crossroads town. Warp isnt contained to mountains, but also several miles between peoples feet Common information about the gods lost to time Not here
Pharasma/Auntie Miko info from Grundiir time No new revelations, but confirmations on various things Torture: when kholeran begins to be pulled back, time is reversed. Each second pulled is 2 days for kholeran. Taut rope slowly brings her out of the abyss She retains her sanity for a full year Qlisalt 25, 1265 Kholeran is Starving The dwarven bodies are now rocks “I dont have access to spells, but philomine could you prepare stone to flesh?” Going thru ruined hallways of what was once grundiir, occasionally connected by worms that went thru Qlisalt 27, 1265
Homveran is able to meet up w Elain Zenderholm in Vlyn'Darastyl, gives her a hug
Going the Cull'Thaine Estate Most things have been taken Able to see a halfling’s room, images of great trees covering the walls
Memoirebebur is nascent version of the tree, child and infantile compared There was once an attic, refitted into a master bedroom
Some notes of original Vlaundet Thaine, Lume j'Estrilla took anything that could incriminate or give hints to the True King of Tunseel
Original notes mention an outcrop in which various adventurers found, led to illusion of world’s founding. Cul’thaine could sneak in and view it himself, crawled through a window. At a church in the Blackloch, one would have to swim thru rapids or walk on water. Mentions following the group, next destination was to ciburn Go back to brazenthrone Qlisalt 28, 1265
Back to Drosa Korunda He stands, welcomes us in before we can bow “its been done?” Yeah “Then which of you would be considered the messenger to the so called king?” V: me? “Then im sorry for this next part. I have to… it is tradition for war, scar the messenger. Symbolically a scar on the cheek will do.” He scars viktor’s cheek, gives a letter “You can heal it up after the war. After his side has one.” “Let us hope your side is not what he believes it is. This is my letter stating that my troops will out perform his troops. A true king of war would seize the city by troops alone.” “No sane man would hope for deaths in war.” V: well we are not fighting a sane man. “That is our advantage. No sane man would try to seize brazenthrone.” “If you assist, the ploy becomes immediately recognizable. Do not assist, i will call upon friends to defend against the war. But we managed to stay independent despite vespertines rise. We can withstand a lowly nation smaller than the vespertine. No offense viktor.” V: none taken “Anything i can offer from royal armory?”
“Kelda Proudhammer could upgrade your staff.” after Homveran reunited w cart, loads elain into the cart “I’m planning on going back to tunseel.” “If he’s as dangerous as you make
“My apprentice is still operating, you may be able to get into contact. I am sorry for what he did to viktors sister, he believed he was doing the right thing for the people of vitry-seilave.” “Good luck to you all.” takes off
Teleporting to fathrell
The King's Ballroom Kholeran’s group arrives first - kholeran dasa morven rosalind King walks over “its so good to see you all again.”
This is A king, not The king judging by hostility of basilae
Constantin Magnier fi'Alémanie, current king He is incredibly pissed at us for fraternizing with the king K: my name is kholeran mudriver, whats your name “Bow. my name is king constatin fi’alemanie.” R: very nice to meet you again! Dont mind kholeran. We’ve come as two parties, our companions will be here soon- “Do you wish for me to get my ancestor?” K: maybe we can wait for everyone else to arrive D: they shouldnt be that far off? It was only 30 mins to get here K: how are you? Rosalind is that how i talk to people? Is that the right thing to say in this situation? R: yeah good job “Good.” K: i am glad. You are good. “I’ve been… good, war has brought me a new vassal state. The vassal king, your friend viktor, seems lovely enough, but it’s a bit odd for the excuses why i havent executed my vassal king who’s openly a vampire” R: he’s lovely! You just have to get to know him! “There are not openly many vampires outside of sighar, it’s a questionable decision according to my subjects as to why i’ve allowed such a thing.” K: oh. ok. (the crowd hates yurei) K: well. Maybe they are maybe being racist D: vampires can own a city, they can probably run it well
“They probably can, but if it goes against the edicts of both gods of tunseel, Sarenrae and pharasma.” R: there are extenuating circumstances- “Do you know of any that a god should be ignored?” D: there are no gods! :) Yurei group arrives Y: yo king are you racist “I’d be careful. My word has allowed you to stay alive despite your massive blunders.” P: thank you! R: youve done much in our service, we are indebted K: thaaaaank youuuuu P: anything we can do for you? Anything except depose viktor “The question is, how would you depose viktor without angering the rightful king? Except that, no, nothing” “I believe he is in the hall with my other ancestors feasting.” Leaves, returns with the true king V: i come bearing news of war “Good news? I see someone has harmed you without my permission that wasn’t me.” Offers the letter Constantin opens the letter, true king gets the letter with his claws “So he wants a war?” Yes “And he seized my city so we can only attack through the narrow lines of the hall.” “I have a trick up my sleeve.” V: what is your trick? “I will simply blow a hole in the mountain, create a new way in.”
(theoretically possible. Did happen to Cormordor, now a mountainless dwarven city. Happened to a dwarven city that caused a cavein that now sits modernday ciburn where the meteor struck. He plans on doing it himself, but theoretically proves drosas point.) But is it not important that your troops prove your might? (in the grand scheme of his tale, wouldnt this just be the first of his day to days as a god, this isnt worth honor.) R: this is below you as a god. This is one of many successes small enough that theyre insignificant “The men will take brazenthrone. All troops. The men, the women, and should it be needed, child soldiers as well. The faithful will survive.” Constantine: “And what about the holds we barely have in ensile?” “Well viktor will kill any traitors, will he not? You need not kill the entire family, only a portion, string them up on the walls to see what happens to those who betray.” V: you are correct my liege “You are a fair king. I only expect you to kill half of the families that betray me V: if it’s to ensure there’s no uprising then it shall be done “Tunseel will live forever V: so it shall my liege “There is the other issue at hand. Dasa, i believe by right you are my familiar now.” D: i am???? Could i have a moment. Viktor is he not ur master??? “I am viktors great grandsire.” (the king will def understand messages in the demi plane if he can see you) (legal and magical issue with his claim. The sheer fact that he is the queen consort, until he becomes a true god he doesnt have ownership over her stuff. He is, by legal definition, the consort.) R: he doesnt have ownership? (it will piss him off if brought up.) R: find an approach that isnt telling him no? (explain that he cant claim dasa until he reaches true godhood) Grits his teeth “I’ll be sure that when the time comes, i will claim him.” “Viktor. Yurei. Would you like to lead the men against brazenthrone and claim it? Better yet, kholeran, you could become queen of brazenthrone. The very nation that sent you into undeath, would be yours to rule for eternity.” K: thats a long time “You may kill yourself at any point, or allow yourself to be slain by a stronger throne. Its yours to rule for as long as you wish for as long as you have the power.” K: what was the question “Whether you would like to rule brazenthrone.” K: no thank you “You could choose to maek the death penalty, youd have so much food.”
But bbygirl we have to find the runes, we need kholeran to track our quarry “What would you do indeed. (to constantin) find me a worthy one, a dwarf we can corrupt. We will not be able to siege brazenthrone with our might alone.” “If thats all, i have war to prepare for. You can continue on your quest to find the runes.”
Teleport to flamhaltn The people here, as we exit the ballroom, stare at viktor and bow “How may we serve you?” V: whats happened? “The revolts, your advisor has tried to institute democracy. He has instituted rules by which the nobles will be stripped by land and title, this has caused widespread protest.” V: ill speak with him
Abgast is sitting in the quarters, does stand but doesnt bow “Welcome back.” V: unrest with the nobles “There has.” P: how have you been fairing? “Better. I’ve explained and sent out letters explaining that the only ones who benefit are the only the nobles themselves. Even the soldiers would have better employ and prospects.” P: just the nobles? “A few people. I dont want to execute the commonfolk. I dont know how to say this without sounding like a monster. It is mostly the noble children that are given the most problems. A few have demonic power, executing entire squads.” P: what kind of powers? “We’ve only had a few survivors, but convincing soldiers to kill each other.” Names? Gives a long list
“The new Feucreux has been at this for a while.” All were given a doll at one point. P: which is the 16 year old?
“Milo ir'Scipio.” P: we think we might be aware of the one responsible, we will go see what we can do without killing a bunch of children, that they might already be…” P: anything else troubling you? “Outside of the standard issue of nobility vs common folk and the war and the winter being harsh, especially following the war. The lack of literacy and education provided to the commonfolk (lists other issues), no.” P: we have a lot of reform to do. Dasa can help with that. Hallway P: so how did u get the ability to move. Window? (Medical coma occasionally woken up to be put under again.) (for rosalind, there are forces preventing the soul from working together. We could bring back others to their bodies if we can)
Teleporting to Kurociel God we had to swim so much Hi we have the vassal king + old king’s wife + feeble advisor (rosalind), rest Disguise as guardsmen
Noble house ir'Sepiu Estate is a happy family, including 3 children (one is the one that we know of), dad speaks as the primary head of the house “Pleasure to meet you mr keson and ms philomine”
“You seem to have interrupted the Ensilene time of peace. And this change that goes by your V: We have come under the belief/information that your child has been speaking in your name. Some concerning information has been passed to me “He is a soldier and fights for his house. You would not deny a nobleman the right to fight for his honor V: yes but if you would perhaps allow us to speak to him? He has been sickly recently? “Not recently. It has been 3 years since the last incident Rosalind does aura sight on the teenager Hostile, concerned for his family, excellent physical health Appears to be a doctor Child “I had kindroth syndrome, i was blessed by dr feucreux. He is protecting the nobility against the insurgents that go against your name my lord. V: Could we stay for the night? Lets us Viktor sneaks around, finds the doll in a glass case in the noble son’s room. Posed with medical scalpels, performing surgery on the other doll Dasa takes the doll and flies away to the next city over
