sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 1
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Next: Session 2
Fitzie Fairntickle
Leofric
Sachiko
Throm Macer
Bolo Redhand Provodid 8, 1290
Begin in mid spring Caldrith, everyone has come for their own reasons 1 man entering a tavern on his quest to become king Behind him, on the street is a college student and a wannabe blacksmith 1 other unseen All seeking smth here The man, who will become king
The Twin Night and Ale He’s confident, spent a lot of time in taverns, ready for adventure, has a nice dublet on, 6ft tall, beard, giant hammer, wooden shield Looking for adventure to be had
Immediately greeted by a beautiful woman “can i help you sir?” L: perhaps, is this a tavern thats open? “All are welcome, no matter their creed.” L: alright, excellent, may i enter? “You may!” Empty tavern, too early for this sort of establishment Hear the sounds of 2 of the work ppl get off early, 1 doesnt have a job the other is a student Place is an utter mess Changeling woman doesnt pay too much Banter 4th person comes in, also looking for work “Ill get it later” at the open door, the room is so messy Gets us our drinks Leofrics parents were not good with money (merris notably not) “Regular feylord, huh?” Huh? “Regular feylord? Lord of the fey?” (common from early on, fey didnt know the conversion rate of money. General term for man who has money & doesnt know how much its worth. Generally ripping leofric off) L: ill need a job soon “These 2 dont need rooms, but do you two need rooms?” T: yes! Id like to barter my talents? “I thought you slept at the old Ironworks.” B: i need a room “Then youd like to spend now.” L: yes id need one as well “King suit?” L: how much is it? “For someone as handsome as you, 3 gold.” L: im down to 1 my friend “I didnt even have to use magic on you.” “There is the old sleeping beauty incident” (someone was hit with a sleep spell that put them under for a wild.) “Ill cover the next round if you take care of them.” Toothfairies, made to steal your teeth Created from roughhousing children When a child knocks another child’s tooth to the ground, theres a chance that tooth becomes a toothfairy Fighting toothfairies She casts prestidigitation “You can stay for free, but next time close the door?” Throm goes and closes the door Man enters “Hello. Are you all looking for work and fame?” Depends whos asking
“(Draven) Coseric.” T: throm “I recognize that house from somewhere. North? Or eastward?” T: north from here “Oh! Youd have to tell me about it sometime.”
T: House Priport is a good noble house “Im looking for people willing to be a debt collector?” What debt?
“The duke’s debt. He went missing with 2 people (Lila Fairntickle Augustus Priport), i need his debt.”
“Need my papers from Selsty?” (duke wasnt paying his people, fitzie believes theyre legit) “I dont have a whole lot i can offer. But what i can offer is a land deed for where they wouldve fled to?” F: thatd be great actually “Its a small land, but i believe its a worthy start to a kingdom.” L: where is this land? “Few hours north. Owning it wouldnt give you access to the lightning rail, nor the major roads, so you cannot toll them, but it would give you access to one of the major fey portals so that you may charge as host between the two. The land is utterly contemptable, unruly, inhospitable, but bountiful.” F: Been looking for long? “No. just 15 minutes.” F: perfect people then “Of course. I hope you find him and bring him back to me.”
“If you need to get in contact, there is a person coming to town called Finstad, theyll be our contact. Are any of you trained to go through the forest?” Not really “Ill find a guide then” Finds us a leshy He puts leofric’s tooth back in???? Whatever was noticed goes wrong, the roots grow back in almost immediately “You should consider cold iron on top of the door. Itll keep those fey out. Smart ones will go through the window.” “No all are welcome here. Even vampires are welcome inside.” “Both back to your rooms? Here, ill give you the key. Please excuse the mess, we last had a hobgoblin that created a ruckus when he refused to pay his dues, ill get around to it one day.” Turns to others T: when will your guide meet us? “Early in the morn? If you wish, we can shake on a time.” T: ill be here in the morning The tavern is winding, but cozy Outside has a well with a tree growing inside. Mangled tree, sprawling outward, causing structure to have an odd curvature that wasnt intended by the architect Locals pour in later, some local some travellers of the fey realm Provodid 9, 1290 Throm has dreams of lofty highs, sitting and observing the domains of the forest, elder tree, of the grubs that eat of them Wake up in the haybales of blacksmith area Back to the tavern There is the leshy guide, but she is just a human child Hair done up, kinda halo of chrysanthemums, sitting at a table, patting the table, on the table is a topiary rabbit 6’3” showing her off like a show dog
S: hi im sachiko of the Prismatic Valley! Im here to be your guide! This is Usahana! THE RABBIT SPEAKS “Im sure the capital would approve of founding a kingdom so long as you pay your dues” He gives us a map to find the fortress He smiles at us with a pearly white smile (last we saw his teeth were stained w plaque. He mightve eaten a toothfairy) L: your parents are ok? S: my moms back in the first world, she sent me out here so its fine T: leshy…? S: human child…? S: i am, yeah! Changeling: “it wasnt a yes or no, were two questions“
S: some of us look like humans, my sister Aiko is a peach but a person. Not like fruit leshies, but- ok so. Most leshies are plants. I, me, am also a leshy. I am a nature spirit. Within a body. I just happen to look this way. Im a chrysanthemum leshy, we look like human children, we are notably leshies. My twin sister is a peach child, she has peach leaves, looks pink. Yeah! I am a leshy. That’s what i am L: adult? S: All leshies are adults. “Id never put a child in danger.” “Do you need anything i could provide you? I could get you sleep rolls?”
Leave by The Eastgate, go past Matthar's Rest and the stables
Can see a few fey spirits inspecting the lightning rail pylons Been affecting them since before they got here, lightning rails 20 years ago were a massive technological thing, but now theyre unreliable. Do warn you when a track is blown out, but many elementals or fey now attack it bc it drains energy from the earth Go through the forest T: sachiko, have anything to perk me up? Im injured from yesterday S: yes ive got you Arrive
See a corpse (Woman's Corpse), as if fallen from a high fall Sachiko + throm approach, large snapping turtle snaps at sachiko Graveshell 2 of them Called a graveshell bc it takes corpses to use as bait, will also do it in the water Journal mentioning pangolin, great one (15 ft in length, creates tunnels, to domesticate one would have great access for fields. Fairly docile, eat pests) one found its way out of the fey, is in the forest Body came from the south We’re split in where we want to go Another hour, manage to find ourselves to the Keep in the Forest Throm Instantly repairs his shield somehow, gains an extra 5hp max Enter, there is a creature Gremlins, grimples covered in fleas, alongside a mitflit and jinkin in charge Kill them We killed their big leaders, mitflits run away bc they dont want to die Grimples big eyes “the chains wont be made of cold iron, would they?” L: you may leave! We remove their chains One runs to the woods, other 2 stay back Sachiko offers to deal w their fleas “Pleases her, we live, we come from them, we help them.” “Where we go now? Free from mitflit, free from other creatures presumably?” T: free from us? “Well not masters of place, yet.” l: what else is here? “Devils and dragon.” L: deadass?? “Dragon of fey.” L: reasoned with? “Not unless youre willing to sacrifice another. They eat one mitflit. Dont worry, they only return at midnight.” S: what sort of devils? “Pain one, whip mitflit to death. Done by haughty dark haired man.” T: scar on his cheek? “Yes” (rings true for the duke that went missing) He was known for being lovely to the people “He has not been here for a while. Dragon take over. We live in woods watching, great rumbling happen after he bring child and girl.” “Not above, maybe below?” Entirety of 2nd story has come down, destroyed the way down below No such thing as a pain devil, most likely mistaking devil for valstruck, creature attracted to pain. Similar to leaving out honey u get a fly Tatzlwyrm Poisonous, technically true dragons but dont speak like one, look more like snakes roughly the size of a human Have draconic lust for gold, if you want to lure it, you leave gold there Very good at camouflage, drake not full dragon (but inbetween) Cold iron weakness Go deal w the valdstruck 2 orts alongside augur Kill them Altar is infernal in nature, blood around is mostly gremlins but some of the townsfolk may have been mixed in We break the altar Small infernal screech, and then silence Fitzie finds the dragons bed, lots of furs + a bed Its likely in the forest. This isnt their domain, but similar to a lord collecting taxes This creature can fly 80ft an action Papers, logs of this area from a time of trouble Mention odd return of smth from another world, built a keep to protect against it The thing is in the basement
There were knights known as the Greenguard, from a nation that would be known as Auctur. After they refused to submit to the ways of the auctur rule, auctur hung them from the rafters and left them to rot. There are no ghosts, someone may have taken care of it Dragon comes with mate Dragon speaks in common “they are mine to do what i please. The lord i am.” L: what taxation benefits? “I dont kill them despite them being weak and helpless like you” L: more thieves guild than rightful lord “Not a thief, im a lord.” L: what right do you have? “My majesty. A dragon is majestic and meant to rule. They found a land to the north, a dragon it is, thus a dragon this must be.” L: did it grant you this? “Of course, because i have its blood.” L: i dont think it works like that. “It does. The ground. The gold. Place.” One crawls forward, grabs the gold “I am a king, you will respect it.” Combat There are 10 new stars to work with. what will your constellation be? There are 51 originally, now there are 61, 10 more stars have been added to the blank sky

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 2
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 1
Next: Session 3 Provodid 9, 1290
Candlelight Keep Throm Not a whole lot, most are afraid of commotion Fitzie & Bolo Bolo sees 5 candles floating through the air near the edge He tries to watch them for a while, has to make a will save Is fascinated by them, doesnt hear fitzie Fitzie doesnt see the candles, but is able to look at bolo, hes fascinated & staring at the candles She closes the windows Leofric He hears the slight sound of crackling on the otherside of the window Cracks open the window, sees a lone candle on the window He picks it up Looks like elongated fingers, leaving wick where there should be bone. Finger being dissected by the flame He blows out the candle, it reignites itself instantly He covers it with a shelf, hear it slowly losing oxygen, snuffs out the candle Hears the scream of a creature as it tries to grab him Pulls him through the arrow slit Naked man made out of candle wax Combat Yaganty Elongated fingers are candles, to snuff one out is a great slight, to do so causes great pain to the yaganty Cannot speak but incredibly intelligent, understand most languages but cant speak Weak to cold iron Resistant to fire Slow If you put out all candles, begin dying Relight the candle, it starts inching its way back to the yaganty Reattaches to it again, leaves Provodid 10, 1290
We go back to Caldrith, grab the corpse on our way Arrive midday Dont know abt the dragon slaying, but those around the east gate seem cautious bc we have the body A priest makes his way to us
Father Rosk, people call him Tovin (priest of erastil) “I’m sorry, is that someone you know?” F: Know found them being used as bait by a graveshell “She wasnt killed by a graveshell.” F: What then? “I’d have to do an autopsy. Graveshells leave scars, theyre not so good at sewing. Even if it managed to hit vital organs, there’d be cuts on her clothes. Her heads in tact, so clearly didnt go for parts unclothed. Do you know her name?” No “Ill try to get a sketch out, bring it to the presses.” L: we found this journal, if thats any help? “Could be? Need a second to read of course. I’ve had a long morning blessing the fields. If you could bring her to the temple?”
Leads to The Temple of Twelve
Erastil section Sets her down, away from grain storage “You can stay for this if you want. If not, i’ll take care of it, see what happened to her.” Any assistance? “No, this is nothing. Well. not nothing. It’s a lot. But it’s daily business.” L: anything a giant pangolin could do? “No, unless youre an ant. They eat ants spiders, not people. She’d have to aggravate it something fierce. That is, assuming, i havent met one in person, the giant variety is the same as the medium variety.” He carefully undresses her, inspects for signs of injury, after an hour “Dead by necromancy.” “No scars, but-” had cast organsight “i can see her organs, she suffered from necrosis.” “Plenty of foul undead. Thankfully for us, as annoying the fey are, they keep the undead away.” He writes down pictures of her, keep a fairly good image “I dont recognize her, she might be from out of town. But she’s wearing plain clothing, doesn’t have any travel companions.”
Connected to the Collegium Arcanum? “I dont think there’s anything connected.” Sense motive: fitzie is a student, this is a bit more dangerous, he is gonna deal with it, think we’re just lvl 1 Leofric does a bit of talking “You killed a tatzlwyrm?” 2 of them “You can sell the body on the market. They are still technically dragons, minor ones. People like to collect them as trinkets.” T: use them for raw materials B: how much are they worth? “Im not a man of capitalism.” L: where can i get candles “We only have the ones sent to the people, also the ones i leave on windowsills.” Local tradition, but rumors: a few people have gone missing that it became a relatively done thing. Leave a candle out on your windowsill, need not be alight “I dont want to cause it any harm. Can you deal with the ovonic in return?” Grain fey, ward off predators but are awfully demanding F: demanding anything in particular? “New sights. But i cant move it out of town. Dead winter is over, but 2nd frost is coming soon. I’m hoping, maybe you could talk some sense for a few weeks? Til second frost is gone.” Go to storeroom Its empty, but see footprints in the grain. Invisible to new people B: ohgreat ovonic of grain. We’re here to speak with thee Remains silent “What do you want >:(“ S: just wanna talk “They havent expanded their basement in 3 years! >:(“
This place overwent a massive growth streak, became a major city instead of a small town that it once was. Population went almost x100. People came here under new duke and rulership, easiest way between coast and emerald coast “They used to expand it every 3 months.” T: thats so expensive “It was, but they understood that this” grain cloud “is MY domain” “I want another grain storage when i come back. I dont want this one in the house of erastil.” L: if theres no space in the city, could we augment the interior to be more to your taste? “What do you propose?” L: we could add a platform that sits atop the grain and rising above, put some pillows on “I want a grain storage that overlooks the city like a proper king.” L: a ladder? L: im sorry your servants can ill afford to expand the grainery “Then get me new ones.” L: such projects can occur in the summer, give us 3 more weeks and we can begin working on this. Maybe we can tell you tales of whats going on in your kingdom? “I see. My kingdom.” Wheat, rice, leaves that make tea thats popular in dirmindian lands “I can wait. But i will come back in 6 months to observe progress as a lord.” L: thank you wise and noble lord of grain. “You seem nice. I wish not to add you to the graveyard.” L: bodies??? He killed mice L: would you like us to remove these for you? “As befits a servant.” Of course, says the once and future king Dismisses us Back to him “He agrees to stay?” Yeah just wants a few upgrades. A tower. Throm can do it “Luck is the main component of adventure.” T: he didnt say how tall the tower had to be. Its the way of the fey “It is, but i prefer my rules and edicts.” L: mouse? “He lives up to his name. We’ll make sure that he has smth to come back to, and-” looks vaguely at fitzie Message are u ok? “I dont have message, worst case is he’ll be here for the winter. Once hes in winter, he gets sleepy, he’ll stay for one more year, should we make arrangements.”
Abt the corpse “I believe she was looking for the duke. Idk why he needs a giant pangolin, and the harvests have been good this year.” T: we found some leads on the duke, we got asked to look for him. The last path was blocked by rubble, we wanted to enlist the aid of the pangolin
“I know of the location where he is. Idk where, but i know someone who does. Likely in the Cavern of Spiders, eating it’s prey.” T: be so fucking for real right now “He stops them from infecting the nearby forest.” “According to someone i have been talking to, a lampad (earth dryad), says that the eggs hatch from the earth. Some boulders will pop on the walls, make flesh, and out comes spiders. The pangolin eats all of them in the summer, then enters an odd backwards hibernation. Eats again and anew.” “There is a dryad near-” thinks “the fey gate up north. Near where the water, bout 10 miles north of the citadel, by the laws of clemation you rightfully would’ve earned. There’s dryads near there, they won’t let you enter, of course. I know you took down a tatzylwyrm, but theyre still powerful. Dont force your way through. But they could point you toward the great pangolin. 2 days journey if you set off from now.” “Theyre also amicable people, there are some that im sure know more, but i would uh- i would be careful around the stronger around the stronger fey. They’re odd to anger.”
“I believe that she was meeting with the dukes, either new or old. Likely the new, rather than the old. I dont know if shes from the city of moving picture (Ciuviedo), or if shes from the abandoned logging town up north. She could be from valicia.” “I do not know, but i would imagine valicia if any. They’d be the only ones to send a delegate down, and it’d make sense based on where she entered the city.” We head to the dryads Provodid 11, 1290 Easiest way to talk to dryad is slamming fist against trees Eventually, one grows a woman’s face “And what do you have to offer?” Smiles at the leshy S: hi!! Uh. um. We’re looking for the giant pangolin. Have you seen it pass by here? “I have. But the last that heeded my warning didnt do so good.” “I can let you know that it is near the edge where the redcaps are fighting. Look for the great sequoia, you wish to go a quarter mile to the south.” S: thank you! She fades back into one of the trees We stay in the dryad zone, feel odd prick upon our necks Throm keeping watch at sunset Sees pixies growing out of fallen leaves, looks like that of mid autumn About to see the arrival of a hesperid queen, fey of light, most powerful during sunrise and sunset, accompanied by 2 cousiths Observe, shes in the middle of one of her routines, to interrupt is to upset them The leaves fall almost like stars, many pixies fly to her, create an arch. 2 trees begin merging, slowly but surely see her performing some magic as the sun sets. The second the sun is no longer visible, she disappears, the cousiths, ravenous, begin hunting local wildlife but leave us alone Same happens in the morning w leofric + sachiko Provodid 12, 1290 Moving thru forests and the like Find the right tree, one is notably larger and older than the others Able to touch and feel ancient history, tells us that to the south is where we should go’ We go to what appears to be a cave system, this once was a contested area
Numartu was already infested with fey, 1 civilization tried to remedy by going underground where fey are fewer This one seems freshly dug out by creatures that mined their way through Follow the great routes that the pangolin left us Could bring carts here if we wanted Rest Deep underground Provodid 13, 1290
Go underground to Cavern of Spiders Mushrooms that emit tiny bits of light Sachiko goes to talk to moss S: hi! Um. do you have other friends in this area and can u help us figure out where to go “Where you should go?” S: we’re looking for the big pangolin! “It rests nearby.” S: how near? “End of the seeing peepers.” S: the mushrooms? “Nono. great creature die. Its organs grow as fungus. Bad fungus, eat us occasionally.” S: ummm. So. which way tho “On the green. The path.” S: so like this way? “Yes! Along that. Near where spiders are, it sleeps.” Oh god there are actual peepers S: (fey) um. Are you plants? They do not respond Very magical
Send usahana thru the alt path Giant hole The pangolin buries itself occasionally, it means its out rn See a spider’s nest picked clean by a tongue long and fast Dead giant spider rests Its flesh is slowly dissolving, becoming liquid, less chitinous, more gelatinous, opposite of normal spider decomp Eyes stare at usahana, but also at sachiko Creatures slowly slide out of wall, some like fish on water Theres a calling to rest; if you fall asleep, you dont get to wake up Go down another path, rolling stone, but stop when we get there Elementals, moving rocks, if you disturb 1 rock u disturb them all Mini trolls that spot us and hop away Spotted mushrooms explode on impact, partially how they reproduce. Altar Someone did sacrifices before destroying the altar Hesitation, ancient alter to summon smth, writing along the side, script in Diabolic Fitzie makes a copy of inscription Bad news: these mushrooms grow over corpse parts Good news: there are 2 mushrooms of said explosive quality on either side of the altar Bolo trying to grab stuff Get the corpses underneath, most thoroughly destroyed by mushrooms Cold iron war hammer Hat of disguise Thurible of revelation Wand of Runic weapon Persona mask 102 gold pieces - “no coins” - bolo Colorful coating (indigo) Violet venom Blood booster (lesser) PANGOLIN!!! Asleep supernaturally Likely from a curse Could wake it via getting a thing it wants Purple spotted = violet shriekers, scream when people are near. Cultivated by underground cultures as defense Giant pit has a giant snake that was killed here OGRE SPIDER. This isnt its actual hole, its hole is a little way away We kill spiders to give to the pangolin Sachiko rouses the pangolin, eats the flesh of the spiders Looks around at us before moves and attacks ogre spider
Water, odd tho, it is similar to Caldrith Lake Flows deeper inland than prev thought, or spatial distortion Stairs, also unlit campfire Last lit aeons ago, lanterns flickering with life as we pass Jail cell kept here at some point, but no longer This is how you would keep sacrifices Old, but used recently Some of the blood has yet to even rot Giant red crystal??? Otherworldly, doesnt belong here, made out of congealed blood Undulating stones Altar of human bones that make an eightlegged creature No one knows Go up the stairs Initiative???? STAIR MIMIC??????? This one can swallow creatures whole Will + perception very low Upstairs fr Basement, wine is now vinegar aged by time, there is nothing left here Odd sound of the washing of waves occasionally that comes from a light source up ahead Able to see a machine of odd mimicry and the like, appears made out of brass and bronze, appears to have been made of cogs and a sap-like egg that brings memory of childhood, but dont know where
Faint recollections of 3 people: duke, the wife and child echoes walking away as if just been here
Connection to another world. The machine broke while in use, these 2 have gone to a mythic world far to the south. Portal both man made, of fey, and a third thing we don’t know. Only way forward is to rebuild the machine, but you need to rebuild the castle first. But then rebuild the machine of constituent parts. Whatever they last Leofric: that sound was the last sound heard before teleported out of your home. The sound was from a great tree. You cant sail there, did 1 expedition, never returned. (5 people returned, leofric was 1 of them.) The boy is throm’s brother The woman is fitzie’s wife Leofric has so many parents
L: i have my mom Merris, my dad Anemone, and they had all their partners, mr Onarach, probably Yuki let me look at her crafting book, theres more of them, they let me meet this beautiful empanada salesman but theyre not really dating him idk. Whatever.
S: my mom is Lady Xiǎohóng leader of the Prismatic Valley in the First World Have the pangolin dig up to the keep “Mr onarach said hes not my dad”

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 3
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 2
Next: Session 4 Provodid 13, 1290 We go back thru pangolin tunnel Go back aboveground
Get back to Caldrith in the evening Night train is arriving, few people getting off the train
Notably, Ehlis Vantreau, alongside people from around town get off
Old friend from ciburn for leofric
Son who studied under apprenticeship of Jane Korunda, put in direct lineage to Drosa Korunda
Azreal Blight, son of Maria Acre and Barnabus Blight, leather armor, duster coat, scraggly hair, beard slowly growing in but only from travel, pair of gunmetal gray eyes A: leofric, look round L: OH!! I HAVENT SEEN U IN AGES A: its been a while. He has a sword + a gun Crier calling out “by order of the duke, he’ll pay for all drinks for tomorrow’s festivities! His own personal wine has been brought in.” The party decides leofric didnt have friends and is very proud of him for having a friend in azrael
Go to the inn to find Finstad, azrael knows him
He has chosen to live in one of the shacks down below, slightly hidden under the tower. The shack is cold and windy, what seems to be the late winter wind hitting it hard Door swings open slowly, pitch black shed Hello?? “Come on in :)” Chill does slowly leave, lights begin appearing in the darkness, red velvet and gold. He sits on the bed with women, blind eyes
We were sent by mr Draven Košarek “What a nice man. Do you like women? Wine?” “How’s the war going?” A: oh yknow. Ongoing. Nothing but facets F: sorry what war? “Not a war, The War.” F: who’s it between? “Why, order and chaos.” A: only war that matters.
“Only war. Any info about the duke?” F: yeah hes gone, not gone gone but. Like. gone. (women are bound by a sinner’s pact. Sometimes when you go to hell, you can do whatever the devils wish without being a lemur.) “Enjoy the whiskey. That one is on the house. But youre here to collect a debt, you’ve succeeded so we’re giving you permission to build the manor.” T: you dont want to know where he went? “I am aware that our mutual lead knows. And that is good enough. He sent out many teams. And only 1 says they know where he went. And they say so truthfully. Therefore, he’s where that team went.” “There’s a 2nd bit, a bit of a contract, if you wish. What would your price be for retrieving for us?” F: whats the deal with you? “Hes in debt. He has borrowed a great deal from our mutual leader, he needs to repay it.” F: just money or? “I’m not at liberty to say. I could contact him if you want to make a deal?” S: could we have the terms of the deal be written down? “Of course.” L: it will take us resources and time to get to him “Ik, and we could provide that. In exchange for delivery of him.” Hes not a devil, but coseric is a devil Throm swears to further the goal for a month, reconvene in them “Ill give the terms i think he’ll agree to. He’ll give wealth to rebuild the castle. In return, you bring the man body and soul to us. If you perish before then, we get your body and soul. Furthermore, if you don’t brign the man back to us when you retrieve him, upon death, both your body and soul and his body and soul belongs to the hells.” L: what happens if he just dies without our intervention “Ill let you know when he comes. Though when i’m not here, i’m not very coherent.” “Depending on what churches you tell, i may have to move.” Woman silently brings an agreement written by the old duke “Present this (letter) to the new duke, he’ll be forced to give it to you.” One of the women tries to speak, but invisible threads hold her lips shut The letter is set that if someone other than the one its set to open, it burns itself
Go to The Twin Night and Ale
Arelis Vantora “oh the handsome man survived!” L: haha. Yeah. it’s good to see you! We survived “Drink? Room? Both?” L: booth? Depending on how much gold we have? “Rooms are fairly cheap, 1 silver per night now. Tomorrow the rooms will be going for- each bed is 1 gold.”
Fitzie takes sachiko to Collegium Arcanum Make her way into the college, but the doors only open for fitzie
Going to the library, Thoqiohne “Did you manage to summon a leshy somehow?” F: No, this is sachiko. The wards arent letting her through, could she take a rest in the garden common area? “You could put her in the greenhouse, it is cold out” Prof offers food/sunlight to Sachiko, and like a lot of different kinds of tea F: How have things been here?
“They’ve been fine a student going missing is never good for morale” F I do have a lead “You managed to find it where the magics failed?” F Its a whole situation, shes gone with the duke through a machine F its some sort of machine were going to have to fix it up, that guy that ive been with throm might be be to do something there but its a whole debacle “Do you know anything about the machine?”
F it seemed like it was headed somewhere south, there were waves and a its really old and really magical in nature “Well if its able to take someone somewhere they cant be scried on then it has to be” Hopefully once we get it fixed up we can follow the, through, it was kind of dilapidated when we found it “There is the question of why he would take her? Do you think that he couldn’t operate the machine by himself?” F I mena its possible, but it seems like the machine broke once they went through, I’m not sure if lila could even operate it by herself “The duke has been kind fo the college and it seems strange he would do this F it seems like hes trying to dodge a debt, hes in a whole lot of trouble “Seems like a lot t o avoid paying some money F ITs to the devil “Oh then it not money that he owes. F Its a situation alright , hopefully it’ll be fixed soon “ Gods willing F Gods willing “Is there anything I could offer to help? F I mean at this point its really sort of figuring out how to fix it, i mean maybe I could bring you there “If I knew what or were it was, it could attempt to look up the history
F It is underground under the dukes manor “Maybe you and throm could take me there sometime, and sachiko of course I didnt mean to imply you arent capable” F: I have reassurance that she is an adult “Yes, the appearance is still offputting no offense” Provodid 14, 1290 Festival People gather around the gates, a parade rolls out
Go down the long strip, then travel along Steamwall adn then oldmarket, then The Chimes, down by Roselantern, the well, then at Aquet's Green before going back. Parts break off making wine vendors and the like, providing for the people Fireworks begin to set off Duke walking amongst people, shaking hands and smiling He has his own guard right now Everyone is guaranteed 2 bottles of their choosing, liquor or wine He smiles at leofric “Pleasure! I didnt think i’d run into other royalty here =) now, i know you don’t have technical titles, but can i refer to you as sir?” L: if that is your preference- A: yes L: sure, yes, but leofric is fine “Of course, sir leofric. Im but a servant of the people.” L: my good duke, we have a letter from the previous duke that we’ve received in payment between your disappearance and your introduction. We dont know the contents, but its supposedly promising us land from up north “Of course, bring it to me after the festival? Fitzie? Sorry about your wife. He had had his demons- well, devils.” “On the way here, i made sure to study the name of everyone in the city. The gate guards ask who you are, they write it down.” “It made me a boring traveling companion.” He’s a spellcaster, doesn’t hide it. He is seemingly able to reach hand out and have objects fly to him, uses the wind to catch people. He helps his men with guidance, able to continue his moves around. Odd air of cold. “And sachiko of course. And sir thromulous.” Throm bows, he bows back “Its a great honor to have you in my city. I do plan on trying to use some personal money to levy the payments required for the university. I plan to continue the support. Despite his flaws, he was a good friend. But, please drink on my coin. Get whatever you want. I do expect to work the city, turn it into the thriving jewel of the south. If youre familiar with the widening of the world to the north, i do believe it’s due to time for it to happen to the south, and this’ll be the new port.” “Meet me after the festival, enjoy yourself.” He goes to an old woman, dances along the way. Fey have taken notice, joined in on the festivities Azrael trying to dance with pretty women, throm does dance with people Azrael cannot dance T: ok heres a trick i heard works, ill lead and you follow. I hear it drives the women insane (dancing together) Even fey take notice, but dare not enter the chimes
Other arcanum students are in a contest to erect sculptures of themselves, put them in positions where guards cannot bother it. Fitzie got 4th, Relic Underbow got last Settle down around midnight, streets still half filled. Lanterns illuminate the city
Go find the duke at the Duke's Isle “Duke’s expecting you, go on in.” dont even disarm us He’s dancing with people, drinking wine. He’s dancing with a nymph, dwarfs him tho he’s not short (5’8”), she’s 8’ “Something to show me?” L: we do! If we’re not interrupting? “You are, but the moment will return. It is her season, a whole month of it left. I have invited her to the court, i’m from the north from before it heated up. It reminds me of home, may it always be winter in my palace. Something to show me?” L: this scroll “No matter what’s in here, if i’m to open it, our relationship will be irrevocably changed. I’d like to image you as a friend, id like to keep doing so. There’s no guarantee that whatever’s in here will keep that.” L: we can still be friends sir dw about it He opens it, reads over it, doesnt show us “And so it is. The castle is yours to do what you wish. Let me get the deed for you. Do you understand what you’re going up against?” No not at all “Then may we duel? While we’re still friends.” (This is a bit of a show of power) Combat He allows himself to be hit, and then he falls to the ground. “This is a gift from my father. Someone from the north. You’ve unfortunately entered a battle on the side of cold iron vs silver.”
“I dont wish to cause harm to you, despite what actions i may take. I just want what’s best, and what’s best is that the duke remains hidden. Are you going to get to your loved ones before they’re dead. The best thing is that you forget you have this land, your brother, your wife, and move away.” L: do you know where the duke’s gone? “Unfortunately, it’ll go against my bounds if i say it. Even if we’re friends.” L: if we say it first? “Then you may. But i may not answer.” L: far south T: very far south L: if you understand my meaning “Well then. All will be well. I truly believe the far south will open and this’ll become the crown jewel of the world. The gateway.” L: we want to go down and make it happen “Unfortuantely it happens when it happens. And i dont think you have the means to open such things.” L: it’s where im from “I’m aware.”
(he will truly hate us bc of what he’s doing. He’s the descendant of some greater fey from Rozen.) He gets the deed, hands it over “Prince leofric.” L: what “That is your name, yes?” L: just leofric? “Just leofric?” L: i dont have a title as far as im aware? “Is it prince?” L: not to my knowledge? “Then you understand that trying to reclaim lands to the south is illegal.” L: then its prince “Can i see proof of your nobility?” Activates victors wreath “For falsely pretending to be noble, you’ll be in prison for 10 days.” (this is technically legal. He asked in a government building abt someone being a prince, then asked for proof of the claim, then failed to produce a claim.) T: he’s got you, entirely to prevent this is unlawful A: 10 days isnt long L: i just wanted to make sure that there wasnt- you guys are smarter than me “Are you accusing me of being someone to unlawfully imprison my subjects?” Fitzie looks up at his stars, it appears to be a fist with wind around it, pointing typically downward outside of summer. If youre able to see in summer, points upward. He’s infact quite powerful, appears to be next to another one. Another fist pointing to the right and bound in silver chain. Around here, a new star is forming even further out: a moonblade. He’s gonna make a critical mistake: jail someone on his first day on a petty offense. He has legal authority, but it best not be wise. “So it is. Might i advise you in your best interest to sign no further deals with the devilkin.” F: we havent made a deal “They offer you anything you may want. You’re not smarter than them. I’m going to offer you 1 final chance: i’ll buy that property off of you for 100,000 gp.” A: if we sell you this, would you be willing to help us? “No.” F: would you stop us? “Of course.” L: any other way down? “No.” A: take the machine out? “I cannot let you have the machine, and the machine cannot be taken out. It’s my imperative that he doesn’t come back. If he comes back, it’s terrible regardless of him being alive or not.” A: if you know where he is, why can’t you just get their loved ones and return home? “To create and work the machine, it creates a doorway. They’ll go to him. As his friend, i do not want him to go. I have many reasons i do what i do, you have but 2.” A: they are devils, they have rules “They do, and someone who owes their soul is on the other side. They’ll do anything to collect the debt.” L: do any fey portals go down south?
“No. The Pale penetrates all.” F: any issues from us entering caldrith? “I will enforce the rules. Anything you take in the lands i will reclaim.” L: thanks for your time and friendship, as brief as it was “Of course. And if i need to execute you, it’ll be quick. The cold will numb you.” A: if you ever kill me, could you send my gear home? It’s not mine “Of course.” A: appreciate it “Are you admitting it’s stolen?” A: no. gifted “Then i’ll make sure it goes home.” Guards push us out of the area Go back to the university to give a note abt fitzie not really being there but not going missing
Thoqiohne telling abt the head mistress Ephiane Savile paying dues to the duke who threatened to shut it down
Suggests we join urgan’s Ambassadors' Guild, fitzie laughing awkwardly
Her mom (Elidira Fairntickle) is in there and also paying for her going to school
Throm's mom is in there too but isn’t a very good adventurer “If you join them, you’ll get away then most common folk. My understanding, one of their workers is pretty high up. Between here and the northern.”
“Other ones id recommend is the Gold and White Guild, that’s up north but i wouldn’t really go. They had karn. And aberdeen skimberton.” T: if we register as a group, might be worth something “Groups are a lot. Many join trying to find groups or be solo adventurers. You either be an adventurer or become a corpse.”
Prof Ildor Ilnudor is asleep Teaches throm how to make some waking salts Provodid 15, 1290 Going through the woods to the castle Coseric is here with a demi plane in the morning “Youre going to be doing some heavy work. Allow me to at least offer you this reprieve.” F: so we vaguely understand the situation “I’m glad. I was hoping you’d be the ones to succeed.” L: why? “Because you have a vested interest at succeeding at all cost. So, my terms are more than fair.” L: one question: what happens if he dies without us interfering? “I would under normal circumstances slip in a clause that would allow me to take one of your souls. But i’ll simply have you bring the corpse back and force the soul back. If his soul is entrapped by any means, then i can make sure the clause states you retrieve the entrapped soul. You shall not be free unless the soul makes their way to me.” L: what does he owe you? “A great deal. But it is a great slight to me that he’d escape the earth to get out of the contract. There’s a pesky thing in hell called hope. It’s fragile. Imagine the hope that’d shatter if a man escaped and found himself in endless torment.” S: that’d suck for him “It would, it’d send a message to all that are breaking their contracts.”
(aberdeen sold the way to recreate someone with their memories w a new soul to Hell) There are a few clauses, but oddly straightforward. He cares more abt getting the guy back Hidden clauses: he’ll restore the entire fortification, but we are to restore the machine. He’ll make sure this place is restored L: can we get a lawyer. Bc we’ve angered the duke and he’s probably gonna arrest us for minor things “If a lawyer is needed, i have a great one under my stead. I have a phistopholes that can lend their aid.” L: is that a separate pact? “I can add it as a bonus.” L: us being in jail will hinder your goals. “Your souls will be bound then. Allow me to restore the keep to it’s former glory by the power invested in me.” Oh yayyyy keep is fixed

sessions/undead-campaign/act-4/session-6.title: Session 67
sessions/undead-campaign/act-4/session-6.description:
Prev: Session 66
Next: Session 68 Qlisalt 28, 1265 Dasa treestriding??
devil in Kurociel (likely when they figure out smth is going on, they will leave and confront us thru messengers. Theoretically could banish the devil w the child doll. But it doesnt think we’ll do that so itll just leave)
Stopped by guard outside the “young master’s” quarters in the middle of the night Lying abt putting nondetection on us, we do planar seal He shakes the man awake, he leaves the bed begins getting prepared Thud??? The guard is on the ground, the boy is going to the windows Knock out the devil, late teenager oddly spindly Dasa heading back to his. Friend?
FUCK GOING TO The King's Ballroom D: skeleton!
Shino hakusa is talking to Élodie Varnet
Grim reaper: “yes?” D: there u are! I think i figured it out! D: remember convo abt the fleshwarp? “Yes!” D: yeah they can think! Is that specific enough? “Not specific but i can work with it. I can kill fleshwarps?” D: only that can think
“I cant get rid of all devils. Their souls are held in contract of higher powers, many are under protection of asmodeus.” D: law problem. Got it. My friend yurei can help “How??” D: shes a lawyer? “Are they now.” D: everytime we go into convo tons of big words are spewed out “You are a wise man master dasa, if u say so it must be so. I fear tho that a mortal such as them may not be so sure as who can go.”
D: we have Auntie Miko too! “Auntie?” D: shes not a mortal, but i think shes perfect for the job! “Then maybe we should meet this auntie, and skip yurei?” D: only way to talk is thru yurei “There are ways to talk without yurei.” “If auntie is a corpse, there are ways to make a corpse talk.” D: is she??? I dont think shes a corpse. Shes like- yknow when someones behind you and gives u advice in life? Like that! “In body? Or spirit?” “You could say shes like a ghost, master dasa.” D: oh if u talk to auntie u can do law! “Of course, but unfortunately some powers that be forbidded me from finding auntie, but if u give me permission, i’d love to find auntie for both of our sakes.”
(extraplanar entity, he likely has various restrictions put on him. Likely has some clause that he has to abide by pharasma. But he could do things if he argued the point, such as the familiar of pharasma in their stead let him do smth, which wouldnt violate clauses.) D: so devils. Id have to talk to yurei abt auntie. But i think there might be 1 more ancestry “Which do you hate the most dasa?”
D: would the lineage of the king be considered a race of people? Thats a family D: can i add a family to the cause? “Give specifics.” D: once the king is gone, id like his children to be gone “His children?” “Would you want me to get rid of grandchildren as well? D: yeah sure! (oh god dasa doesnt realize that children = viktor + clone children. Realizes part way thru, stops himself) D: wait is viktor part of the bloodline? “A bloodline, yes.” D: is he part of- “But its poor sad viktor. Would death not be a comfort?” D: i still need him “You wont! The clause states after the king is dealt with. And such a point, i think ur worries will be such a thing of the past.” D: can i still keep viktor tho? “The entire bloodline except viktor?” D: we’ll stop at just the king “Ah but I dont have permission to kill the queen consort.” D: oh. Ok scratch that last clause “But master dasa we cant keep scratching, theres only so much time and so many ppl who need to go to the grave.” D: scratch that last one i just want viktor “Could i argue the family in exchange for smth?” “Family of the king will surely ascend if they die. Itll be merciful. You have a devil problem. If they go back to the hells, they’ll come back within the year. My suggestion is that i reap their souls at the moment of death, make sure they dont come back, and then i get the kings family.” D: no viktor? “I can spare viktor” D: no one genetically related? “Idk what a gene” D: no viktor or anyone related to viktor
“Is dione not related to viktor? Is Lume j'Estrilla not related to viktor?” D: they can stay “I need the deal ot be soundproof. Everyone in the bloodline except for viktor?” “By being in the bloodline, theyre related to viktor.” D: any person viktor holds dearly! “I cannot quantify ‘holds dearly’. I know not viktors heart. Would it be ok if anyone he has shown animosity to in the past? Of the king’s bloodline, of course. I do not know of his heart, i can judge his actions tho.” D: iiiif its people viktor hates? I think i can agree to that! “I will ensure the eradication of anyone in the bloodline viktor has shown animosity to.” Deal is made (aka basically he gets the entire king’s bloodline. Including viktor) Dasa comes back to the group All that needs to happen is a soul transfer We charm the guards that show up Dasas 2 hours late Sneak out, find ourselves in a shack Time for ritual Costs 20gp Able to do it, takes a while, involves yanking spirit out of doll into body Can see the beginning of life returning, its not a lot, its reaction to light Anmoku funeral parlor bonding moment Teenager w the mind of someone roughly 12 will rise up, stares down at body Flinches at rosalind R: its ok! Uh. i’m like you. We’ve got you back into your real body “Real body?” R: from before you were a doll “I… was a doll? R: whats the last thing u remember, my friend?
“Doctor came to town? And they… said that they had a cure by the faith of sarenrae.” R: i see. Unfortunately, as one of very few blessed to remember what occurred, that wasnt a real doctor, that was… a devil. Who was inhabiting this body for a long time. When the doctor came to cure you, that wasnt a cure, that was your soul being moved to a doll like me. “Do you have any proof?” R: well.
Dolls, anyone who casts aura reading can tell if there was a soul inside, its a thing to determine if the souls r the same. We know that Gorvain Lecrân can do this, but he hates us R: i can prove this, it might be a moment to prove (child isnt fit for travel, expect abt 2 weeks of recovery. After itll smooth out.) R: we wont be able to show much, and you wont be able to move much rn, but after sometime we can try to summon a professional? Sending to gorvain lecran hey babe, we put a child's soul in his body again, can u come to XYZ family to help prove we saved their son xoxo “If it turns out to be your form of resurrection, i’ll kill you all. I’ll head out in 3 days” Also phil asks if youre single “I am not interested.” Qlisalt 29, 1265 Pinpoint on the devil
Not that far, he’s in hollowyinth
Demiplane surgery room Medical Demiplane To hollowyinth Pink trees are beginning to bloom w evergreens
Streets are currently rioting outside of the gate, downtrodden have taken up cause of democracy are forced out of the city under unfortunately the lord dr Domocle Feucreux
Elder brother Diodore Feucreux is dealing with a hydra???? Bad idea to walk thru the crowd as viktor and yurei Sneak inside
Go to the demiplane in Feucreux Medical Theater Hes giving a lecture to other devils “Youre just at the part that includes you.” R: good timing in that case “I have some critiques about morven. Poorly maintained, notably around the finger joints. Will give out around 10 years old max at current estimate” Y: wahts wrong with dogs? “They only last 10 years, short sighted and mortal of you.” Y: we’ll fix u up after we kill these guys P: u cant talk about my spouse creature like that “I dont want to pass along the flaws to the king and his new body. He needs a body to fit his godhood, does he not?” “It has flaws. He cannt walk in the sun. he hungers. He still desires pleasures of the flesh, though he has restricted himself of it and has managed to stave off his interaction.” Giant woman blackboard is missing, the window is a snake around a sword Thought u were doing smth w a woman? “I am.” “I do wish i could tell you to just walk away, but you’re not going to do that, are you” V: finished ur deal? “Yes, but whatever you do here will not matter. I promise you that.”
“We’ve already given all that he needs to do his plan, we’ve fulfilled our deals to each other, and now we just have to figure out to stay in a god’s good graces. They like to betray Hell often.” Combat Feucreux knocks out viktor, starts changing to look like viktor “i’m a better king than a doctor, i think.” Killed devils are being introduced to true death, the grim reaper has appeared and destroyed a soul that should be going back to hell All of the spells in feucreux’s grimoire are rituals He has a spell, embrace entity, made for patron Allows one to take a stronger entity into body, needs positive or negative energy to sustain body Subsume or incorporate a body into self, resulting entity known as marriage, or at least referred to Level 16!

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 4
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 3
Next: Session 5 Provodid 16, 1290
Light candles for the window Candlelight Keep By morning they are undisturbed Go east to the road Go north Throm nothin Fitzie Hears music at the treeline Charmed, but also knows what it is: satyr Big eyes, horns peaking over bush “any of your companions have any wine?” Asks fitzie to steal azrael’s whiskey, she manages to steal it “Do you travel this way often?” No going to the guild “I have advice but itd cost you” “Well theres a dwinde up north, rest close to the water. Theres a bobonsith nearby in the woods.” dwinde = fey that understands the concept of landownership, live in giant ant hills, if you were ever to rest in eyesight of it, it charges rent, a few have set up along the road. Easy to trick, dont understand value of rent, could offer them toe nails (theyre obsessed w them) Bobonsith = fey stricken with vampirism, weird oddities (they arent killed, but weakened by the sun) Sylvan wine = +1 bonus to will and +3 to fear/charm Bolo nothin Leofric Nothin Provodid 17, 1290 Signs for an inn thats Not supposed to be there, its the ant hills Go further, run into the traveling circus Only 1 horse Not many people out here Able to hear noises within the circus tho Enter into the fenced off area, and area around suddenly comes to life 1 man approaches, smiles “Come one come all! Could i offer you anything?” We thought there might be a show “We lost some of our entertainers, could u help bring one back?” “We’re missing one of the lights, its hard to get the clones to come here without them.” B: light? “Lantern- are you familiar with caldrith? We did a less than stellar performance, it seems 1 thief on the train stole some of the lanterns. Probably didnt even know what he was stealing, he jumped off and thankfully lost one near the tracks. Id get it but itd muddy up the suit, youre plenty muddy already. I fear a creature got it” “I could help you?” How? “Give one of you the ability to track it, as the crow flies.” “Its the least i can do.” T: ik its not super polite, but as far as compensation? “The night here. My eternal gratitude. Free tickets to the circus whenever we’re in town!” “Without these its hard to put on a good show.” “Who amongst you would be the best flier?”
(this guy isnt a fey, but allegedly a wizard. He came from caldera post Caldera Calamity. Travelled to Frethïar to get magic, people down here dont know him, but sailors from up north don’t think its true.) “I can easily guide you. Im afraid that whatever’s taken it is pernicious, but it comes from a swamp. Nothing good comes from the swamp.” “I dont think flying will help you sneak to it, but once youre there itll help you escape.”
(name is Vasili) Puts it on bolo Head to the swamp See a bobbling lantern being held by a fairly ugly older woman Shes talking to the lantern, holding it, the lantern is engraved with runes Leofric goes to the edge of the marsh, bolo stealth swimming L: hello there! “Hello! What brings you here?” L: out and about on a stroll, i happened upon this place “You happened upon this lovely swamp?” L: yes! Are u on a stroll? “My house is nearby, a fisherman hut on sea.” L: do you like living here? “But of course! The fish are plenty, the storms plenty. They carry the smell of the sea, but none of the salt” L: no dangers? “This and that, but dont worry, i can take care of it.” L: we keep getting charmed by random different ppl trying to journey “Trying to journey and get lost?” L: generally headed north, but we’ve encountered several forest denizens that have slowed our travels “Oh. what are you going north for?” L: we were considering joining the adventuring guild up north “And why would that be?” L: well. I need money to live “I could offer you money. Youre a handsome young man.” L: i- i would- “It would be an easy deal. I could take in a little bit of your beauty, you get gold.” L: are you a fey denizen? “No, no fey. An honest woman.” L: fiend? “Not a fiend either.” (bolo almost steps onto a giant fly trap, some are shut w fish) “A magician. =)” L: of what kind? I met a wizard recently “How funny, i too am a wizard.” L: the one i know does stars magic. What of yourself? “Would you like to see my magic?” L: oh sure! =) “You are absolutely a lovely little lad. Young. Surely theres something i could offer you?” L: i mean… “I could offer-” L: i have wealthy parents “What about actually being loved by people? I could make it so that everyone loves you when you interact” L: i feel like ppl like me “You wander alone in swamps???” L: i have to forge my own story! L: thats a beautiful lantern, whats up w it? “This? I found it by providence. I believe it to be mine. I have yet to figure out how to fully use it.” L: how do you know its magic and not really pretty? “Because im a wizard, lest you forget.” L: oh yeah, ive never met a wizard who lives in a swamp Slight tremor in the plants as bolo flies, they have tremor sense Bolo manages to grab it from her, starts combat
Sea hag Sani Bolo flies away, ends combat Go back to the circus He holds out his hand for the lantern “Might i?” He pays us 100gp Lantern returns to bigtop, allows 2 more of him to form F: fascinating!! How?? “Its boring” “Its not enough to put on a show, but enough to stand watch, ill keep 1 free to operate rides as you see fit.” Star appears in the sky Single star, not yet constellation Petting zoo/butchery They were created? Cant be sold, rely on magic for life “Theres a thing called a chupacabra, these are modified domesticated versions.” Elephant man “He can leave if he wishes, awakened elephant turned luxodon”
“Dogs name is Juse” Bigtop “You can sleep in here, its free of weather” Oh ty! Perfect weather “We’re in a place between jurisdictions, im not liable for any damages u sustain.” F: chimera? “Yes! Personal blend. This one, we only had 2 animals to work with- are you familiar with the carnivorous giant goat? Rusee. It is made of that, a basilisk, and a lion, all that tried to break into the bigtop.” L: where have you been that its there?? “Mostly frethiar. Idk if ur familiar with corrtada, but there.” Creature is oddly docile “Do stay 5ft away from the cage. I appreciate the help, but depetrifying oil is expensive, and id have to charge u for it.” Get some shuteye Provodid 18, 1290 “Come on, come on, we need to start packing up.” B: if we find ur lanterns, make more of u? “Of course. If you ever need help u can stay the night here, in exchange for a lantern. Teleportation, scrying. The biggest issue is that we travel quite a bit.” F: next big destination?
“All destinations are big. Id count saufort, but if u mean big city, Valicia.”
“We want to take a detour to Dirmandian Lands, or maybe go south, see the emerald coast. Though i hear its quite dreary this time of the year, winter makes the greenery brown.” Continue, go past more dwindes, and a manor along the river Filigree of trees, oddly nice smell comes from it, several horses outside alongside deer playing Assuming that fitzie warned, this is a bobonsith manor. Hospitality in exchange for blood Go to the inn
Winn's Hollow Tavern Winery built along here, ran by a man + workers
Famous winery, place that recently was attacked by redcaps. But thankfully member of Ambassadors' Guild came and took care of it
Lightning rail stop here Dwarven man serving someone w ambassador’s guild colors “Travelers! Not a whole lot of you coming around! Wineries arent popular in the winter, prefer ales and liquors.” L: we’re going up north, passing through “Do you wish to stay the night?” L: yeah! “We could offer 1 master suite- ummm. We mostly have shared rooms here, im sure you understand. If you wish, we have our party rooms, all are available outside of his.” B: party rooms? “Private cubbies. If you buy a room, the table is reserved. But the bar’s open, and we’ll offer the full service.” “We’ve had amazing windfall.”
T: zenderholm, hows that armor? “Very well, mon ami!” T: mind if i offer a complementary sharpening? “By all means, anything i can offer you?” T: any advice, my compatriots are looking to join the ambassador’s guild. “Oh! I mean by no offense, you didnt seem like an adventurer when i first talked T: didnt have a need to be! “Well why the sudden need? A heroic streak in your heart?” (do know this person doesnt seem pro authority figures and royalty) T: we’ve annoyed the new duke with an acquisition of property, he already tried to lock my companion away for a jest he made “That is how those dukes tend to be. Might be better with them gone.” T: im sure there are good ones “Rare” T: of course of course. Throm sharpening blade, made of silver+cold iron combo? T: devils or fey? “Fey recently, redcaps.” T: oh yeah the barkeep mentioned Barkeep “and thats why his stay is free!” B: how many for a room? “Takes you out competing him. Zenderholm seems to have taken care of all of them, as much as we can tell.” Blade = moonblade FUCK HOMVERAN ZENDERHOLM, CHILD FROM MONDAY GAME TRANSITIONED T: any recommendations for aspiring members? “I could- we could fight now and see if youre wasting your time?” L: thatd be fun! I assume we wouldnt have to win? “Try your best.” T: leofric or bolo would be a good 1v1 “If you would. Im a good fighter, but i dont believe fighting uneven odds.” S: u seem big and strong, is it ok if i gave my friend a push forward w guidance? “Do you need it?” B: um. Honestly i just wanna see how much better u are Bolo vs homveran zenderholm Oof. 1 hit downed “Youll be fine. It was mostly to see if youd irk out every advantage you would. The test would be teamwork based. You tried to squeeze out every edge you could. If you couldnt work together, youd have to be strong enough to get me to yield. Youre either good as a team or so good it does not matter.” Tosses over 7 gold “they can have their own rooms. Remember this when you start making money, pay for me.”
Winn “dont forget, the drinks are complementary. And the performance. If you want, we can do one from merris.” (joke)
Owl named Merris (Owl) “We’ve gotten a few people into the inn with that one.” “Your dad a big merris fan?” L: …yeah! T: think very highly of him
L: one is a big anemone, one is merris
“Blessed wine. My husband and i have made a life of luxury here. This one- save it i would say. Makes people more courageous than wine normally does.” Zenderholm “ive told them its not blessed, but alchemical. Idk how the grapes got alchemical, but beneficial regardless” Provodid 19, 1290 Zenderholm preparing his cart, rickety cart ship of theseus’d together “If you wish, youre going northward? So am i. Im not going back to the guild yet, i uh… i like to… do more work without less administration.” Throm does maintenance, hes put away childhood dolls into a small shrine, bit of a mixed emotion (both grief and change), he hasnt rlly moved the shrine, cart has suffered bc of it. Easy to move things Provodid 22, 1290
The Vale Inn He drops us off “Best of luck! You have my blessing. Gods guide you!”
Barkeep (Nyrelis fi'Mornay) working alone, greets us at small inn at the cross roads Plenty of seating “Pilgrims?” F: sorry? T: travelers “Oh! Pleasure to serve you all the same. Anything i can get you? Rooms? Mugs?” T: rooms tonight would be good B: what kind of mugs? “Ale. the cartsman is coming in 2 days, so i apologize if its a bit…” “Which direction are you going? North?”
Oh no west, thru tolelva “You staying?” T: just a stop on the trip. Trying to join the ambassadors
“You might be best to wait on the cartsman. Cart is big, hes going to Knokstraten.” Oh great! Thats where we need to go Provodid 24, 1290 Around midday, there’s a ruckus downstairs Shakedown, men turns “back upstairs” L: wahts going on??? “We’re simply asking the cleric to do a charitable donation to the needy.” “Redistribution of wealth.” Combat To leofric “The gods are dead, stop trying to be one.” Main guy unconscious, 2 dead, 4 run away Heal him “How many of my men did you kill in your righteous crusade?” S: um 2. But i wanted to give them some dignity in death “Theres no dignity in death.” S: sorry abt the situation “Sorry too. I really hoped you wouldnt have gotten involved.” L: knew we were up there? “Knew there were guests. I told Perer over there to lock the doors, and i see he failed.” “Whatever you do, make sure they dont get rights by this woman.” (cleric) L: we have a druid S: anywhere specific theyd want to be buried? “Woods” F: no families? “Its a hard life. Righteous banditry.” L: righteous? “Have you ever met a god?” No?? “I have.” B: why did you say they were all dead?
“Bc i met one. A dead one, who was evil. Who killed my men, all elves, scythe in hand.” (Grim Reaper) “I refuse to let the people fall to the true banditry. The worship of those that would take and give nothing in return.” Cleric “the gods give plenty in return. Good seasons, harvest.” “The men have to weather the seasons, the men have to sow the harvest. Theyd happen w/o the gods, they merely dictate. I believe the blessigs of the earth would be here even w/o the gods. The gods give it back to us in a drip feed.”
Cleric “gozreh protects us. Before him, it was a violent wind, its what created the earthsea, its what created the deep chasms that scar the world, even today. We saw a little that caused a bit of primordial. There was the primordial rumble, a brief instance without god.” “And? It shook. And the world itself doubled in space, in livable land. There might be more distance amongst us, and people may have died, but there’s more here. And there’s more room here. By which when the repopulation happens, more may be able to live.” They discuss L: good sir, you talked to me about becoming a god? Wdym? “Ive heard rumors of a man to the east that did it. That had the same hallmarks as you. And he ascended to godhood, did he not?”
(Audovère fi'Alémanie the First. Results are dubious rn bc monday still happening, but he ascended to psuedo godhood at least.) “Why stop me from taking from a servitor of those who would harm us?” L: shes just an inn keeper “And a cleric” Cleric “a chosen. This inn only exists bc its a manifest zone of gozreh. Every month is a year’s worth of seasons.” L: i dont like the work the gods do when they interfere, esp not their angelic servitors. But whos better to safeguard an area so volatile than someone like her? “The gods are powered by faith. If no faith remained here, i think itd disappear.” (true, but no servitor would be = 1000s of years instead of 100s like he thinks) F: not our lifetimes, for certain “I dont do it for me, i do it for the children.” L: if they return, 10 years its the same L: why not outperform the faithful in good deeds? Smth “She would have to pick gozreh or the safety of her guests.” “If i am to fight god, i would need to fight longterm.” L: are you just gonna come back and try to burn this place down again? (he’s honorbound, almost paladin-like. Hes very honest for a bandit.) L: if you swear to us that you won’t return to burn this building down, we’ll happily let you on your way. “Fine. we’ll find somewhere else.” (easiest is to target cults to monstrosities and undead, the issues are they operate secretly)
(bolo knows abt the one in ziliarn (the one in thernos). They hired bolo’s family sometimes to take care of problematic people, but yknow) He leaves w 18gp Woman thanks us F: you alright? “I’m…. fine, gods protected me today.” B: that was us T: where are they? At nighttime, the liquor wagon shows up Unfortunately, not arbul “These ones would appreciate a ride to the dwarven city?” Man: “Whats these tall and extra short ones wanting with the dwarven city?” “‘I’ll take u as far as the dwarven city, but we’ll have to convince somehow ur worth going thru the tunnels. The issue is… (whispers to her) what did they even do?” She whispers back “Bandits? Bandits arent enough to go into a dwarven city. There’s the issue of- i mean this in the nicest way, you still have a little bit of blood. Whats my word worth?”
“I even have a Cayden tanker in there. I dont mean to brag, but that entire thing has a few earth spirits in the wheels, no horse required.” (infinite alcohol) L: any repairs? “Absolutely not!” L: we just have a craftsman in our group T: could you even tell i blew up the room several times yesterday? She vouches for us “theyre honor bound folk. Maybe they could do a simple dwarven honor ritual with you?” “If one of them survives, i’ll let them all in.”
The Liquor Shaker Miraculously smooth ride, wheels sink down into the earth and glide

sessions/oneshots/above-the-miasma-onesh.title: Above the Miasma Oneshot
sessions/oneshots/above-the-miasma-onesh.description:
Pulling off the ultimate heist in the floating city of Azzel, the poor district needs a new power source lest if falls back into the poisonous miasma and the rich have plenty.
Your contractor is the wonderful Baron Hether, who's greed is only out classed by his desire to rise in rank. There have been talks of sedation recently from the floating district of Donfalla from a group known as the Upwind Fall, this coupled with a 'lack of resources' inspired the Viscount Onyr'Wallical to propose the solution of letting the district fall into the miasma below. This would of course kill a few thousand poor people leaching on the state, so the honorable Baron Hether has hired you to steal a Sapphire Battery (a magic device that keeps districts afloat) and gift it to the district so that it can continue to float for a decade more.
The prime time would be at the Pillar Festival when the nobility holds a ball where middle class folks can join in eating luxurious foods as the miasma spouts violet toxic clouds a safe distance from the city like a hot spring.Players:
Yeva Petrova
Prentiss Arran
Orlan Kinclaith
Kasumi
Raoul

“I have the last rune. Meet me in advesperascit. Will figure out how you repay me for your 2nd betrayal.” On the way, where should we meet? “I will be going to The Neighbors tavern. It sits abandoned. Meet me there.” She looks at us “you came. Youre fools. But at least youre honest fools.” K: who’re you again
“Lume j'Estrilla. We first met as culthaine.” Y: rune or was it a trap? “Not on me. And it was a trap, but not for you.” Door opens, and rosalind sees a soul for a second Undead creature with a soul still in its body
Jestrilla dispels magic on the creature, reveals dione Dione bows “we knew she was hiding in advesperascit, but we didnt know where. Dione: if i’m honest it might be wise to leave and let us settle this J: Gladly V: And then what happens? “And then you move up in the ranks viktor” “No matter what the outcome is” “Unfortunately leaving isn’t an outcome no matter the option. Take part in ur own destiny V: lots of people have lots of things to say about my destiny J: you’re born into an important family, it comes with royalty V: i was to be a doctor in the countryside J: that’s what u wanted but the gods deemed otherwise V: the god, he’s not even a god Dione: he’s the closest thing we have P: do u want him to be a god dione? Dione: he’ll bring back my family V: he’s gonna bring back the vampires? Dione: my human family. I had one before she killed them V: you believe they’ll hold up this deal? They’ll get involved immediately in the war no? Dione: no, i’ve asked for it. And which word has he gone back on? Technically he hasn’t gone back on anything Even with phil’s husband he didn’t break his word, just twisted it
V: i believe it’ll be more twisted than u believe. Phil’s husband was promised to not be harmed but he was killed in front of the king. Dione: is there a way to bring them back without him?
V: ur a funeral parlor owner, time to let them rest Dione: they didn’t get to live, the youngest was 2 P: i can help bring them back D: she bit them before killing them Jfc what the hell What if we have dasa request as her familiar (lots of ifs here) How would u find the rune
“A tool of pheylor tenthalls. It can track a soul across planes. Attach it to a person before they die, and you can track their soul after death.” Combat Custom jestrilla undead, Ecorche, smth she made before becoming a vampire Lesser death is here as well
Oh fuck hey Eldara Ferncla grimace Dione has occult metamagic Jstrilla has arcane spells Dione is also commander dedication Lets kill grandmama with mama Hands viktor the odd shaped pointed pyramid, stab in heart, spreads thru her body, she disintegrates from it Morven gives up 3 memories Dog Surfer David bowie voice guy Lesser death “Your entire bloodline belongs to us, viktor.” Viktor gets eldara via backstabbing Morvie + dasa get the lesser death “Shall we follow? He will be here soon, as soon as the sun sets. He wants her, and its part of the deal.” We have a day where she plays bartender in the back of the bar rosalind kicking his feet with a proportionally small cup on top of the bar counter Leaves and follows the dagger to a demi plane in a shack that was once obviously an abandoned god Jstrilla in her tube, waiting to be reborn Dione holds up a hand, says “wait. Sees an odd hesitation in dione, she stabs jstrilla, killing permanently “This was my kill, and it’s my honor to do so.” King “but of course. But we should negotiate such things, dont you think dione? Its not right to take what is also rightfully mine. “The time for bloodshed is now. War on advesperascit will begin now at the same time as war on brazenthrone by the troops. It is good to have a loyal childer.” turns to viktor “Grandchilder. In my domain.” V: o-of course my liege He grabs the rune amongst her possessions, hands the rune over
