Kualsaki, near Shisaki Nazva 1, 1265
Hey Auntie Miko we’re going to the Holy Church of Pharasma, any advice bestie? <3 Yurei is wanted. Dragon has taken over as the mayor. The church is full of powerful people, but you could simply kill them all. Psychopomps basement Why am i wanted??? Your face was seen stealing from vendors and drinking alcohol publicly What dragon?? Sovereign dragon from the north, nearly killed you. Good luck
(new continent of dragons opened up in Frethïar, some went south to help ppl. This dragon found the town w leadership recently dead, decided to take over) Kholeran gets us there Kualsaki Disguising Dasa is human, morvie is tiefling Approach the gate, guards dont see thru our disguises City is surprisingly alive at night Split half awake half asleep Popular beliefs is continual movement of the living help subside the dead who would try to fill the void Newly blossoming trees, occasional floating bit of rock Earth is less tethered to the ground than back where we’re from
Head of the church is Saevi Kurohana Doing a forgery to give us a letter into the church Bouquet of healing potions
Full moons are holy symbol of pharasma, 2 are out tonight Proliferating eyes Get a monk, helps older man up the stairs Then another monk who touches this one as she helps light lanterns, dousing a few, allowing a few others to approach
Architecture changes from owariyaru to tunseelian as they approach tunseelian-funded church Lantern duty, 2nd on roaming shift Pilgrim touches a woman, she gets to make a check to notice scrying She reaches out, see her pluck the eye off the person before she holds up her other hand and does sign language “If youre nervous, please come. If you come meaning harm, understand i will have to stop you. Thank you.” crushes eyeball in hand. This is the head deathmidwife Ritualistic process for those v sick, they follow the clerics and doctors around, when there is no more care, they ease the process over. Also important in stopping undeath in such places. Battlefields are a wonderful place for undeath to take root P: i think we may just want to go in? Takes abt a mile into the woods, church itself is a town in and of itself that local leadership doesnt worry abt Church itself is on top of a hill where old sasaki used to be. Size of a castle, bridge goes for half a mile Woman at the center “are you the one that sent the eye?” P: yeah “I can tell. There’s no life in you.” eyes replaced with silken balls.” P: ty for your invitation, my name is philomene “Pleasure to meet you.” R: rosalind P: morven, dasa, viktor. Idk if youve heard abt us “Ive heard plenty about you. You are unfortunately the most important undead. You are a lord and he is a king.” “The undead were granted clemency by tunseel.” Refuses to be spoken privately Calls down 1 man who rides a turtle She keeps the honor guard around P: thats find if ur ok w them knowing information that is dangerous. “Id trust them with life and death.” Viktor and phil feel alive, heart beating. Slows down as we continue talking, feels like dying “So you come.” V: unnerving “It is. But with a touch, i could ensure you move over.” P: i have things to do “The dhampir may walk away. That is not an undead, though they are close, that is not a prerogative to send them over.” D: am i undead? “You are a psychopomp that travels with the undead.” D: IM A PSYCHOPOMP! Hi im a familiar of pharasma :D R: dasa is a familiar of pharasma and has only recently regained the ability to participate in the world. She bows at dasa “are you leading this group on a holy mission?”
D: i think thats what we’re doing? We’re also selling coupons for our funeral parlor- “There’s no funeral here. Tho there are 4 that i’d ask to be buried.” R: the corporal 4 of us? “You have sensed the sickness in the church my lord. I know that you lack the strength to spare them. I believe they are possessed.” (there is a sickness within the church, we are not part of the church notably. Her vows prevent her from intervening.) “We are not allowed within the main church anymore, and idk why. But the others come out to give sermons. I listen at the door, they dont speak to each other.” Y: when did it start?
“The illness started 5 months ago.” (removal of the first rune)
“We were met w someone who met with us, the expert. The one who would become the headmistress of pharasma herself. But she said there was nothing the living could do, and that we should wait for the holy undead to come. Under a god’s orders. Know that the wards that pharasma herself placed are still there.” D: what do you need us to do? “Knock them out and go to the basement. I think you could confront the psychopomps and help them see reason.” Y: we knew this beforehand, a calling of sorts, as if we were approached by a god ourselves D: anything we need to know? “Im sure youre aware of anything i could tell you.” (if ur gonna be a cleric, have humility and present it to the gods and their servants) D: could you tell the rest anyways? “Most of the grave tenders are marignas. Though we have a yamaragh in the basement who tends to the most important of graves.”
(amongst would be Pharasma's Sister, alongside those who were part of her clergy and 1 unmarked one buried underneath.) Yamaragh - Judges of psychopomps, their word is absolute 2nd only to pharasma D: we’ll head inside, see u later “Of coruse my lord.” Go inside the church 3 inside, feel oddly at peace “So youve come. You know what we must do, though we do not wish it.” “If you know it, it is good. Betray them now dasa, and take your place amongst the family. I know all of the names of the dead.” D: but im not dead “Youre not. Youre one of us.” Y: im only half dead “Youve committed many sins that would require vanquishing. What would you call that?” points at morven Y: fine art. Sculpture. Looks at rosalind “i could have brought you back to your body had you came to me before you made the deal.” R: ive made the choice that was best for myself “It is the best for you, but not the world.” R: thank you “May we see of her blessing dasa? Please come forward.” D: we’re trying to save pharasma “So are we. it is by her orders, we cannot abide by the undead.” D: useful tools for her rn! “Then you may have been corrupted by them already. Dont worry. We will cleanse you for the next life.” Combat Saevi Kurohana
Abbot Tsujon - samsaran monk disciple Cleric These ppl are held up by strings puppeting them like marionettes, puppets of beings beyond what we know Goes to the rafters and then the base of the structure, person whos a conduit is protected past them Viktor resuscitates one, cuts the strings of the one next to her “Why do you continue? I believe you will continue to bring about greater harm. Please leave and let us control these bodies for a little longer. Your funeral parlor has no say in about the controlling of others.” R: i think im v much one to speak of it, i see no reason why u should continue to do that “Then do you value these peoples lives?” R: as much as any other life? I believe they deserve it “Do you believe they deserve to live despite attacking you?” R: i do, and its complicated, but are we not defending ourselves “If you dont come to the basement within the hour, they will die” The rafters reset themselves, bodies fall to the ground like puppets, as if strings were cut Right Yurei Morvie rosalind Left Dasa Phil Viktor Blue area, light of pharasma shines throughout all Purple dragon looks at us “Dasa, please. Understand what this path will bring” Thoughts beam into his mind “This is what your current path holds” D: wait… why? “Bc you walk with a child of the usurper” D: come from the king? “It comes from our lady. Both of ours.” dragon acknowledges dasa as its equal P: ur equal dasa “I am, and im asking you to stop please” D: stop what exactly? “This. go home. Many will die, but it will be fine. And the balance of life and death of all things, this is the better way.” D: huh. “I rule these things, and i rule the heretics above, and the worshippers below. Im just asking you to go back.” (he truly believes what he beamed will happen) D: huh “I have waited 1k years, and 6 years ago i received that message from pharasma herself.” D: this is the future thats gonna happen if we go down the path, but what if its gonna happen if we dont? How are u sure? “Lady pharasma would not give me a conflicting message, one way or another.” D: huh.. “I know there are ways she could circumvent it, but u and i both know that may not be” D: awakening her is my purpose right?
“She is awake, she will be. That is the last message of the gods before the gate closed. That what was revealed on the throne of want was an illusion to test faith.” D: there must bc smth abt this. Why do i exist then? “U exist for us to reaffirm said faith” D: but dont i do so if i free her? “She has allowed u to come to me. U travel with unholy ones, and like that, i can sense- their souls have become more and more mortal with each day you travel. One day, they might truthfully revived, regardless of the third law.” D: couldnt you have picked me up earlier? “I cant. My job is to stay here and wait. I follow the orders of those before.” “Theyre mortal, prone to their proclivities and faffing about what needs to be done for the lady.” D: what abt the psychopomps? “We are the psychopomps.” D: the others dont recognize me
“Theyre weaker than me. I was there when you were but a little familiar. You were an old friend of lady pharasma. Much like the snake.” D: then… “Please abandon them. And join us.” Begs us to understand “this is for the best.” Combat Psychopomps disappear from the world as morvie uses ume to eat rune Rush from yurei 1 tail turns into 9 Yurei feels calm and then Pain “Youve done it. And it’s not right.” Y: wdym!!!! 3 good questions to ask, full transparency as shes mindmelded with auntie. 3 she cannot deny yurei What do you mean it’s not right!
There is a burning in me, her body says. My body was removed from here by the chosen of pharasma. Her, to be top priest, pheylor tenthall. (the exorcism ritual is pheylor tenthall’s) Weapon of pheylor tenthall’s can knock u out and track where you’ve gone What are the true circumstances of your death? Betrayal, she was betrayed bc she attempted to tend to the undead. Her own lover tried to cross her, crossed her against her will, pharasma managed to kill and vanquish auntie and then achieved her wish upon the throne of want where she managed to die at the exact moment to ascend to godhood and become true god of the dead. Laid laws, the third, doesnt allow those who died and became undead come back to life lest they create nindoru Undeath used to be more common, creatures will needed to be strong enough to cling to life whether it was unjustly killed. Pharasmas rules narrowed it down, thus haunted buildings are less common. Most ppl back then had different ways, auntie flashes knowledge abt various laws. There were 16 laws, different amt of laws from different worlds that didnt coexist, had contradictions. Wizard or someone powerful enough could come back as undead. If u knew resurrection and rebirth, u come back as nindoru. She knew the law and circumvented it. Thus she became the last and, following pharasmas purge, the only, and remaining nindoru
What’s up w/ the runes? If u grabbed them, fulformed. If they were forced, halfformed. They have been grabbed from the body and sent elsewhere. Pheylor tenthall dug thru her body w a knife to drag out the runes and send them elsewhere.
(why did the king do it? He is a man. He has impulses and furies. He was mad at dione for defiling his kill, a mistake. He might be calculating, but he is still a man.) LEVEL UP Nazva 2, 1265 Viktor gets a message from a friend
“Viktor, i have found a friend. Some people to help me. Tunseel has elected violence. All in the capital who have elected war, will be slaughtered. Me and my protégé and this leshy we found on the way will attempt to free people in the capital, good luck with what youre doing. -homveran.”

Pinpoint on Kualsaki
10 miles to the north thru the groves of Shisaki, hidden in the Deathless Grove that was lost to time. We’d know a way forward Scrying on auntie
Can see pheylor tenthall looking at us, see the grove and shrine that auntie kept preserved. Its on fire w bluish tiny. Ghosts inhabit the fires. She then dispels it, see 2 burning wheels behind her Wheel archons, notably see thru deceit and lies Manifest antimagic field around them, 10ft around them
Sending to Homveran Hey bestie. Going against pheylor tenthall. Anything we should know? Strengths? Weaknesses? Etc? “Her gloves reflect, her sword pierces, her coat majestic. Persistent healing. Cane cannot be disarmed. Can weave spells into her sword.”
Body of auntie has been dug into by a surgical knife. Runes removed from her, lit on fire. The grove is on fire filled with singing spirits “It is by the favor of the god himself that you can walk away from this.” Y: naw im good u deserve death “Step forward thru the gate, we can fight” (one we step foot, we’re going into aunties domain, would feel right to kill us in her masters domain in her eyes. Symbolic in her eyes)
“Viktor, if undeath didnt exist, then your sister would still be alive” Y: if u do it now, then shed still die V: i cant fix the past
“Then we’ll fix the future. Do what pharasma couldnt do herself.” P: w infinite war??? “2 things can be true. We will fix the casualties that allow undeath and will also usher in an age of war to prove theyre fixed.” Combat Yurei does vessel’s form Stopping the fire requires religion checks on aunties corpse Pheylor tenthall does leading dance yurei onto auntie body “I always wanted to try this” Downs yurei, she comes back as auntie “Youll be the oldest thing i killed.” Yurei goes down again, goes to dying 3 Morvie gets the kill via caving her face in Yurei puts out the fire, area goes calm Level up to 19 Start of the finale….. The body of this shrine maiden has been totally eviscerated Embrace entity is required. 2 candidates. 1 was born to be a vessel, one was made. Open heart auntie surgery in a burned grove Left in grove of spirits Auntie has mostly gone silent as she is in yurei’s body Now has innate abilities
Restore 1 creature that is undead or of the Anmoku Funeral Parlor, as 3 actions give the creature long rest benefits (remove doomed, wounded, etc) 1 issue: will saves Yurei: drains enfeebles and clumsies Yurei also cannot benefit from teleportation for the next month Viktor: cannot benefit from teleportation for the next month Morven: cannot benefit from teleportation for the next month
The King's Ballroom is disabled
Brazenthrone has teleportation, immune to effects thatd stop normal teleportation as told by Merris Hasalk and Onarach Oh my god every stop we go is pharasmas
Go from shisaki, go past by the Holy Church of Pharasma where she first preached
Then the desecrated 2nd church, then another, 4 more were set up. Runes taken to capital of grundiir. Then went down south, established herself, then down to mountains below. Stopped by Demon lands, then Ammurun, then up north to fathrell mashallah we have followed the steps of pharasma Nazva 3, 1265
Rest in grove oddly full of life (Sowwin's Grove) Message back from 1 person who can send to us
“Its me, its me niven! People are dying down here. The king has created an eclipse over all of tunseel. The blood of his descendants is raining down upon the castle. We are sheltering people near the Memoirebebur.” Sowwin and niven working together can shield a LARGE number of ppl Nazva 4, 1265
Takes us to Sternbore, various aberrations moving around. Theyre living a healthier life. Selius Wachtervan meets us, stepping out “Things are bad, i sense.” P: raining blood in tunseel “That is not as accordance. Is there anyway i could help?” P: we need to get ppl out of there. Also warcouncil? “They would be in tunseel?” K: they are all around, not just in tunseel “I cant kill most, but i have a specialty. Which one has a noble title, do you know?”
The rival necromancer, Werner ir'Fres
Dornec Champion of asmodeus, head of hakusa family in Sternbore Monastery “Unfortunately they were taken by forces stronger than us. I could certainly tell you for a price.” V: price? “What you did to your friend over there, the one who called you onii-chan.” V: she just got into a scrap, she will recover in no time
“Shino hakusa glowed gold and kidnapped their own siblings (Aki Hakusa, Tone Hakusa). Or hire me, and i could help.” P: what would we hire you for? “A few ppl have committed sin there, but they belong under a new god. But if you hired me, it could be up for dispute. Whatever you kill, we could send to hell.”
(grim reaper has right to mortal souls, but the king isnt mortal anymore. The king has officially been ‘dealt with’. He’s no longer the king of tunseel, as agreed upon by dasa and the grim reaper. But the issue is he’d still have those that feared him until he dies.” F: have u not talked to him urself? “Ive tried but he says im too young to understand how business is to be done. Ik im a mere 60, but thats still worth smth right?” “I’ve been doing this for 30 years” B: is ur father scared? “Of losing his power.” B: if he retires, will ppl still go after him “I believe so, once you have that- i dont think he’ll retire. That power goes with you to your grave or until the power’s gone, albeit temporarily. “Promise youll be back to deal with it. On a dwarven oath?” (clan dagger bleeding, shake hands) He vouches for us to go in but on an express pass, which gets us into the mountain pass within the day, cannot stay in the city Party is able to enter immaculately kept area in rigid area, magical protections to keep it constantly well conditioned. Home away from home
Ambassadors' Guild Door opens, woman working the desk, fiddling with aknife “Hello there!” B: hellooo “Youre new. Submit a commission or-” B: join? “Okay, names?” Gives us 50 pages of docs to fill out (allergies, weaknesses, occupations, wanted by the law) “Okay, uh, pleasure to meet you fitzie. Gawain. I’m going to get my husband rq, he’ll be right out.”
(Gawain Nooks of the dark waters)
Hi Urgan Resplendent mansion “You’ve come at a bad time, ppl dont typically come thru winter.” “We have the basics-” gives a tour “Did any of the ambassadors recommend you?”
Mr zenderholm? “Ok. then we’ll make sure he earns his commission.” “I learned froma person whos like my father. The best way to learn about someone is thru a duel. So take whatever position u want, all at once ofc.” Combat
Urgan remembers sowwin? based on the protector tree sachiko puts down “How old is the child?” Shes like 4 but yknow shes a leshy (he has a mirror image and sure strike scrolls, and also wall of fire) Hes impressed that leofric told us abt travespoir “Congrats you all pass. The first trial. There are three.” Waht next? Does a head count, writes on a slate of distant letters, return letter is large exclamation point “There is a… circle we need mushrooms from. An-” Wife “an ancient alchemist took residence in there. The residual supplies are for teleportation, upon retrieving it you can use the teleporation circle but know that its one way. Its not far, we have a team that could lead you if you need. But- i think you can make it on your own.”
“Its an area located withi the dirmandian lands known as the Boundary Latice. It- the alchemist put himself there bc its an intersection of different worlds.” Which ones? Urgan scowls “its impossible to say, we’re still researching it.”
“I believe Feywild is there, but its not the primary. We’re not sure what it is. But he lives there and i assure you based on your expertise on fighting me that you all will be able to make it.” He gives us each something person smth personal
Gives fitzie kyrie’s old mentalist staff (<- jay is going to start crying) Gives leofric a merciful rune Sachiko trackers goggles
Bolo concealed sheath (Bel’s) Provodid 29, 1290 Valley had drakes and unnatural predators. Valley is now almost instinctually avoided by monsters, tho still not good for agriculture and is barren of natural resources Occasionally pass by a hut, we can stay there occasionally Urozha 1, 1290 Beginning of spring Mushrooms are in a cave w an odd grinding noise throughout Leofric, bolo, sachiko, fitzie The BL Circle Oh god this thing is so crazy Fitzie cut off from the others 2nd grindstone begins moving Sachiko looks in chest, seems empty Leofric looks in, Tricky Liniment Moving heavy rocks Open the bag, there is a sealed letter from throm? Leofric, I told myself I would speak to you properly out loud, with my spine straight and my voice steady, but every time you look at me, my thoughts scatter like startled birds. So I am writing instead, because ink does not tremble the way I do. You probably don’t notice the small things. The way you always pause before entering a room, as if listening for the world to give permission. The way your hands hesitate, careful even when no one is watching. I noticed. I notice everything about you, even when I pretend not to. I wish to take you from this world and return to yours together. No blessings invoked. No omens read. Just my heart, laid bare. —Thromulus Bag is now embroidered w throms name Puzzle seems to ghave unlocked smth somewhere, there is a key at the end of it Card game, strip poker Chest w a small note For you. Trade places. You can give ur nimbleness to another and your strength to another, but it must be one of the same sex. Leofric and bolo do it UKE SEME CONDITIONS Kitchen area has a crossbow that shoots at the women One of the beds gets lit on fire Play strip poker Fitzie gets a royal flush Keeps getting a flush Arbul put itching powder in the clothes Bolo and leofric make a cake and pie together, sexy tiktok bakers Woman who looks bored at work, at bolo and leofric ignores the women “NO, I’M ONLY HURT BY” looks at palm “TWO PEOPLE EMBRACING” Fitzie and leofric hug, she gets ‘hurt’ but gets healed Bolo leofric hug “ONLY A KISS MY SEAL ME AWAY FOREVER” L: are u ok????? “I’m ok! I just need to see a kiss to be banished back to the abyss.” Even demons have rights “If i stay i’ll drain u of ur vitality, itd be wise to banish me!”
Sachiko brings out The Man from Hjelmdall and the Devil Woman, its just like that Sachiko asks what the leaves are “Nyeh, we are leaves to help you! You must convince them to kiss! Sachiko we cant live without the sun, and we won’t ifm they dont kiss!” S: shouldnt it be of their own accord :(( this seems like coercion L: man throm would make out with me Get thru w a little kiss Combat Skeletons “IF ONLY I TOLD HIM HOW I TRULY FELT” “I WAS TOO AFRAID OF SOCIETAL STANDARDS” “ITS NOT TOO LATE TO TELL HIM HOW YOU REALLY FEEL” B: shield me! 1d4 vitality added to weapons Skeletons have recorders on it Slate of glowing virtue? Ancient elvish description of brother over arms where theyd forsake women to have a pure life. Goes on to say that the door behind can only be unlocked with true confession between 2 men Awkward confession between bolo and leofric 2 men on the door go for a hug Door opens, oh yay mushrooms Rotation again We collect mushrooms “Nyeh u can take but wouldnt u like to stay for longer?” Plant unfurls a leaf to reveal a bottled sunlight, extremely well made “Nyeh theres much more if u convince the men to stay” S: oh idk if theyll stay but thank you To bolo “nyeh much more treasure to be found in here if u wish!” Go back to ambassadors guild Stone lion waiting for us Gawain looks “Oh you looks surprisingly well! Was the alchemist not too much?” “Oh maybe because u had a child u were spared the worst of it. The way in is full of… comradery and friendship. Those dark dungeons do things to people.” B: im never going back “Thats fine u passed. We do need you to sign this tho. NDA.” L: did u know we’d have to make out? “No.” “Consider 2.5 trial, signing at the bottom.” “Thank you this is important, it makes sure that the guild works as intended. Its non disclosure, but reasonably you could talk abt it in taverns. We wont enforce after a year has passed.” “Ur green around the gills, this is probably the most exciting thing u did and after a year it wont even be top 10 at the end of the year” “Rest up, the next challenge… is to hunt! Monster slaying! A pair of chimeras.” F: theres a lot more around in general
“There has been, we’ve been investigating. They’ve flown in from the north, so i expect them to be resistant to the cold and vulnerable to the heat. Rest up, take ur time. Important that theyre dead, more that youre not” “Now that you’ve passed, we can give you the payment to help fuel the teleporter + what youve earned.” Bag of holding type 1, 240gp inside “When i met my husband i was wearing a false disguise, and he saw right thru me. I was disguised as a sailor.”
Described trying to sneak onto an embassy ship that was going down south to a great tree, expedition failed, was caught, made contact w urgan, he liked her swashbuckling and bravery against overwhelming odds Omg hey bestie homveran “Youre back!” L: that was weird “It was?” L: we had to make out “Oh huh. 2 of my companions had to make out but i was ignored.” We drink we him, he invites his 2 friends over Halfling wizard Gnomish warrior To them “treat them like how u treat me of course.” They snicker at each other “Now u didnt happen to panic when u had to kiss another man did ya?” B: what panicking “In front of a child no else” S: im an adult “Now, ya coin for drink.” “The young lad has enough to spend (100pp) and a thousand time over.” (pointing at homveran, but leofric feels like the fingers on him)
Homveran “i have a generous patron who provided for me. And leave it at that. I dont go off spilling secrets. I kept in track with some of them when they went down south. I thought it wise to keep track of what they brought back. They brought back this and that, some trees, artifacts, livestock, alcohol was low on the priorities. Alcohol comes and goes, leave it too long, it spoils into vinegar. But people, the trees? The life, the stone? That lasts forever.” B: ppl dont last forever “But their memories do.” “As fancy as the alcohol gets, after the first 3 drinks, u just drink to get drunk and malt is fine.” Leofric glowing a little “Embarrassed about your first kiss leofric?” L: its outta the way now Wizard “leofric, could you step forward a little bit?” Casts silence, targeting sachikos area “Why not just hire a prostitute and get it outta the way.” L: i swear thats a grown ass leshy. Uh. yeah. 1 im a man of chivalry and honor. 2. I didnt think of it. 3 ive been busy Inserts coin into a small sliver cabinet that pours out liquor
“The nice alchemist made it, its a repurposed alchemist supply. It came from castle alchemy itself.” Glass seems oddly indestructible “You could do whatever with this thing” L: havve you heard any news abt it lately
“Have u heard anything abt melissa’s dwindling sales?” F: yeah “Anything interesting” F: not really “Then not really.”

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 6
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 5
Next: Session 7 Urozha 2, 1290
Drinking ends at Ambassadors' Guild around 1am
Homveran Zenderholm points out we’re in the middle of a valley, the closest thing is a farm 5 miles away “Go to bed”
Guy in leofric and sachikos room “newcomers? My name is Geff.” L: pleasure to meet u. Been here for a while?
“I did, i was sent from the Dirmandian Lands from my small tribe to find ambassadors to make peace with.” “Did you come here mistakenly as well?” L: i dont think so?? Did u like it enough to stay or “Of course, the booze is plentiful. And it does my job good enough. This way, i maintain diplomatic ties to almost all nations.” L: good point! “Any one leader you want to be introduced to? I can introduce you as part of my clan.” L: what clan?
“It is part of the Greyrocks Clan.” L: neat! (he seems oddly ok at diplomacy, but he is notably substandard.) L: you seem so friendly right off the bat. “That is how we do it, yes?” L: i see! Um. “We are unfortunately from the cursed lizardfolk decendacy. Some cursed emotions dont come so easily.” L: huh “In the same way that you could see red and know it as red, i can see happiness and feel it as happiness.” L: i. See?? Would u like to meet the rest of my companions? “Is it not midnight?” L: in the morning? “Will u be at the communal breakfast?” 1 opens the door to bolo’s room Woman “youre in my bed.” B: wdym “This is my bed. Everyone knows this is my bed. You dont want to do this.” B: who are you D:
“My name is Sire Quinely.” B: but im already in bed “Then get out.” B: there’s room! She stares him down “I’m glad you see reason.” Lays across a giant flag across the comforter, closes the door w magic Morning comes, yummy breakfast Geff and alyce and gnome eating breakfast Geff “are you from dirmindian lands too?” B: aye “Which town? B: we just kinda moved around from place to place “What group are you in?” B: now? None “Ah. but this not your group?” B: yknow. Yeah actually. “Not with the ambassadors?” B: its a new thing! Im on a trial period T: bolo is a prospective member alongside ourselves “Oh what trial? I remember my 2nd trial. It was a lot for someone such as me to show such intense emotions to survive.” “But your group came from the otherside. Are you a refugee in the troubling times?” B: not really? I just happened to leave a little while back and now im with this group on the otherside. We’ve been moving around for a while “Youve come for adventure at the right time i see. Prudent. Will you be seeking the queen’s fortune?” B: there’s a queen?
“Of the dirmindian lands, yes! The lady nooks is not a queen. I am talking about the Pale Queen and her disappearance as of late.” B: something that either brings fortune or despair. “It could cause a war.” B: which isnt necessarily a good thing “It is usually bad.” Alyce “are uou with this bed stealer?” F: yeah. But also huh T: bolo did u proposition this woman?? B: i had to find a new bed! “Objects have spirits in them dont you know?” T: either way yes hes our friend Alyce “let him know. He’ll understand that it is good practice whenever offered smth and ur new and not full members to not take the biggest portion of such thing.” T: in his defense we just went thru the 2nd trial, its pretty harrowing L: we had to bake pies naked “Ours was an all female group, the doors were opened, we just collected mushrooms and left.” L: why didnt they just send fitzie then??? “Its part of the contract.” she calls out to a friend in the other room
Female kholo (Dreamy Grove) “quick. There are spirits there. That need the souls of men and their passion to reimagine the battle, i imagine the succubus changed it to a passion of lust. I found tablets scrawled on the walls if you’d like to read them.” Oddly well aged tablets, predict groups of very specific men, only way thru is the true embrace of each other F: thats odd “It was in the eagle room if you found it.” T: very specific! “Beautiful those spirits. We understand it was a site of an ancient battlefield.” (room was created for honorable fighting. One of the beliefs was that itd disorient the spirit and so they couldnt go onto the afterlife.)
She talks abt various exploits, appears to be from a group from Dusenhir that has just come thru to seek adventure. Notably she is training to deal w fey, she is from a noble family out there. We talk about our castle “Oh, you could have that registered as an ambassador embassy and it’d be immune. Youd talk to urgan but have to prove you have legal ownership.”
Girkendall. Our goal is to go there and try to hunt down and track the creature before it causes issues. Leads directly into dirmindian lands and is a trading post between here, alkenstar, and dirmindian lands. Originally city of the dead, mausoleum to an old empire that ppl moved into Urozha 5, 1290
Reach the Mausoleum Market Approach guards, 2 large ogres with helmets shaped like skulls “Why come?” The chimera? “Mummy sent you?”
(there is the local leader. Keth the Long Memory. Mummy lord) T: believe we were hired by them yeah One stops, turns around, yells at the tower. Smaller person writes in an isolated shack where we cant see “She says you can pass.” Inner part of the city is giant mausoleum w haphazard road that serves as defenses in the valley. Go to find the mummy
In'Zirgal is where the mummy lord resides Door talks to us “why do you approach?” B: we’re here to speak to mummy “Here to speak to mummy. For why?” L: hunt chimera. His request?
Lizardfolk mummy!!! (he got exiled from Yenitaht by Myka Chamomile, went here instead) “You seek to kill a chimera?” L: we do indeed “And are you capable of such a thing, or are you going to be sending your bodies back if that?” L: i hope so? F: we killed some dragons
“This chimera has the middle head of a basilisk. A creature like our great god the basilisk, The Keeper.” “You’ll kill it one way or another, or you dont. If you turn to stone there’s no helping you. If youre still alive, it’ll simply eat you.”
“Take your stone body back to Urgan, he’ll fix you, he’ll appreciate someone with self sacrifice. You wish to be a hero? It requires danger. That is the way for all mortal kind.” L: makes sense to me T: leofric remember what we spoke about “Why would i manipulate leofric?”
“It is a pleasure to meet you child of Merris Hasalk and Anemone Veremund.” L: oh! Hahaha! Yes. i am. Dont tell mr urgan yet, i’m trying to not have it influence my destiny. S: trying to carve his own path! L: exactly what i mean. How do u know that “I know many things. It comes from ancient power. I could remove your brains through your nose and calcify your heart. I could subjugate you. They call it a rot but its truly a blessing. For the others, he’s already been paid, but i might pay well for some of the body of the chimera.” (could reanimate it, but theoretically you could harvest some of the magic in it.)
“Let urgan know that this would count for this quarter’s contract. Thank you. I will let you know that Sofmoth was the one that was killed, it would be prudent of you to check around there. Along a wheat farm.” There are ogres and the like here, but the primary groups are hobgoblins, kholos, a few ghouls and a medusa. Occasionally see women with snakes under the hood and writhing in the city
“If you wish, there arent any i recommend that are common. But might i recommend a priestess of urgathoa. She’s forsaken her name and goes merely by the Weeping Sister, but she could give you a pest and inform us of your demise.” “This is important. I will be sure to send to the ambassadors as per our agreement. I dont see it having eaten more than the 2 small ones before the next group arrives.” Ushers us off
Throm buys a crushing rune from Father Rell, a ghoul. Notably in charge of crafting, works w fleshcrafters, uses undead for manual labor around town which helps in the harsh desert He offers 1 inch of skin = 3gp off. Then 6gp “Has anyone told you you have lovely skin?” T: no one has “If you want someone to appreciate it. What lovely skin attached to a lovely man. 9gp.” Throm does the deal “Would you like replacement skin or an elixir of some kind?” He takes the elixir, it will leave a scar Go to the weeping sister, she doesnt look down on us but. Her snakes seem lethargic compared to others, the small vermin wind up in cages that she petrifies. She can see thru them “Do you need a lookout? You may take whatever of the pets you wish. We have snakes, rats, birds or insects.” A: insects would be good “Theyre hard to see out of. Like eyes of like eyes make the best of scrying. But they are not small. But some people prefer the company of insects.” T: not me. Leofric pick the rat We hunt the chimera Chanting in the cave system Just 1 Oh my god Combat
Mouse @ leofric: “i remember you!” Mouse head is the only one that disintegrates Collect basilisk blood to unpetrify 3 people 2 in nice condition: hobgoblin and elven person 2 in ok: 1 is ogre and a regular goblin Several other that would pieced together Fitzie bolo went to the cave A group of mice carry a chest to us Confetti flies out of it “i’ll be keeping an eye on you!” There’s a lot throm can make out of the chimera The mummy wont like us if we take it directly to urgan We try to convince the weeping sister to not tell him Start depetrification on the ppl and head thru the valley on the way back Urozha 7, 1290 Arrive w the chimera at the ambassadors’ guild
Urgan is so excited, Gawain Nooks steps in Urgan claps, her “Sign here, did you get in trouble with the local law?” T: the mummy might not be happy we didnt give the chimera. But look at ti. Its so valuable. The things i could do w it Urgan “and what do you plan to do?” T: armor, weapons, chemicals. This thing is a gold mine. I just wish we kept that rat head on it “The what” T: rat head, spoke to us, recognized leofric “A CELEBRATORY DRINK”
(sachiko does recognize the name niven, belongs to a druid that was renowned but has become known as an archfey that has since disappeared form the world. Has not been seen in 15-20 years. Alongside his familiar, who also went missing around that time, or presumed familiar) “Youre no niven. At least i hope not. Drink, small leshy?” S: no thanks! I dont drink T: the rest of us do dw B: dont you need water sachiko? A: theres water in bourbon Reading the fine print We all drank but leofric is fine Azrael didnt drink, reading thru. They wont sue but will kick from the guild for various infringements (will protect for minor things with adventuring). If you murder a man in the streets, they wont help. Oddities abt publishing rights, but other than that nothing really weird. There is some contractual details abt high level ppl had to do stuff for legal stuff, theyre not allowed to get involved. Urgan gavin and others strongarming local government and going. Hey. “Try not to get too drunk. The others here owe you drinks. Dont let them convince you its the reverse.”
T: hey we are in possession of a piece of land, we were wondering abt making it an embassy. “Whats the size?” 4 story, 100x100, 10k square footage that also has spare rooms. L: mr of the dark waters, i was wondering if we could talk for a moment “Urgan to you. But yes.” L: ok mr urgan. Its related to um. Smth you did abt 20 years ago “Would you like to see our garden?” L: YES Oddly thriving garden, neer infinite fruit. Pumpkins grow back in only 2 days L: now. Um. mr urgan do you happen to remember a young boy you happen to rescue 20 years ago from a distant southern island? “Yes i know you leofric, ive kept in contact and sent you money multiple times.” L: i didnt wanna get into the guild. Well thats embarrassing. “Youre not a good liar. Youre fine. This drink is from a friend.” Rum is green, tastes vaguely cinnamon and allspice, but also oddly tastes like pure rum L: i shouldnt have let u come with thats embarrassing “Embarrassing moments are better w friends.” L: in the basement there is a broken portal. T: goes to another plane? L: we’re trying to repair it “Could you do me the favor and draw?” Fitzie draws it “I thought all of them were destroyed?” L: why? “When we went over, it was a disaster. We made it out with only a few living. You of course.” B: where did you go?
“There was a big tree to the south. And the big tree had some bigger problems that we killed successfully. And the new lord appeared and banished us from it, as it was part of his domain. And we lost a lot of good people those days.” F: no ones been there since? “Not that we know of. When we came back the way imploded.” L: how did you get there?
“Do you know what happened with the wandering embassy?”
“A device that carried the ship over. We found you and the previous crew. We managed to find my captain’s sister, but the others were too far gone.” “There was a lord that was formed down there. And one of our crew betrayed us, and let us all be vanquished from there. But he was kind and let us escape with the ones we saved. The land wouldve died by nature, but one very powerful, kinda like sachiko? Gave his life to restore it so that life may bloom again.” “That might eb the way. I cant help you with it. But i could examine and tell you where you need to go? My role is as an advisor.” L: thatd be helpful “Of course.” “Then. to get this settled, i have to sending a few people. But they wont say no. is it in a particularly populous location?”
Outside caldrith “Itll take me 3 days if you dont mind staying here.” Urgan is talking to another older orc
“I want you to meet mr lecran”
(alchemist that survived the resurgence of a god in tunseel. Notably outside of the cities at the time, but did help lead refugees. And then semi-retired from undead hunting ways) T: id love to learn from you! “I have knowledge, but most is useless now. The rules of undeath have changed.” Leofric fucks it up talking to women B: i believe you owe me a drink “Urgan said it?” “I owe you, royal, drinks.”
Urgan thinks fitzie is asking abt killing her mom, which is NOT true Leofric is surprised fitzie has a mom and a dad “And you’re sure shes part of this guild?” F: uhhh. Yeah???? Looks 5 years back “we’ve been paying her stipend, but she hasnt been around for a while. (poors liquor on it) Don’t worry, i wont remember. And neither will you, right?”
Urgan continues to pay ppls stipends after they stop showing up. Both fitzie and throms moms ran into a great loss and stopped adventuring
Dreamy grove is throwing up, Sabora Sharkosa the gunslinger is helping her out “Divinations take a lot out of you. Especially when the stars go scarce. I can read them, you know.” Azrael talks to sabora
She got her guns from her family, “he was part of the Acre Strike Squad.”
A: tiberius acre? “Aye, he killed a lot of people in his day. Figured i’d come here and do some good for once.” (theres a mix of emotions, for example. On one hand, what the gun did was bad. But, against what was likely a dozen armored knights at a time, it won. While u may not agree w the cause of the war or what happened, the gun won. And theres sometimes thats just how it is. At the end of the day, the purpose is to be a survivor, and if you go extra, everyone around you also survives thanks to your actions.) A: tiberius was my uncle “Tiberius was the last 3 guys who hit on me’s uncle! But you hold yours well. Want to try some drunk shooting practice out back? There’s a fancy room.” Takes him out to the shooting range, odd selector and mechanism embedded into it. Has different layers. “1-10, how good of a shot are you in urgan’s eyes?” A: 5? “A 5? I havent hit a 5 yet. Pretty cocky.” “He has high standards, but he’d never admit it.” A: fair “You did good.” A: maybe something a little easier? “Of course. But i’ll have to admit, youre no acre. Apparently he was the only one that could hit the 10, that’s how they designed it.” (urgan was the last to see tiberius alive. Confirmed sighting of tiberius.) He talks abt his family, where he got trained, talks about his uncle “You dont need to impress me, i’m impressed by your own merits. Youre better than that friend of yours, that prissy boy.” A: leofric? He tries too hard. “He does, he tries too hard to be liked.” A: we’re the same age, he’s good. “I’ll say this in the nicest way, by the beard hes trying to grow, he looks 13.” A: he looks better without the beard. “Convince him to shave it. He might even be quinley’s type if he shaves.” A: maybe i’ll let him know, give him better reason to shave “Just dont expect anything to happen with quinely. She’s not into men.” A: oh yeah, me neither Leofric is sitting in the fountain S: are u ok??? L: oh hey sachiko L: yeah im just. Nice weather. Why dont you go back inside- S: did you fumble it? L: yeah i fucked it up 😭 L: why cant i get a beautiful wife like fitzieeeee Geff shows up “please dont sing its odd for my culture.” (strong emotions like playing music is akin to public nudity for his tribe. Under a curse of urgathoa where showing emotions would cause pain, you only do that with someone you love.) Fitzie talking to the kholo woman abt being a diviner
“I was part of the Sthilasmir Tribe, we did one good thing. And then it seems to be over.”
(gnolls that follow the stars for grand divination. Once the stars abandon them, they are left with 1 thing. They had brought a doll to a funeral parlor and set off a chain of events, and following this, they began to disappear. One by one, they left a spear in the sky that too eventually blipped out. Thus has been depressing for this woman who was 10 at the time where the stars ceased to exist. And thus she joined an adventurer’s guild to use her occult magic for some good.) The two drink together Urozha 8, 1290 Urgan does a ritual on the sap “I know how to fix it.” F: yeah??
“I know the requirements to fix it, but you’ll have to find them yourselves. A seed, not seen on this plane before, an hour before you attempt to fix the machine. The blessing of a shadow. The fragment of one of the gods of advesperascit. And the fragment of one of the gods that came after advesperascit. We need to fix the machine, that was the requirements. Idk what it means, but i know what 2 mean.” F: which 2?
“Sachiko. Your mother is one that can create plantlife on another plane, right? Then we need to get her ability to get her seed from her plane to our plane within an hour. Once you start the ritual, you need to get it here before the hour ends. The ritual takes an hour. Get it all the way from the emerald coast to here. The other is the fragment of one of the advesperascit gods. I know a few, but you wont like most of them. Most are locked away in Advesperascit itself. There is the god-fraught fragment of tunseel, but i dont recommend going for it. It almost killed me. Do you know of the caldera calamity? Someone has the condensed hand of it, it’ll be at an auction house in about 2 years. Should it go missing, that would do. The others i have a little idea of, but i am sworn to secrecy, so i hope you understand.” F: by who? “Beings much stronger than me.” (there is 1 that rose to prominence about reincarnation that disappeared as the fey arrived. The Pale Queen. She disappeared, but initially came about during the vespertine empire.)
At one point, urgan having established the dark waters as a major clan, she swore to her. An oath could unmake someone.
The shadow might be for the deep soul. Aberdeen Skimberton has a fragment of the deep soul, and we need to get that
