Next: Session 8 Urozha 9, 1290
Wake up in Candlelight Keep <3 We wait a day Urozha 10, 1290 Knock at the door
The Ehlis Vantreau “I am here to announce the arrest of Thromulus.” S: what???? Th: And may I ask the charges? “The charges are not verified as of now, but a knight as come to report you for kidnapping and endangerment of children.” Th: ah beans. (passes wand and shield to bolo) My friends it is best that I comply. Bolo / Sachiko: YOU KIDNAP CHILDREN???? Th: Any attempts to flee may be seen as a sign of guilt L: Should we contact the guildmaster?
Th: Yes, Guildmaster Urgan “Oh you made it?” L: Yes, this is also an embassy now. Throm complies, passes all his stuff over Making small talk as they go abt nonmythical local politics, trying to get a read on anything He’s trying to thwart local superstitions abt fey creatures, cold iron nails and stuff Attempting a more ‘diplomatic’ approach to the fey, getting rid of the things that would hurt them and allow them in uninvited Th: “Ofc, we would love to help if you have any copies of the initiatives” “You have things to work on, seems youve taken a deal w the devil” Th: Well we don’t have to oppose each other on all fronts “I believe your innocence, but I will make sure that I only send word of it right before your execution.” Th: 🙁 We might need to go to a spellcaster that can send The devils? Old man meets up with Throm, presents handcuffs to him Th: Is this really necessary? (He says, putting them on)
Ser Expus Mentums
M: I don’t want to do this, and to be honest, I found your mother, and it was between you and her so I chose you. I hope you understand. Th: Thank you. M: Figured it’d b the greater mercy. She’s a bit… yknow. Th: yeah.
M: I think I could convince her you’re up adventuring in Rozen and she wouldnt be any the wiser.
Th: Yeah especially if she gets word that I’m a full member of the Ambassadors' Guild now. M: You can hardly swing the hammer, let alone the sword Th: I’ve gotten much better with the hammer! M: They let you in as a smith, don’t they have them? Th: They let me in as an adventurer! I encourage you to speak to my party, I’m sure they’d have some very interesting things to speak to you about. Please. M: Abt the kidnappings? Th: No but they might be able to provide some light on the situation M: I want to believe your innocence but you happen to be in the same town where your brother went missing and it puts you as the only heir Th: They’d have my head before they let me be the heir. Halfway there. M: Well, he has 4 years to impregnate another woman. Th: Another? M: Sickness. It’s, uh, we’ve sent for various alms and the like, but I don’t know what happens in those meetings, they go to talk to your dad but he says its too high a price to pay. Not a knight’s duty to question, it’s duty to serve. Th: My companion Sachiko is a healer, perhaps… M: I mean this in the nicest way, I’m sure she could heal and do a fantastic job, but the simple fact is Sachiko works with you and youre the one going to jail and likely abt to be executed. Th: He was last seen in the keep. M: The keep you own??? Th: ah. Uh. I’ve only owned it for a little bit. Please speak to my party please please please please Th: If you believe my innocence and have any lingering affection, please speak to my party.
M: Well… House Priport has another 3 days of amnesty here, yes? V: Of course. You’re allowed to act as local law enforcement for those three days.
M: It’d be imprudent of me not to get all the fact, and besides, Caldrith, magnificent dungeon on that isle, and our boy Throm? Not the best swimmer. No way he’d be able to get out and swim to shore. I leave him in your care. Th: thankyouuuu Throm is put in the city dungeons We need to find someone to cast sending No AG reps here. That’s us.
Twelvetowers may be an option Scroll costs 150 GP, has a chance to fail Someone casting for us could work We are going to try the priest we met, if he doesn’t have it, we go to the devils
We go to the priest of Erastil Father Rosk, we explain the situation to him and ask if he can cast sending Its like a comedy book, when i leave they arive they leave and when i arrive they leave
Dawnhealer (Name Name) has met them, a bit kind but prickly
The Starwarden Arkos has as well L: Would they both be able to perform this spell? Certainly, at least within a day L: Any suggestions as to which one? Starwarden Arkos if you’re a night owl. I would do it, but I could wake him now since he only stays awake during the night. L: nono its okay You sure?? If your neighbor knocks on your door, is it not your duty tohelp? L: yeah true And we will help too, as servants of gods. Leofric tells him abt the AG embassy! “I recommend making a shrine outside. Helps ward off most evils.” L: uhhh,,, sure..? We’ll make a shrine to Erastil, sachiko will do it, she is green faith follower Wth the way I see it, a shrine set up there and regularly tended to would make the area around it gross with bounty There are some issues. Biggest one, the nearby woods are full of fey, but most are perfectly fine, quite amicable.
Knocks on the door of the church of Desna, dwarven man is there, gives us a thumbs up, Closes The Door Forcefully, and does back to bed Throm searching for weak points The mortar is weak kind of He’s doing graffiti!! We go to the star guy! Tactical Fitzie astrology lore Good roll lets go Are there any new constellations? Stars described as “Missing stars” are still up there to be compared with new ones What do the changes mean? A few things. 1. Newer stars, seemingly less faded, oddly there is a note that stars of the same pattern and constellation increase in brightness when new ones appear. Old ones had the opposite effect where they faded until a massive upheaval caused them all to fade one day. Fuck thursday game L: Weve run afoul of the local lord due to our ownership of some land up north A dispute of mortals??? It’s fine, we all owe each other the right thing
L: Our party member’s been arrested on the charge of kidnapping his brother even though he DIdn’t Do That L: Guildmaster Urgan explaining holds much more weight than the ones he’s trying to get the land from Do you mind if I try to gleam something from this? L: Sure He touches Leofric’s (and the the rest of the party’s) hands, over half an hour, chants to himself. The chant is in celestial Wakes up a bit, then a supernatural drowsiness comes over him. “You’re all blessed.” S: By Desna? “Yes, that’d be appropriate. By the stars.” Describes our constellations, shows us where they are, there is a thread that connects them A southern wind for Leofric. A large (and no offense) tree for Sachiko. Dark brood of darkness in an antistar for Bolo. B: what does that mean. I believe it is a destiny that will suck away life itself to feed its own destiny. S: That’s concerning. B: You gotta take what you can to grow what you can or whatever, idk - bolo This world is plenty for those that inhabit it. Do you know if each of us tilled the fields and mined the mines and none considered ourselves above the other how much wealth would go to eahc person? People come hera ll the time to ask about their destinies and the stars. I am one of the only remaining priests of Desna. Though many have left the faith after the stars disappeared, I stayed, and my faith has been rewarded. For you helping reward my faith, let me reward you. I can spare two Sendings for you. We know if we dont step in Throm WILL be executed ‘Hi urgan its leofric. Throm sentenced to death over lord wanting castle. Please help. Caldrith.’ Will appear following tomorrow’s scroll. Did you join A G to only avoid legal trouble? Could you cast sending whole time? No, we can’t cast. Got help. Enlisted help from cleric. We honestly joined to protect castle. Will be down there soon. Easier to teleport than teleportation circle. Expect me by 10 AM. Now if you don’t mind, if your friend Throm is in trouble, I’d like to give him his last rites. L: ahh go ahead,,, We leave so he can lock up He wanders off to Throm’s cell Th: Oh please tell me you’re not here for my last rites. Priest: 😬 Th: Ah. My companions… I see. Do you have any crimes you wish to confess, Thromulus? Th: I have intentionally overcharged on simple tasks, I have withheld important information from my companions… I’m sure there’s a third.
Sounds like you need Sarenrae, not Desna. Come the morning, face your eyes out of the cell, do 15 stares at the sun in penance. Throm thanks him xoxo, leaves everything to Sachiko and Leofric Priest offers to read Throm’s stars, quickly picks the locks when he stands in. Th: is this a prison break or a murder Neither. Hold me. Th: uhhhhhhhhhh okay He stares up at the stars and follows an invisible thread that follows Weird Goop. its yucky.
“Ah. Good news. You have an older brother.” Th: what He has four stars Th: does dad know… oh my god….. Throm locks the priest in with him Th: im sorry. Wakes in the morning with the priest there Throm does his penance Urgan has come straight to the dungeon He frees Throm! And the priest i guess Th: guildmaster urgan thank you so much for helping in a timely manner! U: Well that depends, did you kidnap your brother, Throm? Th: No Urgan lets him pass The priest is so peeved. So deeply peeved. Pr: Would you call yourself a wise man, Throm? Th: not necessarily, no Urgan stays behind to deal with the politics The party is staying in The One Inn We Know We reunite with Throm We are figuring out where we want to go in town before we leave
We go visit The Noxra Embassy We approach Lion of some kind with opposable thumbs who welcomes us to his home “Welcome to my home are you the new castle owners up north?” So you arent landed nobles but you own land ob nobility T: aye that puts us in quite a predicament politically speaking “Twin noxRA is looking to help you out, we wouldnt mind buying it from you for a reasonable price, whatever the competitions offers well pay higher” “Are any of no vegetarian?” “Gifts of fine meats” “Have you ever had deep roath?” [type of cow that eats mushrooms deep underground] He gives us a sample “I know bolos family? They do work-” B: Wahts your name again/
“/N'Mele Sorn” He is by all means completely legit But it doesnt mean he doesnt know how the underground works
He is an awaken animal, provided his freedom after he escaped from a zoo in Ziliarn, he is pretty far south in a place where he is in relatively natural climate and two he is in a place where he can show off the relative acceptance of the twin noxra nation, by being both an affable and strange creature to look at
Twin noxra is part of the Dirmandian Lands, it goes across the border into the durmindian lands and Auctur. He knows bolo's family quite well “Yluve been doing good, not manmy people disappearing these days from caldrith” B:” Id like it to stay that way for some point “Until its profitable?” B: until necessary i suppose…? “NEcesdsarry…. But is it right for a man to decide when its right to disappear people. Where is the limit?” B: the limit is based on the situation at hands and if all things are necessary i would prefer it to remain as it is “You might have a career as a politician bolo that was quite a non answer” He gives us meat We eat together now Unfortunately for us it is hard to keep up with a lion raised on this stuff He will despite his manners otherwise, gulf it all down in one if you let him. We get oen eighth each
Dirmandian Embassy Approached by old knight wearing blue with the crest of ziliarn alliance, symbol of a crescent moon and eye on his shoulder Smiles at throm “Mind if i kidnap you for a bit?” Ser Mentums T: perhaps we step away- “Im kidnapping you all for a quick chat. My goal is to bring whoever kidnapped throms brother to justice. Unfortunately ser throm is the one charged. He was just released by caldrith, house smth is not caldrith” T: we know who took augustus “Then allow me to kidnap you to an alley or private room. We have one at the keep, but if you have one in the city that works.” Go to the inn “You bed with a witch?” L: what. “Leofric do you have a father figure?” L: um. Yes. i have 1, 2, 3… 6? Father figures? “None of them taught you how to court a lady?” L: uh. No my many parents did not. “Youre a handsome lad. If you like her, first you should figure out what you like about her.” L: ill ponder that “If its simply lust. You have any vows of chastity?” L: no A: you did L: i did????? A: yeah “I mean this in the nicest way. The child. I do believe throm is innocent. If the child is either dead or not, in which case i doubt that a few minutes will matter.” “If its lust, hire a prostitute. Only court a woman if you have a chivalrous yearning for her.” A: a code of chivalry only has like 2 things with women “Yeah the rest have to deal with combat. But look at leofric, he spends 0 of it getting laid and the rest being in combat.” “Sir leofric the chaste.”
T: we believe that augustus and ms fairntickles wife were abducted by the previous duke Miryel Siroth “Missing one?” Aye “Youre blaming a disappearance on another disappearance.” L: we tracked him down to a castle, they went thru a portal of sorts, we’re trying to repair it A: what kind of knight are you? “I use a sword mostly, 2 handed.” A: do you have zone of truth? “I do not. But i have a good sense tho.” A: talk to the new duke- he doesnt hate the good knight, if he is investigating this- “The new duke is the one that told me that throm was here and when he could be arrested.” T: we’ve been working on preparing the repairs for the machine, but it will take time. “Any arcane wards?” Nooooo “So long as its not arcane i can break into the castle.” F: i wont put up wards then! “For now we have the advantage, the forces that may or may not accuse you wish to blame throm. If you let me in, we give away for the potential for a facade. If i climb in and investigate, then that was my own doing, and whatever i find is my own reward.” B: question. Whos the one thats so adamant that throm did this?
“Throm's Father, of course.” T: my father is only following what was most logical. If i was in his shoes, id also suspect me. I’ve done nothing i swear, this is my whole reason for assisting is bc of his brother L: azreal it goes to my homeland A: we’re going back home? L: uh did i not tell you uhhh He heads north to the castle, leavin us here Ok actually to the embassy now Appears to have a large drow man, looks a tus “Youre the new castle owners to the north” Ya
“Pleasure. I’m Ambassador Dirmain.” “Why are you here?” “Does urgan require us to sign another agreement?” A: alcohol and beds “We do for those that need it. It’ll be free for you as long as youre in the city. What rank are you?” Newly joined He pulls out a glass w no label, smells bad but alcohol in there “We give in accordance. When youre higher rank, we’ll give better accordance. We do not care- looks at leofric and bolo- where your family is from.”
Ask abt the Pale Queen, he gives prepaid speech
“She is [smth] queen, appears once every 10 years to give decrees which have allowed dirmandian lands to survive despite conditions and multitudes of ppl, shes delayed this past one bc of the twin noxra experiment, she has managed to annex hols, ziliarn, shar, and the flemotha portsalongside annexing (informally) rozen. But it was during that time that the queen of twin noxra declared independence despite being part of dirmandian lands after the fall of auctur, but this is believed to be a secondary ploy.” (there is info he dares not, hed rather bolo kills him than give info to us. We’re extremely minor nobles/peasant.)
The Emerald Embassy Sprawling complex, indoor gardens, build along a large jungle tree expertly grown. Inside tree bears little parts where bark pealed off, knives have put in sigil for all major houses of emerald coast. Person inside is graceful softspoken woman that seems to be elven “How could i help you, my dear lords of the north?” L: how does everyone know? “That you own a castle and deeds to the land to the north despite the chagrin of the duke?”
“If the emerald coast could offload any goods, that’d be great.”
“As you understand, the emerald coast has fallen out of favor bc of Frethïar, given more power to rozen. But- we do believe that there is land to the south. An expedition went down there will soon open up emerald coast as a major trading post. Call it a merchant’s hunch.” Perception: clearly pointed, leofric shifts and she encroaches witha smile “If you sign now, we can ensure you pay 0 taxes on imports and exports between lands.” Not fey, just extremely capitalistic. Sees an opportunity, has insider info, capitalizes on it. If we dont have imports and exports, this costs nothing. If we DO have some, small cost in the beginning but so much gain going forward. Paper mentions 10% extra tax after 10 years of imports and exports have occurred T: we sleep on it “Of course!”
The Waterlily Stones are warm even in winter, supernaturally heated. Air smells of herbs, clean water, faintest of metal. Light itself reflects here, whether moon and stars or area, it is very liked by populace. Its blessed by summer courts to allowed for eternal bloom and blossom. Leshy with watermelon head looks at us “What can i do! One two three… six towel?” T: yes please! “Six towel, you only get one each.” Focus in, throm feels odd attunement here, roaring waters here T: grand place Small people, checking out the beaches, small rocks thrown in ocean or put in baskets Able to encounter odd fey creature, slithering eel in the shape of a man split apart. “Enjoy the bath!” Thanks “Good bath, warm water, good for both, yes?” Yes!
Beautiful woman appears, the Lady Nethry Leofric slips and falls She holds leofric, face shifting between 3 different states, tree woman puts him gingerly outside of the bath L: thank you! Looks at sachiko, water is thick almost like milky opaqness. Hard mineral water “oh fey ambassador here!” S: yes hi! I’m sort of one, i’m fey and also ambassador’s guild and also sort of one for my mama’s realm “Which realm?”
S: my mama is Lady Xiǎohóng of prismatic valley! “A quaint realm.” S: we do what we can with waht we have “A single tree amongst a grove of bushes, right?” S: uh bigger but ya!
“I work for the Vosan Glass.” S: idk if ive been acquainted! “We’re operating just up north. For a hesperit queen if you can believe it.” “I help grow the fines, of course. We’re building a portal near the city of pipes. Have you been? A beautiful thing, shame the creator didnt live past its creation.” S: no? Maybe we go sometime “You should go at sunset or sunrise, most beautiful then. Have you ever seen the naids dance? Their blue skin dances in the water against orange pipes.” describes the city, empty of people, it was built by a longing inventor who hoped his lover (a naiad) would come back to him. He provided naiads a home. He waited 80 years, his lover never came Describes that what we have taken over: a citadel of once great glory of old tribes that was once fought over by undead hoards, mantis, and then man. Then a group that took it over, a shining beacon of morality.
Last important faction was a group long past, known as The Pathfinders. The world has since moved on. From the age of gods wandering, about 6k years ago at least. Somehow the castle survives, unaffected by natural decay (oneshot that zack ran to find out if the group liked pf2e over 5e) “Are you taking these people back home?” S: we’re um. Exploring together =) “Where are you going if i may ask?” S: oh wait back to my home? “Yes” S: oh yeah but its noit permanent “Why?” S: we just gotta talk to my mama, i need to ask for a favor “Well. is there anyway we could help? Itd be nice to make contact with the fey so far to the south.” S: business card? Lemme ask my friends. “We’re building a fey portal of various parts to bring downsouth to our realm there and their realm here.” S: hate to be presumptuous. Could we strike an arrangement to use it? “We could, but i’d have to talk to the fair queen, but shes unlikely to accept someone of no name and no idea the intent. I serve the lady of sunrise and sunset, and you’re of a small realm.” “Would you like to find out how to integrate yourself into the sunrise or sunset court?” S: id have to talk to my mama, no offense at all, i just dont wanna get in trouble “That’s ok. We’re all subservient to those higher. Take your time, and i’m sure you’ll find us.” Urozha 11, 1290
Lightning rail, yay Jump off the train Lady Xiaohong’s Domain Large fey woman bows “You return. With friends! Are these the kings and queens of the lands outside?” S: UH. dont lie to her. No but i know where the duke went! “The duke!” S: he went thru a portal but not somewhere u can reach thru here, we’re working on figuring it out. These are my friends! She bows, smiles “Well i could help in anyway i can. But any material i give not of nature will disappear upon leaving the land.” S: we were looking for a seed actually? One not seen by the mortal world She walks up, produces a new seed, hands it “Be careful with it.” S: we dont need it rn but- well. I might not have been clear enough “Then when do you need it? Its very new, unexposed to the world.” A: will it keep? “A new one will. This one you can plant and become another leshy. Tho may lack the spark of sachiko, it’s still a leshy.” T: biggest issue my lady is that we must be able to, once the preparations are complete, get the seed over to the keep within an hour “How fast can you run?” T: none of us have the legs for that, i hoped you have an idea? “Teleportation would not work, bc it’d ruin the seed. There’s likely a way to bring part of my domain over to you?” T: how do u suggest we do that? “are new lands of the first world opening up near you?”
“The Land of Summerkind is coming back. You will have to enter and sail upon the great aqueduct upon one of my branches, present it with great favor to the queen.” “Do you know abt the height of the land of summerkind?” Its among a great river of twilight that stands about forests, leads to planet thats also in perpetual twilight, this will be how we sail

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 8
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 7
Next: Session 9 Urozha 11, 1290
Long journey to Ciuviedo to get on Lightning Rail north to caldrith
Rest in sachiko’s mom’s domain Prismatic Valley Urozha 12, 1290 Along the side of the lightning rail A knight approaches “Halt please.” F: an issue? “Could you take off any headgear, do a quick bow?” We bow, knight takes off her helmet “Would you like to come to my camp?” L: YES Go back to her camp “I presume you brought your own tent?”
She is wearing the color and symbol of St. Sirnach
“You do realize the emerald coast is a rainforest?” Sachiko makes us some resting area “You seem to be well armed.” F: kinda have to be around the track “And cold iron, no less.” L: we had some run-ins “Well. i’ve encountered a creature of the woods that seems to… seems to eat the divine?” L: uh oh. Is that good? “Well. its not quite. How would i put it… eats people as well.” “It hasn’t travelled. I imagine it has something back here. If i could be so bold, if i had a good tracker, i could find it.” L: we have sachiko? F: describe it? “Dark skin, 2 heads, wears a hood for that reason.” (a kishi, like to torture people and appear as attractive affable people who offer shelter and then cause distrust amongst the group, reveals the face after one person remains.) “I seek to fight such a fearsome foe. We can just follow its tracks if the little one is as she appears.” “I understand your enthusiasm, just some sense about it.” T: i am curious. Why a knight of st. sirnach is- what youre doing all the way here?
“Um. my order worships a form of the Green Faith, we sensed around the time of my holding a greenman. The purpose is to find the greenman and serve him.” T: fascinating (greenman is formed on the sight where a powerful leshy dies, and thus becomes a guardian of nature in its area.) L: there’s this continent right. So you know how st. sirnach is to us? “South?”
L: yeah we are to this continent. Its very difficult to access. But one of the ppl who went there- mr of the darkwaters mentioned to us that a leshy on his level of prowess gave his life down there. I wonder if thats it? “I mean.. Maybe?” T: when powerful leshies die.. L: unless you have another lead? “I believe its best to exhaust all my options here than go to another continent?” L: im leofric btw
Lady Sae A bit odd, she asks a few follow up questions abt him and then feel more at ease talking abt himself than this persona
Talks of her own home, how her order was found, the strange afterlife, and then concern abt the order accepting said afterlife. Finding a grove, using it to shepherd people over to Eberron. Question of whether her soul goes there if she dies here. She shows a nice big jar of dirt to bury on top of her Urozha 13, 1290 Sachiko leads the way Takes most of the day, creature has built camp deep within Moves through trees, one head gnawing on branches “Okay. who else fights up close?” T: leofric and bolo “Then heres what we’re going to do. We’ll pretend to be a couple lost in the woods. I am sure for such a creature itd love to insert itself in the drama. You do reek of cold iron so dont wield it. You can have it on you, but dont have it at the ready.” (she carries both silver and cold iron) Able to walk through a small clearing, a handsome man greets them within a camp. She yells at leofric for getting them lost L: you said it was this way! “You dont happen to be a priest do you? We heard there were holy ruins this way?” The man “i do.” hood drawn up “and which gods do you serve?”
“Erastil of course. Who else would build it in the middle of knowhere?” Man “of course. Well come on. Its getting late. I think theyre further to the north. Deeper inland. I saw them once, youre right you shouldnt let her push you around.” “I wouldnt have to do so if he had a spine.” L: trip of a lifetime :/ She attempts a deception check He doesnt believe Combat “Good job everyone.” F: you hit hard. “It helps. You dont want to go to the dragon do you?” Huh?
“Your heaven or Hell. Our dragon. Every 2 weeks, the dragon’s wings appear in the sky, bathe the continent in a quilt of colors.” “Could i at least have 40 of the gold?” “There’s very few places where i imagine we’ll get some walls.” She’s half elven Shift Bolo & throm Nothing noticed Leofric & lady sae She talks abt the sect “What about your beliefs? God, nature and the like?” “I saw divine magic from you did i not?” L: well… yes? Sort of? Its more the hopes of the dying people of my homeland coalesced into 1 person “Tragic.” L: sometimes people cry when i look at them Leofrics fave alcohol is hard cider Slight small bits of rain fall down, nice large hand on his back Loud booming voice behind “thats beautiful.” WHO THE HELL??? She bows to them, motions toward leofric. Symbol close to greenman? This is a wood giant, creature of the forest. Benevolent to ppl. Shows up to help ppl who help nature. They arent skilled at combat, but give blessings for kindness shown to them L: you honor us with your presence “You honor us for killing the one with the ferocious appetite.” L: should i wake the others to meet you? “If they wish to awake.” L: i think fitzie and sachiko would be upset if i didnt It gently shakes the party awake F: anything we can do for you? “I just wish to thank you. And see if theres anything i could do to help you with.” Offers to carry us to cuiviedo “Metal in great quantity doesnt agree with our constiution.” L: where are you staying next lady sae? “The woods, search for the greenman.” T: what is your name?
“Fawmalog.” (fawma is a type of moss, when the creature is sleeping it looks like a log covered in moss.) Urozha 13, 1290 We tell lady sae where our keep is, she agrees if shes lonely bc we were good to talk to Tell fawmalog too “Idk how id get there. There is a city that doesnt take kindly to our kind blocking the small riverway.” Offers to teleport them once we can Taken to ciuviedo by fawmalog Go to beautiful city, flagstones play memories of person who placed it down City is 1/4th living people, 3/4ths illusions/phantasms of ppl who are no longer here In the city, if you wish, create a brick and lay it into the wall Party puts 1 brick, memory of us drinking together
Can put them in the Crown Storage, which is a temporary place Looking at memories 1 peson who appeared to have, before this river existed, just spent watching it slowly form bit by bit. Theres a stretch as the river goes from a stream into a river miles wide This took over 2 years, the owner now sits in one of the Seers offices Urozha 15, 1290
Ride in on the train to caldrith, arrive in the Lightning Dock at the Saltmarket Under the nightly glow of the high beacon of eternal fire
Sir Expus Mentums was waiting for us Says throm has a year
“It also says in the letter that i will promptly alert your father.” B: what did you learn? “If i told you, it wouldnt be a noble secret and he wouldnt have reason to change his plan. By doing his arrest these things would come to light, you understand? As an assassin, youre not very politically savvy.”
(House Priport fears things coming to light) Throm walks w him in the streets
T: ive recently learned my older brother has some connection to the constellations “Older brother? Youre the oldest.” (he seems baffled, has no reason to life)
T: thats what i thought too. But the Starwarden Arkos is adamant hes my brother. “Priests and the like are often wrong.” T: another favor? “You can ask, but i only have so much power.” T: perhaps. (throms dad will either be joyed or angry.) T: maybe find a good time for my father to learn this information. “No less than a month. After my findings, he’s bound to be volatile. If there’s an innocent lad, then id rather him meet his father when he’s not angry.”
T: i have to get in contact with mother. Maybe its not father’s. “Its easier to cover up the pregnancy from the man’s side than the woman’s.” T: i’m aware “Well…” T: mother’s not very well known “Its for the best. That’s why you’re the one to be arrested.” “Its a lot. I was mostly waiting by the train to see if you fled. I was gonna wait a week to see if you fled.” T: i appreciate the trust “I follow house prieport, and you do fall under it.” “Buy me a drink sometime.”
Back to inn hi Arelis Vantora “Well hello honey.” B: whats on the menu today? “The usual, the muttons, stews. Unless youre talking abt the fancy drink?” B: how fancy? “You have quite a bit of gold on you, dont you?” B: not a ton “Glow cap grog?” B: sounds expensive “Its grog, it isnt. Seems more fancy than it is.” B: a round for everyone except sachiko Barrel twists a little bit This bartender is slowly transforming into a hag Go diplomacy boy go “You cant use magic to get yourself a free drink.” S: not what im doing! “If you ask for another drink, i’ll say no.” L: i’m not trying to get one. One of my wizardly companions noticed that there’s some changes in you since we started knowing you. Changes consistent of someone receiving the call? “I have a call for many things. Painting, artistry, woodworking.” L: like. The Call “What’s so wrong with that?” L: i mean. No judgement we just thought you should be informed. Esp in the case- my understanding is the calling itself can go ok, but then it goes to ‘kill your loved ones’ territory “Its no such thing, happiness here, some magic there. I could also do this.” (u dont loose witch powers if u say no to the calling.) L: you’d be able to keep some of ur abilities if you said no “We don’t know what they want, do we?” B: are they swampy? “Never met them.” L: do you want us here when you meet them? If they suggest smth you dont like we can protect you? “That’d be nice. But what if i’m to be a norn?” Uhhhh we cant help there much F: but if we can help we’ll be able to help, at least. “Do you know what it entails?” Rule of 3 with hags. 3 changelings, 1 gets to survive, it must eat the other 2 to become a hag “Do you know how long until i have to… yknow” (she’s never met them, and also… imagine if she could do this by herself as a “human” woman and now she has hag powers) Voice rings in around us “Its a good thing to do for her, don’t you think?”
Hey Ehlis Vantreau :/ He bows back, has a genuine smile to see us alive and well He slides her a platinum piece “Get them smth nice to drink, they just got back helping the woods so i heard.” We did that yeah He transforms water into alcohol? Oddly cool, nice refreshingness, mild burn, oddly electric that causes hair to stand at attention
“A delicacy in the Feywild. Have you ever seen the plane of storms? I’ve been there once, they have rain that has its own mind. This is some that never touched the ground, it was collected and distilled into alcohol. You’ve been doing good by nature.” L: we try our best “Then i’d like to ask you again.” he puts sleep on arelis “I’d ask you again to stop where you’re going.” “I know your souls are on the line, and we could fix this together.” F: you know we can’t. T: we put our souls on the line. Its worth the risk. I understand why myself, fitzie, and leofric do it, and i’m thankful for sachiko and bolo.
“It’s noble. If it means anything, i’ll freeze you in ice so that your souls are still on the earth. The block of ice is much better than the hells. You’ve surely met the man from Hell, the hell dealer that’s taken residence outside my walls. Do you wish to be like that?” “You wouldn’t be him, but the one servicing him and his ilk.” “We might come to blows.” F: hope it doesnt “If i win, i’ll destroy the infernal machine completely. But i’ll, best i can, revive your souls.” L: infernal as literally? “Infernal as in the hells.” L: that makes sense. “You do know what created it, right?” Nooooo “It was beyond hell and beyond fiends. Came before them. A vacant void. Those twisting gnawing, rotting roots. That is what provided the power for those machine, initially.” (he says it, doesnt hold a lot of weight bc its spoilers for oneshots) “I promise, the tree is brimming with life now.” L: is it just not to go thru the machines or at all? “Not to go until the powers that be deem it so. Itll be a change, and it’ll be harsh for many… lifetimes.”
“Are you aware of what happened in rozen?” F: vaguely
“The good, the great duke Miryel Siroth were companions in battle. And while others dealt with greater threat, we both dealt with the horrors rising from the ground threatening nature, at the behest of the masters.” “We swore tod different powers to gain the power to stop it. He disagreed with one of which i found, and i disagreed with the one he found. But we lived with harmony for a while. Until our masters had a disagreement. Now you serve his, and i serve mine.” T: a witch? “Simplified way to put it, but not wrong.” L: why cant you go down south? “Youd have to fire up the machine, and i mean this in the nicest way, but the man you’re accusing of being a kidnapper is a lovely man. I’ve seen him save millions. And i believe he has a good reason for it. I wish his soul not to be in hell.” L: i hope we do not come to blows, we’re pretty set on the path we’re on “Youve been doing good in the world. Let me treat you tonight. Fine wine, fine blend.” L: ik we disagree on one thing, but we’re always willing to help with other things “We’ll have to see how it goes. But for now.” he touches her forehead, she shunts awake. “Are you ok? It appears you slipped a bit.” Her “oh, i’m fine.” “If you wish, take a nap, i’ll serve these people. Ill pay double on the govt’s dime for how much they drink.” “Any gift of the fey i can offer you? In exchange of your names of course.” S: DONT DO IT “Now what would i need with your name?” L: IDK WE JUST FOUGHT A GUY WITH A HYENA FACE “A kishi?” L: yeah “Then that giant was bragging about you. Youd do well to keep right by them.” T: he complained abt not being able to pass by the city “My old companion had our differences abt the fey. He liked to keep it at bay, i like to keep it close.” He shakes on letting the giant pass “On my name, vantreau, i’ll allow the friend of Thromulous Macer to pass through the city. 4 times, twice away from his home and twice to, so that he may find his way back no matter what.” (sachiko. Notably the twice pass is a way for him to say that, should the giant be deceased in either land, he may pass to whichever land he prefers in the afterlife. Once for the body and once for the spirit.) “Drink as much as you want. The nice stuff of course.” He gives us various different drinks, and then gives us The Last Light on the Leaf “Its a personal blend. It’s been blessed. I could teach it to you in time. Its best if you drink it.” He smiles, drinks his own. Feels like morning son of our homes Fitzie and leofric start crying “It is hard to understand, but i appreciate these moments. When times were simpler.” “My understanding is that youre going to those fey. Right near your castle. In honor of you helping the spirits to the south, i have to say i’m woeful and hungover. I’ll need 3 days to recover.” (3 day headstart.)
Dirmandian Embassy Leofric bolo throm
Back to school Collegium Arcanum
Master Ephiane Savile is waiting for her F: hiiii :grimace: “Savile to you. You’ve gotten stronger.” F: i didnt think ud notice haha its a honor haha “You reek of it.” F: i do??? “So much so the stars have taken notice.”
“I do have to ask. Why did you seek a deal with a devil before asking me?” F: oh. So you know about that “I’ve figured it out. I met a man. Horrible man. And his succubus hut. The entire way. I understand he was an acquaintance of the old mayor, but why’d you have to get involved?”
F: i know where Lila’s gone. “With him?” F: its the only way. She looks at the sky, reaches and draws with stardust. Tries to read them “Then i’m afraid i have to expel you. But you paid your dues this year. In a year and a half you’ll no longer be a student.” “Youre following his personal business? Some form of interplanar transport?” Yeah? “Its one of the few things i cant help with.” “1 in 20 have died. But 19 are provided a good life. If i were to remind myself, i almost was expelled from a university.” Whatd you do? “They gave me a month, let me study things considered forbidden without consequences. Whenever you know youre going to be expelled, do whatever you can. If you break into a classroom, if you arent caught what can they do? But that was when i was younger and bolder, and im 300 now. I just run the university.” “Youre an outtrack student. Dont treat yourself as a student, and you really havent been one for the past 2 months.” “My understanding is you have a friend of yours. One relates to the old librarian, he helped teach another gunslinger of his familys past. If youre to go down this road, violence might be necessary. Tho i despise the things, non magical contraptions, a gun might be necessary. And of coruse, if theres anything you need for interplanar travel, i am legally, morally and contractually obligated to provide” “If you wish, i have a small bit of power invested in me. Do you know of any who could use a little boost now? A little boost in fate. In the ways the planes align. Ahyio has provided me much.” F: my friend has a bit of an anti-star. Hopefully get that away from him. Urozha 16, 1290
Carnival outside our castle???

Going to the carnival next to Candlelight Keep
Does some mild shows with animals as Vasili approaches Arms spread open “our glorious hosts! I’m on your land of course.” How can we help u?
“Oh we wanted to set up shop, invite people to the show. Sir Expus Mentums and another fellow, hard to be entertained. Turns out we have an enemy of an enemy, so we should help each other out, right?” (talking abt the mayor)
T: and the… your issues with the duke are? “He’s stolen one of my lanterns.” T: why would he do that? (he doesnt trust us enough to tell us abt the magic in there lest we get tempted ourselves.) “People have tried to steal before, some have succeeded.” T: i hope we dont offend you, but as we’re not on the duke’s good side. Why should we help? Ik u have a lot to offer, but… “I travel the realms and i spread good word, ppl come from any city to see me. Imagine they were already amicable to you. My glorious patrons! Isnt it good to also be patrons of fine arts for the people.” F: we dont have to get the lantern back right now right? “Not right now.” B: wheres he keeping it? “Soemwehre in his manor i believe.” L: you dont have a less likely to jail us person that we can get you, right? “I can only tell when theyre nearby, i can tell when theyre near. But its a 20mile range. I have a circus of me.” F: lonely? “It does. If you find anyone wanting to join, invite them my way. But i’m a lot.” T: i do need to ask. Have you met my brother? “Your brother?” T: yes my brother “Depends on who you are?” T: throm macer, idk if i properly introduced myself “Macers i’ve met many of.” Sir mentums is already drunk on wine T: i see ur enjoying the side mission than what we expected
Mentums “its a vacation for me. You remember ziliarn, tho ik u left a bit young.” T: best years of my life “For some of us, it means chopping wood.” T: i was still the lords son at the time “And i’m not.” T: ik you dont work for me. But question between friends. That fellow over there, wahts his deal? “The non dandy man? Allegedly he says the lords of this castle stole his rightful property.” B: who???
“He’s from the ir'Rao family. I’m not familiar with Vespertine royalty.” (Sivani ir'Rao) Leofric goes to make an impression L: hello! He smiles “do you own this castle?” L: why good sir, we do “Good.” bank slip, writes a check for 100,000gp hands it over “i’m sure you’ll find this more than agreeable.” L: i’m afraid we have to decline. As i suspect- He adds a zero L: good heavens. We have to decline, but can we assist? “It’s my destiny to own it.” L: oh? S: who are you? “Sivani ir’Rao. I’ve read through my stars that it’s to be mine, and i can use it to help my declining family. No fool would decline 1mil gold pieces.” L: our interests may align, but truly the power held within is the only way to get back the ppl we love “We have expert necromancers and ressurectionists at the family’s disposal.” L: they’re beyond the pale “Cute. but there’s no one that they cant bring back.” Still alive. “Which company?” L: taken against their will?
“Sir Onarach took them against their will, it would be good to take his assets.”
L: if you need to get in contact w them we can try but theres smth strange abt the pale in the south, this castle is important for that “I’m looking for it, but what i’m hearing is the child of sir merris that his child has confessed that sir fior-”
L: child of merris?
“Merris and anemone.” He has stars, he has 4 of them, beginning to create sign of old vespertine coin “What will it take to get down into the basement. 10 million?” L: to see it? “To own it.” L: we can discuss after our goals are done, unless ur on a timelimit “I’m on the most important timelimit. My dad is on his deathbed.”
(following the True King of Tunseel’s ascension, sighar went up for grabs but reconstituted by the ir’rao family. They united various factions together, claimed a good chunk of sighar including port cities. Allowed them to grow filthy rich. He has 27 confirmed siblings, 38 disputed.) L: you think the device itself is the most unique? “Yes.” L: what if you brought smth from across the pale “Itd have to be absolutely wonderful. But i’d need smth a bit more. Youre planning on going down there, right?” L: we are, is your thought we bring you something back with your aid in exchange “No. well, yes. But i wouldnt do that, that’s shit. You could bring back a jar of dirt and that’d suffice the deal, wouldnt it? Whatever side- if it were to open up, whatever side faces closest to our continent, i get the port cities of.” L: if we were to give you port cities, what would you- how would you- “You’d need help settling down there.” L: and youd be willing to build them up? “They’d be my cities.” L: some landlords tear down “What port cities already exist there?? I plan on ascending to the ultimate immorality. Lichdom, the sign of sighar’s significance.” L: can you do that without killing your loved ones? “No” L: think this is interesting, im not the best at negotiating the finer details, id like to call my legal council to meet with you. Or if u also have one, u meet somewhere neutral, so we can hash out a deal for us? “I figured merris or anemone would’ve raised you to have some political tact?” L: no im very untrained. We go to get our lawyer
Bows at us “Ulralin.” L: leofric “Pleasure to meet in the flesh. Now how might i serve you?” L: thanks for being here, ik its in ur best interest we make the best deals “We live to serve, anything for you.” L: we have someone- he wants the castle, thats not happening. Hes willing to help repair the machine, but he wants a significant number of port cities in the other continent. legal expert negotiate it down to smth that’s less… we know that he plans to become a lich we would like to avoid infinite monopoly across the entire coast. I’m not as suave a negotiator. “We could postpone it. Or sign for it now and then later when he becomes a lich.” T: draw this out and take as long as you can- “Master throm, how long do you need? I can stall for as long as he has patience for.” L: we want this contract bc of his assistance, if it doesnt happen T: delay as long as possible but be ready “I will be able to get it signed within an hour. I will aim for the prior offer, if you dont mind my eaves dropping, of 2. If its needed for more for the trigger to be pulled, in alkenstarian terms.” “Youre only bound to me til the portal is fixed and the man is brought back here. But youre likeable man. Should i not seek a humble and charitable man?” L: we can be honest with each other “I am! You embrace the virtues of humbleness and honestly. And charity, tho you dont have much to give but you do give.” Go to fey gate Water flowing from nearby lake around the tree, nearby woods are carved out for houses for the fey Odd creatures flutter about, griples, dryads, bobunsiths, etc
One approaches “hello. Solasgran. And you?” S: sachiko! “You seem to be lesser, you know, to take a bow.” “She’s one of us. Tainted by this world, but one of us all the same.” (name translates to ‘hates light’)
“Thaefeasgar.” she bows “and from what of the mortal realms that you hail from?” (bolo’s a legit family of a noble family????) “Do you seek pleasantries or the portal?” B: both i suppose? She will talk about the poems of twilight “And do you wish to go in?”
L: We wish to extend Lady Xiǎohóng domain
S: We possibly want to inquire about expandijng lady xiaohongs domain, the prismatic valley She says some words i absolutely do not understand (irish gaelic) She said her name followed by which is full iof hope and love and eyes without light and without torment “Waht could she possibly bring to said poem?” (we could offer to bring their seed to the new world, open up a portal down there) “And you’ll make it to the mother as well?” F: the mother? “My mother of course. The one who owns the portal and the realm beyond. Stronger than lady xiaohong. I need your word and sachiko’s word that you offer this. Only upon you meeting the mom and a reasonable time to present it.” “You may enter. Though i recommend to prepare your masks with who has taken residence there.”
(going to Milvaserin. Land that was once defined by symmetry, elves had to wear masks to tell each other apart. Its tradition there, lest u be spat upon. Wear a mask or no one will talk to you.) (throm makes us masks. His is a stylized eye, sachiko is floral pattern and then rabbit themed, leofric is his face but no details but the beard, fitzie is blank but 2 stars where eyes should be, bolo is stylized coin) Milvaserin Arrive at the bottom of multiple waterfalls, pink and purple land Several of the people look at us, including 1 leshy wearing a mask made of bark sap and twigs that look like antlers, motions with a vine to throw it down the waterfall Throw it down for us, fitzie falls down into the water Fey waters have a faint smell of flowers Leshy waves “pleasure! Are you a fellow woodspeaker?” S: talk to plants? “No, woodspeaker. Are you here part of the roles?” S: no? “You have quite the talent. You could help make more leshy.” S: no i’m not! (interpreter of the deep forest, talk to some of the trees in the jungle as part of the lord’s will in the land. This area has a lot of courts, its the reason its set here. The lady’s court is by the aquaduct, this one is here bc its readily available to the fey. This creature’s job is to go to the nearby rainforest under the aqueduct to ask if any of them would let the seed become sentient w a leshy seed. Anytime a tree is abt to bloom, would u like ur spirit to go elsewhere and become a leshy)
“Oh the same. Thalin. I like to callmyself the Birch Tongue.” S: sachiko! These are my friends “Pleasure to meet you ‘my friends’.” L: leofric “OH its not my friends. You have actual names.” Throm introduces himself in fey, so does fitzie “Anything i can help with? Do you need a place to rest for the night?” S: a place to rest would be nice! “Ah, a place to rest. Well. Rosa Inn would be nice. Binshad. You would be nice in her hospitality. She’ll ask for a price, but amongst the 5 of u u should be able to pay it.” (how u wish to interpret is a bringer of death. Also irish banshee, has found home in the hearth. Made a house that is as amicable as possible. Stay there til you die. Accept payment in the form of a dream, should you forget it upon wake.)
(the realm of dreams is similar to Ethereal Plane, realm of dreams is plane between here and Feywild.) Go to the inn, talk to the woman Her mask is porcelain, faint tear tracks of gold lacquer “You wish to actually stay here?” Yes! “Most don’t wish. They fear what comes. But i promise what comes when you stay here is great for most. I only ask 1 thing, a dream of the night, tho youll be barred of what comes for a bit. Itll be harder, but making it harder makes it more worth it. Who’s dream shall i take?” Bolo will give up his dream She points at the empty wall, itll grow rooms for each of us Rest and eat of her foods and leave Urozha 17?, 1290 Domovoy, tending the bakery just outside Crawls on elbows and knees “Could i serve anything?” S: what do you have? He curses sachiko Something, anything He serves us bread “And what do i owe for the service of serving?” T: a conversation about the goings on of the city “There is a new queen who has built a palace here, tho she doesnt inhabit it. She only lets those who have seen her enter. There is a king that was before her, but his statue is toppled. His statue created a bridge across, tho it speaks and ask questions, but if u answer unsatisfactarily, then u end up like the miflit (crushed). There is talk of the new town and how it expand. I prefer my woods and the realm i inhabit should someone lost wander in.” Go find the woodspeaker again, follow the trees We follow sachiko Eventually catch up to him “You wish to join my ranks sachiko and friends and throm and fitzie and others?” B: and bolo S: no, we’re not trying to make leshies, just wood “For what?” S: a boat “A boat. You cannot swim across the water? Has the water not given you its name? Then a boat is due. There is one that will offer its branch bc its seedling is smothered beneath it. Itll ask just 2 things: it be quick and not felled on the child.” Go to the tree Tree “could you turn my seedling into a leshy?” S: its already been planted, but we can take down the branch. “Do you have any alcohol to ease the felling?” (throm. Raise the ground around the seedling, then roll the log down hill, itll take an hour but itll fully protect the seedling) We cut off the branch, and now we have the branch Tree thanks us s: grow big and strong! Throm getting to work Build it perfectly, feel odd feeling of workshop. The idea of recreating things for children down south, mimic the feeling of happiness during what its like in the apocalypse To get down the waterfall, we need to talk to a resalka made of mud near the water Sachiko and leofric go down L: hello fair ladies! Mud will move, forming the shape of the prev person that talked (elf) to a woman of human standards “Hello. How can we help?” “And why should we let the boat pass?” L: well it would be most kind of you. “Kind for who? What is kind for 1 side of the war is not kind for the other” L: fair point. (these sorts of creatures need a reason, dont know the politics, but often know the sending of ships which = war) S: we need to speak with the hesperid queen, the big one, thats the only way to get to her “Why do you need to speak?” S: we are trying to expand a little tiny bit of lady xiaohong’s domain over in this area so taht we can traverse to her domain easily from the material. It also will help in the efforts to save my friend throm’s brother whos been kidnapped and fitzie’s wife “If they can survive the initial swell, then they will go down, and we will let her know you’re coming.” The Undyne Anixie The rest of us go down the waterfall, bolo failed fort save, vomits water Go down the eternal sunrise w the far moon beyond the reach. Go down the aqueduct, above are dinos and odd fey moving treeants Pass thru prismatic valleys, various angels covered in green stare and bow Pass 500meters away, then move backupright as if never moved before Sachiko makes food for us Urozha 19?, 1290 Approach the other city, smaller in scale but no less impressive
Deireadhan Various humanoids bear regular iron on them on necks and the like During the time of dark when elves were more plentiful, they asked for solace to go back to first world. Some fey tricked them into becoming slaves, wandering the feywild and becoming eladrin, slaves of the fey. These are some of them. Same marks are found on duke Vantreau’s neck, minus the iron Many bow at us, they seem to move w metaphorical purpose, help us ashore “Could i help you? You are free folk, and none are elves. Tho the gnomes doth decline the offer. Why do you want to come here?” F: the hesperid queen? “Should she be expectign you, the spire. Upon her bridges and to her home.” B: and if she isnt expecting us? “You wont find refuge here, youre not collared, tho theres no such things to worry abt as mortals.” L: (sachiko is the hesperid queen the one that enslaved these guys or what) S: (um) (probably yes) S: (yeah probably) Enter the maze, it seems boundless with so many choices to make. All choices we make are right tho and take us to the bridges Hesperid queen bows, we bow back “And by what do i owe the honor?” S: um. Hi. hello. We’ve come to make a request. I am sachiko of the prismatic valley, its not very big, but i was hoping you might be willing to allow us to expand it a bit over here so that we can access it easily from the material? “What do you offer me?” S: there is a new world that should be accessible relatively soon (compared to you my lady)- “If you wish, i could make you my child.” S: NO I LOVE MY MAMA BUT I APPRECIATE IT A LOT. um. We could take a seed from your land and plant it there so that you may be able to access the land to the south. “Which land do you speak?” S: do you know the pale? “I know of the divine and mortal construct.” S: down there “And do you know what was left in the shadow once [blank] was removed?” S: i do not know… “The roots of the old feywild. That leads down and down through depravity. And why would i wish to build upon that?” B: to restore it? S: make it beautiful like your lands? T: bring light to shadows?
“A simple favor in return. I wish you to swear to take upon it when you get there to go upon the city of the south, go to the city at the deepest of the roots, take of the fallen statues that were petrified of roots. I want you to take where the gold in the vaults come from. I want you to bring it here, the heart of it. Should you say yes, i will give you its name, its true name, and it’ll be binding. We’ll agree to allow your lady to come here so you don’t have to go as south as the Emerald Coast.” “The heart is important, and the heart will be used by me.” “You will try, or die trying. I won’t betray you, and you won’t betray me. There is a city of the roots of that area, deep deep down below.” “Say it verbally, and we can bind.” We agree
“Then you shall go to the roots of the city of Menzoberranzan.”
“The land of Evermeet, where upon life is restored, fey shall inhabit among the roots. Then Nectoria where the sap grows. Going south is where the parasites begin to live, The Thousand Stings. Then to the Redcap Acreage. Avoid The Pit of Jörmungandr. Then go to the Webwood, of where life should cease. But should you go beyond it, you will go to a land called menzobarranzan. It’s ruled over by the spirit of one called Baba Yaga.” “It shall be on both our souls.” “To fulfill my end of the contract immediately, where would you like your lady to inhabit?” S: at the edge of the portal
(any stories mentioning it before? Yes. able to know one. There is a land that the group of adventurers’ never talked abt, named Sarthol. Floating island that has a way down but not up. Mentioned once in a vague story, tho its valuable, u shouldnt mention it freely in a feys domain.) For the 5 days in the feywild, it was only 2 days in the material. Urozha 19, 1290 Back to our home to check on the devil Oh hey duke vantreau He gives a small curtsey “Pleasure to meet you lords at your castle. How was it, did you enjoy the slaves?” Nooooo He undoes his collar area, the iron left a permanent mark “And which part of serving the lord that gives them was your favorite?” “I hope you see now what i hope to prevent. But i trust as people who see wise what you understand what you have given if you had. But you had not, correct?” “The potential for slavery in those lands is surely waht they asked. Of subjugation of those who fall within their realms?” B: that wasn’t asked for? “Is it not?” L: was it not discussed but implied “Wdym they did not ask? What did they ask for?” L: i mean. Menzobarranzan? They asked us to get the heart? “What is that?” L: IDK “You promised them something you dont know???” Hes so angry at us B: it was smth that couldnt be avoided “YOURE GONNA DIE” “I asked you, and i asked you to not sign the contract.” “When i kill you, and i will- “Trust me, it is good for a few to lose their souls for the betterment of others. I of all people know this. So shut the fuck up you pesolant children!!! When you die, i will try to bring them back. Regardless of what youve done now, i will try.” Go to the carnival to avoid scrying (we are going to tell him we’re not giving the queen that) “What is this?” T: the carnival. Good times without worry. Hey we fucked up, sorry man “Why did you promise something you did not know it’s value to?” (he is removed from his control at this point? calmer)

Ehlis Vantreau “Why are you so quick to try and make deals and get this over with? That you would enslave hundreds?” B: we didnt- hm “You didn’t what?” L: your grace. I am beginning to learn- and this is almost entirely my fault, my companions encouraged not to do this, especially bolo. I… am beginning to understand that i lack experience in the world, and i- want to believe that any problem can be solved thru conversation and mutual trade, coming to an agreement- “And you spent less than a day with a fey queen and thought you were going to get the favorable deal initially?” L: now that you point it out, i’m starting to see that the error we made is unimaginable. Your words are starting to see a tiny bit of the terrible we’ve done. Its my mistake that just because fey are bound by certain rules, doesn’t mean that they’re negotiating in good faith or… being fair and i shouldve realized that as soon as i stepped foot in the city, but i was too focused on our goal and wishful thinking. We thought that anyone would be truthful and honest, i lack experience in such deals to make the smallest bit of amends- “You’re in a position of great power, why should i not stop you from making further mistakes? Here and now?” T: if we do not have this righted by the end of the decade, i will submit to execution. L: as will i S: and me. (a decade would be closer, but that is a big ask.)
“You’re lucky, i’m trying to be more like Miryel. But… i still have my impatience before i was under his tutelage.” (she cannot hear us, thats a lot of magic but we’ll find we cannot say the words abt assassination) S: so u know when ppl are in high position of power and some people dont like them- “I could offer you a separate way out, a way to break chains. A thing to overcome a feys pact, is higher fey’s pact.” F: who or what do you suggest? “Same as i did. My patron.” S: who’s your patron?
“Galorfin, at the tree.” L: the tree? “He resides there.”
S: the south tree? “Naturally, what other tree would be notable?” S: i would say my moms tree “That is her tree, and its beautiful. I have seen it.” L: if we succeed in making our way down there? “Make a pact with him. He disappeared on that expedition that 20 some years ago.” “I will try to kill you before it is up. Its not a pact that is forbidding me from killing you. Its only by the good duke siroth’s will that i do not kill you.” F: you’re a good friend to him “He was good friend to me. He freed thousands from slavery.” (oh god we suck.) L: he wants us to make it there??? “He does not, his letter says as follows: hinder them, but do not kill them. Not unless they are to succeed. He did not call to you specifically, just whoever tries to rebuild the keep. He also forbade me from destroying the keep.” S: why? “I do not know. But back to the issue of slavery.” F: the gods have fallen- “And you would do that? Those who couldnt stand up to my fist?” There are some weaknesses in her court, but we’d be replacing 1 chain with another. We’d be barred from speaking such things tho, sedition is a type of betrayal. L: anything he’d want? “I imagine your presence would be enough.” Fitzie tries to mindlink to share the map + idea we want to assassinate via the court stuff and taking down what shes built up
“I know not of her court, we were working class slaves, but i do know of her handwoman, Astana, a weak link in the court. A slave, but a very loyal one. We offered her the chance to escape, but she betrayed us. One of the groups trying to escape. She’s dim, dimmer than even i. Physically weak and easily intimidated. But do know that if you dont kill her, she’ll tell her masters everything. And she may still, if they find her body or soul. Im not telling you to destroy her soul, but there’s a good reason the duke sent a soul somewhere it cannot be touched.” (we can make a soul cage, modify it like sunday, get the schematics from the sighar man) “Why spare her soul? She sent 200 slaves to eternal slavery. I, unlike you, don’t suggest to kill innocent.” B: when did we- “You tried to stab a man up north, unless the winds lied to me.” He punches bolo clean unconscious, heals him back up F: any idea of where she might be? Ik you said handmaiden but “Where the handmaiden is supposed to be, by the master’s side. So she does have private quarters and a chance to roam to the north.” shes immortal when in the feywild “If i do kill you, i’ll try to get your souls from hell. But i make no promises or binding vow.” “I have spent the last few years educating myself.” F: what have you learned? “About teas? Plenty. I wish to be more like my friend.” S: favorite? “i’m partial to oolong.” “I’d offer (wine), but it’s probably too strong for you.” L: i believe you He raises a glass “to you all. And may the 3rd expedition down fail.” F: have a good night, duke vantreau “You too fitzie. And may you honor the rest of your days.” He makes his leave Go to bed 5 new stars have appeared in the sky, but they have yet to form constellations. Ppl are trying to do things, claim glory, or wealth. No matter what, the stars appear all the same
Candlelight keep Someone comes to throm “I didn’t know we have a blacksmith here?” T: who are you???
He is an ambassador staying in our basement T: one of the owners of the building “Oh! M’lord?” he bows “my apologies for mistakign you for a blacksmith”: T: its a noble trade. How can i help you “I was wondering if i could get some of my gear fixed up. I’m not familiar with how these sorts of things go, if i’m to be procured- i apologize my nervousness, i dont often encounter a lord.” T: id have to look over the contract, we can say its on the house rn
His name is Ploeton “Could i get some runes on this m’liege?” T: what kind of runes? “The basics. I lack even fundamentals.” T: alright. Uh. head upstairs and tell leofric to come down here, i’ll get working on these. Lord leofric “Of course.”
Goes to leofric “If you ever need a knight of your realms, i plan on establishing knighthood down southward. Caldrith region in the south, across the bay. I understand its a lawless refuge out there.” L: interesting! Is that why youre staying with us? “It was closest, i recently joined.”
L: did you do the- the BL dungeon? “No my lord, why? Do you know of the BL dungeon, i could go there if tis worth the time and effort?” L: i cant say i can give that strong of an endorsement “If its been cleared by you, i see no reason to go.” L: introduce yourself to the others in the castle? He goes to say hi to the rest of us, tho he does take a second and sit down. Sits at the pews, and the statue is smth we dont know F: i’m not entirely certain “Bit odd to have a statue to a god you dont know.” F: we fixed up the place, it was like this when we moved in “I’m sure whoever had it would feel lovely that you kept it. Its your land, is it not?” B: no reason to remove it, it could anger (statue appears to be some sort of paladin like man bleeding out over his sword. The person is wearing but a breastplate, and the sword goes into a lantern where a candle is in. mix of martial might and odd mysticism)
(clearly a reference to djinn, whoever this is is associated with jungle and genies at the same time) (old sean pc?) (Sean Djinn) F: know anything abt the djinn? “Not really, but i prefer the non-trickstery gods. The gods of a good deal. A strong order and the like would bring peace to the realms, esp in such times as this.” B: who do you follow?
“My lord asmodeus, of course.” Other statue
This one does appear to be someone, repentant dragonborn lying in water. (old Ritchie pc) (Ritchie Dragonborn) Not actually the Prophet (but still blessed be his name) Throm does the runes “Thank you, could i give a blessing in return?” “What kind of blessing would you wish from the lord asmodeus?” T: maybe luck in negotiations He recites a prayer “May you find your way.” Urozha 20, 1290 Leofric has to piss early morning. Instead of the tent, he sees a gremlin esque man packing up the circus, including the lanterns and begins to make a run for it into the woods We run after w godspeed, stitched together mask. It holds up its hands, 2 lanterns that it has “Don’t kill.” F: what are you doin? “Dont take, i need them. Theyre mine. I just dont want you to see me like this, outside of the ringlights.” S: are you the ringleader??
“No right now, just vasili.” He seems to be telling the truth, just deformed T: i believe our good friend is simply trying to get along to the next town any longer than he wishes to be here. “I did warn you- i did want to tell you next time we met. Your house has some antiteleportation effects. Its easy to teleport in, but to teleport out, it seems harder for me. I can move these just fine. I dont know why, i found them one day and i was able to erect them.”
(this appears to be the stuff of dreams. Vasili is from rozen, matches the constellation in the sky. He is mythic, but only in the bigtop. Effectively lvl 20 in the bigtop, but lvl 2 everywhere else. He can multiply himself, but in his little realm, it appears he can be a god. This device only manifested it bc he was desperate and had a dream. Rn with 2, he is effectively lvl 14. At 3 lanterns, he can do teleport, 4 he can teleport out.) “People take from the weak all the time. When i move, i try to hire and actor to play me. No one suspects the homeless man in the back to be the true ringleader. Idk how, but out of caldrith, i got caught.” F: by the duke? “No. he told me he knew up front, told me to stand well. He didnt seem the man to take it, but he did take one after i helped you. He slayed a drake that took it, went out to the river and slew it.” L: let us know if u find anymore “It does get lonely, if you find anyone that doesnt mind the carnival and doesnt mind travelling with.. This, please let me know.” F: where are you headed next?
“I was going to be up in ziliarn, but the first time i visited, i got caught in this form and had to leave. But i want to go back. Vasili the great is expected in the city.” T: we hope to see you again. He wanders into the woods Throm wakes up with memories of a distant grove of pumpkins far to the south. Odd primordial heart that thrums with energy, healing all, radiating pulse of primordial flame, radiates out when he casts his spells, healing others around him We go to caldrith
Throm crafting at Twelvetowers
Working on Erastil Grainery in The Temple of Twelve, familiar feeling Odd spirit overtaking as crafter in the vault hammers and hammers and hammers away Throm loves it
There is smth odd that he didnt notice before on the hammer. There appears to be a symbol. The dwarven inscription roughly translates into “Lifeholder” but its covered in rust, as the crafter provides all the tools he needs bit by bit. Oddly easy with the spirits help to craft the tower into holding smth it wasnt supposed to Takes him the better part of 4 days Leofric is doing some side stories Sachiko feeding the homeless Leofric makes many impressions
Going to House of the Hoard Human and dwarven workers
“Ir'Volsiri at your service.” L: leofric, pleasure to meet you “Are you a man of god?” L: no?
“Sorry, you remind me of my former family. The House Valsiri.” L: who?
“Partitioners of the holy church of sarenrae in the nation formerly known as ensile.” “You look similar to man i saw once myself. That bright glow, the large weapon thrumming with power, but doubt when you set it down itll go into a stick with a rock at the end.” L: uh no my friend made it “Who?” L: thromulous “The shitty blacksmith???” Woman “I doubt-” L: he’s building the tower rn actually “Towers already built?” L: whats been going on? “Thieves downtown, if you want to catch them. There’s been thieves making their way in with the fey from what i know” “We’re the main keepers of gold silver and copper” L: we’d be happy to assist “They turn invisible like, if im to be honest i think theyre part of the blasted school.” “Do you know why yenitaht has such a profitable trade? Do you believe it bananas? No, its the kyber diamonds they find down there that fuels things.” “Only some of the materials they seem to be stealing as of late. Theyve been taking only silver tho, leaving the gold and coin purses, taking only silver.” L: any leads? Or do we just ask around? “Someone like you, someone with a castle to the north. If you were to bring this group to justice, id pay handsomely. But someone like you may need access to exotic or illicet materials. You might have to do a few lines of zerk in front of them to let them in.” “I mean this in the nicest way leofric, you have the air of a narcomaniac.”
Bolo going to Dirmandian Embassy
The receptionist looks at him, Ambassador Dirmain makes his way down “How can i help you bolo?” B: i just was wondering if theres been any changes/news “Are you authorized to hear about these lands?” B: yes?
“Then i’ll need to see paperwork. If not, i could arrange for a letter to be sent to your family, they could inform you of whats happened at their leisure.” B: nooo “They surely already know where you are, so what’s the harm?” B: maybe??? “Everything in life is a maybe, master.” B: anything you can say without such a paper? “Nothing of the matter to outside forces, which you are currently considered. Your family is making a killing in the current political affairs. You could be wealthier beyond your heart’s content in there.” B: at what cost… “Usually the life of mortal kind.” B: maybe when i finish some things on my end, its not the right time “Of course. Anything else?” B: i think we’re good for now… “Understand i will send any missives they send your way. Its my job after all.” B: thank you
Fitzie research at school Collegium Arcanum
Thoqiohne v persuasive and tries to get to not go to the “off limits” area He shows archaic texts that only he can decipher
“These ones even the translate spells cant get right. Theyre written in in zondian and old dirmandian.” (area where caldera resides over)
“Frethiaran, but im sure ur translate spell would help.” He gives 2 4th rank spells and 1 2nd rank of translate “I cannot help with what i do not know, but feel free to browse, but know that the scrolls havent been fully translated. But translating texts fully takes a year.”
F: no worries. Have u heard abt Menzoberranzan? “Once upon a time.” F: anything?
“I know theres a connection to the stars. There was a group of people who found a cavern deep in the well next to a waterfall. It had connection to the old worlds, but the connections were scrawled and connected to an old tree? It was mentioned as one of the parts lost. I may be able to find something about it. Ildor Ilnudor, he has some old knowledge of the stars, and he is better than you. But now is the time to learn from the old masters, and when the time comes, it’ll be time to learn what they failed to. Youre a student until you learn that what the others failed to learn.” Oh yay ilnudor is here He claps and hugs fitzie “I heard you joined an adventuring guild and got expelled??” Ahhhh well teehee “I think its a scare tactic, yknow scaring authorities abt loss of student body.” F: anything going on? “I’ve been out and about too. I went to frethiar! They have different stars. Psychopomps are pissed abt the afterlife there. It seems every even numbered star are not available while in frethiar. But all number of theirs are in tact. Someone has 12 stars over there, well 6. I wish there were more stars in our sky, but theres not enough to compare. In about 2 years i could check!” He thinks “I know the cleric down south, one of sarenrae, meet with her?”
“Menzobarrenzan is where the pale queen is from. Idk much abt it, but theres some connection to her, and a place that we found an inscription from, we eventually found a place filled with drow that was called menzobarrenzen.” Smth witht eh stars?
“There’s belief of a waterfall that was talked abt in the ballads of merris, but nothin but a waterfall. Left an awful feeling, water clean and pure, but such as ciburn is.”
“Some accounts seem dubious depending on ur belief of Auctur, but my account he did the right thing BUT he did a dangerous thing and hes a bard and tells tall tales.”
“He may have gone beyond the pale, but not beyond the waterfall. But there were rumors of constellations of stars that werent beyond the outside. No one in the tale of merris was an astrologer, so no one could read it. They claim good power, and i mean this in the nicest way, that their power was so great that it could be unbelievable. They speak, the world listens!”
“Gods willing it, go meet the priestess of sarenrae. Ill slap the headmistress, and youll get your tuition paid for the next year.”
“I plan on taking a trip up to frethiar. Oh! I forgot! A small gift!” snow globe with a dragon over the town of st. sirnach Bolo sachiko leofric meet up
Meet up at the well Can hear the small pitter patter as smth meets in the center of the area Small thing appears, a rat person Leofric has instinctive fear
“Hello! Im aberdeen! Aberdeen skimberton!” S: hi im sachiko! Shakes icy aberdeen who is slowly melting Not the real aberdeen but whatever is said will be sent to the real one “Its so good to finally meet you! You bested the basilisk, yes?” Yeah! “Which one is the hjemdall and which is the reginald of the group?” S: youre melting, r u ok? “There’s not helping me at this point! Melting me faster would make me slain in battle! But when im melted i’m freed! If slain in battle, it means i need to improved!” B: do u want to get better? “I do not! Ive slain many adventurers!” L: why are you here??? “I have questions!” “Don’t be careful what you say! Be honest!” L: what. Questions?? “What would you consider your greatest achievement?” L: killing the basilisk was cool? “We shall include more in the future! Would you say it improved you as a hero?” L: yeah! “Did the abilities to petrify play a role?” L: not really? “Then we’ll make it harder! So you can get stronger!” S: (should we mention the scary thing wasnt the basilisk?) “You should! Aberdeen doesn’t like it when you dont say the truth!” L: interested in us specifically or just adventurers in general? “Adventurers in general, but ur an interest as of late! Bc of the basilisk, and the house, going into the fey and coming out!” L: have you been watching us?? “No! Observing!” S: thats what that means? “It doesnt! We also use our nose and tongue and ears!” S: would it could as you being felled in battle if you melted faster? “It wouldnt be easier, id be in immense pain!” “This way, its more like starving to death!” B: hungry? “No hunger satisfies me, only the sweet release of death!” L: lets just converse! “Of course, i’ll mark down that sachiko is the sadist of the group! Sachiko yearns for more suffering at the end of life for more people!” Sachiko starts crying L: theres mroe of you arent there? “Of course! I believe i have 100 sisters!” L: please come into the castle for food- come say hi? “Does this apply to the vampiric homunculi?” L: uh- “An experiment to create artificial vampires? Of course!” L: questionnaire type???? “No homunculi will bring you harm outside of those that will enhance your adventure!” L: id rather they come say hi than spy in the woods, so we at least know how many there are B: how do u feel abt the fey?
“I think its great! Do you know abt Hjelmdallermann and the Picrey?” She grows bat wings and flies away
