Caldrith
Meet back up at our fave tavern The Twin Night and Ale
“How could i help you?” Arelis Vantora L: here for a drink “Anything in particular?” L: cider “What kind? Pumpkin?” T: anything but pumpkin please “Apple? Carrot?” T: could you serve them carrot as well A few others filter in, man looks over at the men of the party “Are you men’s knights?” L: nooooo, adventurers but not knights “Whats the difference?” L: one swears an oath to a king L: we can fight but dont represent anyone but ourselves “That sounds like hogwash.” L: are you a knight? “Soon to be.” L: what’s the order? “We’re working it out, whatever one the duke is sworn to” L: much luck! “You as well. I see you want to be one as well, should i putin a good word?” L: no thanks “You seem like the type that wants to help people.”
L: i’m with the Ambassadors' Guild “The group of hedge knights?” T: more adventuring guild “They swear loyalty to- not a lord, but they still galavant like knights.” (just knights that dont own land) T: we are landowners so we’re not hedge knights, but we dont have lords we’re sworn to “I’m gonna own a farm too one day.” “What heroics have you done?” T: we killed a little dragon L: it was a fearsome drake “Me too, one that was threatening the farmlands.” “It was a fearsome creature, it uh- purplish scale, a bit blue, spikes down the back of its neck. This kind of fork in it’s tail.” (wyvern) “Waht about ur drake?” T: tatlswyrm “A wyrm?!” T: yeah, lesser one “A lesser wyrm is a dragon!” T: just called one, not a proper one “Oh, its not old enough?” T: not nearly old enough “Where will you go next?”
2nd voice from behind “where will you go indeed?” Draven Košarek F: surprise! Havent seen u in a while “No, ive been busy. Things have been going smoothly tho from my understanding.” “You’ve already done one of the challenges proper to becoming a lord.” Other man “so you are lords?” F: not yet L: we just happen to own a castle T: theres more to nobility than landownership Coseric “theres the proper chains of authority, my friend. The hierarchy of it all. There shouldnt be equal lords, there should be one on top, i’m sure theyve decided who it will be. But youve done one already in faster time than i gave you credit for.” “You didnt give up anything, it was a splendid deal from my understanding.” F: what can we do for you mr coseric? “I was hoping to see if we could do any other deals. Youve seen my barristers, but we will need a bit more than purpose in order to help you. We need some sort of signing.” F: perhaps somewhere a bit more private? “Of course, but i cannot go to the castle anymore. So we’d have to meet here.” L: id love to know why u cant go anymore? “It was a bit of a stretch of previously established terms to allow me there the first time.” He sees himself out Other man “thats creepy man m’lords.”
T: the current duke is opposed to that man, dont throw in with that man “I wouldnt anyways. Talking abt barristers and the like.” T: fair, as long as u know not to deal with him. We’ve made our bed, now we must lay in it “I could give you a few golds? Itd be the least i could do to treat a proper dragon slayer.” L: your companionship is more than enough, many thanks for the offer. Im leofric by the way
“Oh, Ser Acton.” (Alphons Acton) Shakes our hands, notably stronger than us, worth abt 1.5 leofrics F: a good grip on ya “Good enough to strangle a drake.” T: new tradition, dragon slayers drink under the stars, starting with us. He puts down 1 gold to the nice lady “Whatever the finest thing this’ll get them.” She comes back w something fancier, he stands over all of us minus leofric “Yknow they’ve got wizards in the city?” F: yeah “You dont have a hat.” “Psychics can read your mind at the expense of not being able to read.” Rage baiting fitzie We go to drink outside (he does have A star, but its not a constellation yet) “Yknow ive met some really nice fey before.” L: truly? “Truly” L: i met a beautiful fey in the bath, but i dont remember
“They do that sometimes. One stole my mother’s memories, stole the memory of the birth of my younger sister.” (not common, but does happen when a changeling is placed in a family) L: where is she now? Did she turn alright? “Lovely. Strong as an ox.”
“I live up north, but i figured id head to the big city if i wanted to be a lord proper.” (he is from Blales region) “You have any brothers and sisters?” T: ive on- two brothers “Strong as an ox?” T: the younger is five, the older i havent met “Tragic to be an only child. Im sure your mom and pa are proud of you.” L: they passed when i was young “Grew up in an orphanage and are already a hero?” L: i was raised by some philanthropic adventurers “Idk what that means” L: they found and raised me, even tho- the adventurers taht saved me adopted me instead of sending me to an orphanage “No wonder ur an adventurer, and a lord to boot. Are they lords?” L: i think one of my dads is “One of your dads?” L: they kind of collectively raised me together, the whole adventuring group. I think some are romantically involved but IDK. not sure “No one likes to imagine their parents fucking. Be weird, that.”
S: i dont think my mama does that “Plants have sex, i think. You gotta rub the flowers togethers together.” T: had no idea, grew up in the city “I didnt know a human child could come from a seed.” L: shes a plant. Weird leshy. Yknow how there’re pumpkins with legs and things “Leshies and the like.” L: sachiko looks like a human child instead. The flowers make tea “Will she always be so small?” S: i think so? L: your mom is a woman tho? S: shes not a leshy “Its ok to be small and weak. People used to say i was stupid.” F: you? No,,, “You look kind of weak?” F: shes as strong as the rest of us “Ur all like that?” T: shes a spellcaster, leofric and bolo are frontline “You look like a cleric if i squint” T: my magic is divine “Like a cleric! What god do u worship?” T: i channel minor spirits T: i bind myself to spirits each morning to provide myself with magic. F: a bit thaumaturgical? T: idk not really “Mr cleric if u find urself on the road, treat people. The gods smile on ppl that treat strangers.” T: thats always a good thing to do S: berry? “Id take a berry.” L: was excellent to make ur acquaintance? Feel free to visit us near our castle “I plan to become a knight by tomorrow. The way i see it, a man as honorable as him, should be done within the hour.” T: he might ask you to prove yourself “I cant read misters.” Go back inside, check on inn keeper “Place to stay for the night?” L: i could use one, and wanted to check in with you “Oddly wonderful, tho its only been a day?” L: oh yeah. Long ass day “Id like to go to the fey realm at some point.”
F: would be good to have a Feywild
“I might be related to Baba Yaga yknow?” L: uhh? “Baba yaga’s not real.” L: we thought so too but. “Well its not real. Queen of the hags and all, hags dont have a queen, they work best in a coven. Who would even be in her coven?” (answer: baba yaga is a norn that got scorned by her own kind, manipulated a prophecy which is fucked up. Norns go in covens so maybe she dragged her norn coven with her) “We could talk about other hypotheticals” L: if you have time to take away from ur business, wed be happy to accompany u?
“Maybe in the near future. Rn we’re talking abt things that dont exist. We could talk abt Grumbar? Lord that creates mountains when he walks.”
(theoretically exists, was split apart to create earth elementals that exist between Auctur and dirmandian lands) T: theory, but we dont know for sure S: i do. Its that T: it might be true L: have u heard abt the house of the horde? “I pay my taxes to them so yeah” L: trustworthy? “Well, i wouldnt say so.” L: they asked me to look into smth, wanted someone else’s thoughts “They notably dont take payment outside of silver, which makes me think its theyre devils.” “Obv they cant pressure lords, theyll pay in gold and platinum.” T: v interesting F: its just a bit weird is all L: idk waht to make of it. Theyre generally- not to say trustworthy, but reliable “They do collect the taxes they send it up to the lords.” L: they seem p important. What happens if the taxes go missing. Bad things? “Yes, usually. Taxes make the state run, leofric.” L: theyve tasked me to track down silver taken from the vault. They suggested i might go find a place to do zerk and get connections from there? “Why would u do that? Does the lord not have men to investigate his taxes going missing?” L: oh. Yeah why are they asking me (would be stupid to be devils, but maybe in service to devils.) L: not trusting the guard to do a proficient job, not getting along w the local lord? Maybe they just want a fresh perspective, but waht a perspective “Are you a smart man leofric?” L: NO. which is why im asking for advice “Kind lord was in here earlier. He spoke of you.” L: what did he say? “He called u a coward and indecisive mostly. He also said u believe urself to be a hero, but youve only taken aims that benefit urself.” L: good points “What would be better for the people in ur mind?” L: taxes to be stolen or not? “Depends on waht theyre bieng stolen for” L: idk how harsh they are here, are ppl getting by ok? “No one seems to notice. And im not sure why, but we havent see any disruption in the guard or the docks. The stone on the ground has been set, has it not?” L: we made some terrible diplomatic negotiations “Whats the last thing u did at the expense of urself to help someone else?” F: we fought a kishi L: Fey that lures ppl into the woods to eat them L: lady knight asked for our aid and we said of course “Maybe thats where he got the hope from” L: you dont know of anyone in town that needs assistance?
“The whole town needs it in some way. Duskwater has its hauntings, alongside the Shroudfort. River flooded, swept away houses.” L: if the ghosts werent there, ppl could rebuild? “Duskwater is too marshy to build, but the shroudfort could be a proper fort, yknow?”
“Id check in with Peater before you go galavanting south of his land.” L: if u happen to hear of problems that can be solved, pls let me know “Mostly ppl complaining abt wives and husbands” “If i had to guess where tolook into the silver, my guess is the smartwalk”
“If you havent made ur introductions as a lord lord, id go to Harrowholm. Meet the founder.” Urozha 21, 1290
Twelvetowers, find the priestess of sarenrae’s area (Sarenrae Priestess (Caldrith)) Allowed in bc the sun is out and its shining brightly “How may i help you”
F: the prof doesnt believe me when i say my wife is beyond the pale when i know it “Well, its possible. My good human, could u stand outside while we talk abt this? U may interfere.” “I’m just asking if he’s by the gods righteous. I dont wish to judge a son by the parents.” F: hes a good man? And throm
“Hes good throm, im just concerned abt leofric. Hes the son of the slayers of avare the kind.” They’ll be keeping an eye on Leofric Focusing on Fitzie F: I have great belief in what’s going on “I only ask you to keep an open heart, things are not as they seem despite hard evidence.” F: I’m well aware things arent always how they seem, its just right now, how they seem is… That I have a solid direction forward, and its the most solid direction I’ve had in several months. “And how long will this direction take you? How far, I should ask as well. For she is beyond the pale, is she not?” F: Yes, she is. It’ll take a while, at the very least, if not just the preparation, then getting to her. “I am sorry to bring up such a sensitive topic, but I have no better way to broach it. There is the issue of the fact I believe this is why he brought you here, should you lose your color if you fail.” F: … I’m fine, it was a one time thing. It hasn’t happened since. “He’s just worried.” F: I know he’s worried… “I’m not going to tell him you’re alright, no matter what you say here. I’ll ask you to come back in a month or so’s time. I’ll let him know you’re fine for now, but these things need constant care.” F: I… I’m fairly certain this is the road forward. Come what may, there is a lot that’s going to be happening that I can’t give up at this point. “And that’s fine. My only thing I can ask of you right now is that you try to find enjoyment in the attempt of what you’re doing, rather than a result, so that even if it turns out to be fake or that you couldn’t do it for whatever reason, that you at least remain even if she’s gone. It’s what she probably would have wanted, would she not?” F: You’re not wrong. “Take a breath. Enjoy it. From what it sounds like you’ve traveled almost as much as him.” F: I’ve traveled very far! “Good! Find enjoyment in that, and not just in finding her. I believe Sarenrae will protect her.” F: I appreciate it. Gods willing she’s alright. “Gods willing.” Invites Fitzie to join the prayer to protect Fitzie and the priestess. Brings comfort to those present! :D “I’ll let him know that you’re good for a month or so, but as all that grows, you should be observed periodically.” F: Thank you. As annoying as the check-in is, it’s nice to have. “It’s important to do as people in a mortal world, even if the gods aren’t here. It’s good to bring stability.”
Go to Matthar's Manor Long abandoned estate, ppl leave gifts. No thieves have taken then
Fitzie knows that Matthar exists as a pseudo ghost. Might be a culture ghost or might be real. Rn we’re probably underequipped to deal w him, but ppl offer him wood and nearby things from the city. Despite being on the outskirts of the city, it wasnt washed away Appears to not have violent impulses upon seeing a living creature Throm leaves a brickfrom the worksite from grain storage (throm gets a hero point) House itself is 2 story mansion with detached tower, not dissimilar to aquets green found at the arcanium. Also his ruined boat that he was called a fool for for building in his pond that turned later into a river. Dock is 40ft long, too big for a pond but perfect for along the river
Peater's Patch
Pass over the bridge while a lightning rail passes underneath, pass by The Chimegate that wards against spirits. Cold iron, silver, gold, charged metals are decorate chimes that ring At one point, the master jeweler’s daughter was sick and spirits came for her. Saying that her body was young and so spirits were going after her. He made chimes to ward them away, he used whatever material he had to turn them into a chime His daughter died in peace several days later, her body did not rise again Some of his kids had issues w him smelting down their valuables Go to kind peater, or Simple Peat, cabbage leshy He uses some of his inclinations for natural magics to tell when its the right time to plant. He then asks the plants and theyll say today’s the day Hes at the end of his leshy life “Could i help you young folk?” L: might you be peater? “I might be! The man who raised me, simple man, gave me the first name he could come up with” L: we heard there were troubles with hauntings around these parts? “Troubles? IDK, theyre part of nature, as well as i. Id ask no harm come to them.” L: i see. Are they appeasable haunts? “Oh gods no, they throw brick and stone at your head. But thats how nature is. Ive seen some opossums, squashed under a tree that fell. Sometimes brick and stone falls on ya, and that’s that.” “Sometime the brick and stone levitate, ive heard of the floating isles.” L: i didnt think theyre nature phenomenon? “No, human made. Where else but the gods would they go but the earth?” F: any communication with them or just bricks? “I’ve communicated, but uh. I said hello, they threw a brick back” T: im afraid they might just be dicks “Might be. U know how far i am from where i was born?” 100ft to the south “u know how far they are from where they died?” L: perhaps we could find out if they have unfinished business? “Taking them to their rest place would be the best bet, id think. Where they died. They washed up here when the river formed. Theyre from 100 miles up north!” Would take several weeks to get there “It would be good farmland down south, clean water, irrigation channels. We could even have rice here.” L: oh wow, we know someone whos an expert in the guild, so we can contact them before we charge headfirst before carrying coffins 100 miles. We’ll return! Ty for explaining the situation “Of course. Dont be sad. Ive lived longer than most lettuce.” S: anything i can do to help? “Nature will take its course. My only ask is that if i die in front of you, wake the kind workers and let them know its time to bury me in the patch?” S: of course!
Go to the Collegium Arcanum
Thru Smartwalk into the gardens into the university Illnudor “ur back! And u brought friends! Are u the ppl adventuring w dear fitzie?” Ya
“Wonderful! If i knew u were part of the group, i wouldve brought u back a coin from there. Its minted different, theres a dragon on one side and a tall man on the other. But i think its an elongated man. Its like putting throm on a stretcher” T: please dont “I wont!” He looks thru his pouch, pulls out odd silver coin, shape of a triangle “I have a few silvers, i only have 2 so you’ll have to share. From up there! They call it a gin. Like the alcohol.” “I have my theories. I think it came from an alcohol they brew out from eastward. Our word gin comes from clear and pure-” T: and silver purifies “Clear and pure, and then there’s juniper.”
“Plenty of its coming down, so i dont think itll be collectible, trade being what it is. But i did get it from prime magic school! Theres a beautiful magic city called Heawich. The magic isnt isolated to the green, i do like the green. The towers are built within the city, not like rozen tho.” (non spellcasters = sand analogy) L: u prepare divine spells each morning throm??? “He does???? And u dont?????” L: i just copied my parents (the last animist recorded to have lived lives 800 years ago. The last exemplar lived 22 to 1200 years ago. Depending on how u count living.) T: i believe im an animist “Truly???” T: i have all the telltale signs, my magic is a touch of the divine-
“The last was from Kaldildsted. Where do ur spirits hail?”
T: well idk. I only have slight hints on some, visions of healing light and a field of pumpkins? And the name Lifeholder.
(leofric recall knowledge. He remembers, huddled in a hut. He was in ahouse known as lifeholder where an odd machine thummed like the one in our basement, but bigger. Could extrapolate that he built the machine. And caused the apocalypse of his homeland) L: apocalypse in my homeland
“The one in Frethïar?” L: i’m uh- originally from across the pale “Oh from frethiar then?” L: no the other way “The metaphorical pale?” L: no like down south. Land of giant trees. Or 1 giant tree, ig “Makes sense. Seems to make sense for what could be down there.” L: it does?? Ppl dont really believe “It took 10 years to believe the dragon situation. Some idiots ascribe it to a whale to make fun of us, but yknow.” L: it could be a whale “Its not. Theres an afterlife and a wing.” L: i also was rescued from that land when i was 5. I dont remember much “The spirit of ur people live on leofric.” L: i didnt expect they lives on in throm, esp not the architect of the transportation machine thing? ‘They live in throm it seems! The question is why tho.”
(Joan Calloway niven sowwin wouldve told leofric abt what an exemplar is) L: i also get my abilities from an unusual source. If u havent guessed. Idk how obvious it is. I’m an exemplar?
“Like fi’alemanie?” L: that the- “The new god of war, as it was called.” L: yyyyes. But i have no intention of attempting to claim the divine throne “Well naturally. The issue is, um- do you know the issue with us wizards? Us spellcasters? Those outside of oracles aren’t plagued. Our magic changes us, slightly. The magic inside us changes us, spellslots change us. Yours are affected by the stories told by you, and while us wizards can look at a spell and say no thank you. You’re like the oracles of old” L: fuck “Fuck indeed leofric.” F: insightful “I’ve thought it a bit after the incident out east. I wonder if he was told he was anything but the reincarnation of war would he turn out different.”
F: Our understanding was you had a connection to Urgan and could send him a sending? “Charming lad!” F: He’s very nice! “Spent some time with his wife and him, they offered me some drinks.” F: Perfect match, those two. Awkward exchange about Fitzie’s wife…
F: The one we’re really looking for is Mr Homveran Zenderholm, I know you haven’t met him but… help? “I have a sending prepared every night, I cast it at the end of the night and pray she (The Wife) responds.” F: One of these days it’ll happen. “One of these days. I don’t mean to rob you of the attempt, but just know that’s what I’ll need to use.” F: THere’s always tomorrow. “So far… She’s survived this past month. I’m sure she’ll survive at least a day.” F: That’s a good way to look at it, yes. “What do you want me to say?” L: We’re trying to help with the ghosts of the bodies that drifted- “I’m with Fitzie Fairntickle. Dealing with undead. Need Homveran and a way to get up the river with corpses. Please contact them with payment needed.” He stares into the sky
“Homveran should be here in 2 days at your keep. He asked me not to tell you, the lad is quite wasted. He needs a day to recover before he teleports, lest you get him with his guts inside out.” T: our rugs :( “Yeah theyre quite nice rugs.”
Sachiko House of the Wayward
Has a narrow shouldered man, early 30s, soft brown skin, tired eyes Seraphel Durnewick “Do you need help, young leshy?” S: i’m here to help! I’m here to volunteer “Coin or skill?” S: i can heal! I’m a healer! “You wouldnt lie to me would you.” S: nono Here look! “Thatd work for one, i just want to know if you can fix the many” She hands berry “You can go to the non-viral wards as it were.” S: do u have people that are sick that also need help? “If theyre sick they cannot hold down the berry.” S: i can help with that as well? Um. i am a trained medic. I can help and see if they can feel better, tho i can absolutely heal the injured first if its easier for you. Im here to help “Injured first, loss of blood will kill before loss of nutrient.” “Thank you small one” Sachiko heals people! Finds that there are some people cursed by spirits, some fey spirit perhaps that doesn’t want people being where they are. Throm doing the grain silo
Father rosk thanks throm
T: itd be best to not call me prieport, itd upset folks in the family T: we’re trying to learn abt the shroudfort? “Shroudfort?” T: we’re waiting on an undead expert to help, but itd be good to get any sources
“We have apriest of pharasma in the 12. You trust priests of pharasma after everything?” (theres an issue: pharasma was considered kidnapped, but could she be considered a god if she was taken by someone mortal?) T: who are we to judge the gods “Maybe theyre fallable just like us. Itd explain issues with the world. I do think this priest is highly likeable tho. Obv dont stare in the dead eye.” T: thats the mistake i would make! Ur helping “Hes part of the western tradition of pharasmans.” (eye is still there instead of being removed, effectively the same but followed different paths. Depending on medicinal herbs if u had the herbs to treat a full eye removal or not)
Introduction to Irulian Voss Takes a bow “youre the man that helped the grainery, right?” T: fulfilling our promise to father rosk and the lord of the grainery “Well.” bows, orcish man “thank you for allowing the ppl to live a good life.” T: if i can do good with so little effort, it would be wrong to not try “Little effort?” T: for me “It sounds like a brag, u upended a tower.” T: it was only a few days of labor. My magic helped “Ive seen ppl spend years trying to upend a single tower?” T: well we’re hoping for a small bit of assistance, i was wondering if u could help. We were looking into the shroudfort “Hautned place” T: we’re hoping to deal w the spirits, peat has asked us to not harm the spirits “He asked the same. I was waiting till he died to break his promise. Good man that peat” T: he is, we promised to attempt to do this without harming the ghosts. We even called in an ambassador to help. Any insights to help? “About the ghosts themselves? They are 100 years out of time. During the 2nd to last but the first to final auctur rebellion. Buriment of great houses and the like.” T: so even if we found the right burial place, its not the same lands, is that what ur saying? “Id imagine theyd be lovely, they rose up as a fit of anger, injustice. Ppl buried there were in a mass grave outside the few lords and ladies who survived the river. They fought against auctur, theyd love to go home to see its no longer auctur ruled.” T: its the getting them there “Theyll try to kill you. As a man of quick sea legs and a man of pharasma, i was going to wait for peat to pass on and then do what i must.” T: i understand, we’ll see if our undead specialist has any insights. But we may have to hold him back until old man peat’s gone.
“I know theyre from up near ziliarn.” T: god thats far. “Quite far.” “Anything else i can do to help?” T: no thats so helping, i’ll share it w my comapnions “Are you planning to go down there?” T: yes, getting some info to make the trip easier “Well. you seem a great man, master macer.” T: thank you for that. “Of course. The lady has plans for you yet.” (he believes it) Bows exchanged Follows him out, walk thru the twelvetowers “Try to ignore me if you could. Im not the stealthiest man, i do need a cane to walk.”
Throm walks thru, turns the bend to Dirmandian Embassy and halfway to The Emerald Embassy He stops by the river “it is odd with you, rn. You’re haunted.” T: i do believe thats where my magic comes from “Theyre not malicious, but rather helpful.” T: helpful, but mysterious “I dont know it. But you walked by and that fisherman caught 3 fish when u walked by, all in his net. The water seemed to cease flowing, and the fish feared and swam into his net.” T: today my spirits are one of stone and fire while the other is of rivers “Then the rivers have blessed the fishermen when you walked by” T: perhaps i should charge them a few coppers “Theyd kick ur ass. Master macer, u shant charge a fisherman for luck” T: i was joking “U are a lordling, are you not?” T: by blood but not recognized. I doubt ill sit on the throne, if im lucky ill serve my brothers house “Ur brother? U have an older brother?” T: i meant my younger, but if u dont speak it too publicly i have an older, tho i dont know his identity. “Do u know what my lady pharasma has, its lesser but an aspect yet?” T: reincarnation? “Thats a part of it.” T: death, rebirth, and regular birth?
“Regular birth. I make it a point when a lord as urself enters, u do have a brother being birthed rn, or at least within the week.” T: WHAT “Do u think the counting of ur younger brother was premature?”
T: ill have to speak to sir Expus Mentums, he should know “If u know ur haunted and know theyre not malicious, i shant change it. Its a miracle that someone hitches a ride on a willing creature, its wonderful. Its for the future. Ill tell my acolytes abt such things. They will only try to intervene should you pass and they remain. So please get into contact w them” T: ill let me companions know “No, the spirits, so they know to pass properly.” T: oh! Understood River bends when he passes over a bridge, water moves opposite way Crackle of fire under the ice when he runs Leofric kazuma kiryu style Goes around, catches various ppl doing crimes, beating them up around the night or throwing them until they stop Comes across 2 lords fighting, beating eachother bloody over petty disputes. Abt ones younger sister’s honor, dating from a rival house Leofric lunges, but duke vantreau scruffs him “Should you be assaulting nobles in my city leofric?” L: i was gonna pull them apart so they converse :( “Should you be doing such a thing if its breaking the law, leofric?” L: theyll hurt each other- “Thats a lot of words for a yes or no question.” L: should i be doing it? Probably not, but its the right thing to do- “Are you going to do it? While i watch?” L: i need to start standing up for something Unscruff him “We’ll might make you a hero yet.” kicks his ass into the circle L: is there smth going on here gentlemen? Manages to cause 2 men stop fighting Wont solve the issue in the longrun, stops it in the now Seem to call for various own men to take him down, but those men never come. Those men have been mysteriously knocked out. Unconscious and unable to stop the brute from handling their lords Will stop as long as leofric lets them go saying its a draw L: we wont do this again “We wont until theres another issue.” L: lets get a drink Drags them out for a drink L: whats the source of the feud? Who started? Ik both of u will say its the other, but a lot go on for so long that ppl forget the feud
Lord Rowenbridge, did help construct the Lungton Bridge, state that they should own it since they constructed it bc one of the seers of auctur. The ones who bought it, the Lord Valimir, say they should own it. Decent trade comes over the land. Land bought from revolutionaries after auctur fell L: i can see why ur in dispute, kinda a big ass bridge. Split it in half? “And split my families profits in half?” L: for peace? “Or i could wait for this pauper to run out of money. How much debt are you in? You got 2 years before you lose kneecaps?” L: thats not very nice “It isnt, but its the truth. Its why hes been so violent. Its why i shouldnt let my sister date him.” L: not the same family if they marry? “Our profits would be split in half. My sister would lose everything” L: does ur family still know how to build such sturdy bridges? Other “yes, of course.” L: what happens to your profits if they build another bridge? Owner “oh they may! But there is the issue, we own the one the lightning rail goes over. But i invite them, build another bridge.” L: i’ll intervene if u do this again in public, i encourage u to consider what kindness u could show “Is that it?” l: idk jack shit abt bridges, i was hoping youd have a simple issue. My only answer is blowing it up, but thats a bad idea. U could also hire the other family to maintain the bridge, and ik itd debase u for doing the work instead of owning it buuuut They both leave w hatred in their hearts, but did get postponed Man will sit down, elven eats stick up Vantreau “poltics are hard.” L: its a fucking bridge! “Its a bridge, and it brings in about 20% of the profits into the city.” L: oh “By bridge alone.” L: thats a lot of money “It is. We have an excess of bridges to roads when u think about it. Poltics are hard.” L: itd be so much easier to beat everyone up “It would. But u’d believe its right until someone stronger came along, and then u’d know it was wrong.” L: yes, its better to talk things out most of the time. We’re trying to move the ghosts up the river back to where they were buried, so that peater can have his rice fields “I didnt want to move them yet.” L: oh “I figured peat likes the company.” L: oh! He just- he seems happy enough to put them to rest as long as we didnt do so with violence. Fists. “Im sure he would. Peater’s a kind man. Whenever i went down, i think he was afraid id turn the shroudfort into its former glory. Used to be a fort.” L: hed like it be a rice field “He would. But he doesnt trust me.” L: you wouldnt turn it into a military base right “Why would i. What enemies exist to my south?” L: emerald coast…? “No, if they were to invade theyd do so thru lungton bridge.” L: is there anything troubling folk that you’d need a hand with? “Me sharing a drink with you might be a dereliction of my vows, you are aware?” L: no…? “I told you. The kind duke, the name you spurn at any chance you get, told me to not assist you, to only lay arms upon you should you be almost ready to succeed.” L: ah. I see. I’m not- i didnt consider i’d get anything out of helping ppl of the town “Why would u not?” L: ive been reflecting on the words you spoke to the innkeeper, how we only do things in our own interest. Its not heroic. I should do things without expectations “You should.” “You should do things without expectations. Do things bc theyre right. If they benefit you, so be it.” L: i should think more about whats good than what i need to get done “What makes a hero? Is it strength?” L: i dont- not inherently? There are some that use strength, but its how u use abilities to do deeds that are good or worthy of song. “Are all heroes sung?” L: no. but i should talked about, even if its just neighbors talking abt local boys saving a dog from the river. Even if its not talked abt, itd still be heroic. “I have a new knight that recently talked well of you.” L: he- he was very nice. “He is a true hero, unlike you and i.” L: he strangled a drake in a river “He did so. The drake bit a dog, not even his.” L: im glad he was knighted “Who would i be to deny it, but a villain?” L: i thought ud go thru. Or i hoped “Well. hopefully you can arise to heroics where i can seem like the villain. And should that happen, should u become king, they rise to heroics so that u are seen as a villain. Isnt that the chain of things old and new?” L: i guess. But king? “Is that not your goal leofric?” L: its a dream? But not realistic? “Which dreams are?” L: id be happy if life returned to my place of home, even if it wasnt under my charge. Thats what really matters. “Well so be it.” clinks his glass, walks out into the streets. Throws silver and platinum out to ppl who served him. Wanders off to the duke’s isle Fitzie learning languages Slowly but surely Urozha 23, 1290
Candlelight keep HOMVERAN!!! “Bonjour. Ah mon ami!” hugs sachiko “i hear you have an issue with undead.” Explaining “I did not bring my cart, we should get a boat, should we not.” F: rent a boat? “Anything abt the spirits, what type they are?” (likely lingering spirits) F: lingering spirits? T: sitebound disturbed spirit “That one shouldnt be too hard. How big is the shroudfort?” T: bout the size of this? “This big?” T: roughly so, yes sir “You dont have to yes sir me. But. you know what that means? We’ll have to explore it. They werent buried too far deep. We could theoretically bury them right there. Their souls wouldnt be able to pass on, but they wouldnt haunt no more.” T: push it down the line? “Yeah, but i dont think abt down the line, do i mon ami?” “We should be able to tell when we’re close based on how violent they are. We know they throw rocks within sightrange of the keep, but surely they should draw daggers and casting spells the closer we get.” “Many of us never deal with spirits in our day to day. Should i scope outside while u procure a boat? Or vice versa?” Sir mentums whispers “wahts with the devil worship room?” T: THE ONE TO THE NORTH, IS THAT DEVIL SHIT? “No the one in the basement” T: show me Hidden room with fire imp Appears to be basic devil summoning stuff, and old contracts hidden away. Coded infernal “Hope u dont mind, im a knight, not proper to sleep in the common room.” T: ofc. By the gods wtf “Did u not build the keep urself?” T: contractors :/ “They built a devilish thing in ur keep master!” Throms hand begins passing thru things in the room

“We could convince urgan, it would be for the good of the guild?” T: we’re dropping a lot on ya “Ive dealt with worse since i was 10” T: any iconography abt humanoid bones in the shape of a spider? “Cant say it rings a bell. They made trade w the castle. Lava forge that grabs magma from under the earth Filled with obsidian rn Trolls were tombstone trolls, trolls that are infected w necrotic energies. Incredibly cowardly. Their fave activities is digging into graveyards and eating bodies
There was a hole that couldve been distorted by the Warp thats now filled with obsidian. Direct hole deep where it hits magma Eyeball mushrooms can detach and fly around, belong to Eyelet. Sometimes used as wizard conjurations. Throm is familiar w them, can record info and send it to a book/higher creature Fungus is unrelated to the eyelets, and instead appear to be wasting remains of a great entity that died there Easier to turn a like object to a like object than an unlike object Crack in the floor is from rumbling when machine was activated Blood rock Issue when magic and tech interlink, it can solidify
Any use of magic tech pistol would need to be used exclusively in alkenstar lest they jam This is the run off from large machine that was churning for ages. Can judge that the machine was churning for for at least 100s of years, at least without anyone cleaning it out Can use the run off for magic items Odd thing is well Takes a bit of listening, it is very deep Can hear smth underneath. Running water Cave system further underneath
Couldnt go down safely, but could go down. Would go underneath bowels of the earth that would be part of the Underdark. The river wouldve carved enough overhead without worry abt waterlogging ourselves Well has acted as an air suction for it
Back upstairs, go to caldrith Homveran goes to scout
The Shacks arent too bad, but mostly fisherman boats (not long stretches on the water)
Sunside Harbor is personal harbor, travelling
Mirkwater is for merchants We go to mirkwater Talk to harbor authority
Bimp Noten, gnomish woman “That depends, what do you want to transport?”
L: um. We’re planning to- clear out the ghosts in the shroudfort. Transporting some coffins up the river
“Peater's been good for business. Coffins filled with people? Transporting cadavers?” Yeah “Religious, academic, or personal reasons?” T: probably religious, we’re trying to put them at ease. “Expatriating the bodies.” T: moving them away to the city L: back to their proper burial ground “This will have to go up with the lord. Anything abt the bodies?” Haunted “Salt works on demons not ghosts. I’ll put up a notice, but… don’t expect a response.” “Come back in the afternoon, by sunset. Typically rhe vessel master will want to leave in the morning, so load it up at night and sleep on the ship” Able to meet up with homveran “Well. i know where theyre located” Thats good “Good news and bad news. Bad news is one is very powerful. Good news is- there is a total of 4-5 of them. Other good news is that theyre only active at night, so we could steal their bodies and theyll wake up on the ship. If we fight them here theyll be subdued for a week. We have rites we can do to give them semblance. It wont solve their unfinished business but if you throm could cast peaceful repose, that could buy us another few days.” Throm adding ghost touch to leofric and bolo’s stuff
Fitzie going to Collegium Arcanum and seeing if she can get in touch w the paper sellers
Burnsten will approach fitzie, older student, slight bits of gray hair “You need contact with paper sellers?” Explaining “‘Good thing but… i would support you, but the issue is the papersalesmen arent slated for another week.” Really? “We’re the biggest users, but there are only 30 of us” Trying to convince fitzie to put in votes abt expanding the student body
“We’re no Di Florio Academy, and no The Nexus.” He was rejected from diflorio, he wants to use dreams to help the layman create things
Trying to convince fitzie to like. Get funding to pull the ladder up. wants Ephiane Savile to be even more selective but take in more people Harbormaster
“There’s one that has accepted the request. Odd man from Kaldildsted. He wants to interview you first.” “He said he’d charge 1 gold per day, must be paid in gold or platinum.” “He said he has beds, if you fish on his ship, u can keep it. Otherwise 1 gold per full day’s meal per person.” When to meet? “I can point to his ship, he’s likely there.” She leads us down the docks,to boat with many ores and no sails. Man with blue painted face, odd graying hair “Pleasure to make your acquaintance.” Good to make yours! He bows “You seem quite nice. My understanding is that we’re to be travelling down the river together?” Yes! Interview? “Is one of you to be cargo or gotten later?” Gotten tonight “I can set out tonight once you’ve gotten it.” “I can use the oars.” F: whats ur name? Im fitzie
“Agadul.” “I want to ask, what does death mean to you?” “Are they dead if theyre constant forces in the world?” L: i dont think they’ll be able to fully die- “I would argue a ghost is not dead, nor does it haunt properly.” Hm? “Haunting is a longing for something, but they throw things its not haunting. They may resemble, but they are not the creature.” L: still, there’s some chance their soul is trapped and unable to move on “Yes, and that should be corrected.” H: They need to go down the river and we’re trying to (he is mostly curious abt what death means to us, why we’re taking this on. What does it mean to be alive, what does it mean to be dead, what does it mean to kill. In kaldidsted bodies quickly decompose on the river. If u encounter such a log that is marked with markings, u put it back in the river.) S: can i share my perspective? As a leshy, my perspective is a return to the natural cycle of spirits “Whats the natural cycle?” S: sometimes- “If it can happen int he world, is it not natural?” S: i personally view it as spirits that have been within a body, go out from that body, and either enter a new one or go onto a place beyond. But i think sometimes spirits get stuck in the place btween a new body and beyond, they cant go anywhere without help from others “Its a nice thought. What does it mean to have the right to kill, then? Is it natural, should it be done? If its a continuing of the cycle? If the purpose is to move thru the cycle as fast as possible, should i kill babies?” S: u should make the most out of the time given in ur body, one should ensure others get the same in theirs. There are exceptions- “There are, but we’re talking abt the laws of god and nature. Is the lich not making an exception for himself? What makes it less righteous?” S: liches with the way they consume souls and stop them from entering the cycles are disrupting the natural cycle “Vampires?” S: idk “Blood sucking creatures.” S: well, um. They can die, still, yeah? “And so can liches.” L: do they have to kill to survive? “They do not. They dont have to kill to survive” L: their killer, i might consider in a similar vein to liches, but individual vampires if they wish to stay paused, and their not forcing others to join, it might be ok “Then what’s the natural cycle of life and death if thats ok?” L: seems more like a wheel, you pause on parts. Undead stop in the transition of life and death where u go to the boneyard but they dont. Usually thats bad but.. S: i think of it more like a lake? Kinda? “Id describe it as a river.” S: yeah! Except that- you know like oxbow lakes, where theyre still like attached kinda, sometimes souls go into that loop and then sometimes they go on in that river. But sometimes they get stuck in the spot that connects looping and continuing. Adn thats ghosts! L: since what they want- they have a business, the most compassionate is pushing their log back in and getting them unstuck S: exactly. Just my personal view on death, as a leshy im not the most in tune w my prev lives, ive had them bc im a nature spirit. When i die i go to a new body and have new experiences. Ideally “Well. bring me the cadavers and we can start this. The fee will be 10 gold up front.” F: pleasure to make a deal with you “Pleasure indeed.” Shroudfort Approach “Good news, theres 4. Theres unfortunately mandragoras as well. Hidden near the water.” “Blood drinking plant” “Our best bet is thru the northeastern tower, tho we could go thru southern drawbridge. But we’d have to approach over water.” “Fort is only 70ftx50ft” “Stay away from the water unless u want the mandragoras to join.” Combat 3 ghost commonsers Deianire We defeat the ghosts, time to dig up their bodies
Coffins are nice, clearly of eastern make (from anmoku funeral parlor). He travels w some “Dont worry. Here comes the real hard part.”
Carry coffins to Peater's Patch to get onto cart Get going, peater provides carriage alongside a few work horses that take us in thru the city to baffled guards Homveran “we work with a mortuary”
They nod at the odd tunseelian man, go to the docks where riverboat is bobbing “These are our esteemed guests. Have u asked their names?” Nnnno “But it was a good fight by the looks of it.” B: i helped “You did, tho i am curious why u ran into a corner.” B: yknowww. Sometimes you panic “Next time id recommend boots of freestriding so at least youre stuck on a wall and look cool.” “There are some rules. Dont go into the lower holds, the tech is sensitive. Otherwise, the top holds? Entirely free reign.” Load onto the ship “I have only 4 good rooms and 1 shared room, i can take the shared room for my guests Nono Explain where we need to drop them off
“I have some bad news i have an idea where they came from. Have u heard of the port city of rozen?” Uh oh “It coincided with the expansion of the world.”
Seems to be from Soderburg area, close to the border. Was created w the same river that created the bay of rozen, known as the blade of the dagger of the river. Looks like a twisted blade if u squint ur eyes “A good of place as any. Thatd only take a week.” T: we can keep the bodies in good shape each morning “There is a question of storage. I could, and i wish to keep my methods of maneuvering the boat secret- i could store them below. But id have to blindfold you when you go down. Urozha 24, 1290 “How did u become haunted throm?” T: u can see them? “Ur an animist are u not?” T: oh ur knowledgable “Theyre popular in kaldidsted” (isolationist culture, not uncommon to invoke a spirit attached. Animist are rare, but dedication is not. Guy attached) (he laters himself in blue paint, then white, odd pattern) T: its hard to say rlly, when they appeared it almost like theyd always been there “How did this fit into ur cycle theory sachiko?” S: these are stuck “So we should free them” T: i need these “We could free them, but u wont like it throm. Remove one soul to save… how many throm?” T: its hard to say? I think abt what i need, and the corresponding spirit comes to me
“And the world provides. Yknow, shards of divinity rained on advesperascit. Wouldve been part of ur birth, but they also rained on other parts of the world. Do u think thats how u call the divine?” “Dont worry throm i wont kill u. Sachiko work on ur theory.” T: the priest of pharasma are gonna hunt me after i die to make sure the spirits moved on S: hey do u mind if i ask abt ur facepaint “Of course” S: why? Is it culture significant? “It signifies the relationship between life and death. White is life, blue is death.” S: interesting! (he does have dark skin like inuit person) “Each one i carve in a river of blue. Babies have white faces, elders are almost entirely blue.” He has no stars Goes at during the stars “Why did you pick stars?” Huh? “For ur field of study” Grounded her, stars were changing and she was too, etc “How old are you?” 24, turning 25
“You can see the wings of Frethïar in kaldidsted. Mosaic pattern in the snow. There is one thing im curious abt tho, would it be wise for a gnome to take a while to do a thing they know theyll like to push off the bleaching” Idk, do the things u like now instead of stretching it out says that we wont have to worry abt fitzie being a lich, yeagh Talks abt in frethiar how under certain moons, they shine thru the wings of the dragon wonder if u can see into here from there Devil book is in both diabolic and in code, will take a while to decode It appears to be a treaty talking abt how devils should come from another should behave in current hierarchy at a lower level in exchange for ur freedom Other part is binding marks to identify such creatures. Masters wont have it, but slaves will. Identifiable to devilkind, but not to the layman Caught bolo and leofric in common area “What does it mean to be good? B: good in which way? “Good to the world.” B: doing smth for the betterment of not just urself but the people of the area u live or just around u, where its not just clear cut good or bad, sometimes you have to greater good, lesser good, etc “Have you been doing good?” B: ive been trying “What have you done?” B: i havent murdered anybody- “Many ppl havent murdered, theyre good or neutral.” B: -in some years. Well. L: ur trying to be better? “That is true. Bolo-” B: i never claimed to be good “Does this sentence make me good. I have never raped someone.” B: no? “That is good, we’re in agreement.” B: i hope that stays true. (ears that hear the truth, hes been trying to gauge worthiness of us. How justifiable it is to let us live, let us die, waht does it mean abt our beliefs to deliver some ppl to their final deaths) B: sometimes things have to be moved forward or extended, sometimes you have to.. Like sachiko’s cycle, u have to remove smth to let the cycle regrow and rebuild “What have you removed?” B: just a theory. Say smth stopped the flow of the circle, if u remove that, flow starts. If smth was stopping the safety of the populace, removing that is good. L: huh B: u have to clean things up for them to work properly. Imagine ur ship, what would happen if nothing was rowing ur oars, it wouldnt move “So what have u done?” Bolo leaves B: im working on it “Work harder mr bolo. Please close the door behind u.” “And what good do u wish to do? And what good have u done?” L: ive been thinking abt it lately, cause i want to be a good person but ive been pretty pursuant of my own interests- “Does doing that make u abad person?” L: not necessarily. But i’ve been very focused on making progress in my personal matters, not keeping an eye out for the obvious haunting in the city that i couldve helped with. So… i mean. This feels like a good thing to do to give ppl closure. I dont think i can clear out the medical ward like sachiko. I separated a fight between some nobles, but after i separated them, they told me abt their land disputes. We didnt resolve the problem, i just used my body and size to stop them. Which wasnt what i wanted to do. So. “And? Where does that leave u now?” L: leaves me thinking. Im good at using my shield to get hit “Is a farmer not good to use hoe to pick up and hoe the land?” L: i need to remember i can rely on my friends to cover things im not skilled in. i should sit with fitzie, see if i can make heads or tails of the bridge thing. Maybe theyll listen to someone with good ideas. “Maybe. Itd be good. U have wise companions, and brawny, but wise as well. Theyll carry u far.” L: yes! Yeah. u make a good point. I might not have the best ideas but i can speak loudly “So speak loudly their ideas.” L: thats what ive been thinking! But when i ask fitzie, it goes better “They usually eat flesh, no?” L: yeah that was the problem, and i thought abt cutting off my hand, but thatd be bad. But we found some bees. “U could lure them out with honey? A troll is a sucker for sweet treats.” L: we want to parlay but theyre scared “What kind?” F: TOMBSTONE TROLL “Hard to make peace with. Ud be wise to put them out of their misery .they still have regeneration of normal troll, but body is constantly rotting, countering the effect.” L: healed?? “With great effort, but then u’d have a regular troll. Would be noble” L: are regular trolls bad? “Eat meat, be rough” Explains how the trolls wouldve been affected by void energy “Foul necromancies might be at foot then” L: then we should investigate more, wouldnt want more necromancy things sprouting up “It likely would be behind the mineshaft” Dont expose the pangolin to the necromancy “U could trick the trolls into eating the rock. The tombstone trolls enjoy rotted food, leave honey to rot” “Good luck leofric” He and zenderholm talk abt loss on the deck, talk abt the nature of it and mortality

Audovère fi'Alémanie the First Abilities from homveran He now has 2 reactions per turn, at least King fully kills viktor like 3 times, he gets better King for some reason has been saving his 10th rank spells MORVIE KILLS HIM
At 7 runes The king lets us rest for 1 hour Aura sight Current attitude: friendly. He does like us Emotional state: fine, small nerves getting to him “And what will u do if you win?” K: Go home. Die Y: capitalism
D: u know grim reaper? Who is he
“A parasite on the river of souls but a strong hound. Hes much like u dasa” D: he is??? “Seemingly owned by your own whims and desires than any goal you would achieve.” Y: thats an insult D: HOW DARE YOU “Are you not saccharine and masturbatory?” “We’re having your final meal. We shouldnt talk too much about masturbation.” “I stabbed the grim reaper in the chest until he gave in.” The drink he serves is awful, tastes putrid, almost like daffodils cast in margit wood “It was a drink of the time.” “I have hobbies. Im well read. I enjoy leading prayer.”
Y: have u read my book “I have” Y: what do u think. Any critiques “I have a few, its basic advice, a lot is sensationalized so its too broad. Its not the worst thing i read in this century.” P: what is?
“Dick Mullen.” He gives yurei a copy
V: my sister. Where has she gone?
“Right now outside of our reach. Hidden in a realm of dreams. But we will get to her.” Combat again
FUCK HE GOT PHEYLOR TENTHALL Mirror And 2 more Phil moves homverans soul onto the afterlife from the king Dasa gets him down Viktor torpor poisons him The king’s ballroom finale, it is a wedding venue

The King's Ballroom
Audovère fi'Alémanie the First holy book is on the altar
Look out over the balcony, see the sky and ppl of tunseel seeing our battle on the moon Phil dispels shadow army with manifest He yells and the people on the ground move alongside him, affected by his yelling Get his fort save down: any time that the populace see our ass get beat by him, he gets more invincible. Opposite is also true, anyone charismatic can get the people against him He has 1 glaring weakness: a skeleton actively rejecting him. Could embue it with life and it could strangle him. But also yurei could control it
She implants her malignant seed in pharasmas bones Skeleton begins bulging, escapes the flesh for a split second, if only to drive his own dagger into his neck He drinks viktors blood “do you see them all praying?” V: for your downfall “Theyre praying to me. Ever since i was a child, when i entered a battlefield they started praying.” The king kills rosalind Rosalinds fine The king kills viktor “Its okay. Youll be back. When i ascend i’ll bring you back so we’ll do this forever.” He gets up Downs phil, she gets up, he downs her again “It’s good for gods to have strong- resilient clerics.”
Auntie Miko takes over King “do you promise me a good fight?” Auntie “yes.” Downs dasa “i didnt want him to interrupt.” Downs auntie “3000 years for that?!” Downs morvie, downing aunties creation He casts a mythic spell on him- FAILS BC HES DEAF Swaps saves to fort lowest, will, reflex Viktor gets the final blow, “i’m taking my life back” spits on him The king smiles. He’s left behind worthy heirs Demiplane begins collapsing Pharasmas skeleton is gone, naught but ash. As if it was never there. Pharasma died a long time ago. The reason for the runes was a ritual for her to get form again and her soul bound. That was the only purpose of them. With him dead and the power spent, the runes are no longer. This process can no longer be repeated The moon cracks, allows the sun to wash over tunseel

sessions/undead-campaign/act-5/session-7.description:
Prev: Session 77 Yurei is able to pin back the dirge of death into the world once again
Ppl see a god smited by undead and see the ghoul crawl up to him Horrifying Throws up darkness to hide it Done within a minute
Ppl are thankful abt the sun returning to tunseel
Go back to the palace, see the extraplanars leaving the castle Its now drenched in blood Yurei needs smth from dasa Y: GIVE ME MY SKELETON BACK. GIVE ME MY BONES D: u really want that back? D: u may need to sort through it. He dumps 18 sets of skeletons They find their bones
Shino hakusa successfully retrieves her siblings Aki Hakusa Tone Hakusa, alongside sowwin Joan Calloway and niven “Thank you for my life.” M: no worries. I feel like everyone separated from their family should be reunited “Do you know where you’ll be in 3 years?”
M: uhhh. Absolutely no clue ill tell u that. Ill check back with yurei to see if things are fine, bring Kasumi back home, go around see where these body parts are from. Otherwise not really. I could be back at the temple? “No i want to spend time w my family, far far away from here if youre going.” M: i have a lot i have to help w, theres a lot that have been affected, id like to help as much as i can “It’d be good to do some good for a change. Tho i uh…” she doesnt have the king’s blessing anymore, notably weaker. Needs tutelage to get back to where she was before M: i could help u get back if u want “Itd be good to have my own strength to rely on, and even use it to do good.”
The next few days are uneventful given mass confusion of the area. Mass armies that kept appearing, they’ve stopped. City of brazenthrone still stands There’s the issue of succession w king of tunseel. He’s no longer in the palace
Viktor abdicates 2 thrones: ensile and tunseel. Thus 2 kingdoms die in the same day The king of tunseel is never found again
Fighting spreads, theyre too within accords of advesperascit for ppl to invade. In 3 years time, itll become like three kingdoms of old 3.5 times theyll have their first election During said time plenty of work for phil and morven
Interrupted by very pregnant Shiryo Anmoku + Florence Anmoku returning without kasumi, who will have delivered a message
“The northern lands dont know of erastil and are in need of great help. Much of their continent need help with ruins” she’s elected to stay, invites morvie to join, in the nations where giants and dragons reign Those places up north are Very Wild as befits erastil. They so need the help Shiryo hands yurei paperwork Stating that even tho viktor renounced his title, theres an argument that as his legal parents they could gain exclusive rights to tunseel. They just need yurei to trick viktor into signing it. Viktor Barely sees thru They want to pass a bunch of laws that benefit their business Viktor big sigh. Agrees. Hes gonna be dealing with legalese for many years The local government implodes in 3 months, but 3 month head start! Rosalind during the chaos, gets the army of dolls and children Having successfully hunted down several lesser devils. Most of the children grows up in the house Auntie Miko built back in the early sessions in Fathrell Kholeran visits her relatives

Lulgar Mudriver talks “you’re my… grandmother?” K: maybe. Probably. I could’ve been. And then i died “We got our name from other grandfather that married in?” K: ummm. I am. Far older than he was. The king nods solemnly “Will you be living with us?” K: no. i just wanted to see… the last people in my family. King “just… do her a favor, let her follow you around for a day. Ik its odd, your family will be rewarded. Let them see that life goes on.” K: i would like to see that. It would be nice to know that my family is still around. And dont worry. But ive learned not to say never in this world.” K: that’s true… He escorts her down for expeditions downward. Escorts to the bottom of the stairs, he shakes. “This is as far as i go. This is where you can take over.” K: okay… well….
Rosalind and viktor, both set up near each other in tunseel near vitry-seilave Rosalind runs the circus of misbegotten youths, viktor spending times with his parents at some points Viktor gets help with the blood rock Phil dasa rosalind help Release confused elves gnome and humans Some need immediate medical attention, have spear wounds
Get to a leader amongst the rock Irastra Fair haired elf “What of our nation? Our people?” V: Not the nation u remember. Its been far too long but you can make home best you can here. tho it’s rocky situation rn :( Where can we go? V: Well uh. I mean i can escort you out of tunseel but theres a whole world out there! It’s expanded there are places beyond the pale! Places of dragons and giants and all else We need to go somewhere in the wilds. If someone can escort us over the mountains V: yes, If youre not opposed to them being made of bones?
Dasa leads them into the wilds just beyond the mountains of vitry-seilave to Jafatan To the eternal autumn trees, they might be able to conquer the once inconquerable wilds. Better than living where their people died Takes the better part of a few years PHIL GOING TO HEAVEN? She calls her 8 dearest friends, some sendings Meet up, does her 1 minute casting of interplanar teleport with herself as the key
Force us into heaven, into Naderi’s version
Small riverland with a bridge leading lovers together, before the river sweeps away the bridge, causing them to go to the boneyard 1 angel, the biggest angel Bows “Are you philomine?” P: yes!
“Visacile.” P: pleasure to make ur acquaintance. “Pleasure’s all mine. Any of you lovers of each other that wish to pass on peacefully?” Uh. no “All things pass on.” P: ill have to pass on at some point.
“Even shelyn and naderi passed on together, did they not thru the divine gate?” P: so they did… “If there’s anyway we can serve you here, let us know. Or if you wish to see ppl at the end of their lives. If they have a lover that is dead, the lover may wait here.” P: if its alright for me to spend time here? I wish to help… we are of the same beliefs and goals. Um. so it is my desire. If we have any wrongs to right in the material world, but id like to spend some time here. Yeah if you wish? Set up a way for the party to contact phil. Eventually phil is to go down and talk to people abt heaven Phil becomes somewhat of an undead hunter technically. Hunting those that achieved immortality
Dione is not seen for the entirety of these years
Viktor doesnt find her, but rosalind travelling with the circus goes to Porlumiè where she saw fit to hide in the place named after her old sire Lume j'Estrilla Shes attending the circus not understanding its rosalind at the night market Rosalind disguised as a halfling R: i apologize for approaching, but i was wondering if we could talk for a moment? “Of course, my family would love to be able to talk.” Her kids from 1k years ago are excited to talk to the performers R: hello my friends! Messages dione R: its rosalind. I was hoping we could speak, apologize for the disguise. “Of course.” She makes an excuse for the kids, walks the streets of the port. R: i… we havent seen hide nor hair of u in some time. I hope youre well “I am. I… hope you dont mind, but i do fear its on purpose.” R: i imagine so “I fear my childer like i feared my sire a bit.” R: well. I… promise not to sell you out if you are that uncomfortable. “Its fine. He doesnt need to know where i am. But know that as soon as the las tof my born children grow old, i think ill pass on into the circle. But till then they deserve a good life. Free from all that we’ve seen.” R: that is what im hoping to do here. It may not look it, but many of the performers came from seeing many of the things i did, sparking a bit of joy is the least i could do for my friends and ur children and family “Especially with the wars going on.” R: especially so “Do you know if viktor is taking place in politics?” R: its my impression hes not engaging with things as much as im sure ppl would like him to, since he’s heir to the throne by some metrics “He’s wise to do so. He shouldnt engage. This nation has had too many kings ruling from the shadows.” R: i quite understand “And when your kids are grown? What will you do?” R: i havent grown tired of performance yet. And there’s more children in places they shouldnt be. I dont have plans after this, but i imagine ill be on the road for quite some time.” “Mm. still, nature of us. 1 day we’ll stay the same and they’ll be gone.” R: so is our nature. May seem childish, but i prefer not to dwell on that. At least not yet “No. the world has had too many scheming undead.” R: some could argue its a scheme of sorts “Running a circus?” R: running a circus of runaway children who really shouldnt be here according to their parents, or so i’ve heard. “Rather unambitious in the grand scheme of things. It gets a pass.” R: well. Given my promise that i dont plan on sharing ur whereabouts, nor do i plan on staying, is there anything u want me to pass on?
“Just let him know i’m sorry about everything. And his sister is doing well even if she doesnt want to see him. She was saved by a kind witch from the north from my understanding.” R: im glad to hear that. Even if the family is separated, theyre alive and well “Thats sometimes all you can wish for in the world.” Rosalind offers the kids to get a backstage tour She returns to her family, rosalind can check on her Sendings to viktor abt it Viktor gets a knock at the door
Gorvain Lecrân is at the door “May I come in? Asking out of courtesy, not vampire. V: as long as you’re not here to stake me “No, I just have a question V: what’s up?
“We have a child and out of the Anmoku Funeral Parlor we’re offloading this one on you. You’re the best choice and Elaine looks up to you V: this can’t have been an easy decision “No, but it’s the right one
His allegiance is to the hunting of undead first and foremost, but he also has loyalty to homveran Viktor has the greatest feat and also is the best person to raise a child “She wishes to be a fighter. We would offer compensation but you’re super well off. V: yeah i don’t need it
“And we need to restore the Monastery of the Northern Sun. So your compensation should go to the temple right? V: yes of course. If anything else is needed do not hesitate to contact. But yes I can do this. Are you ok with this? “She has had trouble talking since the master’s passing. V: yes, it’s not an easy thing to have seen for certain. It will take some time to recover but i will not force you to talk. Feel free to live in my home, see what I do. I can train you, not necessarily in the way of homveran, but im sure it will make him happy regardless. “It may be hard but he left manuals behind. If you could train that way, although your way is undeniably effective V: yes it was effective. Lets hope nothing worse than him is to come “Have you been engaging in violence lately? V: no. i’ve been abstaining from it and will for a while to come. It’s not my place to pick up a sword and slay someone, but I will do so to train elaine. “Then I don’t need to stake you yet V: well lets hope it doesn’t come to that. Can I offer you anything? “No I should be going. There’s much to do. And in the wake of all this, many orphans to find homes. Many who have a hatred for vampires, even if she seems to not harbor one. V: i do not blame them. Perhaps it’s best if they have more training. We do not want more kings to rise “No. and hopefully our benefactor this time doesn’t have a vested interest in making sure he is not staked She doesn’t speak for about a year, but viktor does his best to teach her She wakes at the crack of dawn to train, so yurei helps build a covered area for training
Phil visits gepard “I found out more abt the auntie possessions, tho i fear its a bit too late?” P: ill hear abt it! “I was not in tunseel where it was visible” P: what did u find out? “I found out it was related to poisoning. When a member of the family is poisoned thats the only time it appears.” P: according to yurei she died from poisoning “It allows a connection between the two. It need not be fatal, clearly its not.” Florence is using lead paint. Yurei may have contracted auntie via lead poisoning. Shes just hangin out in there (the poisoning) Theres going to bea lot of records, can we get everyone w you on record? P about what happened? Thatll be a good idea ill contact them This is infringing on book rights (from yurei) Yurei tries to get everyone else to stop before yurei writes their book Yurei doesnt really go out of their way to stop anyone but morven and rosalind Would u punch a yurei, morven =(( Phil has a very romantic and communist representation of events Gnome takes alllllll povs. But asks “your names r public but legally do you want them to be attached to this?” Most people say yes. Rosalind says no. witness protected. He jigs intermittently Kholeran has something to say Picturing cinematically. Camera just on kholeran. You dont see who shes talking to. Limp ghoul face Ive wanted to say goodbye myself, i am going home and i am going to die there. They want me to forge a path through the warp and there will not be a way for me to return before my new teeth kill me. I wanted to see you one last time. Its so hard for me to feel and so hard to remember. But i will try to remember you. Like i remember home. I hope you don’t forget me even if i forget you. Goodbye my friend Camera turns and splits to each individual party member. =(((((((((
Morven hits Yuki Seppänen up Experiment time :bangbang: and paid. Also. to help the nearby areas She wants the money to go to the nearby areas and to kasumi Eventually it wont be the prime temple of erastil, as he deems (bc too popular) Consulting auntie Unfortunately w the runes now gone, she cant separate from yurei without killing her Yureis ok with her staying She can control yurei’s body 10mins a day Eventually able to be done for like an hour a day Occasionally wake up hungover as theyve come to expect New headquarters at the old shrine where aunties body was burned
Entered a begrudging relationship w church of pharasma. They dont like yurei At All. but they did save Saevi Kurohana's life, head priestess of her, so while shes alive they cant really do anything. Not without it causing a stint This amt of actions does drain the funeral parlor to waht it once was. A simple one that is run by florence and shiryo, with a small child that sends out flyers. Go child Unfortunately, her research doesnt quite pan out to bring back her lover, but she’ll continue it. Dont worry, even while yurei’s corpse is dead, she can still control it 10mins-1hr a day to continue her research She does plan to maybe bring back her lover even a little bit better than she was in life Yurei keeps chugging, branching out to create a twin city up north. Doesnt rlly need to exist but By God will exist. Yurei invents spirit halloween effectively Dasa leads a new group into the forbidden woods, allowing them to live where no life should be. All invited to brazenthrone by king drosa “It has happened. And i do need your funerary services. I think it would be appropriate.” (after oneshots) Go to capital of brazenthrone, using whatever power drosa has to bring us “Ive heard that the rules of this are changed. If you think she would want it, id pay to give it to her. Theres a chance we could restore her back to true dwarfdom. And not as a ghoul. Requires resurrection beyond my capabilities. Ill pay for the process, ik what it feels like to almost become a monster.” “We couldnt find her full body, but we did find this” her skeleton
Anemone Veremund, Aace Arubedo, and Aberdeen Skimberton also can help. Also sowwins here WE GET IT NAT 20 (as ume???) THE FIRST TIME BRINGING BACK AN UNDEAD AS LIVING Kholeran is back! She has a full belly for the first time K: oh… im not… hungry? It feels like a hazy dream, hard to remember. Certain it was real. Feels like a dark dream with a flash of darkness at the end Drosa warns kholeran that being resurrected this way means shell develop a fear of the dark, its why he cant go down into the warp
Have a celebration at the Ambassadors' Guild
Meeting urgan’s fiancee gawain nooks Getting drunk on a free tab
“I plan to name the first border city into old grundiir after you, kholeran.” K: oh. I appreciate that. Maybe ill stay above ground for a bit “Its good. Being above ground did me much good.” K: i think it’ll help. The party celebrates one last time together cryign…
