Homveran and agadul talk abt loss with each other Sail upward and northbound Fitzie catches agadul to talk abt why hes helping us A: excuse and reasons seem to be mostly used by those doing wrong, no need to think too hard about a good deed “Do you mind if I ask, you dont seem particularly much like a merchant, how did you get this ship?” A: well this ship, I built it myself. I was trained by some of the finest kaldestedian shipmakers and applied the techniques to the wood i found here
“I dont think ive ever seen any Kaldildstedian ships A: They tend to use the ships for the inner seas
“What brings you here to Caldrith?”
A: They say that all they good ship makers work a river, I had dreams of a river. It is a fine river but it seems the wrong one. The one I saw had jungle, and before you ask I did try the emerald coast but those rivers were wrong too
(As he talks about it, it seems that he chose this river because there is a jungle/woods around caldrith and a jungle around rozen, this is one of the longest rivers in the world, but it is not the right one.) A: “Still, until I have a better inking, there are worse fates than sailing up the worlds longest river “If we find a river that matches the description, would you like us to send you a message?” (He is able to go up the coast all the same, with his odd mechanisms down below) A: Why are you doing this, taking these bodies? “Well they didnt deserve to be left there rotting by the side of the river, they deserve to go home. It helps them and old peter.” A: And there was no other reason, less altruistic? If it was pure altruism, I have my doubts youd ask me my own motivation
“Its not purely altruistic, you see I’m trying to find my wife, shes not really where I can get to her right now, but this path I’m going on I want to help people the way they help me and its kind of necessary to help out those around A: What if while youre helping others you miss the chance to save your wife? “I am taking it one step at a time” A: a very mortal view of life, or death “I don’t know where she is or what shes doing, but I know the stars will guide me” A: You pray to the stars fitzy? “I dont know, its my field of study, at the very least its grounding” A: do you think the old stars may have gone to their own afterlife when they disappeared? “Its possible”
A: Maybe we could get a priest of pharasma to tell us if they appeared in her domain
“Theres a priest in caldrith, it doesn’t hurt to ask. As it is theres new stars every day.” A: Look at it like this, those that are born now wont know they lost anything “As it is right now the stars that I know are not the stars that my mother knew growing up, or anyone before, its a whole new world astrologiclaly” A: and I believe a new era as well, theres debate among scholars that we should restart the calendar “Oh, restarting the calendar, that would definitely be interesting, what do you think?” A: I think the stars are a good way to mark the calendar, the stars that we had in the past did not exist during the era of gods, and the stars we have now did not exist in the era that passed. “Do you think when pharasma ascended an entirely new set of stars?” A: I’m not familiar with those times, I know when the gods left behiind the divine gate they took the stars with them and when the sky reappeared the stars were entirely new (Fitz would know this, actually more than he does, there are at least four eras of stars if the most prolific theory is to be believed) (He knows of 2 of the 4 that you know of, the line is not so clean cut as in this example) “I mean if we differentiated the eras by stars I mean as it is right now there are many many stars forming and it seems there connected to different peoples destinies, maybe when each era ended thats the end of their destinies. That would make sense if when the gods left their stars disappeared.” A: Maybe, but we the mortals that remain still name the stars after them, so it does beg the question of whose stars was it at that time “Surely based on my own experiences, the mortals who ascended their stars would have been in there” A: but no mortals ascended during that time “So it does beg the question, whose stars were they? Right now I don’t have those answers for you but in the future” A: Oh I dont expect it to be found in a boat on the river, as great as you are, no offense Fitz
“And my professor he knows more than me I’m certain, theres a lot going on with the stars that were uncertain about, like me its day by day playing it by ear” A: Still, us boatmen are happy. Do you know how hard it was to navigate at night without the stars? “I can’t say that I’ve been on many boats in my lifeb ut I can imagine its quite a relief they’re coming back then. Have you always been a boatman?” A: As long as I can remember yet, and her mother and her mother, I’m the first male one though “I’m sure your mother is very proud of you at the very least A: On the other side, I’m sure she is [He will sail before you can give your condolences] Leofric asks if hes mortal “Of course. Are you not leofric?” L: i am, you just, w all respect, have a very… ominous? Way of speaking? That makes me think im missing smth, i was wondering if you were a psychopomp or smth, seems very storybook boatman journeying with the dead, so i figured id just ask
“We’re not on the River Styx, leofric.” “I dont think that we are, so i would say i am mortal. Most things are.” L: that makes sense. The way u talk abt your past makes it seem like you just appeared one day fully formed, its ok if u dont want to talk abt ur childhood “We can talk about our childhood if you want.” “Psychopomps arent exactly in full force leofric, im sure ur aware.” (after the incident with pharasmas body and the sudden thing up north in frethiar, the psychopomps have been relaxed. A lot going on, theyre very disorganized after their literal will was stripped from them.) L: yeah, i kinda figured w them in disarray that it wouldnt be so unreasonable for one to go on- not vacation but… travel “I imagine a psychopomp’s duty takes them wherever in the world. Theres no need for travel. Ur blunt, i can be blunt w you, what was ur childhood like” L: um. Uhhh. what a great question. Do you want the madman answer or the other one? “The other one would be a life no?” L: technically true, but starts later. I pick a pint
“Are you from Frethïar, during the great loss of life up north?” L: madman or not, bc thatll be the answer to the question “I already think ur mad” L: im from the south, beyond the pale “Hm. so where does the mad part start?” L: ppl dont really believe me. I wonder if the river ur looking for is down there “It might be. Tho it is a bit alarming, no? If the river could be beyond the pale and we dont know what lies beyond it, my river may be anywhere, and it may never be opened in my lifetime.”
L: if we get down there and find a river matching “Is that land where fitzies wife is?” L: yes “And thats why ur travel companions?” L: yup. There was a great extinction of life there when i was a child, some brave adventurers took me back, the way back is lost “You mustve seen a lot of psychopomps in that time.” L: none, actually? “Why is that? If there was a great extinction, those that are neutral would still have to show, those that are evil would delight, and those that are good would have to do what they can in those circumstances” (death was halted, was a child and adults were cagey. Likely whatever the thing the creator made was able to expel extraplanars and execute people. Their way of life was the only way that remained) L: the extinction event was caused by a device that halted death, and as best i can guess, many creatures like psychopomps can bring about death. Someone mightve found a way to get rid of all sorts of beings that would bring it back “If they could halt death, those beings stood no chance.” (he gives a quick prayer under his breath. Puts his arm into an empty sleeve to do it) “Your childhood was good outside of that?” L: it was a nightmare. I was one of the few infants born at that time, now that i think abt it. (one of the non stillborns) one day id like to return and see what happened. Maybe bring people back to the lands “Even tho they wont be your people, likely?” L: even tho. I dont think animals were affected, so theres animals and things “The curse was one of the soul, then?” L: idk the mechanics other than dying again and again. Im one of the few people who never died before the curse was lifted. “I wonder how other immortals were affected by such things” L: huh. Like liches and vampires? “Naturally. Devils. Fey. demon.” L: idk if i encountered such things, but thats gotta be horrific i assume “I imagine devils and demons were starved, were they not? A thing that survives on souls, and a lich, would be crazed by hunger.” L: i didnt consider things like that would be there, undying “They do eat souls, would attack each other.” L: i suppose there might be fey left there, itd be interesting. It would make sense. Regardless, i should become a worthy hero before i try to go down there. “Naturally.” He shall keep row as the ship goes upriver slowly but surely toward rozen Fitzie finds and talks to homveran
“Mr homveran do you happen to have a moment, I have question. My mother was part of the Ambassadors' Guild, but mr urgan hasn’t heard from her in a while. You wouldn’t have happened to have heard from her would you? Apparently she hasn’t been participating for quite a while.” H: I joined 5 years ago, would she have been around then? “I believe she stopped showing up about 3 years ago” H: I can ask some of the other senior members when we return, if you’re worried about her health “When we talked, it seemed like she was still active in the guild, so I’m worried she might’ve been lying about that” [shots with bestie] H: This work takes a toll on us all “She just seemed so happy in the guild” H: and I’m sure she was, it is a beautiful life we get to live through it, and occasionally we will meet something that leaves us not ourselves “I just don’t know why she would lie about it” H: I don’t know if shes lying, I think maybe in her mind its the truth. I’ve seen it a few times, and……. I think in her mind shes still dancing in the halls of the guild. “I mean I hope thats the case and nothing too terrible has happened, I would really appreciate if you talked to the other senior members” H: of course, I’m afraid I don’t know too much about her, do you know anything about the role she filled in the guild? “She never got into too much detail to be honest, she was always just busy H: She has your last name? “Yes” H: Then she wont be too hard to find. While she was active, probably something akin to leadership of the guild, there is a tradition of leadership calling themselves by their first name. Those of the younger generation sometimes like to use their last names, but its all first names, it is a bit awkward to ask for a last name if you don’t already know it, especially if you don’t have to fill out paper work. “Yeah if you hear anything I would really appreciate it, i just dont really have the way to contact her easily right now. H: could you not send? “I do not have the capabilities of casting that spell right now, I’m not that strong yet.” H: I’ll ask urgan directly, have you not tried asking him? “I did, thats how I found out she has not been technically part of the guild for the last couple years, she just hasn’t reported in for a while” H: ok.
time for more sippies, fitzie now owns an Anmoku Funeral Parlor themed shot glass (homveran is so far away from tunseel logistically, he might be here for reasons similar to leofric) Leofric goes to talk to him
L: are you from tunseel? “Oui oui” L: fuck yeah. Thats far, what brings u here? “I wanted my own life and… i could not sleep accurately in my own home.” L: oh? “I, ah. Saw a lot when i was young. And sleeping became an issue despite me staying there. Some kind folks gave me money, so i started my next life.” L: i heard there was an exemplar in tunseel. And youre… were you there for that? “Yes.” L: shit “I am… thirtys” L: um. I get that, leaving. To start a new life. “What are you running from, leofric?” “And im trying not to judge you of exemplars in the past.” L: much appreciated. Tho you are a person of great character to have gone thru that and not preemptively punched me “Why?” L: just in case. My parents obv were very- “Youre from the south, no?” L: yeah “Some of my family did talk about you.” L: they did????
“Yes. My uh…. Father travelled with one who lost his life there. The pumpkin known as sowwin. It was brief, but nice travels in my youth.” L: who’s your dad? “Homveran.” L: oh shit, yeah. So you know that whole circle of characters? “Distantly. Why do you ask?” L: mostly just out of curiosity. I feel like i dont meet too many who actually know know my parents “Theyre hard people to know. Do you know them leofric?” L: idfk “Then no. if you dont know, you dont know.” L: i gotta ask them some questions, but rn ive got my own story to tell. “And what a story it is! But you are from the south. And thus i did hear a bit of what happened. U understand the destruction that can happen from gods and the like. And i can understand the destruction coming from mortal man, achieving too much. So i do mean to ask- which way i the right path then? If its not mortality or immortality.” “Neither man nor god.” L: i mean. What a question. Homveran, im not that smart. Im pretty in favor of mortals choosing their own path, tho mortals can get pretty strong. But gods- its just a whole nother level “Are they?” L: probably. “Gods themselves in some form have been felled in my lifetime in this world. Even by those u call parent.” L: yeahhh. Ive sworn an oath against the divine, so “Than i shant try to turn you oathbreaker.” L: appreciated. I have no plans of doing what that guy was doing, ascending “Then what are your plans?” L: well… do all the good i can in this world during my lifetime. And then die. L: get a wife, kids, learn how to do taxes. Urozha 30, 1290
Eventually enter into the area in Ziliarn Boatman docks at one farm despite our confusion He points at a small rock along the shore “It has an insignia similar to that on the corpses. I have good eyes, it helps for a boatman.” We take paddleboats meant for going to shores, his boat cant go into shallow waters. Go to marshy area where there are vineyards This area is famous for vineyards He is right, the stones do seem to have isignias on them These appear to be 2 keys crossed over each other. Stones seem odd. They bear an archaelogist mark to check age! Seems to have been made within the day, dirt hasnt covered it yet. There is a scholar here Vineyard owner is clear as day: halfling lounging, and there is an elven wizard nearby. Her mouth moves but no sound We wave, halfling looks. “You customers?” L: greetings “Pleasure to meet you, youre early for harvest season. Ur at a bit of an odd time, unless u want a summer vintage early. This has the faint scent of apricots and leather.” L: huh. That does sound lovely. We cam unfortunately for non-customer reasons. Apologies. We’re from caldrith, down the river south “Im familiar. You recently had a big order from me. Festivities of course.” L: neat! One of the farmers- his land was haunted by a bunch of ghosts, their coffins and bodies washed down the river. The issue for stars, the past and the future are similar. no way to tell the difference. Since the stars are new, i tend toward future.” B: is there a way- if maybe its new to being visible but it was there already, would that connect to the past? “How would stars be invisible? Unseen, yes, invisible, no.” B: yes! Not new, but not visible “By what lands did they come from then.”
“Stars did appear when Frethïar’s border dropped, but they blinked out within a few months tragically.” Fitzie “This one is of the past.” F: how can you tell? “It came from another constellation. It was gifted to you, your first.” F: what constellation??? “Its not much one” points at one with 2 stars “more a line, not dissimilar to yours”
Lila gave up one of her stars F: i dont understand… “I dont either, but it means shes still alive. Only abt 43% have survived after getting their stars. It only works out for a select few.” Hundreds and hundreds of stars have been created L: what. Is a star? “Well. that depends on which school you subscribe to. What desnan schools do you follow?” Leofric knows the basics
“If youre part of the school of navigational thought, stars are heralds of destiny. She calls from the dreamlands, and some ppl believe that ppl are using the dreamlands to control our reality.” L: like. Lights from the dream world? “Yes. but they do exist materially for now. Should a creature die without fulfilling its destiny, then the star fades back into dream but still remains visible. Those are illusory stars. That takes 100 years tho. Its only possible to see someone died before their goals were fulfilled way after the fact.” L: super interesting “Of course. Anything else i could help you with?” L: do i? “None that you want to know about.” F: that means there are some? “There are. But it might be best for you to forge your own path for now. Im not a navigator.” L: what do you believe? “Im an Interance. I believe we create the stars, the heroic deed appears before the star for all but a select few.” L: oh! I see. “If she truly wanted us as a prime directive to follow a destiny, shed give the stars so that those in waiting would know, instead of the other way around.” “I speak not to divine what she wants.” This priest doesnt have stars Sachiko
“It appears her star originated in rozen and migrated to wherever it is now.” L: anyone else with stars? “Id have to be able to see them. The stars dont follow you around.” F: how does a star migrate? “Theoretically if its attached to a pocket of dreams and that moved downward, it would as well.” F: many cases? “I think i can know of three stars that have migrated.” T: does one keep migrating? “A few. One does. Why?” L: weeee know someone who only has stars in a specific location- “Thats not true. The stars remain, but they may not be connected to the body in that case.” L: being in that place would let the connection- “Form. imagine trying to speak at a room volume 100meters away in a field vs a tunnel.” L: have u heard of someone needing objects to connect?
“No, but documentation is few and far between. Its a miracle the rituals we had survived. Up until 20 years ago, only one person had stars still. Fi’Alemanie.” Dirmandian Embassy to go to sleep
Drow man Ambassador Dirmain working the counter “Do you need room?” F: that would be nice, yes “Of course. This would obviously be on the queen’s coin. Unless you are paying for yourself?” B: i’ll pay “2 gold for the 5.” Gives him 3, he gives keys back “Will you be coming down for breakfast, or should we deliver to the room?” We’ll come down Osnova 8, 1290
Dirmandian Embassy He’s there still working by the time we come down He’s eating at his desk L: good morning! “Good morning. Was everything satisfactory?” L: yes of course “The food will be to your right. If there’s anything, please don’t hesitate to ask.” Only 1 other person working ambassadorial duties, one automaton who waves and drinks down a slurried food mixture, then standing up This thing has a core, but appears to have a pixie using this thing like a mech Throm approaches T: good morning! Creature responds via speaker “good morning!” T: i couldnt help but notice the well crafted device youre piloting “You like it?” T: its fascinating! “Its a little warning in case they were still around.” T: huh?
“An empire that had an army of these things tried to invade the Feywild. So we killed them, took their corpses, and made mechs out of them.” B: that’s handy “We’re still getting the lady of the situation, we only recently reconnected with the world. For us its only been about 5 years ago.” (wouldve been about 1200-1300 years ago, dragboni empire) F: howd you get it running again? “These things, they ran on soul. But it turns out you can affect the core if you have magic and are small enough to fit inside. You do have to clean out the crystals, but they give a big boost in power.” She slurps her slurry S: whatcha got there? “Grape! From a nearby orchard.” S: ill have to go try their sunlight “Of the orchard??? They dont grow sunlight there?”
S: im sachiko, im from the prismatic valley. Who are u? “Prismatic valley’s still alive?” S: yeah! What do u mean? It just came back
“I thought it was lost to the pale.” S: no! No? L: as far as we know its only 10 years old? “A nova prismatic valley then.” S: i suppose? I dont know of an older one
L: Lady Xiǎohóng? “A minor lord.” L: if this person knows your mother its unlikely its another? “Or maybe its a seed of another one.” S: ik my mamas old, but she didnt just appear. She came back and made the valley “It didnt get lost across the pale, in it.” S: where are you from?
“Kashu.”
Land just south of rozen historically, tho displaced in time. It was cut off during the closing of the divine gate B: any other fey realms that got lost? “Of course!” rants all 100s and 100s of them. T: whats ur name?
“Sare.” (Sar-ey)
Leaves to talk to Ehlis Vantreau Thank ambassador dirmain for his time, apologize for being so short with him last time “Consider it forgiven.” L: thank you!
F: have u heard anything abt House Redhand? “The assassins? Theyve been making a killing. Unfortunately its turbulent times, so its a good time to be an assassin.” L: why? “Rumors of succession.” B: people pay for a lot of things to have a better outlook for themselves.
“The pale queen has missed a meeting, the first one in 12 centuries.” F: not an amazing sign. “No. and it has gotten the more rambunctious families into believing its time to remove themselves from the tribal system.” T: in favor of what? “Depends on the family, but mostly monarchy. A change to absolute monarchy.” F: who’s vying for that the most?
“The Zhiholm is the most likely.” They are a drow family, notably located within the capital, already in a good seat. If theyre right, they can take over, if theyre wrong they can claim it as keeping the peace. All reporting to the capital. Poltically speaking, its a fairly lossless thing. L: being waged in the shadows? T: assassins instead of armies?
“For now. But i promise you its still a wonderful land, and as long as you stay here, youre less likely to be caught in the crossfire. The best places right now are alkenstar and the darkwater area.” F: have things here been alright?
“Of course, theres been a turnover of the guard. But numartu lets us do what we see fit as a freecity, so we’ve been doing well! Not a whole lot to comment on here. You’re pretty aware of the duke. He has calmed down in his older age.” T: knew him in his youth? “Every elf knew of him.” L: why is that? B: bc enslaved…?
“No. he let an influx in of people at the border of what is now modern day twin noxra, and he helped with the rozen incident, which fell under twin noxra. Hard not to know him, he was much more violent back then.” L: where did they come from?
“They feylands, they broke the slaves out themselves. Duke Miryel Siroth made a pact to help free them. With a devil. The current duke was gifted this land bc he was the right hand land of the old duke. He was his rage in battle.” L: together romantically? “Just rumors. Dont get me wrong, the new duke is a master in battle, and i think makes a good leader.” T: i sense a but? “No, a despite what his first impressions were. U have to understand, the first time i saw him was he tore an abomination in half and drank its blood in battle.” (he’s a bloodrager!) (also cast primal magic) F: ever see the old duke? “Of course. When did u come here?” F: abt 6 years “That is around the time he got more reclusive. But he was still contactable.” B: what was his role before?
“A liberator, initially. He was born a slave. And then he was a liberator, and he helped protect the people of rozen. Then he went across the pale on the 2nd Merris Hasalk voyages in order to aid others.” L: the southern? “Yes, people say its a rumor, but id say it was true. He’d never confirm or deny though. He and duke vantreau (bows) travelled down there as companions to aid the expedition.” L: i had no idea.. “And when they got back, they were gifted 1 reward. He just asked to be crowned duke of this lawless city at the time.” T: he requested this place? “Naturally, maybe he knew what it’d grow into. The first 3 years, the city tripled in size, and then it tripled again.” F: and what of the current duke? “I know he travelled. And he never visited. But they’d send letters occasionally. Ive seen him writing. And he kept all the letters that the duke vantreau sent him. Why does the duke vantreau not like you?” T: might be best if we dont say- i doubt hed want it public, its a bit of an embarrassment on our behalf as well L: in our pursuits, we made dealings with some enemies “And what goals are those?” F: we’re working on opening a way down south, past the pale “And he… disagrees with this for some reason?” L: it would likely endanger the old duke. And it requires a great deal of resources quickly, we entered agreements with ppl directly opposed to the duke without knowing how much old history was there “Youve been lovely, but let it be known i side with the duke.” Hes so lovely we want to as well “All the same. Anything else i can get you?” L: no, and let us know if there’s anything we can do to help. “A fine thing to do. Queen guide your soul.”
Collegium Arcanum Throm and sachiko going to the greenhouse She lays down in the dirt Throm plants sachiko like at the beach To the library
Hi Thoqiohne
He doesnt want to talk to his niece “I dont want to taint her innocence. Ik that if shes here she wants to study under me, and my knowledge is dangerous. Im at peace.” The clockwork? “That and the guns.” Guns???
“I was the one who gave him the dualing pistols that he shot children with. And i was the start of the war.” (downtime of talking him thru the process, unfortunately science and magic often produces mistakes before produces results. He made mistakes so she can get results.) “I’ll consider.” F: that’s all im asking “Of course. And for you all, any books i can get you?” S: ur gardening section? Points to an area with local plant life and nearby plant life He tries to sway topic away by working his job
T: any books on someone called lifeholder? “Not a name that i’ve heard. Could put out a request?” T: thatd be fantastic, hes a craftsman of some renown
“I’ll send the request upward. Are you going to talk to the headmaster?” F: yeah “Will u pass the letter on?” F: of course, anything else “No. 2 requests, a form that needs signed, and an application.” B: do you have anything thats just abt magical items in any known ones? Compendium? From lost times?
“There is Volo’s artifact almanac of course.” B: can i check it out? “No. fitzie can though.” Thick tome by 1 volo Volo might be a title or a reincarnating person, ppl are unsure of which
Mostly a chronicler, not really involved in adventures, but will write them down. Good fortune means he gets a good story with not insignificant embellishment. He recently wrote abt the downfall of the auctur empire. The current one talks abt frethiar, its done but its going thru editing rn (oh fuck. Volo was last dating a guy. Yaoi arbul time) Fitzie goes to the central tower
Several smaller towers, rises high and goes over merchants hill and partially into Duke's Isle The headmisstress’s office is built along the other circle with a full balcony that lets her observe the entire city The ward on the door says “fitzie” as she enters “Thought i expelled you” F: hasnt gone thru yet! “11 months still.” “I suppose ur the one asking abt lifeholder?” F: uhhh throm is She holds it up to the flame, burns it “he brought abt the end of the world, best not to bring it up to the duke.” F: oh! I see! She waves it away with prestidigitation “It has to go through the duke.” F: That’s fine! More than hwat we knew, I’ll let him know it’s not a path to be lookin into. “It is, just not this way.” F: More private study? “Yes. At least this way, I burnt the letter in front of you.” TBH even if it wasn’t something he wanted to tell us, he wouldnt anyways “He doesnt like you.” Yeah… “We got into a debate about it.” Is that part of why I got expelled? “Of course. It was either get funding for the school or keep you, and you don’t pay enough tuition.” Yeah that makes sense. “A part of it, of course.” Is there anther part? “None that you should not be able to divine for yourself.” Yeah thats fair “Tis is a city built upon paper and stone of course.” 🎶We built this city on paper and stone🎶 Of course. (what) If you don’t mind, I have a few more questions. “Of course, you’re still a student. If I can answer, I will.” I was particularly curious about your magic, with bringing students and letting them in. I know that when I entered I wasn’t hte best candidate bt you still let me in regardless. “You were the best candidate, the world just didn't realize it yet.” I don't particularly know how you knew that “Are you familiar with divination?” “Consider mine more like… A child near the sand if you will, with various dunes and hills, and mine, a marble. I do something smart so I can know where the marble should be, and wherever the marble rolls has the most potential for the outcome I am seeking, and that’s how I pick.” Did you have one in mind for me? “For you in particular? No. The school? Yes.” What’s the outcome? “To turn this place into a grand place of wizardry like one I once studied in.”
Like Di Florio Academy? The Nexus? Shyvana University?
“I was a student at Heawich Wizard Towers before the war. One of the teachers lost his mind.” (fix this i think) I mean, you have become a great diviner. “I did learn some of his secrets on how to know if someone is worthy and has potential.” Really??? “And I’ve decided to apply it to this new age of stars.” I mean, it’s working out I think. The school’s still growing, and we have a lot of students with a lot of potential. “And all of them have done something good, or will do something good, even the most obnoxious, and even those who haven’t done good yet are on the path to becoming good wizards.” Is it entirely stars based or something else? “Mine doesn't necessarily go fully around stars, moreso whatever the person is oriented towards.” How so?
“Are you familiar with the dragon marks?”
Only appear on ppl born in Frethïar Show in times of great duress “For example, I could enact a form of duress upon them magically not to harm them, but to activate the mark, if not temporarily. I could allow you another star temp.” Do we have a lot of students with dragon marks? “One, and he has done admirably.”
Rithor ir'Dithas I mean, I’m glad he’s done well at the very least. I love this school, so I hope it grows and becomes as great as the others. “He might eventually get a greater one, who knows?” A greater mark? “Maybe, who knows. It’s yet to be seen.” Can I ask, what brought Lila here? What did u see in her? “Potential. More than most. The kind that helps shape destiny.” The kind that helps shape destiny… I just am realizing I don’t really know what she was studying. I know she studied under you, but we didn’t talk much about it. It’s… I’m realizing I don’t know her that well, all things considered, which… ain’t amazing. “You knew her as well as anyone could know her, but her study had to do a lot w the fey and its connections.” I did know that. “It had to do with the crossover of the fey mostly, and how it is to happen and how it is to be. She was researching a potential place where the fey would cross over seamlessly, without needing designated portals like ours.”
You think thats why she went down south? “It’s as good of a reason as I know, and can tell of course.” Did you know that she gave me a star? I know that you have a star, does it’s origin matter in the grand scheme of things?” No, but the fact that she was able to and that it happened, it matters to me. At the very least, it’s something to thank her for. “You have enough to thank her for.” It’s just… I don’t know why she did it. I was hoping you might, but… “I don’t think she did it.” You dont? “I know one she was with that could do it, and had done it in the past to one he loved.” THEYRE GAY! Do you know why he would have done it, then? “None that make sense for me.” Well. Maybe he has info that you nad I don’t. “Maybe. We never saw eye to eye, but saw echo ther as necessary evils.” Really? From my understanding he funded the school a lot. “HE was lovely, but was also the kind to collude with devils, which never ends well.” Why, ifh e was so lovely, why didnt he like you? “You’d have ot ask him.” Unfortunately he’s a bit past the scope of where we can reach rn. “For now. But he’s in the schope of where you plan to be.” Thats the goal at the very least. IF we get there, it’ll be a very interesting time. “Do you drink?” On occasion. Are you offering? “Of course.” Anything for you! Drinking :> “It’s only going to get harder, you know.” It’s not easy as it is. Things are… when youre trying to do good, it’s very tricky not to fall into bad habits, and, well… We’re trying very hard to do good. “Better recently.” Better recently! Not rushing into things as much. “Unfortunately, the good thing to do will take time. It’s very quick and very easy to do bad.” And unfortunately so… I fear that after the scare a few years ago, I rush into things a little bit, but.. I think taking a moment, taking time, will be good, not just for me but for the rest of us, and hopefully it’ll be good for more people as well. “Well. Hopefully so. Good luck, Fitzie, if that’s all.” Inquire abt hand auction, going to local collectors

“Vailith.” S: nice to meet you! Looks at leofric “youre a good man. If there’s any book in the world i can get for you, let me know. Just make sure (rises to abt 8ft tall) you don’t give the books to her.” L: generous offer. Any book? “I have friends who have means of getting what you need.” L: um. I- your offer is very generous, i am from a- well. Down south. Wherein the only records left are written records from before the pale was closed. Vailith “Need help reading leofric?” L: i noticed- are you- are you aware there’s a door behind this bookshelf? “I’m aware” L: oh, where does it go? “To a room.” L: a secret room or? Just a room? “Most things are secret to most people. If i were to enter a new home, and the door was unlabelled, would what layed beyond the door not be a secret?” L: i suppose so. Its secret to me but not to you? Bc u’ve opened the door? “Of course’ L: what kind of room is it? “Storage room.” L: probably got a lot to protect, to keep them secure “Yes? Im mostly just curious, its not often u see a door behind a bookshelf He moves his hand, and the books push against the shelf allowing him to open the door He goes into the secret room L: neat! Incredibly good to make herbs out of S: hi! Where did u come from? “The swamp!” S: makes sense! How long have u been here? “2 weeks?” Sachiko wants a greenhouse Crawling ivy is used for anti-scrying “We work with a glassblowing shop so it has bells and such it moves when its moving” He suggests 2 greenhouses bc of moisture levels S: any plants thats dont need light? “No theres just fertilizer in storage.”

Leofric its just an inn L: do u get ppl looking for others? “We get self righteous ppl looking for others. If theyre in my inn theyre under my care.” L: how much does it cost to stay here? “Depends. A shared room for you all? 1gp each.” We’re getting scammed Police station Half elf cartographer “Pleasure! Are you here to look at the latest maps? All accurate according to adventurers?” T: any particular guild? “A combination.” t: anything local?
“A few things here and there. We have a thing known as a Verdant Grove. We have a fallen temple. Three sets of catacombs. A large well that might be a dungeon?” “There were some side passages found in the bottom. Could be a creature, could be a dungeon. 2 gold, no refunds.” t: we’ll think on it. These paintings did u do? “Of course, i like to go to the ones that got cleared out.”
One is arbul’s dungeon BL Circle, there are also rozen ones. One is familiar to us but not the characters, the temple in Frethïar where we first fought Belanor Sarberos There is a little bit of cheekiness, one is a dungeon thats known as the dungeon of secret doors colloquially T: how much do u sell for? “They take a while, id sell for 5gp. Theyre mostly to draw the eye in.” “I might have a customer i promised that dungeon to? The blackroot as it’s known.” Leofric takes it off the wall, she looks in horror. Ppl are moving around the area Throm puts 10gp on her desk “Thank you…”
Nothing for the Coin's Curve Go thru. Men pointing weapons at us Woman in charge L: um. Im leofric! “Ik who you are. Youre the man who entered the house of whores on the coast. I have to ask you. Are you a whore? Or were you a victim?” F: whats a whore? “One who’s a devil or consorts with them.” T: i do have a question. Those dwarven made weapons- they’re fantastic, grand, they didnt have markings tho, i wanted to know who? “Hervin did.” T: excellent! Thank you! Back to u leofric. L: we areeee under contract with a devil. We’re working on it “How?” L: great question. We dont really have options that arent making worse deals with other creatures?? Age: 42 (Born Venrach 6th, 1222)
Forcefully adopted by Shiryo Anmoku, Florence Anmoku, Yurei Anmoku
Assaulted by a woman, Dione, heavily injured in Frontillé. She attempted to stop, but couldn’t.
He when he awoke, he killed his sister, Sabine Keson, but strongly regrets it.
i guess fucking king of Ensile now???Character Info
Mom: Léonie Keson (née de Montchalin) - Seamstress - Grew up in Frontille, had Viktor with a man called Rosaire Fauveau who skipped town the moment he found out she was pregnant, Viktor does not know him personally but his mother still talks about him like she misses him.
Adoptive Father: Anatole Keson - Elf - Writer with a focus in romance novels (Night Under the Seven Suns, a short series about a priestess of Sarenrae and a priestess of Pharasma overcoming hardships and falling in love, was notably popular for a time) - Moved to Frontille from the capital not long after Viktor was born, ended up getting wooed by his mother and they got married soon after. Ended up raising Viktor as his own kid, but didn't hide that he wasn't Viktor's bio dad. Wasn't the closest with the kids since he was too engrossed with writing, so he's not that knowledgeable with what they're actually Like, but he tried on occasion Character questions Who are you now? Viktor, human? A medic, mostly, but can hurt when cornered. 40-ish.- Why are you the class you are? Why not another class? Being a vampire requires a certain bit of stealth, a bit of a silver-tongue, just to get out of situations he hadn't wanted to be in. He'd never been a very religious person, nor did he have the strength to haul someone out of the way, but he had a nimble touch, and over the years, he was forced to hone it into something like this. What do you specialize in? Medicine, mostly. He was handy with a scalpel in life, and he still practices where he can in the modern day. Describe your characters personal edicts and anathemas. Come up with a situation where they would to go against these beliefs. These may change as the adventure goes on, we just need a starting off point. Master the Art of Escape: Always have multiple escape routes planned; a successful exit is as important as a successful entry. Do no harm. Pretty self-explanatory. Of course, it only extends as long as he's not the one being harmed, or he's taking a risk. Never abandon the injured in pursuit of personal gain. What are your characters goals? What do they wish to see in the world? Help more people than he harms. Make amends with the people he left back at home. He wants to be How did you wind up in Ensile, in a small town where the mountains meet the river? Traveling from town to town, grove to grove, under the cover of night, mostly. It's pure happenstance that he ended up here How did you get your abilities/class? Were you formally trained/a weird by product of undeath/gifted natural? He wasn't very good at it in the beginning, but overtime has gotten quite skilled in slinking into the shadows. He regrets those early days, where he didn't know how to control his hunger and he'd gotten caught one too many times by too nosy of people. Who were you when you were alive? Dr Viktor Keson. He had his vices, like the occasional drink before bed, or making bets that he couldn't hold up half the time, but he wasn't a bad man. Or, at least, he didn't think he was. Was 33 when he died. What did you do while you were alive? He was a small town doctor; he took care of the people in his home as best he could, and he was pretty good at what he did. What is your strongest memory from before then? How many memories did you retain? Patching up a trio of children who'd gotten a bit too brave and tried to scare off a wild creature that'd gotten a bit too close to town. It had been a long night that night, with kids and family crying, but they'd survived. Long enough to hear their parents chew them out for scaring them half to death, at least. What would you have been if you didn't die? Probably still that small town doctor. Might've settled down, had a family. Just a normal guy living a normal life. Where were you from?
Town in southern Tunseel (Frontillé in Vitry-Seilave) (happy to build this w/ you or do some little building of it myself so u don't have to think That hard abt it). Not even much of a town; it'd be more accurate to call it a village. Not even somewhere that notable, just another stop on the way to the capital. Who were you closest to when you were alive?
His half-sister, Sabine Keson. Who did you consider your family?
The people who came and checked in on him throughout the day at work. It takes a village to raise a person, and he felt sufficiently like family to (mostly) everyone at home. Old Isobel Rainier, though, who took in the kids so their mothers could work without worrying, was basically a mother figure to him. How did you die? It was a patient, brought in because some people found her on the edge of town, unconscious and visibly injured. He thought, at first, that she was dead with how shallowly she breathed, but he quickly found out that it was a ploy. When his back was turned, she attacked, draining him of his blood until he died. If possible for the character give 3 NPCs you knew while alive. Do they know your current condition?
Sabine Keson - His half-elven half-sister who was the one who found him after his death. He only found this out because she was also at his grave when he had to drag himself out of it. He was partially delirious, half convinced he was dreaming. He can hardly remember how he got the blood on his hands when he fully came back to himself. He doesn't think he wants to know if she survived. Long, red-brown hair that reaches about mid-back. Appeared young, but wasn't more than 4-5 year younger than him. Her fingers were always callused from working the loom.
Demetric Beckete - One of his patients; they seemed to show up at least once every other week to make sure he checked out whatever injury they'd just sustained. They seemed to like the care and attention he gave. Gnome with vibrant green hair, a wirey build, and as nervous as they came.
Olivier Comtois - The town drunk. He'd gotten into an altercation with him once or twice, when he wouldn't let the guy boss him around. They'd both ended up with black eyes that day, and it was quite embarrassing for both of them. Didn't stop them from getting into another fight later on. Human, light brown hair, with a farmer's tan. Did you know any of your fellow PCs while alive? N/A? I think A and I were planning Something but we haven't discussed it in a bit and I am a teensy bit late with this sowwy What type of undead are you? Vampire! How do you feel about your undeath? It's a curse..... bleh bleh bleh..... no, but externally he may express dislike of it, internally he's almost relieved after all these years; he would have lived and died in that town had he lived, and being able to get away is almost a blessing in disguise. He's seen more of the world than he'd ever had. Do you know who turned you into that type of undead? What's your relationship with them? He didn't know her at first, but over the years, he found out more and more information about her. Her name, or at least the name she was currently using, was Dione; she'd been doing what she did to him for several months at that point to people throughout the region. Only a few of those sired by her had survived, but no one was pleased with her tactics. He has yet to meet her again, but he's not too sure he'd be too happy to deal with her again. Why did you decide to continue with your undeath instead of accepting final death? He considered it at first, but decided against it. He still had people to help, even if he wasn't all that alive himself. That made him more objective, more determined to power through it all. Do those that knew you when you were alive know about your death/undeath? They certainly know about his death. Undeath is a harder question to answer; his sister, yes, if she's alive. If anyone else does, he'd be more surprised no one had hunted him down sooner. How have you been 'sustaining' yourself? A mixture of blood from people who tried to hurt him and those who willingly let him feed. The first is more common than he would like. The occasional animal should he need to feed, but he never kills the animal if he can help it. If possible for the character give 3 NPCs that you knew while undead. How do they feel about your current condition?
Miki Nagai - A self-proclaimed "hedge wizard" that he met on the road. She was particularly interested in how he survived for so long despite being unaware of things he could do. Looking back, he's not actually sure he saw her do any magic? Catfolk, tuxedo markings.
Anra - Elven thaumaturge who sent him running after being called to the town he was in. Seems like word got to her that there was a vampire problem that needed to be solved. He thinks she lost his scent once he got far enough away, but he's still keeping an eye out for bright blonde curls and the scowl she makes.
Edvin Mustonen - A victim of Dione, much more relaxed about his undeath than Viktor was. Was more than willing to share the little information he had on her. Whether it was accurate is the bigger question. Do you know any of your fellow PCs during your undeath? N/A? I'm happy to have connections per GM discretion tho lmao What do you want to get out of playing this character narratively? I'd like to see him become someone who can find comfort in not everything having to be done by him. It's ok! You can rest sometimes! What do you want to get out of this character from a mechanical/gameplay perspective? Sneak moments, a big chunk of damage every once in a while, able to patch my buddies up. =) What do you hope to see in this campaign? Man. Idk. I fully expect to have my brain hurt every time i try to think about whatever story you have cooking. What would you prefer not to have included in the campaign? Uhhhh. Nothing comes to mind! This campaign will involve death/loss as a theme. Are there any specific versions of that (EX: loss of a pet) that you don't want to see? Loss of a pet, yeah...... On your travels you managed to find out about Dhampires who were created without either parent being a vampire
You accidentally found out that you can still experience drunkenness despite your condition, you should not go back to the Rogue Beaver for a few centuries.
A kind monk of Erastil didn't smite you, she was a Kitsune looking for a dwarf. You sadly didn't meet her girlfriend/lover and couldn't help her. Kasumi
Dione was spotted going to Fathrell, up to no good likely. She's apparently something of an experienced ritualist from some of the evidence you've picked up from her. You once got excited about some ash you thought may have been her. It turned out to be wild game she used for a spell. The area you are going to recently had fighting in the main peninsula from the undetermined. Though it has subsided skirmish attacks between the government and revolutionaries are not unheard of. People advise not traveling at night. You don't have that option.
A new king in your home nation of Tunseel is being crowned, he is to be inducted under the seven suns of your nation in 1 weeks time. You've not met him, you're a town doctor. You've seen a cathedral in your day sleep. Odd as it is, when the moonlight shines through its stained glass, it feels like the sun on your skin when you were human. Dione (or someone traveling with her) has had a few victims most seem to be drained via the left arm. Maybe you're special since she bit you on your neck.
The city of Cllerrack, where the Martel River and Korde River meet off the spines, has a dead dragon resting in the bottom of its banks. The people don't know who killed it but it happened 3 years ago. You've grown to appreciate the 7 sun miracle affecting the moons when only one moon is visible. When only one moon is in the Tunseel sky, it reflects 7 times around the borders of the nation. There's probably a metaphor there, you're not a good enough poet to think of it. A kind traveling gnome had wonderful wares of books. He traveled in a strange horseless carriage that looked like it was about to tip over. He offered you a ride but the cart didn't have cover and it's hard to explain why you can't travel during the day.
There is an odd beauty to the old border of Sternbore. The mist rising in little particulates at the crossing of the lost nation seem peaceful to you. Maybe one day you'll enter that wasteland.
A blue robed scholar with red hair from The Nexus talked to you on the road. He was a bit pompous and didn't seem to appreciate the fine arts of nonmagical healing. At least his portable cabin was warm. What was your life like before you became undead? "Ah. Well. Back in Frontillé, my parents were, ah, busy growing up. My mother worked, my father was in his study most of the time. My sister, Sabine, she, er, helped me study when I became interested in medicine. It.. wasn't easy, but she was there with me. I took over the clinic when Dr. Émile retired and things were... busy, but good. I helped people. I still try, where I can." How did you come to be undead? Was it by choice, accident, or something else? "An accident, I... suppose? I'm still coming to terms with it." What challenges do you face as an undead individual in society? "The distrust is the most alarming. Being pinned the blame for crimes is another. I try to stay to myself, but fingers still get pointed in my direction." What misconceptions about the undead would you like to address? "We're not... bloodthirsty killers, as it were. Nor did we all choose to become as we are. It's more common than one would expect." How did you come to become familiar with the king? "Ah. He, er, paid the funeral parlor a visit, we had a discussion. You can imagine it was, ah, a bit of a surprise that he invited us to come visit Tunseel. How could I say no?" Do you feel emotions the same way you did when you were alive? "I... would think so? I'm not that old. Though Yurei does make me feel that way sometimes. My people skills haven't fared well but- my emotions are still strong." Can you describe what your existence feels like—physically, mentally, or spiritually? "That's, ah, a weighted question. I'm- cold? You take the sun for granted until you can't see it. It's a bit, er, draining, I suppose, to think about what the ones you care about are up to. If they're okay and... all that. Lonely, I suppose. Er. Haha." What’s your relationship with the living? Do you have living friends or family? "I'm still a doctor. I do still want to help people. They're the ones who've grown a bit more, ah, distrustful of me, as it were." Do you see your undead state as a curse or an opportunity? Why? "It's... both, in a way? I'm not the same as I was before, but I wouldn't have been able to travel like I do now. I've seen- beautiful things, grotesque things, things that have confused me. Being like I am now- it's not what I wanted, but it's made me reconsider things." What rights or protections do you think undead individuals should have? "Well. Not being attacked for simply passing through town would be.. nice. Er. A hard thing to ask for, I know, haha. Perhaps districts where we might be able to be without worry?" Are you part of a larger undead community or organization? "Er. Not that I am aware of? I have not spent much time around other undead beyond those I travel with." Do you have pets? If so, are they undead too? "Ah. No. I like animals as much as the next person but they, ah, do not particularly like me. Not that I haven't tried, of course. But it is, ah, a bit hard to grow attached nowadays." What’s your ultimate goal as an undead—eternal existence, redemption, or something else? "I don't know. I have more time in the world now than I ever really considered, so it's... hm. Looking for forgiveness from those I've... unintentionally hurt would be ideal. Baby steps, for now." Is there anything else you want the people to know? "Er. Not particularly. Am I supposed to advertise something here?"

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/baalzebu.title: Baalzebul
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/baalzebu.description:
Baalzebul was one of the first angels of Heaven, a glorious lieutenant who followed Asmodeus in his exodus to Hell.
Now known as the Lord of Flies, he rules over Cocytus, the frozen seventh layer of Hell, and attracts followers possessed of deep ambition and a powerful drive to triumph.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/barbatos.title: Barbatos
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/barbatos.description: Barbatos is the youngest of the archdevils. The Prince of Darkness saw fit to grant Barbatos rulership over Hell’s first layer, Avernus. As Hell’s doorwarden, Barbatos oversees the spaces between worlds, and his followers are those who tread such interstitial paths and hold no qualms about the ethics of their journeys.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/belial.h.title: Belial
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/belial.h.description: The lord of Hell’s fourth layer, Phlegethon, is Belial.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/dispater.title: Dispater
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/dispater.description: Hell’s second layer is the Diabolic City, Dis, and its ruler is the archdevil Dispater.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/geryon.h.title: Geryon
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/geryon.h.description: Once the mightiest of asura ranas, Geryon betrayed hundreds of Hell’s original asura inhabitants to aid Asmodeus in claiming the plane, in the process earning himself the title the Source of Lies. His realm of Stygia, Hell’s fifth layer, hews most closely to the nature of Hell before Asmodeus reshaped the plane, and it contains the sunken ruins of countless cities and libraries predating the war against Heaven.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/mammon.h.title: Mammon
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/mammon.h.description: Mammon, the Grasping One, oversees the vast treasuries of Hell secured in the vaults of Erebus, Hell’s third layer.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/mephisto.title: Mephistopheles
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/mephisto.description: The archdevil Mephistopheles was shaped of the ashes and fire of Hell itself to convey the plane’s will. As the lord of Caina, Hell’s eighth layer, he is a conniving schemer and a brilliant politician, quick to offer insults both blatant and cloaked behind silvered words.

misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/moloch.h.title: Moloch
misc/gods/pathfinder-archdevils/moloch.h.description: The general of Hell’s armies, Moloch, embodies infernal discipline and incomparable destructive power. Across his ream of Malebolge, the sixth layer of Hell, the Ashen Bull trains countless legions of devils to wage unending war.

sessions/oneshots/travespoir-oneshots/1..title: 1. The God Machine Oneshot
sessions/oneshots/travespoir-oneshots/1..description:
Players: Arbul Strongbrew
Kholeran Mudriver
Kyrie Edofol
Yuki Seppänen
Merris Hasalk
Travespoir Prev:
Next: 2. Vampire Return Crisis OneshotReal Notes Onarach + Merris / Aace are the richest pcs
Merris sent the Wes the Harrower and Thest Akpagos to their deaths
Warning of doom from beyond the pale
Old Sunday captain Moreg Na'thril We, minus old sunday, get knocked out We arrivie in Travespoir We get put in the spot most like the place we just left
First location is the nearby town spotted from the boat, Teristraz [RIP] Town seems abandoned Humanoid shapes wearing cloaks Merris tries to feed kholeran a beet We say hello and they come closer, cloaks and masks covering their faces Black sludge covers everything 😱 Horrifying creature stands on the water tentacling at us Upsidedown spider ONLY YUKI CAN SEE IT We cant remember it Thulgant: Weakest save reflex Also known as a qlippoth. Negative embodiment of tree of life Highest save will / fort / reflex One of the leeches is real, the others are people its using to protect its real self Not really cult shit, sign against devil and demons Notably forced out of abyss when demons arrived Only way they get back is if no souls go to demons or devils Only would be 1 thing left to take over the roots of the tree Elven man meets us, smiles Small, dark skin, with a counterpart man whos tall with blonde hair
Miryel Siroth and Ehlis Vantreau They found 1 sentient being, and one that ran away Barkeep Managed to get him lucid, chance is pretending to be one of his favorite patrons The other was a lich who teleported away Shes reduced to a state like kholeran Go to tavern Barkeep is slowly turning into slug-like leeches, he’s losing his form as time goes on
Barkeep = Homewarden Dwarfs in this region have a custom, their last name is what their occupation will be
Lifeholder = Plans to hold life He seems to be the last capable of speed person in his town Merris is looking for old employees He saw them, first came 5 years ago Lvl 1s could cross, lvl 20s needed to wait for moons to all be dark. Happens once evry 9 years.
They went to the Mad King???? Last of the Verions
Merris tries to Attune to AnShi Sees a canopy of a tree, waterfalls that fall endlessly into the earth. Odd feeling that something within the tree holds him hostage and says “leave while you can.” A Very Big Qlippoth, roughly the size of the tree. Has been growing within it like a parasite We’re on a tree, barkeep seems surprised we dont know Humans lived 200 years “before the earth went dark”, after that no one could die. Started the age of heroes Captain shows up, takes us down to a boat thats not been taken care of Flag is similar to his, but skull is crossed with 2 scimitars
His sister Jongrun Na'thril He found a trail Boat is mostly rotted away Some people never woke up, their bodies rotted The captain’s sister left a note that says she was going to go up the mountain, says where she went exactly Find an abandoned village
Able to make our way to Lifeholder Manor There are certain type of plants that grow spikes to protect seeds, gives the semblance of seeds. Manor is purposefully designed Enter central lab, pulsating noise in the center There’s an odd clown robot also laying on the ground In dwarven “what is it we seek to conquer?” Kholeran starts talking abt the king, it accepts “dead” Machine is caressing an egg below Outloud, speaking “the machine is missing a critical component. Please attach the heart item.” Merris puts a beet into the machine, it accepts it. Everyone will be sent to focult after they die now. The images of lifeholder’s dead wife are replaced with beets Just need magic items of this world to repair it. And time Automaton approaches “the lich’s doom would have one. A phylactery would be perfect for smth like this” We send kholeran into the woods to look for lichdom Kholeran hunts it down. Its not very strong We sneak into the Lich’s Doom We get the phylactery She seems dazed The cave is behind a waterfall that overlooks the ocean in the world She looks “i know one of you.” points at merris “are you his companions?” She believes us when we say our souls go to the machine “Do you know why demi-lichdom doesnt come?” “I should be a demi-lich by now.” when a lich doesnt consume souls for a while The soul needs to be able to evolve, semi-reincarnation, but it would be blocked here. She thinks shes outside of the cycle “The sorcerer, magus, and… healer were all there. I struck them down with lightning. They didnt die in the conventional manner, but simply disappeared.” “They returned. I tested again, tho they dont seem to remember. And i could not harvest their soul.” “One dances for the wine lords. One dances for the king, and one is in the wine of blood.”
“The inheritors of Craite, greatest mage in this land. Works with Lifeholder.” Who? “Craite is the greatest wizard. Lifeholder was his best friend who stopped death.” Arbul: were they, yknow? “Idk what ur talking about.” “Craite became the last man to die. We dont know how, but he may have found a way around death and deemed it not right to share with others.” The creature has partially destroyed the machine. Causing it malfunction, but we should make it so that someone can go back here and then to focoult Machine needs us to destroy each of the little sap eggs around the land that were corrupted
With Riri, theyll be able to make a formula u can insert into the egg to destroy them Machine growls “do you think i dont deserve my own land after everything?” Whatd u do to deserve it? “It was my land before you came. And your souls started to taint it.” Same presence from around the tree “The people wont know that they arent resting. The time will just slip them by. Right kholeran?” Are u the one responsible “No. You are.” Ppl showing up with souls caused all of his people to die M: i just cant bring myself to feel sorry purely for existing “Thats ok. In the 1000s of years ive yet to feel sorry either.” Machine shuts off TLDR/Sean Notes: We (minus the captain) are knocked out when going through the pale We are dropped off at Travespoir because it is most like where we came from Thulgant Its abandoned, Nevermind we are watched Everything is dirty and sludgy Only Yuki can see the strange spider monster (Thulgant/Qlippoth) Negative embodiment of the tree of life
Originated in the Abyss but were pushed out by demons, We meet Miryel Siroth and Ehlis Vantreau (the Dukes from New Sunday), Arbul finds inspiration at long last
Spellcaster Polycule talk This world has no death You repawn from a sap egg with a little less of yourself There was a lich, reduced to like kholeran Go to tavern Liquor vending machine Barkeep is named Dwarf named Homewarden meant to ward and grant home Lifeholder was meant to hold life.... Where are the PbP dudes? They went looking for the Mad King. Last of the Verions Merris attunes to AniShi Sees a huge Qlippoth eating at the tree We are all on the canopy of the world tree What caused this to happen this Curse of life People hunted monsters to near extinction but kept dying and became worse and worse monsters We are near the end f this cycle Only those who’s soul can accept sin are affected We find the Captain’s Sister’s Boat The captain doesn't like Merris Note: The captain will go up the mountain a We find Lifeholder manor We replace the heart of the machine with beets
Dying now sends you to Foucalt We need the litch’s soul cage to finish the repair We find the lich The PBP characters One dances for the wine lords. One dances for the king, one is in the wine of blood. Craite was the greatest wizard, and Lifholder was his best friend, the greatest inventor Craite was the last person to die die We skedaddle with the soul cage We integrate it to the machine, souls will now correctly send people to focult We must find and destroy the sap eggs The thing chewing on the world tree speaks to us Charlie NotesWe have Kyrie, Kholeran, Yuki, Merris, and ArbulTheyre in Travespoir The town seems abandoned as they exit off the rowboat They walk onto the docks They look and things are watching them, making their way down to the docks, humanoid-like shapes wearing cloaks Kh: there are things coming..should i eat them, shoot them and then eat them M: i mean only if they attack us first K: why would you eat them? Merris gives her beets They taste like ashes Merris learns what ghouls are K: are you always carrying around beets? M: yeah theyre my comfort food Kh: should we…kill them? M: hello! They seemingly avoid them before they make their way down, cloaks and mask cloaking their faces The ruined docks, it fucking filthy here, waves wash away all the mud and gunk off their feet Tarry blood looking sludge that they wade thru They see a Standing on the water. Who tf is this??? (a thulgant) Upside-down spider with tentacles coming out of it Y: theres a fucking thing over there, i dont immediately recognize it The thing: They cant see me, only you M: its past right here (creates invisible walls) K: what are you talking about? Theres nothing there Y: theres a thing there A: is it talking to you? K: be our translator Y: theyre going to ask you questions, ill relay your answers back to you It bumps into the invisible walls and sidesteps them Merris immediately forgets the thing The two guys (condensed writhing masses???) from the back approach and initiative begins Not people but writhing tentacles that look like a person Have little mouths that speak inward, can cast up to 9th rank spells The spider thing can undo itself in a Stunning Display, folds outward showing the inside of itself. Inside eats the outside Kholeran cant smell blood on it They recognize Merris bc his picture was on the ship? Majorly targeting him Thulgant is a qlippoth, negative embodiment of the tree of life The condensed masses are made of condensed souls and what seems to be ppl all around an organism One of the leeches is real, the other ones are people wrapped around itself to protect it Yuki implodes the thulgant Arbul kills one of the creatures, it falls apart and the various slugs and snails that make up its body fall into the waters below Yuki drops a tree on the other creature The qlippoth had a silver veil Its a sign against devils and demons that qlippoths have Were forced out of the abyss when demons arrived The only way theyll ever get back their home is if no souls go to demons or devils Eventually demons and devils will starve, only 1 things to take over the roots of the tree They meet up witht he other crew members Elven man: its a pleasure to meet you all Tall, dark skin. Counterpart is blonde 5’3 Elf is named siroth “Its a pleasure to meet u all, ive heard great things about u all.
Theyve done some great work in the Freilands apparently Theres yaoious rumors about these guys “We found 1 sentient being and another that unfortunately fled from us when we landed” K: what sort? We ran into technically 1 sentient being if u count qlippoth She explains and the guy understands, but his bf doesnt Merris and Yuki discuss their spellcaster marriage (why are all the spellcasters in a polycule??) K: in grinder, the way they did marriage was you had to stand in the mine together and hit each other with hammers, and the first one to fall was the wife K: is that true?? Kh: idk i wasnt marrying age yet “I thought it was to break a stone together??” Kh: i dont know. Maybe things changed since back then They do a classic kholeran introduction cycle thru the conversation K: about this sentient being, what did you find?
“Barkeep, he appears partially sentient. Chance is in there pretending to be one of his favprite patrons judging by the portrait we found on the wall K: what have u learned? “This lands is deathless. Theres saplike eggs that u come out of whenever yu die. And the more you die, the less comes out each time Kh: i’m already dead K: well i dont think youll die here “With you all here, none of us will die “The other one appeared to be a lich. It teleported away” A lich would be reduced to a state like kholeran Standing stock still staring into space, drooling, whenever shes not doing anything A: other than that the city is unoccupied? “I wouldnt say that, but the other inhabitants seem to (glances at kholeran) have lost their mind and were driven to cannibalism “The captain is sailing out to see if it drifted off somewhere, he should be back within the hour K: let us know. Known him for a long time, hope nothing happens to him “Dw nothing will happen to a man like that” Merris puts on a silver veil and offers one to yuki Y: i appreciate it? M: yeah realized i never got u anything, at all, ever The thing is like blood covered and merris uses prestidigitation to clean Y: ty ill get u something some time A: you disgust me. The only true love is between two men you fucking hussy. Breaking up merris and onerach M: oh no we’re still together A: oh good!!
Kh: oh. This is like Yurei Anmoku’s dads.. (Florence Anmoku Shiryo Anmoku) K: oh!! Those ones we teleported! A: two men having children, beautiful The barkeep looks past this tall human who is probably chance “dw theyre on my tab M: oh no worries (tosses like 10 gold) “Oh yaknow we have a machine for this A dwarven maid thing? The barkeep is losing form, muscles show leeches “Where do u come from? M: a little town called foucalt “Never heard it” M: it wasnt very important til recently. What about you, who are you? “Me? Bad at my job, home warden.” K: wdym bad at your job? “Well im a home warden no?” Merris nows that the dwarves in this region have a custom that their last name is what ther occupation is. He is a ward of the home, lifeholder holds life. He’s the last capable of speech person in his town M: we’re looking for some wayward employees of mine (pulls out a list) uhh thes, wes,.. “Ah i saw them, first came to me 5 years ago? (his body is slowly decomposing) The modifications were for the pale to get weak enough to cross over The harder the soul, the harder it is to cross over Lvl 20s had to wait for the all the moons to go dark, happens once every 9 years M: do you know where they last went? What they were looking for? “I know they went too the mad king K: Mad king?? “Idk what to say. Last of the verions. Surely youve heard of it Merris tries to attune to the sickly vampire, he can feel his ind wriggled around as tendrils snap from the tree around him. Snapshot of his view, fresh water around. Something within the tree, a massive termite, hold him hostage and says “leave while u still can”
This thing appears to be a huge qlippoth, has been growing within the tree like a parasite Merris shares the info “i was reaching out for those poor adventurers we sent out here. One of those things we fought at the dock, a giant tree..” “Aye, you seema bit unsteady lad, we’ve been on a tree. Whole world is a tree. We’ve been on the canopy. You sure youre okay? (suggests that merris is undergoing The Rot) Merris is haunted by 1000 ghost women who follow him around
K: first a dragon now a giant tree A: do you happen to know before they left, did they have a residence? “Wes the halfling one, said that they were near a mountain and they were somewhere out east? A: you wouldnt happen to know any bookstore or cartography stores in the city? “That remain? No” K: monasteries? Anything? “I cant say i do. I havent been able to leave the tavern for a while now. But all the buildings outside look perfectly destroyed K: what caused all this to happen? “Curse of life. Aint supposed to go on that long. Humans supposed to live 2yrs then die Y: not supposed to live that ike “Once the sky went dark, after that no one could die. Started the age of monsters. The more you die, the more monsters there are. Those who fought the strongest,, became monsters themselves. We’re near the end of the cyle K: what do you expect happens next? “Two more deaths” Siroth is in a primal rage destroying a monster outside, vantreau drinking its blood “I think thatll happen to me” Kh: the monter part of drinking the blood and tearing them apart with your hands “Both” “Elves usually start the rot right in the neck They check vantreau’ss neck He seems fine but is irritated that theyre bothering him while hes trying to protect them “Do you become a deer when you eat venison?” The captain shows up 15 min early (barkeep waves at chance, believing hes his friend) ‘you come back now. Floating island that went in the pale and back out Man is effectively immortal Going to a shining city with farms and food being eaten that isnt other ppl Johnny and caoilinn stealth Double nat 20 jesus Merris: who here am i married to??? “They call me Tha'iacopo.” Who’s they “The people.” Aace: u got a name? “Tha'iacopo.” “I keep people alive whether they want to be or not. Its necessary for political enemies, no?” Aace: torture way or??? Merris: is the nearest rejuvenation tree not within ur control? “It is, it goes directly to the prison.” Aace: just prisoners or. U do this to other people or? More important people? Youre not like keeping important diplomats alive against their will? “If the king says theyre a prisoner then theyre a prisoner, no?” We leave, realize we need to introduce ourselves, go back “Youre the worst troupe ive ever seen” Go downstairs Accidentally walk into the area with his wives, they point us to the throneroom There’s a bleached gnome in the other room
The king, King Potta, looks at us “you’re from sarthal?” Yes! “Where are your people?” ?? “Ur a delegation u want the best for your people. So where’s sarthal now?” “Youre signing over all people to under my rule, yes?” “What can i offer to make such a deal go through?” “You swear loyalty to me, and your people go under me, and i allow you to rule as a vassaldom.”
“Youd be under the rule of King Virium himself and his eternal line.” Ane: i see. That makes sense. Our island however has been separated so long that we are greatly misinformed abt the main continent, we’d like to do our due diligence and talk to ppl “I can answer that. All but sarthal falls underneath me.” Merris: we do plan to bend the knee my liege Ane: dont give that away! Dammnit “Then bend it. There’s no reason for us to dance back and forth” We bend the kneet “And how many people are in sarthal now?” Merris gives the number of foucolt. 10k would be nice. Enough to not be found but decent number Aace: like 10k “Really? Rn it feels like zero.” Aace: wdym?? Merris tries to be horrified King calls for the guards Ane: surely some misunderstanding??? Might we look into the disappearance of our people??? Ourselves could be useful “You’re so confident but didnt know your people are dead.” “I know you have no souls underneath you to swear.” He believes we believe we are from sarthal, but believes us insane for claiming to be delegates. Trying to convince him that the legendary bards of the party are here to tell tales of him “Then where are you from?” Ane: we thought itd be more believable, good diplomat but terrible liar. We’re from across the pale “Then why didnt you say so?” It sounds outlandish “You think i wouldnt know my own people underneath me.” Ane: the lords back there are not as attentive as you are “And that’s why i should rule, no?” Ane: maybe Merris: the last who tried to rule all of novu mundi was eaten. By a ghoul Rosalind: it was gruesome Ane: apologies for the deception, we’re here to get to know u a bit better “Well. i think its simple. You bow the knee and swear your loyalty to me.” Ane: ik unreasonable, could we get to know u better. Ive never served a lord, ive dedicated myself to freedom, its a big decision for myself “You do understand the futility of saying no, dont you?”
Guards bring in a servant, a woman with glowing eyes Catalina (Travespoir) “This one tried to run away from me. If you dont mind, kill me in the most gruesome way possible.” Woman dies when he’s hit with execute “See that compensation is given to her child. It is just, no? She gave her life for me, the child should get compensation.” She tried to flee the kingdom 2 ways around this A man who can keep someone alive but imprisoned forever With rosalind here, how to string up someone where theyre technically alive Surely he has a backup plan. This sort of magic almost always has a flaw, lich’s does Kyrie goes to the other room, looks at the bleachling The 2nd the woman dies, the bleached gnome begins writing down lineage. The woman’s name isnt in gold, but the child is She object readings the book in daydream trance
List of golden names: 5 souls that have yet to go underneath the level of bleaching or corruption, perfect vessels. Woman is Catalina, son is Leofric. He only achieved this power within the last 4 years There is 1 name that is completely impure, seem to be imprisoned far far away in an iron keep. The physically furthest location from him His office The last thing the king was looking at was trying to figure out where the ship wes came on was Johnny finds such esoteric bullshit King gets distracted Mind probe Aace: what happens to souls that ur magic kills? “She should cycle the equivalent of 4. But for some reason she didnt” (he’s unaware of Why) Aace: where did you get this magic from? “The birthright of my great (xMany) grandfather. Immortality once promised. Only needs to be revoked.” Aace: what can we do to stay for a while? Just act afraid Merris “out of fear” pisses himself
They have a deal. Hes using the qlippoth’s magic to do this, will go across the pale to conquer How to kill u? Disable ur immortality? “The death of the qlippoth.” His death near the most corrupted person in the world would also do it We leave WE RUN INTO BABY LEOFRIC Aace reveals machinations on leofric that theyve been their mother the whole time Aace: ill tell ya a bedtime story! Yuki and kyrie look at the diagrams This is part of the soul transference ritual Theyre able to find a flaw If he dies next to an object marked for soul transference, his soul will go there instead Has to feel human-like
Johnny has Grimgraw & the 7 Heroes of Archland
Game created by Glasswin. Features depictions of screaming children. Kyrie infiltrates his dreams and tells him to meet in the guest bedroom The rogues kill him He gets stuck in the Gambler Leofric has no listed father Merris gets an adopted child The party raids the prison Most of the golden named ppl are in the prison Able to take them back with us Leofric and those dont melt from the lifeholder machine. Neither does the inside man who got us in, villefort
We get Wes the Harrower They vow to kill merris one day
We go back, others return with heavily wounded Ehlis Vantreau, Miryel Siroth also faced permanent death at some point? They fought the qlippoth and barely escaped Unfortunately we have only 3 of the eggs left, its now getting active If it does kill, it can make you somehow stay on this world bc the machine isnt fully complete yet
