Could take up to a day. Usually solved within 2 hours Addresses us within the hour “I was told not to speak with you.” L: apologies if we’re intruding!
“No, that which you would call a duke told me you’d come for a bargain. He exiled all the loggers from these woods.” “I will hear out your offer for exchange.” L: we were hoping to bring a canal over here “It would be impossible to do a canal that wouldnt disrupt many a home. We do have a deal. A new home we could expand upon.”
L: like a different forest here or? New home across the pale “There is no across the pale. The duke too had dissolutions of such things.”
L: i was born there. Ik it sounds unhinged. But just as Frethïar was revealed” I missed so much
“The reuniting of the first world brought together the fey domains.” L: my mistake. Tell me more abt what youre looking for? “A simple request. Cure the blighted woods to the north.” Its caused by a daemon, supernatural sickness. Blighting creature. Ppl havent taken care of it, its dangerous and doesnt currently spread threat to society. Would spread 200ish years, after 300 years itd touch a modern road. Almopst certainly a luoko daemon Been there for 250 years We agree “Then its settled.” L: any wisdom for how to best deal with it? “Cold iron cuts true. And ik the fowl runoff gave it a nokolovi Made by magical runoff Fey creature that enjoys pollution Human and horse that merged together and were skinned alive Might be related to a wizard who tried to summon such things and failed. Or an alchemist Been there for prob 20 years Probably outside of our rank rn. “The duke offered the same thing [his aid]” L: oh hes pretty strong. Yes we are nearby tho Osnova 11, 1290
Approach ciuviedo at nighttime Ppl move around for loose bricks Playing the projection of memories for the city We go shop to shop to find the changeling woman, handing out candy to children “Do you have. Children with you?” She hands sachiko some candy and a streamer “You know, this town wasnt much until it was blessed!” L: blessed? “The video wasnt here until the angel blessed it into reviving.” The angels wings were black. Yeah its coretha “Yeah the angel. Blessed it and that was the last of her magic and she died. Shes buried up in the tomb.” (where the center of the town is) We decide Not to ruin her festival, wait a day Throm rocks the shit out of the festival
“Throm is that you?” LADY SAE! T: hello! KITSUNE??? T: good to see you again! Not wearing her bulky armor now that shes in a public place T: enjoying the festival? “Of course! Have u been any of the other years?” T: no its my first time Fitzie has tho! “Any luck finding the green man i sensed to the south?” Uhhh no not really
“Its a shame. We havent had a confirmed sighting of one in years. Nearly over a millennia. The last one was on this continent, which is why i had faith. The great forest in rozen had one before the mages took it down.” Uh there was one on the tree? “Being born, no?” No fought T: and a leshy died there “Completing the circle of life. Its a chance. It might be. Was it 20 years ago?” Yeah it was “So to sail across can you just- (cut across motion)” NO youll die. We’re working on opening it L: we’ll give you a sending when we get there “Ur strong enough to cast sending?” “Bold assumption.” T: we’re confident We enjoy the night T: we do have a few things u may be interested in. we’ve been tasked by a couple of dryads to root out a daemon. “Where? I can take care of it.” T: we wont send sending, we’ll send a letter “I dont have an address.”
Its several days north of caldrith “I have things to take care of. I can meet you in caldrith?” We also have a keep “Oh yeah i forgot.” T: Also. the general store, the proprietor?
“Terin?” F: nice changeling woman? (her eyes and long black hair) T: we have business with her, thought itd bring ease to have a familiar face. T: shes a changeling experiencing a calling, we’re trying to save her and her sisters “Can i borrow a pen?” She writes down “do you know which coven?”
T: no, her mother is a moon hag we believe.
“Malgara?” Not the true name
In the mushroom forest of charrac there is a powerful hag that views herself a queen She says she doesn't make changelings as she is now beyond that She creates 3 covens instead of changelings They fight for her favor She goes and grabs another round of drinks - “We can talk in the woods?” - We go to the woodline and sit down, she touches a leaf and embues it with light - She puts on her bulky helmet whenever she begins talking - “Its likely. She considers anywhere between the mountains and the valley region of caldrith her domain.” - “Its not that her mother is malgara, but that shes related to a malgara-kin. But i did hear of a villager that was bewitched by her and hexed? - “I believe hes a tree now. It was smth abt life as long as an oak. And she uh… it started small. Gave him the skin of a bark and it went to his joints.” - “We tried to help, me and a local cleric, but there wasnt much we could do. We could free him if we found the bottle hes held in.” - “Youd have to kill the hag and then maybe you’d find the bottle. No chance at finding it while shes around. And if she can turn a man into a tree, i dont want anything to do with it.” - T: going back to. Ive heard of malgara. She makes whole covens. Do u believe these 3 sisters arent destined to kill each other? - “No i dont think malgara birthed them, i think someone is trying to get her favor. It makes sense. Idk the process, but apparently the hags that report to her are especially strong.” - “There’s one now.” points to a star that has 3 next to them. (just beyond a mountain) - Lady sae does in fact have 2 stars - T: oh terrifying - “Theyre strong.” - T: we came to u for seemingly so much. But u wouldnt happen to know abt any other hags? - “There’s the one in caldrith that makes deals.” - B: and the swampy one - L: and the blood hag
- “The swamp one is named Sani. they call her the estranged bride of the sea.” - Sea hags are normally just. Spotted on the sea. Not actually Have to be next to the sea. - Throm makes the best fuckin straw ever Throm goes to leofric T: i cant help but notice. When beautiful women are involved ur not very calm or collected. But. with lady sae everytime you take off her helmet its like ud rather face the hags. Eventually shes gonna take off her helmet to look around or talk?
L: have u ever heard of aace arubedo? And Yuki Seppänen? T: yeah im familiar L: so u know how i have parents. T: …..(horrified) no. nonono.
L: yeah. The list of my parents is aace. Yuki. Anemone Veremund. Merris Hasalk. Dayalu who is too busy for me to know if he has a last name. And Onarach Agus Fìor. T: none taught you to read???? L: that wouldve required more coordination. I think i found an arubedo secret lab but i cant remember? I found a journal i wrote as a child. But i cant read. How did that happen???? The party doesnt know T: idk??? How to help u??? We’re all free to help tutor u on reading tho Osnova 12, 1290 Go back to the general store to help break things down at sae’s suggestion Sae blunt with it “you’re experiencing the calling?” She looks at us, sae adds “dont worry theyre friends. I think theyre somewhat experts?” Her “i have and ive considered it.” F: why? “The magic brings good.” Hags have to bring death, itd be bad for u to go thru with it (6 years between the sisters birth is the converging of a moon phase. Great for a moon hag, but six years between each.) The next convergence is next year, she wouldnt push her kids until then bc her strength is strongest
T: your youngest sister is 17. Practically a child. Ur older sister (29) is so proud of her own hospitality that she allows all folks into her establishment no matter what. No matter fey or whatever
“The Twin Night and Ale proprietess is my sister?” T: she is. Shes a good friend of ours “Ive heard she was an odd ball.” T: oh yeah weird. We thought ud be stranger tbh. “U thought it was a changeling thing???” F: we???? T: SORRY. ME. “The most power i have is requesting food from a nearby town.” B: ud still be eating babies? “Everyone has dark callings. Whether punching a man who catcalled you.” T: so you kill your sisters. Then waht? Youve already killed 2 people. Wahts a third. A fourth. Or fifth. “Have you not killed anyone? Is that mace just for show?” T: oh it is actually. “Oh. bolo have you never killed someone?” T: BOLO IS RECOVERING. “So u admit there is a path to recovery!” B: killing for personal gain is selfish “But if its good for the community in the long run?” T: so you make deals to turn men into trees? Sae “if you dont trust them, trust me?” She’ll delay it for a few months, we gotta come up with a new argument thats just a slippery slope There’s a very easy trick a hag can play: in the weeks leading up, kill ur sisters or ill kill u myself. If we dont keep them safe they’ll go under the hag’s clutches
T: im gonna say smth very strange. I need u to accept what im saying. Ur going to a man named Alphons Acton and say a hag pissed on ur leg. He’s very strong, he’ll view u as a sister. He’ll protect u. Ik its a lot to pick up your life and move, but its the safest thing “Ill leave it to the assistant then. Shes young, but she can handle it. Besides, i took over the shop when i was 16. It would be good for her.” Osnova 14, 1290 Go back to caldrith with her We bump into alphons He waves “did you enjoy the festival to the south?” Lovely! T: have u been? “No, this is the furthest from home ive ever been.”
Hes from the town between blales and valicia, has no name “Are u part of the group too, should i keep tabs on u?” Her “no im just travelling with them. Here to meet my sister?” T: this is ur sisters sister “Ohhh. YOURE THE ONE THAT PISSED ON MY SISTER?” NO THE HAG PISSED ON HER T: this is ur sisters sister He goes for the hug, shes unfortunately like. 5ft and 7’3” T: terin this is ur brother alphons “Aye at least ur not here to piss on me sister its all good.” T: shes here to get protection with the duke. Much like arelis. Actually what is ur sisters name? “Raven, a beautiful type of bird. Have u ever seen one?” “Aye, theyre super common. I think native to the river.”
S: my sister has a raven familiar! His name is Baobao “THEY HAVE NAMES???” NO JUST THIS ONE He took care of dogs off the street T: terin like arelis and raven will be under the duke’s protection in town. And yours, right? Theyre your sisters after all “U dont need to make the argument. Im a knight now. Everyone in town is under my protection.” The duke did tell him abt the hags but he forgot all the facts and forgot the names. Alphons cant read or write. But the duke has been reading to him every night. “He dont talk to me abt u tho. Ive asked a few times. He did say he hopes for us to be friends tho” He puts terin down “Still. The duke dont seem to hate u as much as he should, he said.” T: huh. We’re not that likeable B: we’re not dislikeable “Oh i meant to ask. Throm whats it like to be a bastard noble? Is that not a commoner? T: (explains) T: lesser men are murderers, im not a lesser man “Murder is illegal if u didnt know” T: im no murderer, ik some of the knights believe i am but id never harm my noble brother “Aye. when i first got the job the duke said u were trying to save the brother” T: ofc hes the rightful heir. Its my duty “Dont u want to save ur brother bc its ur brother? My sister aint gonna give me shit. Shes getting the farm in the will.” Throm realizes hes nobility, bows to him “U dont need bow to me. I own a small house recently built.” B: so do we “Aye, but its on the lake.” it has no roads but is near the duke’s. Small tower with a mill and a dock attached so he can fish T: last time we spoke, u mentioned ur sister may be coming down? Is she still? “Aye, in a month’s time.” T: yeah it might be safer to come now “During sowing season? Shes a farmer!” “U want her to starve in the winter?” T: she may be here in the winter “But what abt my little little siblings?” He has like 10 siblings
“I have enough room for me, and i could fit Beatrice Acton if she comes down. But ik Lucian Acton would want to come, then (many other sibling names)” F: we can help plant! Sachiko is a druid she can help
“The cleric would be up there by the time too”
The one of erastil “Idk he made me pray to erastil when he visits”
The next lightning rail is gonna arrive in 5 days Osnova 15, 1290 Go back to our keep
2 people from Ambassadors' Guild are here A kineticist bows “I understand you have problems with your earth?” T: yes! “I was hoping per the ambassador’s agreement u pay me for a contract to do it?” Other woman points at leofric “YOU AND I DO BATTLE NOW” HUH? “I was told there was someone like me blessed by the gods! And what god are you blessed by?” L: nnnnnone? “I can see in your eyes that that’s not true.”
L: i was from an area where everyone died and their hopes for the future powers my abilities. HUH? L: what abt urself?
“I am the reincarnation of Iapholi.” (minor goddess, godhero, she is a goddess of monstrous heritage acceptance. Woman is beautiful but we can see claws and a tail that wags underneath. Tho she clearly is of nephilim heritage.) T: why do u have to do battle? “To establish which one of us is the greater god, no?” L: i have no intention to become a god “I consulted many seers and my mom consulted many seers. They said at the time you wished to become god.” L: huh??? When???? “24 years ago.” L: i wasnt born then???? “But your soul wanted to be god.” L: uh. Ok. sure! Spar with Iapholi Leofric immediately crit fumbles She heals him up “IM SO SORRY, I MUSTVE GOTTEN THE WRONG PERSON” L: i am an exemplar “I was talking abt one with stars???” L: i do… “How????” L: recent thing, i have two “I have two…. Maybe we wait till later” “Im a monster….” L: im not that strong in the way of exemplars “The seers of my birth said if i fought you id die!”
L: i was born theoretically at the same time the last one DIED. so. Explain to her that. Hes so bad with women. Come back in a few months PLEASE L: ty i have a lot more training to do “Still it is a bit disappointing to come all this way.” L: how far away?
“I’m from the dirmandian lands.”
T: like guild master of the darkwaters
“Oh. uh. The Darkwater territory?” T: guildmaster urgan
B: have u heard anything of the queen lately? “Yeah, i was to be one of her daughters.” (daughters become local rulers after meeting with her, normally have some divine spark) B: any luck with trying to find her? “If i did i wouldnt be here wasting my time with- well. Not wasting my time per se. But spending time here fruitlessly.”
L: we’re also searching for her to open the portal down to my homeland “What???” L: yeah. We need the pale queen’s blessing to return to my homeland so we’ve been searching. “U can get the blessing, it was given to new daughters before they return. They just need to meet the pale queen. Ig you could get it from her if you found her.” (she describes the process of getting the blessing) “she would hold up the pale sphere upward and then a drop of blood would fall on us and that was our blessing.” F: just blood? “Idk. idk what it is. Never been there. She ditched our last meeting.” (blessing only lasts until they claim dominion over what they were told to claim dominion over) L: ik we havent made a strong impression but we’d happily aid in searching. “The daughters have been quiet, its a secret. Theyre hidden away.” L: if we met one that met the pale queen but hadnt claimed dominion “No such, she was here naught but 30 years ago. I was supposed to meet her at 14, and we waited 10 years. But. well. Its past that.”
She comes in, we go to the dining room and sir Expus Mentums is there T: sorry sir are u a member of the ambassador’s guild “Aye, passed the dungeon. Me and my companions saw the trap but the walls were made of stone so i just forced my way thru.” T: ur name?
“Of course. Kamin Ga'Val.” F: whats ur rates? “Ive recently passed. And to be honest, depends on how dangerous it is, no? But master urgan said theres a tunnel under ur house to excavate? Id charge 50gp minimum.” “Master urgan said he scented trolls and typical underground dwellers.” T: yes and warpage, some spider nonsense. B: and our friend the ant eater F: pangolin B: sorry. Armored ant eater “He said i should charge 100gp for it. Im charging half to you.” Yeah that works L: should we stick around u in case of dangers? “Im p strong myself. What dangers are- well. Once the rubble is clear, i’ll run away.” We show him the area “Should take 2 weeks minimum.” Osnova 16, 1290 We go explore the forest Split the party Leofric + sachiko Run into the candle forest Leofric feels a breath on his neck Sachiko makes the candles look nice and says to the woods “my friend is sorry abt snuffing out ur candle, we offer this in apology” Sachiko does see one of the threes grab at “Why should we accept? We could kill him now.” S: um. Because. Um. we really are sorry, we didnt intend for any offense. Anything else we can do? We never meant to hurt anyone “You have a way to make this true? That no offense was meant and no offense is given in the future?” (humans keep making this mistake. U can prevent it in the future) S: what if i and my friend here, we go make an announcement or let the ppl know in the nearby town know to not snuff out the candles bc itd be a bad idea to do that. Would that be anything to help prevent future mishaps? “In his heart does he think this true, or does he think it appease?” S: he is sorry! He didnt mean to hurt anyone! “He may go until 2nd offense.” S: TY!! Bolo + fitizie + throm Not a whole lot until the satyr tries to charm fitzie again We get confirmation that the graveyard is north Also a sublime breath took over his old spot. He hates the guy Reconvene There is a creature destroying the terrain before it smashes rocks and dirt It spots us, sits down “Hello there!” Hi! What are you doing? “Destroying the terrain, no?” Why???? “The main reason? Bc i want to, no?” B: no nice “Why? Humans destroy the terrain all the time.” “The forest creatures know to steer clear of things snapping trees.” S: what about the trees? “The trees will have to die to give way to the underbrush. B: trees provide shelter to the underbrush “R u trying to outwit me??” This is a oancanu. This is a type of spirit that needs to live in a destroyed terrain. Part of fey natural lifecycle. She needs to do this to live We send her up north

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 18
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 17
Next: Session 19 Osnova 17, 1290 Go to the hexes near where the satyr said the sublime breath was On the way there, not a whole lot, but do encounter a dead body of a nearby villager crushed to death repeatedly Seems to be a few months old, month or 2
Reconstructing the body and looking around, this man is Elwood Henstock, hunter and drunk In the past few months he turned a new leaf and stopped beating his kids and wife Throm goes thru his pockets, not a single thing on him. All that were on him have been taken away. If it werent for his outfit and scars, we wouldnt be able to tell
Head back to the priest of pharasma Irulian Voss
Stopped by guards at Caldrith, asked if we’re selling smth T: we found a dead body. We’re bringing him to the priest of pharasma Gentle hand on his shoulder “you understand based on previous instances we have to detain you and bring the body there ourselves.” Leads throm away, the other walks us to the priest of pharasma and brings 2 more guards Go to irulian voss Looks at us “do you need anything?” sees the guard “Body’s been found?” F: yes, just off the path outside caldrith He shoos the guard off Asks us to bring out the body and lay it on the slab, sees the rot “ugh. You may want to stand back. Im going to remove some of the alchemy that kept the body for the last few months.” We think its elwood hinstock “That’s not my concern. That’s for you to do as you will. I tend to the dead.” He undoes the alchemies done on his hunts, unfortunately it does preserve flesh unnaturally the smell of rot will go We throw up, bad smell “They get like this if theyre left too long. All the same, its a good thing you brought him by. What will you do with his 2nd chance?” We’ll have to talk to him “Most humanoid shapechangers dont have this kinda strength.” “I’ll still have to give him a proper gravestone, as our lady demands. I dont have to notify the family, and pray they dont see.”
Throm is dragged directly in front of duke Ehlis Vantreau, who’s courting nobles from far away “What were you arrested for throm?” T: bringing a body into town “You couldve just lied????” T: im so bad at lying “Lie and get arrested for lying to a guard or save us both the trouble” T: i’ll take it into account sir “Whats the minimum sentence i can give him? Alright ur in the dungeon for 1 hour throm” T: could i fix the leak in there sir. Ill take like 2 hours to fix tho “Ok give him a chisel mortar and pestle” Guard “chisel for the prisoner???” “If he can chisel his way out in an hour he can just punch his way out.” Throm allowed to leave 2 hours later Meanwhile, the rest of us arrive at the man’s house at dinner time Warm home with soft music playing inside, eventually a kind shorter woman opens the door “um. Can i help you?” L: um. I was hoping we could speak to your husband? “We paid off his old debts last month. Whoever sent you…” OH. no T: these are nothing to worry abt F: just want to talk to him abt a recent trip he had Kind short haired man comes out “Are you local lords needing help navigating the woods? You odnt happen to work for that one fellow?” Who?
“Odd man, long white hair. Gave me a bad feeling.” (Draven Košarek) “We’re about to have dinner, if you want to talk in there?” L: thank you we’d appreciate it “Of course. Id like to spend some time with my family, but there should still be a few stalls open if u want to get some supplementary foods?” tosses a gold, we hand it back w another We get some food The man has 4 kids, the youngest 2, the oldest 10. “Sorry if you drink, i dont carry it around. Figured as im getting older id keep my wits sharp.” So wise He sits on the opposite of his wife, fill in the table of the humble home “What do you all do? Why have you come here?” T: idk if uve heard abt the kerfuffle of the local land owners, we’ve come to own the keep to the north, wanting to own the keep to the north “Thats you???” T: we wanted a hunter to survey the lands “I could do that” “Im neither so good nor cruel of a hunter (to endanger myself)” “I mostly hunt, i dont go as far near your castle. Its dangerous up there.” to his kids “dont worry, you’ll be fine. They’re a bit more wild. Seen’s a giant once. She had 1 eye.” T: met them “Ah never got too close, meself. Saw her smash down a tree.” F: how long ago? “A month or so ago.” We say we need general surveillance, would be 20gp a month “Could i argue 23? Me boy has some potential.” His son produces some weak prestidigitation that can snuff out a candle. Sorcerer “I hate to push it too far, would you have a room in the keep i could stay if i go too far?” T: smth could be arranged, most of our rooms are reserved “Understandable. Maybe if im in the area i could camp in your area?” Yeah thats fine “I shant take too much time. Do you know when i might know? Could i walk the lands beforehand too?” L: you could walk the grounds with us, show you and get your opinion? “Tonight? Or tomorrow?” Tomorrow L: if its not too much on ur schedule of course. “no, no, i could make room. I was teaching my oldest how to hunt tho if she could come” L: we’d like just us in case theres danger “May i deny it come the morrow? The pays good, but i dont wish to leave them” We explain its not super dangerous, but we dont want ur kid as a liability just in case
We go to The Twin Night and Ale
Changelings (Terin and Arelis Vantora) are bickering Osnova 18, 1290 Man is waiting eagerly by the gate Walk through the woods with us “So this is to show that i am a good hunter?” T: and that u know the land “I know the south but not the north” T: that u can learn the land, sorry What changed the past couple months? “Saw my own death and the hands of the bottle. When i dreamt it, i had been hunting for a while. Idk. took a pummeling.” (fitzie able to figure out. If we could get him close to fire, we could be certain.) We head north to the candle time He seems a bit apprehensive? Begins to move away. Certain he’s a Naper. Envy born fey spirit. Notably, they take someone they have great envy for and try to take their place. They then lose their memories of being a naper and truly believe themselves to be the person they stole the identity of. If they reproduce, the child has a chance of being a naper. Will die at the age of 10 if they dont find find someone to steal the identity of “When i was a young boy the woods werent so full of fey.” He’s pretty good at hunting, but a lot of his skills from his fey side. Old hunter was kinda bad at his job Pay him a gold
Return to caldrith, go to the Duke's Isle “What is it now?” T: its regarding my arrest yesterday “About the body. The priest said its most likely not you. So recompense.” gives a silver Explain it “Napers often sense squandered potential. Throm, bolo, you’ve been getting stronger recently. How long did it take for u to have a surge of strength?” B: many moons? “Are you sure you wont find your body in a ditch, with the face gone?” T: itd make my father’s inheritance more complicated “Is he a threat?” L: he’s a kind man and a father B: not rn, but that can change T: we wanted to inform u bc its your city “You did well. Keep an eye on him, if anything happens i’ll hunt him down.” “Your castle is unstaffed, its unbecoming as lords of these lands.” B: we’ll have our first guy! “Aye. it does no good for a lord to hoard his wealth.” He lowkey threatens us but its fine we’re not worth killing
T: mlord. I believe we were speaking with Alphons Acton recently. He tends to speak… he’s a kind man. A good man. But we have trouble understanding what he means- “He forgot the hags.” Yes he did We explain that we’re helping alphons, he offers to pay for our tickets “If you’re lucky, alphons might squire one of you” B: good luck leofric T: time to start asskissing now leofric L: that would be pretty cool tbh “(sighs) It is a joke. We’re still destined at the end of all of this to be enemies. But i see no reason for us to fight while we try to help the same kind boy.” (explain what we know) “Aye there are three. Theyre vying for her favor. Ik one coven wanted to make favor with powerful individuals. One is finding magical esoterica. Another is trying to do so with prime changelings. I understand they chose these changelings for a specific reason. They all own the rights to wherever they are.”
(ownership of the land would expand Malgara’s domain)
“I am unable to interfere with her business, because of duke Miryel Siroth. Long ago, they tried ot take over caldrith, and he hung all of them up. She threatened to kill all of caldrith, so they came to a standstill. He wouldve won, but a lot of ppl would’ve died. She may not directly attack the town. I think she, like a python, will wrap around us. Not attack, but slowly we’ll die.” B: that does make us the perfect people to work with on this. “Why do you think im telling you?” T: this is bolo’s method of talking it thru (dukes and her knights can attack her, in return she and her fey pacts cannot attack the town) T: we think their mother is a moon hag
“Oh. Anara of the Hollow Horror. She lives on the mountains north of the blighted woods.” Oh yeah we’re gonna deal with the demon there btw “Will u be smarter with it than the devils?” Yeah otherwise u gotta put us down i think “Itll be good for the world. Still. (looks to the mountain)” He dismisses us We go pay elwood 3 months in advance We go to the sublime breath Eladrin like man He bows to us “Are you local lords?” Yes in fact “Then, could you tell me a tale and i tell you one back?” (sublime breaths are mythic creatures. They wont attack ppl unless attacked first, their attacks are nonlethal but will hurt a lot. They do also gather mythic tales, gather them bc theyre the source of their mythic points. They also inspire non-mythic ppl to do mythic things.) We tell him our tales, leofric plays his flute “Oh, one of the best mortals ive played here.” (his performance is Really Good. for the sake of artistic skill, theyre a level 13 challenge) He bows to fitzie (nat 20) “i think thats the best ive heard on this road” T: we hear u encountered a satyr on these roads “Aye, i yearned to play. And we played, and i was just barely better. He then attacked.” T: oh, do you want to file assault charges? “No harm done” L: um. He did try to get us to kill you. T: wasnt very passionate abt it either “Is there way to kill someone without passion?” B: yes! “If i met someone who could do such a thing i would be right to kill them then. To remove the one good thing that comes from murder.” T: well. Nobody likes that here. “Still. It has been nice to see you, and if that is it, i should go.” L: we mostly wanted to say ty for protecting the area. We do have ownership of the local castle and um. Also to meet an artist. We’re not here to kill an artist we’re just excited. If u want to visit our castle ur free to. We have many adventurers in and out. If ur interested in ours tories u might be interested there. “I can stay but no more than 3 days a month.” (transient story, he might die) “Once the pale purple moon is anew, that time is reset” (occult moon) He does need to travel, if we were to hold him still for 3 days itd kill him. But he’ll stop by if we want He doesnt stop by now, but will “I did encounter one of your own to the north. The kholo. Staying at the inn.” Head home to rest Osnova 19, 1290 The duke bought us a first class seat each
Bolo goes to Dirmandian Embassy, tells them that any of his family that come by are welcome to his keep “I’ll let them know, but ur family isnt the stationary type.” b: But a few days or so is no big deal.
“But it is in the dirmandian lands now. Maybe when times were slow” B: i suppose when changes are occurring “Ill let them know, encourage them to write a letter at least” Osnova 21, 1290 Jump off the train at alphons’ town A giant approaches us 5’10” eight year old stares at us “you all right mister?”
T: u must be Alphons Acton’ brother “U know my brother??? T: yes hes a knight! “Sis wasnt lyin?!” T: shes not a lion, shes ur sister “Whats a lion?” T: aw L: we’re friends, we’re here to help u All of the siblings are massive except the sister at 5’1
Take us past the graves, they recently buried the dog and slightly less new but fresh grave of the father Able to go to a not insubstantial farmhouse, they built central house first and then side houses as the family grew, haphazard Most of the children share a bed with their sibling, strength with numbers in the countryside
We meet with Raven Acton “You’re the ones my brother described. He described it in his letters.” T: oh the duke’s helping him write letters. (the duke taught him how to write his own name, doesnt match the nice handwriting of the body of the letter) “A friend of alphons is always welcome here. What brings you?”
“Seems u jumped off the train in front of Kale Acton?” T: theres no stop here. “So there isnt! Why not a wagon? Smth urgent?” T: we are actually here for u. F: has alphons explained what a changeling is? “That i am one. And that im experiencing the calling. Im not an idiot.” (explaining it) “The other changelings. Not sisters yet.” T: we had to explain changelings to him. S: he firmly believes youre sisters. Explaining its safer at the city T: the issue being the hag that is calling you, if she doesnt believe itll go her way she’ll just off you herself.
Itll take some bit, but they request 2 things: 1, we help them sow so that if they need to come back they can, 2 we strike a bargain with the neighbors and if they arent back they get all the harvest, 3 they need a place to work (Peater's Patch)
ask Alphons' Mom where she wants to live, its shroudfort Osnova 21, 1290 Tend to the field, she shows us to the cliff what goes into an abyss “My brother kicked a stone golem down there once.” “It was an animated stone creature. Maybe a statue? Idk the difference between the two.” Shes a wizard!! “I went to the local one, sometimes alphons would play hero and go into the ruins on the cliff. Come back with a spellbook or two.” L: what “The ruins. There are some down there. There usually are in those gaps of the world.” “When the world expanded it left stretch marks”
“Took a decade to fix the existing lightning rails” To leofric “can you not read? There’s no shame in that.” Leofric Leaves “My brother’s ashamed. We tought him how to read, but griffins attacked and he hit his head and he forgot. 2 years of learning down the drain” Osnova 22, 1290 Visitor traveling to the north
GAWAIN NOOKS!!! She stops the cart confused at seeing fitzie and leofric in the fields “The adventuring life not work out for you?” This is part of it! “Oh. do you need help?”
“Will you be filing this?” (with Ambassadors' Guild) Uh “HAVE YOU NOT BEEN FILING THE PAPERWORK” Uh We have a few She helps with the final day Oh god we dont have the paperwork Takes 2 day to get there Zima 1, 1290 Arrive the first week of summer Arrive to find alphons waiting like a dog for the train after hearing the news Doesnt seem to notice us, helps the various cabbies unload their train. Work that is normally unbefitting for a knight Unfortunately drops the luggage as he sees his family get off the train, hugs his family He walks with them, showing them around the city, too preoccupied to acknowledge our existence
Sprint to peater
We’re able to meet with him, next to him is the the other Peater Iliev He smiles at the leshy “dad needs his rest.” T: perhaps its best we speak to you abt this then? “Suppose so.” Explain the situation They are experienced
“I’ll need to talk to dad. The shroudfort was able to be fully sowed. Are they big enough to take out the roots of the trees?” Yes the 8 y/o is 6ft tall “They take out the roots, the patch is their’s.” Btw alphons will be visiting often. His family S: do u have a patch of his field prepared? “He asked mr voss to prepare a grave. He deserves that much” S: id love to help if u and mr voss would have me. “That might be good. I’m thinking 1 of 2 places. The patch where he was born, or the new patch. Theyre on opposite sides, and i shant split up my dad so that hes buried in both.” S: perhaps we take some of the earth where he was born, take it to the new patch. So that hes a part of the new land with some of the old. Do u think hed like that? “Tbh i think he would like to be buried in any earth. Personally i think im the one that cares the most.” S: would you like that? “I think itd be fitting. Its the last great thing he organized.” S: we can do that! (there’s smth known as the right of blood and right of death in sighar. 1 council who rules death and 1 who rules life temporarily. If u die while bleeding out in chalice it shows ur conviction. I will be sure that when he comes here, he shall not leave town.” (we could use this as blackmail later. We’d be assholes. “I can make him spill any secret you want.” Soul cages (capturing souls) He agrees

U really love this town “Siroth loved them. So i love them.” Ty for meeting with us “Of course. Youve given me a way to vent my rage soon.”
(l: WE HAVE GOT TO GET THOSE 2 TOGETHER AGAIN. How guarded do u think Hell is) We do the paperwork for lordship
Go to Collegium Arcanum to get a sending scroll Ppl shy away from fitzie bc. Expelled. Alphons Acton asked for many childrens books for himself but acted like theyre for his siblings

“I am almost there, would it not be wise to meet urgan to went to the tree to confirm green man? Able to prepare it, pretilling and sectioning it off. Removing rocks so that when Peater dies u can add the soil and then whenever hes reborn it gives good life to whatever grows, likely cabbages and other vegetables
Fitzie reuniting librarian with Thoqiohne's Niece Fitzie fumbles, he doesnt seem persuaded LEOFRIC WILL HELP WITH THE NEXT ONE Leofric gets 1 more hero point Zima 6, 1290
Lady sae arrives on the lightning rail dizzy from. 25mph, she hugs leofric She asks where our cart is Aw shit we forgot it We by a wagon and 2 horses “Its going to take a while. “I was going to work my way by slowly working my way in and retreating back to ur castle. U can assist.” But first urgan Settle down for the first day, a bit out of the ways. She points toward the woodline at the shapes of creatures “do you see that?” See the outlines of tigers hunting down deer, alongside a giant bear, all fighting, and then the deer get back up immediately. “You wish to set nature right?” yes thats the ideal L: horrible, just like my homeland “Was it?” L: yeah ppl would fight wars and then get back up and continue fighting She grabs her axe and sword She moves to, leofric notices first. The animals dont seem to move their bodies, simply clack against each other like dolls Looking not at animals but a carved beast, not dangerous but afraid of ppl. Type of wood elemental that has carved animals. Actual living is the stump.
This is near where Elwood Henstock died We send sachiko They bury themselves underground, leaving only the tops of the animals S: i have some questions and a request! We kill man.” S: from a distance it really seems like ur real animals “Animal fight back no? When try kill.” S: true? I just…. U crushed that guy to death. “Death only once.” S: u crushed him multiple times to death. I just want to make sure u have ur peaceful play time, but i also want to make sure no one else is getting hurt. Is there… a message i could pass on to the nearby ppl to see if we can find a peaceful compromise? “No shoot us.” S: big roar??? “No mouth.” S: wear a sash to show ur not real animals? “Animal no wear sash.” S: exactly! “Ruin play.” (statue, u paint them.) S: what if we painted u to look even more like animals. Increase quality of ur play! Might be fun, nice to be painted to be the animals taht u are “Paint away” We paint them bright unnatural colors Zima 7, 1290

Iapholi (Reincarnation) is here as well
Wanikiya Luran Pixie and a woman Woman approaches leofric “Would you be a dear and buy a woman a drink?” casts Charming Touch on him Hes so normal now “He seemed nervous. So i wanted him to give me some liquid courage.”
“You can call me the Maiden Eiza Youngglory. Monster and sae is as strong as leofric and tall Leofric comes back out Hes so much calmer Winn and borick are talking abt whether or not they charge leofric for the potato Iapholi “do u find me attractive leofric?” He runs away Luran talking to her, asks if she knows of any monstrous creatures that travel thru time Dismisses hounds of tindalos L: how does ur search go? ‘Not well.” L: sorry to hear that

(his rank is probably higher than sachiko’s mom. No idea what type, but if he walks near u, you’re slowed. Paralyzed if he wishes. L: are u malgara’s daughter? “Of course” L: we’ve heard a lot abt her’
“A lot form the Duke Vantreau i presume” L: oh no just rumors, a local acquaintance in the area that hunts evil fey T: only those that eat ppl She has poison candies and her touch can make u feel compliant and at home “I could answer your questions for your quests, i could warn you of the dangers ahead. Its important to let the next generation do their best and make their way in the world, as im sure you did “No. i would rather see this entire city crumble to dust than to see him take an inch of it.” L: bc he wont make a deal we have? “The way us true lords have. Truly its no coincidence that my city and siroth’s city are 2 of the most prosperous ones.” L: whats up with the prisoners? “What of them?” L: are they here for a show? T: for funsies? “For fun.” L: i thought prisoners were always put underground, away “We have a mine for them to work thu. the ones who underperform get sent to me. I make sure ⅓ survive, and the underperformance stop.”
We sit in the liquor shaker He proposes a simple plan “He goes to whip ppl in the mines occasionally. Why not ambush him there?” L: do we have to leave instantly orrr The slaves wont snitch on us in the mines.
THE PURPLE WATERS ARE ALCOHOLIC BC CAYDEN CAILEAN FOUGHT HERE???? “A goddess of destruction tried to poison the waters, so caden caylean turned it to alcohol, bc he couldnt cure it”

Talk to the son bc we want to kill his dad Brunei Blackstone About to take the liquor shaker out again Wave him down “Still haven’t burnt it down I see.” T: when he goes to collect the underperformers we’re going to have a discussion then? “There’s one way if you wish to have an unobserved meeting with him. Whatever lives in there hates to be observed and hates to have people come through. A decent chunk of their bodies were eaten. Their armor was crushed. No sign of elements tho.” F: how many lost? “10 men, but no idea how many slaves he sent down.” “You’d have to be tricky to avoid it. Its basically just a hallway. But it recent, which means he wouldnt expect people to go thru so soon.” He only checks on the underperformers every 3 days, he went 2 days ago, so if we go fight the thing today and then rest down there, we can get him the next day Takes us to the abandoned mine, simple for us to go Back entrance that would Not be the back end of the thieves guild but a thieves guild could take over We find the boarded up mineshaft, squeeze thru Try and sneak through to not wake the creature Uh oh we get attacked Orange hide tries to attack, but leofric is out of the way Combat Feel a sense of madness overcoming Umber Hulk (5e creature fear) Throm gets materials from it
Its from Deep underground, rarely found in places like the blackloch of brazenthrone, let alone somewhere as high up as here They dont go surfacebound, prefer to dig down, far below where a normal dwarf civilization would be. Doesnt show signs of conjuration, so its likely it was brought here Sachiko goes to the plants S: hello! How are you doing! “Good. lots of water. Far from toxic water.” S: is it ok if i asked some questions? “You already are!” S: some more! Leaves rustle “sure!” S: so some people came in this cavesystem, and we believe they were killed by this creature, are you able to confirm or deny? “They were killed, yes” S: by the thing? They confirm S: do you know how long its been here? Which way it came from? “The roots say its new, but its been here as long as we’ve been here” S: how long have you been here? “2 cold seasons.” S: do you happen to know where it came from? Anyone who would know? “The roots!” there are numerous large roots, polyps that glow Ferns have only been alive for 2 years, but the roots much longer Sachiko cant talk to the roots themselves Giant statue hidden into the wall Appears to be an old statue of torag, if you understand how theyre constructed, dwarves often put inscriptions in their base
Throm is able to read: “Moradin” not “Torag” Rest Zima 19, 1290 Hear the slaves being emptied out of the mines He sees us Smiles
“This is why i knew you weren’t true workers for Draven Košarek.” L: whys that? “You have no eyes or hands for actual treachery.” L: no not really “My own son led you into my trap.” F: your trap? “Of course. Once its been found that ive been ambushed, your castle will be given to me, which will then be given to my son.” (regardless of what happens, he wins. Hes lying, his son didnt betray us) Combat
Hargrit Leadbuster Cleric Recalling dagger Hellknight of Gems

He looks down upon bolo, disappointed Sachiko burns a woman to death Bolo gets the kill on him Bolo gets the kill on the hellknight woman Break their jaws as best we can, run away Sneak thru as the son gets paisley and lady sae thru Offer the clan dagger to him, “we best not keep that, lest someone think you killed my father.” Zima 22, 1290
Get to Ambassadors' Guild
Hi geff “Are these recruits?” Uhhhh maybe! 30 copies of paperwork ppl “Do remember that each person needs to fill out each individually” Yup Geff doesnt like us S: mr geff we realized that we werent very kind, we’d like to apologize (dragging bolo back over) “For what?” S: for being unkind! “Anything more specific” L: for crying in front of you We awkwardly apologize Leofric accidentally walking in on a meeting with the dirmandian lands
(Homveran Zenderholm, urgan, Gorvain Lecrân, another woman) Gorvain stands, walks over “youre lords in the ambassador’s guild, no?” yes! “Then i will see if- the larger room, i think there’s a group partying in it.” Leads us to the bigger room Urgan welcomes us
“There might be war in the dirmandian lands soon.”
“The queen’s been missing for 20 years now. And the peace she built can’t be forever. Some people think that since the queen’s reign is ending, and that i have agreeance with it, the ppl of the dirmandian lands should be given amnesty to travel outward. As such they’ll need castles and villages to stay in. monsieur lecran has offered his own abode in Vensare, historic region once known as ensile and tunseel following the fall of both nations. Its a democracy, at least the beginning of one.” F: that’s good news! “The issue is that is a bit far, so i was hoping that some of the castle holders- and i was going to send word when this concludes in a week. But its good news that youre here!” F: we’d be happy to take ppl in
Woman “i’m Mistress Reignare, pleasure to meet you.” shakes our hands Honorary title amongst drow women, she’s unmarried Fitzie messages leofric, woman gets uncomfy, urgan tells us to not do that “How many buildings under ur lordship?” Just the one but we’re going to expand “Is it at least a big castle? Fit 100?” T: Comfortably fit 75? But caldrith itself has constant need for workers- “Oh! I see. You have a city and a castle.” B: most would go to the city but we can host some in the castle
“I can arrange for you to be sent to caldrith, we do have teleportation set up for each ambassador cities, they havent yet set up a 2 way teleporter” We’re so not capable but urgan convinces her that we are Her “we’ll talk more about it when i’m at caldrith. There are more promising places, like rozen.” Oh there’s no ambassador guild there? Urgan “ik its cheap to slander the competition, but theyre like devils. Youd be best to avoid it. Besides, itd be rude to let monsieur lecran waiting too long. He does have the rest of the continent to show you.” The meeting quiet adjourn with her agreeing to go with him, who hugs homveran goodbye and get ready to teleport Urgan “not the worst youve done!” We’ve set the bar in hell
T: are you- im sure ur familiar with her. But. uh. Guildmistress aberdeen skimberton’s homunculi? “Yes”
T: we’ve come across 2 so far, one has um. Is seeking refuge. F: says that she’s broken free of the scrying, and that ms aberdeen says thinks she dead. “I’ll check tomorrow. But i need to do experiments, but ive found they react badly to them.” S: are we able to warn her to prepare herself? “No the experiments are to make sure that shes not a spy. If she is one, and you warn her… well. It needs to be done. Don’t worry, i’ll make them as painless as i can, but a few will need vials of blood.” Explain that shes skittish, scared ‘I wouldn’t put it past aberdeen to create a humonculous that fully believes these things.” L: makes sense. Im sure u all have everyone’s best interests in mind. Also travelling with us is a woman from frethiar who seeks a green man, we’d hope u’d be willing to answer her questions abt the one seen down south “Of course!”
L: yeah we also. Ran into we believe a servant of galorfin come from the southern continent “That should be impossible.” L: he said he had permission to travel back and forth “That doesnt mean the ability. Most ppl idly have permission, except for those banned.” L: he had a map “Where was he?”
F: Winn's Hollow Tavern “Then i should take my wife down there.” T: how familiar are you with animists and the spirits we invoke? “Ik they are cultural, but they’re very rarely seen in our world’
T: i’m one, my understanding was that the spirits are typically spirits of the dead, but i believe 2 of my spirits lie across the veil and still yet breathe. One i see is a field of pumpkins, fire, and the other has no image, but the man we spoke to, altervein, was deferential. Also lifeholder.” Homveran “would you say that all of them are there? Are there any you’ve confirmed not?” T: i havent confirmed any not from there, but so far we’ve only identified 3 for sure, and one i feel the barest connection to a glyph of water from the keep.
“It could be- ik animism can be passed by blood. It could be that ur the only one has a blood relative across the pale.” F: also we were denied info abt lifeholder, but were denied by duke vantreau. Anymore info abt him? Gives us the basic info
“It is possible that lifeholder- Duke Vantreau knew more abt lifeholder than the rest of the group. Idk why he’d want to stop you.” F: oh he doesnt like us “Why??” T: weeee took a deal with his previous captor, we’re trying to fix it. But on our life we will fix this “Alright. Then you will rectify it, or else its your last act on the earth.” T: we’ve already agreed to execution by his hands if we dont fix it “Itll be just, but it wont come to be, will it?” T: it will not. We get more paperwork from geff “Of course. For some reason it seems you forgot to pick this up.” handbook full of papers we Need in our embassy T: paisley how are you fitting in?
“Wonderful! I was finishing my paperwork! I was helping lady sae, but she got called back.” F: howd that go?
“Perfectly fine, they dont really ask questions. Im to do a mission with lady sae? They’re sending me to the Boreal Ledgerman Dungeon.” T: i wish you luck paisley “Itll be good to go on an adventure!” T: when you say that i truly believe u love adventure “I can feel it in my heart!” S: what kind of things do u like to do! “Read a little bit of everything and conduct magic!” S: ive got some new books! (pulls out the art of the deal, and wenches and how to woo them) “You shouldnt read stuff like that!” S: wdym?? “One it doesnt work, and 2 its sad! If you want a good romance, i have some i can show you!” S: ill take ur suggestions for a friend “I only read a few in the library, and when we were first coming out, the others in my batch. If we didnt choose one of 2 book categories, we were destroyed!” S: what did you choose? “I dont remember! We were but little babies and just crawled towards them. And if we crawled towards the wrong one, disentegration!” “We had to take care of it when we got older, before we could do fieldwork! Do upon others done upon yourself!” S: what were the categories? “Adventure or romance were the right categories” “I’m here to start my first adventure!” Leofric is not normal about women again
Barkeep (Wortvan Verhok) follows him outside “HEY PUSSY BOY” L: AH. WAHTS UP T: dont respond to that!!! L: ITS CLEARLY ME!!! U DIDNT MAKE A FOOL OF URSELF!!! Throws dagger at him “Try shoving this up your ass!” L: would it make it up for you???? “No, but whenever you get butterflies, think abt the dagger up your ass!” Leofric shoves it in his stomach “Why would you do that?????” Sachiko has to convince leofric not to kill himself in embarassment Homveran goes and sees leofric out in the courtyard “Everything alright??” L: uhhhhhh. Ahhhhhhh. S: he put his foot in his mouth with woman. And then a knife in his tummy “Why????” L: i thought it might. Yknow. Help S: condition himself to not- i made him pinky promise to not do it again. If he breaks a pinky promise… “It is a shame.” L: yeah. “Why women?”
L: uhhhh. Great question. Have u ever met. Like. aace arubedo? “Once with my dad.” L: thats. Thats my mom “Oh. biologically?” L: i think so? “I dont!”
L: no as far as i can remember, we- i grew up to the south and my mom worked for a lord and then she left and then she came back and she had ears. Now. cause she’d been in disguise before. “You…. might be cursed?” L: and my mom took me back to our. Home? (headache) there’s a lot i dont remember. Anyway, i think that’s why women? And also im attracted to women. How did u learn to be normal around women? “It’d be kinda weird if i wasnt, all things considered! They are but people.” L: yeah no ur right. Better man than me dude “Nono, dont say that. Ur making an excuse for yourself! You might be cursed, or it could be uh… medical thing.” L: maybe? I think im just a bad person “Maybe! But i have my doubts!” S: u could be better? L: ill work on it! I really dont wanna throw up in another dishwasher. Or break my nose again “Still! I… why not ask guild master urgan to see if he can break a curse on you?” L: thats an option??? “Hes a thaumaturge!” L: thats what they do??? I thought he was just beautiful S: and strong! “He can be both!” L: sure? Id be happy to ask urgan. Well ig asking him to break a curse that makes it bad to talk to women. Sure. alright. Thank you S: thank you. (hugs him) Bar again Bolo talks to another odd gnome. 3 gnomes at the bar! And a halfling “Still, how does he want to be a warrior if he cant talk to half his people?” IDK Drow woman “do you think exposure therapy would work?” F: we tried!!! He just pukes “Does he not feel uncomfortable around women in charge?” Noooo he may be fine there “Why not join a drow society then” Drow woman waiting for leofric, scares him as he comes back in “hey handsome!” Leofric screams L: myyyy name is leofric! And yourself?
“Velianna.” L: what brings you to the guild? “I was looking for a handsome consort, and i seem to have found him!” L: OH GOD IT KEEEPS HAPPENING “??????” L: do u want my divine blood too! “No i just want to fuck” Leofric awkward (shes not looking for a consort, shes trying to say whatever would make him the most self conscious) L: what do u do for work? “Im a daughter of the pale queen”
L: oh! Like Iapholi (Reincarnation)? “Yes. how is she doing by the way?” L: we had a duel! And i lost! She almost killed me with firebreaht and it was so cool! And a week ago we woke up in a tavern and she was on the CEILING T: she said she wanted to hunt us!!! “Then hunt her back!” L: do u think it was a metaphor?? “For her, no, but it could be.” L: shes disappointed im not the right person. She fought the duke and thats cool. “Youre gonna have to fight the duke someday?” L: yyyyeah “So you cant beat my sister, who cant beat the duke…” L: im not very strong. Do u enjoy what u do for work? “Queendom is beautiful. I think i would enjoy being a queen forever.” L: what kinda policies do u have in place? “About which aspect?” L: idk im trying to learn more abt taxation and crop rotations, ive heard theyre important for being a responsible ruler She lays out a tax policy, hes normal (shes fucking with him, it doesnt make sense and has inside jokes from the dirmandian lands) L: i… clearly need to study more, im sorry “Am i not pretty enough for you to stab in the stomach?” L: if you have any daggers “No its poisoned, you shouldnt.” L: that was horrifyingly difficult. But when im talking abt interesting things i can be normal for 5 mins L: thanks for talking to me and im sorry for not stabbing myself F: NO “Its fine, i forgive you.”

Thank you. I’ll see if i can make it work.” T: we have a number of beds set aside for guild members “Any permanent residents?” T: ourselves, also a friend from my youth. “Odd, but must be fantastic for it to be a full embassy for there to be only 6 people living there” T: we’re looking to expand, so if ur ever looking for a permanent location, lets make it 7 “We’ll see what’s underneath first.” T: of course!

Wait for urgan We need sending scrolls

L: there’s a waterfall he and his group discovered that contains relevant info. Some sort of secret library that might have info from beyond the pale? Hard. are you sure you’re going to be able to mentally take it rn?” L: what???? Whats ailing me? I’m just socially not great “Ur probably right i probably just had a misread”
“Fitzie i presume, you should take the 3 sending scrolls. Use them as you will, stay here for 2 days and head back. I need tomorrow to deal with paisley and the day after to send to merris.” F: anything we can do to lighten your load?
“Just keep doing what your doing. Help geff or laverous.”
Lady sae is probably drinking in the baths Throm makes an awesome drink and is forced to become a bartender Fitzie joins the baths
Velianna and lady sae Discuss leofric’s mommy issues
Sowwin’s death day is lady sae’s birthday
Suggest taking the curse eaters to caldera We’d have to take care of the curse-spreader before we try to take down the curse Urgan casts modify memory on leofric during the night Hes forced to remember the death of his mom and the tree Modify memory removing another modify memory Staring directly into his eyes, seeing how he reacts
Leofric saw the king kill his mom bc of the way he redirected the energy
Does Now remember Aace Arubedo coming in and saying theyre his mom now He has another scroll ready just in case he needs to revert it Leofric in shock looking back Urgan lets go (silenced L: they pretended to be my mom? They caused my mom to die?) Leave the room, he drops the silence Urgan wakes the rest of us up Leofric explains what he remembers Urgan takes paisley A while later, he walks out with her, hands a bit bloody Urgan signs at us, paisley over his shoulders, we dont know what he says He comes back, sits down at the bar “she used to be a spy, but she isnt” T: is that from what u did? “No, but i did have to extract-” pulls out an odd stone that is shattered, with runes
“This is how she tracks people.” “It was shattered when it was in her, i think thats why she wasnt recalled” (each side has different types of magic, to track, to see thru, see the vitality of, etc. one shouldve been tied to her life force) F: where was it located? “Near her heart.” he plays around with it, it activates, expands spikes on all of its vertices “its also meant to do that” He snaps it in half, grinds it into fine powder “we want to make sure it doesnt send out a signal even accidentally.” hands over the powder of pailsey’s heart stone “should still be magical.” F: is she… alright? “I’m debating on, ironically, erasing her memories, since i didnt have to do it for leofric. It was traumatizing.” “She’s under a sleep spell, she’ll wake up in abt 3 hours. If you could be awake for her? I think it’d help a lot. I did carry her to your rooms, i placed her in one of the beds.” He downs his alcohol, goes back to his with his wife which he gets to enjoy for 2 hours. Zima 23, 1290 Paisley wakes up with a scream, manage to calm her down “We’ve gotta get out of here, master urgan doesn’t seem to be who he says he is.” F: wdym??? “He does foul experiments. I saw him tear out my heart.” It does appear he took out smth near her heart, but her heart is perfectly in there S: your heart is still in here, he got smth near it, it was the stone “I can’t feel it.” L: describe? “I dont have a heart beat!” Cups her hands around her ears S: do you hear a wooshing sound? Thats ur heart “The wind?” S: no, its your heart (it might be an illusion she’s under. Another aspect thats beyond us rn) She calms down enough “still, i’d rather not stay at this place.” L: you’re welcome to stay at our castle, we really need someone who can read “Cant fitzie read????” F: IM LEARNING SO MANY LANGUAGES RN “Why does master urgan’s teleportation circle work?” Uhhhh dont know “Is it safe then?” Idk, but we live very close to caldrith which IS safe Day of downtime Bolo Asking for a magic mailbox Has to turn in the paperwork to geff “What of the others? Your cosigners for the embassy?” B: i’ll be right back “Remember, he who has a partner has a master.” Once per week, we can leave things in the mailbox and itll be delivered, and the next week itll return (1 bulk or less) Fitzie Urgan asks her to lay out the basic plans for the teleportation circle 1 person per day (DONT USE IT FOR PAPERWORK) Also learning more old zondian Gets throm’s help with sketching up blueprints We decide on a nice gazebo Leofric Making connections with people Sachiko Learning as much as she can about the area from the plants that are here Major events that mightve happened before this building, anything that might be affecting the plants Urgan planted these guys here, but she can go to dirmandian lands to find more interesting trees Unfortunately cant find any that have lived long enough, the average lifespan is abt 5 years Throm Making armor, mace, moving runes over Zima 24, 1290 “Merris can pick you up in a week’s time. My craftsman has already gotten to the castle, build the teleportation circle and mailbox” Oh wow thats so fast!
We go back to Candlelight Keep
Sir Expus Mentums approaches “Throm have u been getting into drawing recently?” T: oh god what did u find? He holds up a painting of sir mentums holding throm tenderly T: UH. its quite well done. But. uh. “I’m going to” holds it up to a torch, passes out Throm nurses sir mentums back to health
Kamin Ga'Val “i have smth interesting” he leads us to now cleared caves “There wasn’t too much, but it seems to lead to a crossroads of sorts. I went down each to see if i needed to clear anything, and… here, i’ll lead you to one” Leads north to a giant cavern, odd almost spire inside of it. Kaledescopic in nature T: oh my! Seems to be a defensive structure? Unsure of what it is, but maybe goes deeper into the earth T: fascinating. Do know 1 person who would know: the duke, surely, as there are symbols of the old duke on here T: maybe duke vantreau knows smth… ty ga’val “There are other ways i can keep digging if you want?” T: which ways are you considering?
“Expands north into the forest, west to the lake, south-east to emerald coast.” Spire is Very magical, rank 10 Fitzie thinks throm is wrong, it doesnt go further down, but pierces up. Symbols matches the umber hulk, also mentioning a god that seemingly created these Seems to be in the form of a hand with an eye on the back The other crossroads have the same spire/symbols Leofric touches the spire, a door appears Enter There is a sudden blackout for everyone as we awaken in our own castle in the communal beds
Draven Košarek is here “I thought we agreed that for the main castle that i was in charge of restorations. It was in the contract.” T: thats below the keep “Unfortunately it still falls underneath me.” T: can i at least still use the magma forge? Its so cool.
Someone else walks in. oh fuck Duke Vantreau Vantreau “my understanding is that they found the spires?” Draven “they have.” Duke to us “you can’t interact due to your contract, however, those you hire can. Itll be dangerous. Be wise about it.” Draven “when i get my hands on him, do you know how i’ll harm him? Ill do it as you, then work my way upward. Starting from the toe nails, then taking off his feet. Cast regenerate. And then-” Vantreau punches him, then passes out “He’s your biggest obstacle. Take care of him now.” T: he’s had many chances, its just to help “Is it just if your wife and little brother “He couldnt protect you from me if he wanted to.” T: numerous hags who want us dead? “And what would they give to have a devil from my circle?” B: theyd ask for control “Of a devil from me… you had no problem taking care another scion of mine.” “Did you see what he’s planning on taking care of the necromancer boy? And what he’s done to others in the past?” “Necromancers dont use souls, they use the bodies, i could give less than a shit what they do with the corpse. Most necromancers just torture a corpse, a simulacrum.” F: most? “There are exceptions. Are lawyers are ever busy. I ask again, why did you kill the noble man?” T: we made a deal. F: seems right up your alley “You want to kill bad people? He’s bad people.” B: its funny, idk if he is. S: we won’t do it “Okay. then i’ll make you an ultimatum. You either kill him now and do not persue the towers, or we will be enemies once the contract is up.” We all agree that’s fine, we’ll be his enemy “When you come down there, know you couldve had a good place by the fire.” and he teleports away. Duke wakes up after an hour, unharmed T: he really baited you there “....yeah.” T: when this is over, we may need assistance with draven. “Ill see what i can do.” F: what are the spires? “Defense mechanisms. I believe they one belonged to gods. But for now, the devils control can be released from them. One of my conditions is that i cannot speak of them to someone who doesnt already know. Idk why siroth wrote it that way, but i assume it has to do with his own deal with draven.” L: how high up is draven? “Son of an archdevil.” L: im gonna shit my pants. And need a bigger hammer. He walks away To clear a spire they need 10 days of time Various challenges will await in [Redacted]. PCs and certain NPCs may not participate. I've made a program to calculate whether it succeeds or fails based on how well you match the requirements of the challenge. Each one will require 10 days of downtime to complete and attempt of. Each participant has had their stats simplified into: Combat Defenses Magic Physical Skills Mental Skills Unique abilities These values will have a rank of 1-10 Each rank adds or substracts 1 from each depending on level difference between people going in there and the challenge. If an NPC completes a challenge of higher level than them they'll level up, regardless of if they are allies or enemies later. You may send as many NPCs in as you want, though doing so will increase the price and certain NPCs will be unavailable. Failure will result in lost money and time. Critical failure will result in potential death of participants. The rewards for success and critical success are redacted for now Closer are easier to do, further are harder Double daily income for downtime First is combat based (under lake), magic (forest), skill (emerald coast)
Sending to Vasili
We need to talk about rozen, where are you so we can talk? Signed fitzie fairntickle “I can swing by your keep in 2 weeks, i am touring the emerald coast right now. Will be taking a break for a week afterwards. Do you need me to send again?” Sends to us Any new leads on lanterns?
“2 in melissa. 2 in rozen. 1 in dirmandian lands.” Check back in with thieves guild
Elyra Vaelith, found Vailith “Why do you need this?” We found it in our walls “It seems to be giving legal ownership to parts of the city, parts of the land.”

Menzoberranzan and a library with a waterfall “Huh” L: back home

L: not ciburn, across the pale “How do you remember?” L: i um. I had a modify memory cast on me. Beyond expectations (Karn) Dedicated to a farmer commoner who rose beyond all expectations to kill a pseudo god Standing below us are the old stars of the previous era that illuminate this bookcase F: have u read any? “They arent mine. Whoever runs this place only lets you pull certain books” We cant read the book hes pulled out He says the books are translucent somewhat to him, but theyre fine for us Each book has a brief foreword/dedication “Feel free to take one with you. I believe the first invitational rights will be in a year after good service to the library.” S: return your books? “All books will return, the being who runs it is mighty powerful.” Books we take Throm takes The cold beyond destiny Access to limited arcane spells (as if sorcerer) Sachiko takes Nature removed from madness Gets sowwins wood gate (gain wood blast) Leofric takes Alms of heaven Limited version of divine font feature Fitzie takes The stationary heroine Either limited occult spells (cantrips + first rank) or gain harrow reading Bolo An innocent shall remain Does allow u to fire a reload weapon twice before needing to reload “So why did u come here?” Uhhhh menzobarrenzen “Do u know shadow elves, etc, what do they call dark elves?” Drow? “Drow? They call them that too? Well menzobarrenzen was their capital.” B: anything abt their heart “Oh the palace.” B: have u been there? “No a diagram! Ive read 2nd hand account "i wish i could tell you about the realm, but its name seems to have been forgotten" “They practiced slavery, but some escaped. The non-slavers ran away to other countries. One even came here.”
F: pale queen? “Oh that makes sense. She went through the early pale.” F: did u ever meet her? “Gods no! Ive been here for 15 years. Im not worthy to meet a god.”
F: with the divine gate being closed she surely didnt go there “Oh no, shes not a god just a very powerful woman.” “If she did disappear these 20 years ago like u said, does make a man wonder where she went.” Ah damn it. 20 years since the pale opened. L: u know anything else abt the world tree down south? Its where im from but idk much abt it. So anything u may know
“ about the world tree?: L: like people who lived there, the food they ate “Ik a little abt the culture. Did u know they had gnomes and halflings to wander the beaches collecting metal?” F: metal???? “They didnt have metal in the ground, they got it from the ocean.” “Ik of some festivities they used to have abt moon convergences. U hear they had 13 moons? And the tree was big enough that it had seasons around its branches.” “My understanding is that it grew so big due to its connection to fey magics.” “They do say that the fey magics were the first of creation, they couldve just dug into a spot with a lot of creation magic.” L: hope we go there “Is that why ur hunting it down?” L: im from there “Longing for home?” L: yeah i was taken as a child away, i also have these abilities that re connected to that world “The divine spark, like that of creation.” L: i suppose? Wdym like that of creation??? “I mean. It was a moldable substance, a thing of the gods from an old world. Its um… i believe the term for it is mana. Or atleast physical mana. It can be folded into any shape u want. Like clay! U mold it and provides what u need. Cant be geographically changed once its established. I think the tree grew on it.” He thought leofric was a cleric and throm different T: is wish they told me their names! But they dont “They dont. Theyre half bodies. Like me.” T: can you tell me if theyre deceased or are elsewhere? “I cant ask them. Theyre not deceased, but not like how u think. They might be from the deceased but theyre yearning for life. They found a craftsman who can bring their will into the world.” (if throm has the right spirit equipped, its half the cost) “They arent the real thing of course. Theyre just… spirits of mana. Being reminded of strong stories.” L: idek what to say Manifest zone vs mana discussion, u can make a manifest zone if u cast a spell over and over at one spot, similar to old teleportation circle magics (have to cast teleport on one spot every day for a year) Exit the cave, merris is so confused bc he couldnt see us but we could see him “Where the hell did u go?” L: the current era? “Current?” L: we saw u in the floor We pull out the books, theyre etched to our souls now “U each took a book? U obv took mine right leofric?” L: no i took dayalu’s. Did u know ive sworn an oath against the divine? “You took dayalu’s? And not mine?” L: he kileld angels. And defied their wishes Merris fucking sucks convo. He did not know leofric cant read or write We go back to the keep “Son what have u been up to?” L: killed a basilisk thing. Actually nvm i dont want to talk abt that. We killed a dragon too Eventually he leaves

Fitzie talks to mira thornveil Shes working on blending divine and occult
She can teleport, using Hell as like a teleportation focus and mixing it with occult magic She agrees to come check out the spires in a week, concerned abt fitzie maybe making a deal with demons her dad brought back her mom that way Throm poisons himself Then fucks it up again Leofric helps out alphons’ family They can hang out in the city while he works on the farm Sachiko making sure throm doesnt die. Then helps on the farm with nature Seems to be a good harvest soon Preispo 4, 1290 We get them a feast ready Throm does it The rest of wait They succeed, the tower pierces the ceiling of the area, going high into the sky, going further and further, see small cracks of light that get filled in From the tower, silver tendrils extend creating bubbles and motes around it and us The tower is 12 miles away for those above ground. Good mile or so under the ground Silvery tendrils flow, group escapes outward “Youre real, right?” L: id like to think so, are u ok??? Sae gasps for breath, takes off her helmet “hall of illusions” B: mustve been awful “Not too bad, mostly a test of mental fortitude, tho creatures of hell did tempt us and shaped the illusions.” L: made some food, if youd like? “O-of course.” looks at silvery thread, looks at raven, who can stand to touch the thread Raven “well its harmless. Seems to be… im not quite sure.” She casts a spell at it “its magic, but it has no school. Nor tradition!” “Can you enter the tower?” L: we tried “You tried when the demons controlled it. They disappeared once we finished it.” B: what was in it when u were leaving? “It was just a hall. Black with a staircase that extended upward.” Leofric can open the door, can see from the staircase going up several stories is a spire that extends into a glass dome. See a midday sky that shines into the dwarven hall. See a door cracked open, hear the sounds of nature echoing down the long hall
Black spire made of near obsidian, various symbols of 2 gods around it. The top has stained glass that lets the hammer and forge of Moradin fall around the black spire They eat with us, celebrating, talks abt the Blue House of Illusion, on an odd lane that they couldnt go down. They could hear the splashing of a bay. In the blue house were shifting hallways, each time they completed they could go back and enjoy a night at the inn where they were the only ones there. The things they ate were clearly illusory, they still felt full. The inn they went to was odd with people dancing, drinking, taking bets of descending into a hole built into its center. (a yawning portal…. Confirmed to be old zondian) Burnsten gains a level! Explore the tower Its of simple design, at its final form what seems to be an ashen black tower made of obsidian-like substance, it pierces the sky. 2 entrances in the forest bed and 1 in the caves we can enter. This is mana, the threads that shape it. Left here by the gods for the gods to help them rebuild after a calamity they were preparing for. Lets them build whatever, even food if you needed. Along the sides, hidden under the obsidian (calcified mana) engravings underneath if we dug deep enough. Tells stories to give to people who survived
Simple stories, but meant to carry on the language/stories of their people. This tells the story of the Blue House of Illusions in waterdeep

Peater Iliev the lesser waves “How goes the hunt for devils?” L: taken an interesting turn B: we’ve taken smth from them L: actually if u want in on that. Elyra Vaelith reaches out her hand, its passed over She folds it open
“So youre the ones who killed the lord. You have his contract, a thing he wouldnt release out of pain of death.” “We’re in your debt. If you could, leave so we can take a vote.” Leaves, eventually come back
“Our next major mission is the assassination of Finstad. Would fitzie be there? And are you still working with her?” L: uh. Yes? Im still working with fitzie? She won’t be on any of the expeditions
“I… we’ve come to believe that Ephiane Savile has made deals with the devils in the past, so we’ve had to open accounts on any of her students.” B: she’s not gonna be a student much longer L: she can come answer questions? “We’d rather her not be involved in any of our operations until such a time that… well.” vaelith “would you be willing to go behind fitzie’s back?” B: for?
“Investigating the university?” L: um. I mean. Would it surprise u that below the first there’s steel doors that go even further?” L: i could see if fitzie’s interested in helping investigate?
B: how much would the duke know? “He likely knows.” B: if theyre doing devil things he’d stop them “He doesnt like them. Hes trying to shut them down. Its been very strange and evasive with what happened there, would u consider perhaps including fitzie on this? She helped us acquire that contract right there “Fitzie has to kill her mentor. Would she be able to? She’s able to shank a man who has slaves openly about and is an openly cruel lord, is she brave enough to shank someone who’s shown her only kindness?” B: i think if she knew they were doing smth evil, even if she couldnt kill them she’d have to limit them. An assassin might have no problem finishing the job “Ur not on the case. Ive asked 3 yes or no questions and youve answered with 3 maybes.” S: i dont think i could violate my friend’s trust. Im sorry “We’ll do what we do. Adn you’ll do what you do. If we can help each other, we’ll hope that the stars align” S: absolutely, i just couldnt go behind her back “Of course. Bolo, grow a pair of balls, stop answering maybe to yes or no.” S: i hope ur investigations are fruitful! L: i. Sachiko. We cant just- if our friend’s friends are in danger. We cant just fuck off. S: i just- L: i dont know if… S: i hate having to keep this info from her! B: i dont think we have to. L: i mean. If we dont believe with conviction- i believe that fitzie will do the right thing. But if we cant look them in the eyes and guarantee she’d help, then we cant expose what theyre doing by mentioning it. I think she can do it but id never want to promise on someone else’s behalf like that. B: i think if she found out they were doing devil practices she’d do smth abt it, but… killing one’s teacher isnt always easy for one to do “Im not asking if itd be easy, im asking if she could do it. S: shes so good at answering questions L: this group of 3 should never be allowed to operate together They go get the other party members “How was the lord up north who died?” T: fucking prick. He tried to get us to murder his son on the off chance we survived. Even his last moments he was a fucking prick

The sewers of the city used to be another city, now theyre sewers.” Pull out a map, then a 2nd map, nearly identical More fleshed out is street map of underneath caldrith recovered from a dusty tome, likely procured by shopkeep Other is sewer map, tho some streets are expected to be missing, and some are due to decay and time. “We’ve seen Ildor Ilnudor going down there as well. But we’ve seen him in transit, so we dont know how he relates.” F: what do u want then? “Well to access, you need to be a student.
