True love should be someone that if they were to die, id feel the call to kill myself immediately.” “So how can the gods service you?” F: ill be honest we werent expecting u T: none of the spires are quite worth what youd be charging for them, no offense
“Our goddess needs many. How abt this, you allow me to erect a shrine for the drowned lady and ill do one for free?” “How can the gods help you today?” T: uh IOU? “Ok! Can i stay here and build a shrine then” Yeah u can do that There’s a glowing sword in the room??? +2 STRIKING SHIFTING cold iron LONGSWORD Also shield next to it is magical Spellguard shield We look around Dragon head labelled venomfang of thundertree Some paintings with knives used for stress relief Most of the alcohol is in a date system that doesnt make sense to us (“DR”) Duke Siroth’s journal bottom left room Fitz room Treaty on the schools of magic, notably abt conflicting schools and consideration of the removal of the necromancy school Blank scrolls An imp skull A basic kyber crystal A bloody looking amulet that looks like the gems from the spider skeleton Pendant of the occult Candle room - Incredibly powerful item, symbols match the egg room. Make motes of light, look like little moons or stars abt the room. 13 in total - Maps that depict a world that no longer exists - Books seem to belong to said world
- Some have been translate into common by the Miryel Siroth Dragon egg? Green dragon egg Old. petrified. Also immaterial and not able to hatch anymore Cards he made to create a new harrow - Machine for carrier pigeons - Worldscale shield - This one is made from the scales of a world dragon. Hardness 9m hp 60, breakthreshold 30 Bolo room - 2 poison daggers, 1 cold iron, 1 silver
- Underground realm with panoramic oil, illuminated by rivers of molten lava and bioluminescent fungi. In the center is a large city (Menzoberranzan) Azrael room Duplicating runes (same runes on each weapon A painting showing the forest transformed by elemental magic, all 4 causing destruction depending on the corner Main general’s room Plans he laid out
Idea for a port of south caldrith, to enable trade to the south Basement Barrel room Ledger book Alcohol distillation from dwarven keep we dont recognize Treasure room So much gold, 1500gp Various treasures including an inert crown with gems removed and various jewelery pieces that are nonmagical Dragon head - requires religion A CONVINCING REPLICA OF THE HEAD OF TIAMAT? (MIGHT BE REAL?) Sword - flashblade (can cast thunderstrike from it) Wondrous statue for stonebreasted owl Gloves - watcher’s armbands Southern room Pickaxe and detailing of an island covered in jungle Throom Worldscales under construction Odd copper-like sheets immune to magic Everbubbling cauldron of lava Activation measures for traps in the castle Impossible to open book/grimoire Magical shards/artifacts that can be reforged. Pseudo mana created by man Devil room Romantistic painting moonlit silver towers, bridge of arcane light between them Broke seascape showing towering cliffs thatre being battered by a storm, contrasts against black fortifications Rennaissance cityscape with spires and dome, canals going thru Meeting room - Desert panorama with golds and reds with a jewel in the middle - Stairway - Academic painting with mountain citadel carved directly in the stone peaks, see glows of fire - Leofric - Landscape showing emerald jungles, ancient zigurats and waterfalls, city that water falls into - Gothic painting with towering black castles in the forest, ravens circling, lightning (CASTLE RAVENLOFT) - Harbor with wealthy mercantile city, unloading treasure of distant lands - Crystalline towers reflecting sunlight on frozen ground, aurora borealis Activating defenses Commander’s room has a button under the desk Leofric moves into there Preispo 7, 1290 burnsten + terin to skill Mira, elwood, ploeton + combat Send them out Preispo 8, 1290 Vasili! :) “Hello! Its only been a few weeks but its felt like years!” S: we missed you! “I missed u too” F: how have things been? “Been better, the hunt hasnt been going well. I have found them but i cant get them.” “My circus will always be open to you, even if things only exist while im in them.” F: what do u know abt the deep soul? “It was defeated around the time of my birth. Apparently it was the cause of the death of my father.” (illusion melts away before snapping into place again.) B: who’s your father? “A common man. I doubt u’d know. But if you do, Curebore.” L: the reason we ask is… our ritual. (explains the basics of the situation) Explain hes connected to the deep soul “I see, makes sense to me. But its my power now.” L: we need a fragment of one of the post advesperascit gods, we were hoping u might be able to help us figure out- “You need a lantern?” T: we wouldnt want to take since u have so few “Would it hurt me?” (yes :( destroy the lantern.) T: we do have other leads “You should seek those other leads.” T: you ever have those moments where u think and then have the realizaiton? “Surely a fragment of the deep soul still exists in rozen?” Occasionally paisley can hear us talk, the mention of the deep soul causes her to shiver We’re still gonna get ur lanterns also btw “Could i recommend a trip to vensare? I could teleport you there if i had enough lanterns. It could be worth pursuing. Its a lovely land, its people are sunny, and it has a circus id die to see. It has gavin rooks in it. The king made carney.”

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 24
Next: Session 26 Preispo 9, 1290
2 day trainride to melissa Preispo 11, 1290 Arrive!
Go to Aldri Ranbin’s Nice retirement house by seashore No windows on the side that is shining with He opens the slits, confused seeing throm and leofric He hugs fitzie whos still being held up Introduces throm and leofric Dressed charcoley colors, dont fit the region, retired here but native to the region Salt and pepper hair, the usual signs of age, no notable injuries despite knowing fitzie “Well come on in. vacation or visiting me?” “Lifes been boring.” Everything for a place type, bookshelf he keeps tidy, most unclean thing is his leftover coffee that he watches the waves and reads most days He does seem oddly meticulous “Well Melissa is declining, but still impressive “Still, youre bound to graduate any day now arent you?”
“I could also check in with the mistress, now that i’m retired i could finance the next student that gets chosen.”
He wants to talk to the duke as well Tell him abt the lanterns
He leads us thru the streets to where we can see the wizard towers The Realms' Relic Appears to be 3 stories tall, standing up around the area, finely carved stone and glass, outside obelisk with glyphs and circles around, showing various wares and showing illusions Person running is a tall catfolk man Looks at us “well come on in! How can i help you?” L: we’re looking for some lanterns, they look like this “Ah, some of those. And what do you want with them?”
T: we just want them to go back to their rightful owner “Rightful or the right owner?” T: rightful “And how do u determine that?” T: they were in his possession, then stolen, and he’s a dear friend “So it sounds neither whether he’s a rightful owner, but that he is a right owner.” T: i guess so “Someone tried to sell me them” T: asked too much? “Of course. 2k gold for a simple lantern.” T: that’s a lot! “It is esp for smth like that. Its bound to bring ruin if it goes into the wrong hands. I dont like to carry stock that could cause ruin when in the wrong hand.” L: wdym? “Oh, they have oneiric magic on them. The kind that would make a person step into a delirious dream and never step out if they didnt know what they were doing. “So long as he’s not trying to using it to escape from reality, its fine.” L: sooo hypothetically theyu were doing that, any advice for what one might do “That? Im a simple wizard turned salesman. I dont deal with the science of psychology.” L: know any wizard turned psychologist?
“Not particularly. The newest of that kind come from St. Sirnach to the north. Tho! There is a powerful witch there who could help, but idk how u would get in contact.” L: her name?
“We know her as the mistress of Heawich, but alas, the name doesnt come to me now.” F: kyrie? “Oh yes. Mistress edoful. Eedoful?”
“I heard that she has a university there. And you seem a student yourself. You could go that way.” “It seems cruel to study stars and harrow in this era, no?” “Are you sure you want the lanterns still? Knowing they could poison him?”
“Ik the man who tried to sell it to me. Assuming you don’t… cause issue. He’s a man by the name Rafael Cortés. Ye high (7ft). Ik he frequents that place near the less prestigious part of town, the Stout Wench. Hes not a criminal sort. Just a scam man.” L: would u happen to have heard anything abt the auction for the hand of a god? “Of course. Why do you ask?” F: is it actually a hand of a god?
“I dont know. But ik that some of the caldera families are looking to get it back, so probably. Ik the Navarro Family is wanting to get it back.” F: stolen?
“Stolen? Easier to determine between you and me, than not nations. The hand would technically belong to the royal family of caldera, but it crushed inward, destroying the port and them. And since theyre no longer here despite there ‘the rightful owners’ even if they were an owariyarn family that happened to be on a ship when the meteor that created caldera fell. Are they actually rightful owners then??” F: uhhhh idk? “Legally yes!” F: but u dont believe so “Well u were asking abt the legality of gods. (talks abt a mr navarro) Anyway im all for small talk but are u buying anything” He has boots of bounding, aeon stone of delaying, also smth on the corners that helps with the heat (night breeze machine) We buy bolo a spike launcher Aldri looks back “why the interest in the hand? Is it related to the… yknow.” “The hand’s not in the city. It’d be somewhere nearby. Holding it in a demiplane or somewhere esoteric. If it was in the city the family could use pinpoint and thieves could steal it. But if u put it in the ruins in the jungle near melissa, theyd never get it. Not in 2 years at least.” Stout Wench Area is incredibly packed Immediately a large burly man reaches toward sachiko “u cant be here” S: im a grown adult leshy! “Ive heard that before” S: how can i prove? “If u go back and get ur parents permission” “There’s a naiad spring 2 kilometers to the south. 15 mins each way.” We pay 10gp to let sachiko in Able to make eye contact with the man, who smiles when we saw we paid to enter, beckens us over Man in surprisingly ok blue coat waves “What brings honest sailors this way?” l: heard its the best place to buy unconventional wares “Tower downtown has better ones, but i can get you this and that. Maybe we should do business elsewhere, youre liable to get scammed if u stay here” L: thanks for looking out for us “I think a little kindness goes a long way in this life.” He takes us to the nearby docks, has set up shop on an abandoned dock that is clearly cleaned and he did an okayish job but none of the posts are scraped of barnacles “I had this imported recently, should be fine. Only about 10gp.” T: keeping our wits about us, maybe just straight to business “It is business, you went to drink, didnt you?” T: no 7ft orcish man “Well for one, i dont do that kind of work but i dont do work and not with a child.” L: no its about the lanterns! “What abt them?” F: interested buyers? Pay him 30gp
“Well she didnt pay for confidence. Isabella Deluna. Witch. Half elven. Not really from around here, lives around the ruins.” F: say what she was interested abt with them? “No. but she bought them at an unreasonable price. Managed to sell them for abt 1k each.” T: quite the markup. “Quite, especially for some rusty old things i found. Happened to be floating down a river.” “I could even lead you to there. You’d need a guide to guide you. If you want, u can pay me, ill take u to the ruins. But wahtever happens happens and ill be 100gp richer.” He leads us to the beautiful seaside ruins Points toward a collapsed tower “she’s somewhere in there!” Yell out for her, sopping wet woman swims up “have you come to make a deal with the witch?” Maybe yes! “What can i do to help?” L: we heard u got some lanterns we’d like to learn more abt them? “Learn abt them or get ur hands on them?” L: learn abt them! “Powerful magical artifacts.” L: do u know who they belong to, or who made them? “They belong to me now. 2 of them. They werent made either, they just exist.” “I cant part with them. My patron wants them. A powerful hag.”
L: wouldnt happen to be Malgara? “It will be. If i can just provide her 2 lanterns.” L: hoping to be a witch or upgrading? “Upgrading of course.”
L: not Sani? “No.” T: why do u want to make a deal with malgara?
“More power! Right now i want to be able to teleport around, maybe go even past the Warp zone.” (she’s interested in. her people were slaves to aboleths that lived near that region. Its believed that some of the ruins are there, believed that theyre in caldera. Meteor hitting ocean floor couldve pushed the ruins past the warp to where they can be viewed.) “Once you get past the abyssopologic zone, you start teleporting around. Creatures can go out of the warp, but not into it.” Leofric stating with absolute certainty that we’ll be destroying malgara so its useless to go to her
“Duke Miryel Siroth failed. And urgan failed.” F: we’re going to rise above them “And if i stop you here and now?” T: you won’t. We do a silly run around getting to her with sharks in the water “Well done. I’ll sell it to you for 4k gold.” We sell sachiko’s lvl 18 bottled sunlight for it She goes and grabs them from the deep “Try not to drop them while jumping the shark.” L: he’s cool now right? “No. they’ve been trained to eat land dwellers. A local gang used to deposit bodies in the water. Theyre like pigeons fed on bread.” L: well It was lovely meeting you The man is there happy we survived and have the lanterns He wants to buy them back we say no Ask abt the demiplanes “There’s one in the senate for sure. That one’s free. Rumors, none verified. They wouldnt advertise such a thing, but i do know a way u could find out urselves. If u want to buy the Cortés plan, 20gp.” We give him 15gp
“Well, the Irora Family has it. Theyre not so publicly working with the Zaragoza Gang for protections. So why not see where they go outside the city. They may not go the first few times but they will go eventually.” F: howd you find this out? “Oh, simple, they were always the lead gang and worked inside the city until a week before the auction was announced, adn then thye worked outside. Now a gang that runs the port i can see why theyd want the market. But one that runs both why would they need to be outside the city? Or why a central part of the gang seems to be missing at the same time.” F: do u know when they were last seen leaving the city? “They dont leave per se, they leave for 1 and then return the next day. They never leave out the same gate either.”
(the gang itself came into some notable wealth thru unknown means, they started small between them. One day gold started washing out of the ocean to them and they started to make it big time. Then able to get in w a few senators, went from small to major. Wouldve happened before travespoir, 3ish years before. (THATS ROZEN’S TAXES FUCK ME))

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.title: Session 26
sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 25
Next: Session 27 Preispo 11, 1290
Melissa
To uncle Aldri Ranbin again He seems to have been in the middle of paperwork, closes his books Gives us some coffee “Im not the best but i know some basic spells” mending leaves clear marks, but he pours it in “There’s 2 reasonable options. One is unfortunate for you, one makes it impossible for you. My best guess? They have a teleportation circle set up. Probably left by the old empire. Ive met a few. Theyre not smart enough to cast it, so itd have to be auto. The other is they have a wizard capable enough to teleport them.”
“The boys arent very smart, the Zaragoza Gang. The way i see it, they didnt want the lower levels ot know where they were going. Lest they speak it at a tavern. It does mean that whatever means theyre teleporting with could be turned off. If u can turn it off, u’d buy yourself a minimum of 3 days. Could be up to a month of time theoretically, but i dont want to overestimate. Also, if its a month’s worth of time, theyd likey hire a wizard to send in reinforcements.”
“Theoretically, if i could suggest smth uncouthe? Amalphie Zaragoza, she’s not super bright or but is trusting. She could be a way in. you’d just have to confirm shed been out of the city” “....i dont believe leofric’s her type anyways.”
Go to the Stout Wench Leofric enters first Seaside tavern
Able to see Rafael Cortés smiling, drinking on our coin, he pays 1 whole copper for whatever swill they have, walks over “how are you doing good friend?” L: well, how abt u? “Good! Newfound fortunes my way.” L: yeah??? “Say those lanterns you bought dont happen to be for sale do they? Cant blame a man for trying. The price just seems to keepn going up” L: another offer or? “Just asking again.” L: u dont happen to know if amalphie zaragoza is here today? “Depends on why youre asking?” L: just want to converse. Buy you some drinks first? “Just want to converse, but u dont know what she looks like?” Leofric offers a gold, he denies it “Maybe we leave her out of this?” (genuine care. He’s afraid whatever bullshit we get into will drag back to her.) L: are you involved somehow? “Grew up in the same orphanage. She’s a bit too trusting. And do u know what happens to gang members who talk? Where do u think those sharks got the taste for human flesh in them?” L: we certainly wouldnt… as much as we need info, that would be causing someone to get hurt like that is not an option. Do u know if shes particularly attached to the city? “And your plan?” L: we own a great deal of land.
“And whenever the Navarro Family have their items stolen from them, and 1 who happened to be in charge goes missing… what are the next steps.”
L: our land is in caldrith, which is of course is protected by Duke Vantreau. “It helps. But assassins exist.” L: do you have any alternatives to getting the info we need? Anyone you particularly don’t like? Better protection against assassins? Im a good hearted fellow, but not the brightest “No but i think you’d be another customer. Id even give you a discount.” L: :( ok :( “Another way in… have you followed them to the portal?” B: know where it is? “I dont. But it’s a demiplane, and those have portals.” L: we havent been able to- this was our first attempt to finding someone to follow. “Who told you to find her? Im not a criminal but id punch them.” L: i wont tell you. Id take the punches instead. “Ok. i respect a man with conviction.” He punches him in the throat, he stops others from jumping him “You need someone who can actually walk the streets” L: im hoping this is followed up with a proposition of some kind? “A few ways we could go about this. Are u good at stealing?” L: im not but i know someone who is “Then… i propose theres a key to get in and not a mere passphrase. I only know for a few reasons, but most of which ive seen a few leave on patrol while incredibly drunk and on zerk. If it was spoken id doubt theyd remember. But they didnt come back until months later. They likely dont keep it unguarded, but there’s quite a few who… wouldnt say no to a kind patron buying rounds of drinks. Then when theyre out, have ur sneaky friend come pick up their bags for them. Ideally, if i were to propose smth. Have them take from a few people, its not a targeted attack but an opportunistic pickpocket.” L: hgave u ever considered being a salary worker “I cant leave the city” L: bc of ppl or smth abt the city? Throm and leofric stay to drink “I would suggest tailing smth to the spot that they use to teleport, they might lock it down before some goes missing.” Bolo takes a gate, he’s able to see a person leave around 1am He follows, sneaking and trailing behind An abandoned naiad spring! 2 statues whose eyes glow whenever someone passes thru, move when they dont think ppl are watching. A tree that shifts against the wind The next group, returning, steps out of the spring Preispo 12, 1290 Throm and leofric drinking Warden goes down Leofric goes and “passes out” for a bit Bolo pickpocketing Gets 50gp and the key from the warden Can rest up to 2pm Preispo 13, 1290 Uncle aldri gives throm and leofric bread Have to go thru the jungle, mosquitos biting at us Step into the spring Gargoyles Resistance physical Janky aoo Whipping willow joins the fight Heal up over an hour Step out of the portal and into an odd ruin that descends down into the earth A wingless choral angel looks at us “why have you come?” Its a bit odd to see, but not theoretically impossible. Punished angel. He wears the colors of abadar “You are not the buyers.” L: we need it to open up a trade route to the south, which will save a lot of people!
“That is good and all. But are you the rightful buyers? The hand of abadar is to be sold. You would deny my god his ability to be sold?” (using it in the ritual will displace it) L: the hand may be lost for a time, but this will possibly increase its mystique and rarity, garnering a higher price. We’d also be willing to build a temple in travespoir to him “I like the way that u bend the truth to fit your goals. The god himself would be most pleased by it. Are those your advisors that whisper to you?” L: yes “And they make these plans with you?” L: yes “Then this will be a most fruitful grouping. Do what u need down there. And if you need to kill whatever is down there to get what u need, by all means.” F: sorry. Smth down there? “People. And dead people, the like. Those who walk.” S: zombie? “I wouldnt call them all zombies. They’re able to understand.” S: undead! “Yes, undead. My understanding is u will gain far more experience in the near future.” “Dont worry, its not a physical distance you’ll be going.” Go down the step Its So Dark 2 voices on the otherside of the door Idle chitchat of when the next group will show up Go back to shut down the teleporter Thinks arcane wisdom is rare “Its good to see you carrying on the tradition. We’ve encountered too many who use magic non-freely. Constrained. They dont innovate. They dont have a capitalistic approach.” Theres no other way out but climbing. “You are only abt 30 miles from the city.” With the deal done the angel will maybe have his wings Agrees to fly us out if he does Goes thru the door Combat Statue of a man with wings and a bird head Melted sundial? Area is oddly silent Silent spell placed upon the doors, all of them, doors Room with odd alchemical formula, meant to make u forget when u imbibe it. If u willingly imbibe, u forget anything Notes are mostly burnt 2 are not burnt One in zondian, one in common, both read the same State that one can achieve a closeness of god by imbibing the liquid, making u forget ur secrets/ur knowledge of them
Norgorber is a big thing abt forgetting things, children of the night, etc Door with giant skeleton on an autopsy table Chair and slab Has necromancy on it, 8th rank All of the books are rotted out here Sit on the chair, the bones twitch, jaws moving, before disintegrating into dust We go into another room, kill all but one, tie him up Papers scattered around Various diary notes from members about their time in the city. Anything related to the city got thrown into the cage No one in the cages as far as we can tell Statue to the north we cant recognize Symbol about “rebirth” Books on the shelves are sometimes legible Detail odd rituals to be done here, dont seem to make sense
Relate to jafatan way to preserve the dead, around tunseel into ensile and into yenitaht Put the “return to the first” onto rebirth. Causes a shift somewhere Man we tied up randomly dies in the cage???? Appears that he died due to his soul leaving his body, starteda necrosis mark. Small mark where his throat was slit from inside the esophagus itself. Minotaur like figure, with that with the head of a god but not a bull Sachiko gives each a shroud No magic in either outside of faint evocation Room with a desk Hidden compartment underneath, have to close the drawer partially Childlike drawing map drawn by one of the people here
Faerûn map????? 8 coffins for 8 people up top

sessions/where-eternity-took-root-campai.description:
Prev: Session 26
Next: Session 28 Preispo 13, 1290 Spirits are restless here, what sachiko has done has helped, but eventually theyll get restless and come back as undead If we leave the bodies here, they will return as undead Go downward, doors open to the sounds of groans Combat Mummies :( OZ THE MUMMY?
Tall woman, old looking, looks like a mummy, long stark white hair, doesnt look threatening, matronly figure. Dark olive skin (Rionn)
Her familiar, Nona, comes out, very dark blue furred cat, midnight black. Look closer at her eyes, and theyre dark black with speckled white. Looks normal and then flies toward the mummy with dark blue wings Halls go silent as the undead die Rionn is so confused She knows shes from the candlekeep coast Map is kinda familiar to her, but shes def been places there. Has familiar names She doesnt realize shes a mummy
Has heard of Menzoberranzan but. Never been there No form of id on her/identifiable gear Throm tries to take her pulse, her skin steals some of his moisture This is the way some mummies can infiltrate society. Cant disguise herself as anything else, but does appear to be living somewhat Odd circle symbols that she associated with the apocalypse back at her home Flowing water It smells of death Rionn knows to Not go into the water This table was made for a grander design than the skeleton, isnt as magical Not sure of its purpose. We are missing half the table of inscription Communication device, similar to slate of distant letters. Writing on it would be sent somewhere else or be received Fitzie tries to write on it, nothing seems to happen Bolo finds in the drawer a white garment with a large blood stain across it Not priestly, looks more military esque Fresh blood Bloodstained waistcoat, notably special magic item thats created when a person feels anguish when a comrade dies in their arms You then can take the waistcoat, they must die by someone else’s hands. Unknown the condition why this one was created tho Reduce flat check to recover from bleed, u can also take it and put it onto an ally and take their bleed Extra room with glowing ankh that we activated earlier Notes relatively readable They seem to be left behind Be a meandering group of poems The people here seem confused, dreamlike logic of poems isnt intentional but rather they mix up 2 locations together Switching the names between them, causes a difference. Each line transitions normally, but the overall part is 2 poems mixed together Describing sort of foresty/near a forest town. Located along hills and countrysides.
Poem is quite simple, person attempting to write a poem and as they begin writing, if the similarities between the 2 locations get too similar, they switch them. Then begin writing the 2nd location, and when they start describing the 2nd location that matches the first they switch. Describing Phandalin and an unknown 2nd one. Go back and forth between them until they stop. Poem is incomplete

Some people were waiting for an unknown signal to attack Rionn Another cup of tea “For the ritual.” R: for the ritual. Am i supposed to feel smth? “No it will all be instant, i’m afraid.” (she’s not lying, the prince is impatient. The ritual isnt supposed to take this long.) She drinks “What are you here looking for?” -tea R: the home which i forgot… She continues Others They rush us along We have a friend tho! Still ehre! “She’s probably dead already.” “With how large the city is, we think he killed a tenth of the populace. Made everyone forget.” L: if opur friend is alive, we cant leave her alive “How do you plan on breaking into the capital? So long as she’s with the cleric, she’ll be safe.” T: we’ll trust you for now. S: promise? “I promise. Nothing bad will happen.” Move thru the streets, ppl move on us` Rionn Priestess will end her miracle 2 parts to it, well 3 As soon as its complete, it projects across the room Chosen priestess of the pale queen See 2 memories 1 of a kindly grandma in faerun
1 of a scumbag from melissa/miranda, heavy in gambling debt who makes a contract with Draven Košarek Simple u help my contracts get this hand, when theyre done, youre done The other person sees the apocalypse of faerun, all crumbling, as the convergence happening Her world, her grandchildren kileld in front of her Othe rperson held down by cultists, forces to drink odd water Whoever the scumbag was no longer exists, only rionn exists. The eye is shoved in, odd skeletal hand Body of an anadi, the memories of a kindly grandma now, and the soul of… not sure which one That’s how the story ended, creature holding her down’s face is blurred. With 1 touch, the 1 handed figure mumifies her From there, there’s the part of the prince’s ritual that plays In the case of her immediate death, that would make whoever nearest count. By this ritual that i allow u to do this, can it be me. To which, the ritual allows the slight override, allowing him to be the next kin of the realm since she’s the only known person who has any ownership of the realm Teleportation circle for her and companions, we are all thrown thru space and time 4th is inheritance rights, requires hidden combatant to take his strike on rionn Kills rionn Tumble into caldrith Blue light calls, the one called for the resurrection for the party
Philomene A group plopped down in front of her, arrow struck Rionn starts slipping from our minds, except for phil Miracle on rionn, she pops back into our minds Get to the bridge to the duke
Alphons Acton “Why are you here??? He told me that if i saw u in the city for…. Another day, i should kick ur asses?” Extenuating circumstances! “Lady phil u can go” P: can they come with me :) T: unknightly to deny a lady’s request. Wouldnt want ur honor to be called into doubt “U may pass, u may pass.” Sir mentums and the duke talking, as various men women and others dance around them in the fey courts Duke looks at us, stands from his chair Walks down angrily, ready to punch us P: ehlis! Its so good to see u! “And its good to see you lady philomene, if u could go inside ill be right with you” P: itll take longer, i ran into these ppl shot dead in the street, they appeared via teleportation, i used a miracle on them. Ill do res for the proper ritual “Please wait inside my lady.” P: absolutely! Mwah! Nice to meet you all Go inside, cold iron chains have dust on them T: ik we agreed to stay away for a while. My lord it was an emergency. Didnt choose to do it “We’ll stop this one together. Do you have any knights underneath you?” No? “Is rionn a lord?” R: of a dead realm? “Are you a lord of this realm? Does she own part of ur castle?” Yes (lying) “Of course. Then by his actions hes attacked numartu. And this time 2 months from now we can call a king’s meet. It a tournament between kings in dirmandian lands, u can fight to contest this. U need 10 people. He’ll have royal guards and shrin. Alphons and i will serve as 2 for you.” “Friends anywhere can swear fealty to you as long as ur not lords.”
S: can we ask Homveran Zenderholm?
“He is related to a pseudo king, but isnt one himself.” “There’s nothing stopping you except your common sense.” “If you need one, ser mentums tho sworn to another lord is sworn to protect the lord’s children.” We call leofric our king for this The prince has “the heart of a lion and the legs of a coward” “By entering you forfeit all rights. But dirmandian law says you must enter, assuming there is a reasonable cause. The next in line is Reignare, who helped us before and is doing refugees Duke ushers us out We have 2 months. Just need to ask ppl who we think could stand a chance. Fitzie receives her school key from an unknown source, slightly modified
Go to the twin night and ale
Hi Arelis Vantora and alphons. Time to drink

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
